Oblast & Medžuslovjansko objasnjenje & English explanation
Oblast & Medžuslovjansko objasnjenje & English explanation
Osnovna ortografija & Čitateljski tekst upotrěbjaje deklarovanu osnovnu površinu za opcionalne bukvy. Tuto ne jest generično odstranjenje diakritiky: ě i drugi razlikujuči znaky ostavajut, a tuđe imena i citaty sut zaščitene. & The reader uses a declared basic surface for optional letters. This is not generic diacritic stripping: contrastive signs such as ě remain, and foreign names and quotations are protected.
Morfologija & Padež, rod, čislo, aspekt i glagolna osoba sut dio terminološkogo izbora. Genitiv množiny glagolnyh imen ima -anij/-enij; tretja osoba množiny ima završno -t; pridavničko soglasovanje slijedi stvarny zaglavnik. & Case, gender, number, aspect, and person are part of the term choice. Verbal-noun genitive plurals take -anij/-enij; third-person plurals take final -t; adjective agreement follows the actual head noun.
Polisemija & Jedna iztočna riječ može zahtěvati nekoliko ciljnyh konstrukcij, a jedna podobna ciljna familija može skryvati nekoliko iztočnyh smyslov. Zato slovnik preferuje smyslove razděljenja prěd globalnym zaměnjenjem. & One source word may require several target constructions, while one similar-looking target family may hide several source senses. Sense partition therefore precedes global replacement.
Imena i identitety & Polny avtorsky, citatny, naslovny, vydavateljski i bibliografičny identitet ostavaje v iztočnoj površini. Samo ime, ktoro stvarno prěma medžuslovjansku morfologiju v běžnom tekstu, může imati integrirany eponimny korenj. & Complete author, citation, title, publisher, and bibliographic identities remain in their source surface. Only names functioning with Interslavic morphology in running prose may use an integrated eponymic stem.
Latinica i kirilica & Latinica jest jediny redagovateljny jezyčny kanon. Kirilica jest deterministična projekcija; ona ne jest nezavisny prěvod i ne može sama potvrditi termin. & Latin is the sole editable language canon. Cyrillic is a deterministic projection, not an independent translation and not independent evidence for a term.
Matematika i TeX & Formuly, komandy, oznaky, odkazy, ključe citat i drugi ne-jezyčni objekty ne sut slovničny material. Jezyčna redakcija mora ohranjati njihovu strukturu i čitateljsku funkciju. & Formulae, commands, labels, references, citation keys, and other nonlanguage objects are not dictionary material. Language editing must preserve their structure and reader function.

Gramatične i pravopisne konvencije / Grammatical and orthographic conventions

Leksičny izbor, gramatična funkcija i pravopis trěbujut različne razloge. Slědujuče zapisy objasnjajut, kako tute razlike upravljajut čitanjem terminov. Etimologične i historijne formy sut sravnenja, ne avtomatično preporučene formy glavnogo prěvoda.

EN: Lexical selection, grammatical function, and spelling require different reasons. These entries explain how those distinctions affect the reading of terms. Etymological and historical forms are comparanda, not automatically preferred forms for the translated reader.

Sklanjanje čislovnika dva / Declension of the numeral two

LING-01

Oficialna gramatika čislovnikov dava dva i žensku formu dvě, genitiv i lokativ dvoh, dativ dvom i instrumental dvoma. Izbor zavisi od funkcije v věte, ne samo od podobnosti napisa. Posebno, ranějša forma dvěma ne može iměti jednu zaměnu v vseh kontekstah: dativ trěbuje dvom, instrumental dvoma. Formy dvuh, dveh, dvěh i dvaju v razmotrenyh genitivnyh ili lokativnyh konstrukcijah ne imajut prednost nad deklarovanoju paradigmatoju. To jest gramatičny razlog, ne glasovanje jezykov. Pojavjenjska tabela zachovuje razliku medžu padežami; ona ne dava razrěšenje zaměnjati čisla, indeksi ili citaty.

EN: The official numeral grammar gives dva and feminine dvě, dvoh in the genitive and locative, dvom in the dative, and dvoma in the instrumental. The selection depends on the sentence, not spelling resemblance alone. In particular, the earlier form dvěma cannot receive one replacement everywhere: a dative context requires dvom, an instrumental context dvoma. The forms dvuh, dveh, dvěh, and dvaju in the examined genitive or locative constructions have no priority over the declared paradigm. This is a grammatical judgment, not a vote among languages. The occurrence table preserves the case distinction; it does not license altering numbers, indices, or quotations.

Leksična osnova i njezina pisemna forma / Lexical identity and its written form

LING-02

Oficialny slovnik podpira osnovy pomoč-, cělost-, cěnnost- i prislovnik imenno. Etimologične zaglavja pomoć, cělosť i cěnnosť trěba razlikovati od osnovnogo pravopisa togo izdanja: pomoč, cělost i cěnnost. Imenno znači točno imenovanje, ne dějanje imenovanja, ktore sugeruje imenujuče. Pri matematičnoj cěnnosti izbrana jest imennikova familija cěnnost-, ne automatno vsako slovo s podobnoju osnovoju: pridavnik vrědnostny ne byl rěšeny tym pravilom. Pět složenyh pridavnikov s cěločislovn- imajut zapis s cěločislov-; samostojno čislovno ne spada pod tu ograničenu odluku. Razlog za leksičnu osnovu, razlog za sklanjanje i razlog za pravopis sut različne pytanja; slovnično zaglavje samo ne dokazuje vsaku matematičnu upotrěbu.

EN: The dictionary supports the lexical families pomoč-, cělost-, cěnnost-, and the adverb imenno. Its etymological headwords pomoć, cělosť, and cěnnosť must be distinguished from this edition’s basic spellings pomoč, cělost, and cěnnost. Imenno introduces an exact designation rather than an act of naming suggested by imenujuče. In mathematical value contexts, the noun family cěnnost- was selected; this did not settle every related word, including the adjective vrědnostny. Five compound-adjective forms with cěločislovn- were assigned cěločislov-, without extending that decision to unrelated bare čislovno. Lexical identity, inflection, and spelling therefore require separate reasons. A dictionary headword alone does not establish every technical use.

Smysl, upravljanje i soglasovanje v věte / Meaning, government, and agreement in the sentence

LING-03

Německy argument upravljaje izborom cěloj konstrukcije. Uzimanje teorema v obzir vyražaje se s obzirom na ili vzame v obzir, ne slovesom, ktore označaje uređenje. K prostějšej zadače zachovuje dativ po k; pridavnik postavjenoj ne trěbuje proměnu samo zato, že susědny oblik jest nepravilny. Jedinym uslovjem jest instrumental, a taky stepen trěbuje pridavnik, ne prislovnik tak ili tako. Komponent jest mužskogo roda: primarny komponent soglasuje se s tym imennikom i s genitivom množiny komponentov. Nahodet i govoret slědujut paradigmě nastoječego vrěmena; etimologična bukva ę ne jest sama dokazom za slovesny konec. Tute odluke objasnjajut gramatičnu i smyslovu funkciju; one ne opravjajut formuly ili nepravilnosti v avtorskih matematičnyh znakah.

EN: The German argument determines the whole construction. Taking a theorem into account is expressed by s obzirom na or vzame v obzir, not by a verb meaning to arrange. K prostějšej zadače preserves the dative governed by k; the adjective postavjenoj does not require alteration merely because a neighbouring form is defective. Jedinym uslovjem is instrumental, while taky stepen requires an adjective, not the adverbs tak or tako. Komponent is masculine: primarny komponent agrees with that noun and with genitive plural komponentov. Nahodet and govoret follow the present-tense paradigm; the etymological letter ę is not by itself evidence for a verbal ending. These decisions concern grammatical function and meaning. They do not emend formulas or irregularities in the author’s mathematical notation.

Gramatičny rod termina upravljaje jego okolinom / A term’s grammatical gender governs its surroundings

LING-04

Prsten i ideal sut mužske imenniki. Izbor termina zato imaje poslědstva za pridavniki, zaimenniki i prědikativne formy, ne samo za samo zaglavno slovo: grupovy prsten, izomorfny ideal i vsaky ideal trěbujut soglasovanje. Slična kontrola dava žensku formu linearna, ne linearnaja. Někoj- s običnoju paradigmoju jest osnova za někoje. Zaglavje prěkriženy trěbuje isto imenovanje v sodržanju i v samom oddělu, ako obě označajut isti pojem. Izomorfizm jest jedno slovo; pečatna granica reda v německom Iso-/morphismus ne stvara dve slova. Tute principy ne dokazyvajut, že vsako soglasovanje v korpusu jest pravilno. Konsultacija konkretnogo pojavjenja ostavaje nužna, osoblivo pri terminah, čij rod ne odgovarja rodu ranějšej kandidatnoj formy.

EN: Prsten and ideal are masculine nouns. Selecting the term consequently affects adjectives, pronouns, and predicative forms, not just the headword: grupovy prsten, izomorfny ideal, and vsaky ideal require agreement. The same kind of grammatical comparison supports feminine linearna rather than linearnaja and někoje from the ordinary někoj- paradigm. A heading using prěkriženy should name the same concept in the contents and the corresponding section. Izomorfizm is one word; the German printed line division Iso-/morphismus does not create two words. These principles do not establish that every agreement in the corpus is correct. Individual occurrences still require examination, especially when the selected noun has a different gender from an earlier candidate.

Razloženje i genitivne konce / Decomposition vocabulary and genitive endings

LING-05

Osnova razlož- veže slova o razloženju s oficialnym razložiti, zapisanym etimologično råzložiti. V familijah razlož- i nerazlož- bukva ž jest čestju leksičnoj formy, ne voljnym okrašeniem slova. Prosty z v razloz- ne jest zasnovany drugim smyslom v razmotrenyh pasažah. Genitiv mužskogo ili srědnjego roda ima konec -ogo v deklarovanoj paradigme: ktory, dodatny i svezany ne trěbujut paralelnu paradigmu na -oho. Rozhodujuči razlog jest slovnična osnova i gramatika; velika čestota istej formy v korpusu služi kako dodatno sravnjenje, ne kako zaměna za normativny dokaz.

EN: The stem razlož- connects the decomposition vocabulary with dictionary razložiti, written etymologically råzložiti. In the razlož- and nerazlož- families, ž belongs to the lexical form rather than being optional decoration. Plain z in razloz- has no distinct sense in the examined passages. Masculine or neuter genitives take -ogo under the declared paradigm; ktory, dodatny, and svezany do not require a parallel -oho paradigm. The grounds are lexical evidence and grammar. Frequent use of the same form in the corpus supplies a consistency comparison, not a substitute for that evidence.

Slovesna forma ne može byti opreděljena samo po koncu slova / An ending alone does not identify a verb form

LING-06

Oficialna gramatika dava -et za tretju osobu množiny drugoj konjugacije. Zato nahodet, govoret, tvoret i naležet trěba sravnjati s toj paradigmoju, ne izvoditi konec -ęt iz etimologičnogo pravopisa drugyh slov. Ale vzęt v izrazu jest vzęt označaje trpny pričestnik od vzeti, ne osobnu formu nastoječego vrěmena. V osnovnom pravopisě on piše se vzet. Razlikovanje jest morfologično: pričestnik ne može byti obražen kako slučaj paradigmy tretjej osoby. Pričestna i osobna forma mogut iměti podobny konec bez istej gramatičnoj funkcije. Prěpis bukvy po osnovnom pravopisě ne měnja tu funkciju.

EN: The official grammar gives -et for the third-person plural of the second conjugation. Nahodet, govoret, tvoret, and naležet must therefore be compared with that paradigm, rather than deriving an ending -ęt from etymological spellings elsewhere. But vzęt in jest vzęt is a past passive participle of vzeti, not a finite present-tense form. Its basic spelling is vzet. The distinction is morphological: a participle cannot be treated as an instance of the third-person paradigm. Participles and finite forms may have similar endings without sharing a grammatical function. Converting an optional letter to basic spelling does not change that function.

Čest i srodne formy v osnovnom pravopisě / Čest and related forms in basic spelling

LING-07

Pravilo osnovnogo pravopisa dava e vměsto opcionalnogo ę. Tym objasnjajut se čest, čestično i srodne formy; to ne jest izbor novogo korenja. Oficialny pravopis razděljuje etimologično objasnjenje od běžnogo pisanja, a slovnične priměry takože upotrěbjajut osnovne formy. Iz toga ne slijedi, že vsako podobno slovo jest pravilno: sčestnik trěbuje osobnu leksičnu analizu, a padež i tvorjenje učestjem sut odvojeno pytanje. Odstranjenje opcionalnogo znaka ne može služiti kako dokaz za lemma, smysl ili gramatičnu konstrukciju.

EN: Basic spelling uses e in place of optional ę. This accounts for čest, čestično, and related forms without selecting a new lexical root. The orthography distinguishes etymological explanation from ordinary writing, and dictionary examples also use basic forms. It does not follow that every similar word is correct: sčestnik requires a separate lexical analysis, while the inflection and formation of učestjem raise another question. Removing an optional mark cannot establish a lemma, a sense, or a grammatical construction.

Sumand: tehničny termin bez samostojnogo slovničnogo zaglavja / Sumand: a technical term without its own dictionary headword

LING-08

Německy iztočnik govori o konečnom čislu Summanden. Sumand označaje čest sumy; po mnogo trěbuje se genitiv množiny sumandov. Izbor jednogo m opiraje se na sumandy i sumandov v sravnimyh pasažah istogo děla, ne na samostojno oficialno zaglavje. V konsultovanom slovniku jest suma, ale ne jest točno sumand ni summand. Srodnost s suma i doslědnost v tom samom matematičnom smyslu podpirajut projektno rěšenje; ne ustanavjajut občinskej normy. Dvojno m ne označaje drugy pojem, citat ili gramatičnu funkciju v razmotrenyh pojavjenjah. Slovnik zato prezentuje sumand kako obrazloženy tehničny prědlog s izrično omejenym dokazom.

EN: The German source refers to finitely many Summanden. Sumand denotes a term of a sum, and mnogo governs genitive plural sumandov. The single-m spelling rests on sumandy and sumandov in comparable passages of the same work, not on an independent official headword. The consulted dictionary contains suma but neither exact sumand nor summand. Its relation to suma and consistent use in the same mathematical sense support an editorial proposal; they do not establish community adoption. Double m marks no different concept, quotation, or grammatical function in the examined occurrences. Sumand is therefore presented as a reasoned technical proposal with explicitly limited evidence.

Slovnične osnovy, tvorjenje slov i kontekstualny izbor / Dictionary stems, word formation, and contextual selection

LING-09

Slovničny dokaz podpiraje někoj, několiko, imenno, izslědovati, poslě, těsno, trěbovati, upotrěbiti i vsegda. Pri někojih drugyh familijah trěba objasniti tvorjenje: matričny jest pridavnik od matrica, dělitelj veže se s děliti, a jediničny jest pridavnik, ne zaměna za imennik jedinica. Izčezati dava osnovu za izčez-, zatymčas dopušćati v etimologičnom zapisu odgovarja osnovnomu dopuščati. Pomoč- i cěl- isto trěbujut razlikovanje osnove i njezinoj formy v věte. V izrazu cěly red form izbran jest cěly, ne zato, že cělkovity jest nepravilen, ale radi točnogo lokalnogo smysla i doslědnosti s drugymi pojavjenjami. Korisno jest izjasnjaje koristnost razmatranja; uměstno ima užši smysl prikladnosti i ne dava identičny razlog. Predloženo cěljesȯobrazno ne imělo točnogo slovničnogo dokaza. Soglasovanje pri cělj trěbuje gramatičnu prověrku odvojenu od izbora korenja. Tute različne razloge ne trěba svesti na jednu nezasnovanu čislenu vagu.

EN: Dictionary evidence supports někoj, několiko, imenno, izslědovati, poslě, těsno, trěbovati, upotrěbiti, and vsegda. Other families also require a word-formation argument: matričny is an adjective from matrica, dělitelj relates to děliti, and jediničny is an adjective rather than a replacement for the noun jedinica. Izčezati supplies izčez-, while etymological dopušćati corresponds to basic dopuščati. The pomoč- and cěl- families likewise require lexical identity to be distinguished from the form used in a sentence. In cěly red form, cěly was preferred for its exact local sense and established usage, not because dictionary cělkovity is inherently wrong. Korisno jest states the usefulness of a line of thought; uměstno expresses appropriateness and is not identical in force. Proposed cěljesȯobrazno lacked an exact dictionary attestation. Agreement around cělj requires grammatical examination separately from root selection. These different reasons cannot responsibly be collapsed into an invented numerical weight.

Etimologično zaglavje i osnovny čitatelsky pravopis / Etymological headwords and ordinary reading forms

LING-10

Oficialny slovnik može pokazovati etimologično zaglavje i osnovnu formu istogo slova. Pri dopuščati, skračati, sučstveny i vratnyh slovesah s vrač- bukva č v čitatelskom tekstu odgovarja etimologičnomu ć. Tuto ne jest rěšenje po prostoj čestotě: oficialny pravopis izrično dava ć → č, a slovničny prikaz potvrđuje formy. Vrač v smyslu lěčitelja ili čarovnika jest drugy imennik, ne dokaz za značenje vračati. Sravnjenje trěbuje istu pravopisnu vrstvu i isti smysl; inače možut dvě saglasne česti slovnika izgledati kako protivorěčje. Prednost osnovnoj formě ne izključaje etimologičnu formu iz naučnogo sravnjenja, kde njezina funkcija jest jasno objasnjena.

EN: The dictionary may supply an etymological headword and a basic reading form of the same word. In dopuščati, skračati, sučstveny, and the return verbs with vrač-, reader-facing č corresponds to etymological ć. This is not a decision by raw frequency: the official orthography explicitly prescribes ć → č, and the dictionary’s displayed forms corroborate it. Vrač meaning a healer or sorcerer is a separate noun, not evidence for the sense of vračati. Comparisons must use the same orthographic level and the same sense; otherwise two compatible parts of a dictionary can appear to contradict each other. Preferring basic spelling in the reader does not exclude etymological forms from scholarly comparisons where their purpose is stated.

Dvě osobne pravila: ć → č i đ → dž / Two special correspondences: ć → č and đ → dž

LING-11

Za osnovny latiničny pravopis oficialna norma dava dve osobne odgovaranja: ć piše se č, a đ piše se dž. To ne jest opče odstranjenje vseh diakritičnyh znakov. Napriměr, č ostavaje č. Pravilo opisujuče zapis ne izbira novo slovo i ne měnja jego matematičny smysl. Priměnjaje se na medžuslovjansku prozu; ne daje pravo proměniti slovo v točnom inojezyčnom citatu, ime v bibliografiji ili identifikator v formule. Takve razlike morajut byti naznačene prěd avtomatičnym prěpisom. V sravniteljnoj tablici etimologična forma može ostati neproměnjena, ibo čitatelj tam izučaje samo odgovaranje medžu pravopisami.

EN: For basic Latin spelling, the official orthography specifies two special correspondences: ć is written č, and đ is written dž. This is not the indiscriminate removal of diacritics; č, for example, remains č. A spelling rule does not select a new lexeme or alter its mathematical sense. It applies to Interslavic prose, not to a word in an exact foreign quotation, a bibliographical name, or an identifier in a formula. Those functions must be marked before automatic conversion. An etymological form can remain unchanged in a comparison table because the correspondence between the orthographies is itself the object being studied.

Opcionalne bukvy i granicy pravopisnogo uproščenja / Optional letters and the limits of spelling simplification

LING-12

Osnovny latiničny pravopis izdanja ne upotrěbjaje opcionalne etimologične znaky v běžnoj medžuslovjanskoj proze. Odgovaranja sut å → a, ę → e, ų → u, ȯ → o, ė → e, ŕ → r, ĺ → l, ń → n, ť → t, ď → d, ś → s i ź → z. Dopustime alternativne zapisy è i ľ odgovarjajut e i l; samo inojazyčno è ne jest medžuslovjansky kandidat za proměnu. Č, š, ž i ě sut čestju osnovnogo alfabeta i ostavajut. Drugoj poredok pravopisnyh informaciji ne može služiti kako nova leksična ili gramatična odluka. Pravilo zato razděljuje čitatelsku prozu, originalne citaty i etimologične sravnjenja; vsaka od tih funkcij potrěbuje svoj zapis. Naučno objasnjenje može pokazati opcionalne bukvy bez vnucanja ih čitatelju glavnogo prěvoda.

EN: The edition’s basic Latin spelling omits optional etymological marks in ordinary Interslavic prose. The correspondences are å → a, ę → e, ų → u, ȯ → o, ė → e, ŕ → r, ĺ → l, ń → n, ť → t, ď → d, ś → s, and ź → z. Permitted alternative spellings è and ľ correspond to e and l; a foreign è is not thereby an Interslavic candidate for conversion. Č, š, ž, and ě belong to the basic alphabet and remain. Presenting orthographic information differently cannot itself settle a lexical or grammatical question. The rule therefore distinguishes reader prose, original quotations, and etymological comparisons, each with its own purpose. A scholarly explanation can display optional letters without requiring them throughout the translated work.

Granice tvrdženja

Slovnik može silno dokumentovati aktualnu izbranu površinu, iztočny smysl, zasvědočenu jezyčnu osnovu, realno odklonjene alternativy i unutrašnju doslědnost. On ne dokazuje, že vsaky govoritelj slovjanskogo jezyka bez trudnosti razuměje vsaku větu, niti že medžuslovjanska občina ili rodny govoritelji potvrdili vse izbory. Profili sut redakcijne sinteze dokazov, ne psiholingvistične mjery. Kde oficialny slovnik potvrđaje samo obyčny smysl, a matematičny smysl dolazi iz disciplinarnoj literatury, ta granica jest imenovana, kako pri prsten.

Povtorljivost, AI-prinos, prava i citovanje

Javny slovnik jest čitateljska sinteza redakcijnyh dokazov, ktore stvarno upravljajut korpusom. Njegov neposrědnje dostavny LaTeX jest samosodrživy, a iztočny ZIP sodrživaje toj samy iztočnik i instrukcije sestavjenja. Stabilny koncept korpusa jest 10.5281/zenodo.21926382; historijska arhivna versija korpusa jest 10.5281/zenodo.23496017; latiničny i kiriličny webovy čitatelj jest dostavny prěz onlajnovy čitateljnik / online reader. Polny čitatelj avtorskogo matematičnogo korpusa ostavaje prvy dokument i PDF-prědgled; slovnik jest oddělny naučny pomoćnik.

Metodološko izloženje i sinteza slovnika sut izrabotane s OpenAI Codex — GPT-5.6 Sol, nivo usilja Ultra; rekonstrukcija terminologičnyh zapisov i daljnje dvojezyčno obrazloženja s OpenAI Codex — GPT-6 Astra, nivo usilja Ultra. Točna identičnost modela i nivo usilja pri naslědženom prěvodu korpusa ne sut pouzdano dokumentovane i ne sut retrospektivno pripisane. Tuto ne podrazuměvaje ljudsku lingvističnu recenziju.

Tekst slovnika a jeho tipografija sut izrabotane AI; matematični originaly, citovane formy, slovniki, gramatiky i sravnjiva literatura ohranjajut svoje avtorstvo i prava. Izdanje jest ponudženo bezplatno za nekomercialne, čisto obrazovateljne cěle na prědpoloženju izdatelja, že nositelji prav ne budu protiv. To jest prědpoloženje, ne ustanovjeno dozvoljenje: bezplatny dostop k originalu sam ne dozvaljaje publikaciju prěklada. Nositelj prav može podati prigovor; izdatelj se obvezuje odstraniti dotičny material na jego zahtěv. Prava na originaly i zaščitjene izvedene prispevky ostavajut pri njihovih nositeljah. Historijske licencijne izjavy sut ohranjene; toj dokument ne davaje novogo dozvoljenja za děla tretjih stran ni za cělo izvedeno izdanje.

Prědloženo citovanje: AI-stvorjena studija medžuslovjanskoj terminologije. Matematičny medžuslovjansky v korpusu Emmy Noether: terminologičny slovnik i metoda izbora / Mathematical Interslavic in the Emmy Noether corpus: terminology dictionary and selection method. 2026. Historijski DOI korpusa: 10.5281/zenodo.21926382.

Method: English version

Purpose and object

This dictionary describes the mathematical Interslavic used in the complete Noether corpus. Its unit of analysis is not automatically a word token. A lexical decision may concern a lemma, an inflectional family, a clause relation, a source-language polysemy, or the boundary between translatable prose and an identity that must remain exact. The Latin text is the editable language canon. The Cyrillic text is deterministically projected from that canon and therefore cannot serve as an independent translation witness.

The dictionary is designed for two readers at once. A Slavic-language reader can use the primary Interslavic account without English. A linguist or mathematician can use the English counterpart to inspect the distinction between source fidelity, cross-Slavic evidence, and editorial judgment. The alphabetical table is intentionally compact; expanded discussion is reserved for decisions whose structure cannot be understood from a gloss alone.

Research questions and the limited claim

Interslavic is a planned zonal language intended for practical comprehension among speakers of Slavic languages, not merely as an exercise in language construction. Previous scholarship has discussed it as an instrument of receptive multilingualism and cross-border access in the Slavic region . The present study asks whether a broad historical mathematical corpus can serve as a controlled site for developing its technical register; whether a language model can compare several kinds of evidence without itself becoming the authority; whether every consequential choice can be documented in a form that a non-technical language specialist can review; and whether the method can transfer to another domain without training a new model.

The practical hypothesis is that a language model can assist candidate generation, corpus comparison, and consistent terminology use when source meaning and linguistic evidence remain the basis of assessment. This study documents such a method; it does not measure time saved against a human-translation baseline. The Noether corpus does not establish the optimality of every form, comprehension by every Slavic reader, or successful transfer to another discipline.

The reader’s starting questions

A linguist needs to know which proposals might be useful to Interslavic, what supports them, and where the evidence is insufficient. A mathematician needs to know whether the same objects, conditions, and arguments survive translation. A researcher wishing to repeat the method needs to know which sources to collect, what to give the model, and how to recognize a wrong answer. The dictionary and methodological account are organized around these questions. Reading the explanations requires no programming knowledge.

Each entry must distinguish four things: the mathematical concept, the selected expression, the evidence for it, and the limits of the claim. An early glossary form may be a proposal rather than a recommendation. Frequent occurrence does not establish the correctness of a sense. Where a reason has not survived, the entry says so; a new explanation cannot be passed off as historical testimony.

How to use the materials

The translated author-work reader and the account of its making are separate objects. The reader remains the first document and PDF preview. The present publication contains:

  • the current canonical dictionary governing the frozen reader;

  • all 2,574 recovered original terminology records, aggregated without loss into 2,016 distinct source–Interslavic pairs;

  • 168 public lexical, semantic, grammatical, orthographic, source-fidelity, notation, and identity decisions from the main normalization lineage;

  • the complete role-policy account for 4,560 reviewed projection records, including 364 corrected classifications and eight added identity-protection spans;

  • all twelve final normalization decisions and all 4,053 occurrence-level changes;

  • machine-readable JSON and CSV crosswalks, direct LaTeX, and a reproducible source package.

“Canon” here means the internally consistent editorial basis of this edition. It does not mean an official decision by the Interslavic community. The stable identifiers and occurrence maps are designed precisely so that specialist review can revise a rule without reconstructing the entire production history.

What the AI did—and did not do

A generative language model is software that produces text from statistical patterns learned from large collections of text. It can compare formulations, propose grammatical paraphrases, and follow elaborate instructions. It is not a dictionary, a language academy, a mathematical source, or a conscious witness to the provenance of every form it proposes. It can confidently invent an unattested word, blend national standards, or alter a mathematical relation, especially in a low-resource language. Research on low-resource translation likewise shows that supplying dictionaries, grammar descriptions, and examples does not by itself solve retrieval and understanding failures ; terminology constraints help, but mechanical enforcement can reduce fluency .

The model therefore has three legitimate roles here: it proposes candidates, compares them against supplied evidence, and manages consistency across occurrences. It has no fourth role as a language legislator. A decision must expose its evidence, scope, rejected alternatives, and uncertainty. This accords with concept-oriented terminology work, where object, concept, definition, and designation are distinguished before a preferred term is chosen . Polysemous source forms receive separate sense records rather than one global replacement.

The method uses an existing language model without training a new system. The researcher supplies the text, relevant passages from grammars and dictionaries, subject literature, and reasoned terminology decisions. The practical requirement is to prepare suitable sources and a well-defined assignment, not to construct a new model. Calling this “zero-shot” would obscure the role of those sources, examples, and prior decisions. Repeatability means that another researcher can repeat the comparisons and tests; it does not mean that every model must propose identical wording.

Reconstruction of the production method

The surviving evidence distinguishes several kinds of work. The source was divided into identified units accompanied by 215 glossaries containing 2,574 records: a German term or concept, Russian and Ukrainian comparanda, an Interslavic candidate, a rationale, and an uncertainty annotation where present. These files constitute the original terminology base. The presence of a comparison word in a glossary does not by itself establish consultation of a particular scholarly source.

The translation trials compared an English intermediate text, separation of prose from TeX and mathematics, and direct translation from German. Preserving every mathematical identifier is necessary but insufficient: the right number of identifiers does not establish correct prose or logical relations. Thirty-one units of the lecture-book text were translated into Russian, Ukrainian, and Interslavic with model assistance. The surviving evidence does not reliably establish the exact model identity or effort level for that translation, nor does it establish human editing.

The linguistic analysis distinguishes vocabulary, sense, grammar, orthography, and fidelity to the source. A separate question concerns the boundary between prose that can be transliterated and names, quotations, Roman numerals, and mathematical identifiers whose identities must be preserved. These are not merely different spellings of words: the function of a sign in the argument determines whether a transliteration rule applies. The occurrence tables make that distinction inspectable in particular passages. Where only later evidence survives, the account is explicitly reconstructive; a later explanation is not presented as contemporaneous testimony.

A repeatable workflow for another domain

  1. Define the mandate. State audience, register, script, domain, rights, source edition, and claim boundary.

  2. Identify and preserve the source edition. Retain the whole text, numbering, formulae, references, and bibliography. Keep a translation of the author’s text separate from any editorially corrected edition.

  3. Read a language and disciplinary canon. Consult the target grammar and dictionary and relevant subject literature in representative Slavic languages; record passages actually used.

  4. Number passages and identify material that must remain exact. Divide the text into meaningful sections. Mark formulas, typesetting instructions, identifiers, quotations, and names whose identity must be preserved.

  5. Request a translation of one identified passage. Supply the passage, relevant evidence, and an explicit description of the required answer. If formulas are separated from prose, restore them exactly and check their order and relation to the translated sentences.

  6. Create concept records. For every non-trivial choice record source concept, target form, grammatical role, branch comparanda, official evidence, disciplinary use, and context. Split polysemy by sense.

  7. Compare the candidates. First exclude expressions that change the source’s mathematical meaning. Compare the remaining candidates for support in Interslavic resources, recognition across Slavic branches, technical usage, consistency, and ambiguity. Report historical numerical weights only where they were actually used.

  8. Record the decision. Preserve the selected form, genuine alternatives, reasons for rejection, uncertainty, and scope.

  9. Map every occurrence. Check each local sense and exclude homographs, citations, names, and mathematical symbols from a global replacement.

  10. Verify language and structure. Compare source and target claims, quantifier scope, signs, references, morphology, aspect, and terminology. Compilation proves only technical buildability.

  11. Maintain one editable text. Derive the other script by stated transliteration rules, preserving names, quotations, and mathematical identifiers where required. Inspect the resulting pages and provide the reader, editable source, dictionary, and supporting data together.

  12. Make particular choices open to criticism. Number the decisions and identify their senses, evidence, and occurrences. A specialist should be able to challenge one choice without having to reconstruct the whole project.

Semi-automatic terminology systems commonly separate corpus processing, term extraction, database population, and database management . This workflow adds two requirements specific to a planned interlanguage: balanced comparison among language branches and an auditable boundary between a model proposal and the accepted editorial canon.

How a specialist can review the result

Applying the method to one passage

A researcher can begin with one complete mathematical argument, such as a definition and its first example. Identify the source passage by author, work, section, and page or numbered paragraph. Read enough surrounding text to establish the notation and assumptions. The passage is a working unit, not a substitute for the full corpus to be translated.

Prepare three short components: the passage itself, relevant language and subject sources, and previously justified terminology. A bibliography without the pertinent passages is insufficient. For a new mathematical concept, distinguish attestation of an ordinary word from attestation of its technical sense. For a word with several meanings, first state which relation the sentence expresses. The model may propose a form and a reason, but a quotation from a book must be found in the book, not accepted on the strength of the model’s assertion.

The answer for one passage has three readable components: the translation, its terminology and grammatical decisions, and unresolved questions. A compact decision record is sufficient if it gives the concept, selected form, relevant source, genuine alternatives, and reason. When no defensible alternative has been found, say so; do not invent a second candidate to fill a comparison table. When a source supports only a broader or different sense, state that limit.

Checking the translation is not the same as asking again whether it is good. Compare particular claims: the subject and referent, the objects quantified over, the assumptions and conclusions, and the scope of conditions and negation. Compare candidate forms within whole sentences, including gender, case, and government. The prsten example shows why replacing a noun without checking agreement around it is insufficient.

After selecting a rule, locate other occurrences of the concept. Searching for a spelling helps, but the same spelling may have another sense. The occurrence table is therefore a concordance: a list of passages in which the rule’s applicability can be examined. It is not proof of correctness by itself. A CSV table opens in an ordinary spreadsheet program; JSON represents relationships for automatic processing. Reading JSON is not necessary to understand a linguistic decision.

What the reconstruction can establish

Contemporaneously recorded reason.

A surviving record states why a candidate was selected. This establishes the documented reason, not automatically its correctness.

Later examination.

A form is compared with a source not documented at the original selection. That comparison may support or challenge the form, but does not establish earlier consultation.

Procedure for repetition.

The method specifies how decisions should be documented and checked in a new corpus. This is not a claim that every historical decision followed an ideal procedure.

These distinctions let a specialist examine both a useful proposal and weaknesses in its evidence. The absence of a numerical weight is not the absence of a reason: many choices turn on a difference of meaning or a grammatical rule, neither of which requires a vote. Where numbers are used, however, their units, complete contributions, and arithmetic must be available. The reconstruction concerns documented decisions, not inaccessible internal thoughts of the model.

Questions for scholarly assessment

A specialist need not review “the AI” as a single object. Each entry supports six ordinary scholarly questions: Was the source concept identified correctly? Is the target form supported by the declared grammar and orthography? Are the compared Slavic traditions representative? Is the technical sense attested rather than inferred from an ordinary-language cognate? Are alternatives and ambiguity stated honestly? Were all and only the relevant occurrences found?

This design follows evidence that professional evaluators using full document context and explicit error categories produce more informative judgments than aggregate crowd scores . Automatic metrics also remain unreliable for distinguishing all small but meaningful differences among strong translations . The publication therefore does not replace expert judgment with a score. It supplies a bounded claim, its evidence, and a revisable occurrence set.

Decision hierarchy

The method has five layers, but they are not five votes of equal status.

  1. Preserving mathematical meaning is indispensable. A candidate must preserve the object referred to, the structure of the argument, the scope of quantifiers, and the relations expressed in the proof. Widespread usage or an attractive etymology cannot justify a term that changes the claim.

  2. Official Interslavic evidence anchors the language. The declared dictionary and grammar provide lemmas, paradigms, aspect, government, and connective structure. An ordinary-language headword does not by itself establish a specialized mathematical sense.

  3. East, West, and South Slavic comparison is diagnostic. The branches are considered in balance to identify recognizability, concentration, and false friends. This is not a raw population vote, and the number of available books in one language is not allowed to dominate the result.

  4. Disciplinary and internal corpus evidence resolves technical use. Mathematical usage can establish a technical extension that an ordinary dictionary does not record. Existing corpus frequency matters only after inherited source bias and error have been considered.

  5. Readability and ambiguity break ties among admissible candidates. A form that can be parsed without English and does not silently merge two mathematical relations is preferred.

Different choices require different kinds of examination. A spelling convention may apply to a family of forms, whereas a word with several meanings requires attention to each sentence. A citation or identifying label must remain recognizable; a mathematical sign is not a word to translate. The surviving records do not establish that every earlier choice received equally thorough examination. Alternatives are reported where they were genuinely considered, not invented to make the selected form look inevitable.

Weighting without false precision

The evidence profile in the dictionary uses five symbols: source fidelity (S), official Interslavic support (O), branch comparison (V), corpus or disciplinary fit (K), and readability (R). A filled mark means direct strong support, an open mark limited or indirect support, and a dash that the decision did not rely on that layer. The marks are an explanatory synopsis, not calibrated probabilities and not a hidden numerical model.

Numerical weights are shown only where the historical decision actually used them. The algebraic-ring decision divided evidence into six equally weighted Slavic groups. The prsten/pierścień root received 2.5 units, kolco 2.0, okruh 1.0, and kolobar 0.5. Official evidence established broad recognition of the physical-ring root, while mathematical books established its technical use. Because East Slavic uses a different root, the first corpus occurrence supplies Russian кольцо and Ukrainian кільце as a reader bridge. No comparable numerical history is fabricated for terms whose decisions were qualitative.

The complete arithmetic is shown below. The six-group structure follows the language project’s design criteria ; the contributions reconstruct the recorded totals from the documented root assignments.

@Yrrrr@ Language group & prsten & kolco & okruh & kolobar
Russian & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0
Ukrainian and Belarusian & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0
Polish & 1 & 0 & 0 & 0
Czech and Slovak & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0
Slovene and Serbian/Croatian/Bosnian & 0.5 & 0 & 0 & 0.5
Bulgarian and Macedonian & 1 & 0 & 0 & 0
Total & 2.5 & 2 & 1 & 0.5

Prsten has the largest share, not an absolute majority of the six units. More books or occurrences confer no extra vote; grouping it with Polish pierścień is a linguistic judgment about cognacy. The reported corpus observations contain no separate Belarusian or Bosnian counts. This is consequently not an equally sampled empirical study of every named language, still less a comprehension experiment. The complete numerical record is supplied in RING_COMPARISON_WEIGHTS.json.

Why semantic partitions matter

Three families illustrate the method particularly well.

First, German gilt cannot be represented responsibly by one borrowed national predicate. Czech and Slovak use platí; Croatian uses vrijedi; Polish uses zachodzi or ma miejsce; Slovene uses velja; and Bulgarian frequently uses fulfilment constructions. The edition therefore selects among imaje město, jest pravdivo, izpolnjaje se, može se priměniti, and ostavaje v silě according to the source relation.

Second, discourse connectives are selected by clause function. Causal zato že, inferential zato, equivalential to jest, naming imenno, conditional ako…to, additive takože, and result/purpose tako že are not stylistic variants. Substituting one for another can reverse or blur the proof structure.

Third, apparent cognates are tested against sense. Mathematical containment is sodrživati; content is sodržanje; hold back is zadržati. Existence is obstajati; essentiality is sučstveny; composition is sostojati se iz. Imperfective assumption is prědpokladati; perfective, passive, adjectival, and nominal supposition uses belong to the prědpolož- family. Similar spelling is evidence to investigate, not a conclusion.

Reproducibility and limitations

The public dictionary is a human-readable synthesis of the exact editorial evidence used for the corpus. Its directly downloadable LaTeX is self-contained, and the source archive contains the same source plus build instructions. The stable corpus concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21926382; a historical archived version of the corpus is 10.5281/zenodo.23496017; the live Latin/Cyrillic reader is available through onlajnovy čitateljnik / online reader. The complete author-work reader remains the first file and PDF preview; this dictionary is a separate scholarly aid.

The dictionary does not claim native-speaker validation, community endorsement, or independent peer review. A historical proposal, a form attested in the translation, and a linguistically justified recommendation establish different things. For example, the presence of masculine prsten does not certify the agreement of neighbouring words; the coexistence of zamknjen- and zatvorjen- in passages on algebraic closedness does not establish a single preferred form. Such differences require contextual examination, not an inference from word counts. A scholarly objection should identify the affected sense and supply contrary or stronger evidence, while distinguishing a revised language choice from an unchanged mathematical source.

AI-work disclosure, rights, and citation

The mathematical authors are Emmy Noether and the named co-authors: R. Brauer in Paper 32; R. Brauer and H. Hasse in Paper 38. M. Deuring prepared the account of Noether’s winter 1929/30 lectures in work 44. Paper 45 is by H. Kapferer, with an appendix jointly written with E. Noether. Their mathematical authorship is distinct from the AI translation and the present linguistic study.

Termini i dokumentovane alternativy / Terms and documented alternatives

Zapisy razděljujut iztočny pojem, zabilěženu medžuslovjansku formu, ruske i ukrajinske sravnjenja i razlog izbora. Formy iz ranogo prěvoda sut historijne prědlogy, ne avtomatično aktualne rekomendacije. Sravniteljna forma v glosaru ne dokazuje sama po sobě konsultaciju konkretnogo odbornogo iztočnika. Kde razlog ili grafija ne sut zachovane, objasnjenje to izrično govori.

EN: Each entry distinguishes the source concept, recorded Interslavic proposal, Russian and Ukrainian comparanda, and reason for the choice. Early proposals are not automatically current recommendations. A comparison form in a glossary does not by itself establish consultation of a particular scholarly source. Missing reasoning and damaged spelling are explicitly identified.

forma \(\mu\)-go stepena po \(x\) i \(\lambda\)-go stepena po \(u\)

Iztočnik / Source: \((\mu,\lambda)\) eine Form \(\mu\)ten Grades in \(x\), \(\lambda\)ten Grades in \(u\)

Rusky / Russian: форма \(\mu\)-й степени по \(x\) и \(\lambda\)-й степени по \(u\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: форма \(\mu\)-го степеня за \(x\) і \(\lambda\)-го степеня за \(u\)

Razlog: Forma ima dva nezavisna stepena: μ po proměnnoj x i λ po proměnnoj u. Prěvod izgovarjaje oba odnosa, aby čitatelj ne směšal bidegree s jednym ukupnym stepenem. Zapis -go pri simbolu označaje porědkovo čislo; arhivny razlog go predstavlja kako praktičnu pisemnu konvenciju, ne kako dokazanu jedinu mogućnost.

Reason: The form has two independent degrees: μ in x and λ in u. The wording states both relations rather than suggesting one total degree. The suffix -go after a symbol was recorded as a practical way of writing the ordinal, not as an independently established unique solution.

\(\lambda\) jest proizvoljno

Iztočnik / Source: \(\lambda\) beliebig

Rusky / Russian: \(\lambda\) произвольно

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \(\lambda\) довільне

Razlog: Proizvoljno označaje, že λ ne jest ograničeno osobnym izborom. Zapis se opira na obyčno matematično vyraženje v ruskom i ukrajinskom i na doslědnost s upotrěbljenjem v oddělu 18. To jest razlog registra i doslědnosti, ne čisleno sravnjenje vseh slovjanskyh jezykov.

Reason: Proizvoljno expresses that λ is arbitrary. The recorded reasons are ordinary Russian and Ukrainian mathematical usage and consistency with Section 18. This is a register-and-consistency argument, not a numerical comparison across all Slavic languages.

\(n\)-e korenje iz jedinice

Iztočnik / Source: \(n\)te Einheitswurzeln

Rusky / Russian: \(n\)-е корни из единицы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \(n\)-ті корені з одиниці

Razlog: Korenje iz jedinice jest prěmy algebraičny izraz. Zapis upotrěbjaje poznate sostavne slova i ne vidi potrěbu tvoriti osobny novy termin. Čislo n ostavaje čestju matematičnogo opreděljenja; zapis sam ne dokazuje, že vsaka padežna forma jest normativno prověrena.

Reason: The proposal uses the familiar algebraic expression for roots of unity rather than coining a separate term. The index n remains part of the mathematical specification. The short original reason does not establish that every inflected form has been independently checked.

konečno algebraično razširenje nad

Iztočnik / Source: (endlicher) algebraischer Körper über

Rusky / Russian: конечное алгебраическое расширение над

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: скінченне алгебраїчне розширення над

Razlog: Razširenje nad izjasnjaje odnos algebraičnogo polja k osnovnomu polju v sučasnom matematičnom registru. Konečno zachovuje ograničenje iz iztočnika. To jest izrično terminologično osuvrěmenjenje: v diplomatskom prěvodu trěba prověriti, že ono ne pribavjaje ili ne gubi nijednu hipotezu.

Reason: The recorded choice expresses the field-over-base relation as a finite algebraic extension, using modern mathematical terminology. It is an interpretive modernization, so a diplomatic translation must check that it neither adds nor removes a hypothesis.

(p)^alpha abo jediničny ideal

Iztočnik / Source: (p)^alpha oder Einheitsideal

Rusky / Russian: (p)^alpha или единичный идеал

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: (p)^alpha або одиничний ідеал

Razlog: Izraz zachovuje dvě alternativy: stepen lokalnogo prostogo generatora i jediničny ideal. Razlog se odnosi na tų matematičnu razliku. Sam zapis ne dava nezavisnogo opravdanja za veznik abo; on zato ne dostaje za rekomendaciju vsej historijnoj formy.

Reason: The reason preserves the dichotomy between a power of the local prime generator and the unit ideal. It concerns that mathematical distinction. It does not independently justify the conjunction abo, so the record alone cannot recommend the entire historical wording.

reducirana norma / reducirana diferenta

Iztočnik / Source: (red.) Norm / (red.) Differente

Rusky / Russian: приведенная норма / приведенная дифферента

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: зведена норма / зведена диферента

Razlog: Norma i diferenta imajut osobny algebraičny smysl; pridavnik reducirana go odliča od drugyh vrst normy ili diferenty. Arhivny izbor zachovuje internacionalny korenj reduciran- radi prepoznajemości. Vagu ili polno medžujezyčno sravnjenje zapis ne dava.

Reason: Norm and different are technical algebraic terms; reduced distinguishes the intended constructions. The recorded proposal retains the international reduciran- root for recognizability. No numerical weighting or complete cross-language comparison is recorded.

-1 kako suma dvoh kvadratov

Iztočnik / Source: -1 als Summe von zwei Quadraten

Rusky / Russian: -1 как сумма двух квадратов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: -1 як сума двох квадратів

Razlog: Vyraženje jest kriterij, ktory se pojavjaje v oběh napravjenjah dokaza. Zato -1, čislo dva i kvadraty morajut ostati jasno razpoznajeme. Razlog podpira semantičnu doslědnost; padežna forma dvoh trěbuje samostojnu gramatičnu prověrku.

Reason: The phrase states the criterion used in both directions of the proof. The value -1, the number two, and the squares must remain identifiable. The reason supports semantic consistency; the inflected form dvoh requires a separate grammatical assessment.

11. poręd / 12. poręd / 13. poręd / 15. poręd

Iztočnik / Source: 11. Ordnung / 12. Ordnung / 13. Ordnung / 15. Ordnung

Rusky / Russian: 11-й порядок / 12-й порядок / 13-й порядок / 15-й порядок

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: 11-й порядок / 12-й порядок / 13-й порядок / 15-й порядок

Razlog: Kratke podzaglavja zachovujut numeričny poręd izloženja. Poręd byl prědložen radi kratkosti, ale sam izvorny zapis ostavjaje otvorjeno sravnjenje s poręda i s vyraženjem čisla slovom. Historijna kandidatna forma zato ne znači zaključen normativny izbor.

Reason: The short subsection labels preserve the enumeration. Poręd was proposed for compactness, but the record expressly leaves comparison with poręda and a written-out ordinal unresolved. The historical proposal is not a settled normative recommendation.

117 form

Iztočnik / Source: 117 Formen

Rusky / Russian: 117 форм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: 117 форм

Razlog: Čislo 117 jest čestju matematičnogo zaključka, ne redakcijna ocěna. Prěvod zachovuje točno čislo i predmet brojanja, formy. Zapis objasnjaje věrnost zaključku, ne novo tvorjenje terminologije.

Reason: The number 117 belongs to the mathematical conclusion, not to an editorial estimate. The translation preserves the exact count and the objects counted, forms. The reason concerns fidelity rather than a newly coined term.

30. marca 1926.

Iztočnik / Source: 30. März 1926

Rusky / Russian: 30 марта 1926 г.

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: 30 березня 1926 р.

Razlog: Nazvanje měsęca jest prěvedeno, a denj i godina ostavajut neizměnjene. Medžuslovjanska forma upotrěbjaje poręd denj–měsęc–godina; rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy imajut svoje obyčne kratke oznaky godiny. Zapis neopravdava směnu samogo datuma.

Reason: The month name is localized while the day and year remain unchanged. The Interslavic proposal uses day–month–year order; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use their ordinary year abbreviations. Nothing in the decision licenses a change to the date itself.

5./6./... poręd

Iztočnik / Source: 5./6./7./8./10./11. Ordnung

Rusky / Russian: 5-й/6-й/... порядок

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: 5-й/6-й/... порядок

Razlog: Terminom poręd se zachovuje nazvanje reda upotrěbljeno pri invariantah v drugom dělu. Izvorny zapis podpira doslědnost, ale izrično ostavjaje ortografiju za jezyčnu prověrku. Skračenje s tri točkami jest zapis skupiny zaglavij, ne zaměna za vsako polno zaglavje.

Reason: Poręd continues the invariant-order vocabulary used in Paper 2. The reason is consistency, with orthography explicitly left for linguistic assessment. The ellipsis summarizes a group of headings; it is not a substitute for their complete text.

\D

Iztočnik / Source: \D

Rusky / Russian: \D

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \D

Razlog: Komanda \D označaje isti matematičny znak kako \mathfrak D. Opreděljenje komandy omogožnjaje nabrati znak bez změny njegova značenja. Tuto jest pravilo matematičnogo zapisa, ne slovnično zaglavno slovo.

Reason: The command \D denotes the same mathematical sign as \mathfrak D. Defining the command supplies the typesetting instruction without changing the sign’s meaning. This is a notation convention, not a dictionary headword.

simboly v \pmod{...} ostavajut latinske

Iztočnik / Source: \modu{(...)} / \pmod{(...)} symbolic modulus list

Rusky / Russian: математические символы остаются латинскими

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: математичні символи лишаються латинськими

Razlog: Simboly v uslovju kongruencije ostavajut matematične oznaky i ne sut prěvedene ili prěpisane kak slova. To uključaje latinske s, t, i i J vnųtri \pmod{...}. Pravilo zachovuje identičnost proměnnyh v latiničnom i kiriličnom čitanju.

Reason: Symbols in a congruence condition remain mathematical identifiers rather than words to translate or transliterate. This includes Latin s, t, i, and J inside \pmod{...}. The rule preserves variable identity in both the Latin and Cyrillic readers.

\pmod{(\sigma,s)}

Iztočnik / Source: \modu{(\sigma,s)}

Rusky / Russian: \pmod{(\sigma,s)}

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \pmod{(\sigma,s)}

Razlog: \pmod{(\sigma,s)} jest tipografsko vyraženje istogo uslovja kongruencije kako iztočna komanda \modu{(\sigma,s)}. σ i s ostavajut točne matematične oznaky. Sadržina skobok ne podleži prěpisivanju v drugy alfabet.

Reason: The standard command \pmod{(\sigma,s)} expresses the same congruence condition as the source-specific \modu{(\sigma,s)}. The identifiers σ and s are preserved exactly. The parenthesized mathematical content is not transliterated.

\pmod{(\varrho,t)}

Iztočnik / Source: \modu{(\varrho,t)}

Rusky / Russian: \pmod{(\varrho,t)}

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \pmod{(\varrho,t)}

Razlog: \pmod{(\varrho,t)} zachovuje matematičny uslov iztočnoj komandy \modu{(\varrho,t)}. Izbor se odnosi na nabirku, ne na proměnu kongruencije; ϱ i t ostavajut iste oznaky v oběh alfabeth.

Reason: The standard command \pmod{(\varrho,t)} preserves the condition expressed by \modu{(\varrho,t)}. The choice concerns typesetting, not a change to the congruence. The identifiers ϱ and t remain the same in both scripts.

a jest děljiva črez t / ideal a, kratny od t

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Aktualny tekst v dělu 31 ima po odnošenju k klasu i po odnošenju k osnovnomu prstenu. Kopija slovnika citovana v rěšenju o toj konstrukciji davaje oba zaglavja po odnošeńju k (18227) i v odnošeńju k (19113), s dativom i smyslom ‘po odnošenju k’. Zato argument, že samo prva forma jest oficialna, ne podpiraje izbora; konsistentna prednost jednoj formě može byti redakcijnoju konvencijeju. Osobny prilog vȯzhodno (4185) znači ‘na vȯzhod’, ne ‘po odnošenju k’. To ne opravdaje ranějše vzhodno k. Kratke odnosno (4107) ima rodni padež i zato ne jest mehanična zaměna frazy s dativom. Čitatelsko po odnošenju k slěduje osnovnomu pravopisu, kde ń prěhodi v n. Sravnjenje podpira značenje i padežno upravjanje, ne dokaz izměrenoj prednosti v razumělivosti.

Textual comparison: The current Paper 31 text has po odnošenju k klasu and po odnošenju k with the base ring. The dictionary copy cited by the decision supplies both po odnošeńju k (18227) and v odnošeńju k (19113), each with the dative and the meaning with regard to. The claim that only the former is official therefore cannot justify the choice; consistently preferring one remains a possible editorial convention. The separate adverb vȯzhodno (4185) means eastwards, not with respect to, and does not justify historical vzhodno k. Shorter odnosno (4107) governs the genitive, so it is not a mechanical replacement for a dative construction. Reader spelling po odnošenju k follows the basic-orthography treatment of ń as n. The comparison supports meaning and government, not measured superiority in intelligibility.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Aktualny tekst v dělu 31 ima po odnošenju k klasu i po odnošenju k osnovnomu prstenu. Kopija slovnika citovana v rěšenju o toj konstrukciji davaje oba zaglavja po odnošeńju k (18227) i v odnošeńju k (19113), s dativom i smyslom ‘po odnošenju k’. Zato argument, že samo prva forma jest oficialna, ne podpiraje izbora; konsistentna prednost jednoj formě može byti redakcijnoju konvencijeju. Osobny prilog vȯzhodno (4185) znači ‘na vȯzhod’, ne ‘po odnošenju k’. To ne opravdaje ranějše vzhodno k. Kratke odnosno (4107) ima rodni padež i zato ne jest mehanična zaměna frazy s dativom. Čitatelsko po odnošenju k slěduje osnovnomu pravopisu, kde ń prěhodi v n. Sravnjenje podpira značenje i padežno upravjanje, ne dokaz izměrenoj prednosti v razumělivosti.

Textual comparison: The current Paper 31 text has po odnošenju k klasu and po odnošenju k with the base ring. The dictionary copy cited by the decision supplies both po odnošeńju k (18227) and v odnošeńju k (19113), each with the dative and the meaning with regard to. The claim that only the former is official therefore cannot justify the choice; consistently preferring one remains a possible editorial convention. The separate adverb vȯzhodno (4185) means eastwards, not with respect to, and does not justify historical vzhodno k. Shorter odnosno (4107) governs the genitive, so it is not a mechanical replacement for a dative construction. Reader spelling po odnošenju k follows the basic-orthography treatment of ń as n. The comparison supports meaning and government, not measured superiority in intelligibility.

Reason: Prosta normalna algebra and dělitevna algebra retain two structural expressions from Paper 42. The rationale continues the division-algebra terminology of Paper 40. It does not say that every simple normal algebra is itself a division algebra, or permit normalna to be omitted. Describing the choice as canonical records a project convention, not independent linguistic or mathematical certification.

Reason: Jediničny element names the particular multiplicative identity from which the whole quantities of the prime field are generated by addition and subtraction in the construction. Two rationales connect its use in Papers 9 and 10. They do not assert that addition and subtraction alone generate every element of every prime field; the source claim must not be enlarged by replacing its whole quantities with the entire field.

The macro names a typographical symbol; the ideal’s meaning must follow the definition, not a resemblance between characters. This is a specific notational hazard, not a new definition of zero.

jediničny ideal \(\mathfrak{o}\) / jediničny element / jediničny klas

Iztočnik / Source: Einheitsideal \(\mathfrak{o}\) / Einheitselement / Einheitsklasse

Rusky / Russian: единичный идеал \(\mathfrak{o}\) / единичный элемент / единичный класс

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: одиничний ідеал \(\mathfrak{o}\) / одиничний елемент / одиничний клас

Razlog: Jediničny ideal, jediničny element i jediničny klas moraju ostati tri odvojene izraza. Oba razloga iz odděla 7 govorju, že ideal vseh elementov može obstajati i pri otsutnosti multiplicativnogo jediničnogo elementa v prstenu, dokolě odgovarjajuče polje klasov ima jediničny klas. Zato ne možno iz slova jediničny ideal samo po sobě zaključiti, že prsten imaje \(1\). Tuta lokalna avtorska konvencija trěbuje osobno objasnjenje.

Reason: Jediničny ideal, jediničny element and jediničny klas must remain three distinct expressions. Both Section 7 rationales say that the ideal of all elements can exist even when the ring has no multiplicative identity element, while the associated field of classes has an identity class. Unit ideal alone therefore does not justify assuming that the ring has \(1\). The author’s local convention needs explicit explanation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Podnožna primětka raboty 30, odděla 7, izrično nazva \(\mathfrak{o}\) idealom vseh elementov i dopušča, že v prstenu ne ima jediničnogo elementa, iako polje klasov ostatkov ima jediničny klas. Rabota 24, odděl 1, takože definira \(\mathfrak{o}\) kako ideal vseh elementov. Primětka raboty 19, odděla 6, dodava drugo ograničenje: \(\mathfrak{D}\) igra jediničnu rolu pri děliteljnosti i najmenšem občem kratnom, ne pri tvorjenju produkta. To sut različne konkretne upotrěby tojže familije slov. Prěvod ne smije vnesti sovrěmenny predpoklad, že vsak prsten ili modul iz teksta už jest zadany s jedinicoju i jediničnym dějstvom. Pasaže podpiraju razloge v TERM-0433–0435; ne dokazujut avtomatično smysl vsakego drugogo pojavjenja jedinica.

Textual comparison: The footnote in Paper 30, section 7 expressly calls \(\mathfrak{o}\) the ideal of all elements and allows the ring to lack an identity element even though the residue-class field has an identity class. Paper 24, section 1 also defines \(\mathfrak{o}\) as the ideal of all elements. Paper 19, section 6 adds a different restriction: \(\mathfrak{D}\) has an identity role for divisibility and least common multiple, not for ideal multiplication. These are distinct contextual uses of the same word family. Translation must not import a modern assumption that every ring or module in the text already comes with an identity and a unital action. The passages substantiate the reasons in TERM-0433–0435, not automatically every other occurrence of jedinica.

Dva zapisa zachovuju jedin razlog s tym izričnym ograničenjem. Skračenje do prosto jedinica bez operacije moglo by proměniti matematično tvrdženje. Reason: Jediničny ideal \(D\) has a restricted identity role in the cited footnote: for divisibility and least common multiple, not automatically for ideal multiplication. Two records preserve one rationale with that explicit limitation. Shortening this to unit without naming the operation could change the mathematical claim. The identifier \(D\) is not a new lexical part of the term.

It does not justify replacing class by element without retaining the quotient structure. The Russian and Ukrainian lettering and part of the Interslavic spelling have not survived; the dictionary makes this explicit.

This does not license identifying the representative \(1\) with its class without acknowledging the passage to classes.

The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the form of the name.

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: одиничний модуль

The phrase alone does not supply a modern definition of simple or prime module without reading the source’s divisor condition.

jediničny operator

Iztočnik / Source: Einheitsoperator

Rusky / Russian: единичный оператор

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: одиничний оператор

Razlog: Jediničny operator imenuje dějstvo, ne samo element prstena. Razlog naglašaje razklad, pri ktorom toj samy jediničny element dějstvuje kako identičnost na jednom sumandu i kako nula na drugom. Avtomatično poistovjetnjenje jedinicy prstena s identičnym operatorom na cělom modulu by izbrisalo toj slučaj. Prěvod mora zachovati razliku medžu elementom i jego dějstvom.

Reason: Jediničny operator names an action, not merely a ring element. The rationale emphasizes a decomposition in which the same ring identity acts as identity on one summand and as zero on the other. Automatically identifying the ring’s identity element with the identity operator on the entire module would erase that case. The translation must retain the distinction between an element and its action.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 34, odděl 17, počinaje s modulom nad prstenom s jedinicoju, ale ne prědpoklada, že ta jedinica dějstvuje identično na cělom modulu. Ona razklada modul na \(\mathfrak{M}_e+\mathfrak{M}_0\) s pomoču \(m=em+(m-em)\). Na prvoj česti \(e\) jest jediničny operator, na vtoroj nulovy. Tekst potom ograničuje razmatranje prědstavjenij na prvu čest, kde jedinici odgovarjaje jedinična matrica. Ta izrična poslědovatelnost pokazuje, začto element, operator i matrica ne mogut byti zaměnjene jednim neoprěděljenym nazvanjem jedinica.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, section 17 begins with a module over a ring with identity, without assuming that the identity acts identically on the whole module. It decomposes the module as \(\mathfrak{M}_e+\mathfrak{M}_0\) using \(m=em+(m-em)\). On the first part \(e\) is the identity operator; on the second it is zero. The text then restricts its representation discussion to the first part, where the ring identity corresponds to the identity matrix. This explicit sequence explains why element, operator and matrix cannot be replaced by one undifferentiated unity term.

Reason: The phrase specifies replacing some indeterminates by numbers, not indiscriminately replacing all variables. The rationale connects Section 3 with the successive numerical specialization lemma in Section 2. Něktore carries a quantifier restriction. This describes a mathematical operation of specialization, not merely an approximate numerical calculation.

jednorazovy prěnos

Textual comparison: Paper 9’s introduction gives four abstract properties of \(\mathfrak G\): closure under addition, subtraction and multiplication; representation of every complex number as a quotient; inclusion of algebraic integers; and exclusion of nonintegral algebraic numbers. Razlogi svęzujut jego s jednim porodžujučim elementom, polinomnoju bazu, funkcionalnoju oblastju i idealom porodženym prostym čislom. Osoblivo važen jest priměr parnyh cělyh čisel v rabotě 19: vsaky ideal jest glavny, ale oblast ne ima jedinice i ne dava jednoznačnogo produktnogo prědstavjenja čisel. Zato naziv ne dopušča potihom dodati hipotezy sovrěmennogo teorema o faktorizaciji. Obči termin mora čuvati različne uslovja svih teh priměnjenj.

Reason: Glavny ideal is a compositional technical name, not an assessment of an ideal’s importance. The rationales connect it with a single generator, a polynomial basis, a functional domain, and an ideal generated by a prime number. The even-integer example in Paper 19 is particularly important: every ideal is principal, yet the domain lacks an identity and does not give unique product representations of its numbers. The name therefore does not license silently adding the hypotheses of a modern factorization theorem. A common term must preserve the different conditions of these applications.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 19 dava oblast parnyh cělyh čisel: vsaky ideal jest glavny, ale jedinica ne obstaja. Tekst razděljuje idealno svojstvo od jednoznačnogo produktnogo prědstavjenja čisel. Pri prěvodu ne možno potihom vključiti hipotezu jedinice samo zato, že obče slovo glavny pripomina sovrěmenny specialny naziv.

Textual comparison: Paper 19 uses the domain of even integers: every ideal is principal, but there is no identity. The text separates the ideal property from unique product representation of numbers. A translation must not silently insert an identity hypothesis merely because principal resembles a modern specialized designation.

glavny ideal / bazny polinom

Razlog: Glavny ideal i bazny polinom opisuju svęzanu dvojicu: ideal i polinom, ktory daje jeho bazu v argumentu o jednoj prěměnnoj. Razlog pri Teoremě XI raboty 22 zadržuje te dve funkcije. Bazny ne znamenaje, že polinom jest jediny bez dodatnoj normalizacije, ni že vsak mnogoprěměnny ideal imaje jednogo porodžujučego elementa. Prědnost prostoj konstrukciji iz poznanyh korenjev jest kvalitativna motivacija; zaměna svakego slova izolovano ne by sohranila vezu medžu nimi.

Reason: Glavny ideal and bazny polinom describe a related pair: the ideal and the polynomial supplying its basis in a one-variable argument. The rationale for Theorem XI of Paper 22 retains these two roles. Basic does not mean that the polynomial is unique without further normalization, or that every multivariable ideal has a single generator. Preference for a straightforward construction from familiar stems is a qualitative motivation; translating each word in isolation would not preserve their relationship.

Razlog: Glavny ideal \(\mathfrak T p\) i po parah vzajemno proste primarne komponenty sohranjajut vse sučstvene česti frazy. Po parah zahtěvaje uslovje za vsaku dvojicu različnyh komponent, ne samo za vybranu dvojicu. Primarny ne možno zaměniti s prosty: teorem o diskriminantu v rabotě 31 izrično razlikuje vlastno primarnu komponentu od prostogo ideala drugogo roda. Zapis prodolžuje ustaljenu frazu o vzajemnoj prostosti; njegov kratky razlog ne jest nova ocěna vseh jezyčnyh alternativ.

Reason: Glavny ideal \(\mathfrak T p\) and po parah vzajemno proste primarne komponenty retain all the phrase’s essential parts. Pairwise requires the condition for every pair of distinct components, not only a selected pair. Primary cannot be replaced by prime: Paper 31’s discriminant theorem expressly distinguishes a properly primary component from a prime ideal of the second kind. The record continues the established coprimeness phrase; its short rationale is not a new assessment of every linguistic alternative.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Diskriminantny teorem raboty 31 govori o razloženju glavnogo ideala \(\mathfrak T p\) na po parah vzajemno proste primarne komponenty. On potom razlikuje vlastno primarnu komponentu i prosty ideal drugogo roda. Te odvojene kvalifikacije sut nužne dlja točnogo tvrđenja; lokalna makrodefinicija potvrđuje frakturnu bukvu \(\mathfrak T\).

Textual comparison: Paper 31’s discriminant theorem concerns decomposition of the principal ideal \(\mathfrak T p\) into pairwise coprime primary components. It then distinguishes a properly primary component from a prime ideal of the second kind. Those separate qualifications are necessary to the exact statement; the local macro definition confirms fraktur \(\mathfrak T\).

kolco glavnyh idealov

V rabotě 30 izraz priměnjaje se takože k prstenam klasov ostatkov. Zato ne možno avtomatično prěvoditi vsaky takovy naziv kak oblast bez děliteljev nuly: ta hipoteza jest osobna. Starša forma kolco ostaje v sravnjenju kak dokumentovana izbira, ne kak potvrda vseh njezinyh aktualnyh gramatičnyh priměnjenj.

Reason: Kolco glavnyh idealov spells out the property that every ideal is principal. Three rationales support continuity with glavny ideal and a full phrase instead of an unexplained abbreviation. Paper 30 also applies the expression to residue-class rings. It must therefore not automatically become a domain without zero divisors: that is a separate hypothesis. The earlier kolco form remains in the comparison as a documented choice, not as certification of all its current grammatical applications.

Pervy naziv dava algebraično svojstvo; vtory dava rolju prstena v konstrukciji. Novy početkovy prsten ne mora byti istogo specialnogo tipa kak ranějši. Razlog zato zadržuje polny naziv glavnyh idealov i ne vvodit kratice, ktora by skryla tę razliku. Aktualna pasaža izrično zaměnjaje ranějšu osnovu obščim multiplikacijskim prstenom.

Reason: The contrast between kolco glavnyh idealov and izhodno kolco matters to the extension of the argument in Section 8 of Paper 31. The first names an algebraic property; the second names a ring’s role in the construction. The new starting ring need not have the same special type as the earlier one. The rationale accordingly retains the full principal-ideal expression rather than an abbreviation that could obscure the contrast. The current passage expressly replaces the earlier base with a more general multiplication ring.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Početok osmogo paragrafa raboty 31 zaměnjaje ranějši prsten glavnyh idealov glavnym poredkom čislovogo ili funkcionalnogo polja i potom obščim multiplikacijskim prstenom. Njegove hipotezy izrično uključajut odsutstvo děliteljev nuly i egzistenciju jediničnogo elementa. Imena prstena, poredka i polja zato ne sut zaměnime opisy jednoj istej hipotezy.

Textual comparison: The opening of Section 8 of Paper 31 replaces the earlier principal ideal ring by a principal order of a number or function field, then by a more general multiplication ring. Its hypotheses expressly include absence of zero divisors and existence of an identity. The names of the ring, order, and field are therefore not interchangeable descriptions of one hypothesis.

The first leaves open the alternative of a specialized international adjective for principal but gives neither an exact Interslavic form nor evidence of its subsequent rejection. Razlika jest medžu imenom i objasnjenjem, ne medžu dvoma matematičnyma objektama. Prednost kompaktnosti jest zabilěžena kvalitativno; čislena težina za nju ne jest dana.

Rusky / Russian: главный порядок

Zato porjadok tu ne jest poredok grupy ni uporjadkovanje elementov. Historijno nazvanje termina stabilnym znači kontinuitet proektnogo jezyka, ne dokaz obščej jezyčnoj normy. Order here is therefore neither a group’s order nor an ordering of elements. The historical description of the term as stable means continuity of project usage, not proof of a general linguistic norm. Comparison with TERM-0796 is necessary because the same German word received maksimalny porjadok in another paper.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 43 nazyvaje sistem cělyh čisel čislovogo polja glavnym poredkom. Rabota 37 govori o maksimalnyh poredkah i v konkretnom dokazu objasnjaje maksimalnost nemožnostju dalšego razširjenja. Dve historijne motivacije zato podpirajut različne nazvy za svęzane aritmetične objekty. Konsistentna rekomendacija trěbuje sravnjenja definicij, ne avtomatičnoj zaměny vseh pojavjenj Haupt-.

Textual comparison: Paper 43 calls the system of integers of a number field its principal order. Paper 37 speaks of maximal orders and explains maximality in a particular proof through the impossibility of further enlargement. The two historical motivations therefore support different names for related arithmetic objects. A consistent recommendation requires comparison of definitions, not automatic replacement of every Haupt- occurrence.

Aktualny dokaz izrično govori o nemožnosti razširiti takovy poredok do obširnějšego pri danoj osnově. Ta motivacija različna jest od kontinuiteta frazy glavny porjadok pri TERM-0795. Oba razloga trěba pokazati vměstě; prosty spis ne može bez kontekstnogo sravnjenja proglasiti vse upotrěby jednoj formy pravilnymi, a drugoj nepravilnymi.

glavny porjadok / glavna oblast

V rabotě 42 oblast grupuje maksimalne poredky po točnyh aritmetičnyh uslovjah; glavna oblast oprěděljaje se črez prěsěk s podpoljem. Proto oblast ne dolžno avtomatično čitati kak oblast cělosti. Historijna motivacija priznaje potrěbu togo kontekstnogo razlikovanja. Samo sosedstvo slova porjadok ne jest dostatočna definicija; čitatelju potrěbne sut uslovja klasifikacije.

Reason: Glavny porjadok and glavna oblast retain the shared Haupt- element but do not name the same type of object. In Paper 42 an oblast groups maximal orders by specified arithmetic conditions; the principal oblast is characterized through intersection with a subfield. Oblast must therefore not automatically be read as integral domain. The historical rationale acknowledges this need for contextual distinction. Merely placing order nearby does not supply a definition; the reader needs the classification conditions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 42 oblast po danomu podpolju obuhvata maksimalne poredky s jednakym prěsěkom i dodatnymi lokalnymi uslovjami. Ako prěsěk jest glavny poredok, tekst govori o glavnoj oblasti. To jest klasifikacija poredkov, ne opča definicija oblasti cělosti.

Textual comparison: In Paper 42 an oblast relative to a subfield comprises maximal orders with the same intersection and additional local conditions. If the intersection is a principal order, the text calls the oblast principal. This classifies orders; it is not a general definition of an integral domain.

glavny porjadok / kvadrat prostogo ideala

This compositional clarity supports retaining every part of the phrase; anticipated recognizability was not backed by a reader test.
