Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: головний ряд

Razlog: Glavny rjad sohranjaje specialny smysl glavnoj serije podgrup. Oba razloga odbivajut zaměnu obščim nazvom normalnogo reda. V rabotě 34 dopustimost zavisi od operatorov; pri vključanju vseh vnutrnyh avtomorfizmov členi sut normalne podgrupy, a red ne dopušča dopolniteljnogo člena togo tipa medžu sosednymi členami. Ta nemožnost dopolnjenja nosi informaciju, koju prosty naziv normalny red ne izražaje. Historijno rjad i aktualno red ostavajut različnymi zapisami, ne dokazom dvuh različnih matematičnyh konstrukcij.

Reason: Glavny rjad preserves the special sense of a chief series of subgroups. Both rationales reject the more general label normal series. In Paper 34 admissibility depends on the operators; when all inner automorphisms are included, the members are normal subgroups and no further member of the required kind can be inserted between adjacent members. This inability to refine the series carries information absent from normal series alone. Historical rjad and current red remain different wordings, not evidence of two different mathematical constructions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 34 kompozicijny red ne dopušča vstavjenje dalšego dopustimogo normalnogo člena medžu dvoma sosednymi členami. Pri operatorah, vključajučih vse vnutrne avtomorfizmy, tekst nazyvaje jego glavnym redom. Zato istorijne slovo rjad ne možno objasniti samo kak proizvoljny normalny red; potrěbna jest i nemožnost dopolnjenja v danej kategoriji.

Textual comparison: In Paper 34 a composition series admits no further admissible normal member between two adjacent members. With operators including all inner automorphisms, the text calls it a chief series. Historical rjad therefore cannot be explained merely as an arbitrary normal series: the absence of refinement in the specified category also matters.

glavna teorema

Iztočnik / Source: Hauptsatz

Rusky / Russian: главная теорема

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: головна теорема

Razlog: Glavna teorema prevodi Hauptsatz kako centralno matematično tvrđenje. Razlog izrično odbiva doslovnu interpretaciju Satz kak rečenice. Pridavnik govori o rolji rezultata v rabotě, ne o dodatnoj hipotezě ili osobnoj matematičnoj klasifikaciji. Ruska i ukrajinska sravniteljnica podpirajut konstrukciju pridavnik plus naziv teoremy. Sohranjena motivacija ne rešaje odnos femininoj teorema k maskulinomu teorem iz drugih zapisov; tu morfologičnu variaciju trěba razlikovati od matematičnogo smysla.

Reason: Glavna teorema renders Hauptsatz as a central mathematical assertion. The rationale expressly rejects treating Satz literally as sentence. The adjective concerns the result’s role in the paper, not an additional hypothesis or a separate mathematical classification. Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the adjective-plus-theorem construction. The preserved motivation does not settle the relation between feminine teorema and masculine teorem elsewhere; that morphological variation must be distinguished from mathematical meaning.

glavny teorem / pomočny teorem / dodatok / zamětka

Iztočnik / Source: Hauptsatz / Hilfssatz / Zusatz / Bemerkung

Rusky / Russian: главная теорема / лемма / дополнение / замечание

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: головна теорема / допоміжна теорема / додаток / зауваження

Razlog: Četyri nazvy čuvajut hierarhiju izloženja: glavny rezultat, pomočny rezultat, dodatok i zamětku. Pri Hilfssatz ruska sravniteljnica izbira lemmu, a ukrajinska pomočnu teoremu. Medžuslovjansky razlog daje prednost pomočny teorem, ibo lema v toj česti prěvoda ješče nebyla ustaljena. To jest lokalno obrazloženje, ne tvrdženje, že lema ne može byti medžuslovjansky termin: TERM-0816 i TERM-0818 dokumentujut upravo tu alternativu. Dodatok i zamětka takože ne morajut byti avtomatično preimenovane v teoremy.

Reason: The four names preserve the exposition’s hierarchy: principal result, auxiliary result, addition, and remark. For Hilfssatz the Russian comparandum chooses lemma and the Ukrainian auxiliary theorem. The Interslavic rationale favours pomočny teorem because lemma had not been settled in that part of the translation. This is a local justification, not a claim that lema cannot be an Interslavic term: TERM-0816 and TERM-0818 document that very alternative. Addition and remark likewise must not automatically become theorems.

glavny slěd

Iztočnik / Source: Hauptspur

Rusky / Russian: главный след

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: головний слід

Razlog: Glavny slěd jest definovany črez regularno prědstavjenje. Tri razloga zadržujut taj naziv i njegov kontinuitet v rabotě 34, vměsto slobodnoj modernizacije. Smysl se opira na definiciju, ne na predstavu, že jeden slěd jest važnějši od drugogo. Tekst osobno definira redukovany slěd črez različne ireducibilne prědstavjenja; pri razširjenju polja dvě veličiny ne vedut se jednako. Zato glavny i redukovany ne sut zaměnime stilistične dodatky.

Reason: Glavny slěd is defined through the regular representation. Three rationales retain that name and its continuity through Paper 34 rather than modernizing it freely. Its meaning rests on the definition, not on the idea that one trace is more important than another. The text separately defines reduced trace through distinct irreducible representations; the two quantities do not behave identically under field extension. Principal and reduced are therefore not interchangeable stylistic qualifications.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija glavnogo slěda v rabotě 34 odkazuje na regularno prědstavjenje; redukovany slěd definira se odvojeno. Pozdněj pasaža govori, že prvy ne měnjaje se pri prěhodu k algebraično zatvorjenomu polju, a to samo ne jest tvrdženo za vtory. Ti dva nazvy zato ne označajut avtomatično istu veličinu.

Textual comparison: The definition of principal trace in Paper 34 refers to the regular representation; reduced trace is defined separately. A later passage says that the former is unchanged on passing to an algebraically closed field, while the same is not asserted for the latter. The two names therefore do not automatically denote the same quantity.

najvyšši elementarny dělitelj

Iztočnik / Source: Highest elementary divisor

Rusky / Russian: наивысший элементарный делитель

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: найвищий елементарний дільник

Sohranjena motivacija jest kratka: upira se na kontinuitet s ranějšimi paragrafami, ne dava novogo sravnjenja superlativov. Najvyšši dolžno razuměti po poredku, danomu v toj teoriji, ne kak čislenu veličinu proizvoljnogo polinoma. Sam naziv ne može zaměniti definiciju dělitelja i način njegovogo uporjadkovanja. Tablica sohranjaje izbor, ale ne pripisuje jemu nezasvědočenu čislenu ocěnu.

Reason: Najvyšši elementarny dělitelj continues the determinant and elementary-divisor vocabulary of Paper 22. The preserved motivation is brief: it relies on continuity with earlier sections rather than offering a new comparison of superlatives. Highest must be understood in the order specified by that theory, not as the numerical magnitude of an arbitrary polynomial. The name cannot replace the divisor’s definition or its ordering. The table preserves the choice without attributing an undocumented numerical assessment to it.

Hilbertove funkcije

Iztočnik / Source: Hilbertsche Anzahlen

Rusky / Russian: гильбертовы функции

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: Гільбертові функції

Razlog: Hilbertove funkcije jest naměrna modernizacija historijnogo zaglavja Hilbertsche Anzahlen, ne doslovny prěvod slova Anzahlen. Sohranjeny razlog tumači matematičny predmet prěz sovrěmennu terminologiju Hilbertovoj funkcije. Ale rabota 27 sama razlikuje Hilbertove čisla, karakterističnu funkciju i druge čisla Macaulaya. Zato modernizacija može zamagliti razliku, ktora jest predmetom teksta. V diplomatičnom izdanju ne trěba predstavljati taki preimenovany naslov kak věrno sohranjeno zaglavje; moderny pojasniteljny naziv može byti odvojeno označeny. Tuto jest redakcijna odluka i jejo omeženje, ne dokaz, že vse nazvane veličiny sut jedna funkcija.

Reason: Hilbertove funkcije is an intentional modernization of historical title Hilbertsche Anzahlen, not a literal translation of Anzahlen. The preserved rationale interprets the mathematical subject through modern Hilbert-function terminology. Yet Paper 27 itself distinguishes Hilbert numbers, the characteristic function, and other numbers introduced by Macaulay. Modernization can therefore obscure a distinction that the text investigates. A diplomatic edition should not present such a renamed title as faithfully retained; a modern explanatory designation can be separately identified. This is an editorial choice and its limitation, not proof that all the named quantities form one function.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 27 ima zaglavje Hilbertove čisla i razlikuje několiko svęzanyh počtov i funkcij. Bibliografija v dvoh městah piše Hilbertove funkcije. Sravnjenje zato potvrđuje konkretnu razliku medžu tekstom i bibliografičnym opisom; ne opravdava ih potihu identifikaciju. Starša modernizacija mora byti obrazložena kak redakcijna interpretacija, ne predstavljena kak jediny možny věrny prěvod zaglavja.

Textual comparison: Paper 27 is headed Hilbertove čisla and distinguishes several related counts and functions. The bibliography reads Hilbertove funkcije in two places. The comparison therefore establishes a concrete difference between text and bibliographical description, not justification for silently identifying them. The earlier modernization needs explanation as an editorial interpretation, not presentation as the only possible faithful title translation.

The current Paper 27 explains several related counts of residue classes and composition factors; it does not reduce them all to one unqualified functional label. Numbers is therefore a consequential semantic choice, not merely reluctance to use a modern term. The comparison with the modernized bibliographical title at TERM-0807 remains explicit.

Hilbertovo tvrđenje

Iztočnik / Source: Hilbertsche Behauptung

Rusky / Russian: утверждение Гильберта

Razlog: Hilbertovo tvrđenje prevodi Behauptung bez povyšenja do teoremy. Motivacija poštuje označenje, ktore Noether sama vybira v zaglavju odděla. Tvrđenje ne znači neformalnu ili nepravdivu mysl; naziv sohranjaje avtorovu strukturu izloženja i sam po sobě ne govori, dali dokaz slěduje niže. Ruska i ukrajinska sravniteljnica podpirajut tu razliku. Zaměna iz ljubvi k sovrěmennoj terminologiji by byla redakcijnoju proměnoju, ne neutralnym prěvodom.

Reason: Hilbertovo tvrđenje translates Behauptung without promoting it to theorem. The motivation respects the designation Noether herself uses in the section heading. Assertion does not mean an informal or false idea; the label preserves the author’s expository structure and does not itself say whether a proof follows. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support that distinction. Replacing it merely out of preference for modern terminology would be an editorial change, not a neutral translation.

Hilbertov teorem o nerazložimosti

Iztočnik / Source: Hilbertscher Irreduzibilitätssatz

Rusky / Russian: теорема Гильберта о неприводимости

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема Гільберта про незвідність

Razlog: Hilbertov teorem o nerazložimosti kombinuje razpoznatelno ime s opisom matematičnogo svojstva. Razlog predpočita nerazložimost radi očekivanoj prozračnosti v slovjanskoj algebri; ruska i ukrajinska sravniteljnica imajut druge korenjeve konstrukcije za isti pojem. To ne jest izměrena razumělivost. Naziv teorema takože ne oprěděljaje samostojno vsih njegovih hipotez. Avtorova pozdnějša dopolnitelna zamětka trěbuje konečno algebraično čislovo polje pri formulaciji v rabotě 11; rěč o jezyčnom nazvu ne daje pravo izpustiti to uslovje.

Reason: Hilbertov teorem o nerazložimosti combines a recognizable name with a description of the mathematical property. The rationale favours nerazložimost for anticipated transparency in Slavic algebra; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use other root constructions for the same concept. This is not measured comprehension. Nor does the theorem’s name determine all its hypotheses. The author’s later supplementary note requires a finite algebraic number field in the formulation in Paper 11; discussion of the linguistic label does not permit omitting that condition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Avtorova dopolnitelna zamětka trěbuje pri formulaciji Hilbertovogo teorema v rabotě 11 konečno algebraično čislovo polje, a objasnjaje takože smysl ranějšej frazy o oblasti racionalnosti. To podčrknuje razliku medžu izborom nazva teorema i sohranjenjem njegovih uslovij. Sravnjenje ne jest nova proverka originalnoj pečati; opira se na konkretnu pasažu aktualnogo prěvoda.

Textual comparison: The author’s supplementary note requires a finite algebraic number field in the formulation of Hilbert’s theorem in Paper 11 and also explains the earlier phrase concerning a domain of rationality. This emphasizes the difference between choosing the theorem’s name and preserving its conditions. The comparison is not a fresh inspection of the original print; it uses a particular passage of the current translation.

Hilbertova teorema o nerazložimosti

Iztočnik / Source: Hilbertscher Irreduzibilitätssatz

Razlog: Hilbertova teorema o nerazložimosti jest feminina konstrukcija istogo imenovanogo teorema, ktory TERM-0810 zapisuje s maskulinym teorem. Sohranjena motivacija govori o medžunarodnom nazvu i slovjanskoj morfologiji, ale ne daje sravniteljnogo dokaza za prednost jednogo roda. Korenj nerazložim- nosi matematičny smysl; rod imenika upravjaje formoju Hilbertova ili Hilbertov. Te dve pytanja ne trěba sliti v jednu ocěnu. Povtorjenje nazva v različnyh rabotah samo po sobě ne opravdava vsaku njegovu formu.

Reason: Hilbertova teorema o nerazložimosti is a feminine construction for the same named theorem that TERM-0810 records with masculine teorem. The preserved motivation mentions an international name and Slavic morphology, but offers no comparative demonstration favouring one gender. The irreducibility stem carries the mathematical meaning; the noun’s gender determines Hilbertova or Hilbertov. These are separate questions. Recurrence of the name in different papers does not itself justify every form.

Hilbertov teorem o bazisu modula

Iztočnik / Source: Hilbertscher Satz von der Modulbasis

Rusky / Russian: теорема Гильберта о базисе модуля

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема Гільберта про базис модуля

Razlog: Hilbertov teorem o bazisu modula sohranjaje lokalny način, kako Noether prenaša Hilbertovo i Gordanovo razvažanje o konečnoj bazi. Razlog ne hoče zaměniti to imenovanje pozdnějšim obščim jezykom noetherovosti. Baza tu služi obrazloženju konečnoj porodženosti; ne možno bez proverky pridati linearnu nezavisnost, koju slovo baza nosi v nekotoryh drugih kontekstah. Sohranjenje modula i bazy pomogaje čitatelju slěditi samomu dokazu, ne samo razpoznati sovrěmennu klasifikaciju.

Reason: Hilbertov teorem o bazisu modula preserves the local way in which Noether transfers Hilbert’s and Gordan’s finite-basis reasoning. The rationale does not replace this name with the later general language of Noetherianity. Basis here serves the finite-generation argument; one must not add linear independence without checking, merely because basis carries that condition in some other contexts. Retaining module and basis helps the reader follow the proof itself, not only recognize a modern classification.

Hilbertovy teorem I o modulnoj bazi

Iztočnik / Source: Hilbertsches Theorem I von der Modulbasis

Rusky / Russian: гильбертова теорема I о модульном базисе

Razlog: Hilbertovy teorem I o modulnoj bazi čuva vlastno ime, rimsko čislo i mechanizm modulnoj bazy. I jest identifikator konkretno citovanogo teorema, ne slovo, ktore potrěbuje prěvoda. Aktualny paragraf raboty 6 izrično priměnjaje teorem I k sistemu odgovarjajučih funkcij. Motivacija ne podava polnu gramatičnu obranu historijnoj formy Hilbertovy; njezina razpoznatelnost ne jest dostatočno opravdanje koncovky. Razlikovanje I i II pri TERM-0814 mora ostati i pri pravopisnom uredženju.

Reason: Hilbertovy teorem I o modulnoj bazi preserves the name, Roman numeral, and module-basis mechanism. I identifies the particular theorem cited; it is not a word to translate. The current section of Paper 6 expressly applies Theorem I to the system of corresponding functions. The motivation supplies no full grammatical defence of historical Hilbertovy; recognizability is not sufficient justification of the ending. The distinction between I and II at TERM-0814 must survive orthographic editing.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem I priměnjaje se k sistemu funkcij, aby dobyti konečno prědstavjenje črez vybrane polinomy. Pri teoremě II tekst izrično nazyvaje cěle racionalne čislove koeficienty i pokazuje prěnos na algebraično-cěločislene polinomy. Rimsko čislo i cěločisleny pridavnik zato nesut različnu, sučstvenu informaciju; njih ne možno sliti v obči naziv bez objasnjenja.

Textual comparison: Theorem I is applied to a system of functions to obtain a finite representation through selected polynomials. For Theorem II, the text explicitly names rational-integer coefficients and explains the extension to algebraic-integer polynomials. The Roman numeral and integer adjective therefore carry distinct, essential information; they cannot be merged into a general name without explanation.

Zato cěločisleny ne jest prazdny pridevek pri bazi. Koeficientna oblast i razširjenje sut čestju matematičnogo sodržanja, ktoru kratky naziv ne može zaměniti.

pomočny teorem

To ne sut dva različne matematične pojmy: nazov i skladnja služe različnym funkcijam. Cěla zavisnost ne znači proizvoljnu algebraičnu ili linearnu zavisnost. Po osnovnom pravopisu pomoćny odgovarja pomočny; to ne měnjaje uslovja integralnosti.

The motivation distinguishes the heading from sentence construction in the proof, where the relation can be expressed as being integral over a specified domain. Basic spelling changes pomoćny to pomočny without changing the integrality condition.

pomocne prěměnne

Iztočnik / Source: Hilfsvariablen

Rusky / Russian: вспомогательные переменные

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: допоміжні змінні

Razlog: Pomocne prěměnne imenuje proměnne uvedene za posrědny račun, ne novu klasu matematičnyh objektov. Rusky i ukrajinsky prěvod tak samo vyražajut pomočnu funkciju. Kratky historijny razlog naziva izraz prozračnym, ale ne podava sravniteljne ocěnjenje čitateljev. Aktualny pasaž raboty 2 govori o pomočnyh prěměnnyh, ktore se identifikujut na koncu računa. Razlika pomocne/pomočne zato ostavaje slovotvorno-pravopisno pytanje, odvojeno od dobro oprěděljenoj funkcije proměnnyh.

Reason: Pomocne prěměnne names variables introduced for an intermediate calculation, not a new class of mathematical objects. The Russian and Ukrainian versions likewise express their auxiliary role. The brief historical reason calls the expression transparent but supplies no comparative reader assessment. The present passage in Paper 2 describes auxiliary variables identified at the end of the calculation. The distinction between pomocne and pomočne therefore remains a word-formation and spelling question, separate from the variables’ clearly specified role.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dva pasaža raboty 2 ukazyvajut funkciju pomočnyh proměnnyh: posrědny račun i pozdnějša identifikacija. Aktualno pomočnyh ma č; ranějša pomocne i pomoćne ostavajut različne zapisane formy, ne tri različne računske pojmy.

Textual comparison: Two passages in Paper 2 identify the variables’ role in intermediate calculation and later identification. Present pomočnyh has č; earlier pomocne and pomoćne remain distinct recorded forms, not three different computational concepts.

pomoćne prěměnne

Rusky / Russian: вспомогательные переменные

Razlog: Pomoćne prěměnne prodolžuje termin iz §2 v §6 toj samoj raboty. Kontinuitetnost jest zapisany razlog: čitatelj ma razpoznati to samo računsko srědstvo pri njegovom daljšem upotrěbljenju. Osnovny pravopis može zaměniti ć s č, ale to pravilo samo ne izjednačava ranějše pomocne s pomočne. Fraza ne trěbuje nove definicije pri vsakom pojavjenju; trěbuje prověrku, že proměnne imajut tu samu pomočnu funkciju.

Reason: Pomoćne prěměnne carries the term from §2 into §6 of the same paper. Continuity is the recorded reason: readers should recognize the same computational device when it is used again. Basic spelling can replace ć with č, but that rule alone does not equate the earlier pomocne with pomočne. The phrase does not need a new definition at every occurrence; it needs confirmation that the variables perform the same auxiliary role.

homogena forma

Iztočnik / Source: homogene Form

Rusky / Russian: однородная форма

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: однорідна форма

Razlog: Homogena forma sohranjaje internacionalno imenovanje iz teorije invariantov, dokolě rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenje upotrěbjajut domače pridavniki. V toj odluci jest ješče drugy krok: historijno i-ter Dimension vyražaje se kako stepen i. To objasnjava matematičny smysl, ne proměnjaje prostorovu dimenziju v stepen. Slovnik potvrđaje osnovu homogenny, s dvoma n, i takože alternativu jednorodny. Zapis homogena zato ne može byti opravdany samo obščim tvrdženjem o internacionalnosti; leksičny izbor i točna forma pridavnika sut dva različne pytanja.

Reason: Homogena forma retains an international invariant-theory term where the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use native adjectives. The decision also makes a separate interpretive move: historical i-ter Dimension is rendered as degree i. This explains the mathematical sense rather than turning a spatial dimension into a degree. The dictionary attests homogenny, with double n, as well as the alternative jednorodny. Homogena therefore cannot be justified solely by an appeal to international vocabulary: lexical selection and the adjective’s exact form are distinct questions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Medžuslovjansky slovnik podava homogenny (19718) i jednorodny (21312), homogennosť (19717) i jednorodnosť (21311), i homogenizovati (23412). To podporuje obe leksične možnosti, ne jedinu obveznu formu. Čislove polja slovnika ne sut težiny historijnogo izbora v tom prěvodu. Tekst raboty 6 objasnjava uvedenje \(x_0\) pri homogenizaciji; rabota 21 govori o formě f(dx) s nenulovym determinantom drugih izvodnyh. Te različne konstrukcije potrěbujut konkretnu matematičnu definiciju, ne samo sličnu osnovu. Slovnikovo dvojno n trěba odlišiti od padežnogo i brojovogo soglasovanja. To jest nyněšnje sravnjenje s točnoj kopijeju slovnika, ne tvrdženje o ranějšem konsultovanju.

Textual comparison: The Interslavic Dictionary lists homogenny (19718) and jednorodny (21312), homogennosť (19717) and jednorodnosť (21311), and homogenizovati (23412). This supports both lexical possibilities, not a uniquely compulsory form. The dictionary’s numerical fields are not historical selection weights for this translation. Paper 6 explains the introduction of \(x_0\) in homogenization; Paper 21 treats f(dx) with a nonzero determinant of second derivatives. These constructions need their particular mathematical definitions, not merely a related stem. The dictionary’s double n must also be distinguished from agreement in case and number. This is a present comparison with a fixed dictionary copy, not a claim of earlier consultation.

Rusky / Russian: однородная форма

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: однорідна форма

Razlog: Homogenna forma zadržuje internacionalnu osnovu homogenny, potvrđenu v slovniku. V korennom argumentu raboty 9 tekst sravnjava stepen \(\nu\chi\) formy po vybranyh η s ukupnym stepenem λ polinoma po η. Koeficienty samy mogut zavisěti od η; zato homogennost po vybranyh argumentah ne trěba směšati s tvrdženjem, že cěly izraz ima točno stepen \(\nu\chi\) po vsih proměnnyh. Ta razlika objasnjava, začto dokaz dava neravnost \(\lambda\geq\nu\chi\).

Reason: Homogenna forma retains the dictionary-attested international stem homogenny. In Paper 9’s root argument, the text compares the form’s degree \(\nu\chi\) in selected η arguments with the polynomial’s total degree λ in η. The coefficients may themselves depend on η; homogeneity in the selected arguments must not be confused with a claim that the whole expression has exactly degree \(\nu\chi\) in all variables. This distinction explains why the argument gives the inequality \(\lambda\geq\nu\chi\).

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §3 raboty 9 \(F_\nu\) i \(G_{\nu\chi}\) sut formy po vybranyh η, ale jih koeficienty takože zaviset od η; tekst zato zaključaje \(\lambda\geq\nu\chi\). V §9 ta sama rabota upotrěbjaje historijno dimenzija za stepen homogenyh česti \(a_i(\eta)\). Ta dva pasaža pokazyvajut, začto trěba izrično ukazati argumenty i smysl stepena. Modernizacija slova Dimension ne jest opča zaměna vsakego pojavjenja slova dimenzija.

Modernizing Dimension is not a general replacement of every occurrence of dimension.

Slovnik ima i homogenny, i jednorodny; nacionalne sravniteljne formy takože ne ukazyvajut jedinu mogućnost. Pojavjenje izraza v aktualnom korpusu potvrđaje upotrěbljenje, ale ne pravilnost vsakego n, padeža ili kontekstualnogo značenja. Izbor osnovy i proverka gramatičnoj formy zato ostavajut različne česti ocěnjenja.

Reason: Homogene polinomy was retained for the international stem’s expected familiarity and its proximity to citations. That explains the lexical direction, not demonstrated pan-Slavic intelligibility. The dictionary has both homogenny and jednorodny, and the national-language comparanda likewise do not establish a unique option. Occurrence in the present corpus establishes use, not the correctness of every n, inflection, or contextual meaning. Choosing the stem and checking its grammatical realization are separate parts of the assessment.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Medžuslovjansky slovnik podava homogenny (19718) i jednorodny (21312), homogennosť (19717) i jednorodnosť (21311), i homogenizovati (23412). To podporuje obe leksične možnosti, ne jedinu obveznu formu. Čislove polja slovnika ne sut težiny historijnogo izbora v tom prěvodu. Tekst raboty 6 objasnjava uvedenje \(x_0\) pri homogenizaciji; rabota 21 govori o formě f(dx) s nenulovym determinantom drugih izvodnyh. Te različne konstrukcije potrěbujut konkretnu matematičnu definiciju, ne samo sličnu osnovu. Slovnikovo dvojno n trěba odlišiti od padežnogo i brojovogo soglasovanja. To jest nyněšnje sravnjenje s točnoj kopijeju slovnika, ne tvrdženje o ranějšem konsultovanju.

Textual comparison: The Interslavic Dictionary lists homogenny (19718) and jednorodny (21312), homogennosť (19717) and jednorodnosť (21311), and homogenizovati (23412). This supports both lexical possibilities, not a uniquely compulsory form. The dictionary’s numerical fields are not historical selection weights for this translation. Paper 6 explains the introduction of \(x_0\) in homogenization; Paper 21 treats f(dx) with a nonzero determinant of second derivatives. These constructions need their particular mathematical definitions, not merely a related stem. The dictionary’s double n must also be distinguished from agreement in case and number. This is a present comparison with a fixed dictionary copy, not a claim of earlier consultation.

homogena rezultanta členov najvyššego stepena

Iztočnik / Source: homogene Resultante der Glieder höchster Dimension

Rusky / Russian: однородная результанта членов наивысшей степени

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: однорідна результанта членів найвищого степеня

Razlog: Homogena rezultanta členov najvyššego stepena prěvodit Dimension kak stepen v konkretnom polinomnom kontekstu; rezultanta ostavaje tehničnym imenovanjem. Ne ide o rezultant proizvoljnyh členov, ale o najvyšše homogene česti polinomov. Pasaž raboty 5 razlikuje nenulovu rezultantu, dostatočnu za obstojanje integralnoj bazy, od silnějšego uslovja, že rezultanta jest jedinica koeficientnoj oblasti, potrěbnogo v navedenom argumentu za integralnost prědstavjenja. Prěvod ne može sliti ne-nula i jedinica.

Reason: Homogena rezultanta členov najvyššego stepena renders Dimension as degree in this polynomial context while retaining resultant as a technical term. It concerns the polynomials’ highest homogeneous parts, not arbitrary terms. The passage in Paper 5 distinguishes a nonzero resultant, sufficient there for an integral basis, from the stronger unit condition used in the stated argument for integrality of the representation. Nonzero and unit must not be merged in translation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 5 nenulova rezultanta najvyšših členov daje dostatočno uslovje za integralnu bazu. Slědujuči pasaž osoblivo zahtěvaje jedinicu koeficientnoj oblasti za integralnost prědstavjenja; još dalje avtor naglašaje, že prvo uslovje ne jest potrěbno. Prěvod mora sohranjati vse tri razlikovanja: najvyšše česti, ne-nula protiv jedinice, i dostatočnost protiv potrěbnosti.

Textual comparison: In Paper 5 a nonzero resultant of the highest-degree parts gives a sufficient condition for an integral basis. The next passage separately requires a unit of the coefficient domain for integrality of the representation, and the author then stresses that the first condition is not necessary. Translation must preserve all three distinctions: highest-degree parts, nonzero versus unit, and sufficiency versus necessity.

homogenny izobarny invarianty

Iztočnik / Source: homogene, isobare Invarianten

Rusky / Russian: однородные изобарные инварианты

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: однорідні ізобарні інваріанти

Razlog: Homogenny izobarny invarianty čuva dva pridavnika, zato že oni ne nesut jednu i tu samu informaciju. V invariantnoj teoriji homogennost odnosi se k stepenu, a izobarnost k jednakoj važe členov po danoj konvenciji. Historijny razlog naglašaje kratkost internacionalnyh imenovanj; ne dava test njihove razumlivosti. Pasaž raboty 6 razlikuje sistem takyh invariantov od polja, ktoro dobivaje se pri dopuščanju racionalnyh kombinacij i odgovarjajučem ograničenju transformacij. Samo izobara v obščem slovniku ne bi dokazala matematičny smysl izobarny.

Reason: Homogenny izobarny invarianty preserves two adjectives because they do not convey the same information. In invariant theory, homogeneity concerns degree and isobaricity concerns equal term weight under the specified convention. The historical reason emphasizes the international terms’ compactness, without an intelligibility test. The passage in Paper 6 distinguishes a system of such invariants from the field obtained with rational combinations and the appropriate restriction on transformations. A general dictionary entry for isobar would not by itself attest the mathematical sense of isobaric.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 6 razlikuje sistem homogennyh izobarnyh invariantov od polja racionalnyh invariantov. Rabota 23 definira homogenu oblast cělosti tym, že ona sodrživaje vsaku homogennu čest polinoma, ktory k nej prinaleži. Drugy izraz zato ne označa oblast, v kojoj vsi elementy imajut jedin stepen. Sohranjanje pridavnika bez definicije moglo by zakryti tu razliku.

Textual comparison: Paper 6 distinguishes a system of homogeneous isobaric invariants from the field of rational invariants. Paper 23 defines a homogeneous integral domain by its containing each homogeneous component of any polynomial belonging to it. The second expression therefore does not mean a domain whose elements all have a single degree. Retaining the adjective without its definition could conceal the distinction.

homogena oblast cělosti

Iztočnik / Source: homogener Integritätsbereich

Rusky / Russian: однородная область целостности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: однорідна область цілісності

Razlog: Homogena oblast cělosti prodolžuje ranějše imenovanje oblasti, ale pridavnik potrěbuje definiciju iz raboty 23. Tu on znači: ako polinom prinaleži k oblasti, njegove homogene česti takože prinaležet k nej, vsaka odvojeno. To ne znači, že vsaky element oblasti sam jest homogenny polinom jednogo stepena. Ta razlika čuva smysl razloženja i dopušča sumy različnyh stepenjev. Historijna motivacija kontinuitetnosti ne izgovarja tu definiciju; zato ona jest dana v kontekstualnom sravnjenju.

Reason: Homogena oblast cělosti continues the earlier name for the domain, but its adjective needs Paper 23’s definition: if a polynomial belongs to the domain, each of its homogeneous components belongs to it separately. This does not mean that every element of the domain is itself homogeneous of a single degree. The distinction preserves decomposition and permits sums of different degrees. The historical continuity rationale does not state that definition, so it is supplied in the contextual comparison.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 6 razlikuje sistem homogennyh izobarnyh invariantov od polja racionalnyh invariantov. Rabota 23 definira homogenu oblast cělosti tym, že ona sodrživaje vsaku homogennu čest polinoma, ktory k nej prinaleži. Drugy izraz zato ne označa oblast, v kojoj vsi elementy imajut jedin stepen. Sohranjanje pridavnika bez definicije moglo by zakryti tu razliku.

Paper 23 defines a homogeneous integral domain by its containing each homogeneous component of any polynomial belonging to it. The second expression therefore does not mean a domain whose elements all have a single degree. Retaining the adjective without its definition could conceal the distinction.

uslovje homogennosti / homogenizovanje

Iztočnik / Source: Homogenitätsvoraussetzung / Homogenisieren

Rusky / Russian: условие однородности / гомогенизация

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: умова однорідності / гомогенізація

Razlog: Uslovje homogennosti i homogenizovanje razlikujut prědpoloženje od operacije: prvo opisuje svojstvo vhoda, drugo jest postupok, ktory dovoljava razgledati inoj slučaj pomoču homogennogo. Internacionalna osnova zbližava ta imenovanja. Arhivny razlog tvrdi, že ona jest menje dvosmyslena než domači kalk, ale ne nazyvaje konkretno sravnjanu formu ni měru dvosmyslenosti. Slovnik nyně potvrđaje homogennosť i homogenizovati, i takože jednorodnosť. To podkrepljaje tvorjenje povezanoj terminologije, ne dokazuje historijno odbacanje vseh domačih alternativ.

Reason: Uslovje homogennosti and homogenizovanje distinguish a hypothesis from an operation: the former describes an input property, the latter a procedure for treating another case through a homogeneous one. The international stem connects the two names. The archival reason claims less ambiguity than a native calque but names neither a specific competitor nor a measure of ambiguity. The dictionary now attests homogennosť and homogenizovati, as well as jednorodnosť. This supports a related terminological family, not a historical rejection of every native alternative.

To jest nyněšnje sravnjenje s točnoj kopijeju slovnika, ne tvrdženje o ranějšem konsultovanju.

homomorfny / modulno-homomorfny / kolcevo-homomorfny

Iztočnik / Source: homomorph / modul-homomorph / ring-homomorph

Rusky / Russian: гомоморфный / модульно-гомоморфный / кольцево-гомоморфный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: гомоморфний / модульно-гомоморфний / кільцево-гомоморфний

Razlog: Homomorfny zadržuje internacionalnu osnovu; modulno- i kolcevo- ukazyvajut, ktoru strukturu zobraženje čuva. Najvažnějša informacija jest v definiciji raboty 30: cilj jest izčerpany obrazom, i čuvajut se razlika i množenje operatorom. To jest surjektivno zobraženje v današnjem vyraženju, ne libovoljny nesurjektivny homomorfizm v zadany cilj. Prstenovy slučaj dodatno čuva produkt. Historijno kolcevo- ne smy avtomatično prenesti v aktualnu terminologiju prstena; i izbor korenja, i uslovja definicije potrěbujut svoji odvojene opravdanja.

Reason: Homomorfny retains the international stem; modulno- and kolcevo- specify which structure the map preserves. The crucial information lies in Paper 30’s definition: the image exhausts the target, and subtraction and multiplication by an operator are preserved. In present terminology this is a surjective map, not an arbitrary nonsurjective homomorphism into a specified target. The ring case also preserves products. Historical kolcevo- cannot automatically be carried into the present prsten terminology: root selection and the definition’s conditions each need their own justification.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija raboty 30 zahtěvaje, že obraz izčerpava cilj, i izpisuje sohranjanje razlike i operatornogo množenja. Pri prstenah dodava se produkt. Rabota 34 izrično svęzuje obraz s faktorprstenom po dvustrannom idealu i čuva dodatne operatorne uslovja. Nazov homomorfizm sam ne može zaměniti tu informaciju o zobraženju i njegovom cilju.

Textual comparison: Paper 30’s definition requires the image to exhaust the target and writes out preservation of subtraction and operator multiplication. Products enter in the ring case. Paper 34 explicitly relates the image to a quotient by a two-sided ideal and retains additional operator conditions. The name homomorphism cannot substitute for this information about the map and its target.

homomorfno matrično kolco ... stvorjeno idealom

Iztočnik / Source: homomorphe Matrizenring ... durch ein Ideal ... erzeugt

Rusky / Russian: гомоморфное матричное кольцо ... порожденное идеалом

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: гомоморфне матричне кільце ... породжене ідеалом

Razlog: Fraza homomorfno matrično kolco … stvorjeno idealom sohranjaje ograničenje v avtorskoj primětkě. Klasy prědstavjenij tu vključajut samo matrične prsteny, dobyte iz idealov po navedenoj konstrukciji, ne vse myslime homomorfne matrične obrazy. Pytanje o vsih takyh obrazah avtor izrično ostavlja izvan razgledanja. Aktualno homomorfno matrično prsten pokazuje dodatny problem: pri zaměně kolco na prsten ostalo je srednorodno soglasovanje. To jest gramatičny nedostatok, ne nova razlika medžu matematičnymi objektami.

Reason: The phrase homomorfno matrično kolco … stvorjeno idealom preserves a restriction in the author’s footnote. Representation classes here include only matrix rings obtained from ideals by the specified construction, not every conceivable homomorphic matrix image. The author expressly leaves the more general question outside the discussion. Present homomorfno matrično prsten reveals a further problem: replacement of kolco by prsten has left neuter agreement behind. That is a grammatical defect, not a new distinction between mathematical objects.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Avtorska primětka ne razrěšaje obče pytanje, može li vsak homomorfny matričny obraz byti stvorjen idealom; ona omežuje definiciju klasov do obrazov stvorjenyh po danoj konstrukciji. Aktualny zapis homomorfno matrično prsten ima srednorodne pridavniki pri imenovanju prstena. Slovnikova rodova informacija i pravilo soglasovanja razgledane pri TEXT-COMP-67 pokazujut, začto tu zaměnu imenovanja potrěbno dopolniti gramatičnoju korekcijeju; matematično ograničenje ostavaje odvojeno od njej.

Textual comparison: The author’s footnote does not settle whether every homomorphic matrix image can be obtained from an ideal; it restricts the definition of representation classes to images obtained by the specified construction. Present homomorfno matrično prsten leaves neuter adjectives with the ring noun. The dictionary gender evidence and agreement rule discussed at TEXT-COMP-67 show why the noun replacement needs a grammatical correction as well; the mathematical restriction is a separate issue.

teorem o homomorfizmu za kolca

Iztočnik / Source: Homomorphiesatz für Ringe

Rusky / Russian: теорема о гомоморфизме для колец

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема про гомоморфізм для кілець

Razlog: Teorem o homomorfizmu za kolca prodolžuje imenovanje iz §2, ale omežuje predmet do prstenov. Aktualna teorema govori, že homomorfny obraz jest izomorfny faktorprstenu po dvustrannom idealu; operatorne uslovja ostavajut važny, kogda sut zadane. Nazov zato ne trěba razuměti kak tvrdženje o vsakom zobraženju ili vsakom jednostrannom idealu. Kolca jest historijna leksična forma, dokolě aktualno zaglavje ima prsteny. Ta zaměna ne smy zatemniti neproměnjenu matematičnu strukturu teoremy.

Reason: Teorem o homomorfizmu za kolca continues the name used in §2 while restricting its subject to rings. The present theorem states that a homomorphic image is isomorphic to a quotient ring by a two-sided ideal; specified operator conditions remain relevant. Its name must not be read as a claim about every map or every one-sided ideal. Kolca is the historical lexical form, whereas the present heading has prsteny. That replacement must not obscure the theorem’s unchanged mathematical structure.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija raboty 30 zahtěvaje, že obraz izčerpava cilj, i izpisuje sohranjanje razlike i operatornogo množenja. Pri prstenah dodava se produkt. Rabota 34 izrično svęzuje obraz s faktorprstenom po dvustrannom idealu i čuva dodatne operatorne uslovja. Nazov homomorfizm sam ne može zaměniti tu informaciju o zobraženju i njegovom cilju.

Textual comparison: Paper 30’s definition requires the image to exhaust the target and writes out preservation of subtraction and operator multiplication. Products enter in the ring case. Paper 34 explicitly relates the image to a quotient by a two-sided ideal and retains additional operator conditions. The name homomorphism cannot substitute for this information about the map and its target.

homomorfizmy iz centra v \(\Omega\)

Iztočnik / Source: Homomorphismen von Z in \(\Omega\)

Rusky / Russian: гомоморфизмы из центра в \(\Omega\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: гомоморфізми з центра в \(\Omega\)

Razlog: Homomorfizmy iz centra v Omega čuva smer zobraženja: iz centra Z v polje Ω. Zaměna slova homomorfizm slovom karakter v toj točkě byla by prědčasna. Pri prědstavjenju centra matricami Eξ korespondencija z ↦ ξ ima stepen jeden; v daljšej formuli karakter na centru jest \(n_\nu\)-kratny toj korespondencije. Zato internacionalno imenovanje ne jest samo stil: ono pomaga razlikovati zobraženje od slěda prědstavjenja. Pismeno Omega v starom zapisu označaje simbol Ω, ne novu leksičnu jedinicu.

Reason: Homomorfizmy iz centra v Omega preserves the map’s direction, from the centre Z to the field Ω. Replacing homomorphism with character at this point would be premature. When the centre is represented by matrices Eξ, the correspondence z ↦ ξ has degree one; in the later formula, the character restricted to the centre is \(n_\nu\) times that correspondence. The international term therefore helps distinguish a map from the trace of a representation. Written-out Omega in the earlier record denotes Ω, not a new lexical item.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §21 raboty 34 povezuje prědstavjenje centra matricami Eξ s korespondencijeju z ↦ ξ. §24 razděljuje tu korespondenciju θ od karaktera χ i dava faktor \(n_\nu\): \(\chi^{(\nu)}(z)=n_\nu\theta^{(\nu)}(z)\). Pri \(n_\nu\) = 1 ony soglašajut se; za děljenje prěz \(n_\nu\) daljši tekst prědpoklada karakteristiku nula. Slovnik mora sohranjati te uslovja, ne podavati karakter kak neograničeny sinonim homomorfizma centra.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §21, connects representation of the centre by matrices Eξ with the correspondence z ↦ ξ. Section 24 distinguishes this correspondence θ from the character χ and gives the factor \(n_\nu\): \(\chi^{(\nu)}(z)=n_\nu\theta^{(\nu)}(z)\). They coincide when \(n_\nu\) = 1; for division by \(n_\nu\) the following text assumes characteristic zero. The dictionary must retain these conditions instead of offering character as an unrestricted synonym for centre homomorphism.

homomorfizm centra

Iztočnik / Source: Homomorphismus des Zentrums

Rusky / Russian: гомоморфизм центра

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: гомоморфізм центру

Razlog: Homomorfizm centra zadržuje vezu medžu algebričnoju strukturoju i karakterami, ale ne izjednačava ih. V rabotě 34, §24, formula jest \(\chi^{(\nu)}(z)=n_\nu\theta^{(\nu)}(z)\): θ jest homomorfizm centra, χ jest slěd prědstavjenja. V komutativnom slučaju \(n_\nu\) = 1, i karakter sam dava homomorfizm. Čislovy faktor i domen centra zato sut sučstveni za imenovanje. Historijny razlog stabilnosti internacionalnogo termina podkrepljaje kontinuitetnost, ne opravdava izpuščenje tih uslovij.

Reason: Homomorfizm centra maintains the connection between algebraic structure and characters without identifying them. In Paper 34, §24, the formula is \(\chi^{(\nu)}(z)=n_\nu\theta^{(\nu)}(z)\): θ is the centre homomorphism and χ the representation’s trace. In the commutative case \(n_\nu\) = 1, the character itself gives a homomorphism. The numerical factor and the domain of the centre are therefore essential. The historical appeal to terminological stability supports continuity, not omission of these conditions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §21 raboty 34 povezuje prědstavjenje centra matricami Eξ s korespondencijeju z ↦ ξ. §24 razděljuje tu korespondenciju θ od karaktera χ i dava faktor \(n_\nu\): \(\chi^{(\nu)}(z)=n_\nu\theta^{(\nu)}(z)\). Pri \(n_\nu\) = 1 ony soglašajut se; za děljenje prěz \(n_\nu\) daljši tekst prědpoklada karakteristiku nula. Slovnik mora sohranjati te uslovja, ne podavati karakter kak neograničeny sinonim homomorfizma centra.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §21, connects representation of the centre by matrices Eξ with the correspondence z ↦ ξ. Section 24 distinguishes this correspondence θ from the character χ and gives the factor \(n_\nu\): \(\chi^{(\nu)}(z)=n_\nu\theta^{(\nu)}(z)\). They coincide when \(n_\nu\) = 1; for division by \(n_\nu\) the following text assumes characteristic zero. The dictionary must retain these conditions instead of offering character as an unrestricted synonym for centre homomorphism.

hiperkompleksne veličiny

Iztočnik / Source: hyperkomplexe Größen

Rusky / Russian: гиперкомплексные величины

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: гіперкомплексні величини

Razlog: Izraz sohranja historičny jezyk abstrakta iz 1925 goda: avtorica govori o hiperkompleksnyh veličinah, ne prosto o modulah. Rusky i ukrajinsky ekvivalenty podpirajut medžunarodny koren hiperkompleks-, a veličiny oddavaje německe Größen. Glavny argument jest věrnost pojmovomu i historičnomu kontekstu. Zaměna slovom algebry mogla by pomagati dnešnjemu čitatelju, ale ona by izbrisala razliku medžu nazvanjem elementov i nazvanjem struktury. Zato objašnjenje može povezati stary izraz s teorijeju algebr, ne podměnjajuči avtorin tekst. Zapis ne ustanovjava, že izraz jest nova tvorba ili občepriznany medžuslovjansky termin.

Reason: The expression preserves the historical language of the 1925 abstract: Noether speaks of hypercomplex quantities, not simply modules. The Russian and Ukrainian equivalents support the international stem hypercomplex-, while veličiny renders Größen. The governing consideration is fidelity to the conceptual and historical setting. Substituting algebry might help a present-day reader, but would erase the distinction between naming elements and naming their structure. An explanation can therefore connect the older expression with algebra theory without replacing the author’s words. The record does not establish either a new coinage or general Interslavic acceptance.

hiperkompleksne sistemy, algebry

Iztočnik / Source: hyperkomplexe Systeme, Algebren

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Dvojica hiperkompleksne sistemy, algebry sohranja starše nazvanje i jegovo bezposrědnje objašnjenje. Čitatelj ne mora vybirati medžu dvoma konkurenčnymi prěvodami: v danom kontekstu vtore nazvanje objasnjaje prvo. To jest razlog sohraniti obě česti, a ne ostaviti samo algebry. Izraz ne znači, že vsaka upotrěba slova sistema v korpusu označaje algebru. Ruske i ukrajinske polja v tom zapisu izgubili sut bukvy i ne mogut služiti kak čitateljne attestacije. Argument o historičnoj kontinuitetě možno rekonstruovati, ale sravnjenje tyh dvou jezykov ne možno dopolniti iz domysla.

Reason: The pair hiperkompleksne sistemy, algebry retains an older designation together with its immediate explanatory equivalent. Readers are not being offered two rival translations: in this context the second term explains the first. That is the reason for keeping both instead of retaining only algebry. It does not mean that every occurrence of sistema elsewhere in the corpus denotes an algebra. The Russian and Ukrainian fields in this record have lost their lettering and cannot serve as readable attestations. The historical-continuity argument survives; the missing language comparison cannot be supplied by conjecture.

hiperkompleksna sistema

Iztočnik / Source: hyperkomplexes System

Rusky / Russian: гиперкомплексная система

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: гіперкомплексна система

Razlog: Hiperkompleksna sistema sohranja avtorin tehničny izraz iz raboty 32. Vybor opiraje se na kontinuitet termina, ne na tvrdženje, že sistema i prsten vsegda sut ravnoznačne. Žensky rod tu jest čest zachovanogo prěvoda; drugy zapis dava mužsky hiperkompleksny sistem. Te dvě formy trěba sravniti kak gramatične varianty jednogo nazvanja, ne kak dva različne matematične pojmy. Iz zapisanoj motivacije ne slěduje, ktory rod ima prednost v občej medžuslovjanskoj normě.

Replacing it with prsten alone or an algebraic paraphrase could obscure the way Noether introduces the object and its representations. The choice rests on terminological continuity, not on a claim that system and ring are always synonymous. Feminine gender is part of the preserved translation here; another record has masculine hiperkompleksny sistem. These are grammatical variants of one designation, not two mathematical concepts. The recorded justification does not decide which gender should prevail in general Interslavic usage.

Te dve jedinične uslovja ne sut identične; sovrěmenno objašnjenje ne smi sliti jih.

najvyšša dimenzija

Razlog: Najvyšša dimenzija oddavaje Höchstdimension kak termin iz teorije idealov raboty 24. Prědnost ima prozračna konstrukcija so superlativom, ne novo jednoslovno nazvanje. V toj rabotě dimenzija opiraje se na osnovne idealy i individualne normy; za libovoljny ideal jest važno, ktora dimenzija jest največša sredi komponentov. Zato najvyšša tu ne znači proizvoljno največšu dimenziju objekta v kakom-koli drugom smyslu. Jediničny ideal imaje v avtorinoj konvenciji dimenziju −1. Reason: Najvyšša dimenzija renders Höchstdimension as a term in Paper 24’s ideal theory. A transparent superlative construction is preferred to a new single-word designation. In that paper dimension is developed through basic ideals and individual norms; for an arbitrary ideal, the largest dimension among its components matters. Thus highest does not mean whichever notion of dimension happens to be largest in some other setting. The unit ideal has dimension −1 under Noether’s convention. That convention belongs in the mathematical explanation and must not be silently replaced with a present-day one.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 24 povezuje najvyššu dimenziju s prvym nejediničnym individualnym normom i potom s dimenzijami primarnyh komponentov. Konvencija o jediničnom idealu s dimenzijeju −1 ostaje čest avtorinoj teorije. Prěvod ne trěbuje tiho podměniti tu teoriju inym obščim oprěděljenjem dimenzije.

Textual comparison: Paper 24 relates highest dimension to the first nonunit individual norm and then to the dimensions of primary components. The convention giving the unit ideal dimension −1 remains part of Noether’s theory. Translation does not call for silently replacing that theory with another general definition of dimension.

Iztočnik / Source: Ideal / Hauptideal / Primideal / primäres Ideal

Rusky / Russian: идеал / главный идеал / простой идеал / первичный идеал

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ідеал / головний ідеал / простий ідеал / первинний ідеал

Razlog: Ta četvorka tvorji svezanu terminologičnu rodinu: ideal, glavny ideal, prosty ideal i primarny ideal. Izbor medžunarodnogo ideal olakšava vez s algebraičnoju literaturoju; glavny imaje sravnjene ruske i ukrajinske paralely. Sučstveno jest ne sliti prosty s primarny. Prosty i primarny odgovarjajut različnym definicijam i mogut igrati različne rolje v razloženju. Proto sohranjanje dvou različnyh pridevnikov ima bolju važnost než površna sličnost slova primarny so slovom prime. Rodina ne jest dokaz nove tvorby vsih četyreh izrazov; ona jest zapis soglasovanogo vyboru v danom prěvodu.

Reason: These four expressions form a coordinated terminological family: ideal, glavny ideal, prosty ideal and primarny ideal. International ideal connects the text with algebraic literature; glavny has the recorded Russian and Ukrainian parallels. The crucial requirement is not to merge prosty with primarny. Prime and primary have different definitions and can play different roles in a decomposition. Keeping two distinct modifiers therefore matters more than the superficial resemblance between primarny and English prime. The family is not evidence that all four expressions were newly coined; it records a coordinated choice for this translation.

ideal / modul / modul form

Iztočnik / Source: Ideal / Modul / Formenmodul

Rusky / Russian: идеал / модуль / модуль форм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ідеал / модуль / модуль форм

Razlog: Ideal, modul i modul form ne sut tri bezuslovno zaměnjajeme nazvanja. V rabotě 19 primětka povezuje ideal polinomov s staršim obyčajem govoriti o modulah; ona takože daje zatvorenost pri razlikě i množenju polinomom. Prěvod sohranja tu historičnu vez, aby čitatelj razuměl i starše nazvanje, i matematičny objekt. Slovnik mora razlikovati takovu kontekstnu ravnoznačnost od dnešnjego obščego pojma modula. Opis staršego upotrěbljenja ne opravdava globalnu zaměnu vsih modulov idealami. Izraz modul form sohranja imenovanu kategoriju, ne skryvajuči jejne historične granice.

Reason: Ideal, modul and modul form are not three unconditionally interchangeable labels. A footnote in Paper 19 connects a polynomial ideal with the older practice of speaking of modules; it also supplies closure under subtraction and multiplication by a polynomial. The translation retains this historical connection so that readers can understand both the older designation and the mathematical object. The dictionary must distinguish such contextual equivalence from the modern general notion of a module. Reporting the older usage does not justify replacing every module with an ideal. Modul form preserves the named category while making its historical limits explicit.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Primětka raboty 19 objasnjaje starše nazvanje modul i odrazu dava idealno svojstvo. V rabotě 22 definicija idealov iz polinomov sohranja zatvorenost pri razlikě i množenju libovoljnym polinomom; primětka razlikuje jih od modulov linearnyh form. Ta dva odlomky opravdavajut historično objašnjenje, ne globalnu zaměnu slova modul slovom ideal.

Textual comparison: The Paper 19 footnote explains the older designation module and immediately supplies the ideal property. Paper 22’s definition of polynomial ideals retains closure under subtraction and multiplication by an arbitrary polynomial; its footnote distinguishes them from modules of linear forms. These passages support a historical explanation, not a global replacement of module with ideal.

ideal iz polinomov

Iztočnik / Source: Ideal aus Polynomen

Rusky / Russian: идеал из полиномов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ідеал з поліномів

Razlog: Ideal iz polinomov byl izbrany vměsto samogo pridevničnogo skračenja, zato že odlomok najprvo oprědělja objekt. Fraza pokazuje, iz čego ideal sostoji se, a slědujuče uslovja davajut zatvorenost pri razlikě i množenju libovoljnym polinomom. V rabotě 22 primětka izrično razlikuje to upotrěbljenje od modulov linearnyh form. V prěvodu ne dostača prepoznati koren ideal: trěba sohraniti polje koeficientov, neoprěděljene i kvantifikaciju v definiciji. Rusky i ukrajinsky izrazy takože podpirajut konstrukciju iz polinomov; to jest jezykova opora, ne zaměna matematičnogo teksta.

Reason: Ideal iz polinomov was preferred to an adjectival shortening because the passage first defines the object. The phrase identifies what the ideal consists of, while the following conditions give closure under subtraction and multiplication by an arbitrary polynomial. In Paper 22 a footnote expressly distinguishes this usage from modules of linear forms. Recognizing the stem ideal is not enough: the translation must preserve the coefficient field, indeterminates and quantification in the definition. The Russian and Ukrainian expressions also support a noun construction involving polynomials; that is linguistic support, not a substitute for the mathematics.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Primětka raboty 19 objasnjaje starše nazvanje modul i odrazu dava idealno svojstvo. V rabotě 22 definicija idealov iz polinomov sohranja zatvorenost pri razlikě i množenju libovoljnym polinomom; primětka razlikuje jih od modulov linearnyh form. Paper 22’s definition of polynomial ideals retains closure under subtraction and multiplication by an arbitrary polynomial; its footnote distinguishes them from modules of linear forms. These passages support a historical explanation, not a global replacement of module with ideal.

baza ideala

Iztočnik / Source: Idealbasis

Rusky / Russian: базис идеала

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: база ідеалу

Razlog: Baza ideala sohranja istorijsko upotrěbljenje bazy za konečnu tvorjaču sovkupnost ideala v rabotě 22. Tu baza ne potrěbuje linearnoj nezavisnosti kak baza vektornogo prostora. Genitiv ideala čini nositelja bazy izričnym, a rusky bazis i ukrajinska baza davajut sravnitelnu oporu. Taka prozračnost ne odstranja polisemičnosti: ekspert mora viděti definiciju, a čitatelj mora byti prěduprědženy o različnyh smyslah bazy. Izraz tvorjača sovkupnost možno upotrěbiti v objašnjenju; ne trěba tiho podměnjati im avtorino historično nazvanje.

Reason: Baza ideala preserves the historical use of basis for a finite generating set of an ideal in Paper 22. Here basis need not carry the linear-independence condition of a vector-space basis. The genitive ideala makes the object explicit, while Russian bazis and Ukrainian baza supply comparative support. This transparency does not remove the polysemy: an expert needs the definition, and a reader needs to see the different senses of basis. Generating set can be used in the explanation without silently replacing Noether’s historical designation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §8 raboty 31 dopušča modulnu bazu s \(m\ge n\) elementami. Potrěbne determinanty linearno izražajut se prěz konečno mnogo determinantov iz te bazy; ony tvorjat bazu diskriminantnogo ideala. Slučaj linearno nezavisnoj modulnoj bazy iz \(n\) elementov jest razgledany odvojeno. Ta izrična razlika daje čitatelju možlivosť razuměti istoričnu polisemičnost bazy bez izměnjenja avtorinogo nazvanja.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §8, allows a module basis of \(m\ge n\) elements. The required determinants are linear combinations of finitely many determinants drawn from that basis, which generate the discriminant ideal. A linearly independent module basis of \(n\) elements is considered separately. This explicit distinction lets readers understand the historical polysemy of basis without replacing Noether’s designation.

idealna baza

Iztočnik / Source: Idealbasis

Rusky / Russian: идеальный базис

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ідеальний базис

Razlog: Idealna baza jest pridevnična variantnost srodnogo izraza baza ideala. Zapis iz raboty 23 podpira kontinuitet medžunarodnyh korenjev ideal i baza; ne prědstavjaje novy matematičny pojem. Pridevnik idealna tu znači naležeča idealu, ne sovršena ili najlepsa. Jeho kompaktnost možno sravniti s jasnějšim genitivom baza ideala, ale zachovany razlog ne dava formalno sravnjenje s čislenymi vagami i ne dokazuje, že jedna forma jest vsegda prednostna. Smysl bazy mora byti vzety iz odlomka; sam pridevnik ne dodava linearnoj nezavisnosti.

Reason: Idealna baza is an adjectival variant of baza ideala. The Paper 23 record supports continuity of the international stems ideal and baza; it does not introduce a new mathematical concept. Idealna here means belonging to an ideal, not perfect or best. Its compactness can be compared with the more explicit genitive baza ideala, but the preserved reason provides neither a numerical comparison nor a demonstration that one form should always be preferred. The sense of basis must come from the passage; the adjective does not add linear independence.

Slučaj linearno nezavisnoj modulnoj bazy iz \(n\) elementov jest razgledany odvojeno. Ta izrična razlika daje čitatelju možlivosť razuměti istoričnu polisemičnost bazy bez izměnjenja avtorinogo nazvanja.

baza diskriminantnogo ideala

Iztočnik / Source: Idealbasis des Diskriminantenideals

Rusky / Russian: базис дискриминантного идеала

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: базис дискримінантного ідеалу

Razlog: Baza diskriminantnogo ideala sohranja bazu kak avtorino nazvanje i genitivom točno ukazuje objekt. V §8 raboty 31 konečno mnogo determinantov tvoret taku bazu, zato že ostale potrebne determinanty izražajut se jih kombinacijami. Tekst dopušča modulnu bazu s količstvom elementov \(m\ge n\) i posebno razgleduje slučaj linearno nezavisnoj bazy iz \(n\) elementov. To razlikovanje pokazyvaje, začto obča baza ideala ne mora byti linearno nezavisna. Vybor ne jest samo doslovny kalk: on sohranja termin i istočasno potrěbuje objašnjenja jegovogo istoričnogo smysla.

Reason: Baza diskriminantnogo ideala retains basis as Noether’s designation and identifies its object precisely through the genitive. In Paper 31, §8, finitely many determinants form such a basis because the other required determinants can be expressed as their combinations. The text allows a module basis with \(m\ge n\) elements and separately treats the case of a linearly independent basis of \(n\) elements. That distinction shows why an ideal basis need not generally be linearly independent. The choice is not merely a literal calque: it preserves the term while requiring an explanation of its historical sense.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §8 raboty 31 dopušča modulnu bazu s \(m\ge n\) elementami. Potrěbne determinanty linearno izražajut se prěz konečno mnogo determinantov iz te bazy; ony tvorjat bazu diskriminantnogo ideala. Slučaj linearno nezavisnoj modulnoj bazy iz \(n\) elementov jest razgledany odvojeno. diferenciranje idealov

Iztočnik / Source: Idealdifferentiation

Rusky / Russian: дифференцирование идеалов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: диференціювання ідеалів

Razlog: Diferenciranje idealov nazvaje operaciju, a ne samo formalnu sličnost s diferenciranjem polinomov. Izbor procesnogo imennika so korenom diferenc- i doplnjenja idealov dava kratky, razpoznavajemy izraz. Rabota 36 objavjaje vez s diferentoju; rabota 43 razviva definiciju s razlikovym idealom i idealnym kvocientom, poslě čego sledi specializacija. Zato ne trěba objašnjati termin prosto kak priměnjenje običnogo izvodnogo k svakomu tvorjačemu elementu. Tekst pokazuje, pri kakom specialnom slučaju konstrukcija sběgaje se s polinomnym diferencialnym kvocientom. Sohranjanje toj svezi i jejnyh uslovij jest važnějše než sličnost nazvanij.

Reason: Diferenciranje idealov names an operation, not merely a formal resemblance to differentiating polynomials. A process noun with the stem diferenc- and the complement idealov gives a short, recognizable expression. Paper 36 announces the connection with the different; Paper 43 develops the definition through a difference ideal and an ideal quotient, followed by specialization. The term should therefore not be explained simply as applying the ordinary derivative to each generator. The text identifies the special case in which the construction coincides with a polynomial differential quotient. Preserving this connection and its conditions matters more than the resemblance between the names.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kratka rabota 36 objavjaje interpretaciju diferenty kak diferencialnogo kvocienta definujučego ideala. V rabotě 43 ide o razlikovy ideal, idealny kvocient v ukazanoj polinomnoj oblasti i specializaciju. §3 izrično upotrěbja \((0):\mathfrak B\). Vez s obyčnym diferencialnym kvocientom polinoma nastupaje pri specialnom uslovju, že baza sostoji se iz stepenjev jednogo elementa. Slovnik zato ne smi zaměniti obšču konstrukciju proizvoljnym diferenciranjem tvorjačih polinomov.

Textual comparison: The short Paper 36 announces an interpretation of the different as the differential quotient of the defining ideal. Paper 43 uses a difference ideal, an ideal quotient in a specified polynomial domain and specialization. Section 3 explicitly uses \((0):\mathfrak B\). The connection with an ordinary polynomial differential quotient appears under the special condition that the basis consists of powers of one element. The dictionary must not replace the general construction with arbitrary differentiation of generating polynomials.

klas idealov / klas predstavjenj

Iztočnik / Source: Idealklasse / Darstellungsklasse

Rusky / Russian: класс идеалов / класс представлений

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: клас ідеалів / клас представлень

Razlog: Klas idealov i klas predstavjenj tvoret paru, zato že tekst povezuje dve klasifikacije. Genitivne konstrukcije izrično kažu, čto jest klasifikovano, vměsto da pridevnik idealny mogl zvučati kak obča ocěna. V sravnjenom odlomku raboty 31 idealy naležat istomu klasu, kogda sut izomorfne kak moduly nad danom prstenom; zatim ustanovjava se korespondencija s klasami prědstavjenij. To jest konkreten odnos ekvivalentnosti, ne svobodno grupovanje podobnyh objektov. Zapisana kontinuitet s ranějšimi izrazami podpiraje vybor, ale ne rěšaje variantnost klas/klasa ni pravopis predstavjenj/prědstavjenij v celom korpusu.

Reason: Klas idealov and klas predstavjenj form a pair because the text connects two classifications. The genitive constructions make explicit what is classified, avoiding an adjectival idealny that could sound evaluative outside mathematics. In the compared passage from Paper 31, ideals belong to the same class when they are isomorphic as modules over the specified ring; a correspondence with representation classes is then established. This is a particular equivalence relation, not an informal grouping of similar objects. Recorded continuity supports the choice but does not settle klas/klasa or predstavjenj/prědstavjenij throughout the corpus.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija v §4 raboty 31 povezuje naležnost dvoh idealov istomu klasu s izomorfizmom kak modulov nad osnovnym prstenom. Poslě togo tekst ustanovjava korespondenciju s klasami prědstavjenij. Zato klas ne jest prosto sovkupnost podobnyh idealov; genitivna konstrukcija sohranja objekt klasifikacije, a priložena definicija sohranja odnos ekvivalentnosti.

Textual comparison: The definition in Paper 31, §4, connects two ideals belonging to the same class with their isomorphism as modules over the underlying ring. The text then establishes a correspondence with representation classes. Thus class is not merely a collection of similar ideals: the genitive construction preserves the object classified, and the attached definition preserves the equivalence relation.

idealna klasa; glavna klasa; glavne idealy

Iztočnik / Source: Idealklasse; Hauptklasse; Hauptideale

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Idealna klasa, glavna klasa i glavne idealy sohranjajut rodinu nazvanij iz raboty 41. Pridevnik glavny povezuje glavnu klasu s glavnimi idealami i s terminom glavny rod, ne s proizvoljno največšoju ili najvažnějšoju klasoju. To jest matematična motivacija za soglasovanost vyboru. Pridevnična idealna klasa razlikuje se gramatično od genitivnogo klasy idealov; razlika ne ustanovjava dva različne pojmy. Ruske i ukrajinske bukvy v tom zapisu ne sut zachovane. Zato njim ne možno pripisati konkretne sličnosti ni vagovany dokaz, hoti obči razlog kontinuiteta ostaje čitateljny.

Reason: Idealna klasa, glavna klasa and glavne idealy preserve the family of expressions in Paper 41. Glavny connects principal class with principal ideals and with principal genus, not with an arbitrarily largest or most important class. That is the mathematical reason for coordinating the choices. Adjectival idealna klasa differs grammatically from genitive klasy idealov; the difference does not establish two mathematical concepts. The Russian and Ukrainian lettering in this record has not survived. Specific similarities or weighted support cannot therefore be attributed to those fields, although the general continuity argument remains readable.

klasy idealov

Iztočnik / Source: Idealklassen

Rusky / Russian: классы идеалов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: класи ідеалів

Razlog: Klasy idealov daje prozračny plural: klasifikovane objekty sut idealy. Zapis dava toj konstrukciji prednost prěd težšoju pridevničnoju kalkoju, sohranjajuči vez s glavnoju klasoju i korespondencijeju klasov. Izbor jest stilističny i terminologičny, ne rezultat izměrenoj čitateljskoj razumlivosti. V rabotě 31 smysl klasa opiraje se na modulny izomorfizm; ne treba avtomatično prěnesti sem vsaku definiciju idealnogo klasa iz drugogo razděla teorije čisel. Srodny zapis s jedinicoju klas idealov i variant klasa ostajut vidime, aby ekspert mogl posuditi i smyslovu kontinuitet, i jezykovu normu.

Reason: Klasy idealov gives a transparent plural: the classified objects are ideals. The record prefers this construction to a heavier adjectival calque while preserving links with the principal class and class correspondence. This is a stylistic and terminological judgment, not measured reader comprehension. In Paper 31 the sense of class rests on module isomorphism; not every definition of ideal class from another part of number theory should be imported automatically. The related singular klas idealov and the variant klasa remain visible so that an expert can assess both continuity of meaning and linguistic usage.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija v §4 raboty 31 povezuje naležnost dvoh idealov istomu klasu s izomorfizmom kak modulov nad osnovnym prstenom. Poslě togo tekst ustanovjava korespondenciju s klasami prědstavjenij. Zato klas ne jest prosto sovkupnost podobnyh idealov; genitivna konstrukcija sohranja objekt klasifikacije, a priložena definicija sohranja odnos ekvivalentnosti.

Textual comparison: The definition in Paper 31, §4, connects two ideals belonging to the same class with their isomorphism as modules over the underlying ring. The text then establishes a correspondence with representation classes. Thus class is not merely a collection of similar ideals: the genitive construction preserves the object classified, and the attached definition preserves the equivalence relation.

idealny kvocient

Iztočnik / Source: Idealquotient

Rusky / Russian: частное идеалов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка ідеалів

Razlog: Idealny kvocient nazvaje kolonnu operaciju \(\mathfrak a:\mathfrak b\), ne prsten klasov ostatkov i ne polje kvocientov. Pri obyčnom čitanju kolonnej operacije ishodi se od elementov, kotoryh produkty s \(\mathfrak b\) ležat v \(\mathfrak a\); kontekst oprědělja osnovnu oblast. Zapis dava prednost kratkoj konstrukciji pridevnik plus imennik, sposobnoj povtorjati se v dokazah. Ruske i ukrajinske paralely upotrěbjajut različne srodne imenniky; oni podpirajut pojem, ale sami ne ustanovjavajut medžuslovjansky kvocient. Osoblivo važno jest ne sputati avtorin děliteljny poredok s obyčnym poredkom vključenja množstv.

Reason: Idealny kvocient names the colon operation \(\mathfrak a:\mathfrak b\), not a residue-class ring or a field of fractions. Under the usual reading of the colon operation, one considers elements whose products with \(\mathfrak b\) lie in \(\mathfrak a\); the context specifies the ambient domain. The record favours a short adjective–noun construction usable repeatedly in proofs. Russian and Ukrainian render quotient by related but distinct nouns; these support the concept without themselves establishing Interslavic kvocient. It is especially important not to confuse Noether’s divisibility ordering with ordinary set inclusion.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija raboty 30 upotrěbja děliteljny jezyk: jejino najmenši modul ne možno bez objašnjenja prěnesti v jezyk najmenej sovkupnosti po vključenju. Uslovje kolonnej operacije oprědělja elementy, ktoryh produkty popadajut v pervy ideal. Pri \((0):\mathfrak a\) ono dava ideal elementov, ktore uništožajut \(\mathfrak a\) pri množenju; rabota 31 izrično razlikuje toj ideal od ostatkovogo prstena, v ktorogo imenitelju on stoji. Takže \(\mathfrak b\) prost po odnošenju k \(\mathfrak a\) jest orientovano uslovje; vzajemna prostost potrěbuje obě orientacije.

Textual comparison: Paper 30’s definition uses divisibility language: its smallest module cannot be transferred without explanation into the language of smallest sets under inclusion. The colon condition determines elements whose products fall in the first ideal. For \((0):\mathfrak a\) it gives the annihilator of the ideal; Paper 31 explicitly distinguishes this ideal from the quotient ring in whose denominator it occurs. Likewise, \(\mathfrak b\) prime relative to \(\mathfrak a\) is a directed condition; mutual relative primality requires both directions.

idealny kvocient nulovogo ideala črez \(\mathfrak{a}\)

Iztočnik / Source: Idealquotient des Nullideals durch \(\mathfrak{a}\)

Rusky / Russian: частное нулевого идеала по \(\mathfrak{a}\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка нульового ідеалу за \(\mathfrak{a}\)

Razlog: V izrazu idealny kvocient nulovogo ideala črez \(\mathfrak a\) nulovy ideal jest prvy operand, a \(\mathfrak a\) vtory. Konstrukcija \((0):\mathfrak a\) vyznača elementy, kotore uništožajut \(\mathfrak a\) pri množenju. V rabotě 31 ona pojavjaje se kak ideal v imenitelju prstena klasov ostatkov; sam kolonny ideal ne jest tym ostatkovym prstenom. Proto prěvod sohranja směr operacije, ne skračaje frazu do kvocienta po idealu. Istorično črez ne mora ostati rekomendovanym prědlogom; srodny korpusny odlomok upotrěbja prěz. Smysl operacije i izbor prědloga sut odvojene pytanja.

Reason: In idealny kvocient nulovogo ideala črez \(\mathfrak a\), the zero ideal is the first operand and \(\mathfrak a\) the second. The construction \((0):\mathfrak a\) singles out elements that annihilate \(\mathfrak a\) under multiplication. In Paper 31 it occurs as the ideal in the denominator of a residue-class ring; the colon ideal itself is not that quotient ring. The translation therefore retains the direction of the operation instead of shortening the phrase to quotient by an ideal. Historical črez need not remain the recommended preposition; the related corpus passage uses prěz. The operation’s meaning and the prepositional choice are separate questions.

Takže \(\mathfrak b\) prost po odnošenju k \(\mathfrak a\) jest orientovano uslovje; vzajemna prostost potrěbuje obě orientacije.

kvocienty idealov

Iztočnik / Source: Idealquotienten

Rusky / Russian: частные идеалов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частки ідеалів

Razlog: Kvocienty idealov jest pluralna genitivna variantnost idealny kvocient. Pozdny zapis povezuje ju s definicijnoju primětkoju pri rabotě 45 i s ranějšeju rabotoju 43. To objasnjaje kontinuitet vyboru: idealov čini argumenty operacije jasnymi, a kvocient sohranja kratky tehničny koren. Prěvod ne smi prětvoriti kolonnu operaciju v děljenje čisel ili v tvorjenje ostatkovyh klasov. Motivacija nazvaje izraz rabotnym tehničnym rěšenjem; ona ne dava dokaz prijetja od medžuslovjanskoj obščiny. Nově sravnjene definicije v rabotah 30 i 43 razjasnjajut smysl, ale ne zaměnjajut potrěbnu prověrku točnogo odlomka raboty 45.

Reason: Kvocienty idealov is a plural genitive variant of idealny kvocient. The later record connects it with a defining footnote in Paper 45 and with Paper 43. This explains the continuity of the choice: idealov makes the operands explicit, while kvocient retains a compact technical stem. The translation must not turn the colon operation into numerical division or the formation of residue classes. The rationale treats it as a working technical solution, not evidence of acceptance by the Interslavic community. Newly compared definitions in Papers 30 and 43 clarify the meaning but do not replace checking the exact Paper 45 passage.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija raboty 30 upotrěbja děliteljny jezyk: jejino najmenši modul ne možno bez objašnjenja prěnesti v jezyk najmenej sovkupnosti po vključenju. Uslovje kolonnej operacije oprědělja elementy, ktoryh produkty popadajut v pervy ideal. Pri \((0):\mathfrak a\) ono dava ideal elementov, ktore uništožajut \(\mathfrak a\) pri množenju; rabota 31 izrično razlikuje toj ideal od ostatkovogo prstena, v ktorogo imenitelju on stoji. Takže \(\mathfrak b\) prost po odnošenju k \(\mathfrak a\) jest orientovano uslovje; vzajemna prostost potrěbuje obě orientacije.

Textual comparison: Paper 30’s definition uses divisibility language: its smallest module cannot be transferred without explanation into the language of smallest sets under inclusion. The colon condition determines elements whose products fall in the first ideal. For \((0):\mathfrak a\) it gives the annihilator of the ideal; Paper 31 explicitly distinguishes this ideal from the quotient ring in whose denominator it occurs. Likewise, \(\mathfrak b\) prime relative to \(\mathfrak a\) is a directed condition; mutual relative primality requires both directions.
