Reason: Teorija idealov v \(\mathfrak T\) concerns the theory of a specified order, not a general digression about ideals. In Paper 31, §7, the phrase introduces a structural theorem on uniquely representing a nonzero ideal as a product of primary ideals. Preserving \(\mathfrak T\) and its place in the phrase is therefore part of mathematical fidelity. The Slavic genitive idealov and the preposition v make the construction explicit; no new single-word term is needed. Historical plain T is an abbreviated record of a symbol set in Fraktur in the passage.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tri primětky raboty 31 imajut konkretne funkcije: §7, 3 pri teoriji idealov poredka; §9, 7 pri integralnoj zamknutosti; §9 i §3, 1 pri egzistenciji konečnoj modulnoj bazy. Německe kratko nazvanje Idealtheorie identifikuje iztočnik. Prěvod veznika v tretjoj primětkě ne měnja nazvanje. Točne odlomky potrvrdžajut funkciju citacij v nynějšem korpusu; ne potrvrdžajut samo soboju prijašnje tvrdženja o pečatnom svědku.

Textual comparison: The three Paper 31 footnotes have specific functions: §7, 3 accompanies the ideal theory of the order; §9, 7 accompanies integral closure; §9 and §3, 1 accompany existence of a finite module basis. The shortened German title Idealtheorie identifies the source. Translating the conjunction in the third note does not change the title. These passages establish the citations’ functions in the present corpus; they do not by themselves verify earlier claims about the printed witness.

razloženje ideala / razloženje nulovogo ideala

Iztočnik / Source: Idealzerlegung / Zerlegung des Nullideals

Rusky / Russian: разложение идеала / разложение нулевого идеала

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розклад ідеалу / розклад нульового ідеалу

Razlog: Razloženje ideala i razloženje nulovogo ideala upotrěbjajut isti koren za svezane konstrukcije. Doplnjenje nulovogo ne jest izlišno: pri prěhodu k ostatkovomu prstenu razloženje vybranogo ideala odgovarja razloženju nulovogo ideala v novoj strukturě. Zapis dava prednost kontinuitetu s terminom primarnogo razloženja i razpoznavajemomu slovjanskomu korenu. Ale jedno slovo razloženje ne odstranja razliku medžu produktom idealov, jih prěsěčenjem i direktnoju sumoju; konkretny teorem oprědělja operaciju. Slovnik sohranja svez, ne spaja različne teoremy v jednu neograničenu definiciju.

Reason: Razloženje ideala and razloženje nulovogo ideala use the same stem for related constructions. Nulovogo is not redundant: on passing to a residue-class ring, a decomposition of the chosen ideal corresponds to a decomposition of the zero ideal in the new structure. The record favours continuity with primary-decomposition terminology and a recognizable Slavic stem. But decomposition alone does not erase the distinctions between a product of ideals, their intersection and a direct sum; the particular theorem determines the operation. The dictionary preserves the connection without merging different theorems into one unrestricted definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §7 raboty 31 homomorfizm prěnosi razloženje ideala \(\mathfrak T p\) na razloženje nulovogo ideala v \(\mathfrak R\). Odlomok takože razlučuje prědstavjenje slěda matricami od prědstavjenja prěz konjugovane elementy: poslednje ne mora byti priměnimo k \(\mathfrak R\). Izbor slova ideal i sohranjanje obou simbolov jest nužno, aby slovnik ne izravnal iztočny objekt s jegovym obrazom.

Textual comparison: In Paper 31, §7, a homomorphism takes decomposition of the ideal \(\mathfrak T p\) to decomposition of the zero ideal in \(\mathfrak R\). The passage also distinguishes the matrix description of trace from a description through conjugate elements: the latter need not apply to \(\mathfrak R\). The word ideal and both symbols must be preserved so that the dictionary does not identify the original object with its image.

idempotentne elementy

Iztočnik / Source: idempotente Elemente

Rusky / Russian: идемпотентные элементы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ідемпотентні елементи

Razlog: Idempotentne elementy sohranja medžunarodny tehničny koren; opisujuče zaměny ne sut navedene kak konkretny konkurenty. Motivacija povezuje termin s rabotoju 32 i spominaje češku i poljsku upotrěbu. No zapis ne dava točnyh odlomkov tyh dvoh jezykov, zato oni ne mogut byti prědstavjene kak neposrědnje citovane attestacije. Matematicky idempotentny element izpolnjaje \(e^2=e\); v rabotě 34 on učestvuje v razloženjah idealov i prědstavjenijah. Nazvanje samo ne pomeni primitivnost, centralnost ni nenulovost. Takove dodatne uslovja trěba sohraniti tam, kde avtorica jih potrěbuje.

Reason: Idempotentne elementy retains the international technical stem; no specific descriptive replacements are recorded as competitors. The rationale links the term with Paper 32 and mentions Czech and Polish usage. It supplies no exact passages from those languages, however, so they cannot be presented as directly cited attestations. Mathematically an idempotent satisfies \(e^2=e\); in Paper 34 it participates in ideal decompositions and representations. The name alone does not imply primitivity, centrality or nonzeroness. Such additional conditions must be preserved wherever Noether requires them.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 32 povezuje idempotentny element \(r\) s razloženjem \(S=rS+(e-r)S\), kde \(e\) jest jedinica. Primitivne idempotenty vyděljajut proste idealy. V kvaternionnom slučaju tekst dodatno izključuje 0 i 1 i razgleduje razpad. Tym sučstveno jest odlišiti osnovne svojstvo idempotentnosti od primitivnosti i od dodatnyh hipotez; sam koren idempotent- ne nosi vsih tyh uslovij.

Textual comparison: Paper 32 connects an idempotent \(r\) with a decomposition \(S=rS+(e-r)S\), where \(e\) is the identity. Primitive idempotents single out simple ideals. In the quaternion case the text additionally excludes 0 and 1 and discusses splitting. It is therefore essential to distinguish idempotency itself from primitivity and from additional hypotheses; the stem idempotent- does not carry all those conditions.

Razlog: Identično v \(Y\) sohranja točno matematično ograničenje: relacija važi kak identičnost po proměnnoj \(Y\), ne samo pri jednoj specialnoj cěnnosti. Zapis povezuje frazu s relacijeju (7) v §7 raboty 9. Rusko toždestvenno i ukrajinsko totožno podpirajut potrebu izraziti identičnost, ale ne daju osnovu tiho zaměniti proměnnu ili oslabiti kvantifikaciju. The record connects the phrase with relation (7) in Paper 9, §7. Russian toždestvenno and Ukrainian totožno support the need to express identity, but do not justify silently changing the variable or weakening the quantification. identične razklady

Iztočnik / Source: identische Zerlegungen

Rusky / Russian: тождественные разложения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: тотожні розклади

Razlog: Identične razklady razlikuje istost samyh razloženij od izomorfnosti jih česti. Motivacija iz raboty 17 naglašaje, že ponavljanje istogo izomorfizmova klasa v različnyh razloženjah ne čini te razloženja identičnymi. Zato ne trěba zaměnjati identične slovom ekvivalentne bez definicije, ni razklady s izomorfnymi komponentami. Rusky i ukrajinsky paralely podpirajut silny smysl istosti. Izbor razklady koegzistuje s razloženje v drugyh zapisah; slovnik mora pokazati variantnost, ale ne izdumati smyslovu razliku samo iz različnyh korenjev prěvoda.

Reason: Identične razklady distinguishes identity of the decompositions themselves from isomorphism of their parts. The Paper 17 rationale stresses that recurrence of the same isomorphism class in different decompositions does not make the decompositions identical. Identical should therefore not become equivalent without a definition, nor should decompositions become isomorphic components. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels support the stronger sense of identity. Razklady coexists with razloženje in other records; the dictionary must show that variation without inventing a conceptual distinction solely from different translated stems.

identičnost polj

Iztočnik / Source: Identität der Körper

Rusky / Russian: тождество полей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: тотожність полів

Razlog: Identičnost polj sohranja ravnost konkretno razgledanyh polj, ne samo jih abstraktnu izomorfnost. Zapis iz §6 raboty 6 upiraje se na sravnjenje stepenjev razširjenja v dokazu pripisanom Steinitzu. V sravnjenom odlomku važno jest takože vključenje polj v obče nadpolje. Jednaky konečny stepen sám po sobě ne dokazuje, že dva proizvoljne polja sut identične; zaključanje rabota zaradi togo vključenja. Zato slovnik objasnjaje i termin, i logičnu osnovu frazy. Izbor ne dodava novy teorem: on brani silu ravnosti, ktoru argument už potrěbuje.

Reason: Identičnost polj preserves equality of the particular fields under consideration, not merely their abstract isomorphism. The Paper 6, §6, record relies on a comparison of extension degrees in an argument attributed to Steinitz. In the passage compared, inclusion of the fields within a common overfield also matters. Equal finite degrees alone do not prove that two arbitrary fields are identical; the conclusion works because of that inclusion. The dictionary therefore explains both the term and the logical basis of the wording. The choice adds no new theorem: it protects the strength of equality already required by the argument.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 6 argument upotrěbja vključenje podpolj v isto polje racionalnyh funkcij i ravnost odgovarajučih konečnyh stepenjev. Zato identičnost polj označaje ravnost vybranyh podpolj v danoj situaciji. Bez vključenja ravnost stepenjev ne dostava. To jest uslovje samogo argumenta, a ne dodatno opravdanje vybrano samo zaradi prěvoda.

Textual comparison: Paper 6’s argument uses inclusion of subfields within the same rational-function field and equality of the corresponding finite degrees. Identity of fields therefore means equality of the selected subfields in that setting. Without inclusion, equal degrees are insufficient. This is a condition of the argument itself, not an extra justification invented solely for the translation.

Doplnjenje medžu polinomami zato ne jest samo stilistična izbytočnost. Ono kaže, v kakih objektah relacija nyně važi, i ne dopušča zaměniti identičnost ravnostju pri jednoj specializaciji. Rusky i ukrajinsky paralely podpirajut istu konstrukciju. Zapis daje to funkcionalno opravdanje; ne dava sravnjenu listu konkurentnyh nazvanij ni dokaz, že fraza byla novotvorba.

Reason: Identičnost medžu polinomami makes a particular proof step visible: the passage moves from rational functions to a polynomial identity. The complement medžu polinomami is therefore not merely stylistic redundancy. It identifies the objects in which the relation now holds and prevents identity from becoming equality at one specialization. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels support the same construction. The record supplies this functional justification, not a comparison of competing names or evidence that the phrase was newly coined.

teorema identičnosti

Iztočnik / Source: Identitätssatz

Rusky / Russian: теорема тождества

Razlog: Teorema identičnosti sohranja prozračnu dvuslovnu strukturu německogo nazvanja. Zapis dava medžunarodnomu korenu identičnost prednost zaradi tehničnoj točnosti. Ale samo nazvanje ne identificiruje jednu univerzalnu teoremu: v rabotě 2 ono prinaleži invariantno-teoretičnomu kontekstu. Razlog: Indukovane transformacije i totalna diferencialna forma svezane sut s transformacijami koeficientov diferencialnyh form na koncu §6 raboty 13. Indukovane ukazuje, že koeficienty ne transformujut se proizvoljno, ale po pravilah izvornogo prěobraženja. Totalna ne mora avtomatično značiti točna forma: takove razlučenje mora rešiti avtorina definicija, ne sličnost nazvanij. Opravdanje izbora pridevnikov ne jest dokaz, že vse podrobnosti formy i jej transformacije už sut proverjene.

Reason: Indukovane transformacije and totalna diferencialna forma concern transformations of differential-form coefficients at the end of Paper 13, §6. The record retains international modifiers for technical clarity and continuity with the compared languages. Induced indicates that the coefficients do not transform arbitrarily but according to the original transformation’s rules. Total must not automatically be read as exact: Noether’s definition, not similarity between labels, must settle that distinction. Justifying the modifiers is not evidence that every detail of the form and its transformation has already been checked.

Razlog: Vnutrišnje avtomorfizmy sočeta razpoznavajemy slovjansky pridevnik s medžunarodnym nazvanjem odobraženja. Odlomok izrično piše odobraženje s \(x^{-1}\) i \(x\). Ta formula objasnjaje smysl pridevnika. In Paper 34 the passage between two decompositions is given by conjugation; inner preserves that restriction, not simply the fact that both objects belong to one structure. The passage explicitly writes a map using \(x^{-1}\) and \(x\). This formula explains the adjective’s meaning. The claimed intelligibility of the Slavic stem is a qualitative reason for the choice; no reader test or numerical weights are recorded.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem raboty 34 dava konjugaciju \(\alpha'\mapsto x^{-1}\alpha'x\) pri prěhodu medžu dvoma razloženjami. To jest matematičny smysl pridevnika vnutrišnji v danom vyborě. Nije dostatočno rekti, že avtomorfizm jest něgde vnutri struktury; potrěbno sohraniti točno odobraženje.

Textual comparison: The theorem in Paper 34 gives conjugation \(\alpha'\mapsto x^{-1}\alpha'x\) in passing between two decompositions. Potrěbnyh jest sučstveno: ne znači, že samo izpolnjenje bez ostalyh hipotez vsegda dava rěšenje. V sravnjenom tekstě racionalnost koeficienta izključuje izraz s \(\log x\); slědujuči priměr potom adjunguje \(\log x\) oblasti racionalnosti i opisuje drugu situaciju. Proto ne trěba čitati frazu kak bezuslovnu nerěšimost togo samogo diferencialnogo zapisa v vseh klasah funkcij. Izbor termina podpiraje smyslovu vez s sovrěmennom kompatibilnostju uravnenij.

Reason: Uslovja integrabilnosti retains the footnote’s language explaining the reduction procedure through failure of necessary conditions for a differential-equation system. In the compared text, rationality of a coefficient excludes an expression involving \(\log x\); the next example adjoins \(\log x\) to the rationality domain and describes a different situation. The choice connects the terminology with contemporary equation-compatibility language.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Primětka raboty 17 opisuje redukciju kak neizpolnjenje potrěbnyh uslovij integrabilnosti. Okolny tekst izključuje koeficient s \(\log x\) zaradi racionalnosti. Slědujuči priměr razširjaje oblast racionalnosti adjunkcijeju toj funkcije i govori o izpolnjenom uslovju. Ta razlika pokazuje, začto tvrdženje mora ostati svazano s ukazanoju oblastju funkcij.

This difference shows why the assertion must remain tied to the specified function domain.

Sohranjenje nazvanja dopušča čitati avtorovu vez medžu algebroj i diferencialnymi uravnenjami bez tihoj modernizacije. Pojasnjenje rěšenja jest zato korisno, ale ne zaměnjaje iztočnogo termina. Rusky / Russian: область целостности

Razlog: Oblast cělosti v rabotě 17 označaje polinomovu oblast \(J\), pri kotoroj ne prědpokladaje se komutativny zakon množenja. Proto sovrěmenno naviknuty smysl komutativnoj integralnoj oblasti ne směje tiho dobaviti novu hipotezu. Motivacija sohranja istoričny Bereich i ne zaměnjaje jego automatično slovom prsten; naglas na otsutstvu nulovyh děliteljev ostaje svazany s konkretnym objektom. Reason: Oblast cělosti in Paper 17 denotes a polynomial domain \(J\) for which the commutative law of multiplication is not assumed. The rationale preserves historical Bereich instead of automatically replacing it with ring; its emphasis on absence of zero divisors remains tied to the particular object. In the exposition, \(J\) is formed by adjoining indeterminates to a field \(P\). Non-assumed commutativity is a mathematically important limit on the analogy, not a spelling difference.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 6 stroji integralnu oblast iz sistemy racionalnyh funkcij posrědstvom zatvorenosti pod skalarnym množenjem, dodavanjem i množenjem; dopuščene kvocienty dajut polje. These comparisons do not license imposing one dictionary definition on every occurrence.

integralna baza

Iztočnik / Source: Integritätsbasis

Rusky / Russian: интегральная база; интегральный базис

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: інтегральна база; інтегральний базис

Razlog: Integralna baza svazuje Integritätsbasis s algebraičnoju cělostju, ne s moralnoju ili pravnoju integritetnostju. Šest motivacij pokryvajut rabotu 5, uvod raboty 6, jej §§10 i 12, i raboty 23 i 29. V rabotě 6 definicija izrično potrěbuje konečno mnogo polinomov, prěz ktore vsaky polinom oblasti jest cěla racionalna kombinacija s koeficientami iz \(\Omega\). Tu baza znači polinomove generatory: ne trěba dobaviti linearnu nezavisnost ni čitati termin kak svobodnu cěločislenu bazu. §12 svazuje to nazvanje s teoremami VIII i IX. Ruske zapisy kolebajut se medžu baza i bazis, pri čem jedna motivacija preferuje bazis kak idiomatičny; ukrajinske zapisy takože imajut oba vida. Medžuslovjanska odluka daje prědnost kontinuitetu integralna baza. To jest dokumentovany kvalitativny izbor, ne izčisljeny rezultat sravnjenja.

Reason: Integralna baza links Integritätsbasis to algebraic integrality, not moral or legal integrity. Six rationales cover Paper 5, the introduction to Paper 6, its §§10 and 12, and Papers 23 and 29. In Paper 6 the definition explicitly requires finitely many polynomials through which every polynomial of the domain is a whole rational combination with coefficients in \(\Omega\). Here basis means polynomial generators: neither linear independence nor a free integral-module basis should be added. Section 12 connects the name to Theorems VIII and IX. The Russian records alternate between baza and bazis, with one rationale preferring bazis as idiomatic; Ukrainian records also contain both forms. The Interslavic decision prioritizes continuity of integralna baza. This is a documented qualitative choice, not a calculated comparison result.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija VI raboty 6 potrěbuje polinomove kombinacije konečno mnogih generatorov s koeficientami iz \(\Omega\), ne linearne kombinacije nezavisnyh vektorov. Teorema VII utočnjaje uslovja, pri ktoryh involucijska baza jest integralna baza. Rabota 35 upotrěbjaje integritetna baza pri porodženju cěločislenymi polinomami. Blizkost nazvanj ne izključuje razlikovanja koeficientnyh oblastij i operacij.

Textual comparison: Definition VI in Paper 6 requires polynomial combinations of finitely many generators with coefficients in \(\Omega\), not linear combinations of independent vectors. Theorem VII specifies conditions under which an involution basis is an integral basis. Paper 35 uses integritetna baza for generation by integer polynomials. The related names do not remove distinctions between coefficient domains and operations.

Rusky / Russian: область целостности

Razlog: Oblast cělosti obhvata dvě německe formulacije, Integritätsbereich i Bereich der Integrität, v rabotě 19. Motivacija obhvača zakres do §§6 i 12 i razlikuje oblasti cělosti od občejših prstenovyh oblastij. V uvodnom oprěděljenju vlastna oblast cělosti imaje jedinicu i ne imaje nulovyh děliteljev, dokolě obči prsten može ne iměti jedinicu i može iměti nulove dělitelje. Tak pojasnjen izbor sohranja avtorovo razlikovanje; samo leksično zjednoobraznjenje vsih pojavjenij Bereich zamazalo by jeho. Dvě německe formulacije ne potrěbujut dvě nezasvědčene medžuslovjanske novotvorne nazvanja.

Reason: Oblast cělosti covers two German formulations, Integritätsbereich and Bereich der Integrität, in Paper 19. The rationale spans the material through §§6 and 12 and distinguishes domains of integrity from the more general ring domains. In the introductory definition, a proper domain of integrity has an identity and no zero divisors, whereas a general ring may lack an identity and have zero divisors. Relativno cěly here does not simply mean analytically entire: the local condition requires that a quotient of two functions of the domain belong to it if and only if it is a polynomial. The ensuing argument relates that definition to Hilbert’s designation. The gloss must therefore be read with this definition, not as an unrestricted modern term for entire functions of a complex variable.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 19 i 30 objasnjajut nerazloživost pomoču najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo dvoh vlastnyh děliteljev. V rabotě 17 ireducibilne sostavne česti govoret o aditivnom razloženju grupy ostatkov. Te upotrěby ne trěba spojiti s polinomovym razloženjem na faktory bez ukazanija operacije.

Textual comparison: Papers 19 and 30 explain irreducibility by the least common multiple of two proper divisors. In §§8 and 10 the connection is explicitly to earlier §§3, 7 and 9; in §11 the international stem is motivated by avoiding preference for one national language. Rusky / Russian: неприводимые формы / порядок

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: незвідні форми / порядок

Razlog: Nereducibilne formy / poręd v rabotě 2, §19, svazuje dve odluki v kontekstě vyčisljenja Sistema III. Prva prodolžuje semju redukcije iz §18. Druga prědava Ordnung, matematičny parametr formy, vidom poręd. Ranějši zapis izrično ostavjaje toj vid za jezykovu ocěnku; slovnik ne směje vydavati jeho za potvrždženu normu. Poręd ne trěba čitati kak porědok stroček v spisku, ni bez konteksta zaměnjati stepenjem: točny pojam zadava lokalna teorija form.

Reason: Nereducibilne formy / poręd in Paper 2, §19, links two choices in the enumeration of System III. The first continues the reduction family from §18. The second renders Ordnung, a mathematical parameter of the form, as poręd. The earlier record expressly leaves this form open to linguistic appraisal; the dictionary must not present it as an established norm. Poręd should not be read as the order of rows in a list, or replaced without context by degree: the local theory of forms determines the underlying concept.

nerazložime funkcije

Rusky / Russian: неприводимые функции

Prěvod ne zaměnjaje jego tiho sovrěmennym elementi, hotě by se mogli opisati podobni algebraični objekty. Smysl nerazloživosti potrěbuje danu oblast i jej ponimanje děliteljnosti. Transparentny pridevnik ne ustanavjaje ni analitičnu nerozložimost libovoljnoj funkcije, ni univerzalno svojstvo po vsakom razširjenju oblasti.

Reason: Nerazložime funkcije in Paper 6, §8, retains the source noun Funktionen in the context of a polynomial domain. It does not silently substitute modern elements, even where similar algebraic objects could be described that way. Irreducibility depends on the stated domain and its notion of divisibility. The transparent adjective establishes neither analytic indecomposability of an arbitrary function nor a universal property under every domain extension.

Rusky / Russian: неприводимая целая функция

Reason: Nerazložima cěla funkcija in Paper 6, §§5 and 9, retains historical ganze Funktion. In this algebraic context, cěla funkcija is a polynomial, not an arbitrary analytic function without finite singularities. Both rationales keep funkcija rather than silently substituting polynomial or equation. This permits a modern explanatory gloss without erasing the author’s designation. Irreducibility remains relative to the coefficient domain under consideration.

To poslednje jest sud v zachovanom obosnovanju, ne dokaz nezavisnoj normativnoj publikacije. Ruski i ukrajinski sravnjajuči izrazy podpirajut algebraičnu irreducibilnost; prosto neděljivo moglo by zamučiti, čto imenno ne može byti razloženo. That last description is a judgment in the surviving rationale, not evidence of an independent normative publication. The Russian and Ukrainian comparators support algebraic irreducibility; simply indivisible could obscure what is unable to factor. The compared text does use nerazložimo jednačenje for the equation of \(h(x)\) relative to the given functions. nerazložime komponenty / podsistemy

Iztočnik / Source: irreduzible Komponenten / Teilsysteme

Rusky / Russian: неприводимые компоненты / подсистемы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: незвідні компоненти / підсистеми

Razlog: Nerazložime komponenty / podsistemy v rabotě 27 sohranja razložnu terminologiju i razděljenje sistemov na česti. Odlomok o Hilbertovyh čislah govori o podsistemah danyh čislami nerazložimyh komponentov idealov i o čislah členov kompozicijnogo reda. Proto komponenta i podsistem ne sut dve proizvoljne sinonimne nazvanja: imajut različne roli v odlomku. Izbor ne trěbuje zaměniti vsak podsistem odmahu podmodulom; avtorovo konkretno grupovanje čisel mora ostati vidimo.

Reason: Nerazložime komponenty / podsistemy in Paper 27 retains the decomposition vocabulary and the division of systems into parts. The passage on Hilbert numbers discusses subsystems given by counts of indecomposable components of ideals and by lengths of a composition series. Component and subsystem are therefore not arbitrarily interchangeable names: they serve different roles in the passage. The choice does not require replacing every subsystem with submodule; the author’s particular grouping of numbers must remain visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 27 podsistemy Hilbertovyh čisel dany sut čislami nerazložimyh komponentov idealov i čislami členov kompozicijne serije. Zato dva imenika imajut svazane, ale različne funkcije; ne trěba jih svesti k jednoj univerzalnoj komponentě.

Textual comparison: In Paper 27, subsystems of Hilbert numbers are given by counts of indecomposable ideal components and by lengths of a composition series. The two nouns thus have related but different functions; they should not be collapsed into a universal component.

Iztočnik / Source: irreduzible unzerlegbare Identitäten

Rusky / Russian: неприводимые неразложимые тождества

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: нередуковні нерозкладні тотожності

Razlog: Nereduktibilne nerazložime identičnosti prědava oba pridevnika v irreduzible unzerlegbare Identitäten raboty 4, §3. Motivacija izrično odklanja jih slitje v jedno sovrěmenno slovo. Nereduktibilne upotrěbjaje medžunarodny koren redukcije, nerazložime slovjansky koren razloženja; sravnjajuči prevody takože sohranjajut paru. To jest naměrno terminologično razlikovanje, ne stilično povtorjenje. Za operativne definicije oběh svojstv potrěbny jest kontekst identičnostij; slovnik ne směje sam dobaviti jednu iz modernyh definicij polinomovej irreducibilnosti.

Reason: Nereduktibilne nerazložime identičnosti renders both adjectives in irreduzible unzerlegbare Identitäten in Paper 4, §3. The rationale explicitly rejects merging them into one modern word. Nereduktibilne uses the international reduction stem, nerazložime the Slavic decomposition stem; the comparator translations likewise retain a pair. This is an intentional terminological distinction, not stylistic repetition. Operational definitions of the two properties require the context of the identities; the dictionary must not supply a modern definition of polynomial irreducibility in their place.

nerazložime dvustranne klasy

Iztočnik / Source: irreduzible zweiseitige Klassen

Rusky / Russian: неразложимые двусторонние классы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: нерозкладні двобічні класи

Razlog: Nerazložime dvustranne klasy jest formulacija zavěršajučej teoremy raboty 19, §12. Dvustranne otnosi se k klasam i ne směje odpadnuti: odlomok svazuje jih s ekvivalentnymi matricami i elementarnymi děliteljami, a primětka izrično protivostavlja jednostranne klasy, za ktore takova jedina razložimost ne slěduje. Zato medžu pridevnikami i imenikom sohranja se blizka sintaktična vez. Obšča fraza nerazložime klasy bez ukazanija storonovosti proširila by tvrdženje izvan dokazanogo slučaja.

Reason: Nerazložime dvustranne klasy formulates the closing theorem of Paper 19, §12. Dvustranne modifies the classes and cannot be dropped: the passage relates them to equivalent matrices and elementary divisors, while a footnote explicitly contrasts one-sided classes, for which the same unique decomposition does not follow. The adjectives are therefore kept syntactically close to the noun. Bare indecomposable classes would broaden the assertion beyond the case established in the text.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 19 svaz s elementarnymi děliteljami dany jest za dvustranne idealy i klasy ekvivalentnyh matric. Primětka otměčuje, že jednostranne klasy ne imajut togo samogo jednoznačnogo razloženja. Zato dvustranny jest uslovje tvrdženja, ne odstranima rečnikova podrobnost.

Textual comparison: Paper 19 supplies the connection with elementary divisors for two-sided ideals and classes of equivalent matrices. The footnote states that one-sided classes lack the same unique decomposition. Two-sided is therefore a condition of the assertion, not a dispensable verbal detail.

nerazložima algebraična mnogovidnost

Iztočnik / Source: irreduzibles algebraisches Gebilde

Rusky / Russian: неприводимое алгебраическое многообразие

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: незвідний алгебричний многовид

Razlog: Nerazložima algebraična mnogovidnost interpretuje Gebilde geometrično. Motivacija ukazuje na §10 raboty 19, kde proste idealy i nerazložime algebraične tvorby izrično svazany sut prěz nule polinomov. Rusko многообразие i ukrajinsko многовид podpirajut izbrany odborny registar; medžuslovjansko mnogovidnost jest izrično naměrny tvoreny termin, otvorjeny jezykovoj ocěnce. To ne jest dokaz ranějšej medžuslovjanskoj attestacije. Kontekst takože ne dava prava razuměti mnogovidnost kak gladku mnogovidnost diferencialnoj geometrije: ide o algebraičny objekt oprěděljeny polinomami.

Reason: Nerazložima algebraična mnogovidnost interprets Gebilde geometrically. The rationale points to §10 of Paper 19, where prime ideals and irreducible algebraic objects are expressly related through polynomial zeros. Russian многообразие and Ukrainian многовид support the disciplinary register; Interslavic mnogovidnost is explicitly a deliberately constructed term open to linguistic appraisal. This is not evidence of prior Interslavic attestation. Nor does the context license reading mnogovidnost as a smooth manifold of differential geometry: the object is algebraic and specified by polynomials.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kontekst raboty 19 svazuje proste idealy s nerazložimymi mnogovidnostjami prěz izčezanje polinomov. To podpiraje geometrično čitanje Gebilde i odlišaje njegovo značenje od gladkoj mnogovidnosti. Sam odlomok ne zasvědčaje mnogovidnost kak ranějši medžuslovjansky termin; to ostaje projektna leksična odluka.

Textual comparison: Paper 19 relates prime ideals to irreducible varieties through vanishing polynomials. This supports the geometric reading of Gebilde and distinguishes the sense from a smooth manifold. The passage does not attest mnogovidnost as a pre-existing Interslavic term; that remains the project’s lexical decision.

nerazložimy ideal

Iztočnik / Source: irreduzibles Ideal

Rusky / Russian: неразложимый идеал

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: нерозкладний ідеал

Razlog: Nerazložimy ideal v rabotě 30, §6, znači ideal, ktory ne možno prědstaviti kak najmenše obče mnogokratno dvoh vlastnyh děliteljev. Ta definicija jest neposrědnja pričina izbora korena razlož-. Ona sohranja razlikovanje od irreducibilnosti elementa pri produktnom razloženju. Rusko неразложимый i ukrajinsko нерозкладний pokazyvajut tu samu smyslovu orientaciju. Slovo ne dava samostojno informaciju o faktorovoj algebrě ili o prostosti ideala.

Reason: Nerazložimy ideal in Paper 30, §6 means an ideal that cannot be expressed as the least common multiple of two proper divisors. That definition directly motivates the razlož- stem. It preserves the distinction from irreducibility of an element under product factorization. Russian неразложимый and Ukrainian нерозкладний show the same semantic orientation. The word alone supplies no further assertion about a quotient algebra or primality of the ideal.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 19 i 30 objasnjajut nerazloživost pomoču najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo dvoh vlastnyh děliteljev. Pri uslovju cěpov nerazložimy ideal jest primarny, ale kontekst s nulovymi děliteljami razgledaje takože razložime primarne idealy. V rabotě 17 ireducibilne sostavne česti govoret o aditivnom razloženju grupy ostatkov. Te upotrěby ne trěba spojiti s polinomovym razloženjem na faktory bez ukazanija operacije.

Textual comparison: Papers 19 and 30 explain irreducibility by the least common multiple of two proper divisors. Under the chain condition an irreducible ideal is primary, but the zero-divisor context also considers reducible primary ideals. In Paper 17 irreducible constituents concern additive decomposition of a residue group. These usages must not be merged with polynomial factorization without specifying the operation.

izolovane najveće primarne idealy

Iztočnik / Source: isolierte größte primäre Ideale

Rusky / Russian: изолированные наибольшие примарные идеалы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ізольовані найбільші примарні ідеали

Razlog: Izolovane najveće primarne idealy sohranja vse tri kvalifikacije iz dodatka k rabotě 19. Zapis svazuje jedinost iz §5 s pozdnějšim rezultatom §7. Izolovane ne jest zaměnjeno sovrěmennym nazvanjem nekogo klasa pridruženyh prostyh idealov; največši primarny ideal i pridruženy prosty ideal ostajut različnymi objektami. Teorema XIII govori o jednoznačnosti izolovanyh komponentov, ne vseh primarnyh komponentov bez različenija. Nynějši tekst piše največših vměsto arhivnogo najveće; ta razlika formy takože ostaje vidima v sravnjenju.

Reason: Izolovane najveće primarne idealy retains all three qualifications in the addendum to Paper 19. The record links the uniqueness discussion in §5 to the later result in §7. Isolated is not replaced by a modern name for a category of associated primes; a greatest primary ideal and its associated prime remain different objects. Theorem XIII concerns uniqueness of isolated components, not all primary components indiscriminately. The present text has največših rather than archival najveće; the comparison also keeps that difference in form visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prědbežne odkazy raboty 19 vodat k Definiciji VIa i Teoremě XIII. Definicija sohranja uslovja na pridružene proste idealy i prědstavjenje, ale ne zavisi od specialnogo komplementa. Jedinost ne proširjaje se avtomatično na neizolovane komponenty. V rabotě 24 osnovny ideal jest izolovana komponenta oprěděljena cěloju sovokupnostju prostyh idealov; zato komponenta ne znači vsegda jeden primarny ideal. Rabota 30 povtorjaje tvrdženje jedinosti v podnožnoj primětke.

Textual comparison: Forward references in Paper 19 lead to Definition VIa and Theorem XIII. The definition retains conditions on associated primes and the representation while becoming independent of a particular complement. Uniqueness does not automatically extend to non-isolated components. In Paper 24 a basic ideal is an isolated component determined by a whole collection of primes; component therefore does not always mean a single primary ideal. Paper 30 repeats the uniqueness assertion in a footnote.

Rabota 30 povtorjaje tvrdženje jedinosti v podnožnoj primětke.

Textual comparison: Forward references in Paper 19 lead to Definition VIa and Theorem XIII. The definition retains conditions on associated primes and the representation while becoming independent of a particular complement. Uniqueness does not automatically extend to non-isolated components. In Paper 24 a basic ideal is an isolated component determined by a whole collection of primes; component therefore does not always mean a single primary ideal. Paper 30 repeats the uniqueness assertion in a footnote.

skobkovy faktor

Iztočnik / Source: Klammerfaktor

Rusky / Russian: скобочный множитель

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: дужковий множник

Ne ide prosto o každý izraz, zapisany v skobkah, ni o sam znak skobky kak samostojny množitelj. Motivacija sočetaje razpoznavajemy medžunarodny imenik s opisnym slovjanskim pridevnikom; jeje dostatočnost zavisi od togo, že formula ostaje pored objasnjenja.

Reason: Skobkovy faktor in Paper 2, §5 is a literal notation-facing phrase. The formula \((abc)\) gives the bracket notation a concrete referent; faktor preserves its algebraic role. It does not simply mean every expression in parentheses, or the bracket character itself as an independent multiplier. The rationale combines a recognizable international noun with a descriptive Slavic adjective; its adequacy depends on keeping the formula alongside the explanation.

klasa grupovogo elementa

Iztočnik / Source: Klasse eines Gruppenelements

Rusky / Russian: класс элемента группы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: клас елемента групи

Razlog: Klasa grupovogo elementa izbira kratky pridevničny izraz vměsto genitivnoj konstrukcije ruskogo i ukrajinskogo sravnjenja. Odlomok raboty 34, §26, dava sučstveno utočnjenje: klasoju nazvana jest suma \(K_a=\sum_s s^{-1}as\) v grupovom prstenu, pri čem sumuje se samo po različnyh konjugatnyh elementah. Zato čitatelj ne směje razuměti frazu samo kak množinu konjugatov, ostavjajuči sumu nevyrečenoju. Klasy v tom smyslu sut centralne elementy prstena. Izbor sintaksy i pojasnjenje lokalnogo značenja sut različne, ale obě potrěbne česti prevoda.

Reason: Klasa grupovogo elementa selects a compact adjectival phrase instead of the genitive constructions in the Russian and Ukrainian comparisons. Paper 34, §26 adds an essential qualification: what it calls a class is the group-ring sum \(K_a=\sum_s s^{-1}as\), with summation only over distinct conjugates. Readers must therefore not understand the phrase merely as a set of conjugates while leaving the sum unexpressed. Classes in this sense are central ring elements. Choosing the syntax and explaining the local sense are distinct but both necessary tasks.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §26 raboty 34 klasa jest izrično suma različnyh elementov \(s^{-1}as\) v grupovom prstenu. Daljše tvrdženje, že te klasy sut centralne elementy, zavisi od takogo ponimanja. Glosa samo množina konjugatov ostavila by matematičnu operaciju nevyrečenoju.

Textual comparison: In Paper 34, §26, class is explicitly a sum of the distinct elements \(s^{-1}as\) in the group ring. The subsequent statement that these classes are central elements depends on that reading. The gloss set of conjugates alone would leave a mathematical operation unexpressed.

klasa \(\mathfrak{R}_i\) / podmnožstvo \(\mathfrak{R}_i^*\)

Iztočnik / Source: Klasse \(\mathfrak{R}_i\) / \(\mathfrak{R}_i^*\)

Rusky / Russian: класс \(\mathfrak{R}_i\) / подмножество \(\mathfrak{R}_i^*\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: клас \(\mathfrak{R}_i\) / підмножина \(\mathfrak{R}_i^*\)

Razlog: Klasa \(\mathfrak R_i\) / podmnožstvo \(\mathfrak R_i^*\) v rabotě 9, §8, razlikuje zbirku s vozmožnymi povtorjenjami od izbora bez povtorjenja. Iz oblasti \(\mathfrak G_i\) stroji se klasa vseh izomorfnyh k nej oblastij, pri čem ista oblast može pojavjati se mnogo razov. Podmnožstvo so zvezdoju sodrživaje vsaku takovu oblast jedin raz. To ne znači izbor samo jednogo prědstavitelja za cěly izomorfny klas: ostavajut vse različne oblasti, izomorfne k \(\mathfrak G_i\). Arhivni latinski R i G predstavjajut gotične označenja tekstovogo odlomka.

Reason: Klasa \(\mathfrak R_i\) / podmnožstvo \(\mathfrak R_i^*\) in Paper 9, §8 distinguishes a collection with possible repetition from a selection without repetition. Starting from \(\mathfrak G_i\), the construction gives a class of all domains isomorphic to it, in which the same domain may occur many times. The starred subset contains each such domain once. This does not mean choosing only one representative for the entire isomorphism class: all distinct domains isomorphic to \(\mathfrak G_i\) remain. Archival Latin R and G represent the passage’s fraktur identifiers.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: \(\mathfrak R_i\) može sodrživati istu oblast mnogo razov; \(\mathfrak R_i^*\) sodrživaje vsaku oblast izomorfnu k \(\mathfrak G_i\) jedin raz. Ne ide o izbor jednogo jedinogo objekta vměsto vseh izomorfnyh objektov. Razlikovanje klasa i podmnožstva sohranja imenno točnu izbirovu operaciju.

Textual comparison: \(\mathfrak R_i\) may contain the same domain many times; \(\mathfrak R_i^*\) contains each domain isomorphic to \(\mathfrak G_i\) once. This is not selection of one single object in place of all isomorphic objects. The distinction between class and subset preserves the particular selection operation.

klasy podobnyh algeber; grupa klasov

Iztočnik / Source: Klassen ?hnlicher Algebren; Gruppe der Klassen

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Klasy podobnyh algeber; grupa klasov sohranja opisny jezyk raboty 40 vměsto tihoj zaměny pozdnějšim eponymnym nazvanjem. V tekstě jeden klas sobiraje matrične algebry s tym samym pridruženym dělitvenym objektom, s izomorfnymi objektami identificirovanymi. Produkt nad obščim centrom definuje umnoženje klasov; jediničny klas davajut matrične prsteny nad centrom, obratny klas recipročna algebra. Tak podprta jest vez s pozdnějšim jezykom Brauerovoj grupy, ale podobny ne směje byti pročitan kak libovoljna matrična podobnost. Ruska i ukrajinska polja v zachovanom zapisě poškodžena sut; njih leksika ne rekonstruuje se iz paměti.

Reason: Klasy podobnyh algeber; grupa klasov retains Paper 40’s descriptive language instead of silently replacing it with a later eponym. In the text, a class collects matrix algebras with the same associated division object, identifying isomorphic division objects. Product over the common centre defines multiplication of classes; matrix rings over the centre give the identity class, and the reciprocal algebra gives the inverse. This supports the connection with later Brauer-group language, but similar must not be read as arbitrary matrix similarity. The Russian and Ukrainian fields in the surviving record are damaged; their wording is not reconstructed from memory.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 40 razlikuje dělitvene algebry s centrom \(P\) od komutativnyh razširitelnyh polj. Klasy podobnyh algeber imajut umnoženje, jediničny klas i obratne klasy, izrično opisane v §7. To podpiraje smyslovu rekonstrukciju, ale ne vozvrača izgubjene bukvy ruskoj i ukrajinskoj kolonki.

Textual comparison: Paper 40 distinguishes division algebras with centre \(P\) from commutative extension fields. Classes of similar algebras have multiplication, an identity class and inverse classes, explicitly described in §7. This supports semantic reconstruction but does not restore the lost Russian and Ukrainian lettering.

Textual comparison: In Paper 31 the coefficients of \(|tE-C|\) are class invariants. The trace is the coefficient of \((-t^{s-1})\) and equals the sum of diagonal entries. The definition links the lexical choice to an exact sign and a particular meaning of class.

najmenša soderžeča integralna oblast

Iztočnik / Source: kleinster enthaltender Integritätsbereich

Razlog: Najmenša soderžeča integralna oblast naziva objekt potrěbny pri obobčenju poslě Teoremy VIII v rabotě 6, §12. Najmenša nosi uslovje vključenja, ne ocěnu čislovoj veličiny. Sravnjeni tekst govori o polinomah najmenšej oblasti, ktore možut byti prědstavjene cělymi racionalnymi kombinacijami konečno mnogyh polinomov početnogo sistema. Čislo tyh polinomov može zavisěti od izbranogo elementa. To jest sučstveno za prěnos argumenta o bazi; zaměna samym slovom zamknutost skryla by, kakoj objekt jest skonstruovany.

The compared text describes polynomials in the least domain as integral rational combinations of finitely many polynomials from the initial system; the number may depend on the element represented. Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 6 razlikuje cěle racionalne kombinacije od kvocientov i vsih racionalnyh kombinacij. Textual comparison: Paper 6 distinguishes integral rational combinations from quotients and arbitrary rational combinations. Following Theorem VIII, an element of the least domain uses finitely many initial-system polynomials, with the number depending on that element. Containment and leastness are therefore substantive qualifications.

Odlomok §7 pozdněje definira to polje prěz vse racionalne kombinacije konečno mnogyh funkcij sistema s koeficientami iz \(\Omega\). Zato najmenjše ne znači najmanje po čislu elementov. Section 7 subsequently defines the field through all rational combinations of finitely many system functions with coefficients in \(\Omega\). Least therefore does not mean smallest cardinality. This relative clause and the shorter adjectival construction in the next record are two ways of expressing the containing condition, not two new kinds of field.

Rusky / Russian: наименьшее содержащее поле

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: найменше поле, що містить

Razlog: Najmenše soderžeče polje jest kratka forma konstrukcije iz raboty 6, §7. Čitatelj mora uviděti sodržanje sistema i minimalnost polja, zato že argument prěnosi racionalne bazy polj na libovoljne sistemy. Sravnjeni tekst razlikuje linearne kombinacije, cěle racionalne kombinacije i kvocienty, prěhodeči poslědovateljno k linearnoj familiji, integralnoj oblasti i polju. Najmenše polje ne jest samo drugoje ime za jednu iz predhodnyh oblastij. Arhivno soderžeče i nynešnje sodrživajuče ostajut različnymi formami v dokumentaciji.

Reason: Najmenše soderžeče polje is the compact construction in Paper 6, §7. Both containment and leastness must remain visible because the argument transfers rational bases of fields to arbitrary systems. The compared text distinguishes linear combinations, integral rational combinations and quotients, passing successively to a linear family, a domain and a field. The least field is not merely another name for either preceding object. Archival soderžeče and present sodrživajuče remain distinct documented forms.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 6 razlikuje cěle racionalne kombinacije od kvocientov i vsih racionalnyh kombinacij. Poslě Teoremy VIII jasno jest, že element najmenšej oblasti koristi konečno čislo polinomov iz početnogo sistema, zavisno od elementa. Zato sodržanje i minimalnost ne sut samo ukrasne pridevniky.

Textual comparison: Paper 6 distinguishes integral rational combinations from quotients and arbitrary rational combinations. Following Theorem VIII, an element of the least domain uses finitely many initial-system polynomials, with the number depending on that element. najmenša soderžeča relativno cěla oblast

Iztočnik / Source: kleinster enthaltender relativ-ganzer Bereich

Rusky / Russian: наименьшая содержащая относительно целая область

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: найменша відносно ціла область, що містить

Razlog: Najmenša soderžeča relativno cěla oblast v rabotě 6, §9, naměrno povtarjaje konstrukciju najmenšego sodrživajučego polja. Analogia ne odstranjaje ograničenje na polinomy: nova oblast sodrživaje vse polinomy, ktore možut byti kvocientami dvoh polinomov početnoj oblasti. Ne vključaje proizvoljne racionalne funkcije bez togo uslovja. Zato relativno cěla jest tehnična kvalifikacija v lokalnoj definiciji; ne trěba jeje bez objasnjenja zaměniti sovrěmennym nazvanjem integralnogo zamknutja.

Reason: Najmenša soderžeča relativno cěla oblast in Paper 6, §9 deliberately parallels the least-containing-field construction. The analogy does not remove the restriction to polynomials: the new domain contains all polynomials expressible as quotients of two polynomials from the initial domain. It does not admit arbitrary rational functions without that condition. Relativno cěla is therefore a technical qualification under the local definition, not a licence to substitute the modern label integral closure without explanation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija dopušča kvocienty polinomov samo togda, kogda rezultat jest polinom. Predhodna i nova oblast imajut isto najmenše sodrživajuče polje; iz togo ne slěduje ravnost samyh oblastij.

Textual comparison: The definition admits quotients of polynomials only when the result is a polynomial. The initial and new domains have the same least containing field; this does not make the domains themselves equal.

najmenše razširjeno polje

Razlog: Komutativno povezano s v rabotě 34, §§18–19, prodolžuje tehničnu frazu iz §15. Obča reč povezano ne by sama prědala ty uslovja; ona potrěbuje definovanu tehničnu upotrěbu. Sočetanje ne tvrdi, že sam razgledany prsten jest komutativny.

Submodules must also admit multiplication by \(P\). Connected alone would not convey these conditions; the phrase needs its defined technical use. It does not assert that the ring itself is commutative.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §15 i pozdnějši odlomok raboty 34 izrično svazujut operatorno sohranjenje s \((am)\rho=a(m\rho)=(a\rho)m\). Druhy odlomok dodaje uslovje jediničnogo operatora i stabilnost podmodulov po \(P\). To ne jest tvrdženje komutativnosti vsego prstena.

Textual comparison: Section 15 and a later Paper 34 passage explicitly relate preservation of the operator action to \((am)\rho=a(m\rho)=(a\rho)m\). The latter adds the identity-operator condition and stability of submodules under \(P\). This is not a statement that the entire ring is commutative.

Zato komplementarny ne znači samo dodatny i ne označuje avtomatično direktny sumand. Razpoznavajemost jest razlog izbora, ale točno značenje davaje svaz s formulami.

Reason: Komplementarne bazy / komplementarne moduly in Paper 42 retains the international adjective shared by the comparator translations. kompozicijny red / kompozicijny faktor

Razlog: Kompozicijny red / kompozicijny faktor v pozdnějših paragrafah raboty 34 sohranja svaz s grupami s operatorami iz glavy I. Zapis izbira red radi soglasovanja s izloženjem prědstavjenij i otvorjeno pomina ranějše rjad. Sravnjeni §3 uže govori red, ale §23 imaje serija. Zato dokumentovana želja doslědnosti ne jest dokaz jednotnogo imenika v celoj rabotě. Razlika red/faktor ostaje strukturna: red sostoji se iz podobjektov, faktor jest kvocient medžu poslědovateljnymi členami.

Reason: Kompozicijny red / kompozicijny faktor in later sections of Paper 34 retains the connection with Chapter I’s operator groups. The record selects red for consistency with the representation-theory exposition and openly flags earlier rjad. The compared §3 already has red, but §23 uses serija. An intention of consistency is therefore not evidence of a uniform noun throughout the paper. Series and factor remain structurally distinct: the former consists of subobjects, the latter is a quotient between successive terms.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §3 raboty 34 definira konečny nevstavimy red dopustimyh podgrup i njegove kvocientne faktory. On upotrěbjaje red, dokolě §23 pri matricah prědstavjenja imaje serija. Arhivno rjad jest treti variant istej terminologije; promena imenika ne dava novu konstrukciju.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §3 defines a finite unrefinable series of admissible subgroups and its quotient factors. It uses red, whereas §23 uses serija for representation matrices. Archival rjad is a third form of the same terminology; the noun variation does not introduce a new construction.

kompozicijny rjad / kompozicijny faktor

Iztočnik / Source: Kompositionsreihe / Kompositionsfaktor

Rusky / Russian: композиционный ряд / композиционный фактор

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: композиційний ряд / композиційний фактор

To opravdava kontinuitet značenja, ne novi samostojny leksičny vybor za vsako pojavljanje. Arhivna forma rjad ostaje sravniteljnym variantom k red i serija. Pri objašnjenju trěba jasno razlikovati dolgost reda od njegovih faktorov i ne prěvratiti formnu variantnost v razlikovanje trěh matematičnyh konstrukcij.

Reason: Kompozicijny rjad / kompozicijny faktor in Paper 34, §5 deliberately continues the §3 rationale and Jordan–Hölder framing. This supports continuity of meaning, not a new independent lexical selection for every occurrence. Archival rjad remains a comparator to red and serija. The exposition must distinguish series length from its factors and must not turn noun variation into three different mathematical constructions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §3 raboty 34 definira konečny nevstavimy red dopustimyh podgrup i njegove kvocientne faktory. On upotrěbjaje red, dokolě §23 pri matricah prědstavjenja imaje serija. Arhivno rjad jest treti variant istej terminologije; promena imenika ne dava novu konstrukciju.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §3 defines a finite unrefinable series of admissible subgroups and its quotient factors. It uses red, whereas §23 uses serija for representation matrices. Archival rjad is a third form of the same terminology; the noun variation does not introduce a new construction.

kompozicijna serija modula predstavjenja

Iztočnik / Source: Kompositionsreihe des Darstellungsmoduls

Rusky / Russian: композиционный ряд модуля представления

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: композиційний ряд модуля представлення

Razlog: Kompozicijna serija modula predstavjenja v rabotě 34, §23, naměrno izbira serija vměsto rjad radi širšej medžuslovjanskoj razumljivosti. To jest zabilěžena ocěna, ne rezultat ispytanja. Nyněšnji odlomok dava kompozicijna serija modula prědstavjenja pri izboru bazy, ktora vodi k blokovoj formě matrice \(W\). Smysl zato ostaje kompozicijny red modula prědstavjenja, ne osobny novy vid serije. Slovnik mora javno pokazati konkurenciju serija/red/rjad i razumljivost ne proglasiti dokazanom.

Reason: Kompozicijna serija modula predstavjenja in Paper 34, §23 deliberately chooses serija over rjad for broader cross-Slavic readability. That is a recorded judgment, not an experimental result. The present passage has kompozicijna serija modula prědstavjenja when choosing a basis that gives the matrix \(W\) a block form. The meaning remains a composition series of the representation module, not a new kind of series. The dictionary must expose serija/red/rjad competition without declaring intelligibility proved.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §3 raboty 34 definira konečny nevstavimy red dopustimyh podgrup i njegove kvocientne faktory. On upotrěbjaje red, dokolě §23 pri matricah prědstavjenja imaje serija. Arhivno rjad jest treti variant istej terminologije; promena imenika ne dava novu konstrukciju.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §3 defines a finite unrefinable series of admissible subgroups and its quotient factors. It uses red, whereas §23 uses serija for representation matrices. Archival rjad is a third form of the same terminology; the noun variation does not introduce a new construction.

kongruentny po modulu

Iztočnik / Source: kongruent mod \(M\)

Rusky / Russian: конгруэнтные по модулю

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: конгруентні за модулем

Razlog: Kongruentny po modulu čuva algebraično nazvanje v rabotě 17. Formula \(F\equiv G\) po modulu \(\mathfrak M\) znači, že \(F-G\) naleži k \(\mathfrak M\). To uslovje oprědělja klasy ostatkov, ale ne ustanavjaje avtomatično množenje klasov: tekst potom opozarja, že v nekomutativnom slučaju produkt dvoh proizvoljnyh klasov ne mora byti dobro oprěděljen. Zato znano nazvanje kongruencije ne može zaměniti prověrku operacij, ktore konkretna struktura dopušča.

Reason: Kongruentny po modulu retains the algebraic congruence term in Paper 17. The relation \(F\equiv G\) modulo \(\mathfrak M\) means that \(F-G\) belongs to \(\mathfrak M\). This defines residue classes but does not automatically give them a multiplication: the text warns that, in the noncommutative setting, the product of arbitrary classes need not be well defined. Familiar congruence terminology cannot replace checking which operations the particular structure admits.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razlika \(F-G\) dolžna naležati k modulu. Slědujuči odlomok pokazyvaje, že produkt dvoh proizvoljnyh klasov ne mora byti dobro oprěděljen, hotě lěvo umnoženje polinomom jest dopustimo.

Textual comparison: The difference \(F-G\) must belong to the module. The following passage shows that multiplication of two arbitrary classes need not be well defined, although left multiplication by a polynomial is admissible.

konjugaty

Iztočnik / Source: Konjugierte

Rusky / Russian: сопряжённые

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: спряжені

Razlog: Konjugaty v zapisah raboty 9, §§3 i 9, i raboty 10, §2, zadržava medžunarodny koren dlja algebraičnoj konjugacije. Razlogy svezujut tri odlomky s ranějšim terminom, dokolě rusky i ukrajinsky sravniteljne formy imajut slovjanske koreni. To jest izbor kratkogo tehničnogo nazvanja, ne tvrdženje, že vse vidy konjugacije sut jedna operacija. Razgledane objekty i osnovna oblast morajut byti nazvane v konkretnom argumentu; na primer, konjugaty oblastij ne sut obyčno kompleksno sprjažene čisla.

Reason: Konjugaty in the records for Paper 9, §§3 and 9 and Paper 10, §2 retains the international root for algebraic conjugacy. The rationales connect all three passages with earlier terminology, while Russian and Ukrainian use Slavic-root comparators. This selects a compact technical designation; it does not identify every kind of conjugation as one operation. The objects and base domain must be specified in the argument: conjugate domains, for example, are not merely complex-conjugate numbers.

konjugat / konjugaty vzhodno k \((H)\)

Iztočnik / Source: Konjugierte / in bezug auf \((H)\) Konjugierten

Rusky / Russian: сопряжённое / сопряжённые относительно \((H)\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: спряжене / спряжені відносно \((H)\)

Razlog: Konjugat / konjugaty vzhodno k \((H)\) čuvaje relativnost konstrukcije klasov v rabotě 9, §8. Zapis naměrno zadržava konjugat, ale sam označaje vzhodno k kak konstrukciju za daljšu ocěnu. Nyněšnji tekst imaje po odnošenju k \((H)\); primětka kaže, že elementy konjugovanyh oblastij možut byti racionalno izrazimy prěz početnu oblast, ale ne potrěbno cělo i racionalno. Zato oblasti možut byti različne. Ispuščenje osnovy \((H)\) ili tiho tvrdženje identičnosti skrylo by matematično uslovje.

Reason: Konjugat / konjugaty vzhodno k \((H)\) preserves the relative character of the class construction in Paper 9, §8. The record deliberately keeps konjugat but itself flags vzhodno k for further appraisal. The present text has po odnošenju k \((H)\); its note says elements of the conjugate domains can be expressed rationally through the initial domain, but not necessarily integrally and rationally. The domains may therefore differ. Removing \((H)\) or silently asserting identity would lose a mathematical qualification.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Sravnjeni odlomok raboty 9 imaje po odnošenju k \((H)\) i izrično dopušča različnost konjugovanyh oblastij. Racionalna izrazimost ne mora byti cělo racionalna izrazimost. To jest matematična granica, ktoru predložna fraza mora čuvati.

Textual comparison: The compared Paper 9 passage has po odnošenju k \((H)\) and expressly allows the conjugate domains to differ. Rational expressibility need not be integral rational expressibility. The prepositional phrase must preserve that mathematical qualification.

konjugaty imenovatelja

Iztočnik / Source: Konjugierte des Nenners

Rusky / Russian: сопряженные знаменателя

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: спряжені знаменника

Razlog: Konjugaty imenovatelja v rabotě 7 naziva elementy potrěbne za odstranjenje imenovatelja pri racionalnom absolutnom invariantu. Genitiv imenovatelja čuva, čije konjugaty se berut; tekst dodatno oprěděljaje odnos k grupě. Množenje čislitelja i imenovatelja dotičnymi konjugatami dava količnik cělyh racionalnyh absolutnyh invariantov. Tekst izrično ne zahtěvaje, že oba sut vzajemno proste. Zato obično navodjenje na racionalizaciju kompleksnogo imenovatelja ne objašnjaje toj konkretny postupok.

Reason: Konjugaty imenovatelja in Paper 7 names the conjugates needed to clear the denominator of a rational absolute invariant. The genitive identifies what is conjugated; the text further specifies conjugacy with respect to the group. Multiplying numerator and denominator by the relevant conjugates produces a quotient of integral rational absolute invariants. The text expressly allows these to have common factors. Ordinary complex-denominator rationalization would therefore not explain the construction.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odlomok raboty 7 izrično svjazuje konjugaty imenovatelja s grupoju. Dobijeny čislitelj i imenovatelj sut cěle racionalne absolutne invarianty, ale ne morajut byti vzajemno proste.

Textual comparison: Paper 7 specifies conjugates relative to the group. The resulting numerator and denominator are integral rational absolute invariants, but need not be relatively prime.

konjugovane elementy

Iztočnik / Source: konjugierte Elemente

Rusky / Russian: сопряженные элементы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: спряжені елементи

Razlog: Konjugovane elementy v rabotě 31, §6, prodolžuje medžunarodny korenj ranějših konjugovanyh faktorov i polj. Zapis sravnjaje rusko сопряженные i ukrajinsko спряжені, ale predpočita konjugovane prěd prinudnym kalkom. V tekstě elementy pojavjajut se v prědstavjenju slěda, normy i diskriminanta pri polnoj razložimosti prvogo roda; v poljevom slučaju odpovědajut izomorfizmam, ktore fiksujut \(P\). Nijedna opča podobnost elementov ni kompleksno konjugovanje bez ukazanja osnovy ne daje togo smysla.

Reason: Konjugovane elementy in Paper 31, §6 continues the international stem used for conjugate factors and fields. The record compares Russian сопряженные and Ukrainian спряжені but prefers konjugovane to a forced calque. In the text, the elements occur in formulas for trace, norm and discriminant under complete decomposability of the first kind; in the field case they correspond to isomorphisms fixing \(P\). Neither unspecified similarity nor complex conjugation without a base-field qualification supplies that meaning.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V poljevom slučaju raboty 31 izomorfizmy fiksujut osnovno polje. Tekst dodatno razlikuje izomorfny objekt od polja, už vključenogo v Galoisovo razširjenje.

Textual comparison: In Paper 31’s field case, the isomorphisms fix the base field. The text further distinguishes an isomorphic object from a field already included in the Galois extension.

Rusky / Russian: сопряженные величины

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: спряжені величини

Veličina ne znači samo realno izměrimy razměr: tuto sut algebraične izrazy. Osnovno polje i relacija konjugovanosti ostajut čestju objašnjenja.

Reason: Konjugovane veličiny in Paper 6, §5 refers to linear forms in an algebraic extension. The text uses \(z-u(x)\) and its conjugates to construct the involution form. Veličina here denotes an algebraic expression, not necessarily a measurable real magnitude. The record says that the phrasing followed an English control version: this identifies an intermediary in the choice, not independent Interslavic authority. The base field and the conjugacy relation remain part of the explanation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 6 povezuje faktory \(z-u(x)\) s redami konjugovanyh veličin i jejich elementarnymi simetričnymi funkcijami. Odstranjenje redov iz nazvanja skrylo by koordiniranu strukturu, na ktoroj stoji argument.

Textual comparison: Paper 6 connects the factors \(z-u(x)\) to conjugate tuples and their elementary symmetric functions. Omitting the tuples from the name would conceal the coordinated structure used by the argument.

Reusing the phrase preserves that proof connection; it does not justify dropping rows or replacing coordinated tuples with an unstructured list.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 6 povezuje faktory \(z-u(x)\) s redami konjugovanyh veličin i jejich elementarnymi simetričnymi funkcijami. Odstranjenje redov iz nazvanja skrylo by koordiniranu strukturu, na ktoroj stoji argument.

Textual comparison: Paper 6 connects the factors \(z-u(x)\) to conjugate tuples and their elementary symmetric functions. Omitting the tuples from the name would conceal the coordinated structure used by the argument.

Iztočnik / Source: Konjugiertenklasse / Klassen konjugierter Gruppenelemente

Razlog: Konjugacijna klasa naziva klasu grupovyh elementov, srodnu ruskomu класс сопряженности i ukrajinskomu клас спряженості. Reason: Konjugacijna klasa names the conjugacy class corresponding to Russian класс сопряженности and Ukrainian клас спряженості. The record favours the international adjective over inventing a native calque, but its clarity assessment is not measured. Paper 34, §26 requires a distinction between the class of group elements and its sum in the group ring. A central element has coefficients constant on a class, whereas \(K_a\) is the sum of its distinct conjugates. These related uses of class are not literally one object.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Koeficienty centralnogo elementa sut konstantne na konjugacijnoj klasi. Ranějše \(K_a\) jest suma različnyh konjugatov; klasa elementov i suma v grupovom prstenu trěbujut različne objašnjenja.

Textual comparison: Coefficients of a central element are constant on a conjugacy class. The preceding \(K_a\) is a sum of distinct conjugates; the class of elements and its group-ring sum need separate explanations.

konstanty

Iztočnik / Source: Konstanten (\(\xi_i a=a\xi_i\))

Rusky / Russian: константы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: константи

Razlog: Konstanty jest obično medžunarodno slovo, no rabota 17, §10, dava jemu točno lokalno uslovje: veličiny \(a\) iz oblasti racionalnosti trěbujut izpolnjati \(\xi_i a=a\xi_i\). Zapis naměrno sohranja tu definiciju, da by slovo ne bylo čitano samo kak neproměnny čislovy parametr. Teorem VIII predpolagaje beskonečno mnogo takyh konstant. Izpuščenje relacije komutovanja ili te beskonečnosti proměnilo by hipotezu, iako samo slovo ostalo by poznano.

Reason: Konstanty is an ordinary international term, but Paper 17, §10 imposes a precise local condition: quantities \(a\) in the rationality domain must satisfy \(\xi_i a=a\xi_i\). The record preserves this definition so that constant is not read merely as a fixed numerical parameter. Theorem VIII requires infinitely many such constants. Omitting the commutation condition or that infinitude would change the hypothesis even though the familiar word remained.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem VIII raboty 17 sojedinja uslovje \(\xi_i a=a\xi_i\) s potrěbovanjem beskonečno mnogyh konstant. Obe česti sut hipotezy, ne osobnosti nazvanja.

Textual comparison: Paper 17, Theorem VIII combines \(\xi_i a=a\xi_i\) with the requirement of infinitely many constants. Both are hypotheses, not optional features of the terminology.

konstrukcija \(f(z)\)

Iztočnik / Source: Konstruktion von \(f(z)\)

Rusky / Russian: построение \(f(z)\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: побудова \(f(z)\)

Razlog: Konstrukcija \(f(z)\) v rabotě 10, §3, izbira medžunarodny imennik vměsto ruskogo построение i ukrajinskogo побудова. Sravnjeny početok paragrafa govori, že najdene potrěbne uslovja davajut takože konstrukciju: zadavaje drugo dobro uporjadkovanje i postupno prirědžaje ješče neupotrěbjene bazove elementy. Zato konstrukcija ima točno dokazno sodržanje. Moderno nazvanje ne daje prava prědložiti konvergentnu čislovu proceduru ili konečnu implementaciju, ktoryh fraza sama ne obeščava.

Reason: Konstrukcija \(f(z)\) in Paper 10, §3 chooses an international noun beside Russian построение and Ukrainian побудова. The opening says that the necessary conditions also yield a construction: it specifies a second well-ordering and successively assigns previously unassigned basis elements. Construction therefore has definite proof content. Modern terminology does not authorize presenting it as a convergent numerical procedure or a finite implementation, neither of which the phrase promises.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §7 raboty 9 razlikuje dokaz obstajanja od konstrukcije pri zadannom dobrom uporjadkovanju. §3 raboty 10 izrično prirědžaje bazove elementy s pomočju drugogo dobrogo uporjadkovanja. Reč konstrukcija ne obeščava konečny algoritm.

Textual comparison: Paper 9, §7 distinguishes existence from construction under a specified well-order. Paper 10, §3 explicitly assigns basis elements using another well-order. The word construction does not promise a finite algorithm.

kontinuirna grupa v smislu Lija

Iztočnik / Source: kontinuierliche Gruppe im Lieschen Sinne

Rusky / Russian: непрерывная группа в смысле Ли

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: неперервна група у сенсі Лі

Razlog: Kontinuirna grupa v smislu Lija sohranja istorijno ograničenje raboty 13. Pridavnik kontinuirna ne nosi vsu informaciju: dodatok v smislu Lija svjazuje variacijske problemy s konkretnymi grupami transformacij. Vvedenje samogo teksta razlikuje uravnenja, nastavajuče iz variacijskyh problemov, od libovoljnyh diferencialnyh uravnenij, dopuščajučih grupu. Zato ne trěba skračati frazu do obče kontinuirnoj simetrije i potratiti toj kontrast. Zapis opira izbor na teoriju Lija, ne na tvrdženje o novom izslědovanji razumljivosti.

Reason: Kontinuirna grupa v smislu Lija retains the historical qualification in Paper 13. The adjective continuous does not carry all the information: in Lie’s sense connects the variational problems to the specified transformation-group setting. The introduction distinguishes equations arising from variational problems from arbitrary differential equations admitting a group. Reducing the phrase to generic continuous symmetry would lose that contrast. The record grounds the choice in Lie-theoretic framing, not in a new comprehension study.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Vvedenje raboty 13 izrično razlikuje diferencialne uravnenja variacijskyh problemov od libovoljnyh uravnenij, dopuščajučih grupu. Liejev kontekst i to ograničenje trěbujut ostati vidime.

Textual comparison: Paper 13’s introduction distinguishes differential equations arising from variational problems from arbitrary equations admitting a group. The Lie-theoretic context and that restriction must remain visible.

kontragradientny / kogradientny

Iztočnik / Source: kontragredient / kogredient

Rusky / Russian: контрагредиентный / когредиентный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: контрагредієнтний / когредієнтний

Razlog: Kontragradientny / kogradientny jest arhivna dvojica iz §26 raboty 2. Jej razlog jest sohranitje medžunarodnyh terminov različno usměrenyh transformacij. Ale zapis ima -gradient-, dokolě ruska i ukrajinska sravnjenja i ranějše medžuslovjanske zapisy imajut -gredient-. Nyněšnji odlomok sohranja kontragradientnym i kogradientne. To jest dokumentovana pravopisna nedoslědnost, ne dokaz dvuh novyh matematičnyh smyslov. Slovnik pokazyvaje ju zajedno s ranějšim pravilom, ne izdavaje neprovedeno soglasovanje za završeno.

Reason: Kontragradientny / kogradientny is the archived pair from Paper 2, §26. Its rationale is retention of international terms for different transformation behaviours. Yet the record has -gradient-, whereas its Russian and Ukrainian comparators and earlier Interslavic records have -gredient-. The current passage retains kontragradientnym and kogradientne. This is a documented spelling inconsistency, not evidence of two additional mathematical meanings. It must remain visible beside the earlier rule rather than being described as resolved.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odlomok §26 raboty 2 imaje kontragradientnym i kogradientne. To jest točno svědčenje upotrěby -gradient- v sravnjenom tekstě, a ne dokaz završenoj normalizacije k -gredient-.

Textual comparison: Paper 2, §26 has kontragradientnym and kogradientne. These attest -gradient- in the compared text, rather than a completed normalization to -gredient-.

kontragredientne formy

Iztočnik / Source: kontragrediente Formen

Rusky / Russian: контрагредиентные формы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: контрагредієнтні форми

Razlog: Kontragredientne formy sojedinja šest zapisov iz raboty 2. Razlog počinaje od terminologije simbolov v vvedenju i §1, potom prodolžuje ju za formy v §8 i daljših redukcijah. Bitna jest razlika od prosto pridruženoj formy: kontragredientnost oprěděljaje, ktore produkty vhodet v dotične kontrakcije. Zapis o prěnosah slov pri prelomu reda v ruskoj i ukrajinskoj versijah označaje tipografiju, ne razliku termina. Povtorjena motivacija čuva kontinuum pojma, no ne stvara šest nezavisnyh jezykovyh dokazov.

Reason: Kontragredientne formy brings together six Paper 2 records. The rationale extends the symbol terminology of the introduction and §1 to forms in §8 and later reductions. Its distinction from merely associated forms matters: contragredience governs which products enter the stated contractions. A record about discretionary hyphenation in the Russian and Ukrainian versions concerns typesetting, not a different term. Repeated reasons establish continuity of the concept, not six independent linguistic attestations.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Početna konstrukcija razlikuje čislo redov kontragredientnyh simbolov. Daljše redukcije ograničajut vhodenje odredženyh form v kontrakcije produktami s kontragredientnymi formami. To jest matematična relacija, ne opča asociacija.

Textual comparison: The initial construction distinguishes the number of contragredient symbol rows. Later reductions restrict specified forms’ participation in contractions to products with contragredient forms. This is a mathematical relation, not generic association.

Simboly zato sut čestju točnoj simboličnoj konstrukcije, ne prosto drugoje slovo za proizvoljne znaky. Kratkost termina ne zaměnjaje objašnjenje transformacijnogo odnosa, no sohranja vezu s daljšimi kontragredientnymi formami.

In §1, the number of symbol rows affects uniqueness of the series of forms: two rows are distinguished from a greater number. The concise phrase does not replace explanation of the transformation relation, but preserves its connection with the later contragredient forms.

Explanation must connect each term to its particular object and transformation behaviour, rather than merely displaying cognate spellings.

Nova konsultacija jej §1, str. 1, potvrdžaje ukrajinske kontravarianty v pisemnoj formě контраваріанти; avtor razlikuje kovarianty i kontravarianty prěz razne kolca invariantov s prěměnnymi i dualnymi prěměnnymi. To podpiraje ukrajinsku tehničnu upotrěbu i smyslovu razliku, ne samo medžuslovjansko slovo ni jeho obšču razumljivost. Nova konsultacija ostaje oddělena od istorijnogo navodjenja iztočnika.

Reason: Kontravarianty continues the international stem in Paper 2, §13. Here the record identifies a specific linguistic source: Bedratyuk, arXiv:math/0702732v1 (2007). Fresh examination of §1, p. 1 confirms Ukrainian контраваріанти and a distinction between covariants and contravariants through different invariant rings involving variables and dual variables. This supports the Ukrainian technical use and semantic distinction, not independent Interslavic adoption or general intelligibility. The new consultation is distinct from the earlier record’s citation.

odgovarjajuče matrice

Iztočnik / Source: korrespondierende Matrizen

Rusky / Russian: соответствующие матрицы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: відповідні матриці

Razlog: Odgovarjajuče matrice jest opisna fraza, ne novy izmysljeny termin. Rabota 4 prodolžuje upotrěbu iz raboty 3. Sravnjeny teorem prirědžaje redu \(p_\rho\) red \(q_{n-\rho}\), svjazany s minorami i uslovjem \((u\mid x)=0\). Zato odgovarjanje tuto ne znači jednakost matric niti njih podobnost bez dodatnyh uslovij. Obyčna konstrukcija ostaje prikladna, zato že sam teorem dava točnu relaciju; slovnik ne trěbuje izmysljati osobny internacionalizm za vsako opisno sočetanje.

Reason: Odgovarjajuče matrice is descriptive correspondence language, not a new coinage; Paper 4 continues its use in Paper 3. The compared theorem associates a row \(p_\rho\) with a row \(q_{n-\rho}\) through minors and the condition \((u\mid x)=0\). Correspondence here does not mean equality of matrices or similarity without further conditions. An ordinary phrase can suffice because the theorem specifies the relation; a separate internationalism need not be invented for every descriptive expression.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem v rabotah 3 i 4 sojedinja redy \(p_\rho\) i \(q_{n-\rho}\) prěz minory i relaciju \((u\mid x)=0\). Obična fraza odgovarjajuče matrice opira se na to oprěděljeno odgovarjanje.

Textual comparison: The theorem in Papers 3 and 4 relates rows \(p_\rho\) and \(q_{n-\rho}\) through minors and \((u\mid x)=0\). The ordinary phrase corresponding matrices relies on that specified correspondence.

kovariantna derivacija

Iztočnik / Source: kovariante Ableitung

Rusky / Russian: ковариантная производная; ковариантная производная / ковариантное дифференцирование

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: коваріантна похідна; коваріантна похідна / коваріантне диференціювання

Tekst raboty 21 dava formulu za \(h^{(1)}\), ktora odstranjaje druge diferencialy i ostavlja invariantnu formu. Zato ne trěba izjedniti termin s običnym parcialnym diferenciranjem. Reason: Kovariantna derivacija was selected in Paper 12 and continued in Paper 21. The first record explicitly leaves native izvodna open for linguistic appraisal; the second invokes continuity, not a new independent selection. Paper 21 supplies a formula for \(h^{(1)}\) that eliminates second differentials while retaining an invariant form. The term therefore cannot be equated with ordinary partial differentiation. The Russian and Ukrainian derivative/differentiation pair helps distinguish result and process without itself settling the Interslavic stem.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 12 naziva proces kovariantnoju derivacijeju. Formula (143) raboty 21 izrično odstranjaje druge diferencialy; rabota 23 prěnosi konstrukciju na formy \([\Omega_i]\) i ih poslědovateljne derivacije. Kontinuum termina ne rěšaje jezykovy izbor medžu derivacija i izvodna.

Textual comparison: Paper 12 names the process covariant differentiation. Paper 21’s formula (143) explicitly eliminates second differentials; Paper 23 uses the construction for \([\Omega_i]\) and successive derivatives. Terminological continuity does not settle the linguistic choice between derivacija and izvodna.

ciklotomične polja

Iztočnik / Source: Kreiskörper

Rusky / Russian: круговые поля

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кругові поля

Razlog: Forma ciklotomične polja v rabotě 11 jest medžunarodna alternativa bukvalnomu kružno polje, sravnjenomu s ruskim круговое поле i ukrajinskim кругове поле. Reason: Ciklotomične polja in Paper 11 is the international alternative to the literal circle-field wording compared with Russian круговое поле and Ukrainian кругове поле. The record favours ciklotomične to avoid the ordinary geometric sense of circle. The current text uses it in discussion of Abelian fields and a coefficient field derived from group characters. This is a reader-orientation argument, not a measured result. Another record deliberately chooses kružno; both choices and their local senses must remain visible rather than being forced into an invented universal rule.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tekst ima ciklotomično v rabotě 11, kružno v 38 i kružno-dělitelno v 32. V poslednjem slučaji ciklično \(K\) jest podpolje \(P(\varepsilon)\), kde \(\varepsilon\) jest primitivny korenj jedinice. Formy nazvanij i različne relacije vključenja ne trěba směšivati.

Textual comparison: The text has ciklotomično in Paper 11, kružno in 38 and kružno-dělitelno in 32. In the last case the cyclic field \(K\) is a subfield of \(P(\varepsilon)\), with \(\varepsilon\) a primitive root of unity. Variations in naming must not obscure the different inclusion relations.

Rusky / Russian: круговое поле

An explanation must preserve those field/subfield qualifications instead of deriving them from the circle metaphor. The choice contrasts with the earlier preference for ciklotomične; a different stem does not itself introduce different mathematics.
