Ruskij i ukrajinskij sravnjeni izrazy koristajut imenicu podstavjenja s imenom v zavisnom padežu. Oni podpirajut identifikaciju operacije, ale sami ne dokazujut, že substitucija jest najrazumělivějša vsim slovjanskim čitateljam. Arhivny argument o razumělivosti ostaje nepoměrenym očekivanjom.

Reason: Kroneckerova substitucija combines a possessive adjective with an international name for the operation. In Paper 20, several variables are replaced by powers of one variable; the formula, not the name alone, specifies the procedure. The recorded Russian and Ukrainian expressions use a noun for substitution followed by the name in a dependent case. They help identify the operation but do not establish that substitucija is the most intelligible form for all Slavic readers. The archival appeal to intelligibility remains an unmeasured expectation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Formula v rabotě 20 zaměnjaje prěměnne stepenjami jednoj prěměnnoj. Pridavnik od imena ne jest zaměna za tu matematičnu specifikaciju.

Textual comparison: Paper 20 replaces the variables by powers of one variable. The possessive naming construction is not a substitute for that mathematical specification.

teorem Kronekera / relativno-Abelove polja

Reason: Teorem Kronekera and relativno-Abelove polja retain the names and the mathematical qualification relative. Paper 11 distinguishes the rational base field from quadratic number fields; each theorem has its own scope. Kronekera adapts the name, whereas other records use Kroneckerov. These are different linguistic realizations of one name, not different mathematicians or independent terminological attestations. Recognizability of the name does not justify omitting the theorem’s conditions.

Zachovanje imena i konstrukcije podpiraje svez s citovanym rezultatom, ne tvrdženje o novoj medžuslovjanskoj kovanici.

Paper 6, §14 connects the system with elementary symmetric functions and algebraic integrality. Fundamental therefore does not simply mean important, nor may system be replaced without explanation by basis in an arbitrary sense. Retaining the name and construction connects the passage with the cited result; it is not evidence of a newly coined Interslavic expression.

forma kriviny

Textual comparison: Papers 12 and 23 connect Riemann’s form with the quadratic case. A modern tensor paraphrase is not a purely linguistic substitution needing no explanation.

polje

Iztočnik / Source: Körper

Rusky / Russian: поле

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле

Razlog: Polje prodolžaje ustanovjene nazvanje komutativnogo algebraičnogo objekta. Dva zapisa davajut različne razloge: kontinuitet raboty 6 i matematičny dokaz v rabotě 30, §7. V drugom slučaju odsutnost děliteljev nuly daje jedinost rěšenja jednačenja \(ax=b\) pri nenulovom \(a\); uslovje cěpov jest takože potrěbno v navedenom dokazu obstajanja. Zato kratko slovo polje ne směje prikryti uslovja, od ktoryh vyhodi zaključok. Samo podobnost k ruskomu i ukrajinskomu pole ne izpolnjaje tu matematičnu kontrolju.

Reason: Polje continues the established name for the commutative algebraic object. The two records give different reasons: continuity within Paper 6 and the proof in Paper 30, §7. In the latter, absence of zero divisors gives uniqueness of a solution to \(ax=b\) for nonzero \(a\); the chain condition is also needed in the stated existence argument. The compact word field must not obscure the assumptions supporting the conclusion. Resemblance to Russian and Ukrainian pole cannot replace that mathematical check.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 30, §7 koristi uslovje cěpov zajedno s odsutnostju děliteljev nuly. Poslědnje uslovje samo ne směje zastupiti cěly dokaz; nynějšni imennik jest prsten, ne arhivny kolco.

Textual comparison: Paper 30, §7 uses the chain condition together with absence of zero divisors. The latter must not stand in for the whole proof; the current noun is prsten, not archival kolco.

tělo

Iztočnik / Source: Körper

Rusky / Russian: тело

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: тіло

Razlog: Tělo v rabotě 34 označuje strukturu s obratnymi nenulovymi elementami bez občeho prědpoloženja komutativnosti. Zapisy iz §§2 i 14 zato ne forsujut polje. To ne znači, že vsaky objekt nazvany tělom jest strogo nekomutativny: definicija dopušča takože komutativny slučaj. Matematičny znak jest obratimost nenulovyh elementov, ne metafora těla. Pozdnějši izraz komutativno tělo v §20 potvrdžaje, že prosty bezuslovny slovnik Körper=polje byl by nedostatočny.

Reason: Tělo in Paper 34 covers a division structure without a general assumption of commutativity. The records for §§2 and 14 therefore resist forcing field terminology. This does not mean that every object called tělo is strictly noncommutative: the definition permits the commutative case. Razlog: Rodove oblasti zachovuje historijny naziv Gattungsbereiche, ale rod tu ne znači rod algebraičnoj krivoj. V rabotah 5 i 6 ide o polja racionalnyh funkcij, ktore ostavajut neizměnjene pri permutacijah zadanoj grupy. Rabota 6 potom razgleduje jih cěle racionalne funkcije i integralnost nad elementarnymi simetričnymi funkcijami. Tri zachovane razloga podčrkivajut historijnu identičnost i kontinuitet termina. To opravdyvaje zachovanje naziva s objasnjenjem objekta, ne prenos v sovrěmennu terminologiju roda bez opory v definiciji. Ruske i ukrajinske formy sut zabilěžene sravnjenja, ne samostatny dokaz ustaljenoj upotrěby.

Reason: Rodove oblasti preserves the historical designation Gattungsbereiche, but rod does not mean the genus of an algebraic curve here. Papers 5 and 6 concern fields of rational functions unchanged by the permutations of a specified group. Paper 6 subsequently studies their polynomial elements and integrality over the elementary symmetric functions. All three preserved explanations emphasize historical identity and continuity of terminology. That supports retaining the name with an explanation of its object, not transferring it into modern genus terminology without support from the definition. The Russian and Ukrainian forms are recorded comparanda, not independent evidence of established usage.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicije v rabotah 5, 6 i 11 svęzujut naziv s racionalnymi funkcijami invariantnymi pri permutacijah. Razgovor o cělyh racionalnyh funkcijah v §13 i §15 ne znači, že polje i polinomny podprsten sut to samo.

Textual comparison: The definitions in Papers 5, 6 and 11 connect the name with rational functions invariant under permutations. The discussion of polynomial elements in §§13 and 15 does not identify the field with its polynomial subring.

The formula’s mathematical role varies: a footnote in Paper 7 identifies a gap in Weber’s proof and replaces interpolation by differentiation, whereas Paper 36 invokes it as a comparison in a generalization. The name does not imply that both arguments apply the same formula. The earlier uncertainty about the Cyrillic spelling of the eponym cannot be resolved from the Latin comparison alone.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Podnožna primětka v rabotě 7 zaměnjuje interpolaciju diferenciacijeju radi propusta v citovanom dokazu. Rabota 36 upotrěbjaje interpolaciju kako sravnjenje pri teoriji diferenta. Jedin naziv zato ne označuje jeden i toj samy korak oběh argumentov.

Textual comparison: The footnote in Paper 7 replaces interpolation by differentiation because of a gap in the cited proof. Paper 36 uses interpolation as a comparison in the theory of the different. One name therefore does not designate the same step in both arguments.

The archived explanation is brief and supplies no new linguistic evidence for rodova. Its meaning must be read from the definition and context; the historical term must not suggest the modern genus of a curve.

Iztočnik / Source: Laplacesche Entwicklung

Razlog: Laplaceovo razloženje označuje razvinutje determinanta po minorah. V rabotě 4 ta operacija daje sumu produktov odgovarjajučih determinantov pri definiciji matričnogo produkta. Razloženje jest srodno ruskomu razloženiju i ukrajinskomu rozkladu v zabilěženom sravnjenju; ime Laplace ostavaje vidimo. Tu ne ide o libovoljno razloženje polinoma na faktory. Izbor zato trěba vezati s operacijeju v dokazu. Arhivny razlog govori o obyčajnom nazivu, ale ne daje konkretnogo jezykovogo iztočnika, ktory by sam potvrdil normativnost medžuslovjanskoj formy.

Razloženje resembles the Russian razloženie and Ukrainian rozklad in the recorded comparison, while keeping Laplace’s name visible. This is not arbitrary factorization of a polynomial. The choice must therefore be tied to the operation in the proof. The archived explanation calls the name standard, but provides no specific linguistic source that would independently establish the Interslavic form as normative.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 4 determinanty i jih minory daju konkretno značenje slovu razloženje. Ta vez čuva matematičnu operaciju, koju samo slovo bez konteksta ne oprěděljaje.

Textual comparison: In Paper 4, determinants and their minors give razloženje its specific meaning. That connection preserves the mathematical operation, which the word alone does not determine.

leksikografičny red / najvyšše členy

Razlog: Najvyšše členy bylo izbrano vměsto kalka najstarše členy: porjadok členov jest formalny, ne vrěmenny. Rusky i ukrajinsky sravniteljny izraz upotrěbjajut metaforu staršinstva; to samo po sobě ne čini jih matematično netočnymi. Medžuslovjansky izbor daje prědnost vysotnoj metaforě. V rabotě 24 dokaz vybira najvyšši član s koeficientom ne dělimym zadanym prostym idealom, po leksikografičnom redu. To ne znači prostě najvyššu obču stepenj. Reason: Najvyšše členy was preferred to the calque najstarše členy because the ordering is formal, not temporal. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use a seniority metaphor; that does not itself make them mathematically inaccurate. The Interslavic choice instead prefers a height metaphor. In Paper 24 the proof selects the highest term whose coefficient is not divisible by a specified prime ideal, using lexicographic order. This does not simply mean highest total degree. The original record leaves the naturalness of the phrase open; no reader-testing result is available here.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 17 upotrěbjaje leksikografičnu redukciju, a rabota 24 izbira najvyšši člen s koeficientom ne dělimym zadanym prostym idealom. V oběh slučajah red mora byti znany; najvyšši ne znači avtomatično najvyššu obču stepenj.

Textual comparison: Paper 17 uses lexicographic reduction; Paper 24 selects the highest term whose coefficient is not divisible by the specified prime ideal. In both cases the order must be known: highest does not automatically mean highest total degree.

The recorded preference is for continuity in red and an international adjective resembling the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda. Red here means neither a numerical series nor polynomial degree. Explaining the terminology does not replace a proof that the particular reduction is valid; it identifies the information that the term must retain.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 17 upotrěbjaje leksikografičnu redukciju, a rabota 24 izbira najvyšši člen s koeficientom ne dělimym zadanym prostym idealom. V oběh slučajah red mora byti znany; najvyšši ne znači avtomatično najvyššu obču stepenj.

Textual comparison: Paper 17 uses lexicographic reduction; Paper 24 selects the highest term whose coefficient is not divisible by the specified prime ideal. In both cases the order must be known: highest does not automatically mean highest total degree.

linearno-drobna zavisnost

V §6 raboty 6 takova zavisnost slěduje za funkcije, ktore porodžajut to samo racionalno polje, v okviru razgledanogo voprosa o Lürothovoj funkciji. Ona ne slěduje iz každoj racionalnoj zavisnosti dvuh funkcij. Slovo zavisnost zachovuje ulogu tvrđenja, dokolě prěobraženje imenuje način prěhoda medžu izrazami. Sravniteljne formy podpirajut složeny naziv, ne čislovu ocěnku jego razumlivosti.

Reason: Linearno-drobna zavisnost describes dependence expressed as a fraction with linear numerator and denominator. The archived reason links it to the earlier term for a fractional-linear transformation. In §6 of Paper 6 this dependence arises for functions generating the same rational function field, within the discussion of a Lüroth function. It does not follow from every rational dependence between two functions. Zavisnost preserves the role of the assertion, whereas transformation names the passage between expressions. The comparison forms support the compound terminology, not a numerical estimate of comprehensibility.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §6 raboty 6 veže linearno-drobnu zavisnost s ravnostju odgovarjajučih racionalnyh polj. Tuto ograničenje brani čitanje tvrđenja kako pravila za libovoljnu racionalnu zavisnost.

Textual comparison: §6 of Paper 6 connects fractional-linear dependence with equality of the associated rational function fields. This qualification prevents reading the assertion as a rule for arbitrary rational dependence.

linearno nezavisny vzhodno k \(P\)

Iztočnik / Source: linear unabhängig in bezug auf \(P\)

Rusky / Russian: линейно независимый относительно \(P\)

Razlog: Dopolnjenje po odnošenju k \(P\) ne može se izpustiti: linearna nezavisnost zavisi od polja dopustimyh koeficientov. Ranějši zapis měl vzhodno k \(P\), a sravnjeny tekst §1 raboty 31 imaje po odnošenju k \(P\). Nezavisnost nad \(\overline P\) tam jest čestju specialnoj konstrukcije razširjenja; podnožna primětka objasnjaje, začto ona ne jest avtomatična pri libovoljnom vključenju v veče polje. Racionalna cělj ranějšej frazy jest jasna, ale tvrđenje, že vzhodno k bylo ustaljenym jezykovym obratom, ne jest tym dokazano.

Reason: The complement po odnošenju k \(P\) is mathematically indispensable: linear independence depends on the field of allowed coefficients. The earlier record has vzhodno k \(P\), while the compared text of §1 in Paper 31 has po odnošenju k \(P\). Independence over \(\overline P\) belongs there to a particular construction of an extension; a footnote explains why it is not automatic under an arbitrary embedding into a larger field. The intended function of the earlier phrase is clear, but that does not establish the claim that vzhodno k was an accepted linguistic idiom.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §1 raboty 31 tekst upotrěbjaje po odnošenju k, ne ranějše vzhodno k. Konstrukcija razširjenja čuva nezavisnost; podnožna primětka izrično upozornjaje na inačny rezultat bez jej prědpoloženij.

Textual comparison: The text of §1 in Paper 31 uses po odnošenju k, not the earlier vzhodno k. The extension is constructed to preserve independence; the footnote explicitly warns of a different result without its assumptions.

linearno nezavisne medžu soboju i od ...

Iztočnik / Source: linear unabhängig voneinander und von ...

Razlog: Konstrukcija medžu soboju i od dopolnjaje, katere veličiny trěba razgledati zajedno pri izpytanju linearnoj nezavisnosti. Samo parna nezavisnost ne by dostala. Arhivny razlog za §4 raboty 22 različa semejstva \(\xi\) i \(\omega\). Sravnjeny tekst, nasuprot tomu, upotrěbjaje \(\xi\) za obe semejstva, vključajuči tvrđenje o nezavisnosti \(\xi\) od \(\xi\). To jest sučstvena nejasnost oznak, ne razlog izbrisati vtoru polovinu frazy. Bez sravnjenja s izvornym svědkom ne pripisujemo točnu zaměnu pojedinym simbolam; razlikujemo naměru konstrukcije od nepodtvrđenogo zapisa dokaza.

Reason: The construction medžu soboju i od specifies which quantities must be considered together when testing linear independence. Pairwise independence alone would not suffice. The archived explanation for §4 of Paper 22 distinguishes \(\xi\) and \(\omega\) families. The compared text, however, uses \(\xi\) for both, including a statement of independence of \(\xi\) from \(\xi\). This is a substantive ambiguity of notation, not a reason to omit the second part of the phrase. Without comparison against the original witness, no exact replacement is assigned to individual symbols; the intended construction is distinguished from the unconfirmed notation of the proof.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Sravnjeny tekst §4 raboty 22 označuje konečno i konstruovano semejstvo črez \(\xi\), dokolě zachovany razlog govori o \(\xi\) i \(\omega\). To sravnjenje ustanovjaje nejasnost, ale samo ne daje izvornogo raspoloženja vsih simbolov. Dokaz ne jest tu proglašen izpravnym.

Textual comparison: The compared text of §4 in Paper 22 denotes both the finite and the constructed family by \(\xi\), while the preserved rationale distinguishes \(\xi\) and \(\omega\). The comparison establishes an ambiguity but does not itself supply the original placement of every symbol. The proof is not certified as correct here.

linearno nezavisna modulna baza / klasy ostatkov / kongruencija

Iztočnik / Source: linear unabhängige Modulbasis / Restklassen / Kongruenz

Rusky / Russian: линейно независимый модульный базис / классы вычетов / конгруенция

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: лінійно незалежна модульна база / класи лишків / конгруенція

Razlog: Tute tri frazy rabotajut zajedno v dokazu: modulna baza daje jednoznačne koeficienty, klasy ostatkov sut obrazy elementov po redukciji, a kongruencija vyražaje ravnost po modulu ideala. V §7 raboty 31 iz relacije medžu klasami bazovyh elementov dobyva se ravnost s kratnikom \(p\); nezavisnost izvornoj bazy togda prinudžaje vse koeficienty byti dělimymi prěz \(p\). Internacionalne korenja linear-, modul- i kongruenc- byly izbrany radi prědpoloženej medžujezykovoj poznavajemosti. To jest zabilěžen razlog izbora, ne izměrena razumlivost. Bazu ne možno zaměniti libovoljnym porodžajučim sistemom bez utraty argumenta.

Reason: These three phrases work together in the proof: a module basis gives unique coefficients, residue classes are the images of elements under reduction, and a congruence expresses equality modulo the ideal. In §7 of Paper 31, a relation between the classes of basis elements becomes an equality with a multiple of \(p\); independence of the original basis then forces every coefficient to be divisible by \(p\). The international stems linear-, modul- and kongruenc- were chosen for presumed cross-language recognizability. That is a recorded reason, not measured comprehension. Replacing the basis by an arbitrary generating system would lose the argument.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §7 raboty 31 upotrěbjaje nezavisnost bazovyh elementov, aby iz kongruencije dobyti dělitelnost koeficientov. To jest razlog za zachovanje vsih treh različenij: baza, klasa i kongruencija.

Textual comparison: §7 of Paper 31 uses independence of the basis elements to deduce divisibility of coefficients from a congruence. That is why all three distinctions matter: basis, class and congruence.

linearno nezavisne relacije

Iztočnik / Source: linear unabhängige Relationen

Rusky / Russian: линейно независимые соотношения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: лінійно незалежні співвідношення

Razlog: Linearno nezavisne relacije imajut linearno nezavisne vektory koeficientov; nijedna iz relacij ne jest linearna kombinacija ostalyh. V §4 raboty 10 relacije s realnymi koeficientami ograničajut veličiny \(x,y,X,Y\); rang četiri, tri, dva ili jedin odgovarja nuli, jednoj, dvěma ili trem nezavisnym relacijam. Pridavnik ne govori, že same veličiny sut nezavisne. Relacije prodolžuje ranějšu terminologiju algebraičnoj zavisnosti; rusky i ukrajinsky sravniteljny izraz vyražajut soodnos. Presna priroda koeficientov i čislo nezavisnyh relacij sut važnejše od samogo izbora internacionalnogo korenja.

Reason: Linearno nezavisne relacije have linearly independent coefficient vectors: no relation is a linear combination of the others. In §4 of Paper 10, relations with real coefficients constrain \(x,y,X,Y\); ranks four, three, two and one correspond to zero, one, two and three independent relations. The adjective does not assert that the quantities themselves are independent. Relacije continues the earlier terminology of algebraic dependence; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda express a relation or interrelation. The coefficient domain and the number of independent relations matter more than the choice of an international stem alone.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §4 raboty 10 svęzuje rang s čislom nezavisnyh relacij medžu četyroma veličinami. Koeficienty sut realne; izpuščenje togo uslovja ili zaměna nezavisnosti relacij nezavisnostju veličin by změnilo tvrđenje.

Textual comparison: §4 of Paper 10 connects rank with the number of independent relations between four quantities. The coefficients are real; omitting that qualification or replacing independence of relations by independence of the quantities would change the assertion.

linearno nezavisna \(Z\)-modulna baza

Iztočnik / Source: linear unabhängige \(Z\)-Modulbasis

Rusky / Russian: линейно независимая \(Z\)-модульная база

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: лінійно незалежна \(Z\)-модульна база

Razlog: Oznaka \(\mathfrak Z\) imenuje osnovnu oblast, ne obavezno prsten cělyh čisel. §4 raboty 31 izrično dopušćaje polje, prsten racionalnyh cělyh čisel ili odgovarjajuču funkcionalnu oblast. Baza jest linearno nezavisna nad toj osnovoj; egzistencija konečnoj takovoj bazy jest prědpoloženje, ne svojstvo vsakogo modula. Arhivny razlog čuva osnovu v složenom nazivu Z-modulna baza. V objasnjenju vračajemo frakturnu oznaku iz matematičnogo teksta, ale ne pretvarjajemo arhivno prosto Z v oznaku \(\mathbb Z\). Time ostavaje vidima i osnovna oblast i sila prědpoloženja.

Reason: The symbol \(\mathfrak Z\) names the base domain, not necessarily the ring of integers. §4 of Paper 31 explicitly allows a field, the rational integers or the relevant function domain. The basis is linearly independent over that base; the existence of a finite such basis is an assumption, not a property of every module. The archived reason preserves the base in the compound Z-modulna baza. The explanation restores the fraktur symbol from the mathematical text, but does not turn the archive’s plain Z into \(\mathbb Z\). Both the base domain and the strength of the assumption remain visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prědpoloženje §4 raboty 31 zahtěvaje konečne nezavisne modulne bazy. Osnovna oblast jest označena frakturnym Z i v tekstu ima několiko dopustimyh tipov; ona ne jest izključitelno prstenom cělyh čisel.

Textual comparison: The assumption in §4 of Paper 31 requires finite independent module bases. The base domain is denoted by fraktur Z and has several allowed types in the text; it is not exclusively the ring of integers.

linearna / racionalna / algebraična baza

linearne faktory

Textual comparison: Paper 4 introduces linear factors as auxiliary forms; Paper 24 retains multiplicities; Paper 31 characterizes a splitting field. The term alone guarantees neither distinctness of the factors nor their belonging to the original field.

Arhivny izbor kombinuje internacionalno faktor so slavjanskymi odnorodnjeny i korenj. Njegova ocěnka prozračnosti jest razlog za prědlog, ne rezultat jezykovogo izpytanja.

In Paper 15, a function of such roots must satisfy three separate conditions: invariance, weight and symmetry; the latter two preserve polynomial dependence on the coefficients of the original forms. The recorded choice combines international faktor with Slavic odnorodnjeny and korenj. Its judgment of transparency motivates the proposal; it is not a language-testing result.

Textual comparison: The introduction to Paper 15 connects linear factors with roots and distinguishes invariance, weight and symmetry conditions. Root here does not name numerical root extraction.

Tekst takože razlikuje slučaj prstena s jedinicoju od slučaja bez njej, kde prihodet dodatne cěločislene kratnosti. Arhivny razlog čuva prosty paralelny naziv v trěh jezykah. The text also distinguishes a ring with identity from one without it, where additional integer multiples occur. The archived reason retains a simple parallel name in the three languages. That resemblance must not lead to replacing the module by a vector space or adding independence absent from the definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §2 raboty 30 definovaje konečnu modulnu oblast prěz vse linearne kombinacije konečno mnogyh elementov. Nezavisnost ne jest zahtěvana, a prsten bez jedinicy potrěbuje dodatne členy.

Textual comparison: §2 of Paper 30 defines a finite module domain through the linear span of finitely many elements. Independence is not required, and a ring without identity needs additional terms.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 18 i 22 razgledujut stepenove produkty vybranyh prěměnnyh kako linearne argumenty. Polinomy v ostalyh prěměnnyh služat kako koeficienty; to ne čini početkove polinomy linearnymi po vsih prěměnnyh.

linearna nezavisnost \((\alpha_i)\)

Iztočnik / Source: Linearunabhängigkeit der \((\alpha_i)\)

Rusky / Russian: линейная независимость \((\alpha_i)\)

Razlog: Linearna nezavisnost tu odnosi se k klasam ostatkov \((\alpha_i)\), ne samo k početkovym elementam \(\alpha_i\). V §7 raboty 31 prědhodny dokaz pokazuje, že kongruencija linearnoj kombinacije modulo \(p\) prisiljaje vsaky koeficient byti dělivym prěz \(p\). Zato klasy tvorjat bazu nad poljem ostatkov. Arhivny razlog čuva svezu s tym dokazom; slědujuči prěhod diskriminanta opiraje se na nju. Kratka fraza blizka ruskomu i ukrajinskomu sravnjenju, ale sama podobnost slov ne zaměnjuje ukazanja oblasti koeficientov i značenja skobok.

Reason: Here linearna nezavisnost concerns the residue classes \((\alpha_i)\), not merely the original elements \(\alpha_i\). The preceding proof in §7 of Paper 31 shows that a linear combination congruent to zero modulo \(p\) forces every coefficient to be divisible by \(p\). The classes therefore form a basis over the residue field. The recorded reason preserves the connection with this proof, on which the subsequent passage of the discriminant depends. The short phrase resembles the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda, but verbal similarity cannot replace the coefficient domain or the meaning of the parentheses.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §7 raboty 31 skobki označajut klasy ostatkov. Nezavisnost nad poljem ostatkov slěduje iz dělivosti vseh koeficientov prěz \(p\); tek potom po toj bazi tvori se diskriminant.

Textual comparison: In §7 of Paper 31, parentheses mark residue classes. Independence over the residue field follows from divisibility of every coefficient by \(p\); the discriminant is then formed using that basis.

lěvy dělitelj nulja

Iztočnik / Source: linker Nullteiler

Rusky / Russian: левый делитель нуля

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: лівий дільник нуля

Razlog: Lěvy dělitelj nulja jest doslovno složeny naziv s domačim korenjem děliti, podobno ruskomu i ukrajinskomu sravnjenju. O smyslu lěvy odlučuje formula: v §7 raboty 34 \(P\) stoji lěvo v \(PA=0\). Obstajanje lěvoj obratnoj matrice dava \(A=P^{-1}PA=0\), zato \(P\) ne može anulirati nenulovu matricu s toj strany. Strana ne směje byti izpuščena niti zaměnjena po inoj konvenciji nazvanja. Arhivny zapis naziva termin standardnym, ale ne dava odělne slovnične potvrđenje; izričny dokaz jest tu točna opora za matematičny smysl.

Reason: Lěvy dělitelj nulja is a compositional calque using the native division stem, parallel to the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda. The formula determines the sense of left: in §7 of Paper 34, \(P\) stands on the left in \(PA=0\). A left inverse gives \(A=P^{-1}PA=0\), so \(P\) cannot annihilate a nonzero matrix on that side. The side must neither be omitted nor silently reversed to follow another naming convention. The archived record calls the term standard but supplies no separate dictionary attestation; the explicit proof establishes its mathematical sense here.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §7 raboty 34 formula \(PA=0\) pokazuje, že lěvy odnosi se k městu \(P\) v produktu. Lěva obratna matrica poništaje tuty produkt i dava \(A=0\).

Textual comparison: In §7 of Paper 34, \(PA=0\) fixes the convention: left refers to the position of \(P\) in the product. Multiplication by a left inverse gives \(A=0\).

lěva jedinica

Iztočnik / Source: Linkseinheit

Rusky / Russian: левая единица

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ліва одиниця

Razlog: Lěva jedinica jest element, ktory pri množenju s lěva ostavlja elementy razgledanogo prstena nepoměnjenymi. V §9 raboty 34 ona nastavaje kako suma odgovarjajučih idempotentov i služi prstenu, sostavljenomu iz pravyh idealov. Naziv zato mora čuvati i stranu množenja, i točny prsten, za ktory jedinica dějstvuje. Arhivny razlog svezuje frazu s ranějšim nazvom prstena s jedinicoju; rusky i ukrajinsky sravnitelje imajut tu samu strukturu. Ne tvrdi se, že lěva jedinica už jest dvustranna ili že svaki idempotent jest jedinica cělogo prstena.

Reason: A lěva jedinica leaves elements of the ring under consideration unchanged when multiplied on the left. In §9 of Paper 34 it arises as a sum of suitable idempotents and serves the ring formed from the indicated right ideals. The name must therefore retain both the multiplication side and the ring on which the identity acts. The recorded reason connects the phrase with the preceding ring-with-identity terminology; Russian and Ukrainian have the same construction. It does not assert that a left identity is already two-sided or that every idempotent is the identity of the whole ring.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §9 raboty 34 dava lěvu jedinicu na sumě pravyh idealov. §13 najprvo dobiva lěvu jedinicu za cěly prsten i potom izključenjem nilpotentnogo ostatka dokazuje pravo dějstvovanje. Te koraky ne sut zaměnime.

Textual comparison: Section 9 of Paper 34 gives a left identity on the sum of right ideals. Section 13 first obtains a left identity for the whole ring and then proves its right-identity action by ruling out a nilpotent remainder. These steps are not interchangeable.

lěva jedinica / prava jedinica

Iztočnik / Source: Linkseinheit / Rechtseinheit

Rusky / Russian: левая единица / правая единица

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ліва одиниця / права одиниця

Razlog: Par lěva jedinica / prava jedinica čuva dva koraka dokaza v §13 raboty 34. Najprvo se konstruuje lěva jedinica. Potom Peirceovo razloženje daje dodatny lěvy ideal s kvadratom nula; pod danym prědpoloženjem toj ideal mora izčeznuti, i jedinica jest takože prava. Arhivny razlog daje prědnost konkretnomu nazvanju identičnogo dějstvovanja s každoj strany. Tut ne ide o libovoljny obratimy element: ravnosti \(ex=x\) i \(xe=x\) sut različne uslovja, čije sjedinenje jest rezultat dokaza.
