Two rows \(S^\sigma,T^\tau\), together with variable rows, give a product of the third kind. The archived reason chooses vid for German Art without claiming a generally established classification. It does not mean a matrix of order three, the third power of a product, or a new general operation of matrix multiplication.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 3 i 4 izrično definujut matričny produkt kako sumu produktov odgovarjajučih determinantov. Produktna matrica jest iny objekt, čij determinant dava tu cěnnost. Tretji vid v §2 raboty 4 znači tretju lokalnu možnost sjedinjanja redov simbolov, ne tretji razměr ili tretju mocninu.

Textual comparison: Papers 3 and 4 explicitly define the matrix product as a sum of products of corresponding determinants. The product matrix is a different object whose determinant gives that value. Third kind in §2 of Paper 4 means the third local arrangement of symbolic rows, not a third dimension or third power.

matrične produkty

Iztočnik / Source: Matrizenprodukte

Rusky / Russian: матричные произведения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: матричні добутки

Razlog: Množny naziv matrične produkty v uvodu raboty 4 čuva to samo nazvanje kako odělne konstrukcije. Uvod najprvo najavjaje, že invariantne tvorjenja možno prědstaviti prěz te produkty, a dodatna zamětka sravnivaje jih s Grassmannovym směšanym produktom stupnja nula. Arhivny razlog govori o prozračnosti produkt i o inoj ruskoj i ukrajinskoj leksice. Gramatično čislo imenika ne tvori novy matematičny smysl. Ale obča razumlivost nazva ne oslobađa objašnjenje od lokalnoj definicije, osoblivo dlja čitatelja, ktory znajet samo obyčno množenje matric.

Reason: The plural matrične produkty in the introduction to Paper 4 continues the name used for the individual constructions. The introduction announces representation of invariant expressions by these products; an added note compares them with Grassmann’s mixed product of degree zero. The recorded reason invokes the transparency of produkt and the different Russian and Ukrainian vocabulary. Grammatical number does not create another mathematical sense. Yet a familiar name does not remove the need for the local definition, especially for readers who know only ordinary matrix multiplication.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 3 i 4 izrično definujut matričny produkt kako sumu produktov odgovarjajučih determinantov. Produktna matrica jest iny objekt, čij determinant dava tu cěnnost. Tretji vid v §2 raboty 4 znači tretju lokalnu možnost sjedinjanja redov simbolov, ne tretji razměr ili tretju mocninu.

Textual comparison: Papers 3 and 4 explicitly define the matrix product as a sum of products of corresponding determinants. The product matrix is a different object whose determinant gives that value. Third kind in §2 of Paper 4 means the third local arrangement of symbolic rows, not a third dimension or third power.

matrično kolco

Iztočnik / Source: Matrizenring

Rusky / Russian: матричное кольцо

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: матричне кільце

Razlog: Matrično kolco jest arhivna forma nazva; nynějšni tekst §25 raboty 34 govori o matričnom prstenu. Obe formy tu odnoset se k prstenu matric, v ktorom računaje se diskriminant posrědstvom matričnyh jedinic. Arhivny razlog daje kolco radi očekyvanoj razumlivosti pored ruskogo kolco i ukrajinskogo kilce. Zapis ne dava čitateljskogo testa ni opravdanja zaměny za prsten vo vseh kontekstah. Slovnik mora pokazati obě istorijne formy i ih isto značenje, ne predstaviti staru formu kako nynějšnu normu.

Reason: Matrično kolco is the archived form; the current text of §25 of Paper 34 speaks of a matričny prsten. Both refer here to a matrix ring whose discriminant is calculated using matrix units. The archived reason prefers kolco for anticipated intelligibility alongside Russian koltso and Ukrainian kiltse. It supplies neither a reader test nor a justification for replacement by prsten in every context. The dictionary must show both historical forms and their shared meaning, rather than present the earlier form as the current norm.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §25 raboty 34 upotrěbjaje matričny prsten i računaje jego diskriminant s pomočju dvoh uporedženij matričnyh jedinic. Posebno indeksno pytanje pojavlja se raněje: pri zapisanoj proměně bazy \((b)=(a)P\) slědujuče formuly stavljajut matricu Grama bazy \((a)\) ravnoju \(P^t\) puta matrici Grama bazy \((b)\) puta \(P\). Napravljenje proměny i te ravnosti ne soglašajut se; potrěbno jest sravnjenje s izvornym svědkom.

Textual comparison: Section 25 of Paper 34 uses matričny prsten and computes its discriminant using two orderings of the matrix units. A separate notation question occurs earlier: after the displayed basis change \((b)=(a)P\), the following formulas equate the Gram matrix of \((a)\) with \(P^t\) times the Gram matrix of \((b)\) times \(P\). The direction of the basis change and these equalities disagree; the original witness needs to be checked.

prěobraženje matric

Iztočnik / Source: Matrizenumformung

Rusky / Russian: преобразование матриц

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: перетворення матриць

Razlog: Prěobraženje matric razklada německy složeny naziv na imenik dějanja i genitiv objekta. Arhivny razlog izbiraje sovrěmenny linearno-algebraičny izraz vměsto doslovnogo prěnosa složenogo Umformung; rusky i ukrajinsky sravniteljny izraz imajut tu samu stavbu. To opravdava konstrukciju nazva, ale samo po sobě ne oprěděljaje, kakovo prěobraženje jest dopuščeno. V zachovanom zapisu jest odkaz na rabotu 23, ale točno tako nazvana operacija ne byla ustanovjena v nynějšnom tekstu toj raboty. Zato ne priravnjajemo nazva bez daljšego svědka k podobnosti matric, elementarnym rjadovym operacijam ili proměně bazy.

Reason: Prěobraženje matric renders the German compound as a noun of action followed by the object in the genitive. The archived reason favours modern linear-algebraic wording over a literal reshaping compound; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda have the same construction. This supports the wording but does not determine which transformations are allowed. The record points to Paper 23, but an operation with this precise designation has not been established in its current text. Without a further witness, the expression should therefore not be equated with matrix similarity, elementary row operations or change of basis.

matrice

Iztočnik / Source: Matrizes

Rusky / Russian: матрицы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: матриці

Razlog: Matrice jest množna forma od matrica. Arhivny razlog spojuje medžunarodny korenj, rusku i ukrajinsku formu i kontinuitet s ranějšim v matricah. V §7 raboty 34 ide o kvadratnyh matricah nad prstenom, s dodavanjem po elementah i obyčnym matričnym množenjem. Tu ne jest potrěbny novy naziv za stary německy plural Matrizes. Ale obyčno množenje v toj rabotě trěba razlikovati od specialno definovanyh matričnyh produktov ranih rabot 3 i 4; sam korenj matrica ne garantuje isto značenje vsakoj složenej frazy.

Reason: Matrice is the plural of matrica. The archived reason combines the international stem, Russian and Ukrainian forms, and continuity with the earlier v matricah. Section 7 of Paper 34 concerns square matrices over a ring, with entrywise addition and ordinary matrix multiplication. The older German plural Matrizes does not require a different object name. Ordinary multiplication here must nevertheless be distinguished from the specially defined matrix products of Papers 3 and 4: a shared matrix stem does not guarantee that every compound has the same meaning.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §7 raboty 34 definira obyčno matrično množenje i potom razlikuje tělo \(K\) od dodatnogo komutativnogo slučaja. Matrice nad \(K\) zato imajut elementy iz \(K\) i ne prědpokladajut avtomatično komutativnost.

Textual comparison: Section 7 of Paper 34 defines ordinary matrix multiplication and then distinguishes a division ring \(K\) from the additional commutative case. Matrices over \(K\) thus have their entries in \(K\) without automatically assuming commutativity.

matrice nad \(K\)

Iztočnik / Source: Matrizes in \(K\)

Rusky / Russian: матрицы над \(K\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: матриці над \(K\)

Razlog: Nad v matricah nad \(K\) označaje, že matrične elementy naležet \(K\), ne že matrice same sut elementami \(K\). Arhivny razlog izbiraje tu konstrukciju kako sovrěmenny algebraičny izraz, soglasny s ruskim i ukrajinskim nad. §7 raboty 34 izrično dopušča tělo \(K\) bez prědpoloženja komutativnosti; komutativnost pojavlja se kako dodatno uslovje pri nazivu hiperkompleksny sistem. Zato slovnično objašnjenje ne směje zaměniti \(K\) komutativnym poljem bez ogovorki. Formulacija obhvata i nekomutativny slučaj, pri ktorom poredok množenja elementov ostaje sučstvenny.

Reason: Nad in matrice nad \(K\) says that the matrix entries belong to \(K\), not that the matrices themselves are elements of \(K\). The archived reason selects the modern algebraic construction, parallel to Russian and Ukrainian nad. Section 7 of Paper 34 explicitly allows a division ring \(K\) without assuming commutativity; commutativity is added when the matrix ring is described as a hypercomplex system. A dictionary explanation must therefore not silently replace \(K\) by a commutative field. The phrase includes the noncommutative case, where the order of coefficient multiplication matters.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §7 raboty 34 definira obyčno matrično množenje i potom razlikuje tělo \(K\) od dodatnogo komutativnogo slučaja. Matrice nad \(K\) zato imajut elementy iz \(K\) i ne prědpokladajut avtomatično komutativnost.

Textual comparison: Section 7 of Paper 34 defines ordinary matrix multiplication and then distinguishes a division ring \(K\) from the additional commutative case. Matrices over \(K\) thus have their entries in \(K\) without automatically assuming commutativity.

uslovje maksimalnosti

Iztočnik / Source: Maximalbedingung

Rusky / Russian: условие максимальности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: умова максимальності

Razlog: Uslovje maksimalnosti čuva istorijny naziv i vezu s uslovjem prekinjenja vzrastajučih verig. V §3 raboty 34 maksimalna podgrupa znači maksimalnu v razgledanom množstvu dopustimyh podgrup, ne najveliku podgrupu vsěh grup. Smysl jest, že v vsakom nepustom takim množstvu obstaja maksimalny element; ekvivalentno, strogo vzrastajuča veriga ne može prodolžati se bez konca. Slovo nepusto tu objasnjava logičny obseg definicije: nynějšna formulacija teksta jego ne izgovarja. Arhivny razlog daje prědnost istorijnomu uslovju, a ne neposrědnoj zaměně nazvom neterovost, ktory by zakryl razgledany vid podgrup.

Reason: Uslovje maksimalnosti preserves the historical name and its connection with termination of ascending chains. In §3 of Paper 34, maximal means maximal within the specified collection of admissible subgroups, not a greatest subgroup of all groups. The intended condition is that every nonempty such collection has a maximal member; equivalently, a strictly ascending chain cannot continue indefinitely. Nonempty here makes the logical scope explicit: the current wording of the text does not say it. The archived reason favours the historical condition rather than directly replacing it with Noetherianity, which could obscure the class of subgroups under consideration.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicije v §3 povezuju maksimalnost so vzrastajučimi verigami i minimalnost so spadajučimi. Slovnično objasnjenje dodava nepusto k razgledanom množstvu; to jest logično objasnjenje, ne citat iz toj formulacije. §4 razlikuje prědpoloženje za konečno razloženje od silnějših prědpoloženij dlja jednoznačnosti.

Textual comparison: The definitions in §3 connect maximality with ascending chains and minimality with descending chains. The dictionary explanation supplies nonempty for the collection considered; this is a logical clarification, not a quotation from that wording. Section 4 distinguishes the hypothesis for a finite decomposition from the stronger hypotheses used for uniqueness.

uslovje maksimalnosti / minimalnosti za prave idealy

Iztočnik / Source: Maximalbedingung / Minimalbedingung für Rechtsideale

Rusky / Russian: условие максимальности / минимальности для правых идеалов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: умова максимальності / мінімальності для правих ідеалів

Razlog: Dopolnjenje za prave idealy jest částju uslovja, ne nepovinna stilistična podrobnost. Arhivny razlog prěnosi nazvy maksimalnosti i minimalnosti iz §3 v §8 raboty 34. Tu dopustimy pravy ideal jest jednočasno \(K\)-modul; konečny rang daje ograničenje dlja strogo vzrastajučih i spadajučih verig. Prave ne možno izpustiti, osoblivo v nekomutativnom prstenu: uslovje za prave idealy samo svojom nazvoju ne ustanavjaje analogičnogo uslovja za lěve. Parna formulacija maksimalnosti / minimalnosti pokazuje dva uslovja, ne jednu nerazličenu vlastnost.

Reason: The qualifier za prave idealy is part of the condition, not optional stylistic detail. The recorded reason carries the maximality and minimality terminology from §3 into §8 of Paper 34. Here an admissible right ideal is also a \(K\)-module, and finite rank bounds both strictly ascending and strictly descending chains. Right cannot be omitted, especially in a noncommutative ring: a condition on right ideals does not establish the corresponding left condition merely by being named. The paired wording maksimalnosti / minimalnosti denotes two conditions, not one undifferentiated property.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §8 raboty 34 konečny rang \(K\)-modula ograničaje verigi dopustimyh pravyh idealov. Ograničenje prave jest izrično; njegovo izpuščenje by razširilo tvrdnju izvan citovanogo argumenta.

Textual comparison: In §8 of Paper 34, finite \(K\)-module rank bounds chains of admissible right ideals. The right-sided qualification is explicit; removing it would extend the statement beyond the cited argument.

maksimalna oblast

Iztočnik / Source: Maximalbereich

Rusky / Russian: максимальная область

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: максимальна область

Razlog: Maksimalna oblast v rabotě 35 imaje osobnu definiciju. V danoj okolnoj oblasti \(\mathfrak Z\) ona ne može byti razširjena dodavanjem cěločislnyh imenovateljev: ako \(ag\) naleži jej, \(g\in\mathfrak Z\) i \(a\) jest nenulovo cělo čislo, togda jej naleži i \(g\). To jest zamknjenost pod takim děljenjem, ne maksimalnost sredi vsih sobstvennyh podprstenov. Arhivny razlog čuva oblast za Bereich, medžutym kako prstenova struktura jest oprěděljena odělno. Razlikovanje jest važnějše od same doslovnosti: naziv ne znači proizvoljno integralno zamknjenje ni normalizaciju, a ograničenje na cěločislne imenovatelje mora ostati vidimo.

Reason: Maksimalna oblast has a particular definition in Paper 35. Within a fixed ambient domain \(\mathfrak Z\), it cannot be enlarged by adjoining integer denominators: if it contains \(ag\), where \(g\in\mathfrak Z\) and \(a\) is a nonzero integer, it also contains \(g\). This is closure under that division operation, not maximality among all proper subrings. The recorded reason preserves oblast for Bereich while the ring structure is specified separately. The distinction matters more than literal wording: the name does not mean arbitrary integral closure or normalization, and the restriction to integer denominators must remain visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 35 definira maksimalnost vnutri danoj \(\mathfrak Z\) posrědstvom uslovja, že \(ag\in M\) vleče \(g\in M\) za nenulove cěle \(a\) i \(g\in\mathfrak Z\). Opisana oblast \(M(\mathfrak I)\) jest takym načinom zamknuta oblast porodžena prěz \(\mathfrak I\); naziv ne označaje maksimalny sobstvenny podprsten.

Textual comparison: Paper 35 defines maximality inside a fixed \(\mathfrak Z\) by the condition that \(ag\in M\) implies \(g\in M\) for nonzero integers \(a\) and \(g\in\mathfrak Z\). The described \(M(\mathfrak I)\) is the domain generated from \(\mathfrak I\) by this closure operation; the term does not denote a maximal proper subring.

maksimalny nilpotentny ideal

Iztočnik / Source: maximales nilpotentes Ideal

Rusky / Russian: максимальный нильпотентный идеал

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: максимальний нільпотентний ідеал

Razlog: Nilpotentny jest zachovany medžunarodny matematičny korenj, ktory podpirajut i oba zapisane istočnoslovjanske sravnitve. Nilpotentnost ideala znači zanuljenje někojej potegy cělogo ideala, ne samo nilpotentnost vsakogo elementa odělno. V rabotě 34 uslovje maksimalnosti za prave idealy i teorem o sumě dvoh nilpotentnyh pravyh idealov vedut k jednomu takomu idealu, ktory sodrživaje vse ostale. Tekst potom pokazuje, že on jest dvustranny, i nazyvaje jego radikalom. Zato maksimalny tu stavaje takože najveliky v toj klasě, ale to slěduje iz argumenta; ne jest opča definicija slova maksimalny.

Reason: Nilpotentny retains the international mathematical stem also represented in both recorded East Slavic comparanda. Nilpotence of an ideal means that some power of the whole ideal is zero, not merely that each element is separately nilpotent. In Paper 34, the ascending-chain condition on right ideals and the result about sums of two nilpotent right ideals lead to one such ideal containing all the others. The text then shows that it is two-sided and calls it the radical. Thus maximal is also greatest in this particular class, but that follows from the argument; it is not the general meaning of maximal.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Argument o sumě nilpotentnyh idealov vedet k najvelikomu takomu idealu. Posebne pytanje pojavlja se v §19: formulacija teorema davaje anulovanje od radikala kako jednu iz dvoh alternativ, ale dokaz ustanavjaje to anulovanje dlja vsakogo prostogo modula. Dalje dokaz razlikuje anulovanje cělym kvocientnym prstenom od dejstvija jego jedinice kako jediničnogo operatora. Formulaciju i poslědok trěba sravniti s izvornym svědkom; ne prěnosimo ih kakoby už soglasovanu dihotomiju.

Textual comparison: The sum argument gives a greatest nilpotent ideal. A separate question arises in §19: the theorem states annihilation by the radical as one of two alternatives, whereas the proof establishes this annihilation for every simple module. The proof then distinguishes annihilation by the entire quotient ring from its identity acting as the identity operator. The statement and corollary need comparison with the original witness; they are not adopted here as an already reconciled dichotomy.

maksimalne porjadky

Iztočnik / Source: Maximalordnungen

Rusky / Russian: максимальные порядки

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: максимальні порядки

Razlog: Maksimalne porjadky jest arhivny naziv; nynějšny tekst raboty 42 imaje maksimalne poredky. Arhivny razlog davaje prědnost kontinuitetu s ranějšim nazivom i istočnoslovjanskimi sravnitvami. V obojih formah ide o algebraičnyh poredkah v algebraji nad čislovym poljem, ne o relacijah uporjadkovanja. §II tvori take poredky iz komplementarnyh konečnyh modulov i opisuje jih prěz lěve i prave idealy. Zato anglijsky izraz order theory v starom opravdanju ne trěba razuměti kako teoriju čestičnyh poredkov. Razlika porjadok / poredok ostaje slovničnym pytanjem; matematičny objekt od nje ne mjenja se.

Reason: Maksimalne porjadky is the archived wording; the current text of Paper 42 has maksimalne poredky. The recorded reason favours continuity with the earlier term and the East Slavic comparanda. Both forms denote algebraic orders in an algebra over a number field, not ordering relations. Section II constructs such orders from complementary finite modules and describes them through left and right ideals. The phrase order theory in the older rationale should therefore not be understood as the theory of partially ordered sets. The porjadok / poredok variation remains a lexical question, not a change of mathematical object.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §II raboty 42 imaje poredky i konstruuje jih v razloženoj algebraji iz komplementarnyh modulov. To kontekstualno oprěděljaje smysl arhivnogo porjadky; ne govori se o relaciji čestičnogo uporjadkovanja.

Textual comparison: Section II of Paper 42 uses poredky and constructs them in a split algebra from complementary modules. This establishes the contextual sense of the archived porjadky; the subject is not a partial-order relation.

množinno-teoretičny prěsěk

Iztočnik / Source: mengentheoretischer Durchschnitt

Rusky / Russian: теоретико-множественное пересечение

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теоретико-множинний перетин

Razlog: Množinno-teoretičny prěsěk izrično govori o občih elementah dvoh množstv. V začetku raboty 31 množstva prstena \(\mathfrak R\) i razširjenogo polja \(\overline P\) imajut obči prěsěk ravny \(P\); dodatno uslovje govori o odnošenjah operacij izvan \(P\). Arhivny razlog hoče razlikovati tu konstrukciju od razgovora o idealah i modulah. To ne znači, že prěsěk idealov jest druga množinstvena operacija. Pridevnik označaje pogled na osnovne množstva i ne može sam vyraziti dodatno algebraično uslovje. Uslovja zato ne slivajemo v neoprěděljenu tvrdnju o nezavisnosti.

Reason: Množinno-teoretičny prěsěk explicitly concerns the common elements of two sets. At the beginning of Paper 31, the underlying sets of the ring \(\mathfrak R\) and the extension field \(\overline P\) intersect in \(P\); a further condition concerns relations between operations outside \(P\). The archived reason seeks to distinguish this construction from discussion of ideals and modules. This does not make intersection of ideals a different set operation. The adjective identifies the underlying-set perspective and cannot by itself express the additional algebraic condition. The two conditions should not be collapsed into an unspecified claim of independence.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prěsěk prstena \(\mathfrak R\) i polja \(\overline P\) jest \(P\), a slědujuče uslovje o operacijah jest odělno. Primětka opisuje ekvivalentne razširjenja kako izomorfne razširjenja, čij izomorfizm fiksuje \(P\) element po elementu.

Textual comparison: The ring \(\mathfrak R\) and field \(\overline P\) intersect in \(P\), while the following condition about operations is separate. The footnote describes equivalent extensions as isomorphic extensions whose isomorphism fixes \(P\) element by element.

determinanta reda najmanje dva

Iztočnik / Source: mindestens zweireihige Determinante

Rusky / Russian: определитель порядка не менее двух

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: визначник порядку принаймні два

Razlog: Determinanta reda najmanje dva zaměnjaje doslovno dvurjadnu determinantu nazivom za razměr kvadratnoj matrice. Arhivny razlog izbiraje medžunarodno determinanta i red, a ruska i ukrajinska sravnitva takože označajut red. V §6 raboty 31 govor ide o matričnoj razměrnosti prinajmenje dva: vse elementy diskriminantnoj matrice kromě vozmožno jednoj pozicije izčezajut, zato njejna determinanta jest nula. Ne trěba čitati najmanje dva kako točno dva, ni kako tvrdnju samo o grafičnom čislu rjadov. Nynějšny tekst imaje prinajmenje dva; to jest ta sama dolna granica, ne nova matematična definicija.

Reason: Determinanta reda najmanje dva replaces the literal two-rowed determinant with a description of the size of a square matrix. The archived reason selects international determinanta and red, while the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda likewise specify the order. In §6 of Paper 31, the size is at least two: every entry of the discriminant matrix except possibly one vanishes, so its determinant is zero. Najmanje dva must not be read as exactly two or as a statement merely about the visual number of rows. The current text uses prinajmenje dva, expressing the same lower bound rather than another mathematical definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Diskriminantna matrica imaje prinajmenje dva rjada i stolpca, a samo jedna pozicija može byti nenulova. To jest lokalny razlog zanuljenja determinanty; najmanje i prinajmenje vyražajut tu samu neostru dolnu granicu.

Textual comparison: The discriminant matrix has at least two rows and columns, but only one position can be nonzero. This is the local reason its determinant vanishes; najmanje and prinajmenje express the same inclusive lower bound.

minimalna baza

Iztočnik / Source: Minimalbasis

Rusky / Russian: минимальная база; минимальный базис

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: мінімальна база

Razlog: Četyri zapisy za minimalna baza podčrkivajut, že točny smysl davaje definicija, ne sama obča slova minimalna i baza. V §6 raboty 6 racionalna baza jest minimalna, ako sodrživaje samo \(\rho\) funkcij; one togda sut algebraično nezavisne. Ide o racionalnom generovanju polja funkcij, ne o linearnoj bazi vektornogo prostora ni samo o neizbytočnom spisku generatorov. Teorem o egzistenciji takej bazy imaje svoja ograničenja: tekst odělno govori o razširjenju koeficientnogo polja i o neuspehu v občem pri \(\rho\ge3\). Arhivno opravdanje zato podpiraje kratky naziv vměstě s definicijeju, ne bezuslovnu oběčanu egzistenciju.

Reason: The four records for minimalna baza stress that the definition, not the ordinary words minimal and basis alone, supplies the precise sense. In §6 of Paper 6, a rational basis is minimal if it contains only \(\rho\) functions; these are then algebraically independent. This concerns rational generation of a function field, not a vector-space basis or merely an irredundant generating list. Existence has restrictions: the text separately discusses extension of the coefficient field and failure in general for \(\rho\ge3\). The recorded rationale therefore supports a concise name together with its definition, not an unconditional promise that such a basis exists.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija IV v rabotě 6 žada racionalnu bazu iz \(\rho\) funkcij, ktore sut algebraično nezavisne. Tri slědujuče tvrdnje razlikujut slučaj odnogo parametra, slučaj dvoh s koeficientnym razširjenjem i obči neuspeh pri vyššem \(\rho\). Slovnik ne prěpisyvaje tu istorijnu informaciju kako bezuslovny sovrěmenny teorem.

Textual comparison: Definition IV in Paper 6 requires a rational basis of \(\rho\) algebraically independent functions. The following three statements distinguish one parameter, two with coefficient extension, and general failure for higher \(\rho\). The dictionary does not recast this historical discussion as an unconditional modern theorem.

uslovje minimalnosti

Iztočnik / Source: Minimalbedingung

Rusky / Russian: условие минимальности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: умова мінімальності

Razlog: Uslovje minimalnosti jest parny naziv k uslovju maksimalnosti. Arhivna dva razloga čuvajut kontinuitet medžu §3 i §4 raboty 34 i vezu s nynějšim govorom o spadajučih verigah. Smysl jest konečnost strogo spadajučih verig dopustimyh podgrup, ili obstajanje minimalnogo elementa v vsakom nepustom ih množstvu. Minimalny ne znači nužno jeden najmenši element dlja cělogo množstva. V §4 to uslovje daje konečno razloženje na direktno nerazložime faktory; primětka o jednoznačnosti žada oba uslovja. Ta razlika v prědpoloženjah ne směje izčeznuti pri objasnjenju modernym nazvom artinovost.

Reason: Uslovje minimalnosti is paired with uslovje maksimalnosti. The two archived reasons preserve continuity between §§3 and 4 of Paper 34 and the connection with present-day descending-chain language. The condition requires termination of strictly descending chains of admissible subgroups, or a minimal member in every nonempty collection of them. Minimal need not mean one least member of the whole collection. In §4 the condition yields a finite decomposition into directly indecomposable factors; the note about uniqueness assumes both chain conditions. That difference in hypotheses must not disappear when explaining the term through modern Artinian terminology.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicije v §3 povezuju maksimalnost so vzrastajučimi verigami i minimalnost so spadajučimi. Slovnično objasnjenje dodava nepusto k razgledanom množstvu; to jest logično objasnjenje, ne citat iz toj formulacije. §4 razlikuje prědpoloženje za konečno razloženje od silnějših prědpoloženij dlja jednoznačnosti.

Textual comparison: The definitions in §3 connect maximality with ascending chains and minimality with descending chains. The dictionary explanation supplies nonempty for the collection considered; this is a logical clarification, not a quotation from that wording. Section 4 distinguishes the hypothesis for a finite decomposition from the stronger hypotheses used for uniqueness.

minimalne razpadne polja kvaternionnogo těla

Iztočnik / Source: minimale Zerfaellungskorper des Quaternionenkorpers

Rusky / Russian: минимальные поля расщепления тела кватернионов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: мінімальні поля розщеплення кватерніонного тіла

Razlog: Minimalno razpadno polje jest tu polje, ktoro razklada kvaternionno tělo, ale ne sodrživaje sobstvennogo podpolja s toju samoju vlastnostju. Minimalnost jest po vključanju, ne po najnižšem stepenu. Rabota 32 izrično davaje taka polja neograničenyh stepenjev. Arhivny razlog čuva razpadno polje radi kontinuiteta, a tělo radi nekomutativnogo kvaternionnogo objekta. On takože spominaje češsky i poljsky korenj rozklad- kako alternativu za razgledanje, ale ne dava točnogo slovničnogo ili knižnogo města; to ne jest dokaz čitanja tih izvorov. Izbor korenja i definicija minimalnosti sut zato dva odělna pytanja.

Reason: A minimal splitting field here splits the quaternion division algebra but has no proper subfield with that property. Minimality is by inclusion, not by the smallest degree. Paper 32 explicitly gives such fields of unbounded degrees. The archived reason keeps razpadno polje for continuity and tělo for the noncommutative quaternion object. It also mentions the Czech and Polish rozklad- stem as an alternative for consideration, but supplies no exact dictionary or book passage; this is not evidence that those sources were read. The choice of stem and the definition of minimality are therefore separate questions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 32 razgledaje ciklične polja stepena \(2^n\): prědstavimost \(-1\) kako sumy dvoh kvadratov davaje razpad, a realnost sobstvennyh podpolj izključaje razpad v nih. Minimalnost po vključanju soglašaje se s neograničenymi stepenjami.

Textual comparison: Paper 32 considers cyclic fields of degree \(2^n\): expressing \(-1\) as a sum of two squares gives splitting, while the reality of proper subfields excludes splitting there. Minimality by inclusion is compatible with unbounded degrees.

minimalna rezolventa

Iztočnik / Source: Minimalresolvente

Rusky / Russian: минимальная резольвента

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: мінімальна резольвента

Razlog: Minimalna rezolventa čuva medžunarodny naziv s istorijnym algebraičnym smyslom. Arhivny razlog ne zaměnjaje jego občim pomočno uravnenje, zato že to by izbrisalo vezu s teorijeju eliminacije. V §12 raboty 19 nerazložime mnogovidnosti izolovanyh primarnyh komponentov sut spojene s minimalnoju rezolventoju; primětka odkazuje na Königovu knigu iz 1903, stranicu 235. Tu jest prověren odkaz v tekstu, ne nezavisno čitanje samoj Königovoj stranicy. Zato slovnik može pokazati lokalnu funkciju nazva i jego bibliografičnu vezu, ale ne vydavati odkaz za polnu, izvorně prověrenu definiciju rezolventy.

Reason: Minimalna rezolventa preserves an international term in its historical algebraic sense. The archived reason avoids the generic auxiliary equation because that would erase the connection with elimination theory. In §12 of Paper 19, the irreducible varieties associated with isolated primary components are linked to the minimal resolvent; the footnote cites page 235 of König’s 1903 book. What has been checked here is the citation in the text, not an independent reading of that page in König. The dictionary can therefore show the term’s local role and bibliographical connection without presenting the citation as a fully source-checked definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §12 raboty 19 spojuje minimalnu rezolventu s nerazložimymi mnogovidnostjami izolovanyh primarnyh komponentov. Odkaz na Königa ustanavjaje bibliografičnu vezu; čitanje samoj citovanoj stranicy ne jest tu zasvědčeno.

Textual comparison: Section 12 of Paper 19 connects the minimal resolvent with the irreducible varieties of isolated primary components. The König reference establishes a bibliographical connection; reading the cited page itself is not attested here.

s koeficientami iz \(K\)

Iztočnik / Source: mit Koeffizienten aus \(K\)

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]; \(K\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]; \(K\)

Razlog: S koeficientami iz \(K\) ostavjaje koeficientno polje vidimo. V §6 raboty 9 \(K\) znači polje vsih algebraičnyh čisel; primětka objasnjava, kako by formulacije ostali važeče pri zaměně njegovoj poljem racionalnyh čisel. Zato racionalna funkcija ne znači tu nužno funkciju s racionalnymi čislovymi koeficientami. Arhivny razlog čuva imenno tu razliku. Bukvy v ruskoj i ukrajinskoj sravnitvě sut povređene; zachovany jest samo simbol \(K\). Ih ne dopolnjujemo dogadkoju i ne račitajemo kako prověrjene jezyčne attestacije.

Reason: S koeficientami iz \(K\) keeps the coefficient field visible. In §6 of Paper 9, \(K\) is the field of all algebraic numbers; a footnote explains how the statements would remain valid if it were replaced by the rational number field. Rational function here therefore does not necessarily mean a function with rational numerical coefficients. This is the distinction the archived reason preserves. The lettering in the Russian and Ukrainian comparison fields is damaged; only the symbol \(K\) survives. Those fields are neither completed by guesswork nor counted as verified linguistic attestations.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija racionalnoj bazy v rabotě 9 sodrživaje koeficientno polje \(K\). Primětka izrično razlikuje algebraične i racionalne čislove koeficienty i opisuje dovolenu zaměnu polja; tu razliku ne možno odčitati iz samogo pridevnika racionalna.

Textual comparison: The definition of rational basis in Paper 9 includes the coefficient field \(K\). Its footnote expressly distinguishes algebraic from rational numerical coefficients and describes the permitted field replacement; that distinction cannot be recovered from rational alone.

predstavime s koeficientami iz \(o\)

Iztočnik / Source: mit Koeffizienten aus \(o\) darstellbar

Rusky / Russian: выражаются с коэффициентами из \(o\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: виражаються з коефіцієнтами з \(o\)

Razlog: Predstavime s koeficientami iz o čuva ne samo možnost prědstavjenja, ale i oblast dopuščenyh koeficientov. Arhivny zapis upotrěbjaje proste o; v §8 raboty 31 toj oblastju jest prsten \(\mathfrak o\). Ne ide o čislu nula. Tekst nazyvaje vybrane determinanty bazoju diskriminantnogo ideala i tvrdi, že druge determinanty sut ih linearnymi kombinacijami s koeficientami iz \(\mathfrak o\). Koeficienty iz bolšego polja ne byli by dostatočne dlja takej tvrdnje o idealu v \(\mathfrak o\). Arhivny razlog čuva tu nužnost; samo jezyčno sravnjenje frazy ješče ne jest polnym dokazom tvrdnje o vybranyh determinantah.

Reason: Predstavime s koeficientami iz o preserves not just expressibility but the allowed coefficient domain. The archive uses plain o; in §8 of Paper 31 the domain is the ring \(\mathfrak o\), not the number zero. The text calls selected determinants a basis of the discriminant ideal and asserts that the other determinants are their linear combinations with coefficients in \(\mathfrak o\). Coefficients in a larger field would not suffice for that assertion about an ideal in \(\mathfrak o\). The archived reason preserves this requirement; comparison of the wording alone is not a full proof of the claim about the selected determinants.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §8 raboty 31 determinanty naležet \(\mathfrak o\), i tvrdnja o konečnom generovanju žada linearne kombinacije nad tym samym prstenom. To jest točna informacija, ktoru čuva fraza s koeficientami iz o; stary proste o ne jest nula.

Textual comparison: In §8 of Paper 31, the determinants belong to \(\mathfrak o\), and the finite-generation assertion requires linear combinations over that same ring. This is the precise information preserved by s koeficientami iz o; the archived plain o is not zero.

pomnoženyh konstantami

Iztočnik / Source: mit Konstanten multipliziert

Rusky / Russian: умноженных на постоянные

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: помножених на сталі

Razlog: Pomnoženyh konstantami v §4 raboty 4 govori o skalarnyh množiteljah polarnyh operacij. Arhivny razlog sravnivaje medžunarodnu konstantu s ruskim postojannye i ukrajinskim stali; on ne tvrdi, že tam sut nove matematične konstanty s osobnymi nazvami. Tekst označaje s \(\Pi\) agregat takyh operacij, čto dozvoljaje zapisati ranějše sumy jednoj formuloju. Množny oblik pomnoženyh mora ostati vezany k operacijam, a konstante ne možut byti zamenjene funkcijami proměnnyh, po ktoryh vrši se diferencijacija: to by izměnilo samy operator.

Reason: Pomnoženyh konstantami in §4 of Paper 4 describes scalar multipliers of polar operations. The archived reason compares international konstanta with Russian postoyannye and Ukrainian stali; it does not claim that new named mathematical constants are introduced. The text denotes an aggregate of these operations by \(\Pi\), allowing the earlier sums to be written in one formula. The plural participle must remain attached to the operations, and the constants cannot be replaced by functions of the differentiation variables: that would change the operator itself.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Poslě izpisanja polarnyh operacij tekst raboty 4 naziva \(\Pi\) jih agregatom s konstantnymi množiteljami. Formulacija govori o kombinaciji operacij, ne o zaměně koeficientov proizvoljnymi funkcijami.

Textual comparison: After displaying the polar operations, Paper 4 names \(\Pi\) as their aggregate with constant multipliers. The wording concerns a combination of operations, not replacement of the coefficients by arbitrary functions.

modul

Iztočnik / Source: Modul

Rusky / Russian: модуль

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модуль

Razlog: Modul čuva obščy medžunarodny korenj, prisutny i v obojih slovjanskyh sravnjenjah. Dva zachovane razloga ne sut jednako podrobne: prvy prěduprědžaje prěd avtomatičnym modernym čitanjem, vtory samo naziva slovo algebraičnym terminom. V rabotě 1 moduly upravljajut postupnoju konstrukcijeju odnosno polnyh sistemov form; tekst měnjaje \((abc)\) na druge označene formy. V §9 raboty 4 konečno mnogo form zjedinjaje se v modul pri izslědovanju viših form. Eti konteksty opravdyvajut čuvanje slova, ale ne davajut osnovu pripisati vsěm pojavjenjam jednu pozdnějšu aksiomatičnu definiciju. Različenje smyslov potrěbno jest v slovniku, ne posrědstvom tihoj zaměny avtorovogo nazva.

Reason: Modul retains the international stem shared by both Slavic comparanda. The two preserved reasons differ in detail: the first warns against an automatic modern reading, while the second merely calls it an algebraic term. In Paper 1 the moduli govern the successive construction of relatively complete systems of forms; the text replaces \((abc)\) by other specified forms. In §9 of Paper 4 finitely many forms are collected into a module in studying higher forms. These contexts justify retaining the word but do not justify assigning every occurrence a single later axiomatic definition. The dictionary must distinguish the senses rather than silently replace the author’s terminology.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 1 i 2 opisyvajut postupnu zaměnu modulov pri odnosno polnyh sistemah. V §17 raboty 2 višina pripada etoj postupnosti, a ne dimenziji modula v sovrěmennoj algebraičnoj definiciji.

Textual comparison: Papers 1 and 2 describe successive changes of moduli for relatively complete systems. In §17 of Paper 2, higher belongs to this succession, not to module dimension in a modern algebraic definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §9 konečno mnogo form zjedinjaje se v modul za daljše izslědovanje. Nazvanie prěmy algebraičny termin ne zaměnjaje matematičny opis etoj konstrukcije.

Textual comparison: In §9 finitely many forms are collected into a module for the subsequent investigation. Calling it a direct algebraic term cannot replace the mathematical account of this construction.

modul

Iztočnik / Source: Modul (historical generated polynomial set)

Rusky / Russian: модуль

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модуль

Razlog: V rabotě 45 modul označaje sistem, zadany polinomami; pojavjajut se izrazy \((\varphi,\psi,p^\rho)\) i \((\varphi,\psi,p^\sigma)\). Arhivny razlog prědpočita modul prěd avtomatičnoju zaměnoju na ideal, bo uvod izrično izbira izlaganje bez aparata teorije idealov. To ne znači, že sodržina nema idealno-teoretičnogo tumačenja. Avtorska granica takože jest važna: osnovny članok jest od H. Kapferera, a dodatok napisan jest vměstě s E. Noether; jezyk osnovnogo uvoda ne trěba pripisyvati lično Noether. Anglijsky opis v skobkah pri izvornom slově jest objašnjenje iz terminologičnogo zapisa, ne němečska citata.

Reason: In Work 45, modul denotes a system specified by polynomials; expressions include \((\varphi,\psi,p^\rho)\) and \((\varphi,\psi,p^\sigma)\). The archived reason prefers modul to automatic replacement by ideal because the introduction explicitly chooses an exposition without the apparatus of ideal theory. This does not mean that the content lacks an ideal-theoretic interpretation. The authorship boundary also matters: the main article is by H. Kapferer, with a supplement written jointly with E. Noether; the language of its main introduction should not be attributed personally to Noether. The parenthetical English description in the source field is a terminology-record gloss, not a German quotation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvod izbira elementarno izlaganje bez idealno-teoretičnogo aparata. Nazv modul čuva etu prezentaciju; zaglavje pripisyvaje osnovnu rabotu H. Kapfereru, a dodatok spoločnomu avtorstvu s E. Noether.

Textual comparison: The introduction chooses an elementary exposition without ideal-theoretic apparatus. Modul preserves that presentation; the title attributes the main work to H. Kapferer and the supplement to joint authorship with E. Noether.

modul / osnovna oblast cělosti

Iztočnik / Source: Modul / Grundintegritätsbereich

Rusky / Russian: модуль / основная область целостности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модуль / базова область цілісності

Razlog: Para modul / osnovna oblast cělosti razděljuje objekt i oblast jego koeficientov. V rabotě 14 modul jest zamknuty pri odčitanju i pri množenju elementami osnovnoj oblasti \(\mathfrak{S}\). Ako \(\mathfrak{S}\) jest oblast cělyh čisel, druga potrěba slěduje iz prvoj; pri obščem \(\mathfrak{S}\) ona neset dodatnu informaciju. Arhivny razlog upomina Dedekindovu tradiciju i slovjansky idiom oblasti cělosti. Jednak razlika od vektornogo prostora ne jest razlika od vsakego modernogo modula: koeficienty ne morajut tvoriti polje. Tekst posebno razlikuje moduly od idealov, čije elementy ležet v samoj oblasti \(\mathfrak{S}\). Čuvanje obojih nazvov čini tu razliku vidimoju.

Reason: The pair modul / osnovna oblast cělosti separates the object from its coefficient domain. In Paper 14 a module is closed under subtraction and multiplication by elements of the ground domain \(\mathfrak{S}\). If \(\mathfrak{S}\) is the integers, the second requirement follows from the first; for general \(\mathfrak{S}\) it adds information. The archived reason invokes the Dedekind tradition and the Slavic expression for an integral domain. However, a distinction from vector spaces is not a distinction from every modern module: the coefficients need not form a field. The text separately identifies ideals, whose elements belong to \(\mathfrak{S}\) itself. Retaining both names makes that distinction visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija imenuje odčitanje i množenje elementami \(\mathfrak{S}\). Uslovje, že elementy samogo modula ležet v \(\mathfrak{S}\), razlikuje idealny slučaj; vektorna nezavisnost ne jest častju toj definicije.

Textual comparison: The definition names subtraction and multiplication by elements of \(\mathfrak{S}\). Requiring the module’s own elements to lie in \(\mathfrak{S}\) distinguishes the ideal case; vector-space independence is not part of the definition.

modul / vyši modul

Iztočnik / Source: Modul / höherer Modul

Rusky / Russian: модуль / более высокий модуль

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модуль / вищий модуль

Razlog: Vyši modul jest sravnitelny izraz iz postupka konstrukcije form, ne tvrdženje o višej dimenziji ili večšej kardinalnosti. V §17 raboty 2 iz sistema form \(s\) prěhodi se k slědujučemu odnosno polnomu sistemu; redukcija izraza \(\nu(s)=(ss'u)^4\) privodi k modulam \(\varrho\) i \(t\). Arhivny izbor čuva medžunarodny modul i sravnitelny oblik vyši, pri čem sam zapis ostavjaje morfologiju za daljše izslědovanje. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenje podpirajut semantičnu strukturu, ale ne sut dokazom, že pravopis vyši byl jezykově potvrđeny. Slovnik zato razděljuje matematičny smysl sravnjenja i jezykovu ocenku oblika.

Reason: Vyši modul is a comparative expression within the construction of forms, not a claim of higher dimension or greater cardinality. In §17 of Paper 2 the system of forms \(s\) leads to the next relatively complete system; reduction of \(\nu(s)=(ss'u)^4\) leads to the moduli \(\varrho\) and \(t\). The archived choice retains international modul and renders the comparative with vyši, while expressly leaving its morphology open to further examination. The Russian and Ukrainian comparison supports the semantic structure but does not establish that the spelling vyši received linguistic validation. The dictionary therefore separates the mathematical meaning of the comparison from assessment of the word form.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 1 i 2 opisyvajut postupnu zaměnu modulov pri odnosno polnyh sistemah. V §17 raboty 2 višina pripada etoj postupnosti, a ne dimenziji modula v sovrěmennoj algebraičnoj definiciji.

Textual comparison: Papers 1 and 2 describe successive changes of moduli for relatively complete systems. In §17 of Paper 2, higher belongs to this succession, not to module dimension in a modern algebraic definition.

modul / moduly

Iztočnik / Source: Modul / Moduln

Rusky / Russian: модуль / модули

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модуль / модулі

Razlog: Modul / moduly čuva jedinstveno i množestveno čislo němečskogo Modul / Moduln. V uvodu raboty 2 različne formy postupno služet modulami pri konstrukciji odnosno polnyh sistemov; množina ne jest nazvom nove vrste algebraičnogo objekta. Arhivny razlog izbira prěmy kognat, no jego slovo o neizběžnosti togo izbora jest ocěna, ne dokaz nedostatka alternativ. Smyslova granica jest konkretna: odnosi medžu modulami v etom postupku ne smějut byti zamenjene obščim opisom modernoj teorije modulov. Oba čislove obliki zato ostajut pod jednoj lemoju s kontekstualnoju definicijeju.

Reason: Modul / moduly preserves the singular and plural of German Modul / Moduln. In the introduction to Paper 2, different forms successively serve as moduli in constructing relatively complete systems; the plural does not name a new kind of algebraic object. The archived reason selects the direct cognate, but its claim that this choice is unavoidable is an assessment, not evidence that no alternatives exist. The semantic boundary is specific: relations between moduli in this procedure must not be replaced by a generic account of modern module theory. The two number forms therefore belong under one headword with a contextual definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 1 i 2 opisyvajut postupnu zaměnu modulov pri odnosno polnyh sistemah. V §17 raboty 2 višina pripada etoj postupnosti, a ne dimenziji modula v sovrěmennoj algebraičnoj definiciji.

Textual comparison: Papers 1 and 2 describe successive changes of moduli for relatively complete systems. In §17 of Paper 2, higher belongs to this succession, not to module dimension in a modern algebraic definition.

modul vseh identičnyh relacij

Iztočnik / Source: Modul aller identischen Relationen

Rusky / Russian: модуль всех тождественных соотношений

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модуль усіх тотожних співвідношень

Razlog: Modul vseh identičnyh relacij čuva i avtorovo modul i točno potrěbu identiteta. V rabotě 16 polinomy \(G(t)\) pripadajut tomu modulu, ako poslě zaměny \(t\) vyrazami \(p\) rezultat \(G(p)\) jest identično nula v prěměnnyh \(x,y\). Identične zato ne znači, že vsě relacije sut jedna i ta sama relacija. Arhivny razlog prědpočita ta slova prěd modernizacijeju na ideal, v soglasnosti s izlaganjem posrědstvom sistemov modulov. Dnešnje objašnjenje kako jadro podstanovky može pomoči čitatelju, ale jest objašnjenjem, ne zamenoj avtorovogo termina. V prověrenom tekstu stojí oblik vsih; slovnik čuva razliku od arhivnogo vseh.

Reason: Modul vseh identičnyh relacij retains both the author’s modul and the requirement that a relation hold identically. In Paper 16 the polynomials \(G(t)\) belong to this module when substitution of the expressions \(p\) for \(t\) makes \(G(p)\) identically zero in the variables \(x,y\). Identične therefore does not mean that every relation is the very same relation. The archived reason prefers this wording to modernization as ideal, consistent with the exposition through systems of modules. A present-day explanation as the kernel of substitution can help the reader, but is an explanation rather than a replacement for the author’s term. The checked text has vsih; the dictionary preserves its distinction from archived vseh.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uslovje \(G(p)=0\) jest identitetom poslě podstanovky, ne tvrdženjem, že različne polinomialne relacije sut identične jedna drugoj. Tekst čuva modul kako nazv sistema takyh relacij.

Textual comparison: The condition \(G(p)=0\) is an identity after substitution, not a claim that different polynomial relations are identical to one another. The text retains module as the name of this system of relations.

modul iz linearnyh form

Iztočnik / Source: Modul aus Linearformen

Rusky / Russian: модуль из линейных форм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модуль з лінійних форм

Razlog: Modul iz linearnyh form jest prěmy opis elementov modula. V §1 raboty 22 formy sut linearne v konečnom spisku prěměnnyh \(\xi_i\), dokoliko jih koeficienty mogut byti cělymi čislami ili polinomami jednoj drugoj prěměnnoj nad poljem \(P\). Slovo linearnyh zato ne ograničuje stepen koeficientnyh polinomov. Arhivny razlog želi razlikovati etu konstrukciju od polinomialnyh idealov uvedenyh v §3; to jest razlika ulog v izlaganju, ne zabrana opisati někoje ideale kako moduly. Prědlog iz i genitiv form prědavaju sastav objekta bez dodatnogo teoretičnogo nazva.

Reason: Modul iz linearnyh form directly describes the elements of the module. In §1 of Paper 22 the forms are linear in a finite list of variables \(\xi_i\), while their coefficients may be integers or polynomials in a different single variable over a field \(P\). Linearnyh therefore does not bound the degree of the coefficient polynomials. The archived reason seeks to distinguish this construction from polynomial ideals introduced in §3; this is a distinction between roles in the exposition, not a prohibition on describing some ideals as modules. The preposition iz and genitive form describe the object’s constituents without adding another theoretical label.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Formy sut linearne v \(\xi_i\), a koeficienty imajut svoj odvojeno oprěděljany obseg. Tekst dozvoljaje polinomialne koeficienty; linearny zato ne znači stepen najvyše jeden vo vsěh prisutnyh prěměnnyh.

Textual comparison: The forms are linear in \(\xi_i\), while the coefficients have a separately specified domain. Polynomial coefficients are allowed; linear therefore does not mean degree at most one in every variable present.

modul v \((\Sigma,T)\)

Razlog: Modul v \((\Sigma,T)\) čuva dve razne ulogi: \(\Sigma\) dava skalary, a \(T\) jest aditivna grupa, v kojoj ležet elementy modula. V §9 raboty 19 podmnožstvo \(T\) mora byti zamknuto pri odčitanju i pri dejstvu skalarov. Arhivny razlog pravilno podčrkuje obobčenje idealov; to ne jest para dvoh modulov. Poradok množenja jest suščestveny, bo \(\Sigma\) ne mora byti komutativny. Prověreny tekst piše \(c\alpha\), ale v primětci naziva toj slučaj pravym modulom. Slovnik čuva to dejstvo i opisuje konvenciju, ne opravjaje je po navikah sovrěmennogo čitatelja. Sravnjenje s pečatnym originalom togo označenja ostaje potrebno.

Reason: Modul v \((\Sigma,T)\) preserves two different roles: \(\Sigma\) supplies scalars, while \(T\) is the additive group containing the module elements. In §9 of Paper 19 a subset of \(T\) must be closed under subtraction and scalar action. The archived reason correctly stresses the generalization of ideals; the notation is not a pair of modules. Multiplication order matters because \(\Sigma\) need not be commutative. The checked text writes \(c\alpha\) but calls this the right-module case in a footnote. The dictionary preserves the action and describes that convention rather than correcting it to a present-day reader’s expectations. Comparison of this designation with the printed original remains necessary.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija jest v §9. Tekst piše \(c\alpha\) i v primětci naziva toj slučaj pravym; etu kombinaciju ne možno tiho obrnuti. Ako nema jedinice, zapis generatorov vključaje takože cěločislne množitelji. Pečatny svědok nazvanija strany ne byl prověren v etom sravnjenju.

Textual comparison: The definition is in §9. The text writes \(c\alpha\) and calls this the right-hand case in a footnote; that combination must not be silently reversed. Without an identity, the expression in generators also includes integer multipliers. The printed witness for the side designation was not checked in this comparison.

modul \(M_\sigma\) / modulno svojstvo

Razlog: Modul \(M_\sigma\) i modulno svojstvo sut vezane k konkretnomu argumentu v §9 raboty 9. V tekste modul, zapisan frakturnym \(\mathfrak{M}_\sigma\), porađajut monomy stepena \(\sigma\), s dozvoljenymi množiteljami iz oblasti cělyh algebraičnyh funkcij. Dokaz potrěbuje, že izomorfizm oblastij prěnosi toj modul v sootvětny modul drugoj oblasti; sama bijekcija elementov ne vyjadřaje vsego potrěbnogo. Arhivny razlog prědpočita prěmu terminologiju modula i čuvanje jeje veze s §3. Zapis \(M_\sigma\) v lematě jest prostějši arhivny zapis, ne utvrđženje, že v avtorovoj notaciji stojí obyčno latinske M.

Reason: Modul \(M_\sigma\) and modulno svojstvo belong to a particular argument in §9 of Paper 9. In the text the module, written with fraktur \(\mathfrak{M}_\sigma\), is generated by monomials of degree \(\sigma\), with permitted multipliers from the domain of integral algebraic functions. The proof requires an isomorphism of the domains to carry this module to its counterpart in the other domain; a mere bijection of elements does not express the whole requirement. The archived reason favours direct module terminology and continuity with §3. The headword’s \(M_\sigma\) is the simpler archived notation, not a claim that the author’s symbol is an ordinary Latin M.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Modul \(\mathfrak{M}_\sigma\) porađajut označene monomy. Dokaz upotrěbjaje jego zamknutost pri množenju dozvoljenymi funkcijami, da izvesti sootvětstvo modulov. To svojstvo jest bolše než samo aditivno sravnjenje dvuh oblastij.

Textual comparison: The module \(\mathfrak{M}_\sigma\) is generated by the specified monomials. The proof uses closure under multiplication by the permitted functions to derive correspondence of the modules. This property is more than an additive comparison of the two domains.

modulne bazy

Iztočnik / Source: Modulbasen

Rusky / Russian: модульные базы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульні бази

Razlog: Modulne bazy jest množina izraza modulna baza; arhivny razlog prědpočita ju težšemu opisu kako bazisny sistem. V §4,2 raboty 31 različne bazy jednogo i togo že ideala davajut različne matricne zapisy, ale istu klasu ekvivalentnyh prědstavjenij. Sootvětny izbor baz pri izomorfnyh idealah može dati identične matrice. Zato slovnik ne směje skratiti rezultat do tvrdženja, že matrice ne zaviset od bazy. Nezavisna od izbora jest klasa, a ne vsaka matrica. Slovjansko soglasje pridevnika s množinoju bazy čuva običnu gramatičnu strukturu prěmogo kalka.

Reason: Modulne bazy is the plural of modulna baza; the archived reason prefers it to a heavier expression such as basis system. In §4,2 of Paper 31 different bases of the same ideal give different matrix expressions but the same class of equivalent representations. Corresponding choices of bases for isomorphic ideals can give identical matrices. The dictionary must therefore not shorten the result to a claim that the matrices are independent of the basis. The class is independent of that choice, not each matrix. Agreement of the adjective with plural bazy preserves the ordinary grammatical structure of the direct calque.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zaměna bazy ne ostavjaje každu matricu neizměnnoju; ona ostavjaje klasu ekvivalentnosti. Sootvětstvo baz izomorfnyh idealov dava točniji rezultat o identičnyh matricah.

Textual comparison: A change of basis does not leave each matrix unchanged; it preserves the equivalence class. Corresponding bases of isomorphic ideals give the more specific result about identical matrices.

modulna baza

Iztočnik / Source: Modulbasis

Rusky / Russian: модульная база; модульный базис

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульна база

Razlog: Modulna baza čuva němečske složenje kako pridevnik s imenikom; arhivne razloge združajut Hilbertovu teoriju konečnyh generatorov, konstrukciju iz §3 raboty 9 i bazy iz raboty 31. To ne dava jednu potrěbu nezavisnosti za vsě slučaje. V rabotě 6 važna jest možnost vyraziti formy kombinacijami konečnogo spiska; v rabotě 9 slova o roli prěměnnyh kako bazy ne tvrđet samy po sebě jih linearnoj nezavisnosti. Naprotiv v §2 raboty 31 nezavisnost nad poljem jest izrična, a v §3 posebne komponenty jedinice tvoret nezavisnu bazu razširenogo prstena. Zato baza mora iměti kontekstualny opis: generatory, ili generatory s dokazanoju nezavisnostju.

Reason: Modulna baza renders the German compound as an adjective and noun. The archived reasons bring together Hilbert’s finite-generation theory, the construction in §3 of Paper 9, and the bases in Paper 31. This does not establish one independence requirement for every case. In Paper 6 the important property is expression of forms as combinations of a finite list; in Paper 9 the statement that indeterminates play the role of a basis does not itself assert their linear independence. By contrast, §2 of Paper 31 expressly requires independence over a field, and in §3 particular components of the identity form an independent basis of the extended ring. Baza therefore needs a contextual description: generators, or generators with established independence.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V uvodu raboty 6 konečne formy služe za vyraženje ostalyh form kombinacijami s koeficientami oprěděljenogo vida. Sama upotrěba baza ne ustanavjaje nezavisnost generatorov.

Textual comparison: In the introduction to Paper 6 finitely many forms express the remaining forms through combinations with coefficients of a specified kind. The use of basis alone does not establish independence of the generators.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 9 prěnosi opis s prěměnnymi k cělym algebraičnym funkcijam. Zapis \(z=\alpha+\sum g_i\eta_i\) i primětka o svojstvu \(z-\alpha\) davajut konkretny smysl slovam modulna oblast i baza; sam nazv ne dokazyvaje nezavisnosti \(\eta_i\).

Textual comparison: Paper 9 passes from a description with indeterminates to integral algebraic functions. The expression \(z=\alpha+\sum g_i\eta_i\) and the footnote on the property of \(z-\alpha\) give concrete content to module domain and basis; the name alone does not prove independence of the \(\eta_i\).

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 31 nezavisnost v etyh městah jest izrična. To oprěděljaje silnějši smysl bazy než samo porađanje iz konečnogo spiska v drugih rabotah.

Textual comparison: In these passages of Paper 31, independence is explicit. It establishes a stronger meaning of basis than generation by a finite list in other papers.

bazis modula / konečny bazis modula

Iztočnik / Source: Modulbasis / endliche Modulbasis

Rusky / Russian: базис модуля / конечный базис модуля

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: базис модуля / скінченний базис модуля

Razlog: Bazis modula jest imenna konstrukcija s genitivom, v sravnjenju s pridevnikovym modulna baza. Arhivny razlog ne dava čislove ocěnky dvoh oblikov; on objašnjaje, začto čuvati slovo bazis: v §6 raboty 17 konečno mnogo izbranyh elementov dozvoljaje predstaviti cěly sistem linearnymi kombinacijami. Konečny odnosi se k spisku generatorov, ne k čislu elementov v oblasti. V prověrenom tekste stojí modulny bazis. Množiteli \(A_{ij}\) v zapise \(F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j\) stojat s lěvoj strany; uslovja na nekomutativne koeficientne zakony ne smějut byti izgubjene. Toj konečny bazis ne jest avtomatično nezavisnym bazisom proizvoljnogo modula.

Reason: Bazis modula is a noun with a genitive complement, as opposed to adjectival modulna baza. The archived reason supplies no numerical ranking of these forms; it explains why basis is retained: in §6 of Paper 17 finitely many selected elements express the whole system by linear combinations. Konečny concerns the list of generators, not the number of elements in the ambient domain. The checked text has modulny bazis. The multipliers \(A_{ij}\) in \(F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j\) stand on the left; the hypotheses governing the noncommutative coefficient laws must not disappear. This finite basis is not automatically an independent basis of an arbitrary module.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V §6 raboty 17 zapis \(F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j\) oprěděljaje ulogu konečnogo bazisa. Lokalni zakony za koeficienty sut častju uslovij; to ne jest bezuslovny teorem o proizvoljnom nekomutativnom prstenu.

Textual comparison: In §6 of Paper 17, \(F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j\) specifies the role of a finite basis. The local coefficient laws are part of the hypotheses; this is not an unconditional theorem about an arbitrary noncommutative ring.

modulna baza / fundamentalna forma / fundamentalno uravnenje

Iztočnik / Source: Modulbasis / Fundamentalform / Fundamentalgleichung

Rusky / Russian: модульная база / фундаментальная форма / фундаментальное уравнение

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульна база / фундаментальна форма / фундаментальне рівняння

Razlog: Modulna baza, fundamentalna forma i fundamentalno uravnenje sut tri povezane, ale ne sinonimne nazvy. Uvod raboty 31 objašnjaje prěhod od stepenej primitivnogo elementa i jego oprěděljajučego uravnenja k bazě s relacijami; analogično govori o stepeneh fundamentalnoj formy i jeje uravnenju. Arhivny razlog bira prěmy modulny naziv i medžunarodne fundamentalna forma / fundamentalno uravnenje, čuvajuči strukturu argumenta. Motivacija jest matematična: rabota s bazami dozvoljaje redukciju po prostom modulu v uslovjah, v ktoryh izbor primitivnogo elementa može byti neprigodny. Iz etogo ne slěduje, že vsak algebraičny poredok ima bazu iz stepenej jednogo elementa.

Reason: Modulna baza, fundamentalna forma and fundamentalno uravnenje are three related names, not synonyms. The introduction to Paper 31 explains the move from powers of a primitive element and its defining equation to a basis with relations; it also speaks of powers of the fundamental form and its equation. The archived reason chooses direct module terminology and the international expressions fundamental form / fundamental equation, preserving the argument’s structure. The motivation is mathematical: working with bases permits reduction modulo a prime under circumstances in which a primitive-element choice can be unsuitable. This does not imply that every algebraic order has a basis consisting of powers of one element.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvod raboty 31 sravnivaje različne sposoby zadanja algebraičnogo objekta i objašnjaje prědnost bazy pri redukciji. Fundamentalna forma, jeje uravnenje i modulna baza imajut različne ulogi v tom sravnjenju.

Textual comparison: The introduction to Paper 31 compares ways of specifying the algebraic object and explains the advantage of a basis for reduction. The fundamental form, its equation and the module basis play different roles in that comparison.

modulna baza / linearno nezavisna modulna baza

Iztočnik / Source: Modulbasis / linear unabhängige Modulbasis

Rusky / Russian: модульная база / линейно независимая модульная база

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульна база / лінійно незалежна модульна база

Razlog: Dodatok linearno nezavisna ne jest stilistična izbytočnost. Na početku §4 raboty 31 izrično potrěbuje se, že vsak \(\mathfrak{Z}\)-modul v oblasti \(\mathfrak{R}\), uključajuči samu \(\mathfrak{R}\), ima konečnu nezavisnu bazu. Zapis \(\mathfrak{Z}\) označaje osnovnu oblast, ne avtomatično cěle čisla. Arhivny razlog čuva etu formulaciju vměsto vvedenja novogo nazva svobodny modul. Tak čitatelj vidi točno uslovje, ktoro nosi daljši argument o zaměně baz i determinantu. Bez lokalnyh uslovij ne možno prěnesti toj rezultat na vsě moduly nad vsěmi prstenami.

Reason: The addition linearno nezavisna is not stylistic redundancy. At the beginning of §4 of Paper 31 the explicit requirement is that every \(\mathfrak{Z}\)-module in \(\mathfrak{R}\), including \(\mathfrak{R}\) itself, have a finite independent basis. The symbol \(\mathfrak{Z}\) denotes the ground domain, not automatically the integers. The archived reason retains this formulation rather than introduce the additional name free module. The reader can thus see the exact hypothesis supporting the subsequent argument about changes of basis and their determinant. Without the local hypotheses, the result cannot be transferred to all modules over all rings.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uslovje govori o vsěh \(\mathfrak{Z}\)-modulah v danoj \(\mathfrak{R}\), ne o vsěh modulah bez ograničenja. Bazovy symbol ne označaje avtomatično prsten cělyh čisel.

Textual comparison: The hypothesis concerns all \(\mathfrak{Z}\)-modules in the given \(\mathfrak{R}\), not every module without restriction. The ground-domain symbol does not automatically denote the ring of integers.

modulna baza iz linearno nezavisnyh elementov

Iztočnik / Source: Modulbasis aus linear unabhängigen Elementen

Rusky / Russian: модульный базис из линейно независимых элементов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульний базис із лінійно незалежних елементів

Razlog: Modulna baza iz linearno nezavisnyh elementov čuva polny uslovny izraz: slova iz linearno nezavisnyh elementov ne možno izpustiti pod prědlogom, že vsaka baza už po definiciji jest nezavisna. V §8,4 raboty 31 tvrđženje govori o lokalizovanom prstenu \(\mathfrak{T}_{\mathfrak{P}}\) kako konečnom poredku nad glavnym prstenom \(\mathfrak{o}_{\mathfrak{p}}\), s vezju \(\mathfrak{P}=\mathfrak{T}\mathfrak{p}\). Arhivny razlog izrično čuva nezavisnost. To jest baza nad označenym koeficientnym prstenom, ne proizvoljny spisok elementov. Primětka citira H. Grella; konsultacija njegovoj raboty ne jest zasvědčena tym, že citata prisutstvuje v perevodě.

Reason: Modulna baza iz linearno nezavisnyh elementov retains the full condition: from linearly independent elements cannot be omitted on the assumption that every historical use of basis already entails independence. In §8,4 of Paper 31 the assertion concerns the localized ring \(\mathfrak{T}_{\mathfrak{P}}\) as a finite order over the principal ideal ring \(\mathfrak{o}_{\mathfrak{p}}\), with \(\mathfrak{P}=\mathfrak{T}\mathfrak{p}\). The archived reason explicitly retains independence. This is a basis over the specified coefficient ring, not an arbitrary list of elements. A footnote cites H. Grell; the presence of that citation in the translation does not establish consultation of his work.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija prstena kvocientov upotrěbjaje dozvoljene imenovatelje, ne klasy ostatkov. Baza iz nezavisnyh elementov pripada konkretnoj lokalnoj konstrukciji nad \(\mathfrak{o}_{\mathfrak{p}}\). Glavny prsten i konečnost poredka sut matematične uslovja.

Textual comparison: The definition of the ring of quotients uses permitted denominators, not residue classes. The basis of independent elements belongs to a particular local construction over \(\mathfrak{o}_{\mathfrak{p}}\). The principal ideal ring and finite-order conditions are mathematical hypotheses.

modulna oblast

Iztočnik / Source: Modulbereich

Rusky / Russian: модульная область

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульна область

Razlog: Modulna oblast čuva istoricky obraz izraza Modulbereich i soglasnost medžu rabotami 9 i 30. Arhivni razloge protivjajut se neobjašnjenoj modernizaciji, ale ne trěba iz njih izvesti, že objekt nikogda ne jest modulom v dnešnjem smyslu. V §2 raboty 30 oblast jest aditivna Abelova grupa s dejstvom elementov prstena, a tekst izrično dava distributivne i asociativne zakony; v §10 analizuje jeje lance i kompozicionne redy. To ne jest prosto kolekcija modulov. V §3 raboty 9 nazva pripada specifičnoj konstrukciji s algebraičnymi funkcijami. Jednaky korenj podpiraje jezykovu kontinuitetnost, no vsaka definicija mora byti čitana v svojem městu.

Reason: Modulna oblast preserves the historical expression Modulbereich and continuity between Papers 9 and 30. The archived reasons oppose unexplained modernization, but they should not be taken to establish that the object is never a module in the present-day sense. In §2 of Paper 30 the domain is an additive Abelian group acted on by ring elements, with explicit distributive and associative laws; §10 studies its chains and composition series. It is not simply a collection of modules. In §3 of Paper 9 the name belongs to a particular construction with algebraic functions. A shared stem supports linguistic continuity, but each definition must be read in its own setting.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 9 prěnosi opis s prěměnnymi k cělym algebraičnym funkcijam. Zapis \(z=\alpha+\sum g_i\eta_i\) i primětka o svojstvu \(z-\alpha\) davajut konkretny smysl slovam modulna oblast i baza; sam nazv ne dokazyvaje nezavisnosti \(\eta_i\).

Textual comparison: Paper 9 passes from a description with indeterminates to integral algebraic functions. The expression \(z=\alpha+\sum g_i\eta_i\) and the footnote on the property of \(z-\alpha\) give concrete content to module domain and basis; the name alone does not prove independence of the \(\eta_i\).

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tekst dava aditivnu grupu, skalarnu akciju i jeje zakony, potom lance i kompozicionny red. Arhivno prěduprědženje protiv modernizacije ne opravyvaje negaciju etoj modulnoj struktury.

Textual comparison: The text supplies an additive group, scalar action and its laws, followed by chains and a composition series. The archived warning against modernization does not justify denying this module structure.

modulno predstavjenje

Iztočnik / Source: Moduldarstellung

Rusky / Russian: модульное представление
