Razlog: Modulno predstavjenje v rabotě 24 znači zapis polinomialnogo ideala kako modula s oprěděljenymi generatorami i koeficientami. Formula (3) dava diagonalny oblik s faktorami \(E,E_1,\ldots\); pozdnějši primjer upotrěbjaje toj oblik. Arhivny razlog bira prosty kalk, da slovo predstavjenje ne sugeruje teoriju matricnyh prědstavjenij prstenov ili grup. Eti smysly istogo němečskogo Darstellung trěba razlikovati, ne avtomatično sjediniti. V prověrenom tekste upotrěbljaje se prědstavjenje s ě; arhivna lema čuvaje svoj zapis. Nijedny od dvoh zapisov ne može sam zaměniti opis togo, čto jest predstavjeno i nad kakymi koeficientami.

Reason: Modulno predstavjenje in Paper 24 means expression of a polynomial ideal as a module with specified generators and coefficients. Formula (3) gives a diagonal form involving \(E,E_1,\ldots\), used in a later example. The archived reason chooses a plain calque so that predstavjenje does not suggest the theory of matrix representations of rings or groups. These senses of the same German Darstellung must be distinguished, not automatically merged. The checked text uses prědstavjenje with ě; the archived headword retains its own spelling. Neither spelling can replace an account of what is being represented and over which coefficients.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Formula (3) i pozdnějši primjer govoret o predstavjenju ideala posrědstvom modulnyh generatorov. To ne jest to samoe značenje prědstavjenija kako matrice, ktore dejstvajut na prostorě.

Textual comparison: Formula (3) and the later example concern expression of an ideal through module generators. This is not the same sense of representation as matrices acting on a space.

modulne svojstvo

Iztočnik / Source: Moduleigenschaft der Restgruppe

Rusky / Russian: модульное свойство

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульна властивість

Razlog: Modulne svojstvo v §3 raboty 17 odnosi se k grupě ostatkov: klasi možno skladyvati i množiti elementom \(F\) s lěvoj strany. Arhivny razlog naziva to modulopodobnym svojstvom i izběgaje dodatnu modernu etiketu. Matematična granica jest točnije vidima v dokazě: množenje dvoh klasov ne jest občno dobro oprěděljeno, dokoliko dejstvo \(F\) na klas ostaje dobro oprěděljeno. Zato ne trěba tvrdžiti, že nema modulnoj struktury; ne ustanovjena jest struktura kvocientnogo prstena. Klas jedinice služi cikličnym generatorom pri tom dejstvu, ne sam po sebě vnutrišnoju jedinicoju neoprěděljenogo množenja klasov.

Reason: Modulne svojstvo in §3 of Paper 17 concerns the residue group: its classes can be added and multiplied on the left by an element \(F\). The archived reason calls this a module-like property and avoids an additional modern label. The mathematical boundary is clearer in the proof: multiplying two classes is not generally well defined, whereas the action of \(F\) on a class is. One should therefore not claim that there is no module structure; what has not been established is a quotient-ring structure. The class of the identity serves as a cyclic generator for this action, not by itself as an internal identity for an undefined multiplication of classes.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dokaz razděljuje dobre oprěděljeno lěvo dejstvo i občno nedozvoljeno množenje dvuh klasov. Zato izraz modulno svojstvo ne trěba zaměniti kvocientnym prstenom, ni tumačiti kako negaciju modula.

Textual comparison: The proof distinguishes a well-defined left action from generally unavailable multiplication of two classes. Module property should therefore neither be replaced by quotient ring nor interpreted as a denial of a module structure.

modulna homomorfnost ... k sistemě slědov (§4, 3)

Iztočnik / Source: Modulhomomorphie ... zum System der Spuren (§4, 3)

Rusky / Russian: модульная гомоморфность ... к системе следов (§4, 3)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульна гомоморфність ... до системи слідів (§4, 3)

Razlog: Modulna homomorfnost k sistemě slědov čuva naziv konkretnoj mapy i odkaz k §4,3 raboty 31. Pri fiksovanom klasu idealov slědy tvoret modul. Pišemo \(S\) za toj slěd; formula \(S(\beta-\gamma)=S(\beta)-S(\gamma)\) vměstě s \(S(c\beta)=cS(\beta)\) vyjadřaje aditivnost i soglasnost s koeficientami. V §8,2 to upotrěbjaje se v argumentu o konečnoj bazě. Arhivny razlog prědpočita polny opis skraćenju po linearnosti: čitatelj mora moči najdti, ktora mapa i ktory zakony sut potrěbne. Homomorfnost ne znači injektivnost i ne tvrdi zakona \(S(\beta\gamma)=S(\beta)S(\gamma)\); to byl by drugy, prstenovy uslov.

Reason: Modulna homomorfnost k sistemě slědov retains the name of the particular map and the reference to §4,3 of Paper 31. For a fixed ideal class, the traces form a module. Writing \(S\) for this trace, \(S(\beta-\gamma)=S(\beta)-S(\gamma)\) together with \(S(c\beta)=cS(\beta)\) expresses additivity and compatibility with coefficients. In §8,2 this enters an argument about a finite basis. The archived reason prefers the full description to the abbreviation by linearity: the reader must be able to locate the map and the required laws. Homomorfnost does not mean injectivity and does not assert \(S(\beta\gamma)=S(\beta)S(\gamma)\); that would be a different, ring-theoretic condition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zakony za razliku i skalarny množitelj oprěděljajut potrěbnu homomorfnost. Odkaz iz §8,2 k §4,3 imenuje etu konstrukciju, bez tvrdženja o injektivnosti ili množenju dvuh slědov.

Textual comparison: The laws for a difference and a scalar multiple specify the homomorphism required. The reference from §8,2 to §4,3 identifies this construction without asserting injectivity or a law for multiplying two traces.

moduly

Iztočnik / Source: Moduln

Rusky / Russian: модули

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модулі

Razlog: Moduly jest nazvanje algebraičnoj struktury, ne obče slovo za sistemy. V rabotě 17 polinomy mogut ne komutovati. Klasy ostatkov možno dodavati i množiti polinomom s lěvoj strany, ale produkt dvuh klasov ne musi byti dobro oprěděljeny. Modulny jezyk zato čuva potrěbnu razliku medžu dejstvom polinomov i množenjem v prstenu ostatkov. Arhivny razlog izbira prěmy algebraičny termin vměsto opisov sistemy ili idealy; to ne znači, že idealna interpretacija nikogda ne jest možna. Konečnost v uvodu znači konečno čislo linearno nezavisnyh klasov, ne konečno čislo vsih klasov. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjena podpirajut izbor toj slovnoj rodiny, ale sama ne dokazujut ponimanje medžu čitateljami vsih slovjanskyh jezykov. Dostupny tekst nazyva zatvorenost na \(FM\) pravostrannom, a na \(MF\) lěvostrannom. To označenje strany trěba sravniti s pečatnym izvornikom; ne zaměnjujemo go tiho današnym obyčajem.

Reason: Moduly names an algebraic structure, not systems in general. In Paper 17 the polynomials need not commute. Residue classes can be added and multiplied by a polynomial on the left, but multiplication of two classes need not be well defined. Module language therefore preserves the distinction between a polynomial action and multiplication in a residue-class ring. The archived reason chooses direct algebraic terminology over the paraphrases systems or ideals; it does not rule out an ideal interpretation where appropriate. Finiteness in the introduction means finitely many linearly independent classes, not finitely many classes altogether. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the lexical family, but do not themselves establish comprehension across Slavic readerships. The available text calls closure under \(FM\) right-sided and under \(MF\) left-sided. That side designation requires comparison with the printed witness; it is not silently replaced by modern convention.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Korpus odlišaje množenje klasa polinomom od množenja dvuh klasov. To objasnjaje, počemu obecny opis sistema ne zaměnjaje modulny jezyk. Označenja stran pri FM i MF ostavajut posebnym pitanjem za pečatny izvornik.

Textual comparison: The corpus distinguishes multiplying a class by a polynomial from multiplying two classes. This explains why the generic description system cannot replace module language. The side designations attached to FM and MF remain a separate printed-witness question.

modulny produkt

Iztočnik / Source: Modulprodukt

Rusky / Russian: модульное произведение; произведение модулей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: добуток модулів; модульний добуток

Razlog: Modulny produkt označa sumy produktov elementov, ne množinu uporjadkovanyh par. V §8 raboty 34 produkt \(AB\) sostoji se iz konečnyh sum \(ab\), kde \(a\) naleži k \(A\) i \(b\) k \(B\). To jest važno takože za konstrukcije poredkov v rabotě 42. Arhiv imaje dva razloge za izbor: čuvati modulnu konstrukciju, ne nazyvati ju prědčasno idealnym produktom; i upotrěbjati produkt soglasno s terminom skrěženy produkt, vměsto alternativy dobytok. To jest kvalitativny izbor doslědnosti, ne dokaz, že dobytok jest loš slovo. Termin ne znači tenzorny produkt ni prěmy produkt modulov; konkretny zakon množenja davaje rabota.

Reason: Modulny produkt denotes sums of products of elements, not a set of ordered pairs. In §8 of Paper 34, \(AB\) consists of finite sums of products \(ab\), with \(a\) in \(A\) and \(b\) in \(B\). This also matters for the constructions of orders in Paper 42. The archive gives two reasons: preserve the module-level construction without prematurely calling it an ideal product; and use produkt consistently with skrěženy produkt, rather than the alternative dobytok. This is a qualitative preference for consistency, not evidence that dobytok is an unsuitable word. The term does not mean a tensor product or a direct product of modules; the work supplies the particular multiplication law.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija v rabotě 34 zahtěvaje sumy produktov. Konstrukcije poredkov v rabotah 31 i 42 čuvajut toj smysl; ne ide o tenzorny produkt.

Textual comparison: The definition in Paper 34 requires sums of products. The constructions of orders in Papers 31 and 42 retain this meaning; they are not tensor products.

modulny kvocient

Iztočnik / Source: Modulquotient

Rusky / Russian: частное модулей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка модулів

Razlog: Modulny kvocient v §9 raboty 30 označa konstrukciju s dvojtočkoju. Ako jednačenje \(\mathfrak A T=\mathfrak B\) imaje jedino rěšenje, tekst identifikuje go s \(\mathfrak B:\mathfrak A\). Uslovje jedinstvenosti ne možno izpustiti i tvrditi, že vsak takovy kvocient bez daljših prědposylok rěšaje produktno jednačenje. Arhivny razlog oddělja toj pojem od polja kvocientov, prstena klasov ostatkov i obyčnyh drobjev. Rusko častnoe modulej i ukrajinsko častka moduliv sut sravnjena za toj specialny smysl, ne instrukcija čitati dvojtočku kako obyčno děljenje čisel.

Reason: Modulny kvocient in §9 of Paper 30 denotes the colon construction. If the equation \(\mathfrak A T=\mathfrak B\) has a unique solution, the text identifies it with \(\mathfrak B:\mathfrak A\). The uniqueness condition must not be dropped to suggest that every such quotient solves the product equation without further hypotheses. The archived reason distinguishes this object from a quotient field, a residue-class ring and ordinary fractions. The Russian частное модулей and Ukrainian частка модулів are comparanda for this specialised sense, not instructions to read the colon as ordinary numerical division.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija kvocienta koristi obratny porjadok děliteljnosti. Uvjet jedinstvenosti v §9 ne trěba izpustiti pri prěhodu od produktnogo jednačenja k kolon-kvocientu.

Textual comparison: The quotient definition uses the reverse divisibility ordering. The uniqueness condition in §9 must be retained when passing from a product equation to a colon quotient.

modulny kvocient / idealny kvocient

Iztočnik / Source: Modulquotient / Idealquotient

Rusky / Russian: частное модулей / частное идеалов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка модулів / частка ідеалів

Razlog: Modulny kvocient i idealny kvocient tvorjat jednu terminologičnu paru, zato že §5,4 raboty 30 prvo oprěděljaje konstrukciju za moduly v razširjajučem prstenu, a potom specializuje ju k idealam. \(C=A:B\) izpolnjaje \(CB\subseteq A\), a vsaky modul \(D\) s \(DB\subseteq A\) jest sodržany v \(C\). Po vključanju to jest največši takovy modul. Slovo najmenši v istorijskom opisu odnosi se k obratnomu porjadku děliteljnosti; ne trěba čitati go kako najmenši po vključanju. Arhivny razlog zahtěvaje odlišati etot kvocient od prstena ostatkov \(R/I\): elementy kolon-kvocienta sut množitelje, ne klasy po ekvivalenciji. Pari odgovarja para modul/ideal, ne dva slučajno izbrana sinonima.

Reason: Modulny kvocient and idealny kvocient form a terminological pair because §5,4 of Paper 30 first defines the construction for modules in an extension ring and then specialises it to ideals. \(C=A:B\) satisfies \(CB\subseteq A\), and every module \(D\) with \(DB\subseteq A\) is contained in \(C\). It is therefore the largest such module by inclusion. Smallest in the historical description refers to the reverse divisibility ordering, not to the smallest set by inclusion. The archived reason requires a distinction from the residue-class ring \(R/I\): elements of a colon quotient are multipliers, not equivalence classes. The two names reflect the module/ideal distinction rather than being arbitrary synonyms.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija kvocienta koristi obratny porjadok děliteljnosti. Uvjet jedinstvenosti v §9 ne trěba izpustiti pri prěhodu od produktnogo jednačenja k kolon-kvocientu.

Textual comparison: The quotient definition uses the reverse divisibility ordering. The uniqueness condition in §9 must be retained when passing from a product equation to a colon quotient.

modulny teorem

Iztočnik / Source: Modulsatz

Rusky / Russian: модульная теорема

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: модульна теорема

Razlog: Modulny teorem jest kratko nazvanje točno ukazanogo teorema prěnosa uslovij cěpov. V §2 raboty 30 \(M\) jest konečno poraždany modul nad komutativnym prstenom \(R\) s jediniceju. Uslovje rastučih odnosno padajučih cěpov idealov v \(R\) togda prěhodi na podmoduly \(M\). Konečny tu ne znači, že \(M\) imaje konečno mnogo elementov. Arhivny razlog čuva nazvanje zato, že §1 odkazuje k tomu teoremu v lemě o cělyh elementah. To ne jest nazvanje vsih teoremov o modulah ni zakon modularnoj rešetky. V rěčniku trěba čitati nazvanje vměstě s jego prědposylkami.

Reason: Modulny teorem is a short name for the specified theorem transferring chain conditions. In §2 of Paper 30, \(M\) is a finitely generated module over a commutative ring \(R\) with identity. The ascending or descending chain condition on ideals of \(R\) then transfers to submodules of \(M\). Finite here does not mean that \(M\) has finitely many elements. The archived reason retains the name because §1 invokes this theorem in the integral-elements lemma. It is neither a name for all module theorems nor the modular law for lattices. The dictionary name must be read with its hypotheses.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem imaje eksplicitne prědposylky o prstenu i modulě. Konečnost jest oprěděljena prěz konečnu poraždajuču sistemu, ne prěz čislo vsih elementov.

Textual comparison: The theorem has explicit hypotheses on the ring and module. Finiteness is defined through a finite generating system, not by counting all elements.

teorija modulov / bazis modula / prosty modul / nulovy modul

Iztočnik / Source: Modultheorie / Modulbasis / Primmodul / Nullmodul

Rusky / Russian: теория модулей / базис модуля / простой модуль / нулевой модуль

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорія модулів / базис модуля / простий модуль / нульовий модуль

Razlog: Teorija modulov, bazis modula, prosty modul i nulovy modul sut povezane nazvanja v rabotě 15, ale ne vse imajut današny najočekivany smysl. Modul relacij sostoji se iz cěločislovyh polinomov, ktore izčezajut po podstavjenju determinantov; zatvoren jest na dodavanje i množenje polinomami. Bazis tu označa poraždajuču sistemu, bez tvrdženja linearnoj nezavisnosti. Nulovy modul sodrži samo nulu. Arhivny razlog dopušča, že prosty pokryva i prostotu v idealnom smyslu, i prostotu modula. To ne opravdava matematično izravnjenje: prostota v etom kontekstu relacij i redukcije modulo \(p\) ne znači, že modul ne imaje vlastnyh nenulovyh podmodulov. Dodatno, identifikacija \(M=M_p\) v dostupnom tekstu zahtěvaje sravnjenje s pečatnym izvornikom; po tam danoj cěločislovoj definiciji konstanta \(p\) naleži k \(M_p\), ale ne k \(M\). Ne predlagajemo tiho popravljanje etoj ravnosti.

Reason: Teorija modulov, bazis modula, prosty modul and nulovy modul are related names in Paper 15, but not all have the most immediately expected modern meaning. The relation module consists of integer polynomials that vanish after substitution of the determinants; it is closed under addition and polynomial multiplication. Basis here means a generating system, without an assertion of linear independence. The zero module contains only zero. The archived rationale allows a prime/simple ambiguity in prosty. This does not justify mathematical equivalence: prime in this relation-theoretic, modulo-\(p\) context does not mean a module with no proper nonzero submodules. Moreover, the identification \(M=M_p\) in the available text requires comparison with the printed witness: under the integer-polynomial definition given there, the constant \(p\) belongs to \(M_p\) but not \(M\). No silent correction of that equality is proposed.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Množenje relacije libovoljnym polinomom ostavja relaciju. Kvadratične relacije poraždajut N; pri menje než četyroh indeksah N jest nulovy modul. Bazis jest poraždajuča sistema.

Textual comparison: Multiplying a relation by any polynomial preserves a relation. The quadratic relations generate N; with fewer than four indices N is the zero module. Basis means a generating system.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dostupny tekst poistovnjaje \(M\) i \(M_p\), ale opisuje \(M_p\) cěločislovymi polinomami, ktore izčezajut modulo \(p\). Konstanta \(p\) zato razděljuje dvě dane definicije. Trěba sravniti pečatny izvornik i njegovu konvenciju redukcije; ne imajemo ovdě dokazano izvorno popravljanje.

Textual comparison: The available text identifies \(M\) with \(M_p\) but describes \(M_p\) by integer polynomials vanishing modulo \(p\). The constant \(p\) therefore separates the two definitions as stated. The printed witness and its reduction convention require comparison; no source correction is established here.

čisla mnogokratnosti

Iztočnik / Source: Multiplicity numbers

Rusky / Russian: числа кратности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: числа кратності

Razlog: Čisla mnogokratnosti imenujut čisla, ktore čuvajut informaciju o povtorjenju faktorov. V §7 raboty 22 eksponenty linearnyh faktorov i čisla pri nerazložimyh faktorah morajut byti odlišene. Ako \(\gamma_\mu\) jest stepen nerazložimogo faktora i \(\beta_\mu\) jego eksponent, tekst davaje mnogokratnost \(\beta_\mu\gamma_\mu\) kako čislo linearno nezavisnyh ostatkovyh klasov nad ukazanym poljem. Arhivny opis čislo ostatkovyh klasov zato trěba dopolniti slovami linearno nezavisnyh. Anglejsko Multiplicity numbers v arhivu jest opis pojma, ne německy citat. Izbor prodolžaje rodinu mnogokratnost; prirodnost izraza ostala jest otvorjena za jezykovu ocěnku. Čislove vagi kandidatov ne sut zapisane.

Reason: Čisla mnogokratnosti names numbers retaining information about repeated factors. In §7 of Paper 22, exponents of linear factors must be distinguished from the numbers attached to irreducible factors. If \(\gamma_\mu\) is the degree of an irreducible factor and \(\beta_\mu\) its exponent, the text gives the multiplicity \(\beta_\mu\gamma_\mu\) as the number of linearly independent residue classes over the specified field. The archival shorthand residue-class count therefore needs the qualification linearly independent. The archived English Multiplicity numbers is a concept description, not a German quotation. The choice continues the mnogokratnost family; its naturalness remains a linguistic review question. No numerical candidate weights are recorded.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Eksponent i stepen faktora imajut odlišne uloge. Njih produkt daje navedenu mnogokratnost; izpustiti linearnu nezavisnost značilo by poměniti čislo, ktoro opisuje tekst.

Textual comparison: Exponent and factor degree have distinct roles. Their product gives the stated multiplicity; omitting linear independence would change the quantity described.

multiplikacijsko kolco / regularne multiplikacijske kolca

Iztočnik / Source: Multiplikationsring / reguläre Multiplikationsringe

Rusky / Russian: мультипликационное кольцо / регулярные мультипликационные кольца

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: мультиплікаційне кільце / регулярні мультиплікаційні кільця

Razlog: Multiplikacijsko kolco jest istorijno nazvanje specialnoj klasy prstenov, ne opis libovoljnogo prstena ili oblasti operatorov. Rabota 31, §8, citira Krulla i objasnjaje, že on upotrěbjaje nazvanje regularne multiplikacijske prsteny za razgledany slučaj bez děliteljev nuly. Uslovja vključajut jedinicu i jednoznačno razloženje nenulovyh vlastnyh idealov na potegy prostyh idealov, ktore sut maksimalne. Arhivny izbor čuva poznavajemo medžunarodno osnovu zaradi etogo konkretnogo nazvanja. Poznavatelnost medžu slovjanskymi čitateljami jest naměr, ne rezultat testa. V dostupnom korpusu kolco odgovarja prsten, ale fraza multiplikacijsko prsten ne imaje soglasovanja roda; očekivana mužska forma jest multiplikacijsky prsten. Eto jest jezykovo pitanje za popravljanje, ne nova matematična definicija. Citiranje Krulla v rabotě ne dokazuje, že njegov članok byl pročitany pri izboru termina.

Reason: Multiplikacijsko kolco is the historical name of a particular class of rings, not a description of any ring or operator domain. Paper 31, §8 cites Krull and explains that he uses regular multiplication rings for the case without zero divisors considered here. The hypotheses include an identity and unique factorisation of nonzero proper ideals into powers of prime ideals that are maximal. The archived choice retains a recognisable international stem because this is a specific historical name. Cross-Slavic recognisability is an aim, not a measured result. In the available corpus kolco corresponds to prsten, but multiplikacijsko prsten lacks gender agreement; the expected masculine form is multiplikacijsky prsten. This is a linguistic correction question, not a new mathematical definition. The work’s citation of Krull does not establish that his article was read when the term was chosen.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Citacija razlikuje istorijno nazvanje od obče frazy o množenju. Korpusna fraza multiplikacijsko prsten imaje nezavisno jezykovo pitanje: neutralna forma pridavnika ne soglašaje se s mužskym prsten.

Textual comparison: The citation distinguishes a historical name from a generic phrase about multiplication. The corpus phrase multiplikacijsko prsten also presents a separate linguistic issue: the neuter adjective does not agree with masculine prsten.

tablica množenja

Iztočnik / Source: Multiplikationstafel

Rusky / Russian: таблица умножения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: таблиця множення

Razlog: Tablica množenja v §6 raboty 34 opisuje produkty baznyh elementov hiperkompleksnogo sistema. Formula \(u_i u_k=\sum_j u_j\gamma^j_{ik}\) davaje strukturne konstanty; njim sut naložene uslovja asociativnosti. To ne jest prosto tablica cěločislovogo množenja i ne proizvoljna zbirka koeficientov. Arhivny razlog daje prědnost poznatoj slovjanskoj konstrukciji tablica množenja, blizkoj ruskomu i ukrajinskomu sravnjenju, vměsto opisnogo hibrida. Konkretny odbačeny hibrid ne jest zapisan; zato ne izmysljajemo kandidata ni čislovu ocěnku. Značenje tablicy jest oprěděljeno njenoju funkcijeju v algebraičnom sistemu.

Reason: Tablica množenja in §6 of Paper 34 specifies products of basis elements in a hypercomplex system. The formula \(u_i u_k=\sum_j u_j\gamma^j_{ik}\) gives structure constants, which are constrained by associativity. This is not merely an elementary integer multiplication table or an arbitrary collection of coefficients. The archived reason prefers the familiar Slavic construction tablica množenja, close to the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda, over a descriptive hybrid. No particular rejected hybrid is recorded, so neither a candidate wording nor a numerical score is invented. The table’s meaning is determined by its function in the algebraic system.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tablica davaje produkty baznyh elementov s koeficientami. Asociativnost naložuje relacije tym koeficientam; tablica ne jest proizvoljna.

Textual comparison: The table gives products of basis elements with coefficients. Associativity constrains those coefficients; the table is not arbitrary.

množitelje

Iztočnik / Source: Multiplikatoren

Rusky / Russian: множители

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: множники

Razlog: Množitelje v §9 raboty 9 sut elementy, s ktorimi tvorjat se linearne kombinacije generatorov modula. Tekst izrično dopušča vse cěle algebraične funkcije od \(\eta\) kako množitelje; ne ograničuje jih na konstanty i ne zaměnjaje jih libovoljnymi racionalnymi funkcijami. Arhivny razlog bira obče algebraično slovo blizko ruskomu množiteĺ i ukrajinskomu množnyk. Jego primětka, že tu ne ide o operatornu oblast množiteljev, razjasnjaje toj konkretny pasus; ne zabranjaje upotrěbu iste slovnoj rodiny za dejstvo prstena v rabotě 34. Kontekst, a ne razne koreni za vsaku upotrěbu, razlikuje te smysly.

Reason: Množitelje in §9 of Paper 9 are the elements used to form linear combinations of module generators. The text expressly allows all integral algebraic functions of \(\eta\) as multipliers; it neither restricts them to constants nor replaces them by arbitrary rational functions. The archived reason chooses the general algebraic word corresponding to Russian множитель and Ukrainian множник. Its observation that this is not an operator-theoretic multiplier domain explains this particular passage; it does not prohibit the same lexical family for a ring action in Paper 34. Context, rather than a separate root for every use, distinguishes the senses.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Modul tvori se s cělymi algebraičnymi funkcijami kak množiteljami. Točny obseg množiteljev jest čestju definicije, ne dodatna sinonimična glosa.

Textual comparison: The module is formed using integral algebraic functions as multipliers. The specified range of multipliers is part of the definition, not an optional synonymous gloss.

oblast množiteljev

Iztočnik / Source: Multiplikatorenbereich

Rusky / Russian: область множителей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: область множників

Razlog: Oblast množiteljev označa prsten, ktory dejstvuje na aditivnoj grupě modula. V §1, priměru 4 raboty 34 množitelje stojat lěvo; tri zakony izražajut distributivnost i soglasnost dejstva s množenjem prstena. Absolutna oblast množiteljev znači, že različne elementy davajut različne operacije, to jest dejstvo jest věrno. §8 poistovnja elementy s jednakym dejstvom i dobyvaje prsten ostatkov po idealu, ktory anuluje cěly modul. Arhivny razlog čuva paralelu s oblastju operatorov i točny odkaz nazad k §1. Oblast tu ne znači oblast cělosti: odsutnost děliteljev nuly ne jest utvrđena. Takože ne mora vključati vse endomorfizmy aditivnoj grupy.

Reason: Oblast množiteljev denotes a ring acting on the additive group of a module. In §1, example 4 of Paper 34 the multipliers stand on the left; three laws express distributivity and compatibility with ring multiplication. An absolute multiplier domain means that distinct elements give distinct operations: the action is faithful. Section 8 identifies elements with the same action and obtains the residue-class ring modulo the ideal annihilating the whole module. The archived reason preserves the parallel with operator domain and the precise reference back to §1. Domain here does not mean integral domain: absence of zero divisors is not asserted. Nor need it include every endomorphism of the additive group.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Različne množitelje v absolutnoj oblasti davajut različne operacije. Prěhod k njoj jest kvocient po idealu, ktory anuluje cěly modul; ne jest tvrdženje o odsutnosti děliteljev nuly.

Textual comparison: Distinct multipliers in the absolute domain induce distinct operations. Passing to it takes the quotient by the ideal annihilating the whole module; it does not assert absence of zero divisors.

uslovja mnogokratnosti / mnogokratnost

Iztočnik / Source: Multiplizitaetsbedingungen / Multiplizitaet

Rusky / Russian: условия кратности / кратность

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: умови кратності / кратність

Razlog: Uslovja mnogokratnosti i mnogokratnost upotrěbjajut jednu slovjansku osnovu za povtorjenje s točnym matematičnym čislom. V rabotě 45 Kapferer oprěděljaje lokalne uslovja prěz eksponenty izčezanja, označene \((K_i)\) i \((g_i)\); suma čisel \((g_i)\) jest mnogokratnost prěsěčenja \(\mu\). V Teoremu III, pri ego prědposylkah o prostyh točkah na \(\psi\) i vzajemnoj prostotě \(K\) s \(\psi\), pripadnost \(K\) idealu \((\varphi,\psi)\) odgovarja neravnostjam mnogokratnostij prěsěčenja v vsakom občem punktu. To ne jest samo uslovje, že kriva prohodi prěz toj punkt. Arhiv bira mnogokratnost vměsto medžunarodnoj zaimky zaradi prozračnosti i soglasnosti s jezykom o punktah i prěsěčenjah. To jest razlog izbora, ne dokaz, že vse lokalne pojmy mnogokratnosti sut identične.

Reason: Uslovja mnogokratnosti and mnogokratnost use one Slavic stem for repetition measured by a precise mathematical number. In Work 45, Kapferer defines local conditions through vanishing orders denoted by \((K_i)\) and \((g_i)\); the sum of the numbers \((g_i)\) is the intersection multiplicity \(\mu\). In Theorem III, under its hypotheses concerning simple points on \(\psi\) and coprimality of \(K\) with \(\psi\), membership of \(K\) in \((\varphi,\psi)\) corresponds to inequalities between intersection multiplicities at every common point. This is not merely the condition that a curve passes through the point. The archive chooses mnogokratnost over an international loan for transparency and compatibility with point and intersection language. This explains the choice; it does not establish that all local notions of multiplicity coincide.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uslovja \((K_i)\) i \((g_i)\) ne znači samo prohod prěz punkt. Teorem III imaje osobne prědposylky, ktore trěba čuvati pri tumačenju mnogokratnosti.

Textual comparison: The conditions on \((K_i)\) and \((g_i)\) do not merely assert passage through a point. Theorem III has particular hypotheses that must be retained when interpreting multiplicity.

mnogokratnost

Iztočnik / Source: Multiplizität

Rusky / Russian: кратность

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кратність

Razlog: Mnogokratnost povezuje terminologiju rezultantov v rabotah 22 i 24 s jezykom primarnyh idealov. Arhivny razlog daje prědnost prozračnoj slovjanskoj tvorbě i zahtěvaje doslědnost medžu etymi smyslami, pri otvorjenoj jezykovoj ocěnci. Matematična doslědnost ne znači, že vsekde trěba vzeti samo eksponent faktora. V rabotě 22 stepen nerazložimogo faktora množi se s jego eksponentom; rezultat měri čislo linearno nezavisnyh ostatkovyh klasov nad ukazanym poljem. Rabota 24, Teorem XI i prinaležna primětka H.-N., povezuje stepen primarnogo faktora normy s odgovarjajučim prostorom klasov. Rěčnik mora pokazati, ktory objekt i ktoro polje sut zadane, vměsto obče glosy čislo povtorjenij.

Reason: Mnogokratnost links the resultant terminology of Papers 22 and 24 with primary-ideal language. The archived reason favours a transparent Slavic formation and consistency between these uses, while leaving its linguistic assessment open. Mathematical consistency does not mean taking the factor exponent alone everywhere. In Paper 22, the degree of the irreducible factor multiplies its exponent; the result measures the number of linearly independent residue classes over the specified field. Paper 24, Theorem XI and the accompanying H.-N. footnote, relates the degree of a primary factor of the norm to the corresponding space of classes. A dictionary must identify the object and field rather than offer only the generic gloss number of repetitions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Eksponent i stepen faktora imajut odlišne uloge. Njih produkt daje navedenu mnogokratnost; izpustiti linearnu nezavisnost značilo by poměniti čislo, ktoro opisuje tekst.

Textual comparison: Exponent and factor degree have distinct roles. Their product gives the stated multiplicity; omitting linear independence would change the quantity described.

močnosť

Iztočnik / Source: Mächtigkeit

Rusky / Russian: мощность

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: потужність

Razlog: Močnost označa kardinalnost množiny, ne fyzičnu silu, algebraičnu potenciju ili stepen poljnogo razširjenja. V §8 raboty 9 upotrěbjena jest za postavjenje vzajemno jednoznačnogo odgovaranja medžu osnovami; argument citira Steinitza. Arhivny izbor močnosť prodolžaje už uživanu proektnu terminologiju, a dostupny korpus piše močnost. Razlika v označenju končnogo t jest pravopisna, ne smyslova. Opis mora čuvati etu razliku i pri čitanju latiničnoj i kiriličnoj formy. Jednakost kardinalnostij razgledanyh beskonečnyh množin ne opravdava opču tvrdnju, že vsako algebraično razširjenje, uključajuči razširjenja konečnyh polj, imaje tu samu kardinalnost. Steinitzova citacija jest svedočstvo izvora argumenta v rabotě, ne dokaz ranějšego pročitanja njegovogo teksta pri prěvodě.

Reason: Močnost denotes set cardinality, not physical power, an algebraic power or field-extension degree. In §8 of Paper 9 it is used to establish a bijective correspondence between bases; the argument cites Steinitz. The archived choice močnosť continues existing project terminology, while the available corpus writes močnost. The treatment of final t is an orthographic distinction, not a difference of meaning, and should remain recognisable in the Latin and Cyrillic forms. Equality of cardinalities for the infinite sets considered does not justify the unrestricted claim that every algebraic extension, including an extension of finite fields, has the same cardinality. The Steinitz citation identifies the work’s source for the argument, not an earlier reading of his text during translation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Močnost v etyh pasusah označa kardinalnost. Citacije Steinitza i upotrěba baz svězujut formulaciju s točnym argumentom, ne s fyzičnoju ili algebraičnoju potencijeju.

Textual comparison: Močnost in these passages means cardinality. The Steinitz citations and use of bases link the wording to a particular argument, not to physical or algebraic powers.

močnosť / kontinuum / dobra uporjadkovanja

Iztočnik / Source: Mächtigkeit / Kontinuum / Wohlordnungen

Rusky / Russian: мощность / континуум / вполне упорядочения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: потужність / континуум / добрі упорядкування

Razlog: Močnost, kontinuum i dobro uporjadkovanje imajut različne funkcije v §9 raboty 9. Močnost sravnjava veličinu množin; kontinuum davaje kardinal \(c\); dobro uporjadkovanje jest porjadok, v ktorom vsaka neprazdna podmnožina imaje najmenši element. Poslědnje svojstvo jest silnějše než obyčny linearny porjadok. Arhivny razlog prodolžaje terminologiju §8 i ostavjaje dobro uporjadkovanje za daljšu jezykovu ocěnku. Tekst daje \(2^c\) za čislo razgledanyh konstrukcij, ne avtomatično za čislo različnyh domen ili klasov ekvivalencije: sám ukazuje slučaj s samo odčislimo mnogo neekvivalentnymi domenami. Oznaka kontinuuma ne zahtěvaje hipotezu kontinuuma.

Reason: Močnost, kontinuum and dobro uporjadkovanje have different functions in §9 of Paper 9. Močnost compares sizes of sets; kontinuum supplies the cardinal \(c\); a well-order is an order in which every nonempty subset has a least element, a stronger property than an ordinary linear order. The archived reason continues the vocabulary of §8 and leaves dobro uporjadkovanje open to further linguistic assessment. The text gives \(2^c\) for the number of constructions considered, not automatically for the number of distinct domains or equivalence classes: it itself notes a case with only countably many inequivalent domains. The continuum notation does not require the continuum hypothesis.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tekst izrično razlikuje mnohostvo konstrukcij i čislo neekvivalentnyh domen. Rěčnik ne može izbrisati etu razliku pri objasnjenju kontinuuma i dobryh uporjadkovanij.

Textual comparison: The text expressly distinguishes the multitude of constructions from the number of inequivalent domains. Explaining continuum and well-orderings must preserve this distinction.

močnosť kontinuuma

Iztočnik / Source: Mächtigkeit des Kontinuums

Rusky / Russian: мощность континуума

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: потужність континууму

Razlog: Močnost kontinuuma jest rodilnikova konstrukcija, ktora imenuje kardinalnost kontinuuma. V §2 raboty 10 ona nastupaje pri sravnjenju racionalnyh baz za polje vsih realnyh i kompleksnyh čisel i pri postavjenju vzajemno jednoznačnogo odgovaranja. Arhivny razlog jest doslědnost s rabotoju 9; ne sodrži novo sravnjenje alternativ ni čislove vagi. Arhiv piše močnosť kontinuuma, a dostupny tekst močnost kontinuuma. Dobro uporjadkovanje i porjadok elementov v argumentu ne davajut sami po sobě konečnogo algoritma za izpisanje cěloj takoj bazy. Termin imenuje teoretičnu kardinalnost, ne praktičnu proceduru enumeracije.

Reason: Močnost kontinuuma is a genitive construction naming the cardinality of the continuum. In §2 of Paper 10 it occurs when comparing rational bases for the field of all real and complex numbers and establishing a bijective correspondence. The archived reason is consistency with Paper 9; it supplies neither a new comparison of alternatives nor numerical weights. The archive writes močnosť kontinuuma and the available text močnost kontinuuma. The well-ordering and ordering of elements in the argument do not by themselves supply a finite algorithm for listing such an entire basis. The term names a theoretical cardinality, not a practical enumeration procedure.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Močnost v etyh pasusah označa kardinalnost. Citacije Steinitza i upotrěba baz svězujut formulaciju s točnym argumentom, ne s fyzičnoju ili algebraičnoju potencijeju.

Textual comparison: Močnost in these passages means cardinality. The Steinitz citations and use of bases link the wording to a particular argument, not to physical or algebraic powers.

prirodne iracionalnosti prinadležeče grupě

Iztočnik / Source: natürliche zur Gruppe gehörige Irrationalitäten

Rusky / Russian: естественные иррациональности, принадлежащие группе

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: природні ірраціональності, що належать групі

Razlog: Prirodne iracionalnosti prinaležeče grupě čuva historičny izraz, za ktory rabota 11 davaje posebno oprěděljenje. Arhiv piše prinadležeče; dostupny tekst ima prinaležeče. Izraz ne znači libovoljne generatori. V §1, č. 2 parametry zaměnjajut se racionalnymi funkcijami korenj smotrenyh kako neoprěděljene; te funkcije morajut byti algebraično nezavisne, a polinom nad nastaly poljem mora iměti ukazanu grupu. To, že funkcije sut racionalne v korenjah, ne protivrěči historičnomu nazvanju iracionalnosti: važno jest, po odnošenju k ktoromu polju se govori. Sravnjajeme ruska i ukrajinska fraza zachovajut isto povezanje s grupoj. Razlog vernosti definiciji jest silnějši od želanja zaměniti izraz modernym kratkym terminom. Avtor izrično postavlja silnějše požadanje i potom dostatočne uslovja, ne obče potrěbnu karakterizaciju.

Reason: Prirodne iracionalnosti prinaležeče grupě preserves a historical expression given a specific definition in Paper 11. The archive writes prinadležeče; the available text has prinaležeče. It does not mean arbitrary generators. In §1, item 2, the parameters are replaced by rational functions of roots treated as indeterminates; these functions must be algebraically independent, and the polynomial over the resulting field must have the specified group. Rationality in the roots does not contradict the historical name irrationalities: the reference field matters. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda preserve the same relation to the group. Fidelity to the definition takes precedence over replacing it with a shorter modern term. The author expressly imposes a stronger requirement and obtains sufficient conditions, not a universally necessary characterization.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prirodne iracionalnosti sut definovane točnymi uslovjami na parametry, funkcije korenj i grupu. Dostatočnost uslovij ne směje stati potrěbnostju v prěvodu.

Textual comparison: Natural irrationalities are defined through exact conditions on parameters, root functions, and the group. Sufficiency of the conditions must not become necessity in translation.

dodatno uslovje

Iztočnik / Source: Nebenbedingung

Rusky / Russian: дополнительное условие

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: додаткова умова

Razlog: Dodatno uslovje prědava Nebenbedingung bez doslovnogo obraza bočnogo uslovja. Arhivny razlog vključaje i kontinuitet: v rabotě 9 to jest uslovje konstrukcije racionalnoj bazy, ne novy nazov za hipotezu. Ruska i ukrajinska fraza takože zachovajut značenje dodatnogo uslovja. Po §6 oblast \([\Theta]\), vyvedena iz bazy, ne směje sodrživati algebraično-drobnogo čisla. Dodatno zato ne znači dobrovoljno. V §10 avtor razděljuje karakteristiku nula i karakteristiku \(p\); v drugom slučaju uslovje otpadaje iz navedenogo svojstva prvotnogo polja. Ne trěba prěnesti to izključenje na slučaj karakteristiki nula. Izbor jest kvalitativny: jasnost uslovja i jeho svez s ranějšim oprěděljenjem imajut prědnost prěd doslovnym kopirovanjem německoj struktury.

Reason: Dodatno uslovje renders Nebenbedingung without the literal image of a side condition. The recorded reason also concerns continuity: in Paper 9 it is a condition on the construction of a rational basis, not a new synonym for hypothesis. The Russian and Ukrainian phrases likewise retain the additional-condition sense. In §6 the domain \([\Theta]\) generated from the basis must contain no algebraically fractional number. Additional therefore does not mean optional. In §10 the author distinguishes characteristic zero from characteristic \(p\); in the latter case the condition falls away because of the stated property of the prime field. That exception must not be transferred to characteristic zero. The choice is qualitative: clarity of the condition and its connection to the earlier definition outweigh literal reproduction of the German structure.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uslovje izključaje algebraično-drobne čisla iz vyvedenej oblasti. Njegovo otpadenje v karakteristikě \(p\) jest odvojeno od slučaja karakteristiki nula.

Textual comparison: The condition excludes algebraically fractional numbers from the generated domain. Its disappearance in characteristic \(p\) is distinguished from characteristic zero.

imenovatelj

Iztočnik / Source: Nenner

Rusky / Russian: знаменатель

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: знаменник

Razlog: Imenovatelj označa imenovatelj racionalnogo izraza, ne nazov ili indeks. Arhivny razlog jest vezany k točnomu dokazu v rabotě 10, §3. Pri zaměně bazovyh veličin jih obrazami muset se zachovati i relacije \(H=0\), i uslovja \(H\ne0\). Druge potrěbovanje postoji zato, že polinom može nastupati v imenovatelju: nule ne smějut nastati tam, kde dolžen ostati oprěděljen količnik. Rusko znamenatelj i ukrajinsky znamennyk sut sravnjajeme nazvy iste funkcije; sam zapis ne dokazuje, že imenovatelj jest jedin možny vseslovjansky izbor. Formula s čisliteljem i imenovateljem pokazuje, začto kratky nazov potrěbuje točno uslovje nenulovosti. Zaměna frazoj vse funkcije sut nenulove byla by nepravdiva: govori se o zachovanju togo, bylo li dano značenje nula ili ne.

Reason: Imenovatelj denotes the denominator of a rational expression, not a name or an index. The recorded reason concerns a precise step in Paper 10, §3. Replacing basis quantities by their images must preserve both relations \(H=0\) and conditions \(H\ne0\). The latter requirement matters because a polynomial may occur as a denominator: a zero must not appear where the quotient needs to remain defined. Russian znamenatelʹ and Ukrainian znamennyk name the same function; the record alone does not establish imenovatelj as the only possible pan-Slavic choice. The numerator-denominator formula shows why the short term requires the exact nonzero condition. Replacing the statement by all functions are nonzero would be wrong: what is preserved is whether the given value is zero or not.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tekst potrěbuje zachovanje nulovyh i nenulovyh relacij. Nenulovost imenovatelja čuva oprěděljenost racionalnogo izraza.

Textual comparison: The text requires preservation of both zero and nonzero relations. Nonvanishing of the denominator preserves the definedness of the rational expression.

ne jest zatvorjena vzhodno k tvorenju pr?s?kov

Iztočnik / Source: nicht abgeschlossen gegen?ber Durchschnittsbildung

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Arhivny zapis ne zachoval vse bukvy: znaky pytanja v pr?s?kov i cělo poškodžene ruska i ukrajinska polja ne dovoljut obnoviti izvorne formy bez dodatnogo iztočnika. Dostupny tekst raboty 9, §5 odvojeno potvrđuje frazu ne jest zatvorjena po odnošenju k tvorenju prěsěkov. To jest tekstovy dokaz za tekuču formulaciju, ne obnova vseh arhivnyh bukv. Smysl jest algebraična zamknjenost klasa pri operaciji: prěsěk vsih oblastij iz \(\mathfrak M(\mathfrak G)\) jest \([H]\), a \([H]\) sam ne naleži tomu klasu. Arhivny razlog požadaje jasnost togo strukturnogo zaključka. Ne ide o topologičnu zamknjenost; iz navedenogo prěsěka vsih členov ne trěba bez daljšego dokaza zaključiti nezamknjenost pri prěsěku dvou členov.

Reason: The archival record does not preserve all lettering: question marks in pr?s?kov and wholly damaged Russian and Ukrainian fields prevent certain recovery of the original forms. The available text of Paper 9, §5 separately attests ne jest zatvorjena po odnošenju k tvorenju prěsěkov. This is evidence for the current wording, not recovery of all archival letters. The meaning is algebraic closure of a class under an operation: the intersection of all domains in \(\mathfrak M(\mathfrak G)\) is \([H]\), which is not itself a member of that class. The recorded reason calls for an explicit statement of this structural conclusion. Topological closedness is not meant; the stated intersection of all members does not by itself establish failure of closure under binary intersections.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prěsěk vsih členov klasa jest \([H]\), ktory ne jest členom togo klasa. To jest izričny tekstovy základ za čtenje poškodženogo arhivnogo izraza, ne obnova jeho izgubljenyh bukv.

Textual comparison: The intersection of all class members is \([H]\), which is not itself a member. This supplies explicit textual context for reading the damaged archival phrase, not recovery of its lost lettering.

ne izčezaje identično / identično izčezaje

Iztočnik / Source: nicht identisch verschwinden / identisch verschwinden

Rusky / Russian: не обращается тождественно в нуль / тождественно обращается в нуль

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: не зникає тотожно / тотожно зникає

Razlog: Identično izčezati znači byti nulovym polinomom v ukazanyh neoprěděljenyh, ne izčezati samo pri jednoj izbranoj cěnnosti. Po substituciji koeficientov rabota 20 ispytuje identično izčezanje formy reducibilnosti v ostalyh neoprěděljenyh. Ne izčezati identično zato ne znači nikogda ne byti nula. Arhivny razlog prědava rusku razširjenu frazu obračati se v nulj i kratše ukrajinsko i medžuslovjansko izčezati kako odgovarjajuče izrazy za isto svojstvo. Matematična točnost ima prědnost prěd doslovnym izravnanjem glagolov. Potrěbno jest zachovati takože prědpoloženje, že specializacija ne snižaje stepen polinoma; bez njega iskazana ekvivalencija razložimosti i izčezanja ne jest ta sama. Zapis ne daje čislove vahy ni dokaz čitateljskoj razumlivosti.

Reason: To vanish identically means to be the zero polynomial in the specified indeterminates, not merely to vanish at one selected value. After coefficient substitution, Paper 20 tests whether the reducibility form vanishes identically in the remaining indeterminates. Not vanishing identically therefore does not mean never being zero. The recorded reason treats the expanded Russian turn into zero wording and the shorter Ukrainian and Interslavic vanish wording as expressions of the same property. Mathematical precision takes precedence over matching the verbs literally. The condition that specialization does not lower the polynomial’s degree must also be retained; without it the stated equivalence between reducibility and vanishing is not the same assertion. The record supplies neither numerical weights nor evidence from reader testing.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Forma reducibilnosti ispytuje se po koeficientnoj substituciji. V glavnom tvrđenju ostavaje uslovje nesniženja stepena.

Textual comparison: The reducibility form is tested after coefficient substitution. The main assertion retains the condition that the degree does not drop.

ne nužno celočislene funkcije

Iztočnik / Source: nicht notwendig ganzzahlige Funktionen

Rusky / Russian: не обязательно целочисленные функции

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: не обов’язково цілочисельні функції

Razlog: Ne nužno celočislene funkcije zachovaje obseg negacije v německom nicht notwendig: uslovje cěločislennosti ne jest potrěbno, ale něktore dopustime funkcije mogut jego izpolnjati. Prěvod necěločislene funkcije by naprotiv izključil te slučaji. Rusky i ukrajinsky ekvivalent takože izrično neguje potrěbnost. V koncu §3 raboty 9 dostupny tekst piše ne potrěbno cěločislene. Sravnjenje s ranějšeju primětkoju o cělyh algebraičnyh funkcijah pokazyvaje, že ide o koeficientne uslovja v algebraičnom kontekstě. Cěločisleny tu ne možno bez objasnjenja čitati kako prijmajuči samo cěle čislove cěnnosti; takože algebraično cěly ne jest synonym racionalnogo cělogo čisla. Razlog izbora jest zachovati razširjenje dopustimoj klasy i razlikovati njegove uslovja, ne samo prěvesti jedino prislovje.

Reason: Ne nužno celočislene funkcije preserves the scope of negation in German nicht notwendig: the integer-coefficient condition is not required, although some permitted functions may satisfy it. Rendering it as non-integer-coefficient functions would instead exclude those cases. The Russian and Ukrainian equivalents likewise negate necessity explicitly. At the end of §3 of Paper 9 the available text reads ne potrěbno cěločislene. Comparison with the earlier footnote on integral algebraic functions shows that coefficient conditions in an algebraic setting are at issue. Cěločisleny must not be read without explanation as integer-valued; nor is algebraically integral synonymous with rational integer. The reason for the choice is to preserve the enlargement of the allowed class and distinguish its conditions, not merely to translate an adverb.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Ranějša primětka oprědělja koeficientno uslovje; pozdnějši odstavec jego oslabjaje, ne neguje cělost vsih dopustimyh funkcij.

Textual comparison: The earlier footnote defines the coefficient condition; the later paragraph relaxes it rather than denying integrality of all permitted functions.

ne jest popolno reducibilno prvogo roda

Iztočnik / Source: nicht vollständig reduzibel erster Art

Rusky / Russian: не является вполне приводимым первого рода

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: не є цілком редуцибельним першого роду

Razlog: Popolno reducibilny prvogo roda jest sostavny historičny termin. Arhivny izbor reducibil- měl zachovati ranějšu terminologičnu familiju i ne sugerovati moderny pojem redukovanogo prstena. Negacija se odnosi k cělomu svojstvu, uključajuči prvogo roda. V rabotě 31, §§7-8 ono nastupaje pri prstenu klasov ostatkov i izčezanju diskriminanta. §6 davaje kontrolu smysla: poslě ukazanogo razširjenja koeficientnogo polja nerazložime komponenty morajut byti poljami izomorfnymi algebraično zatvorjenomu polju. Dostupny tekst ne jest terminologično jednorodny: §6 piše polna razložimost, a pozdnějše města polno reducibilno. Ta dva stemna rěšenja ne smějut byti smolčana kako už provedena standardizacija. Ruska i ukrajinska fraza takože čuvajut ograničenje prvogo roda; ne jestdna kratka zaměna redukovany ne davaje vse to značenje.

Reason: Popolno reducibilny prvogo roda is a compound historical term. The recorded choice of reducibil- was intended to preserve an earlier terminological family without suggesting the modern notion of a reduced ring. The negation applies to the whole property, including of the first kind. In Paper 31, §§7-8 it concerns a residue-class ring and the vanishing of its discriminant. Section 6 controls the meaning: after the specified extension of the coefficient field, the indecomposable components must be fields isomorphic to the algebraically closed field. The available text is not terminologically uniform: §6 has polna razložimost, whereas later passages use polno reducibilno. These two stem choices must not be represented as an already accomplished standardization. To ne znači, že vsaka neizolovana komponenta mora byti mnogoznačna: priměry v §11 izrično dopuščajut jednoznačnost i tutyh komponent. The recorded reason preserves the quoted form rather than silently modernizing it to embedded or presenting it as a new Interslavic word. In the available text the expression occurs in the footnote to Theorem XIII of Paper 19, §7; archival unit labels are not by themselves exact section headings. The theorem locates possible ambiguity in the non-isolated components, while isolated components are uniquely determined. V rabotě 9, §§8-9 ili v toj frazě davaje druge nazvanje istogo odnosa, ne slabu alternativu medžu neizomorfijoju i obyčnoju neravnostju množstv. Različne zapisy ili različne elementy ješče ne dokazyvajut neizomorfiju. Dokaz sravnjaje algebraične svojstva oblastij s različnymi indeksami; zato zaključek opisuje različne klasy po izomorfiji. Slědujuča primětka ješče različa izomorfiju cělyh oblastij od izomorfije s čestju drugoj oblasti: vsaka iz dvou neizomorfnyh oblastij može byti izomorfna česti drugoj. Arhivny razlog jest kontinuitet togo pojma, ne nova empirčna ocěnka razumlivosti slova suštno.

Reason: Neizomorfne ili suštno različne links a formal term to the explanatory name used in the preceding section. The available text writes sučstveno različne. In Paper 9, §§8-9, ili in this phrase supplies another name for the same relation, not a weaker alternative between non-isomorphism and ordinary inequality of sets. Different descriptions or different elements do not alone establish non-isomorphism. The proof compares algebraic properties of domains with different indices, so its conclusion concerns distinct isomorphism classes. The following note further distinguishes isomorphism of the whole domains from isomorphism with part of the other domain: each of two non-isomorphic domains may be isomorphic to part of the other. The recorded reason is continuity of this concept, not a new empirical assessment of the intelligibility of suštno.

Arhivny razlog jest, že ne možno tiho prěnesti komutativne prědpoloženja v nekomutativny kontekst. The recorded reason is that commutative assumptions must not be silently imported into a noncommutative setting. In §9 of Paper 19 the definition omits the commutative law of multiplication; this does not mean that every two elements must fail to commute. Oblast alone does not establish the absence of zero divisors. In §12 the example is the domain of integer matrices, with one-sided ideals and two-sided ideals as a special case. This record supplies no numerical weights for kolco against prsten. Choice of noun stem and grammatical gender agreement must be distinguished from the mathematical property; noncommutativity must obscure neither sidedness of ideals nor other explicit hypotheses.

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: нераціональна інволюція

Razlog: Neracionalna involucija čuva termin geometričnogo argumenta, ne obyčno značenje nerazumnosti. Arhivna motivacija odsyla k Enriquesovomu priměru, ktory Noether navodi v §6 raboty 6. V tom kontekstě minimalna baza polja \(\mathfrak{K}_{n\rho}\) imaje \(\rho\) algebraično nezavisnyh racionalnyh generatorov; citovany priměr daje polje \(\mathfrak{K}_{33}\) bez takoj bazy. Odgovarjajuče ruska i ukrajinska forma zachovajut internacionalny korenj racional-. Ne jest korektno zaměniti historičnu geometričnu involuciju bez dodatnogo objasnjenja prostym modernym opisom funkcija, čije dvojno priměnjenje jest identičnost: tuto město svęzuje involuciju s poljem funkcij i jego racionalnostju. Takože priměr ne govori, že vsako polje ranga tri ne imaje minimalnoj bazy. Zapis dokumentuje upotrěbu i citaciju v Noetherovom tekstě, ne nezavisnu prověrku Enriquesovogo dokaza.

Reason: Neracionalna involucija preserves the term in the geometric argument, not the everyday sense of irrational judgment. The archived motivation points to the example by Enriques cited in §6 of Paper 6. Here a minimal basis of \(\mathfrak{K}_{n\rho}\) has \(\rho\) algebraically independent rational generators; the cited example supplies a field \(\mathfrak{K}_{33}\) without such a basis. The corresponding Russian and Ukrainian forms retain the international racional- root. It would be inappropriate to replace the historical geometric involution, without further explanation, by the simple modern description of a function whose square is the identity: this passage connects involution with a function field and its rationality. Nor does the example say that every field of rank three lacks a minimal basis. The record documents usage and citation in Noether’s text, not an independent verification of Enriques’s proof.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Noether svęzuje Enriquesov priměr s poljem bez minimalnoj bazy. Opis jest ograničeny tym priměrom, ne vsimi poljami istogo ranga.

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: неіснування явного подання

V §3 teorema II ješče razlikuje prědstavjenje bez substitucije (11). Zaključna negacija ograničena jest razgledanymi identičnostjami i uslovjem, že medžu redami prěměnnyh ne jest red \(x\) ili \(u\). Ne možno zato prěvesti frazu kako ne obstaje nikako prědstavjenje. Rusky javny i ukrajinsky javny izraz sut v arhivu sravnjajemi s internacionalnym eksplicitny; razlog medžuslovjanskogo izbora jest kontinuitet definicije. Reason: Neobstajanje eksplicitnogo prědstavjenja asserts nonexistence of a precisely defined kind of representation, not failure to find a formula. The archival record connects the term to §2 of Paper 4: explicit representation uses whole symbol rows, or rows uniquely derived from them, rather than their decomposed constituent rows. In §3 Theorem II further distinguishes representation without substitution (11). The concluding negative statement is restricted to the identities considered and the condition that no variable row is an \(x\) or \(u\) row. It therefore cannot be rendered as no representation exists. The archive compares the Russian and Ukrainian explicit wordings with international eksplicitny; continuity of the definition is the stated reason for the Interslavic choice. The available text writes prědstavjenje where the archive has predstavjenje.

Rusky / Russian: нецелый элемент

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: нецілий елемент

Razlog: Necěly element potrěbuje ukazanje osnovnogo prstena i smysla cělosti. Arhivna motivacija kaže, že izraz prodolžaje familiju cěly iz §1 raboty 30. Tam cělost po odnošenju k \(R\) jest oprěděljena konečnostju vyvedenogo poredka i ekvivalentno moničnym polinomnym uravnenjem s koeficientami v \(R\). Ale §9, č. 7 dokazyvaje samu integralnu zamknjenost. Početkovo necěly v tom dokazu mora označati element izvan osnovnogo prstena, dlja ktorogo se potom izključa cělost po odnošenju k němu; inače by zaključek byl už prědpoloženy. Tuto čtenje podpiraje uvod raboty, govoreči o pravo drobnom elementu. Kvocient \(a/c\) s nepodělimymi stepenjami čislitelja služi k proturěčju s moničnym uravnenjem. Bez prověrky německogo města ne trěba proglasiti razliku slov izvornoju pogrěškoju; slovnik mora jasno razděljati dva smysla, ne směšati jih s necělym racionalnym čislom.

Reason: Necěly element requires the base ring and the relevant sense of integrality to be specified. The archival motivation says that it continues the cěly family from §1 of Paper 30. There, integrality over \(R\) is defined by finiteness of the generated order and equivalently by a monic polynomial equation with coefficients in \(R\). But §9, item 7 is proving integral closedness itself. At the beginning of that argument necěly must refer to an element outside the base ring, for which integrality over that ring is then excluded; otherwise the conclusion would already be assumed. The introduction supports this reading by referring to a properly fractional element. A quotient \(a/c\) whose numerator powers are not divisible by the denominator supplies the contradiction with a monic equation. Without checking the German passage, the wording difference should not be declared an original error; the dictionary must distinguish these two senses rather than conflate them with a non-integer rational number.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §1 oprědělja cělost po odnošenju k \(R\). Uvod i dokaz aksioma V razlikujut pravo drobny element od možno cělogo elementa nad \(R\); prěvod dolžen čuvati to razlikovanje, da ne prědpoloži zaključek.

Textual comparison: Section 1 defines integrality over \(R\). The introduction and proof of axiom V distinguish a properly fractional element from possible integrality over \(R\); the translation must preserve that distinction rather than assume the conclusion.

Razlog: Nekomutativne oblasti jest šire nazvanje algebraičnyh oblastij prěd oprěděljenjem konkretnoj polinomnoj oblasti \(J\) v rabotě 17. To jest izričny arhivny razlog za oblast, sravnjajemu s ruskym i ukrajinskym oblastj. Slovo samo ne ustanovjaje vse aksiomy. V §2 koeficientno polje jest komutativno; nekomutativnost može nastati v množenju neizvěstnyh s koeficientami. Tek te zakony podpirajut zaključek, že produkt dvou nenulovyh polinomov ne jest nula. Ne trěba ni prěložiti vse te prědpoloženja v samo slovo oblast, ni prenesti vse teoremy na libovoljny nekomutativny prsten. In §2 the coefficient field is commutative; noncommutativity can arise when indeterminates multiply coefficients. Later assumptions concern mutual commutativity of the indeterminates and a special multiplication law yielding additivity of degree. Those laws support the conclusion that a product of two nonzero polynomials is nonzero. The translator should neither pack all these assumptions into oblast itself nor extend every theorem to an arbitrary noncommutative ring. This is a connection between terminology and the exact scope of a definition, not a universal unification of historical uses of Bereich.

This explains what embedding must convey: an isomorphic realization inside a larger structure. Elsewhere in the corpus the same stem can denote substitution of values into a formula. The policy must preserve the different algebraic objects, not mechanically replace every occurrence of Körper by tělo, including passages about commutative fields.

Razlog: Nekomutativno tělo jest jednična forma togo samogo izbora kako nekomutativne těla. Dva arhivne zapisy svęzujut ju s občimi razpadnymi poljami i redukcijnym teoremom raboty 32. Dostupny tekst različa tělo \(A\) od prstena \(A_r\) vseh matric reda \(r\) nad \(A\). Za \(r>1\) ne vsaka nenulova matrica jest obratima, tako že pridruženo tělo ne jest drugo nazvanje cělogo matričnogo prstena. Their reason is the precise distinction between a division ring and a commutative field; the description of tělo as the clearest pan-Slavic calque remains editorial judgment, not a measured result. The available text distinguishes the division ring \(A\) from the ring \(A_r\) of all matrices of order \(r\) over \(A\). For \(r>1\) not every nonzero matrix is invertible, so associated division ring is not another name for the entire matrix ring. A common term should retain its sense across cases and numbers without concealing this structural distinction.

Rusky / Russian: нелинейные тождественные соотношения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: нелінійні тотожні співвідношення

Razlog: Nelinearne identične relacije označajut identičnosti medžu komponentami, ne tvrđenje, že te komponenty sut identične jedna drugoj. Arhivny razlog prědpočita terminologiju relacije i identičnosti bez dodavanja statusa samostojnoj teoremy. V §1 raboty 4 relacije medžu elementami \(p_\rho\) omogućajut normovati symbole \(S^\rho\) tako, da oni izpolnjajut te same identičnosti kako determinanty ukazanoj matrice. Nelinearny opisuje formu tyh relacij; on ne neguje vse linearne transformacijske zakony, prisutne v istom razvažanju. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože sodrživajut termin za identičnost. Za razuměnje potrěbno jest čitati te slova vměstě: relacija, ktora drži identično, ne prosto podobnost ili jednako imenovanje objektov.

Reason: Nelinearne identične relacije denotes identities among components, not a claim that the components are identical to one another. The recorded reason favors the terminology of relation and identity without assigning an additional theorem-level status. In §1 of Paper 4, relations among the elements \(p_\rho\) permit normalization of the symbols \(S^\rho\) so that they satisfy the same identities as determinants of the specified matrix. Nonlinear describes these relations; it does not negate all the linear transformation laws used in the argument. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda likewise express identity. The words must be read together: a relation that holds identically, not merely resemblance or giving objects the same name.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Relacije ogrančivajut komponenty i podpirajut normalizaciju simbolov; ne poistovětjajut vse komponenty.

Textual comparison: The relations constrain components and support normalization of symbols; they do not identify all components with one another.

Iztočnik / Source: nichtmeßbare Funktionen

Rusky / Russian: неизмеримые функции

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: невимірні функції

Razlog: Neměrime funkcije upotrěbjajut měrimost v smyslu teorije měry, ne kako opis veličin, ktore nikto ješče ne izměril. To razlikovanje jest cěly izričny razlog arhivnogo izbora. V §4 raboty 10 podčrtna primětka pripisuje Lebesgue rezultat o neměrimosti realnoj i imaginarnoj česti funkcije dvou realnyh prěmennyh. Avtor osobno upozornjaje, že iz samoj toj neměrimosti ješče ne slěduje ekstremna diskontinuirnost v kompleksnoj oblasti. Ta poslědnja vlastnost znači možnost približiti libovoljnu zadanu cěnnost slikami toček v vsakoj okolině. Zato neměrimy, diskontinuirny i ekstremno diskontinuirny ne sut tri zaměnljive etikety. Tut prověrena jest formulacija dostupnogo korpusa, ne nezavisny prěgled Lebesgueovoj citovanoj raboty.

Reason: Neměrime funkcije uses measurability in the sense of measure theory, not quantities nobody has yet measured. This distinction is the entire explicit reason preserved for the choice. In §4 of Paper 10 a footnote attributes to Lebesgue the nonmeasurability of the real and imaginary parts as functions of two real variables. The author expressly warns that this alone does not imply extreme discontinuity in the complex domain. That latter property means being able to approximate any prescribed value by images of points in every neighborhood. Nonmeasurable, discontinuous, and extremely discontinuous are therefore not interchangeable labels. The evidence checked here is the wording of the available corpus, not an independent examination of Lebesgue’s cited work.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Avtorova definicija i podčrtna primětka odděljajut dvě svojstva, ktore ne možno spojiti v jednu etiketu.

Textual comparison: The author’s definition and footnote distinguish two properties that cannot be merged into a single label.

Arhiv prědpočita internacionalnu osnovu eksponent, dokolě ruska i ukrajinska paralela uživajut pokazatel odnosno pokaznyk; to jest kvalitativny izbor, ne čislovy rezultat sravnjanja. V polinomnoj relaciji (6) iz §2 raboty 6 eksponenty \(\sigma_k\) sut nenegativne cěle čisla, i prinajmenje jeden mora byti nula. Zaměna s pozitivne zato ne prosto skrati stil: ona izključi slučaj, ktory tekst izrično zahtěvaje. Padežna forma nenegativnyh eksponentov v rečenju i nominativna slovarna forma označajut isti pojem. Tut ne postoji novo prědpoloženje o libovoljnyh realnyh eksponentah.

Reason: Nenegativne eksponenty preserves the difference between numbers greater than zero and numbers greater than or equal to zero. The archive favors the international stem eksponent, whereas its Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use pokazatelʹ and pokaznyk; this is a qualitative choice, not a numerical comparison result. In polynomial relation (6) of Paper 6, §2, the exponents \(\sigma_k\) are nonnegative integers and at least one must be zero. Substituting positive would therefore not merely shorten the style: it would exclude a case expressly required by the text. The inflected nenegativnyh eksponentov in the sentence and the dictionary’s nominative form designate the same concept. No new assumption about arbitrary real exponents is involved.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Relacija i slědujuče uslovje zahtěvajut prinajmenje jeden nulovy eksponent.

Textual comparison: The relation and its following condition require at least one zero exponent.

neprimarny

Iztočnik / Source: nichtprimär

Rusky / Russian: непримарный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: непримарний

Razlog: Neprimarny jest neposrědna negacija primarny. Arhivny razlog čuva vidlivu opoziciju v dokazě teoremy VI raboty 19, bez tvorjenja drugogo žargonnogo nazvanja. Primarny tu ne znači prosty: definicija govori o produktu \(ab\) i o stepenah faktora. Ako ideal ne jest primarny, tekst izbira \(ab\) v idealu, ale \(a\) izvan njega i vse pozitivne stepeny \(b\) izvan njega. Teorema svęzuje neprimarnost s razložimostju; ona ne ustanovjaje ekvivalenciju primarnosti i nerazložimosti. Podčrtna primětka davaje primarny, ale razložimy ideal \((x^2,xy,y^\lambda)\) pri \(\lambda\ge2\). To jest važna ograda za prěvod negacije: slovarna blizkost ne směje obračati směr logičnogo zaključka.

Reason: Neprimarny directly negates primarny. The recorded reason preserves the visible opposition in the proof of Theorem VI of Paper 19 without inventing a separate technical label. Primary does not mean prime here: the definition concerns a product \(ab\) and powers of a factor. For a nonprimary ideal the text chooses \(ab\) inside it, but \(a\) outside it and every positive power of \(b\) outside it. The theorem connects nonprimaryness with reducibility; it does not establish equivalence between primaryness and irreducibility. Its footnote gives the primary but reducible ideal \((x^2,xy,y^\lambda)\) for \(\lambda\ge2\). This is an important safeguard in translating negation: lexical proximity must not reverse the direction of the implication.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabotě 19 prinaleži izričny protivpriměr k obratu; rabota 30 objasnjaje, pod kojim prědpoloženjem slaba i silna primarnost sovpadajut.

Textual comparison: Paper 19 supplies an explicit counterexample to the converse; Paper 30 explains the hypothesis under which weak and strong primaryness coincide.

To ne jest odstranjenje nepotrěbnyh pridavnikov povsudu: bez togo uslovja tekst davaje priměr, kde oni ne sovpadajut. Slaba forma govori o stepenah elementov-děliteljev nuly, silna o stepenah idealov-děliteljev nuly. V §6 uslovje cěpov děliteljev ostava prědpoloženjem teoremy o nerazložimyh idealah. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela v tom zapisě imajut drugu osnovu za primarnost než paralely k rabotě 19; kontinuitet medžuslovjanskogo termina zato jest svesna leksična odluka, ne bukvalno kopiranje vseh paralel.

Reason: The pair neprimarny / primarny continues the terminology of §5 of Paper 30. The record expressly justifies the shorter primary by the coincidence of weak and strong primaryness under axiom I. This is not permission to remove the qualifiers everywhere: without that hypothesis the text gives a counterexample to their coincidence. The weak form concerns powers of zero-divisor elements, the strong form powers of zero-divisor ideals. In §6 the divisor-chain condition remains a hypothesis of the theorem about irreducible ideals. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda in this record use a different stem for primaryness from those for Paper 19; continuity of the Interslavic term is thus a deliberate lexical decision, not literal copying of every parallel.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabotě 19 prinaleži izričny protivpriměr k obratu; rabota 30 objasnjaje, pod kojim prědpoloženjem slaba i silna primarnost sovpadajut.

Textual comparison: Paper 19 supplies an explicit counterexample to the converse; Paper 30 explains the hypothesis under which weak and strong primaryness coincide.

neregularne sistemy

Iztočnik / Source: nichtreguläre Systeme

Rusky / Russian: нерегулярные системы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: нерегулярні системи

Razlog: Neregularne sistemy jest negacija definiranoj regularnosti, ne ocěnka, že sistemy sut neobyčne ili loše uredžene. Arhivny razlog jest kontrast potrěbny za Hilbertov protivpriměr i slědujuči paragraf raboty 6. Definicija VIII svęzuje regularnost s nenulovym rezultantom členov najvyššej dimenzije v ukazanoj oblasti. Teorema IX davaje integralnu bazu za regularny sistem; podčrtna primětka pokazuje, že obstojat neregularne sistemy bez takoj bazy. Ona ne tvrdi, že nijeden neregularny sistem ne ima bazu. Prikazany sistem \(x_1,x_1x_2,x_1x_2^2,\ldots\) ne može byti generovany konečnym početkom toga rěda kako polinomnymi kombinacijami. Zato integralna baza tu dolžna byti čitana v avtorovom kontekstě, ne avtomatično kako baza cělyh čisel čislovogo polja.

Reason: Neregularne sistemy negates a defined regularity condition; it does not describe systems as unusual or badly arranged. The recorded reason is the contrast needed for Hilbert’s counterexample and the next section of Paper 6. Definition VIII ties regularity to a nonzero resultant of highest-degree terms in the specified domain. Theorem IX supplies an integral basis for a regular system; the footnote shows that some nonregular systems have no such basis. It does not assert that no nonregular system can have a basis. The displayed system \(x_1,x_1x_2,x_1x_2^2,\ldots\) cannot be generated polynomially by a finite initial segment of this sequence. Integral basis must therefore be read in the author’s context, not automatically as an integral basis of a number field.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija regularnosti, teorema i protivpriměr imajut različne logične funkcii. Protivpriměr dokazyvaje obstojanje, ne tvrđenje o vseh neregularnyh sistemah.

Textual comparison: The definition of regularity, theorem, and counterexample have different logical functions. The counterexample proves existence, not a statement about all nonregular systems.

Iztočnik / Source: Nichtverschwinden der Diskriminante

Rusky / Russian: ненулевость дискриминанта

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ненульовість дискримінанта

Razlog: Nenulovost diskriminanta zaměnjaje dolgu frazu diskriminant ne jest nula kratkym imennym nazvanjem svojstva. To jest zapisany stilističny razlog, podpirany ruskoju i ukrajinskoju paralelami, ne zahtěvanje, aby vsaka polna rečenija byla skračena. V §6 raboty 31 svojstvo jest uslovje teoremy o polnoj razložimosti prvogo roda. Diskriminant jest oprěděljen do ukazanogo nenulovogo faktora, a njegova nenulovost od izbora ne zavisi. Nenulovy ne znači pozitivny. Isto tako, ekvivalencija s jediničnym diskriminantnym idealom v danoj teoremě zavisi od koeficientnogo polja; nad libovoljnym prstenom nenulovy element ne mora byti jedinica. Kratkost termina ne směje izgubiti ty uslovja.

Reason: Nenulovost diskriminanta replaces the longer phrase the discriminant is not zero by a compact nominal designation of the property. That is the recorded stylistic reason, supported by the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda, not a prohibition on the full sentence when it is clearer. In §6 of Paper 31 the property is the criterion in the theorem on complete reducibility of the first kind. The discriminant is determined up to the specified nonzero factor, while its nonvanishing is independent of that choice. Nonzero does not mean positive. Likewise, equivalence with the discriminant ideal being the unit ideal in that theorem depends on the coefficient field; over an arbitrary ring a nonzero element need not be a unit. The compact term must not erase these hypotheses.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Slovesno nazvanje uslovja odgovarja točnoj teoremě s koeficientnym poljem i konečnym rangom.

Textual comparison: The verbal name of the criterion corresponds to the precise theorem with a coefficient field and finite rank.

The archive favors the broadly Slavic stems nižši and ręd, compared with the Russian and Ukrainian expressions, over a specifically national construction. It supplies neither a numerical intelligibility score nor a named rejected alternative. In §14 of Paper 2 the phrase instructs replacement of \(j\) or \(A\) by lower forms of the relevant series in constructing a reducent; it refers to the earlier construction of that series, not to formulas lower on the page. Lower alone therefore does not determine the parameter by which the forms are ordered. Podčrtna primětka raboty 17 govori o děliteljah nižšej mnogovidnosti i o izključenju, kogda mnogovidnost jest nula. Tu smysl svęzan jest s dimenzijeju v algebraičnom razvažanju; samo slovo ne uvodi gladku ili topologičnu mnogovidnost v modernom smyslu. Bukvalnost čuva vidlivu historičnu terminologiju, ale možna nejasnost ostava predmetom stručnogo razsmotrenja. Reason: The archival ni??a mnogovidnost is damaged; the available translation reads nižšej mnogovidnosti. The record explains the literal stem mnogovidnost as a way to preserve the historical contrast between the author’s prime module and commutative usage of that name. The footnote in Paper 17 concerns divisors of lower Mannigfaltigkeit and the exception when it is zero. The sense is dimensional within an algebraic argument; the word alone introduces neither a smooth nor a topological manifold in the modern sense. Literalness keeps the historical terminology visible, but possible ambiguity remains a subject for expert examination. It does not license identifying the author’s prime module with every later definition of a prime ideal.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Podčrtna primětka izrično različa dva upotrěbjenja prostogo modula; sam termin ne dovoljaje utočniti modernu geometričnu kategoriju.

This distinction between degree and order is the express archival reason, with Russian stepenʹ and Ukrainian stepinʹ as comparanda. In §23 of Paper 2 the author’s footnote explains \(\equiv\): products of forms of lower degree have been omitted. The displayed formulas must therefore not be read as ordinary exact equalities with those products simply absent. Terminology and notation carry the same information: the reduction calculation preserves the relevant equivalence, not a claim that the omitted products are zero. Both the phrase and the author’s explanation of the sign must remain; the symbol \(\equiv\) alone does not imply an integer modulus.
