Razlog: Najbližši vyši modul čuva poredok korakov konstrukcije v rabotě 2, §7. Arhivny razlog pomina hierarhiju modulov; ruska i ukrajinska paralela jasno vyražajut slědujuči vyši korak. Važno jest istorijsko značenje slova modul. V toj rabotě ono služi pri relativnoj polnotě sistema form: dopušče se ostatny izrazy, dobyvane kontrakcijami so sistemom modula. To ne jest samo današnji abstraktny modul s višim rangom. §7 prěhodi od modula k nazvanomu vyšemu modulu i potom k grupě vyših modulov. Pridavniki označajut toj konstrukcijny poredok, ne fizičnu vysotu ni avtomatično vključenje jednogo abstraktnogo modula v drugy.

Reason: Najbližši vyši modul preserves the sequence of construction steps in Paper 2, §7. The archived reason mentions a hierarchy of moduli; the Russian and Ukrainian parallels expressly indicate the next higher step. The historical sense of modul matters. In this paper it belongs to relative completeness of a system of forms: remainder expressions obtained by contractions with the modulus system are allowed. It is not simply a modern abstract module of higher rank. Section 7 passes from a modulus to the designated higher one and then to a collection of higher moduli. The adjectives mark that construction order, not physical height or automatic inclusion between abstract modules.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Oprěděljenje v rabotě 2, §3, govori o relativnoj polnotě do dodatnyh kontrakcijnyh izrazov. Prěhody v §7 koristajut toj smysl modula. Vyši zato potrěbuje konkretny red form i pravilo redukcije; ne možno go čitati kako obču teoremu o rangah abstraktnyh modulov.

Textual comparison: The definition in Paper 2, §3, states relative completeness up to additional contraction expressions. The steps in §7 use that sense of modulus. Higher consequently requires the specified series of forms and reduction rule; it cannot be read as a general theorem about ranks of abstract modules.

slědujući vyši relativno polny sistem

Iztočnik / Source: nächsthöheres relativ vollständiges System

Rusky / Russian: следующая более высокая относительно полная система

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: наступна вища відносно повна система

Razlog: Slědujući vyši relativno polny sistem razlagaje německy složeny opis v čitateljnu frazu. Arhiv ocěnjuje rusku i ukrajinsku formulaciju kako gladšu, ale pri medžuslovjanskoj izrično ostavjaje voprosy soglasovanja pridavnikov i ih poredka za prověrku. To ograničenje ne možno proměniti v tvrdženje o uže ustanovjenoj normě. V rabotě 2, §17, sistem ostavaje polnym po danym modulam; vyše i slědujući označajut prěhod konstrukcije, ne bezuslovnu polnotu. Dostupna fraza slědujučego vyšego relativno polnogo sistema pokazyvaje i sklonjeny oblik i pisanje č naměsto arhivnogo ć. Različenje formulacij trěba razgledati v rečenici, bez slepogo prěnosa starogo pravopisa v nove prěvody.

Reason: Slědujući vyši relativno polny sistem expands the German compound description into a readable phrase. The archive judges the Russian and Ukrainian wording smoother, but expressly leaves Interslavic adjective agreement and comparative word order for review. That qualification must not become a claim of an already established norm. In Paper 2, §17, completeness remains relative to specified moduli; higher and next indicate the construction step, not unconditional completeness. The available phrase slědujučego vyšego relativno polnogo sistema shows both inflection and č in place of archival ć. The formulations need comparison in their sentences, without blindly transferring older spelling to new translations.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dostupny §17 raboty 2 koristi frazu slědujučego vyšego relativno polnogo sistema, potom davaje slědujuči modul i sistemy form. Tekst podpiraje relativny, korakovy smysl frazy. On ne razrěšaje sam po sobě arhivny vopros o najlepšem slovoporedku i ne opravdavaje prěnosa pisma ć bez sravnenja s nynějšim č.

Textual comparison: The available §17 of Paper 2 uses slědujučego vyšego relativno polnogo sistema, then supplies the next modulus and systems of forms. It supports the relative, stepwise sense of the phrase. By itself it does not settle the archived word-order question or justify transferring ć without comparison with current č.

gorny / dolny indeks vagy

Iztočnik / Source: oberer / unterer Gewichtsindex

Rusky / Russian: верхний / нижний весовой индекс

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: верхній / нижній ваговий індекс

Razlog: Gorny i dolny v tom paru označajut položenje indeksa, ne najvyššu i najnižšu vrijednost vagy. V rabotě 4, §1, gorny indeks \(\rho\) broji symboly jednogo roda, a dolny \(n-\rho\) drugogo; vaga reda jest \(\rho(n-\rho)\). Isti red može zato byti označeny črez gorny ili dolny indeks. Arhivny razlog povězuje imenovanje neposrědno s položenjem vo formulah; ruska i ukrajinska paralela podpirajut toj sostav. Slovo vaga tu ima avtorovo kombinatorno značenje. Ono ne označaje ocěnku terminologičnogo kandidata, statističnu važnost ni čislovu ocěnku dověrja. Ta razlika jest osobno važna v slovaru, ktory takože objašnjaje kvalitativno odvažanje jezykovyh izborov.

Reason: Gorny and dolny here denote index position, not the greatest and least values of the weight. In Paper 4, §1, the upper index \(\rho\) counts symbols of one kind and the lower index \(n-\rho\) the other; the row’s weight is \(\rho(n-\rho)\). The same row can consequently be designated by an upper or a lower index. The archived reason connects the names directly with their placement in formulas; the Russian and Ukrainian parallels support that composition. Weight has the author’s combinatorial meaning. It is not a terminology candidate’s score, statistical importance or a numerical confidence rating. This distinction matters especially in a dictionary that also discusses qualitative weighing of language choices.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 4, §1, daje gorny indeks \(\rho\), dolny indeks \(n-\rho\) i vagu \(\rho(n-\rho)\). Točna oznaka povězuje dva sposoby zapisa togo samogo reda. Ulohu vsakogo indeksa trěba čuvati; zaměna gorny/dolny s veči/menši proměnila by smysl.

Textual comparison: Paper 4, §1, gives the upper index \(\rho\), lower index \(n-\rho\) and weight \(\rho(n-\rho)\). The notation connects two ways of designating the same row. Each index’s role must be retained; replacing upper/lower with greater/smaller would change the meaning.

\(\Omega\)-proces

Iztočnik / Source: Omega-Prozeß

Rusky / Russian: \(\Omega\)-процесс

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \(\Omega\)-процес

Razlog: Symbol \(\Omega\) ostavaje čestju nazvanja operacije. Arhivny razlog izrično daje prědnost čuvanju Noetherinoj oznaki pred opisnym prěimenovanjem operatora. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože čuvajut grčku bukvu, s prilagodjenym slovom proces. V rabotě 2, §1, normalna forma opisana jest uslovjem, že \(\Omega\)-proces po ukazanyh parah proměnnyh davaje nulu. Nazvanje zato nosi konkretnu ulogu v oprěděljenju, a ne samo ukrašajuču simboliku. Sama bukva ne dokazuje svezu s vsakoj drugoju \(\Omega\) v korpusu: v rabotě 34 ona, na priměr, označaje oblast operatorov. To sut različne ulohy iste oznaki, ne jeden termin za avtomatično objedinjenje.

Reason: The symbol \(\Omega\) remains part of the operation’s name. The recorded reason explicitly prefers preserving Noether’s notation to replacing the operator name with a descriptive paraphrase. Russian and Ukrainian likewise retain the Greek letter with adapted forms of process. In Paper 2, §1, normal form is characterized by the \(\Omega\)-process giving zero for specified pairs of variables. The name therefore has a concrete defining role rather than decorative symbolism. The letter alone does not establish a connection with every other \(\Omega\) in the corpus: in Paper 34 it denotes an operator domain, for example. These are different roles of the same symbol, not one term to merge automatically.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 2, §1, priměna \(\Omega\)-procesa k ukazanym proměnnym poničuje normalnu formu. Zachovanje symbola daje neposrědnu svezu s tym kriterijem. To ne jest ista uloga \(\Omega\), ktora v rabotě 34 imenuje množstvo operatorov; sovpadanje bukvy ne jest terminologičnym dokazom.

Textual comparison: In Paper 2, §1, applying the \(\Omega\)-process to the specified variables annihilates a normal form. Preserving the symbol keeps a direct link to that criterion. This is not the role of \(\Omega\) naming a collection of operators in Paper 34; sharing a letter is not terminological evidence.

oblast operatorov

Iztočnik / Source: Operatorenbereich

Rusky / Russian: область операторов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: область операторів

Razlog: Oblast operatorov jest cělost danyh operatorov, ne oblast oprěděljenja jednogo operatora. Zapis čuva doslovno nazvanje, zato že ta cělost upravljaje dopustimymi podgrupami i operatornymi izomorfizmami. V rabotě 34, §1, vsaky operator davaje endomorfizm grupy; obratimost vsakogo dějstva ne jest potrěbna. Različne oznaki mogut iměti isto dějstvo, dokolko ne dodano osobno uslovje razlikovanja. Dopustima podgrupa mora byti stabilna pod vsimi danymi operatorami. Iz toga ne slěduje, že vsaka jest normalna ili karakteristična: te sveze vyžadajut osobno izbrane oblasti operatorov. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela podpirajut nazvanje. Načalno oprěděljenje samo ne naměta prstenovu strukturu oblasti.

Reason: Oblast operatorov is the collection of specified operators, not the domain of definition of one operator. The record retains the literal name because this collection governs admissible subgroups and operator isomorphisms. In Paper 34, §1, every operator induces a group endomorphism; invertibility of every action is not required. Distinct operator labels may have the same action unless a separate distinguishing condition is added. An admissible subgroup must be stable under all specified operators. It is not therefore automatically normal or characteristic: those connections require particular operator collections. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels support the name. The initial definition does not itself impose a ring structure on the collection.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 34, §1, dopustimost podgrupy znači stabilnost pod vsimi operatorami danej oblasti. Vnutrne automorfizmy i vsi automorfizmy davajut osobne slučaje normalnosti i karakterističnosti. Pozdějši operatorny homomorfizm mora usoglasiti grupovo zobraženje s operatornym dějstvom, ne samo čuvati grupovy produkt.

Textual comparison: In Paper 34, §1, subgroup admissibility means stability under every operator in the specified collection. Inner automorphisms and all automorphisms give the special normal and characteristic cases. A later operator homomorphism must respect the operator action as well as the group product.

operatorny homomorfizm / operatorno-homomorfny

Iztočnik / Source: operatorhomomorph

Rusky / Russian: операторный гомоморфизм / операторно-гомоморфный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: операторний гомоморфізм / операторно-гомоморфний

Razlog: Operatorny homomorfizm i pridavnik operatorno-homomorfny čuvajut ne samo grupovo zobraženje, ale i jego soglasje s danymi operatorami. Zapis raboty 34, §§18-19, izrično prodolžaje terminologiju §15 i ostavjaje spojnik v pridavniku kako kratku tehničnu konstrukciju. To jest zapisany pravopisny izbor, ne dokaz, že ina pisanja ne sut dopustime. V §15 operatorne homomorfizmy povězuju dejstvo množiteljev s modulom prědstavjenja; v §18 različajut se operatorny homomorfizm i izomorfizm. Ne možno izostaviti operatorny samo zato, že bližši kontekst govori o module. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela zachovajut istu čest značenja; čislove važnosti sravnenyh form ne sut zabilěžene.

Reason: Operatorny homomorfizm and the adjective operatorno-homomorfny preserve both the group map and its compatibility with the specified operators. The record for Paper 34, §§18-19, expressly continues §15 and retains the hyphenated adjective as a compact technical construction. This is a recorded spelling choice, not evidence that other spellings are inadmissible. In §15 operator homomorphisms connect multiplier action with a representation module; §18 distinguishes operator homomorphism from isomorphism. Operatorny cannot be dropped merely because the surrounding discussion concerns modules. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels retain the same qualification; no numerical weights for the compared forms were recorded.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 34, §§2, 15 i 18, čuva razliku medžu operatornym homomorfizmom i izomorfizmom pri prědstavjenjah. Spojnik v arhivnom pridavniku jest pravopisna odluka; formula o soglasju dějstvij jest matematično uslovje. Jedno ne može zaměniti drugo.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §§2, 15 and 18, retains the distinction between operator homomorphism and isomorphism in representation theory. The archival adjective’s hyphen is a spelling decision; compatibility of the actions is a mathematical condition. Neither substitutes for the other.

operatorny homomorfizm

Iztočnik / Source: Operatorhomomorphismus

Rusky / Russian: операторный гомоморфизм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: операторний гомоморфізм

Razlog: Pridavnik operatorny jest sučstvena čest oprěděljenja. V rabotě 34, §2, homomorfizm čuva grupovy produkt i mora soglasovati se s dějstvom vsakogo operatora. Ako obraz od \(a\) jest \(\bar a\), obraz od \(\Theta a\) mora byti \(\Theta\bar a\). Arhiv daje tomu uslovju prědnost pred kratšim, neoprěděljenym homomorfizmom. Podčrtna primětka razširjaje pojem na različne oblasti operatorov, ale togda potrěbno jest takože odgovarjajuče zobraženje samyh operatorov. Slovar čuva oba slučaje razděljeno. Ruska i ukrajinska fraza imajut isto eksplicitno ograničenje; sama podobnost nazvanja ne ustanavljaje, ktory operatory dane zobraženje v konkretnom priměrě čuva.

Reason: Operatorny is an essential part of the definition. In Paper 34, §2, a homomorphism preserves the group product and must commute with each specified operator action. If \(a\) maps to \(\bar a\), then \(\Theta a\) must map to \(\Theta\bar a\). The archive prioritizes this condition over the shorter, unspecified homomorphism. A footnote extends the concept to different operator collections, but then a corresponding map of the operators is also required. The dictionary keeps these cases separate. Russian and Ukrainian express the same qualification; similarity of names alone does not determine which operators a particular map preserves.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Oprěděljenje v rabotě 34, §2, vyžadaje čuvanje grupovogo produkta i operatornogo dějstva. Primětka razširjaje pojem na različne oblasti operatorov, s dodatnym zobraženjem medžu njimi. Bijektivnost stavaje osobnym uslovjem operatornogo izomorfizma, ne čestju vsakogo homomorfizma.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §2, requires preservation of both the group product and operator action. Its footnote extends the notion to different operator collections with an additional map between them. Bijectivity is the separate condition for operator isomorphism, not part of every homomorphism.

operatorno izomorfny

Iztočnik / Source: operatorisomorph

Rusky / Russian: операторно изоморфный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: операторно ізоморфний

Razlog: Dva zapisy čuvajut operatorno izomorfny pri modulah i prědstavjenjah v rabotě 34 i pri Galoisovyh modulah v rabotě 37. Oba razloga odvrgajut skračenje k izomorfizmu samyh aditivnyh grup. V prvom slučaju zobraženje mora čuvati množenje s elementami danej oblasti; v drugom takože substitucije Galoisovej grupy. Polje razgledaje se kako modul nad osnovnym poljem, ne kako kvocient dvou polj. Ne mora iz toga slědovati izomorfizm polja s grupnym prstenom kako prstenov: predmetom jest modul s operatorami. Različenje izomorfizma i homomorfizma ostavaje osobno uslovje bijektivnosti. Pisanje bez spojnika jest zachovany oblik tyh zapisov, ne oddělny matematičny pojem.

Reason: Two records retain operatorno izomorfny for modules and representations in Paper 34 and Galois modules in Paper 37. Both reasons reject shortening this to an isomorphism of the underlying additive groups. In the former setting the map respects multiplication by the specified operators; in the latter it also respects Galois substitutions. The field is treated as a module over its base field, not as a quotient of two fields. This need not make the field and group ring isomorphic as rings: the object is a module with operators. Bijectivity remains the additional distinction from homomorphism. The unhyphenated spelling is the form preserved in these records, not a separate mathematical concept.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 34, §18, razgleda proste modulne komponenty; rabota 37, §2, razgleda polje s Galoisovym dějstvom. V obojih slučajah izomorfizm čuva imenovanu operatornu strukturu. Ravnost rangov sama po sobě ne davaje izomorfizm proizvoljnogo zobraženja: važna jest dana konstrukcija i njejna baza.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §18, concerns simple module components; Paper 37, §2, concerns a field with Galois action. In both settings the isomorphism preserves the specified operator structure. Equality of ranks alone does not make an arbitrary map an isomorphism: the actual construction and its basis matter.

operatorno-izomorfny

Iztočnik / Source: operatorisomorph

Rusky / Russian: операторно изоморфный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: операторно ізоморфний

Razlog: Operatorno-izomorfny prodolžaje terminologiju raboty 33 i §2 raboty 34. Arhivny razlog vyžadaje zachovanje operatornoj struktury, ne samo složenja. V §10 raboty 34 toj uslovje razlučuje nenulove prave idealy iz različnyh dvustrannyh komponentov: operator, ktory poničuje jeden ideal, ne poničuje drugy. Aditivna podobnost zato ne jest dosta. Zachovany spojnik razlikuje pisanje od operatorno izomorfny v drugih zapisah, ale ne davaje osnovu za dva različne matematične značenja. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela pišut odnos razděljeno. Izbor jedinoobraznogo pravopisa potrěbuje jezykovu ocěnku; argument s poničenjem stanovjaje semantično ograničenje, ne pravopisnu normu.

Reason: Operatorno-izomorfny continues Paper 33 and §2 of Paper 34. The archived reason requires preservation of the operator structure, not addition alone. In §10 of Paper 34 this distinguishes nonzero right ideals in different two-sided components: an operator annihilating one ideal does not annihilate the other. Additive similarity is therefore insufficient. The retained hyphen differs from operatorno izomorfny elsewhere, but does not establish two mathematical meanings. Russian and Ukrainian write the relation as separate words. Selecting a uniform spelling requires linguistic assessment; the annihilator argument establishes a semantic constraint, not an orthographic norm.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 34, §10, različaje idealy prěz dějstva, ktore ih poničujut. Argument potrěbuje nenulove idealy: nulovy ideal ne možno razlučiti takim neponičujučim dějstvom. To objašnjaje, začto operatorny uslovje jest silnějši od samotnogo aditivnogo izomorfizma, bez ustanovjanja prědnosti jednogo pisanja pridavnika.

Textual comparison: Paper 34, §10, distinguishes ideals by their annihilating actions. The argument requires nonzero ideals: the zero ideal cannot be distinguished by a non-annihilating action. This explains why the operator condition is stronger than additive isomorphism alone, without establishing a preference for one spelling of the adjective.

operatorno izomorfny / operatorny homomorfizm

Iztočnik / Source: operatorisomorph / Operatorhomomorphismus

Rusky / Russian: операторно изоморфный / операторный гомоморфизм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: операторно ізоморфний / операторний гомоморфізм

Razlog: V rabotě 34, §14, zapis naměrno ostavjaje operatornu terminologiju vměsto zaměny s občim opisom modulnogo zobraženja. To čuva jezyk dokaza. Množenje s vhodnym elementom davaje operatorny homomorfizm medžu prostymi pravymi idealami; nenulovost zobraženja, prostota ideala i izčrpanje obraza davajut izomorfizm. Sama jedina slova homomorfizm i izomorfny ne sut vzajemno zaměnime. Operatorno tu vyražaje soglasje s danym množenjem; ono ne znači libovoljnu funkciju medžu množstvami. Arhivna alternativa modulno zobraženje jest zachovana kako odvrgany opis, ne kako dokaz, že današnji modulny jezyk byl by matematično nepravilny.

Reason: For Paper 34, §14, the record deliberately retains operator terminology instead of replacing it with a general module-map description. This preserves the proof’s language. Multiplication by a suitable element gives an operator homomorphism between simple right ideals; nonzeroness, simplicity and coverage of the image give an isomorphism. Homomorphism and isomorphic are not interchangeable labels. Operatorno expresses compatibility with the specified multiplication, not an arbitrary function between sets. The module-map alternative is preserved as the rejected wording, not as evidence that modern module language would be mathematically wrong.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 34, §14, element medzi idealami zadavaje homomorfizm prěz množenje. Prosty ideal ne ima netrivialnogo jadra, a nenulovy obraz izčrpava ciljevy prosty ideal. Te uslovja, ne samo slovo homomorfizm, opravdavajut slědujuče izomorfny.

Textual comparison: In Paper 34, §14, multiplication by an element defines a homomorphism between the ideals. Simplicity excludes a nontrivial kernel, and the nonzero image fills the simple target ideal. These conditions, rather than the word homomorphism alone, justify the subsequent isomorphic.

operatorny izomorfizm

Iztočnik / Source: Operatorisomorphie

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]; операторный изоморфизм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]; операторний ізоморфізм

Razlog: Operatorny izomorfizm sjedinjaje tri zapisy iz rabot 33, 34 i 39. Razlogi sut zachovanje operatornogo uslovja, paralela s operatornym homomorfizmom i upotrěba internacionalnogo korenja s pridavnikom, a ne s německym složenjem. Jeden rusky i jeden ukrajinsky zapis imajut izgubjene bukvy; pozdějše čitateljne zapisy ne razrěšajut rekonstrukciju izgubljenyh tekstov. Rabota 39 izrično objašnjaje izomorfizm polja i grupovoj algebry kako zobraženje, ktoro čuva linearne kombinacije i odgovarjanje Galoisovyh substitucij grupovomu množenju. To ne jest tvrdženje o izomorfizmu prstenov. Jej pozvanje na Deuringov dokaz i prazdninu rannějšego dokaza ostavaje avtorovo svědčenje, ne novy nezavisny pregled tyh dokazov.

Reason: Operatorny izomorfizm brings together three records from Papers 33, 34 and 39. Their reasons are preservation of the operator condition, parallelism with operator homomorphism, and use of an international stem with an agreeing adjective rather than a German compound. One Russian and one Ukrainian record have lost lettering; later readable records do not license reconstruction of those lost strings. Paper 39 expressly describes the field-to-group-algebra isomorphism as preserving linear combinations and the correspondence between Galois substitutions and group multiplication. This is not a ring-isomorphism claim. Its reference to Deuring’s proof and a gap in the earlier proof remains the author’s testimony, not a fresh independent review of those proofs.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 33 i 34 oprěděljajut operatorny izomorfizm črez soglasje s vsim danym dějstvom. Rabota 39 govori o linearnyh kombinacijah i Galoisovyh substitucijah pri izomorfizmu polja i grupovoj algebry. Ne utvrđaje se čuvanje proizvoljnogo množenja elementov polja. Rannějši dokazny propust imaje avtorovo priznanje v primětkě.

Textual comparison: Papers 33 and 34 define operator isomorphism by compatibility with the specified action. Paper 39 describes linear combinations and Galois substitutions in the field-to-group-algebra isomorphism. It does not assert preservation of arbitrary field multiplication. The earlier proof gap is acknowledged by the author in a footnote.

porjadok

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnung

Rusky / Russian: порядок

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядок

Razlog: Porjadok byl izbrany pro algebraično-čislovoteoretičny smysl Ordnung, bez tvorjenja novogo purističnogo nazvanja. Dva razloga ukazujut na rusko i ukrajinsko порядок i prědpolagajut širšu slovjansku razumlivost; ne davajut test čitanja v zapadnyh i južnyh jezykah. V rabotě 30, §1, oprěděljenje jest širše než obyčajny konečny čislovy poredok: prsten medžu fiksovanym osnovnym prstenom i danym nadprstenom nazyvaje se poredkom. Konečnost jest dodatno uslovje konečnoj generovanosti modula. Dostupny prěvod piše poredok. Slovar čuva arhivno porjadok kako dokumentovany izbor, ne kako razlog vrnuti staru formu vo vsaky nynějšnji pojav.

Reason: Porjadok was chosen for the algebraic-number-theoretic sense of Ordnung, without coining a purist replacement. Two reasons invoke Russian and Ukrainian порядок and anticipate wider Slavic recognition; they supply no West- or South-Slavic reading test. Paper 30, §1, defines the term more broadly than a usual finite number-theoretic order: a ring between the fixed base ring and the given overring is called an order. Finiteness is the additional condition of finite generation as a module. The available translation spells it poredok. The dictionary preserves archival porjadok as a documented choice, not a reason to restore it at every current occurrence.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 30, §1, oddělja oprěděljenje poredka od dopolnitelnoj konečnosti modula. V rabotě 31 uvodna primětka zatem ograničavaje vse poredky na konečne. To jest razlika medžu opreděljenjem i lokalnoju dogovorenoju kratkostju; konečny tu ne broji vse elementy prstena.

Textual comparison: Paper 30, §1, separates the definition of an order from the additional finiteness of its module. Paper 31’s introductory footnote then restricts all orders to finite ones. This distinguishes a definition from a local abbreviation; finite here does not count all the ring’s elements.

porjadok / konečny porjadok

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnung / endliche Ordnung

Rusky / Russian: порядок / конечный порядок

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядок / скінченний порядок

Razlog: Konečny porjadok v toj rabotě ne znači prsten s konečno mnogo elementami. Rabota 30 oprěděljaje konečnost črez konečnu modulnu bazu nad osnovnym prstenom. Rabota 31 potom v uvodnoj primětkě izrično govori, že pod poredkom vsegda razuměje konečny poredok. Arhivny razlog čuva tu lokalnu dogovorenost i prodolžaje rano izbrano nazvanje. Kratše slovo poredok možet zato byti dovoljno vnutri toj raboty, ale v samostojnom slovarnom zapisu potrěbno jest ukazati vynešene uslovje. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela ne odstraňajut razliku medžu konečnym čislom generatorov i konečnym čislom elementov. Ne možno prěnesti uvodnu dogovorenost na vsaky drugy tekst.

Reason: Konečny porjadok here does not mean a ring with finitely many elements. Paper 30 defines finiteness through a finite module generating set over the base ring. Paper 31 then expressly stipulates in its introductory footnote that order always means finite order. The recorded reason preserves this local convention and continues the earlier terminology. The shorter poredok can therefore suffice within that paper, but a standalone dictionary entry must state the suppressed hypothesis. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels do not remove the distinction between finitely many generators and finitely many elements. The introductory convention cannot be transferred to every other text.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 30, §1, oddělja oprěděljenje poredka od dopolnitelnoj konečnosti modula. V rabotě 31 uvodna primětka zatem ograničavaje vse poredky na konečne. To jest razlika medžu opreděljenjem i lokalnoju dogovorenoju kratkostju; konečny tu ne broji vse elementy prstena.

Textual comparison: Paper 30, §1, separates the definition of an order from the additional finiteness of its module. Paper 31’s introductory footnote then restricts all orders to finite ones. This distinguishes a definition from a local abbreviation; finite here does not count all the ring’s elements.

porjadok / glavny porjadok

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnung / Hauptordnung

Rusky / Russian: порядок / главный порядок

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядок / головний порядок

Razlog: Arhiv odděljaje Ordnung kako prstenovy objekt od poredka ili stepena form. Glavny porjadok byl izbrany kako prozračny opis, s jezykovoj paraleloju k glavnomu idealu. Ta paralela ne ustanavljaje isto matematično svojstvo. V rabotě 31, §7, glavny poredok jest cělost elementov konečnogo razširjenja polja, cělyh nad danym osnovnym prstenom. On ne jest tim samym ideal porodženy jedinym elementom. Vsaky razgledany poredok leži medžu osnovnym prstenom i tym prstenom cělyh elementov. Dostupny tekst daje formy poredok i glavny poredok; arhivne porjadok i glavny porjadok ostavajut istorijskymi oblikami. Jezykovu srodnost trěba objasniti, ne proměniti v nepravilnu definiciju.

Reason: The archive distinguishes Ordnung as a ring object from the order or degree of forms. Glavny porjadok was selected as a transparent phrase, with a linguistic parallel to principal ideal. That parallel does not establish the same mathematical property. In Paper 31, §7, the main order is the collection of extension-field elements integral over the specified base ring. It is not thereby an ideal generated by one element. Every order under consideration lies between the base ring and that ring of integral elements. The available text has poredok and glavny poredok; archival porjadok and glavny porjadok remain historical forms. Linguistic resemblance needs explanation, not conversion into a false definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §7, imenuje cěly prsten integralnyh elementov glavnym poredkom. Rang inogo poredka měri se nad navedenym osnovnym prstenom; nižši rang vodi k medžupolju. Glavny v toj frazě ne znači, že vsaky ideal poredka jest glavny, ni že rang jest velkostju determinanta.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §7, calls the whole ring of integral elements the main order. Another order’s rank is measured over the specified base ring; lower rank leads to an intermediate field. Main here does not mean every ideal is principal, nor that rank is the size of a determinant.

red grupy

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnung der Gruppe

Rusky / Russian: порядок группы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядок групи

Razlog: Dva zapisy koristajut red grupy pro različne veličiny. V rabotě 7 \(h\) jest čislo elementov konečnoj grupy i davaje granicu stepena invariantov. V rabotě 17, §11, red grupy ostatkov izrično oprěděljen jest čislom elementov linearnoj bazy nad \(P\). To jest dimenzija, ne kardinalnost aditivnoj grupy; pri beskonečnom \(P\) cělo množstvo može byti beskonečno. Rannějši razlog označaje red kako kratku formu, ale ostavjaje alternativu porjadok za jezykovu ocěnku. Pozdějši zapis čuva doslědnost i istorijsko bazovno značenje. Sovpadanje ruskyh i ukrajinskyh nazvanij ne dopušča sliti te smysly. Oba morajut byti vidime pro čitatelja.

Reason: Two records use red grupy for different quantities. In Paper 7, \(h\) counts the elements of a finite group and bounds invariant degree. In Paper 17, §11, the order of a residue group is expressly defined as the number of elements in a linear basis over \(P\). It is dimension, not the cardinality of the additive group; over infinite \(P\) the underlying set can be infinite. The earlier reason calls red compact but leaves porjadok for linguistic assessment. The later record preserves consistency and the historical basis-count meaning. Matching Russian and Ukrainian names do not license merging these senses. Both must be visible to the reader.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 7 red \(h\) upravljaje čislom grupnyh substitucij i graniceju stepena invariantov. Rabota 17, §11, davaje ino izrično oprěděljenje: red \(\mu\) jest dimenzija grupy ostatkov nad poljem \(P\). Čitatelj potrěbuje oba smysly; klasifikacija svih pojavov kako obyčajnoj kardinalnosti grupy byla by nepravilna.

Textual comparison: In Paper 7, order \(h\) governs the number of group substitutions and the invariant-degree bound. Paper 17, §11, gives a different explicit definition: order \(\mu\) is the residue group’s dimension over \(P\). Readers need both senses; classifying every occurrence as ordinary group cardinality would be wrong.

porjadok vzhodno k \(o\)

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnung in bezug auf \(o\)

Rusky / Russian: порядок относительно \(o\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядок відносно \(o\)

Razlog: Vzhodno k v arhivnom nazvanju označava odnos poredka k osnovnomu prstenu \(o\). Zapis daje prědnost povtorjanju togo odnosa pred novym opisom zaměny osnovy. Dostupna rečenica občeho diskriminantnogo teorema nyně piše po odnošenju k i koristi frakturno \(o\); slovo ne govori o vostočnom napravjenju. To jest relativny prstenovy pojem: osnovny prsten upravljaje cělostju, modulom i diskriminantnym idealom. Pravilo čuvanja odnosa ne vyžadaje vozvrata arhivnoj formulaciji. Ni podobno slovo otnosno v sravniteljnyh jezykah, ni kratka oznaka osnovy ne dopuščajut izostaviti, nad ktorym prstenom stanovjajut se uslovja. Slovo \(o\) jest matematična oznaka, ne čislo 0.

Reason: Vzhodno k in the archived phrase marks the order’s relation to the base ring \(o\). The record prefers repeating that relation to a new base-change paraphrase. The available general discriminant theorem now says po odnošenju k and uses fraktur \(o\); the phrase does not express an eastward direction. This is a relative ring-theoretic notion: the base ring governs integrality, module structure and the discriminant ideal. Preserving the relation does not require restoring the archived wording. Neither a similar relational word in the comparison languages nor an abbreviated base symbol licenses omitting the ring over which the conditions are imposed. The letter \(o\) is a mathematical identifier, not the numeral 0.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §8, povtorjaje osnovny prsten pri poredku i diskriminantnom idealu. Dostupno po odnošenju k odpovědaje funkciji arhivnogo vzhodno k, bez vozvrata staroj frazě. Prěhod od osnovnogo prstena k njegovoj lokalizaciji menja město, v ktorom čitajut se uslovja dělitelnosti.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §8, repeats the base ring for the order and discriminant ideal. Current po odnošenju k performs the role of archival vzhodno k without restoring the older phrase. Passing from the base ring to its localization changes where the divisibility conditions are interpreted.

poręd v koeficientah

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnung in den Koeffizienten

Rusky / Russian: порядок в коэффициентах

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядок у коефіцієнтах

Razlog: Poręd v koeficientah čuva razliku medžu stepenom po koeficientah osnovnoj formy i stepenom po jeje proměnnyh. Arhivny razlog prodolžaje tu razliku i nazyvaje poręd prozračnym, ale izrično ne predstavlja to kako okončanu jezykovu ocěnku. Rabota 2, §7, uporedžuje formy po tom čislu i davaje tabelu kontrakcij: priměry različnih poredkov ne sut različne moči množstva form. Dostupny tekst piše pored, bez ę, i jasno čuva dopolnjenje v koeficientah. Izostavjenje togo dopolnjenja moglo by skryti, po ktoryh veličinah ide račun. Poręd, red i porjadok zato ne smijut byti avtomatično objedinjene bez različenja matematičnyh značenij.

Reason: Poręd v koeficientah preserves the distinction between degree in the original form’s coefficients and degree in its variables. The recorded reason continues that distinction and calls poręd transparent, while expressly leaving linguistic assessment open. Paper 2, §7, orders forms by this number and provides a contraction table: different orders are not different cardinalities of collections of forms. The available text writes pored without ę and retains v koeficientah. Dropping that complement could obscure which quantities are being counted. Poręd, red and porjadok must therefore not be automatically merged without distinguishing their mathematical meanings.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tabela v rabotě 2, §7, grupuje formy po poredku v koeficientah. Dopolnjenje v koeficientah jest čestju smysla, zato že stepen po proměnnyh jest drugo čislo. Dostupno pored ne imaje nosovogo znaka iz arhivnogo poręd; sravnenje čuva oba zapisy bez avtomatičnoj zaměny.

Textual comparison: The table in Paper 2, §7, groups forms by order in the coefficients. The complement in the coefficients is part of the meaning because variable degree is a different number. Current pored lacks the nasal mark of archival poręd; the comparison preserves both spellings without automatic replacement.

porjadky v čislovyh i funkcionalnyh poljah

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnungen in Zahl- und Funktionenkörpern

Rusky / Russian: порядки в числовых и функциональных полях

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядки в числових і функціональних полях

Razlog: Porjadky v čislovyh i funkcionalnyh poljah prodolžaje terminologiju teorije poredkov, ne teorije usporědženij ili dobryh usporědženij. To jest izričny razlog arhivnogo izbora. Rabota 31, §4, razširjaje prědpoloženja o koeficientnom prstenu, da bi objediniti poredky i ranějše konečno-razměrne algebry nad poljem. V tom odlomku obstajanje konečnoj linearno nezavisnoj modulnoj bazy jest prědpoloženo; ono ne vyhodi iz samogo nazvanja poredok. Dostupny tekst čuva i čislove i funkcionalne polja. Relativny poredok nad konkretnym osnovnym prstenom ne jest prosto libovoljna kolekcija funkcij ani relacija menše nego. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela podpirajut terminologičnu svezu, ne zaměnjajut navedene definicije.

Reason: Porjadky v čislovyh i funkcionalnyh poljah continues the terminology of orders, not order relations or well-orderings. That is the archive’s express reason. Paper 31, §4, broadens assumptions on the coefficient ring to treat orders together with the preceding finite-dimensional algebras over a field. Existence of a finite linearly independent module basis is an assumption in that passage; it does not follow from the name order alone. The available text retains both number fields and function fields. A relative order over a specified base ring is neither an arbitrary collection of functions nor a less-than relation. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels support the terminological connection without replacing the definitions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §4, davaje konkretne prědpoloženja o oblasti cělosti i modulnyh bazah, aby objediniti čislove i funkcionalne poredky s ranějšimi algebrajami. To oprěděljaje predmet frazy, ne pravilo uporedženja elementov. Glavny zadatok prěvoda jest čuvanje toj struktury i njejnyh hipotez.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §4, gives explicit domain and module-basis assumptions to treat number- and function-field orders together with the earlier algebras. These define the objects denoted by the phrase, not an ordering rule on elements. Translation must preserve that structure and its hypotheses.

porjadky ranga \(n\)

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnungen vom Range \(n\)

Rusky / Russian: порядки ранга \(n\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядки рангу \(n\)

Razlog: Rang \(n\) označaje modulny rang poredka nad osnovnym prstenom. Arhivny razlog prodolžaje rang iz §2 i odlišuje go od poredka determinanta i stepena. V rabotě 31, §7, \(n\) jest takože stepen okolnogo polja nad osnovnym poljem. To sovpadanje nastavaje iz ukazanyh uslovij; ne znači, že rang i stepen vsegda sut sinonimy. Poredok nižšego ranga poraždaje svoje medžupolje črez tvorjenje kvocientov, zato tekst može ograničiti razgledanje na polny rang. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela čuvajut rang i symbol \(n\). Dostupny oblik poredky ranga \(n\) razlikuje se pravopisno od arhivnogo porjadky, ne značenjem togo čisla.

Reason: Rank \(n\) is the module rank of the order over the base ring. The archived reason continues rang from §2 and distinguishes it from determinant order and degree. In Paper 31, §7, \(n\) is also the ambient field’s degree over the base field. That agreement follows from the stated setting; rank and degree are not universally synonyms. An order of lower rank generates its own intermediate field by taking fractions, so the text can restrict attention to full rank. Russian and Ukrainian preserve rank and the identifier \(n\). Current poredky ranga \(n\) differs orthographically from archival porjadky, not in what the number denotes.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §7, imenuje cěly prsten integralnyh elementov glavnym poredkom. Rang inogo poredka měri se nad navedenym osnovnym prstenom; nižši rang vodi k medžupolju. Glavny v toj frazě ne znači, že vsaky ideal poredka jest glavny, ni že rang jest velkostju determinanta.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §7, calls the whole ring of integral elements the main order. Another order’s rank is measured over the specified base ring; lower rank leads to an intermediate field. Main here does not mean every ideal is principal, nor that rank is the size of a determinant.

porjadky relativnyh polj

Iztočnik / Source: Ordnungen von Relativkörpern

Rusky / Russian: порядки относительных полей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: порядки відносних полів

Razlog: Relativny v nazvanju porjadky relativnyh polj čuva zavisnost od izbranogo osnovnogo polja i prstena. Arhiv daje prědnost internacionalno-slovjanskoj formě, so znanym matematičnym značenjem; ruska i ukrajinska paralela koristajut svoje odnošenjske pridavniki. V rabotě 31, §8, osnovny prsten uže ne mora byti prstenom glavnyh idealov. Razgledaje se širša klasa multiplikacionnyh prstenov, a vměsto jednogo diskriminantnogo elementa nastavaje diskriminantny ideal. Zato relativny ne znači približny ni uslovno pravilny. I polje, i prsten, po odnošenju k ktoromu oprěděljajut se cěle elementy, sut česti značenja. Relativny poredok ne možno bez proverky zaměniti s apsolutnym.

Reason: Relativny in porjadky relativnyh polj retains dependence on a selected base field and ring. The archive prefers an international-Slavic form with mathematical relational meaning; Russian and Ukrainian use their own relational adjectives. In Paper 31, §8, the base ring need no longer be a principal ideal ring. A broader multiplication-ring class is considered, and a discriminant ideal replaces a single discriminant element. Relative therefore means neither approximate nor conditionally correct. Both the field and the ring relative to which integrality is defined belong to the meaning. A relative order cannot be replaced by an absolute one without checking the context.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 31, §8, obči osnovny prsten vyžadaje diskriminantny ideal. Čislovopoljny specialny slučaj govori o relativnom diskriminantu. Relativny ne jest samo stilističny pridavnik: osnovny prsten i razširjenje polja ostavajut neizostavime.

Textual comparison: In Paper 31, §8, the more general base ring calls for a discriminant ideal. The number-field specialization concerns the relative discriminant. Relative is not stylistic: the base ring and field extension remain indispensable.

ortogonalnostne uslovja

Iztočnik / Source: Orthogonalitaetsbedingungen

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Ortogonalnostne uslovja pomenovajut relacije idempotentov: \(a_i^2=a_i\) i \(a_i a_j=0\) za \(i\ne j\). Arhivny razlog smatra ortogonalnost poznanym tehničnym opisom; zachovane ruske i ukrajinske polja však ne imajut čitateljnyh bukv, zato jih formy ne možemo podati kako točne sravnjenja. V rabotě 17, §5, to sut osobne klasy ostatkov, za ktore potrěbne produkty obstajut; ne trěba podrazuměvati libovoljno množenje vseh klasov po module. Relacije so sumoju ravnoju jedinici objašnjajut razloženje i jeho jedinstvenost. Tu ne zadano vnutrěšnje množenje vektorov ili měrenje ugla. Algebraična ortogonalnost ne mora izvirati iz geometrije.

Reason: Ortogonalnostne uslovja names the idempotent relations \(a_i^2=a_i\) and \(a_i a_j=0\) for \(i\ne j\). The archived reason treats orthogonality as familiar technical language, but the preserved Russian and Ukrainian fields have no recoverable lettering, so their exact forms cannot be supplied as comparanda. In Paper 17, §5, these are special residue classes for which the required products exist; arbitrary multiplication of all classes modulo a module must not be assumed. Together with the sum being the identity, the relations explain the decomposition and its uniqueness. No vector inner product or angle measurement is specified. Algebraic orthogonality need not arise from geometry.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 17, §5, ustanavljaje, za ktore klase ostatkov potrěbne produkty sut oprěděljene. V rabotah 31 i 34 relacije idempotentov razlučujut komponenty prstena. Sveza jest algebraična: kvadrat čuva element, različne komponenty davajut nulovy produkt. Iz toga ne slěduje geometričny ugol ili centralnost vsih idempotentov.

Textual comparison: Paper 17, §5, establishes which residue classes admit the required products. In Papers 31 and 34 the idempotent relations separate ring components. The connection is algebraic: squaring preserves an element and different components have zero product. Neither a geometric angle nor centrality of every idempotent follows.

relacije ortogonalnosti

Iztočnik / Source: Orthogonalitätsrelationen

Rusky / Russian: соотношения ортогональности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: співвідношення ортогональності

Razlog: Relacije ortogonalnosti čuva internacionalny korenj vměsto novogo purističnogo opisa. Dva zapisy povězujut toj izbor s razloženjem na idempotentne komponenty v rabotah 31 i 34; ruska i ukrajinska paralela sut čitateljne i tak samo imenujut ortogonalnost. V rabotě 31 produkt elementov razloženogo prstena računa se po komponentah. V rabotě 34 iz razloženja na prave idealy dobyvajut se idempotenty, čiji mješane produkty sut nula. Ne trěba iz samej relacije zaključati, že vsaky idempotent jest centralny. Takože to nije tvrdženje o pravom uglu. Glavny kriterij izbora jest neizgubljenje postoječej algebraičnoj svezy, a širša razumlivost ostavaje jezykovym očekivanjem, ne izměrjenym rezultatom.

Reason: Relacije ortogonalnosti retains the international stem instead of introducing a purist description. Two records connect the choice with idempotent decompositions in Papers 31 and 34; their Russian and Ukrainian parallels are readable and likewise name orthogonality. In Paper 31 products in the decomposed ring are computed componentwise. In Paper 34 decomposition into right ideals supplies idempotents whose mixed products are zero. The relations alone do not imply that every idempotent is central. Nor is this a claim about right angles. Preserving the established algebraic connection is the principal selection criterion; wider intelligibility remains a linguistic expectation, not a measured result.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 17, §5, ustanavljaje, za ktore klase ostatkov potrěbne produkty sut oprěděljene. V rabotah 31 i 34 relacije idempotentov razlučujut komponenty prstena. Sveza jest algebraična: kvadrat čuva element, različne komponenty davajut nulovy produkt. Iz toga ne slěduje geometričny ugol ili centralnost vsih idempotentov.

Textual comparison: Paper 17, §5, establishes which residue classes admit the required products. In Papers 31 and 34 the idempotent relations separate ring components. The connection is algebraic: squaring preserves an element and different components have zero product. Neither a geometric angle nor centrality of every idempotent follows.

\(p\)-adično razširjenje

Iztočnik / Source: \(p\)-adische Erweiterung

Rusky / Russian: \(p\)-адическое расширение

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \(p\)-адичне розширення

Razlog: \(p\)-adično razširjenje čuva internacionalny pridavnik i običny algebraičny pojem razširjenja. Arhivny razlog povězuje jego razumlivost s ruskoju i ukrajinskoju matematičnoju terminologijeju; konkretna čitateljska prověrka ne jest navedena. V rabotě 37 osnovno polje prěhodi k polju pri izbranom prostom idealu, a koeficienty grupovogo prstena razširjajut se odgovarjajuče. To ne znači prostě dodati jeden algebraičny korenj ni zaměniti polje njegovym ostatkovym poljem. Dostupny tekst označaje ideal frakturou; prosto p v starom glosaru ne opravdava zameny tyh oznak. Primětka razlikuje polno p-adično razširjenje od slabšego prěhoda k prstenu kvocientov v osobnom komutativnom slučaju.

Reason: \(p\)-adično razširjenje retains the international adjective and the ordinary algebraic word for extension. The recorded reason links intelligibility to Russian and Ukrainian mathematical terminology; no reader test is reported. In Paper 37 the base field passes to the field at a specified prime ideal, and group-ring coefficients are extended accordingly. This is not simply adjunction of one algebraic root or replacement by the residue field. The available text uses a fraktur ideal symbol; the early glossary’s plain p does not justify interchanging those identifiers. A footnote distinguishes the full p-adic extension from the weaker passage to a ring of quotients in a special commutative case.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 37 povězuje razširjenje osnovnogo polja s odgovarjajučim razširjenjem koeficientov grupovogo prstena. Primětka izrično razlikuje toj postupok od slabšego prěhoda k prstenu kvocientov v osobnom slučaju; ostatkovo polje ne može zaměniti ni jedno.

Textual comparison: Paper 37 relates extension of the base field to corresponding extension of group-ring coefficients. A footnote expressly distinguishes this from a weaker passage to a ring of quotients in a special case; a residue field is not a substitute for either.

\(p\)-adične komponenty / razvětvjene města

Iztočnik / Source: \(p\)-adische Komponenten / Verzweigungsstellen

Rusky / Russian: \(p\)-адические компоненты / места ветвления

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \(p\)-адичні компоненти / розгалужені місця

Razlog: \(p\)-adične komponenty i razvětvjene města prodolžajut ranějši lokalno-globalny slovnik: město imenuje matematičny objekt, a razvětvjenje njegovo svojstvo. Rabota 42 ne razděljuje poredky samo po jih prěsěku s podpoljem: v občej prostoj algebrě trěbuje takože ravnost lokalnyh komponentov na razvětvjenyh městah. Izostavjenje poslednogo uslovja změnilo by razdělbu. Komponenta tu ne jest proizvoljny člen direktnoj sumy; ona jest p-adična komponenta danogo poredka. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela podpirajut oba nazvanja, ale ne zaměnjajut tu definiciju. Arhivny razlog jest doslědnost, ne dokaz, že vsako razvětvjenje v drugoj oblasti ima istu matematičnu prirodu.

Reason: \(p\)-adične komponenty and razvětvjene města continue the earlier local-global vocabulary: město names the mathematical place, and razvětvjenje its ramification property. Paper 42 does not classify orders solely by their intersection with a subfield: for a general simple algebra it also requires equality of local components at ramified places. Omitting that condition would change the classification. A component here is the p-adic component of the given order, not an arbitrary direct-sum summand. Russian and Ukrainian parallels support both names but do not replace the definition. The recorded reason is continuity, not evidence that every use of ramification in another subject denotes the same structure.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 42, §3, ravnost prěsěkov s podpoljem ne dostačuje: definicija oblasti uključaje ravnost p-adičnyh komponentov na razvětvjenyh městah. To jest dopolnitelno uslovje na poredky, ne svojstvo, ktore možno izostaviti iz nazvanja.

Textual comparison: In Paper 42, §3, equality of intersections with the subfield is insufficient: the definition of a region includes equality of p-adic components at ramified places. This is an additional condition on orders, not a qualification that can be dropped from the wording.

\(p\)-togo razmjera

Iztočnik / Source: \(p\)-ter Dimension / \(p\)-te Dimension

Rusky / Russian: \(p\)-го измерения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \(p\)-го виміру

Razlog: \(p\)-togo razmjera jest zachovany prěvod historijnogo Dimension pri homogennyh formah. Sam arhiv ostavjaje razmjer otvorenym k jezykovoj ocěnki i nazyvaje dimenzija kako alternativu. Kontekst ale ne dopuščaje avtomatičnu zaměnu: v rabotě 12 \(p\) označaje stepen homogenej formy, s kvadratičnym slučajem \(p=2\), ne čislo nezavisnyh koordinat. Ranějše razvitje po \(u\) oddělja homogene česti po takomu stepenju. Slovnik mora zato pokazati matematičny smysl prěd izborom jednoobraznogo nazvanja. Dostupny tekst piše razměr, ne arhivno razmjer. Ni podoba s ruskoju i ukrajinskoju formou, ni prědložena alternativa sama ne rěšaje razliku medžu stepenjem i dimenzijeju.

Reason: \(p\)-togo razmjera is the recorded rendering of historical Dimension for homogeneous forms. The archive itself leaves razmjer open to linguistic assessment and names dimenzija as an alternative. Context prevents an automatic replacement: in Paper 12, \(p\) denotes homogeneous degree, with the quadratic case \(p=2\), not the number of independent coordinates. The earlier expansion in \(u\) separates homogeneous parts by that degree. The dictionary must therefore explain the mathematical sense before choosing uniform wording. The available text spells razměr rather than archival razmjer. Neither resemblance to the Russian and Ukrainian forms nor the proposed alternative itself resolves the distinction between degree and dimension.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 12 razvitje po \(u\) razděljuje homogene česti po stepenju; koncovy odlomok razgleda kvadratične formy kako slučaj \(p=2\). Historijno Dimension zato potrěbuje kontekstualno objasnjenje, ne mehaničnu zaměnu s dimenzija.

Textual comparison: Paper 12’s expansion in \(u\) separates homogeneous parts by degree; its concluding passage treats quadratic forms as the case \(p=2\). Historical Dimension therefore requires contextual explanation, not mechanical replacement by dimenzija.

konjugacija črez \(P\)

Iztočnik / Source: \(P^{-1} R_a P\) / \(P^{-1} C P\)

Rusky / Russian: сопряжение посредством \(P\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: спряження через \(P\)

Razlog: Konjugacija črez \(P\) jest pojasnjujuče nazvanje operacije, zapisanej formulami \(P^{-1}R_aP\) i \(P^{-1}CP\). Arhiv davaje prědnost zachovanju formul; nazvanje ma služiti daljšoj terminologiji klasov prědstavjenij. V rabotě 31, §4, zaměna modulnoj bazy jest dana matricou \(P\) s determinantem, ktory jest jedinica v osnovnom prstenu. To jest silnějše než nenulovost determinanta nad proizvoljnym prstenom. Red faktorov slěduje iz izbranoj konvencije bazovyh redov i ne može byti obratny samo radi stilja. Ne ide o kompleksno konjugovanje ni o konjugovane korenje polinoma; ruska i ukrajinska fraza ne uklanjajut potrěbu ukazati upravo matričnu operaciju.

Reason: Konjugacija črez \(P\) is an explanatory name for the operations written as \(P^{-1}R_aP\) and \(P^{-1}CP\). The record prioritizes preservation of the formulas and supplies the name for later representation-class terminology. In Paper 31, §4, the module-basis change uses a matrix \(P\) whose determinant is a unit in the base ring. This is stronger than merely being nonzero over an arbitrary ring. Factor order follows the chosen row-basis convention and cannot be reversed for stylistic reasons. The operation is neither complex conjugation nor passage to conjugate polynomial roots; the Russian and Ukrainian phrases do not remove the need to specify the matrix operation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §4, izvodi \(P^{-1}CP\) iz konkretnoj konvencije bazovyh redov. Determinant \(P\) jest jedinica osnovnogo prstena. Red faktorov i to uslovje čuvajut smisao; nenulovy determinant sam ne daje isti rezultat nad libovoljnym prstenom.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §4, derives \(P^{-1}CP\) from the particular row-basis convention. The determinant of \(P\) is a unit of the base ring. Factor order and that condition carry the meaning; a nonzero determinant alone does not give the same result over an arbitrary ring.

po parah vzajemno proste

Iztočnik / Source: paarweise teilerfremd

Rusky / Russian: попарно взаимно просты; попарно взаимно простые

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: попарно взаємно прості

Razlog: Po parah vzajemno proste čuva uslovje za vsaku dvojicu, ne samo za cěly zbir faktorov. Tri zapisy daju tri svęzane razloge: prozračnu frazu vměsto zgustnjenogo pridavnika, matematičnu ulogu pri direktnom razloženju i doslědnost medžu paragrafami. V rabotě 31 ista fraza nastupaje pri idealah, pri nerazložimyh polinomah i pri primarnyh komponentah. To ne čini te objekte identičnymi: pri polinomah nad poljem prostota garantuje odgovarjajuče razloženje ostatkovogo prstena, a pri idealah trěba čitati ih srodnu definiciju. Dodatok po parah ne možno izostaviti. Arhiv ne dava čislove težiny niti nazyvaje konkretny kratši pridavnik, ktory byl odvrgnuty.

Reason: Po parah vzajemno proste preserves a condition on every pair, not merely on the whole collection of factors. Three records give related reasons: a transparent phrase rather than a dense adjective, its mathematical role in direct decomposition, and consistency across sections. Paper 31 uses the phrase for ideals, irreducible polynomials and primary components. That does not identify the objects: coprimality of polynomials over a field supports the corresponding residue-ring decomposition, while ideals require their own definition. Po parah must not disappear. The archive gives no numerical weights and does not name the particular shorter adjective it rejected.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31 koristi istu frazu pri idealah i pri polinomah nad poljem. Uslovje prvogo roda v §3 čuva razpad na različne nerazložime faktory; razloženje ostatkovogo prstena ne slěduje samo iz slova nerazložimy. V §7 komponenty ponovno sut idealy.

Textual comparison: Paper 31 uses the same phrase for ideals and for polynomials over a field. The first-kind condition in §3 preserves factorization into distinct irreducible factors; the residue-ring decomposition does not follow from the word irreducible alone. In §7 the components are again ideals.

poparno vzaimno proste

Iztočnik / Source: paarweise teilerfremd

Rusky / Russian: попарно взаимно просты

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: попарно взаємно прості

Razlog: Poparno vzaimno proste jest ranějša forma frazy o vzajemnoj prostosti za vsaku dvojicu. Zapis upotrěbja prozračno slovjansko izrazjenje i prodolžaje ranějše razloženja idealov. Dostupna rabota 19 piše poparno vzajemno proste. Važnějša od toj razlike pisanja jest razlika medžu vzajemno prostymi i vzajemno relativno prostymi idealami: §6 definira relativnu prostost jednostrannym uslovjem; §8 izrično govori, že obratna implikacija ne drži. Zato podobne frazy ne sut slobodne sinonimy. Pri vzajemnoj prostosti suma dvoh idealov jest cěly prsten; upravo to podpiraje ravnost produkta i najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo. Glosarova doslědnost ne opravdava gubitok slova relativno tam, kde ono pripada definiciji.

Reason: Poparno vzaimno proste is an earlier form of the phrase requiring coprimality for every pair. Its record favors a transparent Slavic expression continuous with earlier ideal decompositions. The available Paper 19 spells it poparno vzajemno proste. More important than that spelling difference is the distinction between coprime and mutually relatively prime ideals: §6 defines relative primality by a directional condition; §8 explicitly says the converse implication fails. The similar phrases are not interchangeable synonyms. For coprime ideals their sum is the whole ring, which supports equality of product and least common multiple. Glossary consistency does not justify losing relativno where it belongs to the definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 19, §6, definira jednostrannu relativnu prostost. §8 oddělja od njej vzajemnu prostotu s jediničnym največšim občim děliteljem i daje priměr, gde obratna implikacija ne drži. To različenje mora ostati vidimo i pri ponovjenju frazy v nekomutativnom priměru §12.

Textual comparison: Paper 19, §6, defines directional relative primality. Section 8 distinguishes coprimality with unit greatest common divisor and gives an example where the converse implication fails. That distinction must remain visible when the phrase recurs in the noncommutative example of §12.

po parah vzajemno proste primarne ideale

Iztočnik / Source: paarweise teilerfremde Primärideale

Rusky / Russian: попарно взаимно простые первичные идеалы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: попарно взаємно прості первинні ідеали

Razlog: Po parah vzajemno proste primarne ideale sodrživaje dva nezavisne uslovja: vsaky faktor jest primarny, a vsaka dvojica jest vzajemno prosta. Arhiv izrično čuva vtory uslovje, ibo on dopuščaje zaměniti najmenše obče mnogokratno produktom. V rabotě 31, §2, konečny rang dava dvojno uslovje cěpov; s jediničnym elementom ono vodi k takomu razloženju. Ne tvrdži se, že vsako primarno razloženje v libovoljnom prstenu jest po parah vzajemno prosto. Arhivna forma ideale ne jest osnovou za mehaničnu pravopisnu zaměnu nyněšnjih padežnyh form. Slovnik čuva i primarnost, i dvojicovost, i uslovja prstena.

Reason: Po parah vzajemno proste primarne ideale contains two separate conditions: each factor is primary, and each pair is coprime. The record explicitly preserves the latter because it permits replacing the least common multiple by the product. In Paper 31, §2, finite rank gives the double chain condition, which, with an identity element, leads to this decomposition. It does not say every primary decomposition in an arbitrary ring is pairwise coprime. The archival ideale spelling is not a basis for mechanically replacing current inflected forms. The dictionary preserves primaryness, the pairwise quantifier and the ring hypotheses.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 30 povězuje produktnu formu s dvojicovoju vzajemnoju prostotoju; teorema V takože trěbuje komutativnost, jedinicu i dvojno uslovje cěpov. Rabota 31 dobyva to uslovje iz konečnogo ranga. Nijedny iz tyh korakov ne možno zaměniti samym pridavnikom primarny.

Textual comparison: Paper 30 connects product form to pairwise coprimality; Theorem V also requires commutativity, an identity and the double chain condition. Paper 31 obtains the chain condition from finite rank. None of these steps can be replaced by the adjective primary alone.

poparno vzaimno proste primarne idealy

Iztočnik / Source: paarweise teilerfremde Primärideale

Rusky / Russian: попарно взаимно простые первичные идеалы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: попарно взаємно прості первинні ідеали

Razlog: Poparno vzaimno proste primarne idealy povězuje tri svojstva bez ih slivanja. Arhivny razlog odkazuje na teoremu V raboty 30: pod dvojnym uslovjem cěpov i pri jedinici različne pridružene proste idealy sut vzajemno proste, zato i primarne komponenty imajut to svojstvo. Togda prědstavjenje najmenšim občim mnogokratnym stava produktnym. Sam fakt, že dva proste idealy sut različne, ne dava takogo zaključka bez ukazanyh prědpoloženij. Dostupny tekst piše vzajemno. Ta pravopisna razlika ostavaje oddělena od matematičnogo razloga, kako i alternativa po parah vměsto poparno. Nikakve čislove važnosti medžu tymi formami ne sut zachovane.

Reason: Poparno vzaimno proste primarne idealy joins three properties without conflating them. The recorded reason invokes Theorem V of Paper 30: under the double chain condition and with an identity, distinct associated prime ideals are coprime, and the primary components inherit that property. A least-common-multiple representation then becomes a product representation. Distinctness of two prime ideals alone does not establish this conclusion without the stated hypotheses. The available text spells vzajemno. That spelling difference remains separate from the mathematical reason, as does the choice of po parah rather than poparno. No numerical weighting between these forms is preserved.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 30 povězuje produktnu formu s dvojicovoju vzajemnoju prostotoju; teorema V takože trěbuje komutativnost, jedinicu i dvojno uslovje cěpov. Rabota 31 dobyva to uslovje iz konečnogo ranga. Nijedny iz tyh korakov ne možno zaměniti samym pridavnikom primarny.

Textual comparison: Paper 30 connects product form to pairwise coprimality; Theorem V also requires commutativity, an identity and the double chain condition. Paper 31 obtains the chain condition from finite rank. None of these steps can be replaced by the adjective primary alone.

po parah vzajemno proste primarne komponenty

Iztočnik / Source: paarweise teilerfremde Primärkomponenten

Rusky / Russian: попарно взаимно простые первичные компоненты

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: попарно взаємно прості первинні компоненти

Razlog: Po parah vzajemno proste primarne komponenty prodolžaje terminologiju raboty 31, §7, v občem diskriminantnom teoremu §8. Razlog davaje prědnost prozračnoj slovjanskoj frazě radi očěkuvanoj razumlivosti za češske, slovačske i poljske čitatelje; ne prědstavjaje izměreny čitateljski rezultat i ne nazyvaje točny kratši internacionalny konkurent. V teoremu komponenty sut idealy v nadprstenu. Uslovje, že prinajmenje jedna jest vlastno primarna ili prosty ideal drugogo roda, mora ostati različne od jih po-parnoj vzajemnoj prostosti. Nazvanje komponenty ne može samo zaměniti dokaz takogo razloženja. Ni primarny ne znači vsegda prosty.

Reason: Po parah vzajemno proste primarne komponenty carries the terminology of Paper 31, §7, into the general discriminant theorem of §8. The reason prefers a transparent Slavic phrase for anticipated Czech, Slovak and Polish comprehension; it reports no measured reader result and names no exact shorter international competitor. The theorem’s components are ideals in the overring. Its condition that at least one is properly primary or a prime ideal of the second kind must remain distinct from their pairwise coprimality. The word component cannot itself replace proof of that decomposition. Nor does primary always mean prime.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odlomky raboty 31, §§7-8, čuvajut po-parnu prostotu komponentov i odděleno uslovje, že pojavjaje se prinajmenje jedna vlastno primarna komponenta ili prosty ideal drugogo roda. Svez ili i kvantifikator prinajmenje jedna sut česti tvrdženja.

Textual comparison: The passages in Paper 31, §§7-8, retain pairwise coprimality of components and the separate condition that at least one properly primary component or prime ideal of the second kind occurs. The disjunction and at-least-one quantifier are parts of the assertion.

paralelno prěnešenje vektora

Iztočnik / Source: parallele Vektorübertragung

Rusky / Russian: параллельное перенесение вектора

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: паралельне перенесення вектора

Razlog: Paralelno prěnešenje vektora daje slovjansko nazvanje tehničnomu ponjatju paralelnogo transporta. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela imajut srodny glagolni korenj; arhiv ipak izrično ostavjaje izbor medžu prěnešenje i internacionalnoju semjeju transport otvorenym k jezykovoj ocěnki. V rabotě 21 nazvanje povězano jest s uslovjem \(p(d,\delta)=0\) i s geometričnym tolkovanjem Levi-Civity. Ne ide o proizvoljno poměščenje vektora ni prosto o pravu liniju v izbranyh koordinatah. Tekst razlikuje variacionnu osnovu i Weylovo obobčenje, kde odgovarjajuča geodezična uslovja ne izhode več iz istej variacionnoj zadači. Slovnik ne smije činiti vse te konstrukcije identičnymi samo radi odnogo nazvanja.

Reason: Paralelno prěnešenje vektora gives a Slavic name to the technical notion of parallel transport. Russian and Ukrainian use a related transfer stem; the archive nevertheless explicitly leaves prěnešenje versus the international transport family open to linguistic assessment. In Paper 21 the name is tied to \(p(d,\delta)=0\) and Levi-Civita’s geometric interpretation. It is not arbitrary relocation of a vector or simply a straight line in chosen coordinates. The text distinguishes the variational setting from Weyl’s generalization, where the corresponding geodesic condition no longer follows from the same variational problem. A shared name must not identify all these constructions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 21 povězuje prěnešenje s uslovjem \(p(d,\delta)=0\). Vyvod trěbuje diferenciranja prěd eliminacijeju, a Weylovo obobčenje ne daje istu variacionnu osnovu. Nazvanje transporta ne uklanjaje te razlike konstrukcije.

Textual comparison: Paper 21 connects transport to \(p(d,\delta)=0\). The derivation requires differentiation before elimination, and Weyl’s generalization does not supply the same variational foundation. The transport label does not remove these differences of construction.

parametrično predstavjenje

Iztočnik / Source: Parameterdarstellung

Rusky / Russian: параметрическое представление

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: параметричне подання

Razlog: Parametrično predstavjenje označaje racionalnu konstrukciju jednačenij pomoču parametrov, ne prilagodženje čislovyh koeficientov k danym. To jest izričny arhivny razlog. V rabotě 5 konstrukcija zavisi od byta minimalnoj bazy pripadajučeho invariantnogo polja i od koeficientnoj oblasti. Najprostejši priměr jest obče jednačenje s neoprěděljenymi koeficientami. Zato fraza ne obeščaje bezuslovno rěšenje za vsaku grupu. Rusko predstavlenie i ukrajinsko podannja pokazyvajut različne prirodne nazvanja istej uloge; ne ustanavjajut jediny dopustimy medžuslovjansky korenj. Dostupny tekst piše prědstavjenje, a rabota 11 koristi pridavnik parametrno; pravopisny i tvorbeny izbori ostavajut oddělene od algebraičnogo smysla.

Reason: Parametrično predstavjenje denotes rational construction of equations through parameters, not numerical fitting of coefficients to data. That is the explicit archived motivation. In Paper 5 the construction depends on a minimal basis of the associated invariant field and on the coefficient domain. The simplest example is the general equation with indeterminate coefficients. The phrase therefore promises no unconditional solution for every group. Russian predstavlenie and Ukrainian podannja illustrate different natural names for the same role; they do not establish one uniquely admissible Interslavic stem. The available text spells prědstavjenje, while Paper 11 uses the adjective parametrno; orthographic and derivational choices remain separate from the algebraic sense.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 5 i 11 povězujut parametre s minimalnoju bazoju invariantnogo polja i s prědstavjenjem jednačenij. Množstvo primerov, polna familija i singularne izključky ne sut isto. Drugo popravjenje raboty 16 dalje ograničaje osnovnu oblast; slovnično objasnjenje mora ukazati tu granicu bez molčalivoj proměny ranějšego izdanja.

Textual comparison: Papers 5 and 11 connect parameters with a minimal basis of the invariant field and a presentation of equations. Many examples, a whole family and singular exceptions are different claims. Paper 16’s second correction further restricts the base domain; the dictionary must explain that boundary without silently changing the earlier edition.

parametrno predstavjenje

Iztočnik / Source: Parameterdarstellung

Rusky / Russian: параметрическое представление

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: параметричне подання

Razlog: Parametrno predstavjenje ma izražati koeficienty ili korenje kako funkcije parametrov, ne samo davati jim nove oznaky. Arhivny razlog čuva tu konstrukcijnu ulogu i paralelnost prěvodov. Rabota 11 razlikuje obstojanje mnogo jednačenij od obhvačenja cěloj zadanoj familije; ona takože ograničaje prědstavjenje radi singularnyh cěnnostij. Pozdějše avtorovo popravjenje v rabotě 16 izrično sužuje uslovja na osnovnu oblast pri Hilbertovom teoremu: konečno algebraično čislovo polje, s navedenym razširjenjem obsega uvoda. V uvodu dopusčaje takože adjunkciju konečno mnogyh parametrov i medžupolja takovyh razširjenij. To ograničenje ne smije izgubiti se v slovničnom objasnjenju. Izbor parametrno proti parametrično jest tvorbena tema; on ne rěšaje ni polnotu konstrukcije, ni potrěbne uslovja na polje.

Reason: Parametrno predstavjenje expresses coefficients or roots as functions of parameters, rather than merely assigning them new symbols. The recorded reason preserves that constructive role and parallel wording across translations. Paper 11 distinguishes existence of many equations from coverage of the whole specified family and also restricts the presentation because of singular values. The later authorial correction in Paper 16 expressly narrows the base-domain conditions for Hilbert’s theorem to a finite algebraic number field. For the introduction, it also permits adjoining finitely many parameters and taking intermediate fields of such extensions. This restriction must not disappear from the dictionary’s explanation. Parametrno versus parametrično is a derivational choice; it settles neither completeness of the construction nor the necessary field hypotheses.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Raboty 5 i 11 povězujut parametre s minimalnoju bazoju invariantnogo polja i s prědstavjenjem jednačenij. Množstvo primerov, polna familija i singularne izključky ne sut isto. Drugo popravjenje raboty 16 dalje ograničaje osnovnu oblast; slovnično objasnjenje mora ukazati tu granicu bez molčalivoj proměny ranějšego izdanja.

Textual comparison: Papers 5 and 11 connect parameters with a minimal basis of the invariant field and a presentation of equations. Many examples, a whole family and singular exceptions are different claims. Paper 16’s second correction further restricts the base domain; the dictionary must explain that boundary without silently changing the earlier edition.

Peirceovo razloženje

Iztočnik / Source: Peircesche Zerlegung

Rusky / Russian: разложение Пирса

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розклад Пірса

Razlog: Peirceovo razloženje čuva ime pri nazvanom algebraičnom razloženju. Arhiv izbiraje prisvojny pridavnik vměsto transliterovanej imennej frazy; v ruskom i ukrajinskom zapisu ime stoji v genitivu. V rabotě 34, §13, ide o jednostrannom razloženju \(r=cr+(r-cr)\), kde \(c^2=c\). Jedna čest leži v pravom idealu porodženom \(c\), a drugu \(c\) anuliraje. To ne jest utvrždenje, že oba sumandy sut dvustranne idealy; ni ne potrěbuje molčalivo napisati \(1-c\) v prstenu, ktoremu jedinica ješče ne jest dokazana. Slovnik mora čuvati jednostrannost i ulogu idempotenta, ne samo eponim.

Reason: Peirceovo razloženje preserves the name of the algebraic decomposition. The archive chooses a possessive adjective instead of a transliterated noun phrase; Russian and Ukrainian use the name in a genitive construction. In Paper 34, §13, the passage concerns the one-sided decomposition \(r=cr+(r-cr)\) with \(c^2=c\). One part lies in the right ideal generated by \(c\), and the other is annihilated by \(c\). This does not assert that both summands are two-sided ideals, nor does it license silently writing \(1-c\) in a ring whose identity has not yet been established. The dictionary must preserve one-sidedness and the idempotent’s role, not just the eponym.
