Razlog: Prost vzhodno k / vzaimno prosty zapisuje dva odnosa, ne dva ravnoznačna izraza. V rabotě 30 prostost po odnošenju k idealu znači, že idealny kvocient ne měnja toj ideal; vzajemna prostost kako děliteljev jest druga definicija. Arhiv izrično čuva razlikovanje do teorema V, kde pri jediničnom elementu i dvojnym uslovju cěpov pojmy sběgajut se. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože čuvajut odnositelnu i vzajemnu konstrukciju. Zato kratši obči izraz vzaimno prosty ne može zaměniti vse pojavjenja. Starše vzhodno k jest arhivna forma; dostupny tekst ima po odnošenju k, čiji osobny razlog jest opisan v heslu o toj predložnoj konstrukciji. Novy slovnik mora pokazati i smysl, i razliku medžu arhivnoju i aktualnoju formoju.

Reason: Prost vzhodno k / vzaimno prosty records two relations, not two equivalent expressions. In Paper 30, being prime with respect to an ideal means that taking the ideal quotient leaves that ideal unchanged; being coprime as divisors has a different definition. The record expressly preserves the distinction until Theorem V, where identity and the double chain condition make the notions coincide. Russian and Ukrainian likewise retain relational and mutual constructions. A shorter blanket translation as vzaimno prosty would therefore lose information. Vzhodno k is the older recorded wording; the available text uses po odnošenju k, whose separate rationale is explained in the entry on that prepositional construction. The dictionary must preserve both the meaning and the difference between recorded and current wording.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Idealny kvocient oprědělja napravljenje odnosa. Sběženje s vzajemnoju prostostoju jest pozdnějši rezultat pod silnějšimi uslovjami, ne početkova ravnoznačnost slov.

Textual comparison: The ideal quotient fixes the direction of the relation. Coincidence with coprimeness is a later result under stronger assumptions, not an initial equivalence of words.

prost vzhodno k \(a\) / vzaimno proste v tom smyslu

Iztočnik / Source: prim zu \(a\) / gegenseitig prim

Rusky / Russian: прост относительно \(a\) / взаимно просты в этом смысле

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: простий щодо \(a\) / взаємно прості в цьому сенсі

Razlog: Prost vzhodno k \(a\) / vzaimno proste v tom smyslu čuva napravljenje odnosa. V točnoj definiciji raboty 30, §5, ravnost \(\mathfrak a:\mathfrak b=\mathfrak a\) kaže, že \(\mathfrak b\) jest prost po odnošenju k \(\mathfrak a\), ne obratno. Vzajemnost trěbuje oba napravljenja. Dodatok v tom smyslu oddělja toj pojem od raněje definiranoj vzajemnoj prostosti kako děliteljev; v obščem slučaju tekst dava samo implikaciju od poslednje k prvoj. Zapisany izbor zato plača dolžinoju frazy za točnost odnosa. Arhivno obične \(a\) ostaje tak v zaglavju, dokole sravnjena formula upotrěbljaje frakturu. Aktualno po odnošenju k ne opravdava tiho prěpisanje staršego vzhodno k v historijnoj tabeli.

Reason: Prost vzhodno k \(a\) / vzaimno proste v tom smyslu preserves the direction of the relation. In the exact definition in Paper 30, §5, \(\mathfrak a:\mathfrak b=\mathfrak a\) says that \(\mathfrak b\) is prime with respect to \(\mathfrak a\), not the reverse. Mutuality requires both directions. The qualification v tom smyslu distinguishes this notion from coprimeness as divisors, defined earlier; in general the text gives only the implication from the latter to the former. The recorded choice thus accepts a longer phrase to preserve relational precision. The archive’s plain \(a\) remains in the headword, while the compared formula uses fraktur. Current po odnošenju k does not justify silently rewriting historical vzhodno k in the comparison table.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Idealny kvocient oprědělja napravljenje odnosa. Sběženje s vzajemnoju prostostoju jest pozdnějši rezultat pod silnějšimi uslovjami, ne početkova ravnoznačnost slov.

Textual comparison: The ideal quotient fixes the direction of the relation. Coincidence with coprimeness is a later result under stronger assumptions, not an initial equivalence of words.

nerazložimy polinom

Iztočnik / Source: Primfunktion

Rusky / Russian: неприводимый многочлен

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: незвідний многочлен

Razlog: Nerazložimy polinom jest vědomo osuvremenjenje německogo Primfunktion v Štejnicovoj definiciji citovanoj v rabotě 31. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože imenujut polinom i jego nerazložimost, ne obču funkciju. Zapis dava prednost razumlivosti dlja sovremennogo algebraista, ale ne navodi čitateljsky test. Definicija razširjenja prvogo roda trěbuje, že vsaky element jest nulja takogo polinoma i že v vhodnom razširjenju polinom ima različne linearne faktory. Sama nerazložimost ne vključaje poslednje uslovje. Literalno prosta funkcija jest zachovano v drugyh rabotah; to različje politika po kontekstu mora objasniti, ne skryti pod jedinom obščim prěvodom.

Reason: Nerazložimy polinom deliberately modernizes German Primfunktion in the Steinitz definition cited in Paper 31. Russian and Ukrainian likewise name a polynomial and its irreducibility rather than a function in general. The record prioritizes readability for present-day algebraists but supplies no reader test. The definition of an extension of the first kind requires every element to be a root of such a polynomial, which must split into distinct linear factors in a suitable extension. Irreducibility alone does not include the latter condition. The literal prosta funkcija is retained elsewhere in the corpus; a context-sensitive policy must explain that difference rather than conceal it beneath one universal translation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Štejnicova definicija vyžaduje nerazložimy polinom i različne linearne faktory po vhodnom razširjenju. Ostatkovo polje prostogo ideala daje kontekst definicije.

Textual comparison: The Steinitz definition requires an irreducible polynomial and distinct linear factors after suitable extension. The residue field of a prime ideal supplies the context.

prosta funkcija

Iztočnik / Source: Primfunktion

Rusky / Russian: простая функция

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: проста функція

Razlog: Prosta funkcija čuva historijnu analogiju medžu polinomom i prostym idealom. To jest izričny razlog v zapisu raboty 24; ruska i ukrajinska paralela slědujut toj samoj literalnoj formě. Tekst definira izraz kako polinom nerazložimy nad \(P(u)\), takže prosta tu ne znači lehka i ne označaje prostyh funkcij iz teorije měry. Prednost jest vidima paralela s idealami; cena jest potrěba čitati definiciju, zato že samo zaglavje ne kaže polinom. Alternativa nerazložimy polinom, izbrana v rabotě 31, čini objekt neposrědněje vidimym. Obe strategije sut zapisane v korpusu; slovnik ne predstavlja jih kako dva različna matematična objekta v tom kontekstu.

Reason: Prosta funkcija retains the historical analogy between a polynomial and a prime ideal. That is the explicit reason in the Paper 24 record; Russian and Ukrainian follow the same literal wording. The text defines the expression as a polynomial irreducible over \(P(u)\), so prosta means neither easy nor a simple function in measure theory. The advantage is a visible parallel with ideals; the cost is reliance on the definition, because the headword alone does not identify a polynomial. Nerazložimy polinom, chosen in Paper 31, makes the object more immediately explicit. Both strategies are recorded in the corpus; the dictionary does not treat them as different mathematical objects in this context.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Literalna funkcija tu jest polinom nad ukazanym poljem. Primarna funkcija jest njegova stepenj; vlastna primarna funkcija ne jest prosta. Množinnost korenja i stepenj polinoma ostavajut različne veličiny.

Textual comparison: Literal function here denotes a polynomial over the specified field. A primary function is a power of a prime function; a properly primary function is not prime. Root multiplicity and polynomial degree remain different quantities.

ireducibilna funkcija / ireducibilne faktory

Iztočnik / Source: Primfunktion / Primfaktoren

Rusky / Russian: неприводимая функция / неприводимые множители

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: незвідна функція / незвідні множники

Razlog: Ireducibilna funkcija / ireducibilne faktory osuvremenjuje Primfunktion i Primfaktoren v determinantnom odlomku raboty 34. Zapis dava internacionalnomu ireducibilny prednost zaradi kontinuiteta s jezykom teorije prědstavjenj; ruska i ukrajinska paralela upotrěbljajut svoje izrazy za nerazložimost. To ne jest tvrdženje, že polinomna nerazložimost i ireducibilnost prědstavjenja sut jedna definicija. Tekst povezuje je prěz determinanty blokov i pri algebraično zamknjenom osnovnom polju pokazuje nerazložime, medžu soboju različne faktory za neekvivalentne prědstavjenja. Uslovje o polju ostaje potrěbno. Arhiv ne dava čislenogo sravnjenja s nerazložimy; kontinuitet jest kvalitativny razlog, ne izměrena jezyčna prevaga.

Reason: Ireducibilna funkcija / ireducibilne faktory modernizes Primfunktion and Primfaktoren in the determinant passage of Paper 34. The record favours international ireducibilny for continuity with representation-theoretic vocabulary; Russian and Ukrainian use their expressions for irreducibility. This does not mean that polynomial irreducibility and irreducibility of a representation have one definition. The text connects them through block determinants and, over an algebraically closed base field, obtains irreducible, mutually distinct factors for inequivalent representations. The field hypothesis remains essential. The record gives no numerical comparison with nerazložimy; continuity is a qualitative reason, not a measured linguistic advantage.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razloženje prědstavjenja dava determinantne faktory. Tvrdženje o jih nerazložimosti i različnosti izrično koristi algebraično zamknjeno osnovno polje; slovny korenj sam to uslovje ne nese.

Textual comparison: Decomposing the representation gives determinant factors. Their irreducibility and distinctness expressly use an algebraically closed base field; the shared lexical stem does not carry that hypothesis by itself.

prosta funkcija / primarna funkcija

Iztočnik / Source: Primfunktion / Primärfunktion

Rusky / Russian: простая функция / первичная функция

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: проста функція / первинна функція

Razlog: Prosta funkcija / primarna funkcija čuva paru, ktora v rabotah 24 i 25 prěnosi se od polinomov k idealam. Prva jest nerazložimy polinom nad danom poljem, druga stepenj takogo polinoma; vlastna primarna funkcija ima stepenj vyšu od prve. Arhiv bira internacionalno primarna vměsto nove domašnej kovanice, ale ne imenuje tu kovanicu. Zato ne možno dodati izmišljenu tabelu kandidatov. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela čuvajut prost-/pervičn- odnosno prost-/pervyn- razlikovanje. Teoremy XII i XIII raboty 24 činjut razlikovanje nositelem argumenta: norma prostogo ideala jest prosta funkcija pod dodatnym uslovjem doskonalosti polja, ne bez njega. Nad nedoskonalym poljem norma može byti viša stepenj. Terminologična paralela ne dozvaljaje izbrisati to uslovje.

Reason: Prosta funkcija / primarna funkcija retains a pair carried from polynomials to ideals in Papers 24 and 25. The first is an irreducible polynomial over the specified field; the second is a power of one; a properly primary function has exponent greater than one. The record chooses international primarna instead of a new native coinage but does not name that coinage. An invented candidate table would therefore be inappropriate. Russian and Ukrainian preserve their prime/primary contrasts. The distinction is load-bearing in Theorems XII and XIII of Paper 24: a prime ideal’s norm is a prime function under the additional perfect-field hypothesis, not without it. Over an imperfect field the norm can be a higher power. The terminological parallel does not permit deletion of that hypothesis.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Literalna funkcija tu jest polinom nad ukazanym poljem. Primarna funkcija jest njegova stepenj; vlastna primarna funkcija ne jest prosta. Množinnost korenja i stepenj polinoma ostavajut različne veličiny.

Textual comparison: Literal function here denotes a polynomial over the specified field. A primary function is a power of a prime function; a properly primary function is not prime. Root multiplicity and polynomial degree remain different quantities.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem XIII daje prime/primary paralelu za normy nad doskonalym poljem. Teorem XIV i slědujuče priměry čuvajut izključenja nad nedoskonalym poljem.

Textual comparison: Theorem XIII gives the prime/primary parallel for norms over a perfect field. Theorem XIV and the following examples retain the exceptions over an imperfect field.

nerazložimy polinom prvogo roda

Iztočnik / Source: Primfunktion erster Art

Rusky / Russian: неприводимый многочлен первого рода

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: незвідний многочлен першого роду

Razlog: Nerazložimy polinom prvogo roda prodolžaje izrično zapisano osuvremenjenje Primfunktion iz raboty 31, §2. Prvogo roda znači v tom odlomku separabilnost: po razširjenju polja polinom razpada se bez povtorenyh korenjev. V §3 tekst najprvo piše polje kako \(P[x]/f(x)\), potom razširjaje koeficienty do \(Q\). Ireducibilnost \(f\) ne musi ostati nad \(Q\); jego nove nerazložime faktory ostavajut parno vzajemno proste. Zato prvogo roda ne znači prvogo stepena i ne obešča, že polinom ostaje nerazložimy nad vsakym poljem. Isty modernizujuči izbor v ruskoj i ukrajinskoj paraleli pomaga vyjavniti objekt, ale ne zaměnjaje definiciju prědanogo historijnogo kvalifikatora.

Reason: Nerazložimy polinom prvogo roda continues the explicitly recorded modernization of Primfunktion in Paper 31, §2. First kind here expresses separability: after field extension the polynomial splits without repeated roots. In §3 the text first writes a field as \(P[x]/f(x)\), then extends coefficients to \(Q\). Irreducibility of \(f\) need not survive over \(Q\); its new irreducible factors remain pairwise coprime. Thus prvogo roda means neither first degree nor irreducibility over every field. The same modernizing choice in the Russian and Ukrainian parallels helps identify the object but cannot replace the definition of the retained historical qualifier.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Polinom, nerazložimy nad \(P\), može razpasti se nad \(Q\). Prvi rod garantuje različne faktory, ne obšču neproměnnost nerazložimosti.

Textual comparison: A polynomial irreducible over \(P\) may factor over \(Q\). First kind guarantees distinct factors, not universal preservation of irreducibility.

prosta funkcija prvogo roda

Iztočnik / Source: Primfunktion erster Art

Rusky / Russian: простая функция первого рода

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: проста функція першого роду

Razlog: Prosta funkcija prvogo roda čuva jezyk raboty 24 i njegovu paralelu s prostymi idealami. Prvogo roda dodava uslovje o različnyh korenjah; ne jest samo ukras k prostoj funkciji. Lema V dokazuje to svojstvo dlja formy elementarnyh děliteljev prostogo ideala pri doskonalom osnovnom polju. Slědujuči odstavek izrično upozornja, že dodanje neoprěděljenyh može dati nedoskonalo racionalno funkcionalno polje v pozitivnoj karakteristice. Zato rezultat ne jest neposrědny poslědok tvrdženja, že osnovno polje jest doskonalo; tekst trěbuje osobny argument. Zapis bira kontinuitet s ranějšimi definicijami, dokole alternativa nerazložimy polinom prvogo roda v rabotě 31 vyjavnja polinom v samom nazvanju.

Reason: Prosta funkcija prvogo roda preserves Paper 24’s vocabulary and its parallel with prime ideals. First kind adds the distinct-root condition; it is not an ornamental addition to prime function. Lemma V establishes this property for the elementary-divisor form of a prime ideal over a perfect base field. The following paragraph expressly warns that adjoining indeterminates can produce an imperfect rational function field in positive characteristic. The result therefore does not follow immediately from perfection of the base field; the text needs a separate argument. The recorded choice favours continuity with earlier definitions, whereas nerazložimy polinom prvogo roda in Paper 31 identifies the polynomial directly in its name.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dostupny dokaz izrično oddělja doskonalo osnovno polje od racionalnogo funkcionalnogo razširjenja, ktoro može byti nedoskonalo. Lema jest potrěbna dlja danej formy.

Textual comparison: The available proof expressly distinguishes the perfect base field from the rational function extension, which can be imperfect. The lemma is needed for the particular form.

nerazložimy polinom drugogo roda

Iztočnik / Source: Primfunktion zweiter Art

Rusky / Russian: неприводимый многочлен второго рода

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: незвідний многочлен другого роду

Razlog: Nerazložimy polinom drugogo roda prodolžaje modernizaciju Primfunktion, ale čuva historijnu opoziciju prvogo i drugogo roda. V priměru raboty 31 polinom \(t^2-x\) nad ukazanym poljem karakteristiki \(2\) jest nerazložimy, no neseparabilny. Zato ostatkovy prsten jest polje, ale razširjenje jest drugogo roda. To ne znači polinom drugogo stepena: stepenj \(2\) pripada priměru, ne definiciji drugogo roda. Arhiv izrično dava toj formě prednost prěd literalnoju prostoju funkcijeju zaradi jasnosti ostatkovogo polinomnogo priměra. Teorem o diskriminantu odliča takovu prostu komponentu od vlastno primarnoj komponenty; ni jedna ne směje byti tiho zaměnjena drugoju.

Reason: Nerazložimy polinom drugogo roda continues the modernization of Primfunktion while retaining the historical first-kind/second-kind opposition. In Paper 31’s example, \(t^2-x\) over the specified characteristic-\(2\) field is irreducible but inseparable. The quotient ring is therefore a field, yet the extension is of the second kind. This does not mean a polynomial of second degree: degree two belongs to the example, not the definition of second kind. The record expressly prefers this wording to literal prosta funkcija for clarity in the residue-polynomial example. The discriminant theorem distinguishes such a prime component from a properly primary component; neither may silently replace the other.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Priměr \(t^2-x\) v karakteristice \(2\) oddělja nerazložimost od separabilnosti. Teorem rozlišuje prostu komponentu drugogo roda od vlastno primarnoj komponenty.

Textual comparison: The characteristic-\(2\) example \(t^2-x\) separates irreducibility from separability. The theorem distinguishes a prime component of the second kind from a properly primary component.

prosta grupa

Iztočnik / Source: Primgruppe

Rusky / Russian: простая группа

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: проста група

Razlog: Prosta grupa prěnosi Primgruppe, ale jej smysl trěbuje definiciju raboty 17. Tu jest to grupa ostatkov modula, ktory ne ima drugyh děliteljev kromě samogo sebe i polnogo jediničnogo modula. Arhiv izrično upozornja na riziko anahroničnogo čitanja kako sovremennoj abstraktnoj proste grupy bez netrivialnyh normalnyh podgrup. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela čuvajut isto kratko nazvanje; cena jest potrěba držati modulnu strukturu i dopustime operacije vidimymi. Tekst dodava, že takove proste grupy mogut byti beskonečne i že sut ireducibilne v jeho smyslu. Slovnik ne prěnosi ty tvrdženja na libovoljnu modernu kategoriju grup. Kontinuitet historijnogo nazvanja jest opravdanje izbora, ne dokaz ravnoznačnosti vsego slova prosty.

Reason: Prosta grupa translates Primgruppe, but its meaning requires Paper 17’s definition. Here it is the residue group of a module having no divisors other than itself and the full unit module. The record expressly warns against an anachronistic reading as a modern abstract simple group with no nontrivial normal subgroups. Russian and Ukrainian retain the same short name; the cost is that the module structure and admissible operations must remain visible. The text adds that these simple groups can be infinite and are irreducible in its sense. The dictionary does not transfer those statements to an arbitrary modern category of groups. Continuity of the historical name motivates the choice, not equivalence of every use of prosty.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija počina modulnymi děliteljami i potom nazyvaje grupu ostatkov prostoju. To jest kontrola historijnogo smysla, ne dovoljenje uvoziti lubovoljnu modernu definiciju proste grupy.

Textual comparison: The definition begins with module divisors and then calls the residue group simple. This controls the historical sense; it does not license importing an arbitrary modern definition of simple group.

prosty element

Iztočnik / Source: Primgröße

Rusky / Russian: простой элемент

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: простий елемент

Razlog: Prosty element zaměnja literalnu prostu veličinu konkretnym algebraičnym objektom. Oba zapisa raboty 31 davajut toj modernizaciji prednost; ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože imajut element. §7 definira \(p\) takim, že glavny ideal, ktory on poraždaje v osnovnoj oblasti, jest prosty i različny od nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala. To ne kaže, že njegov razširjeny ideal ostaje prosty. V §8 po lokalizaciji element \(p\) poraždaje lokalny prosty ideal; element i ideal ne sut ista věč. Različny šrift i okolny prsten čuvajut razliku. Nerazložimy element ne jest avtomatična zaměna: pri obščem prstenu nerazložimost i prostost ne sut ista vlastnost.

Reason: Prosty element replaces literal prime magnitude with a concrete algebraic object. Both Paper 31 records favour that modernization; Russian and Ukrainian likewise use element. Section 7 defines \(p\) by requiring the principal ideal it generates in the base domain to be prime and different from the zero and unit ideals. This does not say that its extended ideal remains prime. In §8, after localization, an element \(p\) generates the local prime ideal; element and ideal are not the same object. Typography and the ambient ring preserve the distinction. Irreducible element is not an automatic substitute: in a general ring, irreducibility and primality are different properties.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Element \(p\) jest odličen od ideala, ktory poraždaje. Prostost v osnovnoj oblasti i ponašanje razširjenogo ideala sut različne tvrdžbe; lokalizacija pozdněje dava osobny generator.

Textual comparison: The element \(p\) is distinct from the ideal it generates. Primality in the base domain and the behaviour of the extended ideal are different assertions; localization later supplies a particular generator.

prosty element osnovnoj oblasti

Iztočnik / Source: Primgröße des Grundbereichs

Rusky / Russian: простой элемент основной области

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: простий елемент основної області

Razlog: Prosty element osnovnoj oblasti čuva ne samo izbor slova element za Größe, ale i město, kde prostost jest utvrdžena. Rabota 31 sravnjava osnovnu oblast s poredkom v razširjenom polju; element prosty v osnovnoj oblasti može v razširjenom poredku dati ideal s několiko primarnymi komponentami. Zato skračenje do prosty element bez konteksta može skryti potrěbnu razliku. Uvod povezuje dělitelje diskriminanta s vlastno primarnymi komponentami abo prostymi komponentami drugogo roda. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela čuvajut kvalifikator osnovnoj oblasti. Zapisany razlog jest semantična točnost i jasny osnovny objekt, ne tvrdženje, že každa osnovna oblast jest polje ili že vsaka komponenta jest prosta.

Reason: Prosty element osnovnoj oblasti preserves not only element for Größe but also where primality is asserted. Paper 31 compares the base domain with an order in an extension field; an element prime in the base domain can generate an ideal with several primary components in the extended order. Shortening the phrase to prime element without context can therefore hide a necessary distinction. The introduction relates discriminant divisors to properly primary components or prime components of the second kind. Russian and Ukrainian retain the base-domain qualifier. The recorded reason is semantic precision and an explicit base object, not a claim that every base domain is a field or every component prime.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvod i diskriminantny teorem označajut osnovnu oblast i razširjeny poredok. Kvalifikator osnovnoj oblasti čuva to napravljenje i razliku medžu prostym elementom i komponentami njegovogo razširjenogo ideala.

Textual comparison: The introduction and discriminant theorem identify the base domain and extended order. The base-domain qualifier preserves that direction and distinguishes a prime element from the components of its extended ideal.

prost ideal

Iztočnik / Source: Primideal

Rusky / Russian: простой идеал

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: простий ідеал

Razlog: Prost ideal jest kratka arhivna forma za Primideal v rabotě 24. Razlog jest stabilny algebraičny smysl i razlikovanje od primarnogo ideala; ruska i ukrajinska paralela imajut odgovarajuči prost- korenj. Definicija kaže, že ako produkt dvoh elementov leži v idealu, prinajmenje jeden faktor leži v njem. Pri primarnom idealu vměsto togo može byti potrěbna stepenj drugogo faktora. Zato primarny ne jest stilska razširjena forma od prosty. Arhivno prost i drugde zapisano prosty ne dokazuju dva koncepta; slovnik čuva razliku form bez izmišljanja matematičnoj razlike. Obča normativna tvrdžba zapisa sama po sobě ne dokumentuje nezavisnu konsultaciju vsih slovjanskyh tradicij.

Reason: Prost ideal is the short recorded form for Primideal in Paper 24. The reason is a stable algebraic meaning distinct from primary ideal; Russian and Ukrainian have the corresponding prost- stem. The definition says that if a product of two elements lies in the ideal, at least one factor lies in it. For a primary ideal, a power of the other factor may instead be required. Primarny is therefore not a stylistically expanded form of prosty. Recorded prost and the prosty found elsewhere do not establish two concepts; the dictionary preserves the difference in form without inventing a mathematical difference. The record’s general appeal to standard usage does not itself document independent consultation of all Slavic traditions.

prosty ideal

Ostrovskogo poslědok dopušča konečno mnogo izključenij pri redukciji modulo prosty ideal. Ostrowski’s consequence permits finitely many exceptions when reducing modulo a prime ideal. In Paper 31, primality of contraction follows from embedding the residue-class ring; this does not assert that extending every prime ideal preserves primality. In Paper 35, the relation ideal is prime because the homomorphic image has no zero divisors. Continuity of naming is the recorded reason, but it cannot replace those three different arguments and their hypotheses. The short prost ideal from Paper 24 remains a difference of form, not of concept.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tri odlomky koriste isti termin, ale različne argumenty: konečna izključenja pri redukciji, vloženje pri kontrakciji i otsutnost nulovyh děliteljev v homomorfnom obrazu. Njih uslovja ostavajut osobne.

prost ideal / vlastny primarny ideal

A reader must therefore not replace component by power merely because of that familiar special case. In Paper 31’s introduction, the ideal’s classification depends on the extension formed by its residue field over the image of the base field. Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: примітивні ідемпотентні елементи

Razlog: Primitivne idempotentne elementy čuva dva internacionalne termina s različnymi ulogami. Idempotentny govori o množenju elementa so soboju; primitivny tu označaje komponenty jedinice, povezane s prostymi jednostrannymi idealami pri direktnom razloženju. To jest zapisany razlog, ne značenje primitivny kako nerazvity. Rabota 32 dava razloženje \(S=rS+(e-r)S\), kde \(e\) jest jedinica; strana idealov ostaje važna. Uslovje \(r\ne0,1\) ne garantuje primitivnost v vsakom proizvoljnom prstenu: posebny zaključok teksta odnosi se k kvaternionnomu slučaju s indeksom dva. Reason: Primitivne idempotentne elementy retains two international terms with different roles. Idempotent describes multiplication of an element by itself; primitive here marks the components of the identity associated with simple one-sided ideals in a direct decomposition. That is the recorded reason, not primitive in the sense of undeveloped. Paper 32 gives \(S=rS+(e-r)S\), with \(e\) the identity; the side of the ideals remains important. The condition \(r\ne0,1\) does not guarantee primitivity in every arbitrary ring: the text’s special conclusion concerns the quaternion case with index two. Russian and Ukrainian retain the same international pair; the literature cited in the passage was not independently rechecked here.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Komponenty jedinice svazany sut s jednostrannym razloženjem. Specialny kvaternionny slučaj ne jest obča definicija primitivnosti.

Textual comparison: Components of the identity are linked to a one-sided decomposition. The special quaternion case is not a general definition of primitivity.

Ruska paralela koristi pervoobraznyj, ukrajinska primityvnyj: ne možno predstaviti je kako tri identične izbory. Primitivny označaje točny multiplikativny red \(p\), ne prosto proizvoljny korenj jednačenja \(z^p=1\). Rabota 32 izbira prosto čislo \(p\) s kongruencijnym uslovjem na \(2^r+1\) i potom koristi korenj \(\varepsilon\) v normnom argumentu za razpadno polje kvaternionnoj grupy. Indeks \(p\) i stepenj \(2^n\) razgledanogo podpolja imajut različne ulogi; ne sut dva zapisa iste veličiny.

Russian uses pervoobraznyj, Ukrainian primityvnyj: they cannot be presented as three identical choices. Primitive specifies exact multiplicative order \(p\), not an arbitrary solution of \(z^p=1\). Paper 32 selects a prime \(p\) satisfying a congruence condition on \(2^r+1\), then uses a root \(\varepsilon\) in a norm argument for a splitting field of the quaternion group. The index \(p\) and the degree \(2^n\) of the subfield have different roles; they are not two names for the same quantity.

Textual comparison: The root has exact order \(p\). The norm argument and choice of cyclic subfield retain separate conditions on \(p\), \(r\) and \(n\).

Rusky / Russian: примитивные многочлены

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: примітивні поліноми

Razlog: Primitivne polinomy jest kratky termin s izričnoju lokalnoju definicijeju: največši obči dělitelj koeficientov jest jedinica v osnovnom prstenu. Arhiv zato ne dodava parafrazu do samogo nazvanja; ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože koristajut primitiv- korenj. Rabota 30 izrično govori o dělitelju v polinomnom smyslu, ne idealnom, i dava osnovny prsten s jednoznačnym razloženjem. Primitivnost zato ne znači nerazložimost, moničnost ni minimalny stepenj. The record therefore adds no paraphrase to the name itself; Russian and Ukrainian also use the primitiv- stem. Paper 30 expressly means divisibility in the polynomial sense, not ideal divisibility, and supplies a base ring with unique factorization. Primitive therefore means neither irreducible, monic nor of least degree. Primitive denominators then define the functional domain. Removing the expression from this context without specifying the base ring could change its meaning.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Največši obči dělitelj koeficientov jest jedinica v ukazanom osnovnom prstenu. To jest druga vlastnost od nerazložimosti i služi dlja izbora imeniteljev.

Textual comparison: The coefficients’ greatest common divisor is a unit in the specified base ring. This differs from irreducibility and supplies the denominator condition.

Iztočnik / Source: Primkörper

Rusky / Russian: простое поле

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: первинне поле

Razlog: Prvotno polje jest projektov izbor za polje porodženo jediničnym elementom. Rusky zapis ima prostoe pole, ukrajinsky pervynne pole; ukrajinsky i medžuslovjansky izbor ostali označeni za autoritativnu jezyčnu prověrku. Tekst rabot 9 i 10 definira objekt operacijami nad jediniceju: nastava tip racionalnyh čisel ili ostatkovyh klasov modulo prosto \(p\). Ni starost polja, ni prostost algebraičnogo razširjenja ne sut smyslom prvotno. Novy slovnik čuva predběžnost izbora; ne predstavlja internu prevenciju dvosmysla kako dokazan obči slovjansky standard. Rabota 22 v dostupnom tekstu vsejedno ima prosto polje za isti objekt; to jest konkretno nesoglasje korpusa, ne dokaz, že jedno iz imen jest oficialno.

Reason: Prvotno polje is a project choice for the field generated by the multiplicative identity. The archive explicitly prefers it to prosto polje to distinguish the field structure from prosta karakteristika. Russian records prostoe pole, Ukrainian pervynne pole; the Ukrainian and Interslavic choices remained marked for authoritative language review. Papers 9 and 10 define the object through operations on the identity, producing the rational-number type or residue classes modulo a prime \(p\). Neither antiquity of the field nor simplicity of an algebraic extension is meant by prvotno. The dictionary retains the provisional status: an internal attempt to avoid ambiguity is not established pan-Slavic standard usage. prosty modul

Iztočnik / Source: Primmodul

Rusky / Russian: простой модуль

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: простий модуль

Arhiv bira prost- paralelno s ruskim i ukrajinskim, ale privjazuje slovo k toj definiciji, ne k libovoljnomu pozdnějšemu pojmu prostogo ideala. V historijnoj děliteljskoj terminologiji trěba čitati napravljenje vključenja; dělitelj ne jest prosto synonym slova podmodul bez objasnjenja. Grupa ostatkov potom nazyvaje se prosta grupa. Čuvanje kratkogo nazvanja zato trěbuje jasne definicije obojih objektov; ne opravdava preměnu modula v ideal ni odebranje operatornoj struktury.

The record chooses prost- in parallel with Russian and Ukrainian but ties the word to that definition, not an arbitrary later notion of prime ideal. Historical divisor terminology requires attention to inclusion direction; divisor cannot simply be treated as a synonym for submodule without explanation. The residue group is then called a simple group. Retaining the short name therefore requires clear definitions of both objects; it does not authorize turning the module into an ideal or removing its operator structure.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prosty modul jest oprěděljen děliteljami, a prosta grupa jeho ostatkovym objektom. Historijno nazvanje ostaje svazano s toj definicijeju.

Textual comparison: The prime module is defined through divisors, and the simple group as its residue object. The historical name remains tied to that definition.

primarny

Iztočnik / Source: primär

Rusky / Russian: примарный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: примарний

Razlog: Primarny čuva internacionalny primar- korenj vo vseh trěh arhivnyh paralelah raboty 19. Izričny razlog jest razlikovanje od prost- pri modernom algebraičnom izlaganju. Definicija III dopušča konečnu stepenj drugogo faktora, kogda produkt leži v idealu, a prvy faktor ne leži v njem; prosty slučaj ima stepenj jednu. Definicija IIIa prěnosi uslovje na produkty idealov pri danej konečnoj bazě. Teorem o nerazložimyh idealah dava primarnost, ale ne obrat bez dodatnyh uslovij. Zato primarny ne znači samo fundamentalny, prvy ili nerazložimy. Soglasnost zapisanyh paralel ne jest sama po sobě dokazom nezavisnoj konsultacije vseh jezyčnyh autoritetov.

Reason: Primarny retains the international primar- stem in all three archived parallels for Paper 19. The explicit reason is differentiation from prost- in modern algebraic exposition. Definition III allows a finite power of the other factor when a product lies in the ideal but the first factor does not; the prime case has exponent one. Definition IIIa transfers the condition to ideal products with the available finite basis. The theorem on irreducible ideals yields primaryness, but not the converse without additional conditions. Primarny therefore means neither merely fundamental, first nor irreducible. Agreement among the recorded parallels is not by itself evidence of independent consultation of all linguistic authorities.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Primarnost dopušča stepenj; prostost jest osobny slučaj. Nerazložimost implicira primarnost pri danyh uslovjah, ale obrat jest izrično oprovrgnuty priměrom.

Textual comparison: Primaryness allows a power; primality is a special case. Irreducibility implies primaryness under the stated conditions, but an explicit example refutes the converse.

primarne idealy / primarny faktor

Iztočnik / Source: primäre Ideale / primärer Faktor

Rusky / Russian: примарные идеалы / примарный множитель

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: примарні ідеали / примарний множник

Razlog: Primarne idealy / primarny faktor čuva primar- v rabotě 18 i jeho polinomnoj interpretaciji. Arhiv dava prednost internacionalnomu korenju prěd neimenovanym čisto slovjanskim izrazom, zaradi očekivanoj slabšej kanoničnosti poslednjego i rizika zaměšanja s prostym modulom. To jest kvalitativny sud; ne zachovano čisleno sravnjenje ni konkretna odbacena kovanica. V pasaži primarnomu idealu \(Q\) odpovědaje polinomny faktor \(Q^{(i)}\), s interpretacijeju normy komplementa po \(Q\). Podobna bukva i isto pridavno imę ne činjut ideal i polinom jednym objektom. The archive favours the international stem over an unnamed purely Slavic expression, anticipating weaker established usage and possible confusion with simple-module vocabulary. This is a qualitative judgement: neither numerical comparison nor a specific rejected coinage survives. In the passage, a primary ideal \(Q\) corresponds to a polynomial factor \(Q^{(i)}\), interpreted through the norm of the complement relative to \(Q\). Similar lettering and the shared adjective do not make ideal and polynomial one object. The mathematical connection motivates terminological parallelism, not substitution of one category for the other.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Normna interpretacija povezuje ideal s faktorom rezultantnoj formy. Ona ne utožsamjaje ideal s polinomom i čuva multiplicitet.

Textual comparison: The norm interpretation links an ideal with a factor of the resultant form. It does not identify ideal and polynomial, and preserves multiplicity.

To ne znači, že proizvoljno razširjenje primarnogo prstena ostaje primarno: ranějši §2 izrično dopušča protivny slučaj. The §6 opening reduces the discriminant calculation to primary components of the extended ring. This does not mean that an arbitrary extension of a primary ring remains primary: §2 expressly allows the contrary. The following special-basis construction uses powers of the nilpotent prime associated with zero. The same adjective connects these passages but does not remove the finite-rank and base-field conditions.

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: первинне кільце

Iztočnik / Source: Primärfunktion

Rusky / Russian: первичная функция

Maximal primary factors thus collect powers of the same irreducible factor, whereas a product of different such factors is no longer primary. primarna funkcija / prosta funkcija

Iztočnik / Source: Primärfunktion / Primfunktion

Rusky / Russian: первичная функция / простая функция

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: первинна функція / проста функція

Razlog: Primarna funkcija / prosta funkcija čuva opoziciju potrěbnu v teoremu IX raboty 24. Zapis ne dopušča složenje obojih pojmov v jedin. Teorem veže primarnost ideala s primarnostju njegove formy elementarnyh děliteljev, i zato normy; dokaz piše \(Q^{(i)}=(P^{(i)})^\rho\) s prostoju funkcijeju \(P^{(i)}\). Zapis eksponenta jest sučestveny, ne ukras. Tekst izrično ostavlja \(\rho=1\) i ne izključaje prosty ideal kako specialny slučaj. Silnějši normny kriterij za prostost trěbuje dodatne uslovja razgledane pozdněje. Zato slovnik čuva inkluziju prostogo slučaja v primarny bez utožsamjenja definicij.

Reason: Primarna funkcija / prosta funkcija preserves the opposition needed in Theorem IX of Paper 24. The record does not permit merging the two notions. The theorem relates primaryness of an ideal to that of its elementary-divisor form, and therefore its norm; the proof writes \(Q^{(i)}=(P^{(i)})^\rho\) with a prime function \(P^{(i)}\). The exponent is substantive, not decoration. The text expressly retains \(\rho=1\) and does not exclude a prime ideal as a special case. The stronger norm criterion for primality requires additional conditions considered later. The dictionary therefore preserves inclusion of the prime case within the primary case without identifying their definitions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem IX razlikuje prostu funkciju od njezinoj stepeni i izrično ne izključaje eksponent jednu. Inkluzija specialnogo slučaja ne znači identične definicije.

Textual comparison: Theorem IX distinguishes a prime function from its power and expressly leaves exponent one included. Inclusion of the special case does not mean identical definitions.

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема добутку для матриць

projektivna invarianta

Iztočnik / Source: projektive Invariante

Rusky / Russian: проективный инвариант

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: проєктивний інваріант

Razlog: Projektivna invarianta čuva internacionalny pridavnik i kratko matematično nazvanje. Točno prěobraženje i fiksovano město noset značenje pridavnika. Ne ide o projektivny modul ni o čislo, ktoro ostavaje neproměnjeno pod vsimi možnymi prěobraženjami. The archive describes the Russian and Ukrainian parallels as standard, but that record alone does not establish independent Interslavic canon status. In Paper 12 an invariant at a fixed point \(x=(x)_0\) is related to a projective invariant of the system \(F_\rho\), with higher differentials replaced by cogredient variables. Sravnjenje s tekstom: Fiksovano město, kogredientne proměnne i linearno prěobraženje konkretizujut smysl pridavnika. Ne ide o projektivny modul.

projektivna invariantna polja

Iztočnik / Source: projektive Invariantenkörper

Rusky / Russian: проективные поля инвариантов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: проєктивні поля інваріантів

Rabota 6, §1, sama objasnjaje razliku: pri razgledanyh transformacijah s determinantom 1 racionalne kombinacije invariantov ostavajut invariantami, tako že nastaje polje. Paper 6, §1, makes the distinction explicit: for the determinant-one transformations considered there, rational combinations remain invariants and constitute a field. Homogeneous isobaric invariants alone instead form a system, not a field. Polje thus carries a claim about algebraic structure. Omitting invariantny or replacing polje with system would erase a distinction on which the exposition depends.

In Paper 4, §2, these relations admit an invariant expression and correspond to relations linear in the basic form’s coefficients. Quadratic and linear are therefore not contradictory descriptions: they concern different arguments. In Paper 15 the forms \(f_{ik,rs}\) in the indeterminates \(\xi_{ik}\) are quadratic polynomials; substituting the determinants \((ik)\) yields identically vanishing expressions. Iztočnik / Source: quasi-lexikographische Anordnung

Rusky / Russian: квазилексикографический порядок

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: квазілексикографічний порядок

Razlog: Kvazi-leksikografičny porjadok označaje osobny poredok konečnyh podmnožstv, ne samo obyčny slovničny red. Arhiv čuva internacionalny kvalifikator vměsto dlgoj parafrazy; nynějšny tekst ima poredok. Rabota 30, §6, najprvo sravnjuje čislo elementov; samo pri jednakej moči odlučuje prvi različny element v danym dobrom poredku. Po tom poredku bira se prva konečna baza vsakogo ideala. Prědpoloženje dobrogo poredka elementov i uslovje konečnoj bazy sut sučstvene: sam adjektiv ne dokazuje dobry poredok. Slovo kvazi- čuva razliku od neograničenogo leksikografičnogo sravnjenja; podrobna definicija mora ostati čitljiva pri vsakom prěnosu togo pojma.

Reason: Kvazi-leksikografičny porjadok names a particular ordering of finite subsets, not merely ordinary dictionary order. The archive retains the international qualifier instead of a long paraphrase; the current text uses poredok. Paper 30, §6, first compares cardinalities and, only when these agree, compares the first differing element in the given well-order. The first finite basis of each ideal is then selected in this ordering. The assumed well-order of elements and finite generation matter: the adjective alone establishes no well-ordering theorem. Kvazi- preserves the distinction from unrestricted lexicographic comparison; the explicit definition must accompany any transfer of this concept.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Konečne množiny najprvo sravnjujut se po moči. Definicija potom koristi dany dobry poredok elementov.

Textual comparison: Finite sets are compared first by cardinality; the definition then uses the given well-order of elements.

kvaternionno tělo

Iztočnik / Source: Quaternionenkörper

Rusky / Russian: тело кватернионов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кватерніонне тіло

Razlog: Kvaternionno tělo čuva nekomutativny smysl německogo Körper. Arhiv izrično razlikuje tuty objekt od komutativnogo polja. V rabotě 32, §2, bazu nad racionalnym poljem tvorjat \(1,i,j,k\), s \(ij=k\) i \(ji=-k\); zaměna tělo slovom polje izgubila by matematičnu razliku. Daljše prisojedinjenje razpadnogo polja može proizvesti netrivialny idempotent, tako že povědě o razširenoj algebrě ne trěba čitati kakoby ona ostavala tělo. Rusko tělo kvaternionov i ukrajinsko kvaternionne tilo v spisku podpirajut poimenovanje, ale ne sut nezavisno proverjena medžuslovjanska norma.

Reason: Kvaternionno tělo preserves the noncommutative sense of German Körper. The rationale explicitly distinguishes it from a commutative field. In Paper 32, §2, the rational basis is \(1,i,j,k\), with \(ij=k\) and \(ji=-k\); replacing tělo with polje would erase a mathematical distinction. Subsequent extension to a splitting field can produce a nontrivial idempotent, so statements about the extended algebra must not be read as asserting it remains a division ring. The recorded Russian and Ukrainian body terms support the naming choice, but do not constitute an independently established Interslavic norm.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zajedny korenj ne sbližaje definicije těla i grupy. Dva pridavne varianty ne imajut zachovanu sravniteljnu ocenu.

Textual comparison: A common stem does not identify division ring and group. The two adjectival variants have no preserved comparative ranking.

kvaternionsko tělo

Iztočnik / Source: Quaternionenkörper

Rusky / Russian: кватернионное тело

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кватерніонне тіло

Razlog: Kvaternionsko tělo čuva tož strukturno razlikovanje tělo/polje kako kvaternionno tělo, ale ima drugi tvorbeny sufiks. Arhiv povezaje izbor s politikoj raboty 40 za nekomutativny Körper; ne pokazuje sravniteljne oceny sufiksov -n- i -sk-. Rabota 42 razgleđaje maksimalny poredok kvaternionskogo těla, ktory sodrživaje poredky dvoh različnyh polj. To potvrdžaje potrebu razlikovati obhvatnu nekomutativnu strukturu od komutativnyh podpolj. Dvě zachovane pridavne formy zato trěba pokazati kako varianty istej terminologičnoj semji, ne izjaviti jednu pobědnicom bez razloga. Pozdnějše ujednačenje sufiksa trěbuje izrično lingvistično opravdanje.

Reason: Kvaternionsko tělo preserves the same body/field distinction as kvaternionno tělo, but uses a different adjectival suffix. The record links this choice to Paper 40’s policy for noncommutative Körper; it provides no comparative ranking of -n- and -sk-. Paper 42 discusses a maximal order of the quaternion division ring containing orders of two different fields, confirming the need to distinguish the surrounding noncommutative structure from its commutative subfields. The two recorded adjectives should therefore appear as variants in one terminological family, not as a winner and loser without evidence. A later suffix standardization requires an explicit linguistic justification.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zajedny korenj ne sbližaje definicije těla i grupy. Dva pridavne varianty ne imajut zachovanu sravniteljnu ocenu.

Textual comparison: A common stem does not identify division ring and group. The two adjectival variants have no preserved comparative ranking.

kvaternionno tělo / kvaternionna grupa

Iztočnik / Source: Quaternionenkörper / Quaternionengruppe

Rusky / Russian: тело кватернионов / группа кватернионов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: тіло кватерніонів / група кватерніонів

Razlog: Kvaternionno tělo / kvaternionna grupa čuva zajedny korenj za svezane, ale različne objekty. Arhiv pripisuje internacionalnomu korenju medžuslovjansku razpoznavajemost; to jest motivacija, ne rezultat měrjenja razumlivosti. V drugom uvodu raboty 32 razpadne polja grupy sut svezane s prědstavjenjami kvaternionnogo těla. Teorija prědstavjenij objasnjaje vez, ale ne stvara identičnost medžu grupoj i tělom. Zato imenica, ne samo korenj kvaternion-, mora ostati eksplicitna. Takovo obhvačenje semji terminov jest korisno pri širjenju slovnika, dokolě definicije objektov ne sut směšane.

Reason: Kvaternionno tělo / kvaternionna grupa retains one stem for related but different objects. The archive attributes cross-Slavic recognizability to the international stem; that is a motivation, not a measured comprehension result. Paper 32’s second introduction connects the group’s splitting fields with representations of the quaternion division ring. Representation theory explains the connection, but does not identify the group with the division ring. The noun, not merely the shared quaternion stem, must remain explicit. Recording a terminological family is useful for dictionary expansion provided that its object definitions remain distinct.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zajedny korenj ne sbližaje definicije těla i grupy. Dva pridavne varianty ne imajut zachovanu sravniteljnu ocenu.

Textual comparison: A common stem does not identify division ring and group. The two adjectival variants have no preserved comparative ranking.

kvocient \(a/D^{(i)}\)

Iztočnik / Source: Quotient \(a/D^{(i)}\)

Rusky / Russian: частное \(a/D^{(i)}\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка \(a/D^{(i)}\)

Razlog: Kvocient \(a/D^{(i)}\) ohranjaje izraz iz zaključnej primětky raboty 22, §6. Arhiv zahtěvaje kontinuitet s terminologijeju Hentzelta i Noether, ne prěpisanje v pozdnějši obči izraz faktor-modul. V nynějšem tekstu \(a\) označaje ideal, a \(D^{(i)}\) jest polinom povezan s sukcesivnoj eliminacijeju. Slědujuči paragraf izrično razgleđaje kvocient ideala prěz osnovny ideal; definicija v §1 vysvětljaje kvocient pomoču množenja i prinaležnosti. Sama kosa črta zato ne znači, že elementy ideala sut prosto razděljene na ostatkove klasy. Symboly v iztočnom spisku sut skračeny zapis; slovnična glava mora jih prikazati matematično, bez zaměny smysla operacije.

Reason: Kvocient \(a/D^{(i)}\) retains the expression in Paper 22, §6’s closing note. The record calls for continuity with Hentzelt and Noether’s quotient terminology, not recasting it as a later generic quotient module. In the current text \(a\) denotes an ideal and \(D^{(i)}\) a polynomial associated with successive elimination. The next section expressly considers an ideal quotient by a basic ideal; §1 defines quotients through multiplication and membership conditions. A slash alone therefore does not imply passage to residue classes of the ideal. The archived headword is a compressed notation that needs mathematical typesetting without changing the operation’s sense.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zapis s kosoj črtoj nosi lokalny idealny smysl; ne ustanavjaje avtomatično faktor-modul.

Textual comparison: The slash carries the local ideal-quotient sense; it does not automatically denote a quotient module.

kvocient ... črez osnovny ideal

Rusky / Russian: частное ... по основному идеалу

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка ... за основним ідеалом

Razlog: Kvocient … črez osnovny ideal povezuje kvocient s už uvedenym osnovnym idealom. Arhiv to opravdava kontinuitetom terminologije osnovnogo modula i idealnoj dělimosti; anglijsky iztočny naslov v spisku jest opis pojma, ne citat německogo originala. Rabota 22, §7, piše idealny kvocient \(\mathfrak a=\mathfrak m/\mathfrak g_{i-1}\) i koristi prědlog prěz. Zato črez i prěz sut dokumentovane povrhnostne varianty, ne dokaz različnyh algebraičnyh operacij. Kontekst govori o transformovanom idealu, jeho osnovnom idealu i uslovju množenja, ne o množině ostatkovyh klasov. Terminologična kontinuitet ne znači pravo odstraniti takovo kontekstno razlikovanje.

Reason: Kvocient … črez osnovny ideal connects the quotient with the already introduced basic ideal. The rationale is continuity with basic-module terminology and ideal divisibility; the English source-side heading is a concept description, not a quotation from the German original. Paper 22, §7, writes the ideal quotient \(\mathfrak a=\mathfrak m/\mathfrak g_{i-1}\) and uses prěz. Thus črez and prěz are documented surface variants, not evidence of different algebraic operations. The context concerns a transformed ideal, its basic ideal and a multiplication condition, not a set of residue classes. Terminological continuity must not erase that contextual distinction.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prěz v tekstu odgovarjaje črez v spisku. Smysl ustanavjajut idealy i uslovje množenja.

Textual comparison: The corpus’s prěz corresponds to the list’s črez. The ideals and multiplication condition establish the sense.

kvocient dvoh modulov

Iztočnik / Source: Quotient zweier Moduln

Rusky / Russian: частное двух модулей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка двох модулів

Razlog: Kvocient dvoh modulov ohranjaje istorijsko nazvanje, ale njegov smysl trěba vzeti iz definicije. Rabota 22, §1, oprěděljaje kvocient modulov linearnyh form kako ideal vsih skalarov \(c\), za ktore \(cB\) leži v \(A\). To ne jest obyčny faktor-modul \(A/B\). Primětka takože izrično govori, že tuty kvocient ne sběgaje se s Dedekindovym kvocientom čislovyh modulov. Arhivna charakterizacija kako Dedekindovy typ zato označaje istorijsku vez, ne polnu identičnost definicij. Racionalny izbor slova kvocient može byti ohranjen samo zajedno s tymi ograničenjami; tri povtorjene zapisy prěvoda ne zaměnjajut matematičnu definiciju.

Reason: Kvocient dvoh modulov preserves the historical name, but its sense must come from the definition. Paper 22, §1, defines the quotient of modules of linear forms as the ideal of scalars \(c\) for which \(cB\) lies in \(A\). This is not the ordinary quotient module \(A/B\). The footnote also expressly says that the quotient defined here does not coincide with Dedekind’s quotient of numerical modules. The archive’s ’Dedekind-style’ characterization therefore records a historical connection, not identical definitions. Kvocient is defensible only with these qualifications; three repeated translation records cannot replace the mathematical definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija govori o skalarah, čiji produkty s drugim modulom ležat v prvom. Primětka čuva razliku od Dedekinda.

Textual comparison: The definition concerns scalars whose products with the second module lie in the first; the note retains the distinction from Dedekind.

tvorjenje kvocientov

Iztočnik / Source: Quotientenbildung

Rusky / Russian: образование частных

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: утворення часток

Razlog: Tvorjenje kvocientov sostavjaje slovjanske ime procesa s internacionalnym algebraičnym korenjem. Tri zachovane razloga odnoset se k rabotam 9, 24 i 25; oni čuvajut terminologičnu kontinuitet i kratkost, bez dokumentovanogo čislovogo vaganja. V rabotě 9 tvorjenje kvocientov prěnosi izomorfnu korespondenciju. V rabotah 24 i 25 prsten ostatkovyh klasov po vlastnom prostom idealu najprvo nema nulovyh děliteljev, a potom razširjaje se do polja tvorjenjem drobov. To sut dva koraka: obrazovanje ostatkovyh klasov i tvorjenje kvocientov v dobytoj oblasti. Izraz ne směje skryti drugy korak ni sugerovati, že kvocient po libovoljnym idealu vsegda jest polje.

Reason: Tvorjenje kvocientov combines a Slavic process noun with the international algebraic stem. The three preserved reasons concern Papers 9, 24 and 25 and emphasize continuity and compactness without a numerical weighting exercise. In Paper 9, formation of quotients extends an isomorphic correspondence. In Papers 24 and 25, residue classes modulo a proper prime ideal first form a ring without zero divisors, which is then extended to a field by forming fractions. These are two operations: taking residue classes and forming fractions in the resulting domain. The expression must not conceal the second step or suggest that a quotient by an arbitrary ideal is already a field.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tvorjenje ostatkovyh klasov i razširenje do polja sut različne operacije, eksplicitno povezane v tekstu.

Textual comparison: Taking residue classes and extending to a field are distinct operations explicitly linked in the text.

Iztočnik / Source: Quotientenideal \((0):c\)

Rusky / Russian: частное нулевого идеала по \(c\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: частка нульового ідеалу за \(c\)

V rabotě 31, §5, \(c\) jest ideal: relevantne elementy \(\delta\) izpolnjajut \(\delta c=0\). Kvocient nulovogo ideala zato označaje anihilator togo ideala, ne prsten ostatkovyh klasov po njem. Nynějšny tekst ima prěz i frakturno označenje ideala; te razlike trěba odděliti od smysla. Čuvanje dvotočky i obuhvata uslovja množenja jest važnějše od mehaničnogo ohranjanja skračenogo tekstovogo zapisa v staroj tabeli.

Reason: Idealny kvocient nulovogo ideala črez \(c\) spells out \((0):c\) in readable prose. The rationale explicitly continues §4’s vocabulary rather than inventing a second name for the same operation. In Paper 31, §5, \(c\) is an ideal: the relevant elements \(\delta\) satisfy \(\delta c=0\). This quotient of the zero ideal is thus the ideal’s annihilator, not a residue-class ring modulo it. The current text uses prěz and a Fraktur ideal symbol; those surface differences must be separated from meaning. Preserving the colon and the scope of the multiplication condition matters more than mechanically reproducing the old table’s abbreviated plain-text notation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uslovje \(\delta c=0\) označaje anihilator ideala, ne kvocientny prsten.

Textual comparison: The condition \(\delta c=0\) defines an ideal annihilator, not a quotient ring.

Iztočnik / Source: Quotientenkörper

Rusky / Russian: поле частных

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле часток

Razlog: Kvocientno polje zachovuje medžunarodny korenj kvocient- za polje drobov oblasti cělostnosti. Arhiv povezuje rabotu 9 s terminologijeju jej poprědnyh paragrafov i rabotu 35 s točnostju internacionalnogo izraza; ruska i ukrajinska paralela koristajut nazvanja polja častnyh odnosno častok. Rabota 9 izrično opisuje elementy polja kako kvocienty elementov oblasti; pri smyslovom vysvětlenju imenitelj mora byti nenulovy. Rabota 35 ustanavjaje polje kvocientov \(Q\) oblasti \(I\) i medžu nimi oblast \(Z\). To ne jest polje ostatkovyh klasov po idealu. Slovnik zato čuva zajednu semju kvocient-, ale ne spojuje različne konstrukcije v jednu definiciju.

Reason: Kvocientno polje uses the international quotient stem for the fraction field of an integral domain. The record links Paper 9 to its preceding sections and Paper 35 to the precision of the international expression; Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use their established quotient-field names. Paper 9 explicitly describes field elements as quotients of elements of the domain; an explanatory definition must require a nonzero denominator. Paper 35 specifies the fraction field \(Q\) of \(I\) and an intermediate domain \(Z\). This is not a residue-class field modulo an ideal. The dictionary therefore retains the common kvocient- family without collapsing its different constructions into one definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kvocientno polje nastaje iz oblasti drobami s nenulovym imeniteljem. Tuta konstrukcija ne jest tvorjenje ostatkovyh klasov.

Textual comparison: The fraction field is formed from a domain using fractions with nonzero denominators, not by taking residue classes.

Iztočnik / Source: Quotientenkörper

Rusky / Russian: поле частных

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле часток

Razlog: Polje kvocientov jest imenična konstrukcija s genitivom, odgovarjajuča pridavnoj formě kvocientno polje. Sedm zachovanyh zapisov povezuje jeje upotrěbu v rabotah 24, 29, 30 i 31: koeficientno polje po prisojedinjenju neoprěděljenyh, razširenja polj, integralna zamknjenost, slěd i norma. Razlog za korenj kvocient- jest kontinuitet i izběganje obyčnogo čestičnogo ili drobnogo smysla; razpoznavajemost jest tvrđenje arhiva, ne izměrjena vlastnost. Tekst razlikuje polje kvocientov od prstena kvocientov i od idealnyh/modulnyh kvocientov. Povtorjenje izbora ne dokazuje, že genitivna forma jest bolja od pridavnoj; arhiv ne davaje takej sravniteljnoj oceny. Obě formy morajut byti povezane jednym smyslom, dokolě lokalne prědpoloženja ostavajut vidime.

Reason: Polje kvocientov is a noun-plus-genitive construction corresponding to the adjectival kvocientno polje. Seven preserved records connect its use in Papers 24, 29, 30 and 31: coefficient fields after adjoining indeterminates, field extensions, integral closure, trace and norm. The reason for kvocient- is continuity and avoidance of ordinary partitive or fractional senses; recognizability is asserted by the archive, not measured. The corpus distinguishes fraction fields from rings of fractions and ideal/module quotients. Repeated selection does not establish that the genitive construction is preferable to the adjective; no such comparative ranking survives. Both forms need one sense connection while local hypotheses remain visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Konstrukcija so genitivom ostavaje v različnih kontekstah. Povtorjenje ne jest sravniteljne jezyčno testovanje.

Textual comparison: The genitive construction recurs in different contexts. Recurrence is not a comparative language test.

polje kvocientov / kolco kvocientov

Iztočnik / Source: Quotientenkörper / Quotientenring

Rusky / Russian: поле частных / кольцо частных

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле часток / кільце часток

Razlog: Polje kvocientov / kolco kvocientov čuva razliku polje/prsten pri zajednom korenju kvocient-. V nynějšem tekstu staromu kolco odgovarjaje prsten. Rabota 30 pri odsutnosti nulovyh děliteljev razgleđaje polje drobov; pri dopuščenju nulovyh děliteljev imenitelj mora byti regularny element. To jest element, ktory ne jest nulovy dělitelj, ne prosto libovoljny nenulovy element. V §9 ostatkovy prsten služi protivpriměru i jest jednak svojemu prstenu kvocientov, zato že vse regularne elementy sut jedinice. Ostatkovy prsten i prsten kvocientov zato imajut različne konstrukcije, hoti v tom priměru objekty sběgajut se. Arhiv izrično zahtěvaje čuvati tutu razliku, ne izravniti nazvanja.

Reason: Polje kvocientov / kolco kvocientov preserves the field/ring distinction within the common kvocient- family. The current text uses prsten where the older list has kolco. Paper 30 treats a fraction field in the absence of zero divisors; when zero divisors are allowed, the denominator must be regular, meaning a non-zero-divisor rather than merely a nonzero element. In §9 a residue-class ring supplies a counterexample and equals its own ring of fractions because every regular element is a unit. Residue-class ring and ring of fractions are different constructions even when their resulting objects coincide in that example. The archive expressly calls for preserving this distinction.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Pri nulovyh děliteljah regularnost imenitelja jest važna. Ostatkovy prsten ne jest po definiciji prsten kvocientov.

Textual comparison: With zero divisors, denominator regularity matters. A residue-class ring is not by definition a ring of fractions.

polje kvocientov integralnoj oblasti

Iztočnik / Source: Quotientenkörper eines Integritätsbereichs

Rusky / Russian: поле частных области целостности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле часток інтегральної області

Razlog: Polje kvocientov integralnoj oblasti zadržuje osnovnu oblast v samom nazvanju. Arhiv opravdava internacionalny korenj prozračnostju standardnogo pojma, ne predlagaje nove konstrukcije. Uvod raboty 6 opisuje najmenše polje, ktore sodrživaje libovoljny razgledany sistem, kako obobčenje polja kvocientov integralnoj oblasti. Fraza zato mora čuvati razliku medžu danoj oblastju i poljem, ktore iz njej nastaje; ne govori, že sama oblast už jest polje. Integralny tutaj znači algebraičnu oblast bez nulovyh děliteljev, ne integral iz analizy. To konkretne sravnjenje potvrđaje upotrěbu pojma v uvodu; ono ne jest nezavisna istorijska atestacija medžuslovjanskogo nazvanja.

Reason: Polje kvocientov integralnoj oblasti keeps the originating domain in the name. The preserved motivation attributes transparency to the international stem for a standard concept; it proposes no new construction. Paper 6’s introduction describes the smallest field containing an arbitrary system under consideration as a generalization of the fraction field of an integral domain. The wording must distinguish the given domain from the field constructed from it, not imply that the domain is already a field. Integral concerns the algebraic domain without zero divisors, not an integral in analysis. This comparison confirms the concept in the introduction, not an independent historical attestation of the Interslavic name.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvod razlikuje integralnu oblast od najmenšego polja, ktore ju sodrživaje.

Textual comparison: The introduction distinguishes the integral domain from its smallest containing field.

Rusky / Russian: поле частных \(T\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле часток \(T\)

Razlog: Polje kvocientov od \(T\) izrično imenuje prsten, iz ktorogo polje nastaje. Zachovany razlog jest soglasnost s ranějšim slovnikom polj kvocientov; nema osobnogo vaganja prědloga od. Bukva \(T\) jest matematičny identifikator, ktory ostavaje latinskoju bukvoju i v kiriličnom izloženju; typografsko prikazanje ne směje zaměniti ju podobnoju kiriličnoju bukvoj. The surviving reason is consistency with the earlier quotient-field glossary; it supplies no separate ranking of the preposition od. In Paper 31, §8, the fraction field of \(T\) contains the ring \(T_a\), whose denominators are restricted by coprimality to the given ideal. The fraction field and that ring are not synonyms. \(T\) is a mathematical identifier and remains Latin in Cyrillic prose; typesetting must not replace it with a similar Cyrillic letter. Checking this occurrence does not establish that every T elsewhere denotes the same object.

Iztočnik / Source: R. Brauersche Gruppe

Rusky / Russian: группа Брауэра

Pytanje o uslovju na stepenj v pozdnějšem tvrdženju togo teksta ostavaje oddělno zaznamenano; lexikalna soglasnost jego ne rěšaje.

Reason: Racionalny / cěly Galoisov modul distinguishes the operator domain, not merely a descriptive style. In Paper 37 the rational case uses the group algebra over the field \(k\), while the integral case uses the group ring over the domain of integral elements. The field and integral normal-basis theorems consequently have different hypotheses and conclusions. The archive expressly requires the rational/integral contrast in every translation. It does not justify saying that every integral Galois module is free or has a normal basis. The separately recorded question about the degree condition in a later assertion of this text remains unresolved; lexical consistency does not settle it.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Poljny i cěly slučaj ne imajut jednakogo tvrđenja o normalnoj bazě.

Textual comparison: The field and integral cases do not carry the same normal-basis assertion.

racionalny funkcional

Rusky / Russian: рациональный функционал

Razlog: Racionalny funkcional jest historičny termin definovany prěz normalizovano prědstavjenje racionalnoj funkcije, ne obyčny sovrěmenny funkcional na prostoru funkcij. V rabotě 9, §2, zapis ima formu \(A=aE_1/E_2\), kde polinomy sut primitivne i vzajemno proste s cělymi racionalnymi koeficientami, a \(a\) jest pozitivno racionalno čislo. Cělost funkcionala zavisi od cělosti \(a\), ne od odsutnosti imenitelja. Arhiv čuva nazvanje funkcional, zato že Noether izrično upuča na Webera; ona ne govori samo o proizvoljnoj funkciji. Ta upučenost jest svedočena pasažeju Noetherovej raboty. Weberova navedena kniga ne byla tu nezavisno pročitana, zato novo neposrědno potvrdženje od Webera ne tvrdi se.

Reason: Racionalny funkcional is a historical term defined through a normalized presentation of a rational function, not an ordinary modern functional on a function space. In Paper 9, §2, the expression has the form \(A=aE_1/E_2\), with relatively prime primitive polynomials having integral rational coefficients and positive rational \(a\). Integrality of the functional depends on integrality of \(a\), not on the absence of a denominator. The archive keeps funkcional because Noether explicitly refers to Weber rather than speaking only of an arbitrary function. That reference is attested by Noether’s passage. Weber’s cited book has not been independently read here, so no fresh direct verification from Weber is claimed.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Cělost zavisi od racionalnogo množitelja v normalizovanoj formě, ne od odsutnosti imenitelja.

Textual comparison: Integrality depends on the rational multiplier in the normalized form, not on the absence of a denominator.

V rabotě 17 osobno uslovje jest beskonečno mnogo konstant, ktore komutujut s oprěděljenymi operatorami. Reason: Oblast racionalnosti retains the historical name for a coefficient or base domain instead of automatically substituting polje. Three records connect Papers 8, 11 and 17. In Paper 8, membership in the specified coefficient domain constrains linear combinations; Paper 11 also speaks explicitly of fields, so oblast does not deny field structure. In Paper 17 the particular hypothesis is the existence of infinitely many constants commuting with specified operators. The archive prioritizes fidelity to the author’s terminology and declines to modernize Bereich everywhere. This lexical restraint does not prohibit explaining the actual structure when the local definition establishes it.
