redukcijne formuly

Iztočnik / Source: Reduktionsformeln

Rusky / Russian: редукционные формулы; формулы редукции

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редукційні формули; формули редукції

Razlog: Redukcijne formuly imenuje zapisane relacije, ne vse rěšenja redukcijnoj metody. Dva zapisy iz §§5 i 10 raboty 2 birajut kratak pridavny naslov radi gustyh formulačnyh blokov i kontinuiteta s §3. Ruski i ukrajinski primeri sodrživajut i pridavnu konstrukciju, i konstrukciju s genitivom; arhiv ne davaje čislovogo sravnjenja med nimi. §5 izrično govori, ktore formule nastavajut polarizacijeju i izključaje relacije za razložime formy. Tuty izključek ne smě izčeznuti pri skračenju termina. Kratkost naslova jest izložiteljska prědnost, ne pravo skratiti sam matematičny obseg formul.

Reason: Redukcijne formuly names the written relations, not every result obtainable from the reduction method. Two records from Paper 2, §§5 and 10, choose a short adjectival heading before dense formula blocks and for continuity with §3. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda include both adjectival and genitive constructions; the archive supplies no numerical ranking between them. Section 5 expressly identifies which formulas arise by polarization and excepts relations for decomposable forms. That exception must survive any abbreviation of the term. Brevity of the heading is an expository benefit, not permission to reduce the mathematical scope of the formulas.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Naslov može byti kratak, ale uslovje polarizacije i njegov izključek morajut ostati polne.

Textual comparison: The heading may be brief, but the polarization condition and its exception must remain complete.

redukcijny teorem

Iztočnik / Source: Reduktionssatz

Rusky / Russian: редукционная теорема

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редукційна теорема

Razlog: Redukcijny teorem označaje konkretno tvrđenje s dokazom, ne samo neformalnu tehniku. Za rabotu 8 arhiv naglašaje rolju teorema v cělom dokazu; v rabotě 16 razlog upuča na specialny poslědok formuly (2). Nynějša pasaža raboty 16 čuva avtorovo ograničenje: ranějši postup davaje redukcijny teorem, ale bez izraza za razliku ne davaje polnogo razklada v redy. Arhivna izjava o kontinuitetu s rabotoju 12 ne ustanavja, že ide o toj samy teorem; tvrdženja trěba identifikovati po formulah i upučenjah. Takože prědnost nazvanja teorem nad tvrdženje jest lokalna urednička ocěna, ne universalny prěklad německogo Satz.

Reason: Redukcijny teorem denotes a particular proved assertion, not merely an informal technique. For Paper 8 the archive emphasizes its role in the whole argument; for Paper 16 it identifies a special consequence of formula (2). The current Paper 16 passage preserves the author’s limitation: the earlier procedure yields the reduction theorem, but without an expression for the difference it does not establish the full series expansion. The archival claim of continuity with Paper 12 does not establish that these are the same theorem; statements must be identified by their formulas and references. Preference for theorem over proposition is likewise a local editorial judgment, not a universal translation of German Satz.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razlikovanje redukcijnogo teorema i polnogo razvitja ograničaje, čo izvedenje dokazuje.

Textual comparison: Distinguishing the reduction theorem from the full expansion limits what the derivation establishes.

teorem redukcije

Iztočnik / Source: Reduktionssatz

Rusky / Russian: теорема редукции

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редукційна теорема; теорема редукції

Razlog: Teorem redukcije jest genitivna alternativa k redukcijny teorem. Zapisy za raboty 12 i 23 čuvaju nazvanje strukturnogo tvrđenja, ktore svodi pytanja diferencialnyh invariantov k algebraičnoj, linearnoj teoriji invariantov. Oni odbirajut redukciju vměsto neoprěděljenogo sniženja i teorem vměsto širšego principa. Arhiv odkazuje na kontinuitet s rabotoju 21; konkretne pasaže pokazyvajut, čo imenovano tvrđenje čini. Ne davajut dokaz, že genitivna konstrukcija jest jezyčno bolja od pridavnoj. Važno jest takože ograničenje: utvrdženje za variacionny kontekst ne prěnosi se avtomatično na libovoljnu novuju strukturu prěnosa.

Reason: Teorem redukcije is the genitive alternative to redukcijny teorem. The records for Papers 12 and 23 preserve the name of a structural assertion reducing questions about differential invariants to algebraic, linear invariant theory. They choose reduction rather than vague lowering, and theorem rather than the broader principle. The archive points to continuity with Paper 21; the actual passages show what the named assertion does. They do not establish that the genitive construction is linguistically better than the adjective. The scope restriction also matters: a result in the variational setting does not automatically extend to an arbitrary new transport structure.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Genitivno nazvanje ne ustanavja novo tvrđenje; smysl čuvajut konkretne definicije i ograničenja.

Textual comparison: The genitive label does not establish a new theorem; the definitions and restrictions establish its sense.

redukcijne teoremy

Iztočnik / Source: Reduktionssätze

Rusky / Russian: редукционные теоремы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редукційні теореми

Razlog: Redukcijne teoremy jest množna forma naslova, ktory uvodi definicije i tvrđenja o redukciji v rabotě 2, §3. Internacionalny korenj redukcij- s pridavnoju morfologijeju čuva svez s redukcija i reducent; arhiv ocěnjuje takovy naslov kako kratak i razumlivy. No to poslednje ostavaje ocěnoju, ne rezultatom jezyčnogo eksperimenta. Slovo teoremy važe se k eksplicitnym uslovjam, osoblivo k roli reducenta i početkovoj i konečnoj formy reda. Nynějšny uvod raboty ima takože variant redukcijske. Arhiv ne davaje argument, ktory by kvantitativno rangoval te sufiksalne možnosti.

Reason: Redukcijne teoremy is the plural heading introducing definitions and assertions about reduction in Paper 2, §3. The international stem redukcij- with adjectival morphology connects redukcija and reducent; the archive judges this heading compact and comprehensible. The latter remains an assessment, not a language experiment. Teoremy is tied to explicit conditions, notably the reducer’s role and the initial and final forms of the series. The current introduction also uses redukcijske. No preserved argument quantitatively ranks these suffixal alternatives.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Redukcijne i redukcijske ostavajut zachovane varianty; doslědna budučna norma ne smě izbrisati razliku med matematičnymi uslovjami.

Textual comparison: Redukcijne and redukcijske remain recorded variants; a consistent future norm must not erase differences in mathematical conditions.

redukcijske teoremy

Iztočnik / Source: Reduktionssätze

Rusky / Russian: редукционные теоремы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редукційні теореми

Razlog: Redukcijske teoremy čuva variant pridavnogo nazvanja v rabotě 4, §9. Arhivny razlog jest algebraičny registar i vernost teoremnomu naslovu. Tekst prostranno oprěděljaje, čo znači vyša forma, i potom formuluje redukcijno tvrđenje za cěly red form. To ne jest prosto metoda za zaměnu složnogo izraza kratšim. Sravnjenje s redukcijne pokazuje opravdane terminologične svezi, ale ne zachovane rěšenje o tom, ktory sufiks imaje byti obča norma. Za novy prěvod mogoče izbrati doslědnu formu po jezyčnom kanonu; historične zapisy i različne matematične uslovja ne smějut byti odstranene, da bi doslědnost izgledala starša než jest.

Reason: Redukcijske teoremy retains the adjectival variant in Paper 4, §9. Its archival rationale is algebraic register and fidelity to a theorem-oriented heading. The text carefully defines higher form before stating the reduction assertion for a whole series of forms. This is not simply a method for replacing a complicated expression with a shorter one. Comparison with redukcijne establishes terminological connections, but no preserved decision selecting one suffix as the general norm. A new translation may choose a consistent form through the language canon; historical records and differing mathematical conditions must not be removed to make that consistency appear older than it is.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Redukcijne i redukcijske ostavajut zachovane varianty; doslědna budučna norma ne smě izbrisati razliku med matematičnymi uslovjami.

Textual comparison: Redukcijne and redukcijske remain recorded variants; a consistent future norm must not erase differences in mathematical conditions.

teorem redukcije

Iztočnik / Source: Reduktionstheorem

Rusky / Russian: теорема редукции

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема редукції

Razlog: Teorem redukcije v rabotě 21 imenuje prěvod problema diferencialnyh invariantov na problem projektivnyh invariantov krivosti i jeje kovariantnyh derivacij. Arhiv dava prednost kratkomu internacionalnomu korenju, zajedničnomu s ruskoj i ukrajinskoj formoj, i hoče razlikovati toj teorem od algebraičnoj reducibilnosti raboty 20. Sam korenj redukc- ne garantuje to razlikovanje: potrěbno jest izjasniti, čo se na čo svodi. Nynějšny tekst ukazuje takože granicu teorema pri drugoj definiciji prěnosa. Zato nazvanje ne znači neograničeno obečanje redukcije za vsaku geometriju. Arhivna ocěna občeho terminologičnogo statusa ne jest nova prověrka vsih slovjanskyh kanonov.

Reason: In Paper 21, teorem redukcije names the passage from a problem about differential invariants to one about projective invariants of curvature and its covariant derivatives. The record favours a compact international stem shared with its Russian and Ukrainian comparanda and seeks to distinguish this theorem from the algebraic reducibility of Paper 20. The stem alone cannot make that distinction: the entry must explain what is reduced to what. The current text also marks the theorem’s limits under a different definition of transport. Its title therefore does not promise reduction for every geometry. The archival assessment of established terminology is not a fresh survey of all Slavic scholarly canons.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem svodi diferencialne invariante na izrično opisane projektivne podatky; daljši odstup označuje granicu pri inoj definiciji prěnosa.

Textual comparison: The theorem reduces differential invariants to explicitly described projective data; the subsequent qualification marks a limit under a different definition of transport.

reducent

Iztočnik / Source: Reduzent

Rusky / Russian: редуцент

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редуцент

Razlog: Reducent jest historično tehnično nazvanje v teoriji invariantov. Četrnaest zapisov davaje prednost zachovanomu nazvanju prěd mehaničnym reduktorom, občim faktorom ili opisom, ktory samo govori o uproščenju. Priznana cena jest menša idiomatičnost než pri parafrazi; korist jest prepoznavajema svez medžu povtorjenymi definicijami i priměnami. V rabotě 2 reducent ne označuje libovoljnu pomočnu veličinu: definicija važe jego k reducibilnomu redu form. Tekst pri tom citira Gordana. Zato arhivno označenje „coined/historical“ ne dokazuje, že slovo izmyslila Noether ili AI. Ostavaje obvezok čitati točnu definiciju v danom kontekstu; povtorjenje nazvanja samo ne dokazuje jezyčnu pravilnost.

Reason: Reducent retains a historical technical noun of invariant theory. Fourteen records favour that identifiable term over a mechanical reducer, a generic factor, or a paraphrase referring only to simplification. They acknowledge reduced idiomatic ease as the cost of keeping a repeated role recognizable across definitions and applications. In Paper 2 the word does not mean any auxiliary quantity: its definition ties it to a reducible series of forms. The passage also cites Gordan. Thus the archive’s label “coined/historical” does not establish that either Noether or the AI invented the term. Its precise definition must still be read in each setting; recurrence alone is not evidence of linguistic correctness.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nazvanje reducent jest svezano s reducibilnym redom form. Citacija Gordana ne jest dokaz novoj konsultacije jeho raboty.

Textual comparison: Reducent is tied to a reducible series of forms. The citation of Gordan is not evidence that his work was newly consulted.

reducenty

Iztočnik / Source: Reduzenten

Rusky / Russian: редуценты

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редуценти

Razlog: Reducenty jest množna forma od reducent, ne nova teorija redukcije. Zapis za rabotu 2, §26, izrično prodolžuje termin iz §§22–25. Ta svez jest vidima i v samom tekstu: pod naslovom „Reducenty“ sut navedene formy s odkazami na §23 i §24, ktore zajedno s ranějšimi formulami daju potrěbnu redukciju. Tako možno ukazati i razlog terminologičnoj doslědnosti, i konkretno město priměny. Ranějšne čislo pojavjenj v cělom korpusu samo ne by dokazovalo pojavjenje v §26. Arhiv ne čuva novy sravnitelny izbor množnogo nazvanja; to jest prodolženje už uvedenoj morfologije.

Reason: Reducenty is the plural of reducent, not a newly proposed theory of reduction. The record for Paper 2, §26, explicitly continues the term from §§22–25. The connection is also visible in the text: a heading “Reducenty” introduces forms referring back to §§23 and 24 which, together with earlier formulas, give the required reduction. This establishes both the reason for terminological continuity and a specific application. A whole-corpus occurrence count would not by itself establish occurrence in §26. The archive records no new comparative selection of a plural term; it extends the morphology already introduced.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §26 priamo imaje naslov Reducenty i odkazy na dva ranějšne paragrafy. Takovo pojavjenje potvrđaje konkretno prodolženje termina.

Textual comparison: Section 26 explicitly has the heading Reducenty and references two earlier sections, establishing a particular continuation of the term.

reducenty / redukcija

Iztočnik / Source: Reduzenten / Reduktion

Rusky / Russian: редуценты / редукция

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редуценти / редукція

Razlog: Para reducenty / redukcija prěnosi nazvanje objekta i nazvanje postupka iz raboty 2 v rabotu 3. Zachovana motivacija jest morfologična doslědnost, ne novo rangovanje konkurentov. Uvod raboty 3 to podpira sodržatelno: govori o teoriji reducentov, redukciji poslědovatelnyh osnovnyh kontrakcij i ulozi konstrukcije, ktora ranějše rezultaty razširjaje. No prěnos slova ne smije skryti uslovnost ranějših tvrđenij za obči slučaj. Reducent i redukcija sut svezane slova s različnymi funkcijami, ne vzaimno zaměnljive sinonimy. Ničto v tom zapisu ne oprěděljaje redukciju dokazov ili izračunjenj v drugoj disciplině.

Reason: The pair reducenty / redukcija carries the object-name and operation-name from Paper 2 into Paper 3. The preserved motivation is morphological continuity, not a new ranking of competitors. Paper 3’s introduction gives that continuity substantive content: it discusses the theory of reducers, reduction of successive basic contractions, and a construction extending earlier results. Terminological continuity must not conceal the conditional status of earlier statements in the general case. Reducent and redukcija are related words with different functions, not interchangeable synonyms. This record establishes no terminology for proof reduction or computation in another discipline.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvod svezava reducenty s redukcijeju i s ranějšimi uslovnymi rezultatami; kontinuitet nazvanja ne odstranjaje uslovja.

Textual comparison: The introduction links reducers with reduction and earlier conditional results; continuity of the name does not remove the conditions.

reducibilny

Iztočnik / Source: reduzibel

Rusky / Russian: редуцируемый

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: редуковний

Razlog: Reducibilny jest izbrano v rabotě 2 radi internacionalnogo korenja i svezanosti s reducent. Arhiv sravnjuje rusko reducirujemoje i ukrajinsko redukovnyj, pričem nacionalny status tych form jest ocěna ranějšego prevoditelja, ne nova kanonska prověrka. Definicija govori o vyraženju formy prěz druge invariante i o reducibilnyh redah form. Ne govori prosto, že element jest produktom dvoh netrivialnyh faktorov. Zato kratka para „reducibilny = razložimy“ bez definicije byla by zavodna. Težina svezanosti slovnoj familije jest zachovana kvalitativno; čisleny bal ili sravnitelny test čitatelskoj razumělivosti ne jest zachovany.

Reason: Paper 2 selects reducibilny for its international stem and connection with reducent. The archive compares Russian редуцируемый and Ukrainian редуковний; its assessments of their national disciplinary status belong to the earlier translator, not a fresh canon check. The definition concerns expressing a form through other invariants and defining reducible series of forms. It does not simply assert that an element factors into two nontrivial factors. A bare equivalence “reducibilny = decomposable” would therefore mislead without the definition. The importance assigned to word-family coherence is recorded qualitatively; no numerical score or comparative reader-comprehension test survives.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nazvanje reducent jest svezano s reducibilnym redom form. Citacija Gordana ne jest dokaz novoj konsultacije jeho raboty.

Textual comparison: Reducent is tied to a reducible series of forms. The citation of Gordan is not evidence that his work was newly consulted.

razložimy / nerazložimy

Iztočnik / Source: reduzibel / irreduzibel

Rusky / Russian: разложимый / неразложимый

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розкладний / нерозкладний

Razlog: Razložimy / nerazložimy jest izbrano radi samej definicije: ideal jest prědstavimy kako najmenše obče mnogokratno vlastnyh děliteljev. V upotrěbjenoj idealnoj terminologiji to odgovarjaje prěsěku; ne ide o faktorizaciju jednogo elementa. Ruska i ukrajinska para daju arhivne sravnitelne formy za razloženje, ale ne nezavisne ocěny istogo izbora. Dva zapisa sodržajut jednu zachovanu motivaciju. Nynějšna definicija nalazi se v §2 raboty 19, iako oznaky rabotnyh jedinic upominajut §6 i §12. Oboje trěba zachovati: historičny identitet zapisa i točno město definicije. To značenje ne smije byti složeno v jedno s reducibilnostju polinomov ili prědstavjenij.

Reason: Razložimy / nerazložimy is chosen because of the definition itself: an ideal is represented as the least common multiple of proper divisors. In the ideal terminology used here, this corresponds to intersection, not factorization of an element. The Russian and Ukrainian pairs provide historical decomposition comparanda, not independent evaluations of the same choice. Two records preserve one rationale. In the current text the definition is in Paper 19, §2, although the working-unit labels mention §§6 and 12. Both identities matter: the historical record and the definition’s actual location. This sense must not be merged with reducibility of polynomials or representations.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Smysl jest oprěděljen najmenšim občim mnogokratnym vlastnyh děliteljev. Definicija nalazi se v §2, različnom od oznak dvoh historičnyh rabotnyh jedinic.

Textual comparison: The sense is defined by the least common multiple of proper divisors. The definition is in §2, distinct from the labels of the two historical working units.

reducibilny / ireducibilny

Iztočnik / Source: reduzibel / irreduzibel

Rusky / Russian: приводимый / неприводимый

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: звідний / незвідний

Razlog: V rabotě 17 reducibilny / ireducibilny odnosi se k grupě ostatkov s operatorami. Redukcijno uslovje trěbuje razloženje vsakogo elementa na jednoznačno oprěděljene sostavne česti iz dvoh nenulovyh podgrup danogo tipa. Izomorfizm v okolnom tekstu čuva takože djelovanje operatorov; ne dosta jest libovoljno aditivno razloženje. Jednoznačnost sostavnyh čestij pri danom razloženju ne znači jednoznačnost izbora samyh podgrup. Arhiv dava prednost internacionalnomu korenju v medžuslovjanskom, različnomu od zachovanyh ruskyh i ukrajinskyh sravnenij. Čest ukrajinskogo teksta v motivaciji jest stracena; čitatelj može viděti zachovane forme v sravnitelnoj tablici, no ne rekonstruovanu citaciju izgubljenogo razsudka.

Reason: In Paper 17, reducibilny / ireducibilny concerns a residue group equipped with operators. The condition requires each element to decompose uniquely into components from two nonzero subgroups of the specified kind. The surrounding definition of isomorphism also preserves operator action; an arbitrary additive decomposition is not enough. Uniqueness of components for a fixed decomposition does not imply uniqueness of the subgroups themselves. The archive favours the international stem in Interslavic, unlike its preserved Russian and Ukrainian comparanda. Part of the Ukrainian wording inside the rationale is lost. The surviving forms can be displayed in the comparison table, but they do not license an invented quotation of the missing argument.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jednoznačnost komponentov mora byti čitana zajedno s definicijeju operatornogo izomorfizma i dopustimoj podgrupy.

Textual comparison: Uniqueness of components must be read with the definitions of operator-preserving isomorphism and admissible subgroup.

redukovalny / reducent

Iztočnik / Source: reduzibel / Reduzent

Rusky / Russian: редуцируемый / редуцент

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: звідний / редуцент

Razlog: Redukovalny / reducent v rabotě 4 čuva tehnično nazvanje reducenta i drugu pridavnu formu za redukcijnu možnost. Definicija prědhodi teoremu IX i važe red form k točnomu uslovju, pri ktorom forma jest vyša od drugoj. Takova vyšina jest oprěděljena kontrakcijami, ne obyčnym rangovanjem po veličině. Arhiv ocěnjuje izbor kako prikladny matematičnomu registru, ale ne sravnjuje redukovalny s ranějšim reducibilny dovolno podrobno, da bi dokazyval prednost jednoj občeje norme. Slovnik čuva oba historična izbora i jih uslovja. Doslědnost v novom tekstu trěbuje jezyčno opravdanje, ne prosto zaměnu vseh različnyh pridavnyh form.

Reason: Redukovalny / reducent in Paper 4 preserves the reducer noun while using another adjective for susceptibility to reduction. The definition precedes Theorem IX and ties a series of forms to a precise condition under which one form is higher than another. That ordering is defined through contractions, not an ordinary comparison of size. The archive judges the wording suitable for mathematical register, but does not compare redukovalny with the earlier reducibilny in enough detail to establish a preferred general norm. The dictionary preserves both historical choices and their conditions. Consistency in a new text requires linguistic justification, not indiscriminate replacement of every differing adjective.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Adjektivny variant naleži k redu form s oprěděljenym porjadkom. Nema zachovanogo rangovanja dvaju medžuslovjanskyh adjektivov.

Textual comparison: The adjectival variant belongs to a series of forms with a defined ordering. No ranking of the two Interslavic adjectives is preserved.

stavaje reducibilny / reducent

Iztočnik / Source: reduzibel wird / Reduzent

Rusky / Russian: становится приводимым / редуцент

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: стає звідним / редуцент

Razlog: Stavaje reducibilny čuva proměnu, vyraženu německym wird, a ne samo statičnu vlastnost. V §17 raboty 2 ta proměna zavisi od vvedenogo modula: tekst govori, kogda forma stavaje reducibilna po tom modulu. Zato izpuščenje dopolnjenja moglo by prevratiti relativno tvrđenje v bezuslovno. Reducent ostavaje nazvanjem drugogo, svezanogo objekta. Arhiv dava prednost doslědnosti redukcijnoj familije, no izrično ostavjaje otvorjeno sravnjenje s možnymi domácimi alternativami. On ne imenuje takovu alternativu i ne dokumentuje završeny ekspertni pregled. Slovnik ne dopolnjaje tu prazninu izmysljenym konkurentom ili izmysljenym glasovanjem.

Reason: Stavaje reducibilny preserves the change expressed by German wird, rather than merely naming a static property. In Paper 2, §17, that change is relative to the modulus introduced in the argument: the text specifies when the form becomes reducible modulo it. Omitting that qualification could turn a relative assertion into an unconditional one. Reducent continues to name a different, related object. The record prioritizes continuity of the reduction family but explicitly leaves comparison with possible native alternatives open. It names no such alternative and documents no completed expert review. The dictionary does not fill that gap with an invented competitor or vote.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Slovesna fraza čuva proměnu po odnošenju k zadannomu modulu, ne bezuslovnu proměnu objekta.

Textual comparison: The verbal phrase preserves change relative to the specified modulus, not an unconditional change of the object.

forma reducibilnosti

Iztočnik / Source: Reduzibilitätsform

Rusky / Russian: форма приводимости

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: форма звідності

Razlog: Forma reducibilnosti imenuje konkretnu pomočnu polinomnu konstrukciju raboty 20. Arhiv izbira internacionalny korenj radi jasnogo tehničnogo nazvanja, pri čem ruska i ukrajinska forma upotrěbljajut svoje slovne familije. Matematična uslovja sut suščestvena: za polinom od najmenje dvoh prěměnnyh, pri specializaciji bez poniženja stepena, neizčezanje toj formy identično v pomočnih neoprěděljenyh jest kriterij absolutnoj nerazložimosti. Arhiv hoče zachovati to jačše uslovje i ocěnjuje regularny kako stabilny algebraičny termin. Obči slovnik potvrđaje slovo, ale ne njegovu isključnu matematičnu priměnu. Nynějšna podnožna primětka ima frazu ne-nulovy dělitelj. Ona može sugerovati nenulovogo dělitelja vměsto elementa, ktory ne jest děliteljem nuly; tu nejasnost treba izjasniti, ne prědstaviti ju kak už rěšenu. Regularnost takože ne znači avtomatično obratimost v izhodnom prstenu.

Reason: Regularny element is here accompanied by the sense-defining gloss nedělitelj nuly. In Paper 30, being nonzero alone is insufficient when the ring permits zero divisors: the stronger condition concerns the generator of a principal module and denominators in the quotient ring. The archive seeks to retain that condition and regards regularny as a stable algebraic term. The general dictionary attests the word, not an exclusive mathematical application. The current footnote says ne-nulovy dělitelj. That wording can suggest a nonzero divisor rather than an element which is not a zero divisor; this ambiguity needs clarification and is not represented as already resolved. Regularity also does not automatically mean invertibility in the original ring.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Arhivni nedělitelj nuly i nynějšno ne-nulovy dělitelj ne sut bezuslovno jednoznačne frazy. Okolny tekst trěbuje jačše uslovje nego samu nenulovost.

Textual comparison: Archived nedělitelj nuly and current ne-nulovy dělitelj are not unambiguously equivalent expressions. The surrounding argument requires more than being nonzero.

Razlog: Regularny polinom vzhodno k \(x_i\) sodrživaje neodstranimy argument: regularnost jest oprěděljena po odnošenju k izbranoj prěměnnoj. V rabotě 22 polinom stepena \(r\) jest regularny po odnošenju k \(x_i\), ako sodrživaje člen \(x_i^r\) s nenulovym koeficientom. Definicija ne trěbuje, aby toj koeficient byl \(1\), i ne znači prosto „polinom bez singularnostij“. Arhiv dava prednost internacionalnomu pridavnomu i čuvanju definicije; dva zapisa ne tvorjat dva nezavisne jezyčne testa. Starše vzhodno k i nynějšno po odnošenju k treba razlikovati. Reason: Regularny polinom vzhodno k \(x_i\) includes an indispensable argument: regularity is relative to a chosen variable. Paper 22 calls a degree-\(r\) polynomial regular with respect to \(x_i\) when it contains the term \(x_i^r\) with nonzero coefficient. The definition does not require that coefficient to be one, nor does it simply mean “a polynomial without singularities”. The archive favours the international adjective and retention of the explicit definition; its two records are not two independent language tests. Earlier vzhodno k and current po odnošenju k must remain distinguishable. The argument \(x_i\) remains an exact mathematical identifier through linguistic editing.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija navodi najvyššu stepenj izbranoj prěměnnoj s nenulovym koeficientom. Predložna čest nazvanja zato sodrživaje neobhodimy argument.

Textual comparison: The definition specifies the highest power of the chosen variable with nonzero coefficient. The phrase identifying that variable carries an indispensable argument.

In Paper 8 a form may depend on \(N\) rows, each containing \(n\) variables; these two counts are not interchangeable. The archive chooses red for continuity with Papers 6–7 and because an infinite analytic series is not intended. The newly consulted dictionary gives ręd with ordinary senses “row, queue” and, in another record, “order, arrangement, sequence”. These support the lexical base but do not themselves define the mathematical blocks. Context, including the polar operators between rows, establishes the technical use. Textual comparison: Each of the \(N\) rows has \(n\) variables. Dictionary rows 2283 and 3798 support ordinary senses of ręd, while the mathematical text supplies the particular arrangement.

V §6 fraza uvodi izračunjenje konkretnoj formuly s pomoču ranějših razloženij i rekursivnogo sistema. To ne jest tvrđenje o konvergenciji beskonečnogo analitičnogo reda. Nynějšny tekst piše razvitje v red. Slovničny zapis ręd o redah i poredku ne opravdava avtomatično ni staršu bukvu ě, ni svaki specialny smysl slova. Reason: Razvitje v rěd is the preserved expression for an algebraic expansion in Paper 2. Its recorded reason is connection with §2 and readability of the form-series construction, not a comparison of every synonym. In §6 it introduces the calculation of a particular formula using earlier expansions and a recurrent system. It makes no assertion about convergence of an infinite analytic series. The current text writes razvitje v red. The dictionary’s ręd entries for rows and order do not automatically justify either the historical letter ě or every technical sense. Historical spelling, present lexical support, and mathematical application are distinct kinds of evidence.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tekst objasnjaje, čto ukazujut dvě linije koeficientov, i izrično započinaje račun iz poslědnjego uravnenja. Slovo konečne odnosi se k rezultatu računa.

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: рядовий розклад

Razlog: Rędovo razloženje jest drugy historičny izbor za Reihenentwicklung. Zapis za §7 raboty 4 hoče zachovati Mertensovo nazvanje razloženja, ne poistovětiti je s prostym seznamom redov prěměnnyh, i izrično dopuščaje možnost razvoj. Zapis za §9 prodolžuje toj izbor, ale ne rěšaje sravnenje. Kontekst govori o razloženju form po polarah normalnyh form s pomoču invariantnyh procesov diferenciacije. Polary i transformovane prěměnne sut česti konstrukcije, ne dokazy analitičnoj konvergencije. Nynějšny tekst upotrěbljaje razloženje v redy. Reason: Rędovo razloženje is another historical choice for Reihenentwicklung. The Paper 4, §7, record seeks to retain Mertens’s expansion terminology without reducing it to a list of variable rows, and explicitly leaves razvoj as a possible alternative. The §9 record continues the choice but does not settle the comparison. The context concerns expansion of forms in polars of normal forms through invariant differentiation operators. Polars and transformed variables are parts of the construction, not evidence of analytic convergence. The current text uses razloženje v redy. No final comparative argument survives establishing a general preference between that expression, rędovo razloženje, and razvoj.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razloženje jest svezano s invariantnymi procesami diferenciacije i polarami normalnyh form. Arhivna alternativa razvoj ne imaje zachovanogo zaključnogo sravnenja.

Textual comparison: The expansion is connected with invariant differentiation operators and polars of normal forms. No final comparison survives settling the archived alternative razvoj.

razklad v rědy v teoriji form

Iztočnik / Source: Reihenentwicklung der Formentheorie

Rusky / Russian: разложение в ряды в теории форм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розклад у ряди в теорії форм

Razlog: Razklad v rědy v teoriji form jest titulna fraza, ktora čuva disciplinarny okvir. Uvod raboty 16 razlikuje dva vida razloženja: po stepenjah determinanta i po normalnyh formah za veličiny različnyh stupnjev. Pozdnějša formula pokazuje konečno razloženje do stepena \(p\). Arhiv zato izbira doslovnu konstrukciju s redami, bez dodavanja analitičnoj konvergencije. To ne znači, že red prěměnnyh, red form i razloženje po stepenjah sut jeden objekt. Nynějšny naslov piše razkladam v redy; slovnik zachovuje staršu formu i jeje razlog, ne izmysljaje novu motivaciju za vsaku razliku v bukvah. Reason: Razklad v rědy v teoriji form is a title phrase retaining the disciplinary setting. Paper 16’s introduction distinguishes expansions in powers of a determinant from expansions in normal forms for quantities of different grades. A later formula displays a finite expansion through degree \(p\). The archive therefore chooses literal row/series wording without adding analytic convergence. This does not make a variable row, a series of forms, and a power expansion the same object. The current title has razkladam v redy; the dictionary preserves the earlier form and its recorded reason without inventing a new motivation for every spelling difference. Citations of Mertens and Fischer in the corpus do not mean their works were newly read.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvod razlikuje dva vida razloženja; izpisana formula po stepenjah determinanta zaključaje se pri \(p\). Ona ne dodava tvrđenje o analitičnoj konvergenciji.

Textual comparison: The introduction distinguishes two expansion types; the displayed determinant-power expansion ends at \(p\). It adds no claim of analytic convergence.

The end of Paper 2, §1, anticipates §2’s construction and identifies a special case in which only the initial term remains. rekurzivno označene bazove veličiny

Iztočnik / Source: rekurrierend definierte Basisgrößen

Razlog: Rekurzivno označene bazove veličiny upuča na zavisimost definicije od ranějše izbranyh veličin. V §7 raboty 9 izbor jest proveden po zadannom dobrom uporjadkovanju vsih kompleksnyh čisel. Ne daje tem dokaz, že konstrukcija jest efektivny računny algoritm. To razlikovanje jest osoblivo važno pri budučoj priměně v OLP. Nynějšno rekursivno definiranym jest jasnějše svezano s definicijeju nego historično označene; oba zapisa ostavajut dokumentovane, bez pripisovanja pozdnějšej formulacije staršej motivaciji.

Reason: Rekurzivno označene bazove veličiny points to the dependence of the definition on previously selected quantities. Paper 9, §7, proceeds along a given well-ordering of all complex numbers. Type 1 tests adjunction relative to preceding basis quantities, while type 3 defines those basis quantities by excluding the first two types. The archive seeks to make that dependence visible. It does not thereby establish an effective computational algorithm. This distinction is particularly important for later use in OLP. Current rekursivno definiranym expresses the definitional role more explicitly than historical označene; both forms remain documented without attributing the later wording to the earlier rationale.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Bazove veličiny oprěděljajut se s pomoču poprědnih veličin pri zadannom dobrom uporjadkovanju. To ne jest samo po sobě dokaz efektivnoj vyčislimosti.

Textual comparison: The basis quantities are defined using preceding quantities in a given well-ordering. This alone does not establish effective computability.

Razlog: Konečne vrědnosti najdene rekursivno govori o zaključnyh rezultatah računa, ne o konečnosti čisel i ne o limitě beskonečnogo procesa. Reason: Konečne vrědnosti najdene rekursivno refers to the final results of a calculation, not finite-valued numbers or a limit of an infinite process. Paper 2, §6, specifies the order: the first line gives substituted values, the second the results calculated starting from the system’s last equation. The archive retains this procedure and the international recursive stem. The current text uses konečne cěnnosti; that lexical difference does not replace the qualification about direction of calculation. Knowing the final formulas does not justify omitting their derivation when the purpose is to explain how they were obtained. This is a specific recurrence, not a general assertion about algorithmic complexity.

Textual comparison: The passage explains the two lines of coefficients and explicitly starts the calculation from the last equation. Final characterizes the outcome of that calculation.

Historical ravnanj and current ravnanij are preserved forms, not evidence of two different mathematical concepts.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvodna metodna fraza imaje konkretno prodolženje v sistemu za koeficienty. Jeje dokumentovanje ne trěbuje pripisati historičnomu tekstu sovrěmennu teoriju algoritmov.

Textual comparison: The introductory methodological phrase has a concrete continuation in the coefficient system. Documenting it does not require attributing a modern theory of algorithms to the historical text.

Zato slovo ne ograničava se na strogu jednakost i samo ne označuje binarnu relaciju kako množstvo uporjadkovanyh parov. To drugo značenje mora byti objasnjeno oddělno pri OLP. Pasaža ima takože ranějše registrovano povtorjenje nazvanja formy; terminologično izjasnjenje ne jest potvrdženje točnosti vseh znakov toj pasaži.

The archive compares it with Russian соотношение and Ukrainian співвідношення, preferring compact wording before a formula. In the current occurrence the relation is a congruence modulo a specified modulus. The term is therefore not restricted to strict equality, nor does it by itself designate a binary relation as a set of ordered pairs. That other sense requires separate explanation in OLP. The passage also contains the previously recorded repeated-form question; clarifying its terminology does not certify every symbol in the passage.

Here whole or integral does not mean integer coefficients, a moral quality, or a general analytic function without singularities. The archive chooses literal wording to retain the connection with the problem, not because every modern sense of integrality is interchangeable. Paper 41, §1, then explicitly broadens the setting to an arbitrary commutative field \(k\) and a separable Galois extension \(K/k\). The label does not say that the field itself is noncommutative. Lost Russian and Ukrainian lettering cannot be reconstructed merely because a model knows an expected term; it is marked unrecoverable, while current čislove is quoted from the corpus.

Konečnost i involucijska integralna baza sut daljši teorem, ne zaměna definicije. Finiteness and the involution integral basis are a subsequent theorem, not replacements for the definition. The archive chooses rod as a classification word and rejects a weaker reading with tip; this is a preserved terminological preference. The current introduction nevertheless has prvogo tipa, while §10 has prvogo roda, so consistency still requires contextual comparison. Prvy priměr govori o polinomah invariantnyh pri danoj permutacijnoj grupě; uravnenje s elementarnymi simetričnymi funkcijami ustanovjaje potrěbnu algebraičnu cělost. Arhivni razlog jest kontinuitet, s izrično zachovanoju relativnostju. Tu konkretnu priměnu treba sravniti s definicijeju, a ne nazvati vsaky konečno porodženy prsten oblastju prvogo roda bez prověrky jeje uslovij. Reason: Relativno-cěle oblasti prvogo roda continues §10’s term in §13’s examples. The historical hyphen groups relativno-cěle but supplies no evidence of a new mathematical condition. The first example concerns polynomials invariant under a specified permutation group; the equation using elementary symmetric functions establishes the required algebraic integrality. The archived reason is continuity with explicit relativity. This application must be checked against the definition rather than calling every finitely generated ring a domain of the first kind without checking its conditions. Hyphenated and unhyphenated records remain distinguishable in the dictionary.

Paper 23 concerns finite generation of the domains of all polynomials in a field of rational functions. Paper 35 examines a maximal domain of integer-coefficient functions and distinguishes finitely many denominator primes from bounded exponents of those primes. The archive retains the historical Hilbert-problem label instead of silently replacing it with a modern algebraic description. This does not justify dropping the additional arithmetic conditions. The current Paper 35 passage contains a contradictory condition involving \(a g\) and \(a^{\varrho}g\); that is an open source question, not an endorsed part of the definition.

The archive continues Paper 5’s language while retaining the historical class name. The introduction summarizes the result’s reach, whereas §§9 and 10 supply distinct definitions. Editing and later reuse must distinguish that motivational connection from an assertion of conceptual equivalence; terminological continuity does not make the terms synonyms.

The text derives the description using all polynomials in the smallest containing field. The archive maintains this lexical family rather than proposing a geometric sense of domain. The phrase must not automatically be replaced by integrally closed domain without comparing definitions and ambient rings. Relative integrality of the domain and algebraic integrality of a quantity in §9 are connected but distinct conditions.

Arhiv izrično razlikuje relativnu od absolutnoj invariantnosti, zato čuva pridavno. Reason: Relativna invariantnost in Paper 13 does not mean approximate invariance. The expression may acquire a precisely specified factor; in §5 that factor is the Jacobian determinant of the independent-variable transformation. The archive expressly distinguishes relative from absolute invariance and therefore retains the adjective. The section’s hypotheses matter: transformations contain no derivatives of dependent quantities, and the new independent variables depend only on the old independent variables. The footnote warns that the argument does not hold without these conditions. Calling individual parts of the relations invariant does not authorize dropping the factor or hypotheses.

Razlog: Relativny / modularny / formalny invariant čuva tri blizke, no ne zaměnljive nazvanja. V rabotě 29 relativny invariant pri grupovoj substituciji měnjaje se samo nenulovym faktorom iz koeficientnogo polja. Modularny invariant mora davati iste cěnnosti pri vsih podstavjenjah iz toga polja; nad konečnym poljem to ne trěbuje identičnosti polinomov. Uvod prědstavjaje razliku medžu modularnymi i obče formalnymi invariantami, a §2 dava identičnost kak uslovje za absolutny polinomny invariant. Reason: Relativny / modularny / formalny invariant retains three related but non-interchangeable labels. In Paper 29 a relative invariant changes under a group substitution only by a nonzero factor from the coefficient field. A modular invariant must give equal values at every substitution from that field; over a finite field this need not be a polynomial identity. The introduction contrasts modular with general formal invariants, while §2 gives identity as the condition for an absolute polynomial invariant. The archive chooses international stems to keep the distinctions visible and open to reasoned linguistic revision. It does not claim that these three labels partition all invariants into disjoint classes.

Textual comparison: Absolute polynomial invariance is an identity; modular invariance requires equality at values from the field. Over a finite field the conditions need not be equivalent.

Paper 32 calculates it as a product of two conjugate factors in \(P(\varepsilon,i)\) over \(P(\varepsilon)\) and obtains the value \(-1\). That negative value itself warns against a metric interpretation. The archive favours a familiar international term and expressly avoids a new coinage; its claim of stability across Slavic algebra literature remains a historical rationale, not the result of a new comprehensive survey. Later reuse must retain the extension field, base field, and sense of norm.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Produkt konjugovanyh faktorov daje relativnu normu, a daljši račun daje cěnnost \(-1\). Smysl jest algebraičny, ne metričny.

The archive therefore does not substitute an unqualified expression for pairwise coprimality. Section 7 later distinguishes coprime ideals from mutually relatively prime ideals and explicitly denies the converse implication. This is not merely stylistic variation between relativno and vzajemno. The definition and direction must remain visible so that the familiar adjective does not import the stronger condition from integer arithmetic. Two linked archival records do not establish two independent linguistic tests.

relativno-prosto-nerazložimy

To znači projektnu terminologičnu odluku, ne potvrdženje od jezyčnoj obščiny. Smysl ne jest totožny s pozdnějšim vzajemno-prosto-nerazložimy, ktory se opira na silnějšu prostost idealov. Trěba čuvati oba směry i uslovja, ne objaviti konečnu kardinalnost modula zato, že red imaje konečnu dolgost. Arhiv daje jezyčny razlog paralelnosti s ranějšimi terminami za prsten i modul klasov. Ne davaje nezavisny čitateljsky test prozračnosti. Nazvanje objasnjava kvocientnu konstrukciju, ale samo po sobě ne dokazuje prěryvanja cěpov u proizvoljnogo modula.

Reason: Modul ostatkovyh klasov continues the ostatk- family in Paper 30’s conclusion. Passage to a submodule and to the residue-class module is used there to connect a composition series with the double chain condition. Both directions and their hypotheses matter; finite length of the series does not imply finite cardinality of the module. The archive gives a linguistic reason for keeping module and ring terminology parallel, not an independent reader test of transparency. The phrase identifies a quotient construction but does not prove termination of chains for an arbitrary module.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zaključenje čuva prěhody k podmodulu i k modulu klasov; konečna dolgost ne jest konečna kardinalnost.

Textual comparison: The conclusion retains passage to a submodule and to the residue-class module; finite length is not finite cardinality.

Razlog: Trojica modul klasov ostatkov, kolco klasov ostatkov i ostatkova klasa čuva tri nivoja opisa. §4 raboty 30 najprvo sobira kongruentne elementy v jednu klasu i daje modulnu strukturu sistemu klasov. Prstenova struktura dodatno trěbuje čuvanje produktov; pri nekomutativnyh prstenah primětka trěbuje dvustranne idealy. Zato izomorfizm modulov ne smi avtomatično stati izomorfizmom prstenov. Arhivny korenj kolco nynějšny tekst zaměnjaje formoju prsten, medžutym ostatk- ostavaje obča familija. Pridavna forma za jednu klasu i genitivna za sistem mogut služiti različnym gramatičnym roljam; ta razlika ne jest matematična nepodudarnost.

Reason: The trio modul klasov ostatkov, kolco klasov ostatkov and ostatkova klasa preserves three descriptive levels. Paper 30, §4 first groups congruent elements into a class and equips the system with module structure. Ring structure additionally requires preservation of products; for noncommutative rings the footnote requires two-sided ideals. A module isomorphism must therefore not automatically become a ring isomorphism. Current prsten replaces archival kolco while the ostatk- family persists. An adjective for a single class and a genitive construction for the system can serve different grammatical roles; that difference is not a mathematical disagreement.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Modulny izomorfizm čuva modulne operacije; prstenovy dodatno čuva produkty. Dvustranne idealy sut potrěbne v nekomutativnom slučaju.

Textual comparison: Module isomorphism preserves module operations; ring isomorphism also preserves products. Two-sided ideals are required in the noncommutative case.

Kratše faktor-kolco ne bylo izključeno iz cělogo korpusa; razvažanje tu odbivaje nemotivovanu zaměnu naziva v srědině dokaza. Razlikovanje od polja kvocientov i od kvocienta idealov čuva različne konstrukcije. Nynějšny tekst už upotrěbjaje prsten klasov ostatkov, zato arhivno kolco ne jest nova rekomendacija. Slovnik pokazuje oba stanja i matematicky smysl, po ktorom trěba prověrjati kontinuitet. Šest zapisov jednej tradicije ne sut šest nezavisnyh potvrđenij jezyčnoj pravilnosti.

Reason: Kolco klasov ostatkov is the archived name for a ring whose elements are congruence classes, not selected representatives. Six records from Papers 30 and 31 favour a transparent phrase and continuity: both the classes and the ring structure remain visible. The shorter faktor-kolco was not excluded from the entire corpus; the stated objection here is an unmotivated change of name within an argument. Distinguishing this construction from a field of fractions and an ideal quotient protects different mathematical objects. The current text uses prsten klasov ostatkov, so the archived kolco is not a new recommendation. Both forms are documented against their mathematical use. Six records within one translation tradition are not six independent confirmations of linguistic correctness.

Razlog: V uvodu raboty 31 zajedny izraz klasov ostatkov svyzuje prsten i polje, ale ne izravnjuje jih. Polje imaje dodatnu strukturu: nenuleve elementy dopuščajut děljenje. Tekst razlikuje polja prvogo i drugogo roda pri nedoskonalom osnovnom polju; ta razlika nestavaje zaměnoju naziva prstena nazvom polja. Dalje je izrično rečeno, že prsten iz polinomnogo prědstavjenja ne mora byti izomorfny prstenu ostatkovyh klasov poredka. Arhivna motivacija zato jest čitlivost zajednoj terminologičnoj rodiny, ne tvrdženje, že vsi takovi prsteni sut polja ili medžu soboju izomorfni. Kratši kvocientny naziv ne směl by skryti, po ktorom idealu i v ktoroj oblasti se tvori kvocient. Nynějšny prsten zaměnjuje arhivno kolco.

Reason: In Paper 31’s introduction, the shared phrase klasov ostatkov links ring and field without identifying them. A field has additional structure: its nonzero elements admit division. The text distinguishes extensions of the first and second kind over an imperfect base field; replacing “ring” with “field” would not express that distinction. It also explicitly warns that a ring obtained from a polynomial presentation need not be isomorphic to the order’s residue ring. The recorded motive is therefore a readable terminology family, not a claim that all these rings are fields or mutually isomorphic. A shorter quotient label must still identify the ideal and ambient structure. Current prsten replaces archived kolco.

Arhiv čuva međunarodny izraz modulo i cěly eksponent, vměsto skračenja do polja po \(p\). V §7 diferenta glavnogo poredka prěhodi v diferentu prstena klasov ostatkov; pri razloženju \(p\) na proste idealne faktory pojavjajut se eksponenty \(te_i\). Zato zaměna \(p^t\) na \(p\) izměnila by samu konstrukciju. Za točno oprěděljenje eksponentov uvod dodatno potrěbuje dostatočno veliko \(t\). To, že \(p\) jest prosty element osnovnoj oblasti, samo po sobě ne daje polje pri vzjatju klasov po jego stepenu. Arhivno kolco ostavaje istorijnoju formoju, nynějšno prsten jest vidimo v tekstu. Matematične bukvy i eksponenty se pokazyvajut kako formulu, ne kako obyčna jezyčna slova.

In Section 7 the different of the principal order passes to the different of the residue ring; factorization of \(p\) into prime ideals introduces exponents \(te_i\). Replacing \(p^t\) by \(p\) would therefore alter the construction. For exact determination of the exponents, the introduction additionally requires sufficiently large \(t\). Primality of the base element alone does not make the quotient by its power a field. Kolco remains the historical form and prsten the current one; mathematical letters and exponents are typeset as notation rather than prose.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Eksponenty ostavajut čestju konstrukcije i odgovarjajučih komponentov.

V §12 raboty 34 se pod uslovjem maksimuma za prave idealy konstruuje največši nilpotentny dvustranny ideal; kvocient po njem jest bez radikala v tutom smyslu. Dvustrannost potrěbna jest za prstenovu strukturu kvocienta. Racionala zato ne podupiraje neograničeno prěnosenje teorema na libovoljny radikal ili libovoljny nekomutativny prsten. Two-sidedness matters to the quotient’s ring structure. This rationale does not support transferring the theorem to every notion of radical or every noncommutative ring. Ona potom dokazyvaje ekvivalenciju dvuh definicij prostogo ideala. Termin ne směje prědstaviti tutu dokazanu ekvivalenciju kako početnu zaměnimost elementa i ideala. V nynějšnem zapisu obe prědpoložki upotrěbjajut te same frakturne simvoly, hoti tekst razlikuje tipy objektov; toj detalj trěbuje sravnjanja s prvotnym svědkom, ne tihu popravku. Paper 30, Section 5, considers a commutative ring without additionally assuming an identity and distinguishes zero divisors among elements from zero-divisor ideals. Pri algebraično zamknjenom osnovnom polju kvocient vlastno primarnogo prstena po asociovanom idealu imaje rang jedan, ale sam primarny prsten imaje prinajmenje dva bazne elementy. Rang jedan zato ne znači, že kvocient imaje samo jeden element. Argument o diskriminantu zavisi od baznyh produktov i izčezanja jih slědov. Arhiv takože tvrdí, že objašnjenje kvocienta bylo obnovjeno iz pečatnogo teksta; ovde se toj istorijni zapis čuva, ale ne vydavaje za novo nezavisno sravnjanje s pečatnym originalom.

Over the algebraically closed base field, the quotient of a properly primary ring by its associated ideal has rank one, while the primary ring itself has at least two basis elements. Rank one therefore does not mean that the quotient has only one element. The discriminant argument depends on basis products and vanishing traces. The historical note also says that the quotient explanation was restored from the printed text. That claim is preserved as an archival claim, not presented as a new independent comparison with the printed original.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kvocient imaje rang jedan, medžutym vlastno primarny prsten imaje veću bazu.

Textual comparison: The quotient has rank one while the properly primary ring has a larger basis.

V rabotě 22, §4, beskonečny modulny opis sravnjaje se s konečnym prědstavjenjem; izomorfija čuva razlike i umnoženje koeficientami. Iz činjenice, že samo konečno mnogo elementarnyh děliteljev jest različno od jedinice, ne slěduje, že obstaje samo konečno mnogo klasov. Arhiv daje prědnost kontinuitetu s ranějšimi paragrafami i adjektivnomu ostatkovyh, ne novomu nezavisnomu nazivu. Dva zachovane zapisa dokumentujut ponovjenje izbora, ne dva nezavisne pokusy ponimanja. Pri pozdnějšem prěnosenju na logiku analogija s klasami može byti polezna, ale modulne operacije ne smějut byti pripisane libovoljnomu sistemu ekvivalencijnyh klasov.

Reason: Sistem ostatkovyh klasov retains system as the broader expression where the argument has not established a field. In Paper 22, Section 4, an infinite module description is compared with a finite presentation; the isomorphism preserves differences and scalar multiplication. Having only finitely many elementary divisors different from one does not imply having finitely many classes. The archive favours continuity with earlier sections and the adjective ostatkovyh rather than an unrelated new name. Two surviving records document recurrence of the choice, not two independent comprehension experiments. For later reuse in logic, the analogy with classes may help, but module operations must not be attributed to an arbitrary system of equivalence classes.

Slovo polje zato nosi matematičnu obvezku, koju samo obstajanje kongruentnyh klasov ne izpolnjaje. Arhivna racionala čuva jednak korenj ostatkov- za čitlivy prěhod medžu lemoju VII i teoremom XIII; ona ne daje pravo skratiti prědpoložki ili zaměniti podsistem cělym objektom. The recorded rationale keeps the same ostatkov- stem across Lemma VII and Theorem XIII; it does not license dropping hypotheses or replacing the subsystem with the entire object. Russian and Ukrainian expressions are comparanda in the preserved record. Without further evidence they establish neither an independent survey of all Slavic traditions nor that every class participates in the stated isomorphism.
