podpolje ostatkovyh klasov

Iztočnik / Source: Restklassenteilkörper

Rusky / Russian: подполе классов вычетов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: підполе класів лишків

Razlog: Podpolje ostatkovyh klasov čuva v jednom nazivu i inkluziju i poljevu strukturu. V rabotě 24, §5, tekst izrično govori o podpolju vyvedenom tvorjenjem kvocientov i měri po njem stepen podprstena, ktory jest prědstavjen klasami iz osnovnogo ideala. Zato podpolje ne jest libovoljna podmnožina ostatkovyh klasov, a stepen ne jest prosto čislo elementov. Arhivna racionala čuva tę svyzu medžu kvocientami, podpoljem i prstenom, vměsto opuščenja pod- ili zaměny polja prstenom. Pri primarnom idealu tekst osoblivo prěhodi k prstenu vsih klasov; to jest kontekstualny rezultat, ne slovnična definicija. Različne matematične tipy ostavajut vidime črěz kratak, sostavny naziv.

Reason: Podpolje ostatkovyh klasov preserves both inclusion and field structure in one expression. In Paper 24, Section 5, the text explicitly describes a subfield obtained by forming quotients and measures over it the degree of a subring represented by classes from the base ideal. Thus the subfield is not an arbitrary subset of residue classes, and degree is not simply a count of elements. The preserved rationale retains this connection among quotients, subfield and ring rather than omitting pod- or substituting ring for field. For a primary ideal the text specifically passes to the ring of all classes; that is a contextual result, not the dictionary definition. A short compound keeps the mathematical types visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Podpolje nastava tvorjenjem kvocientov; stepen zavisi od osnovy.

Textual comparison: The subfield is formed by quotients; degree is relative to a base.

teorem o ostatku / ostatkova grupa / koresidualny

Iztočnik / Source: Restsatz / Restgruppe / korresidual

Rusky / Russian: теорема об остатке / остаточная группа / корезидуальный

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема про залишок / залишкова група / корезидуальний

Razlog: Teorem o ostatku v rabotě 14 jest teorem algebraičnoj geometrije, ne teorem o reziduah kompleksnoj analize. Ostatkova grupa označaje grupu toček na krivoj, ne abstraktnu grupu po kvocientu. Dvě grupy sut koresidualne, kogda se mogut dopolniti toju samoju grupoju do odgovarjajučih prěsěkov; tekst objašnjuje svyzu s ekvivalencijoju idealov i s adjungovanymi krivymi. Koresidualne grupy ne morajut iměti jednako mnogo toček. Arhiv zato čuva ostatkov- za geometričny ostatok i međunarodny koresidualny za definovany odnos. Srodnost s nazvami ostatkovyh klasov ne znači identičnost konstrukcij. Takova razlika jest potrěbna i v slovniku: jadro slova pomaže paměti, ale definiciju dava matematičny kontekst.

Reason: Teorem o ostatku in Paper 14 is an algebraic-geometric theorem, not the residue theorem of complex analysis. Ostatkova grupa denotes a group of points on a curve, not an abstract quotient group. Two groups are co-residual when the same group can complete them to the corresponding intersections; the text relates this to ideal equivalence and adjoint curves. Co-residual groups need not contain equally many points. The archive therefore keeps ostatkov- for the geometric remainder and international koresidualny for the defined relation. Resemblance to residue-class terminology does not identify the constructions. The dictionary must retain that distinction: a shared stem helps recognition, but the mathematical context supplies the definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Grupe toček i koresidualnost ne sut kvocientna grupa ili teorem kompleksnoj analize.

Textual comparison: Point groups and co-residuality are neither an abstract quotient group nor the theorem of complex analysis.

sistem ostatkov / kolco ostatkovyh klasov / ostatkove klasy

Iztočnik / Source: Restsystem / Restklassenring / Restklassen

Rusky / Russian: система вычетов / кольцо классов вычетов / классы вычетов

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: система лишків / кільце класів лишків / класи лишків

Razlog: Dodatok raboty 45 izrično oprěděljaje polny sistem ostatkov kako sistem prědstaviteljev konečno mnogyh linearno nezavisnyh klasov nad oblastju koeficientov. Zato sistem, prsten i posamezne klasy ne možno sbiti do jednogo objekta. V teoremu IV polinomy davajut prědstavitelje; relacije pokazyvajut, že ih linearne kombinacije izčerpavajut odgovarjajuče klasy i že prědstavitelje sut linearno nezavisne. Dolžina ideala svyzuje se s rangom prstena, ne s kardinalnostju množenstva vsih klasov. Arhiv izbira sostavnu rodinu ostatok/ostatkovy i čuva kolco; nynějšny tekst imaje prsten. Tej izbor trěbuje čitanja definicije: sama fraza polny sistem ostatkov mogla by v drugom kontekstu značiti po jednom prědstavitelju každoj kongruentnoj klasy.

Reason: The supplement to Paper 45 explicitly defines a complete residue system as representatives of finitely many linearly independent classes over the coefficient domain. System, ring and individual classes must therefore not be collapsed into one object. In Theorem IV polynomials provide representatives; the relations show that their linear combinations exhaust the corresponding classes and that they are linearly independent. Ideal length is related to ring rank, not to the cardinality of all classes. The archive chooses the compositional ostatok/ostatkovy family and retains kolco; the current text has prsten. Reading the definition is essential: in another context “complete residue system” could mean one representative of every congruence class.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dodatok izrično daje linearnu nezavisnost i izčerpanje klasov kombinacijami.

Textual comparison: The supplement explicitly requires linear independence and exhaustion of classes by combinations.

ostatny sistem \(G-[\Theta]\)

Iztočnik / Source: Restsystem \(G-[\Theta]\)

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable] \(G-[\Theta]\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable] \(G-[\Theta]\)

Razlog: Ostatny sistem v rabotě 9, §6, imenuje ostavajuču čest oblasti, zapisanu \(G-[\Theta]\), ktoru možno vzeti za sistem prisojedinjanyh funkcij. V nynějšnom tekstu oblast označena jest frakturnym \(G\); konstrukcija daje prědstavjenje oblasti prěz \([\Theta,\mathfrak S]\) pri uslovju dopustimosti. Znak minus tu ne oprěděljaje kvocientny prsten, i blizkost k Restsystem v rabotě 45 ne opravdyvaje taku zaměnu. Arhivni rusky i ukrajinsky slovny tekst jest izgubljen v znakach pytanja; zachovana jest samo formula. Slovnik ne domysljaje izgubjene slova iz sadašnjego ponimanja. On pokazuje granicu zachovanogo svědočstva i razlikuje istorijno zapisan izbor od novogo možnogo prěvoda.

Reason: Ostatny sistem in Paper 9, Section 6, names the remaining part of a domain, written \(G-[\Theta]\), which can serve as the system of functions to adjoin. The current text uses a fraktur \(G\) for the domain and represents it as \([\Theta,\mathfrak S]\) under the admissibility condition. The minus sign here does not define a quotient ring, and resemblance to Restsystem in Paper 45 does not justify that substitution. The Russian and Ukrainian wording in the archive has been lost to question marks; only the formula survives. The dictionary does not infer the lost words from present understanding. It marks the evidence boundary and distinguishes the recorded choice from a possible new translation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Minus i dopustimy sistem davajut prědstavjenje oblasti, ne faktor-prsten.

Textual comparison: The subtraction expression and admissible system provide a representation of the domain, not a quotient ring.

rezultant

Iztočnik / Source: Resultante

Rusky / Russian: результант

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: результант

Razlog: Rezultant jest međunarodny algebraičny termin, čij korenj čitatelj može poznavati iz ruskoj i ukrajinskoj matematičnoj tradicije. Arhivny izbor čuva registr eliminacionnoj teorije, svyazanoj v tekstu s Mertensom i Königom; to ne znači, že jih raboty byly nyně nezavisno pročitane. V §11 raboty 6 nenulevy rezultant homogennyh form isključaje zajedno nenulevo rěšenje. Pri nehomogennom sistemu uslovje o členah najvyššego stepena daje dostatočny kriterij v obsudženom argumentu; ne trěba zaměnjati dostatočnost nužnostju. Rezultant zato ne jest prosto konečny rezultat izčislenja. Racionala daje prědnost poznavajemomu tehničnomu korenju prěd opisnym novotvorom, pri sohranjenju uslovij, od ktoryh zavisi jego matematično značenje.

Reason: Rezultant is an international algebraic term whose stem is recognizable in the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda. The recorded choice preserves the register of elimination theory associated in the text with Mertens and König; that does not imply their works have now been independently read. In Section 11 of Paper 6, a nonzero resultant of homogeneous forms excludes a common nonzero solution. For a nonhomogeneous system the condition on highest-degree parts supplies a sufficient criterion in the argument; sufficiency must not be silently changed to necessity. A resultant is therefore not simply the final result of a calculation. The rationale favours a recognizable technical stem over a descriptive coinage while retaining the hypotheses governing its mathematical use.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Homogenny kriterij i dostatočno uslovje za nehomogenny sistem trěbujut razlikovanja.

Textual comparison: The homogeneous criterion and a sufficient condition for a nonhomogeneous system must be distinguished.

rezultant členov najvyššej dimenzije

Iztočnik / Source: Resultante der Glieder höchster Dimension

Rusky / Russian: результант членов наивысшей размерности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: результант членів найвищої вимірності

Razlog: Členy najvyššej dimenzije v arhivnom nazivu znače homogennye česti najvyššego stepena; dimenzija tu ne jest dimenzija algebraičnoj množiny. V §15 raboty 6 potrěbno jest, aby jih rezultant byl jedinicoju v oblasti koeficientov, ne samo nenulevym. Ta silnějša prědpoložka dava odgovarjajuče tvrdženje nad oblastju, v ktoroj ne vsako nenulevo čislo imaje obratny element. Tekst uvodi rezultant \(R_0=\varepsilon\) i ilustruje uslovje elementarnymi simetričnymi funkcijami s rezultantom \(+1\) ili \(-1\). Arhiv čuva frazu raděje nego uvodi nov naziv pri prěhodu od ranějšego kriterija. Slovnik zato objašnjuje istorijni smysl dimenzije i rozděl medžu nenulevostju i obratimostju; ne vyhladžuje jih pod odnym poznatym slovom.

Reason: The archived členov najvyššej dimenzije means the homogeneous parts of highest degree, not the dimension of an algebraic set. In Section 15 of Paper 6 their resultant must be a unit in the coefficient domain, not merely nonzero. That stronger hypothesis supports the corresponding assertion over a domain where nonzero elements need not be invertible. The text writes \(R_0=\varepsilon\) and illustrates the condition using elementary symmetric functions with resultant \(+1\) or \(-1\). The archive retains the phrase rather than introducing a new name when moving beyond the earlier criterion. The dictionary therefore explains the historical degree sense of dimenzija and the difference between nonvanishing and invertibility instead of smoothing both away under familiar vocabulary.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Najvyšša dimenzija označaje stepen; jedinica jest silnějše uslovje nego nenulevost.

Textual comparison: Highest dimension means degree; being a unit is stronger than being nonzero.

rezultant \(i\)-go nivoja / elementarny dělitelj \(i\)-go nivoja

Iztočnik / Source: Resultante \(i\)-ter Stufe / Elementarteiler \(i\)-ter Stufe

Rusky / Russian: результант \(i\)-го уровня / элементарный делитель \(i\)-го уровня

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: результант \(i\)-го рівня / елементарний дільник \(i\)-го рівня

Razlog: Nivoj prěvodí Stufe kako indeksovanu vrstvu konstrukcije, ne prosto vremenny krok algoritma. Definicija VI v rabotě 22, §5, nazyvaje \(R^{(i)}(x)\) rezultantom \(i\)-go nivoja i \(E^{(i)}(x)\) elementarnym děliteljem toho nivoja. Oni nastavajut poslě prisojedinjenja ostalyh neoprěděljenyh; prvi jest odgovarjajuča norma, vtory najvyšši elementarny dělitelj. Produkty po vseh indeksah daju dvě formy, medžu ktorymi tekst dokazyvaje dělitelnost. Arhivni izbor nivoj čuva takvu indeksaciju i izběgaje pretežno proceduralno čitanje etapy. Tej razlog ne jest obči zakaz slova etapa v drugih kontekstah. Dva arhivna zapisa čuvajut to samo pravilo; bukva \(i\) ostavaje matematičnym indeksom i pokazyvaje se odlično od običnogo slova.

Reason: Nivoj renders Stufe as an indexed level of the construction, not simply a chronological algorithmic step. Definition VI in Paper 22, Section 5, calls \(R^{(i)}(x)\) the resultant of level \(i\) and \(E^{(i)}(x)\) the elementary divisor of that level. They arise after the remaining indeterminates are adjoined; the former is the corresponding norm and the latter the highest elementary divisor. Products over all indices give two forms whose divisibility relation is proved. The recorded choice nivoj preserves this indexing and avoids a predominantly procedural reading of “stage.” It is not a general ban on etapa elsewhere. Two archival records preserve the same rule; \(i\) remains a mathematical index, typeset distinctly from ordinary wording.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija VI veže indeks s normoju, elementarnym děliteljem i produktami po nivojah.

Textual comparison: Definition VI links the index to a norm, an elementary divisor and products over levels.

rezultantno značenje

Iztočnik / Source: Resultantenbedeutung

Rusky / Russian: значение результанта

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: значення результанта

Razlog: Rezultantno značenje označaje funkciju, ktoru norma izpolnjaje v eliminacionnoj teoriji. V rabotě 25 svyza medžu razloženjem ideala i razloženjem normy daje rezultantom ih ulogu; slovo značenje tu ne označaje samo numeričnu cěnnost. Kratky adjektiv rezultantno veže vysvětlenje s poznatym terminom bez tvorjenja novogo složenogo substantiva. Arhiv tak objašnjuje izbor, ale ne dava měrene skory za vse možne sinonimy. Pri čitanju potrěbno jest odlišiti normu v tutoj algebraičnoj konstrukciji od metrijnoj normy, a svyzu razloženij od jejich bukvalnoj identičnosti. Takože mnogokratnost, vyražena stepenom, zavisi od relativnoj bazy; ona ne jest neobjasnjeno opakovanje slova rezultant.

Reason: Rezultantno značenje denotes the role played by the norm in elimination theory. In Paper 25 the relation between ideal decomposition and factorization of the norm gives resultants their significance; značenje does not mean merely a numerical value. The short adjective rezultantno connects the explanation to the familiar technical term without creating a new compound noun. That is the preserved rationale, not a measured ranking of every possible synonym. Readers must distinguish this algebraic norm from a metric norm and a relation between factorizations from their literal identity. The multiplicity expressed by degree also depends on the relative base; it is not an unexplained repetition of the word resultant.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rezultantno značenje označaje matematičnu ulogu, ne samo numeričnu cěnnost.

Textual comparison: Resultant significance denotes a mathematical role, not merely a numerical value.

rezultanta forma

Iztočnik / Source: Resultantenform

Rusky / Russian: результирующая форма

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: результантна форма

Razlog: Rezultanta forma v arhivu jest kratka međunarodna fraza. Ukrajinsky sravnjajuči izraz imaje jasny adjektivny korenj rezultant-, pokym rusky izraz rezultirujuščaja možet v običnom jezyku značiti prosto výslednu formu. Matematičny kontekst zato jest važnějši než mehanično kopiranje približno sličnogo slova. V rabotě 18 idealu odgovarja forma složena iz rezultantnyh faktorov; ona izčezaje na zajednyh nuljah, no argument čuva takože faktory i mnogokratnosti. Jednakost forma pri dělitelnosti idealov jest silnějše tvrđenje nego jednakost golyh množenstv nuljev. Slovnik čuva istorijno zapisanu formu i jej razlog, ne proglašaje neizslědovanu morfologičnu variantu jedinym pravilnym standardom. V OLP rezultant takože ne směje byti zaměnjen logičnym pojmom rezolucije po sličnosti zvuka.

Reason: Rezultanta forma is the compact international phrase preserved in the archive. The Ukrainian comparandum has an explicit rezultant- adjective, while the Russian rezultirujuščaja can mean simply “resulting” in ordinary language. Mathematical context therefore matters more than mechanical copying of a superficially similar word. In Paper 18 an ideal is associated with a form made from resultant factors; it vanishes at the common zeros, but the argument retains factors and multiplicities as well. Equality of the forms under ideal divisibility is stronger than equality of the bare zero sets. The dictionary preserves the historical form and its rationale without declaring an unexamined morphological variant uniquely correct. Nor should OLP identify resultant with logical resolution through resemblance of sound.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jednakost form nosi vyše informacije nego samo jednakost množenstv nuljev.

Textual comparison: Equality of forms carries more information than equality of their zero sets alone.

rezultantna forma / forma elementarnyh děliteljev

Iztočnik / Source: Resultantenform / Elementarteilerform

Rusky / Russian: результантная форма / форма элементарных делителей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: результантна форма / форма елементарних дільників

Razlog: Rezultantna forma i forma elementarnyh děliteljev nazyvajut dvě konstrukcije, ktore v §5 raboty 22 stavajut invariantami. Arhiv davaje prědnost stalym složenym nazivam prěd svobodnym opisom: internationalny korenj rezultant- ohranjaje prepoznavajemy naziv, a dělitelj prodolžaje už upotrěbjenu terminologičnu rodinu. Rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy dajut slične složene formy, ale ne sut nezavisny test razumljivosti. V tekste rezultantna forma \(R\) i forma \(E\) ne sut obče identične: navedeno jest \(E\mid R\) i \(R\mid E^k\). Zato podobnost nazivov ne dozvaljaje jih sjediniti. Prědnost tu imajut razlikovanje invariantov i kontinuitet nazivov; čislove ocěnky kandidatov ne sut zachovane.

Reason: Rezultantna forma and forma elementarnyh děliteljev name two constructions that become invariants in Paper 22, §5. The record favours stable compound names over free paraphrase: the international resultant stem remains recognizable, while dělitelj continues an established terminological family. The Russian and Ukrainian records supply similar compounds, not an independent comprehension test. The text does not generally identify the resultant form \(R\) with the elementary-divisor form \(E\): it states \(E\mid R\) and \(R\mid E^k\). Similar names therefore do not justify merging the objects. Distinction between the invariants and continuity of naming are the documented priorities; numerical candidate scores are not preserved.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nazivy razlikujut invarianty; relacija dělimosti ne jest identičnost.

Textual comparison: The names distinguish invariants; divisibility is not identity.

rezultantna forma / rezultant

Iztočnik / Source: Resultantenform / Resultante

Rusky / Russian: результантная форма / результант

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: результантна форма / результант

Razlog: Rezultantna forma / rezultant čuva svez medžu nazvom formy i jeji algebraičnoju funkcijeju. Arhiv opiraje izbor na internationalnu rodinu rezultant-, s blizkimi ruskymi i ukrajinskymi formami, i potrěbuje razlikovati ju od determinant i norma. To potrěbovanje odnosi se na terminologične role, ne na tvrdženje, že objekty nikdy ne mogut byti ravne. V razgledanoj konstrukciji raboty 22 tekst upravo svezuje normu, determinant i rezultantnu formu. Slovnik zato ne može povtoriti kratku arhivnu formulaciju kako bezuslovnu zabranu takoj identifikacije. Smysl prěklada jest ohranjati naziv, pod ktorym autor uvodi objekt, i izjaviti matematičnu ravnost tam, kde ona jest dokazana.

Reason: Rezultantna forma / rezultant preserves the relation between the name of the form and its algebraic function. The record favours the international resultant family, with close Russian and Ukrainian forms, and requires a distinction from determinant and norm. That requirement concerns terminological roles, not a claim that the objects can never coincide. In the construction examined in Paper 22, the text expressly connects the norm, determinant, and resultant form. The dictionary must not turn the abbreviated historical rationale into an unconditional prohibition on that identification. Translation should retain the name under which the author introduces an object and state the mathematical equality where the argument establishes it.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Terminologične role sut različne i togda, kogda konstrukcija davaje ravne objekty.

Textual comparison: The terms have different roles even when a construction identifies their objects.

rezultantna forma i teorija eliminacije

Iztočnik / Source: Resultantenform und Eliminationstheorie

Rusky / Russian: результантная форма и теория исключения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: результантна форма і теорія елімінування

Razlog: Teorija eliminacije opisuje v rabotě 22 odstranjenje proměnnyh v teoriji polinomnyh idealov. Arhiv izbral internationalny korenj zaradi prepoznavajemosti, ale sravnjenje ne pokazuje jednaky korenj vo vseh jezykah: rusky zapis uživaje isključenije, ukrajinsky eliminuvannja. To jest izbor disciplinarnogo naziva, ne proste glasovanje po bukvah. §7 svezuje rezultantnu formu s postopnym eliminovanjem, dimenzijeju i mnogokratnostju; pri specializaciji ostavajut važni izrečene uslovja. Naziv zato ne davaje dozvoljenja vypustiti te uslovja. Za OLP trěba oddělno obosnovati eliminaciju kvantifikatorov: sličny korenj sam ne dokazyvaje identičnost algebraičnogo i logičnogo pojma.

Reason: Teorija eliminacije concerns the elimination of variables in polynomial-ideal theory in Paper 22. Recognizability motivates the international stem, but the comparanda do not all use that stem: the Russian record uses exclusion terminology, whereas the Ukrainian uses an elimination form. This is a choice of disciplinary expression, not a simple vote on matching letters. Section 7 relates the resultant form to successive elimination, dimension, and multiplicity; its stated specialization conditions remain essential. The term does not permit those conditions to disappear. Quantifier elimination in OLP requires its own contextual justification: a shared stem alone does not identify the algebraic and logical concepts.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Naziv glavy ne izpuščaje uslovij o dimenziji, mnogokratnosti i specializaciji.

Textual comparison: The section title does not dispense with conditions on dimension, multiplicity, and specialization.

recipro?no predstavjenje; direktno predstavjenje [Čestično nezachovane bukvy / Partly unrecoverable lettering]

Iztočnik / Source: reziproke Darstellung; direkte Darstellung

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Recipročno prědstavjenje v nynějšnom tekste raboty 40 obracaje poredok množenja; direktno prědstavjenje go ohranjaje. Razlika vyhodi iz lěvyh i pravyh operatorov a ne iz pojetja obratnoj matrice. Arhivna motivacija davaje prědnost internationalnomu nazivu prěd nenazvanoju domačnoju kalkoju, ktora je ocenjena kako menje prepoznavajema; ta ocěnka ne jest podkrepljena testom čitateljev. Sam zapis jest poškodženy: medžuslovjansko recipro?no ne čuva vseh bukv, a rusky i ukrajinsky redy ne dozvaljajut obnoviti slova. Tekst korpusa zato služi kako nynějšny kontekst, ne kako dokaz, čto je stalo v vseh izgubljenyh poljah. Slovo recipročno ne trěba mechanicky zaměnjati s obratno.

Reason: In the current text of Paper 40, recipročno prědstavjenje reverses multiplication order, whereas direktno prědstavjenje preserves it. The distinction comes from left and right operators, not from the concept of an inverse matrix. The historical rationale prefers international terminology to an unnamed native calque judged less recognizable; no reader test supports that judgement. The record itself is damaged: Interslavic recipro?no lacks a letter, and the Russian and Ukrainian lines do not preserve recoverable words. The corpus provides a current contextual witness, not proof of what every lost field originally contained. Recipročno must therefore not be mechanically replaced by obratno.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Obračenje poredka operatorov ne jest isto čto obračenje matrice. Poškodžene arhivne bukvy ne sut obnovjene bez dokazov.

Textual comparison: Reversing the order of operators is not matrix inversion. Damaged historical lettering has not been reconstructed without evidence.

obratna matrica

Iztočnik / Source: Reziproke der Matrix

Rusky / Russian: обратная матрица

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: обернена матриця

Razlog: Obratna matrica zaměnjuje historijsko označenje Reziproke der Matrix modernym nazivom. Rusky obratnaja i ukrajinsky obernena podkrepljajut to pojetjno čitanje. Arhiv tvrdži, že taka modernizacija ne měnjaje algebraičny smysl; to ale ne zaměnjuje kontrolu indeksov. V nynějšnom (43) raboty 17 stojut \(\alpha^{12}=-\alpha_{21}/A\) i \(\alpha^{21}=-\alpha_{12}/A\), pri \(A=\det(\alpha_{ik})\ne0\). Pri obyčnom poredku redov i stolpcov tako označena matrica jest transponovana obratna matrica. Možna jest ina konvencija indeksov ili pogrěška prěpisa; bez primarnogo svědka ne trěba pripisyvati pogrěšku autoru. Leksičny izbor obratna jest razumlivy, ale presna notacija ostavaje otvoreno pitanje.

Reason: Obratna matrica modernizes the historical expression Reziproke der Matrix. Russian obratnaja and Ukrainian obernena support that conceptual reading. The record says that modernization leaves the algebra unchanged, but this does not replace an index check. In the current equation (43) of Paper 17, \(\alpha^{12}=-\alpha_{21}/A\) and \(\alpha^{21}=-\alpha_{12}/A\), with \(A=\det(\alpha_{ik})\ne0\). Under ordinary row-and-column conventions, the matrix so labelled is the transpose of the inverse. A different indexing convention or a transcription defect may be involved; no error should be attributed to the author without the primary witness. The lexical choice obratna is intelligible, but the exact notation remains an open question.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Relacije v (43) potrěbujut sravnjenje s primarnym svědkom; leksična modernizacija sama ne potvrđuje notaciju.

Textual comparison: The relations in (43) require comparison with the primary witness; lexical modernization alone does not validate the notation.

vzaimnosti

Iztočnik / Source: Reziprozitäten

Rusky / Russian: соотношения взаимности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: співвідношення взаємності

Razlog: Vzaimnosti jest kratok arhivny naziv za recipročne relacije medžu modulnymi kvocientami. Nynějšny tekst uživaje vzajemnosti; ta razlika form ostavaje vidima v slovniku. Arhiv ne potrěboval dolgy opis, zato že jednačenja noset presny sodržaj relacije. To jest opravdanje kratkosti v konkretnom izloženju, ne pravilo izpuščati definicije. V §2 raboty 22 čitatelj može sravniti oba naprěvenja relacije i prědpoloženja o faktorah. Naziv ne označaje obče aritmetičny zakon vzajemnosti, niti vsaku simetričnu relaciju. Pri prěnosu do drugogo teksta trěba vozstanoviti objekt, operaciju i uslovja, ne samo izbrati obče slovo za vzajemnost.

Reason: Vzaimnosti is the compact archived name for reciprocal relations between module quotients. The current text uses vzajemnosti; the difference remains visible in the dictionary. The record considers a short name sufficient because the displayed equations supply the precise content of the relation. That justifies brevity in this particular exposition, not the omission of definitions as a general rule. Paper 22, §2 lets the reader compare the two directions and the assumptions on the factors. The name denotes neither an unspecified arithmetic reciprocity law nor every symmetric relation. Transfer to another text requires recovering the objects, operation, and conditions, not merely selecting a generic word for reciprocity.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jednačenja određajut, v kakom smyslu relacije sut vzajemne.

Textual comparison: The equations determine the sense in which the relations are reciprocal.

determinant porjadka \(\rho\)

Iztočnik / Source: \(\rho\)-reihige Determinante

Rusky / Russian: детерминант порядка \(\rho\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: детермінант порядку \(\rho\)

Razlog: Determinant porjadka \(\rho\) jest arhivny popraveny izbor: prvy zapis mešal poredok determinanta s rangom modula. V §7 raboty 24 oba čisla sut označene \(\rho\), ale imajut različne role. Poredok govori o veličině kvadratnoj matrice, čij determinant jest vzety; rang govori o modulnoj strukturě. Nynějšny tekst imaje formu poredka, ne arhivno porjadka. Slovnik ohranjaje i razliku pojmov, i sviděteljstvo o jezyčnoj formě; ne prědstavjaje staru formu kako novu normu. Odločujuči kriterij byl matematična točnost, ne kratkost. Ta razlika ostavaje potrěbna i togda, kogda vrednosti ranga i poredka slučajno sut ravne.

Reason: Determinant porjadka \(\rho\) is the archived corrected choice: an earlier wording confused determinant order with module rank. Both numbers are denoted by \(\rho\) in Paper 24, §7, but they have different roles. Order describes the size of the square matrix whose determinant is taken; rank describes module structure. The current text has poredka rather than archived porjadka. The dictionary preserves both the conceptual distinction and the evidence of the linguistic form, without presenting the older spelling as a new norm. Mathematical accuracy, not brevity, was decisive. The distinction remains necessary when rank and determinant order happen to have equal values.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jednaky simbol za dvě čisla ne sjedinjaje njihove matematične role.

Textual comparison: The same symbol for two numbers does not merge their mathematical roles.

teorem Riemanna–Rocha / redukcijny teorem

Iztočnik / Source: Riemann-Rochscher Satz / Reduktionssatz

Rusky / Russian: теорема Римана–Роха / теорема редукции

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема Рімана–Роха / теорема редукції

Razlog: Teorem Riemanna–Rocha i redukcijny teorem ohranjajut dva imena, ne dva zaměnljive opisy jednogo tvrđenja. Arhiv se opiraje na disciplinarny upotrěb i ohranjaje autorovo Reduktionssatz, s objasněnjem o fiksovanyh točkah v proze. V rabotě 14 geometricky pristup vodi od rezidualnogo teorema črez redukciju do teorema Riemanna–Rocha; aritmetično izloženje měnjaje poredok dokaza. Z toga ne slěduje, že jeden teorem možno izpustiti kako sinonim drugogo. Fiksovane točky tu trěba čitati v danom geometrickom kontekstu, ne kako automaticky odkaz na teorem o kontrakcijah. Eponim ohranjaje naučnu identifikaciju, ale sam naziv ne potvrđuje věrnost vsego dokaza.

Reason: Teorem Riemanna–Rocha and redukcijny teorem retain two names, not interchangeable descriptions of one assertion. The record appeals to disciplinary usage and preserves the author’s Reduktionssatz with an explanation involving fixed points in the prose. In Paper 14, the geometric route proceeds from the residual theorem through reduction to Riemann–Roch, while the arithmetic exposition changes the order of proof. That does not make one theorem dispensable as a synonym of another. Fixed points must be read in this geometric context, not treated as an automatic reference to a contraction theorem. The eponym preserves scholarly identification; the name alone does not certify the entire proof.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Geometricky i aritmetičny pristupy ne činet nazivy redukcije i Riemanna–Rocha zaměnljivymi.

Textual comparison: Geometric and arithmetic approaches do not make the reduction and Riemann–Roch theorem names interchangeable.

Riemannova površina / absolutna Riemannova površina

Iztočnik / Source: Riemannsche Fläche / absolute Riemannsche Fläche

Rusky / Russian: риманова поверхность / абсолютная риманова поверхность

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ріманова поверхня / абсолютна ріманова поверхня

Razlog: Riemannova površina spojuje ohranjeno vlašćne ime s široko slovjanskim nazivom površina; tak jest formulovana arhivna motivacija. Dodatek absolutna ne jest ukras. V rabotě 14 označaje on konstrukciju toček nezavisnu od izbranoj funkcije \(z\); tekst sravnjaje konečne vrednosti \(z\) s upotrěboju \(1/z\) za ostale točky. Izbor zato trěba ocěnjati po toj definiciji, ne samo po sodobnom zvučenju naziva. Ruske i ukrajinske formy podkrepljajut svez s terminologijeju površin, ale ne stanovjajut samostojno medžuslovjansku normu. Slovnik ne prěnosi kvalifikator absolutna na drugy objekt bez novogo čitanja definicije i ne zaměnjuje historijsko izloženje modernym učebničnym.

Reason: Riemannova površina combines the retained proper name with the broadly Slavic noun površina, as the historical rationale puts it. Absolutna is not decorative. In Paper 14 it identifies a construction of points independent of the selected function \(z\); the text contrasts finite values of \(z\) with the use of \(1/z\) for the remaining points. The choice must therefore be assessed against that definition, not merely the modern familiarity of the name. The Russian and Ukrainian forms support a connection with surface terminology but do not independently establish an Interslavic norm. The dictionary does not transfer absolutna to another object without rereading its definition or replace the historical exposition with a modern textbook account.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kvalifikator absolutna imaje lokalnu definicijsku funkciju.

Textual comparison: The qualifier absolute has a specific role in the local definition.

Rimanove normalne koordinaty

Iztočnik / Source: Riemannsche Normalkoordinaten

Rusky / Russian: римановы нормальные координаты

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ріманові нормальні координати

Razlog: Rimanove normalne koordinaty ohranjajut geometricky naziv i eponim. Tri arhivne zapisy svezujut izbor s upotrěboju v rabotah 12, 21 i 23, osoblivo s obosnovanjem redukcije invariantov. V rabotě 12 normalne koordinaty prevodet ekstremaly iz fiksovanoj točky v prave linije; v tom leži smysl naziva, ne v normalizaciji dlžiny vektora. Zapisy o kirilici govorjat i o transliteraciji, i o ohranjanju vlašćnyh imen. Bez sravnjenja konkretnyh kiriličnyh měst te skraćene opisy ne dokazyvajut jednu detaljnu politiku. Pri OLP ne trěba iz geometričnogo normalne vyvoditi izbor za normalnu formu formula: kvalifikator imaje svoju funkciju v vsakom disciplinarnom kontekstu.

Reason: Rimanove normalne koordinaty retains both the geometric term and the eponym. Three records connect the choice with Papers 12, 21, and 23, particularly the justification for reducing invariants. In Paper 12, normal coordinates turn extremals through a fixed point into straight lines; that is the relevant meaning, not normalization of a vector’s length. The Cyrillic notes refer both to transliteration and to preserving proper names. Without comparison of the actual Cyrillic passages, those abbreviated descriptions do not establish one detailed policy. Nor should geometric normalne determine the term for a normal form of formulas in OLP: the qualifier has its own function in each disciplinary context.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Smysl normalnosti ide iz konstrukcije ekstremalov, ne iz občeho normalizovanja.

Textual comparison: Normality derives from the construction using extremals, not generic normalization.

kolco vsih cělyh algebraičnyh čisel

Iztočnik / Source: Ring aller ganzen algebraischen Zahlen

Rusky / Russian: кольцо всех целых алгебраических чисел

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце всіх цілих алгебраїчних чисел

Razlog: Kolco vsih cělyh algebraičnyh čisel čuva razvity opis oblasti koeficientov prěd kratkym nazivom prsten cělyh čisel. Arhiv davaje tomu opisu prědnost, zato že autor izjavjaje, ktore čisla prinadležet k prstenu. Slovo vsih jest ale ograničeno kontekstom: v §7 raboty 24 ide o cěle algebraične čisla danogo konečnogo algebraičnogo čislovogo polja \(K\), ne o vse take čisla bez ograničenja polja. Nynějšny korpus uživaje prsten na městu kolco. Važno jest ohranjati i algebraičny uslov, i polje, v ktorom on jest razgledany. Kratšejši naziv može byti užitečny poslě definicije, ale ne směje skryti drugu oblast koeficientov.

Reason: Kolco vsih cělyh algebraičnyh čisel preserves an expanded description of the coefficient domain instead of the shorter ring-of-integers name. The record favours that description because the author specifies which numbers belong to the ring. Vsih, however, is bounded by context: Paper 24, §7 concerns the algebraic integers of the specified finite algebraic number field \(K\), not all algebraic integers without a field restriction. The current corpus uses prsten where the record has kolco. Both the integrality condition and its ambient field must remain explicit. A shorter name may be useful after definition, but must not conceal a different coefficient domain.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Slovo vsih ostavaje ograničeno danym čislovym poljem.

Textual comparison: All remains restricted to the specified number field.

kolco matric / matrične jedinice

Iztočnik / Source: Ring der Matrizes / Matrizeneinheiten

Rusky / Russian: кольцо матриц / матричные единицы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце матриць / матричні одиниці

Razlog: Kolco matric / matrične jedinice svezuje naziv prstena s jeho koordinatnym opisom. Arhiv podkrepljaje soglasnost treh jezyčnyh zapisov i kontinuitet algebraičnoj konstrukcije; nynějšny medžuslovjansky tekst uživaje prsten. V §14 raboty 34 množenje matričnyh jedinic zavisi od srednjih indeksov: pri jih soglasnosti nastavaje odgovarjajuča jedinica, pri nesoglasnosti nula. Zato jedinice ne znači, že vsi ti elementi sut obratljive; to ne jest sinonim grupy jedinic prstena. Takože koeficientny objekt v tom opisu može byti nekomutativno tělo. Prěklad dolžen ohranjati te razlike, a ne neprimětno zaměniti teoriju matric nad tělom teorijeju nad komutativnym poljem.

Reason: Kolco matric / matrične jedinice connects the name of the ring with its coordinate description. The record emphasizes agreement among the three language records and continuity of the algebraic construction; the current Interslavic text uses prsten. In Paper 34, §14, multiplication of matrix units depends on the middle indices: matching indices give the corresponding unit, mismatching indices give zero. Jedinice therefore does not mean that all these elements are invertible; it is not another name for the ring’s group of units. The coefficient object may also be a noncommutative division ring. Translation must preserve these distinctions, not silently substitute matrix theory over a commutative field.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Matrična jedinica ne jest obče obratlivy element prstena.

Textual comparison: A matrix unit is not generally an invertible ring element.

kolco v abstraktnoj definiciji

Iztočnik / Source: Ring in abstrakter Definition

Rusky / Russian: кольцо в абстрактном определении

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце в абстрактному означенні

Razlog: Kolco v abstraktnoj definiciji bylo izbrano skoro doslovno, zato že autor ne tolko imenuje prsten, ale daje jeho aksiomy. V rabotě 19 definicija potrěbuje komutativnost množenja i specifičnu aditivnu strukturu; jediničny element ne jest potrěbny a nulove dělitelji sut dozvoljene. Kratky moderny naziv s inačejšimi konvencijami ne zaměnjuje toj definicije. Nynějšny prsten ne měnjaje etih uslovij. Iztočny tekst takože pripisuje prědhodnu definiciju Fraenkelu a objasnjaje odstranjenje něktoryh ograničenij; to jest avtorska pohođenost, ne dostignjenje prěklada. Dva historijske zapisy dokumentujut kontinuitet naziva, ne dva nezavisne dokazy pravilnosti vsakoj aksiomy.

Reason: Kolco v abstraktnoj definiciji was kept close to the source because the author supplies ring axioms rather than merely naming the structure. In Paper 19, the definition requires commutative multiplication and a specified additive structure; an identity element is not required and zero divisors are permitted. A compact modern term with different conventions cannot replace that definition. The current name prsten does not change these conditions. The source also credits Fraenkel’s earlier definition and explains the removal of restrictions; that is inherited mathematical provenance, not an achievement of the translation. Two historical records document continuity of naming, not two independent checks of every axiom.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definiciju određajut izrečene aksiomy, ne konvencije dodane kratkym modernym nazivom.

Textual comparison: The stated axioms govern the definition, not conventions imported by a shorter modern label.

kolco bez jediničnogo elementa

Iztočnik / Source: Ring ohne Einheitselement

Rusky / Russian: кольцо без единичного элемента

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце без одиничного елемента

Razlog: Kolco bez jediničnogo elementa ohranjaje vidimu ograničenost prědpoloženja. V dodatku k §2 raboty 30 izpuščenje potrěbovanja o jedinici měnjaje opis poradženogo modula: kromě prstenovyh množiteljev trěba dopustiti cěločiselne mnogokratnosti poradžajučih elementov. Arhiv zato ne zaměnil tu frazu jednoslovnym nazivom. Važno jest razlikovati prsten, za ktory jedinica ne jest prědpoložena, od prstena, za ktory se tvrdži, že jedinicy ne imaje. Oboje ne jest identično ni s tvrdženjem, že nijeden element ne jest obratlivy. Nynějšny tekst imenuje prsten, ne kolco; nasledovanie naziva trěba provoditi zajedno s pravilnym dosegom aksiomy.

Reason: Kolco bez jediničnogo elementa keeps the hypothesis visible. In the addendum to Paper 30, §2, dropping the identity assumption changes the description of a generated module: integer multiples of the generators are needed in addition to multiples by ring elements. The record consequently retains the explicit phrase rather than replacing it with a one-word label. A ring in which an identity is not assumed must be distinguished from a ring asserted to have no identity. Neither expression simply says that no individual element is invertible. The current text says prsten, not kolco; continuity of naming must be checked together with the exact scope of the axiom.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Izpuščena aksioma měnjaje opis poradženogo modula.

Textual comparison: Dropping the axiom changes the description of the generated module.

kolco bez nulovyh děliteljev

Iztočnik / Source: Ring ohne Nullteiler

Rusky / Russian: кольцо без делителей нуля

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце без дільників нуля

Razlog: Kolco bez nulovyh děliteljev ponehava izrečeny uslov, vměsto da avtomatično poda kratko oblast cělosti. Arhiv opiraje to na kontinuitet terminologije v rabotah 29–31. V §4, punktu 7 raboty 31 taj uslov vystupaje pri sravnjenju ranga ideala s rangom prstena i pri opisah slěda i normy. Slovnik čuva motivaciju za eksplicitnu frazu; ona ne dokazyvaje, že moderny naziv nikde ne jest prikladny. Drugy zapis za taj sam německy izraz, oblast cělosti, sviděteljstvuje o drugoj redakcijnoj strategiji. Oba izbory trěba sravniti po kontekstu, osoblivo po komutativnosti i jedinici, prěd ustanovjenjem jedinoj politiki za OLP.

Reason: Kolco bez nulovyh děliteljev retains the stated condition instead of automatically shortening it to oblast cělosti. The record bases this on continuity of zero-divisor terminology across Papers 29–31. In Paper 31, §4, item 7, the condition accompanies comparisons of ideal and ring rank and the treatment of trace and norm. The dictionary preserves the reason for the explicit phrase without treating it as proof that modern domain terminology is never appropriate. Another record for the same German expression chooses oblast cělosti and thus represents a different editorial strategy. Both choices require contextual comparison, especially concerning commutativity and identity, before one policy is established for OLP.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Literalna fraza i modernizovany naziv vyžadujut kontekstualno sravnjenje.

Textual comparison: The literal phrase and modernized name require contextual comparison.

oblast cělosti

Iztočnik / Source: Ring ohne Nullteiler

Rusky / Russian: область целостности

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: область цілісності

Razlog: Oblast cělosti jest svěstna modernizacija německogo Ring ohne Nullteiler za koeficientny prsten \(Z\). Arhiv ju opravdava sodobnym matematičnym registrom a ohranjanjem iztočnogo izraza v aparatu. V danom početku §4 raboty 31 jediničny element osnovnogo prstena prinadleži k \(Z\); tekst potom postavjaje dopolniteljne uslovja o konečnyh slobodnyh modulah. Te daljše uslovja ne sut čest definicije vsakoj oblasti cělosti. Izbor jest zato prikladny tolko s ustanovjenymi konvencijami. On ne odpravjaje susědny literalny izbor bez nulovyh děliteljev; razlika medžu modernizacijeju i věrnym ohranjanjem razvitogo uslova ostavaje predmetom redakcijnogo rěšenja.

Reason: Oblast cělosti is a deliberate modernization of Ring ohne Nullteiler for the coefficient ring \(Z\). The record appeals to current mathematical register while retaining the source expression in the apparatus. At this opening of Paper 31, §4, the ambient ring’s identity belongs to \(Z\); further assumptions on finite free modules then follow. Those additional conditions are not part of the definition of every integral domain. The choice is therefore appropriate only with the conventions established. It does not erase the neighbouring literal choice bez nulovyh děliteljev: the difference between modernization and preserving an explicit hypothesis remains an editorial decision.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uslovja o konečnyh slobodnyh modulah ne prinadležet avtomatično definiciji oblasti cělosti.

Textual comparison: Finite-free module assumptions do not automatically belong to the definition of integral domain.

kolco bez děliteljev nula i s jediničnym elementom

Iztočnik / Source: Ring ohne Nullteiler und mit Einheitselement

Rusky / Russian: кольцо без делителей нуля и с единицей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце без дільників нуля і з одиничним елементом

Razlog: Kolco bez děliteljev nula i s jediničnym elementom izjavjaje dva uslova oddělno: odsutnost nulovyh děliteljev i obstajanje jedinicy. Arhiv im pripisyvaje visoku razumljivost medžu slovjanskimi matematičnymi registrami, ale ne podava empiricky test ili čislove ocěnky. V §8 raboty 31 te dva uslova ješče ne izčerpajut definiciju razgledanogo prstena: slědujut i potrěbovanja o razloženju idealov. Nynějšny tekst uživaje prsten, ale čuva izraz děliteljev nula. To ne rěšaje padežnu razliku prěd formami nuly i nulovyh drugde v korpusu; obosnovanje korenja ne jest obosnovanje vsakoj fleksije. Slovnik zapisuje razliku bez izmyslenogo historijskogo gramatičnogo obosnovanja.

Reason: Kolco bez děliteljev nula i s jediničnym elementom states two conditions separately: absence of zero divisors and existence of an identity. The record attributes high cross-Slavic transparency to them, but supplies neither an empirical test nor numerical scores. In Paper 31, §8, those two conditions do not exhaust the definition of the ring under discussion: requirements on ideal factorization follow. The current text uses prsten but retains děliteljev nula. That does not settle its case-form difference from nuly and nulovyh elsewhere in the corpus; justification of a lexical stem does not justify every inflection. The dictionary records the difference without inventing a historical grammatical rationale.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prsten bez nulovyh děliteljev i s jediniceju ješče ne izpolnjaje avtomatično vsih slědujučih aksiomov.

Textual comparison: A ring with identity and no zero divisors does not automatically satisfy all the further axioms.

kolco bez radikala

Iztočnik / Source: Ring ohne Radikal

Rusky / Russian: кольцо без радикала

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце без радикала

Razlog: Kolco bez radikala ohranjaje uslov o idealu, ne zaměnjaje go opisom vsih elementov. V §12 raboty 34 radikal jest maksimalny nilpotentny dvustranny ideal pri danom uslovju cěpov. Prsten bez radikala imaje taj ideal ravny nuly; to ne znači, že v njem ne može byti nijednogo nenulovogo nilpotentnogo elementa. Zato naziv ne jest avtomatično sinonim modernogo redukovanogo prstena. Drugy arhivny zapis prodolžaje uslov pri priměnjenju k grupovym prstenam, kde važna jest karakteristika koeficientnogo polja. Nynějšny naziv prsten ne měnjaje nijednu od tih granic. Svez s polnoju razložimostju treba čitati po konkretnyh teoremah, ne izvoditi samo iz naziva.

Reason: Kolco bez radikala preserves a condition on an ideal, not a description of every element. In Paper 34, §12, the radical is the maximal nilpotent two-sided ideal under the stated chain condition. A radical-free ring has that ideal equal to zero; this does not say that it cannot contain any nonzero nilpotent element. The name is therefore not automatically synonymous with a modern reduced ring. A second record carries the condition into the group-ring application, where the characteristic of the coefficient field matters. The current name prsten changes none of these boundaries. Relations with complete reducibility must be read from the particular theorems, not inferred from the name alone.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nulovy radikal i odsutnost vsih nenulovyh nilpotentnyh elementov ne sut isto potrěbovanje.

Textual comparison: Zero radical and absence of all nonzero nilpotent elements are not the same requirement.

kolco konečnogo ranga vzhodno k podpolju \(P\)

Iztočnik / Source: Ring von endlichem Rang in bezug auf einen Unterkörper \(P\)

Rusky / Russian: кольцо конечного ранга относительно подполя \(P\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільце скінченного рангу відносно підполя \(P\)

Razlog: Kolco konečnogo ranga vzhodno k podpolju \(P\) čuva i konečnost ranga, i polje, po odnošenju k ktoromu rang jest izčisljeny. Arhiv svezuje izbor s ranějšeju terminologijeju ranga i s prozrěčnym složenjem pod-polje, za ktoro rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy dajut slične nazivy. To ne znači konečno čislo elementov prstena. Teorem v §6, punktu 4 raboty 31 razgledaje taj relativny rang pri uslovjah o diskriminantu i razložimosti. Nynějšny tekst imaje prsten i po odnošenju k, ne arhivno kolco i vzhodno k. Slovnik ohranjaje istoriju izbora, ale pri novoj prěkladnoj rabotě ne rekomenduje vozvračanje k staroj prědložnoj konstrukciji.

Reason: Kolco konečnogo ranga vzhodno k podpolju \(P\) retains both finite rank and the field relative to which rank is measured. The record connects the choice with earlier rank terminology and the transparent compound pod-polje, supported by similar Russian and Ukrainian names. It does not mean that the ring has finitely many elements. The theorem in Paper 31, §6, item 4 concerns this relative rank together with discriminant and reducibility conditions. The current text uses prsten and po odnošenju k rather than archived kolco and vzhodno k. The dictionary preserves the history of the choice without recommending a return to the older prepositional construction in new translation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rang zavisi od danej koeficientnoj oblasti; ne jest čislo vsih elementov.

Textual comparison: Rank is relative to the specified coefficient field; it is not the cardinality of the ring.

kolcova adjunkcija

Iztočnik / Source: Ring-Adjunktion

Rusky / Russian: присоединение как кольцу

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: приєднання як кільця

Razlog: Kolcova adjunkcija izpolzovaje internationalny korenj s kvalifikatorom, ktory kaže, čto jest konstruovano. Arhivny rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy izbirajut obično opisno prisojedinjenje; toj razhod ne jest skryt za izmyslenym edinym slovjanskim nazivom. V §1 raboty 31 prstenova adjunkcija davaje poradženy podprsten: polinomy v prisojeđenih elementah s ohranjanymi relacijami okolnogo prstena. Ne davaje avtomatično polje niti obratne elementy vsih nenulovyh elementov. Takože to ne jest kategorična adjunkcija funktorov. Odločujuči jest smyslovy kvalifikator prstenova v nynějšnom tekste; staro kolcova ostavaje arhivna forma. Prosta zaměna slova adjunkcija v drugoj disciplině izgubila by razliku konstrukcij.

Reason: Kolcova adjunkcija uses an international stem with a qualifier identifying what is constructed. The Russian and Ukrainian records instead choose ordinary descriptive adjoining language; that divergence is not concealed behind an invented single Slavic label. In Paper 31, §1, ring adjunction gives the generated subring: polynomials in the adjoined elements, subject to the relations of the ambient ring. It does not automatically give a field or inverses for all nonzero elements. Nor is it a categorical adjunction of functors. The meaningful qualifier is decisive: the current text has prstenova, while kolcova remains the archived form. Replacing every occurrence of adjunction in another discipline would lose the distinction between constructions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Poradženy prsten ohranjaje relacije okolnogo prstena; ne jest avtomatično polje.

Textual comparison: The generated ring retains ambient relations; it is not automatically a field.

kolceva oblast

Iztočnik / Source: Ringbereich

Rusky / Russian: кольцевая область

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільцева область

Razlog: Kolceva oblast doslovno ohranjaje dvočlenny německy naziv Ringbereich. Arhiv tomu dava prednost, aby ne suzil pojem prěd pozdnějšim razširjenjem k modulam i nekomutativnym oblastjam. Oblast tu ne znači automatno oblast cělosti: v §1 raboty 19 nulove dělitelje sut dozvoljene i jedinica ne jest potrěbna; §9 razděljuje prstenovu oblast i oblast, na ktoro ona dějstvuje. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenje podpirajut formu frazy, ne dodavaju nove aksiomy. Nynějšny prěvod ima prstenova oblast. Slovnik ohranjaje staru formu i jeji razlog, ale pri novoj upotrěbě trěba čitati definiciju oblasti, ne izvoditi odsutnost nulovyh děliteljev iz jedinogo slova oblast.

Reason: Kolceva oblast closely preserves the two-part name Ringbereich. The recorded reason is to avoid narrowing the concept before the later treatment of modules and noncommutative structures. Oblast does not automatically mean integral domain here: Paper 19, §1 permits zero divisors and does not require an identity; §9 distinguishes the ring from the structure on which it acts. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the construction of the phrase, not additional axioms. The current translation has prstenova oblast. The dictionary preserves the earlier form and its reason, but future use must follow the local definition, not infer absence of zero divisors from oblast alone.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Naziv oblasti ne dodava odsutnost nulovyh děliteljev ni komutativnost v pozdnějšem obobčenju.

Textual comparison: The domain label adds neither absence of zero divisors nor commutativity in the later generalization.

kolca konečnogo ranga

Iztočnik / Source: Ringe endlichen Ranges

Rusky / Russian: кольца конечного ранга

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільця скінченного рангу

Razlog: Kolca konečnogo ranga prodolžuje ranějši naziv i izrično ohranjaje rang kako modulny pojem. V §2 raboty 31 rang jest maksimalno čislo linearno nezavisnyh elementov nad danym poljem; ne jest čislo vseh elementov prstena. §4 potom razširjaje prědpoloženja, aby objel i poredky: baza i nezavisnost sut tam odnosne k oblasti cělosti. Arhiv čuva jednu frazu prěz toj prěhod, ne tvrdži, že vsi osnovni objekty sut polja. Ruska i ukrajinska forma davajut paralelu konečnosti i ranga. Nynějšny korpus piše prsteny, ne kolca; pri standardizaciji trěba ohraniti osnovnu oblast i vsako dodatno uslovje o bazi.

Reason: Kolca konečnogo ranga continues the earlier terminology while retaining rank as a module-theoretic condition. In Paper 31, §2, rank is the largest number of linearly independent elements over the specified field, not the number of all ring elements. Section 4 broadens the assumptions to include orders: basis and independence are then relative to an integral domain. The records preserve the phrase across that transition without saying that every base is a field. The Russian and Ukrainian forms parallel both finiteness and rank. Current Interslavic uses prsteny rather than kolca; standardization must retain the coefficient domain and every additional basis hypothesis.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Konečnost ranga jest različna od konečnosti množstva elementov.

Textual comparison: Finite rank differs from finiteness of the set of elements.

kolca s jediničnym elementom / kolco s jedinico

Iztočnik / Source: Ringe mit Einheitselement / Ring mit Einheit

Rusky / Russian: кольца с единицей / кольцо с единицей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільця з одиничним елементом / кільце з одиницею

Razlog: Polny izraz s jediničnym elementom v naslovu i kratky s jedinico v tekučoj prozě sut dvě formy togo samogo uslovja. Arhiv objašnjaje kratkost ruskoj formy i polnějše ukrajinske i medžuslovjanske zaglavje; toj izbor jest registr i ekonomija izloženja, ne različna definicija jedinice. §17 raboty 34 razděljuje modul na čest, kde jedinica dějstvuje kako identičny operator, i čest, kde ona dějstvuje kako nula. Zato prsten s jedinico sam ne znači, že vsak razgledany modul už ima identično dějstvovanje jedinice. Ranějša prednost kolco prěd formoju ring jest zachovana kako historijno obrazloženje; aktualny naziv jest prsten.

Reason: The full heading s jediničnym elementom and the shorter prose form s jedinico express the same assumption. The record explains the short Russian wording and the fuller Ukrainian and Interslavic headings as choices of register and economy, not different definitions of identity. Paper 34, §17 decomposes a module into a part where the ring identity acts as the identity operator and a part where it acts as zero. Thus a ring with identity does not by itself mean that every module being considered already has unital action. The earlier preference for kolco over a borrowed ring is preserved as historical reasoning; current terminology is prsten.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jedinica prstena ne dějstvuje potrěbno identično na cělom modulu.

Textual comparison: The ring identity need not act identically on the entire module.

kolca s jediničnym elementom i bez nuljevyh děliteljev

Iztočnik / Source: Ringe mit Einheitselement und ohne Nullteiler

Rusky / Russian: кольца с единицей и без делителей нуля

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільця з одиницею і без дільників нуля

Razlog: Kolca s jediničnym elementom i bez nuljevyh děliteljev jest rezultat zabilěženoj zaměny provizornogo ringy na tada upotrěbljano kolca. Arhiv se opira na doslědnost s rabotami 19 i 24, ne na čislenu ocěnku kandidatov. Dva dodatka morajut ostati odvojeno vidime: egzistencija jedinice i odsutnost nulovyh děliteljev. Kratka rabota 26 k nim dodava cěpove uslovja i integralnu zamknjenost; prva fraza ne sodržuje cělu karakterizaciju. Nynějšny korpus ima prsteny i ohranjaje nuljevyh na tom městu. Razlika s nulovyh v drugyh pasažah jest stvarna pravopisna ili tvorbena razlika za sravnjenje, ne dokaz različnyh matematičnyh pojmov.

Reason: Kolca s jediničnym elementom i bez nuljevyh děliteljev records a change from provisional ringy to the then-used kolca. Its stated basis is consistency with Papers 19 and 24, not numerical candidate scores. The two qualifications must remain separately visible: existence of an identity and absence of zero divisors. The brief Paper 26 adds chain conditions and integral closedness, so the opening phrase does not contain the whole characterization. The current text has prsteny and retains nuljevyh here. Its difference from nulovyh elsewhere is a spelling or formation difference to examine, not evidence of distinct mathematical concepts.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odsutnost nulovyh děliteljev i jedinica ne zaměnjajut cěpovyh uslovij i integralnoj zamknjenosti.

Textual comparison: Absence of zero divisors and an identity do not replace the chain and integral-closedness conditions.

kolca ranga jedan

Iztočnik / Source: Ringe vom Rang eins

Rusky / Russian: кольца ранга один

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільця рангу один

Razlog: Kolca ranga jedan ohranjaje točnu veličinu ranga. Poslědok v §3 raboty 31 govori o razloženju po razširjenju osnovnogo polja: komponenty sut jednodimenzionalne nad odgovarjajučym poljem i jemu izomorfne. On ne pravi, že početny prsten imaje jedin element, ni že on už jest polje. Prěhod k algebraično zatvorjenomu polju i potom k dostatočnomu konečnomu razširjenju jest čestju argumenta. Rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy takože izgovarjajut čislo, ne nový tip konečnosti. Aktualno prsteny ranga jedan čuva toj smysl; slovo rang trěba čitati s jeho osnovnym poljem.

Reason: Kolca ranga jedan retains the precise value of the rank. The corollary in Paper 31, §3 concerns decomposition after extension of the base field: the components are one-dimensional over, and isomorphic to, the appropriate field. It says neither that the initial ring has one element nor that it is already a field. Passage to an algebraically closed field and then to a sufficient finite extension is part of the argument. Russian and Ukrainian likewise state the number rather than a new kind of finiteness. Current prsteny ranga jedan preserves this meaning; rank must be read with its base field.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Komponenty sut jednodimenzionalne nad odgovarjajučym poljem, ne množstva iz jednogo elementa.

Textual comparison: The components are one-dimensional over the appropriate field, not singleton sets.

kolcovy homomorfizm od \(R\) k \(R_a\)

Iztočnik / Source: Ringhomomorphismus von \(R\) zu \(R_a\)

Rusky / Russian: гомоморфизм колец из \(R\) в \(R_a\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: гомоморфізм кілець із \(R\) до \(R_a\)

Razlog: Kolcovy homomorfizm od \(R\) k \(R_a\) spojuje ustaljeny naziv preslikanja s izričnym iztočnikom i cěljem. Predložky zato noset směr, ne samo stil. V §4 raboty 31 korpus govori o prstenovom homomorfizmu v matrično prsten, a potom iz njega izvodi aditivne i skalarne relacije slěda. Homomorfizm sam ne jest tvrdženje obratnoj jednoznačnosti; takože matrično preslikanje ne trěba směšati s posljedujučym slědom. Arhivny podindeks a jest ohranjen v zaglavju; tekst upotrěbjaje idealny podindeks. Pri novoj upotrěbě každe preslikanje trěbuje svoje operacije i směr, ne samo povtorjenje slova homomorfizm.

Reason: Kolcovy homomorfizm od \(R\) k \(R_a\) combines the established map name with an explicit source and target. The prepositions therefore carry direction, not merely style. In Paper 31, §4, the current text gives a ring homomorphism into a matrix ring and then derives additive and scalar relations for trace. A homomorphism is not by itself a claim of bijectivity, and the matrix map must not be confused with the subsequent trace. The archived subscript a is preserved in the heading; the text uses an ideal subscript. In a new context, each map needs its own preserved operations and direction, not just reuse of the label homomorfizm.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prstenovo preslikanje i iz njega vyvedeny slěd imajut različne role.

Textual comparison: The ring map and the trace derived from it have distinct roles.

kolcove operacije iz elementov kolca

Iztočnik / Source: Ringverknüpfungen aus Ringelementen

Rusky / Russian: кольцевые операции из элементов кольца

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: кільцеві операції з елементів кільця

Razlog: Kolcove operacije iz elementov kolca prěvodi Verknüpfungen nazvom operacij, aby konstrukcija ostala konkretna. Arhiv odpovědno ne zavodi kategorijny jezyk, ktory ne jest v iztočnoj frazě. V §7 raboty 31 sravnjavajuća pasaža razlikuje matričnu definiciju slěda od definicije prěz konjugovane elementy: druga ne mora byti priměnima k rezidualnomu prstenu. Slěd i diskriminant tam nastavajut prěz prstenove operacije, što objašnjaje jih prěnos homomorfizmom. Kratko operacije ne daje pravo dodati děljenje ili proizvoljne nove operacije. Nynějšna forma jest prstenove operacije; formulacija objašnjaje konstrukciju, ne zavodi novy kategoričny objekt.

Reason: Kolcove operacije iz elementov kolca renders Verknüpfungen as operations to keep the construction concrete. The record deliberately avoids introducing categorical language absent from the phrase. In Paper 31, §7, the comparison passage distinguishes the matrix definition of trace from a definition through conjugate elements: the latter need not apply to the residue ring. Trace and discriminant are formed by ring operations, explaining their passage through the homomorphism. The short word operacije does not license adding division or arbitrary new operations. Current wording is prstenove operacije; the expression explains a construction rather than naming a new categorical object.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Matrična definicija ostavaje relevantna, kogda konjugovane elementy ne davajut potrěbno prědstavjenje.

Textual comparison: The matrix definition remains relevant when conjugate elements need not provide the required representation.

obrubljenje

Iztočnik / Source: Ränderung

Rusky / Russian: окаймление

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: облямування

Razlog: Obrubljenje upotrěbjaje sliku okraja, podobno ruskomu okajmlenie i ukrajinskomu obljamuvannja. Arhiv ocěnjuje tu sliku kako razumlivu i prosi daljšu jezyčnu prověrku; ne zapisyvaje izvršeny čitatelsky test. V §3 raboty 2 to jest konkretna operacija Clebschovogo prěnosa, ktora veže binarnu relaciju s ternarnoju, ne proizvoljno dodanje okraja objektu. Novo konsultovane zapisy 21388 i 21390 oficialnogo slovnika podpirajut korenj obrųb v smyslah okraja i podšitego kraja oděže. Oni ne zasvědčajut matematičny smysl ni točno odvođeno obrubljenje; to zaglavje v konzultovanoj kopiji ne bylo nalezeno. Obyčny korenj i tehnično rěšenje zato ostavajut različne vrstvy dokaza.

Reason: Obrubljenje uses an edging image, like Russian okajmlenie and Ukrainian obljamuvannja. The record judges that image intelligible and requests further linguistic checking; it does not report a completed reader test. In Paper 2, §3, this is a specific operation in Clebsch’s transfer from a binary relation to a ternary one, not arbitrary addition of a border. Newly consulted official-dictionary rows 21388 and 21390 support the stem obrųb in the ordinary senses of border and clothing hem. They attest neither the mathematical sense nor the precise derivative obrubljenje, which was not found as a headword in the consulted copy. Ordinary lexical support and the technical proposal therefore remain distinct kinds of evidence.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tehnično značenje vyhodi iz sravnjenja binarnoj i ternarnoj relacije.

Textual comparison: The technical meaning comes from the binary and ternary relations being compared.

\(S(\gamma)\) slěd / \(N(\gamma)\) norma vzhodno k glavnomu klasu

Iztočnik / Source: \(S(\gamma)\) die Spur / \(N(\gamma)\) die Norm in bezug auf die Hauptklasse

Rusky / Russian: \(S(\gamma)\) след / \(N(\gamma)\) норма относительно главного класса

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: \(S(\gamma)\) слід / \(N(\gamma)\) норма відносно головного класу

Razlog: Slěd i norma ohranjajut dva matematična invarianta i jih zavisnost od glavnogo klasa. Arhiv dava prednost kontinuitetu s ranějšimi sekcijami, a ne proglasu jednoj frazy za vse upotrěby. V nynějšnom §6 raboty 31 diagonalno prědstavjenje dava \(S(\gamma)=c_1+\cdots+c_n\) i \(N(\gamma)=c_1\cdots c_n\). Suma i produkt ne sut zaměnjive, a norma tu ne znači metriku ili dolžinu vektora. Korpus už piše po odnošenju k vměsto arhivnogo vzhodno k. Pri skračenju zaglavja trěba ohraniti obě oznaky i relativny klas; bez nego izpustil by se parametr definicije.

Reason: Slěd and norma preserve two mathematical invariants and their dependence on the principal class. The recorded preference is continuity with earlier sections, not one phrase for every use. In the current Paper 31, §6, a diagonal representation gives \(S(\gamma)=c_1+\cdots+c_n\) and \(N(\gamma)=c_1\cdots c_n\). Sum and product are not interchangeable, and norm here does not mean a metric or vector length. The corpus now uses po odnošenju k instead of archived vzhodno k. A shortened heading must retain both symbols and the relative class; otherwise it loses a parameter of the definition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Suma, produkt i relativny klas ohranjajut različne česti definicije.

Textual comparison: Sum, product, and the relative class preserve different parts of the definition.

teorem

Iztočnik / Source: Satz

Rusky / Russian: теорема

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема

Razlog: Teorem prěvodi Satz kako oznaku dokazovanogo tvrdženja, ne kako obyčnu větu. Dva zapisy raboty 31 davajut prednost kontinuitetu mužskogo internacionalnogo naziva i tipografskomu razděljenju oznaky od tvrdženja. Čislo, tučny tisk i kursiv pomagajut najti granicu teorema; oni ne dokazujut jeho matematičnu pravilnost. Ta mužska forma ne jest edinstvena historijna forma korpusa: v rabotě 6 stojit teorema. V novo prověrenoj kopiji oficialnogo slovnika ni teorem ni teorema ne sut samostojne zaglavja. Taka odsutnost ne čini jih nepravilnymi, ale ne dava nezavisny slovnikovy dokaz za izbor roda. Rod i soglasovanje trěba obrazložiti posebno prěd občeju standardizacijeju.

Reason: Teorem renders Satz as the label of a mathematical assertion, not an ordinary sentence. Two Paper 31 records favour continuity of the masculine international form and typographic separation of label from statement. Numbering, bold type, and italics help readers locate the theorem; they do not establish its mathematical correctness. The masculine form is not the corpus’s only historical choice: Paper 6 has teorema. Neither teorem nor teorema occurs as an independent headword in the newly checked official-dictionary snapshot. Absence does not make them invalid, but it supplies no independent dictionary authority for the gender choice. Gender and agreement need separate justification before corpus-wide standardization.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tipografija ohranjaje granicu tvrdženja, ne dokazuje njegovu pravilnost.

Textual comparison: Typography preserves the assertion boundary, not its correctness.

Teorema I

Iztočnik / Source: Satz I

Rusky / Russian: Теорема I

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: Теорема I

Razlog: Teorema I označaje formalno numerovano tvrdženje raboty 6 o vzajemno jednoznačnom priredženju sistemov funkcij s ohranjenjem relacij v oběh směrah. Arhivny razlog jest kratky: Satz jest tu teorem, ne proza bez osobnoj matematičnoj roli. Rimsky I identifikuje tvrdženje; ne jest promenna ni bukva za transliteraciju. Forma teorema i genitiv teoremy v nynějšnoj pasaži stojut vedle teorem v drugyh rabotah. Slovnik tu razliku ne skryvaje i ne pripisyvaje arhivu nepostojajuče čislene sravnjenje roda. Pri jedinoj budučej normě trěba spolu kontrolovati pádne formy i vse odkazy, ne samo zaglavje.

Reason: Teorema I labels the formal numbered assertion in Paper 6 about a one-to-one correspondence between function systems preserving relations in both directions. The archived reason is brief: Satz denotes a theorem here, not prose without a distinct mathematical role. Roman I identifies the assertion; it is neither a variable nor a letter for transliteration. Teorema and the genitive teoremy in this passage coexist with teorem elsewhere. The dictionary neither conceals that difference nor attributes an unrecorded numerical gender comparison to the archive. A future common convention must check inflection and references together, not just replace the heading.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Forma teorema jest zasvědočena s odkazom v genitivu; tvrdženje ohranjaje obě smeri.

Textual comparison: Teorema is attested with a genitive reference; the assertion retains both directions.

teorem o konečnoj cěpi

Iztočnik / Source: Satz von der endlichen Kette

Rusky / Russian: теорема о конечной цепи

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема про скінченний ланцюг

Razlog: Teorem o konečnoj cěpi ohranjaje lokalny opis i historijno nazvanje, ktore tekst pripisyvaje Dedekindu. Ruska cěpna metafora i ukrajinsky lancjug dajut različne korenje za isti porjadkovy obraz; arhiv ne dava čislene sravnjenje teh korenjev. Sam teorem izgovarjaje stabilizaciju ideala od někojego konečnogo indeksa, odnosno nemožnost beskonečnoj strogoj cěpi danogo směra. Ne tvrdži, že cěly prsten ima konečno mnogo idealov ili elementov. Izbor slova konečny mora zato byti svęzany s cěpju i uslovjem konečnosti bazy. Dedekindov i Laskerov prispevek v izvornoj primětce ostavajut avtorsko iztočnikovo dědictvo.

Reason: Teorem o konečnoj cěpi preserves the local description and the historical chain terminology attributed in the text to Dedekind. Russian and Ukrainian use different chain roots for the same ordering image; the archive provides no numerical comparison of those roots. The theorem asserts stabilization from some finite index, equivalently the impossibility of an infinite strict chain in the specified direction. It does not say that the ring has finitely many ideals or elements. Konečny must therefore remain attached to the chain and the finite-basis assumption. Dedekind’s and Lasker’s contributions in the source footnote remain inherited scholarly provenance.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Konečny indeks stabilizacije ne znači konečno mnogo idealov v cělom prstenu.

Textual comparison: A finite stabilization index does not mean finitely many ideals in the whole ring.

teorem o izomorfiji

Iztočnik / Source: Satz von der Isomorphie

Rusky / Russian: теорема об изоморфии

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема про ізоморфію

Razlog: Teorem o izomorfiji imenuje rezultat v §8 raboty 17 opisno, bez zaměny novym slavnym imenom. Arhiv izrično dava prednost toj věrnosti iztočnomu naslovu. Tekst sravnjava dva konečna razklady polno reducibilnoj grupy na proste grupy: každa komponenta ima izomorfnu odgovarjajuču komponentu, a osobne uslovja odlučajut identičnost razkladov. To ne jest toliko formula o kvocientu i jadru homomorfizma, ktora v drugom kontekstu nosi podobno nazvanje. Pri ponovnoj upotrěbě treba identifikovati tvrdženje i prědpoloženja, ne izenačiti vse teoremy o izomorfiji po frazě.

Reason: Teorem o izomorfiji names the result in Paper 17, §8 descriptively rather than substituting a later famous name. The record expressly prefers this fidelity to the source heading. The text compares two finite decompositions of a completely reducible group into simple groups: each component has an isomorphic counterpart, and particular conditions govern identity of the decompositions. This is not merely the quotient-and-kernel formula called an isomorphism theorem in another setting. Reuse requires identifying the assertion and its hypotheses, not equating all results sharing the phrase.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Opisny naslov jest svęzany s konkretnym tvrdženjem o komponentah.

Textual comparison: The descriptive heading is tied to a specific assertion about components.

Iztočnik / Source: schaerfere Relationen (27), (28)

Rusky / Russian: более сильные соотношения (27), (28)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: сильніші відношення (27), (28)

Razlog: Ostrějše relacije označajut silnějši rezultat dokaza: ne samo izomorfiju grup ostatkov, ale konkretne kongruencije (27), (28) s \(X=Q\) i \(Y=P\). Arhivny razlog izrično čuva tu razliku; rusko bolee sil’nye i ukrajinsko syl’niši davajut sravniteljne konstrukcije s tym samym logičnym smyslom. Nynějšny tekst raboty 17 potvrđuje i komparativ, i oba svědka. Ostrějši tu ne znači bolje točny čislovy odhad. Zaglavje starogo zapisa ima nečitljivu bukvu; nynějšnje ostrějše jest oddělno potvrđena forma, ne obnovjena bukva arhiva. Izbor jest kvalitativny: čitljiva sveza s siloj tvrdženja, ne izměreny rezultat sravnjenja jezykov.

Reason: Ostrějše relacije marks a stronger result: not merely an isomorphism of residue groups, but the particular congruences (27), (28) with \(X=Q\) and \(Y=P\). The recorded reason expressly preserves this distinction; Russian bolee sil’nye and Ukrainian syl’niši supply comparative constructions with the same logical force. The current text of paper 17 confirms both the comparative and the two witnesses. Sharper here does not mean a more accurate numerical estimate. One letter in the old heading is unreadable; current ostrějše is separately attested, not a recovered archival letter. The choice is qualitative, favouring a clear relation to strength of assertion, not based on measured language-comparison scores.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kongruencije s \(X=Q\) i \(Y=P\) davajut vyše informaciji než samo izomorfija.

Textual comparison: Congruences with \(X=Q\) and \(Y=P\) give more information than the isomorphism alone.
