Jednoj formě odpovědaje jedna takova točka, ale razne formy mogut ležati pri istoj točki i trebujut dodatnogo uporjadkovanja. Glosa ne smi prevračati tu korespondenciju v neopravdanu bijekciju.

Reason: Sistem vrědnostij here is a tuple of numerical \(\alpha\) values counting elementary contractions. The current text has sistem cěnnostij and presents the values as coordinates of a lattice point. This is not an ethical value system or a newly defined abstract algebra. One form has one such point, but different forms can lie at the same point and need additional ordering. The gloss must not turn this correspondence into an unwarranted bijection.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razne formy mogut iměti tu samuju točku.

Textual comparison: Different forms can have the same point.

sistem vrědnostij

Rusky / Russian: система значений

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: система значень

Zato ranějša preferencija ne može byti predstavjena kako doslědno provedena norma. Pasaža govori o obščih nuljah homogennyh form i odličenju nulovogo priděljenja. The archive prefers vrědnostij to cennostij to avoid a price-related sense; the examined current passage nevertheless writes sistem cěnnostij. The earlier preference cannot therefore be presented as a consistently implemented norm. The passage concerns common zeros of homogeneous forms and distinguishes the zero assignment. A mathematical gloss clarifies the expression without claiming that only vrědnostij is permissible throughout the language.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Aktualno cěnnostij ne soglašaje se s ranějšeju preferencijeju vrědnostij.

Rusky / Russian: системы значений

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: системи значень

Aktualne pasaže imaju sistemy cěnnostij. Shranjajemo zato ranějši izbor i aktualnu variantu, ne vstavjajemo vměsto njih novu vektorno-prostornu notaciju. Both the recorded choice and the current variant are therefore preserved, without substituting new vector-space notation. Rational and algebraic dependencies and the exact rank remain attached to the particular assignments.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razne priměnjenja frazy trebujut konkretne argumenty.

The dictionary can therefore give the precise gloss nonisomorphic in this context, but cannot replace every occurrence of essentially different in another work without checking the relation.

suštstvene parametry / libovoljne funkcije

Iztočnik / Source: wesentliche Parameter / willkürliche Funktionen

Rusky / Russian: существенные параметры / произвольные функции

Razlog: Suštstvene parametry i libovoljne funkcije razlikujut dva vida zavisimosti grupy transformacij. Aktualna forma jest sučstvene parametry. Definicija izrično objasnjaje sučstvenost: zadano čislo parametrov ne možno zameniti menšim čislom. Libovoljne funkcije noset svoju funkcionalnu svobodu i potrebne uslovja regularnosti; one ne sut prosto mnogo čislovyh parametrov. Meždu obojimi slučajami tekst ostavlja osobny graničny slučaj beskonečno mnogyh parametrov. Izbor obščih slov ne smi sliti te kategorije.

Reason: Suštstvene parametry and libovoljne funkcije distinguish two kinds of dependence of a transformation group. The current form is sučstvene parametry. The definition makes essential explicit: the given number of parameters cannot be replaced by a smaller number. Arbitrary functions carry functional freedom and the required regularity conditions; they are not merely many numerical parameters. Between the two cases the text retains the separate limiting case of infinitely many parameters. Choosing ordinary words must not collapse these categories.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Beskonečno mnogo parametrov ne jest avtomatično libovoljna funkcija.

Textual comparison: Infinitely many parameters does not automatically mean an arbitrary function.

mimobežna prjama

Iztočnik / Source: windschiefe Gerade

Rusky / Russian: скрещивающаяся прямая

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: мимобіжна пряма

Razlog: Mimobežna prjama izbrana jest za prostranstvenu geometričnu konfiguraciju; ukrajinska forma blizko srovnjaje se s tim korenjem, ruska upotrěbjaje drugu tvorbu. Tu prjamy ne peresěkajut se i ne ležat v jednoj ravnině. Relacija jest poparna: dvě prjamy, ktore sut mimobežne k tretej, v samom priměru peresěkajut se medžu soboju. Slovnik zato mora označiti, koja para jest razgledana. Arhivna ocěna prozračnosti i ograda o jezyčnoj prověrke ne sut rezultat čitatelskogo eksperimenta.

Reason: Mimobežna prjama was chosen for a spatial geometric configuration; the Ukrainian form closely parallels its stem, while Russian uses a different formation. The relevant lines do not intersect and are not coplanar. The relation is pairwise: the example’s two lines that are skew to a third intersect each other. The dictionary must therefore identify the pair concerned. The archived assessment of transparency and request for linguistic review are not results of a reader experiment.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dvě prjamy mogut se peresěkati, hoti obe sut mimobežne k tretej.

Textual comparison: Two lines may intersect although both are skew to a third.

dobro uporjadkovana množina / dobro uporjadkovanje

Iztočnik / Source: wohlgeordnete Menge / Wohlordnung

Rusky / Russian: вполне упорядоченное множество / вполне упорядочение

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: добре впорядкована множина / добре впорядкування

Razlog: Dobro uporjadkovana množina i dobro uporjadkovanje nazyvajut tehničny poredok, ne prosto uredny spis. Primětka upotrěbjaje dobry poredok funkcij dlja poslědovateljnogo postrojenja dopustimogo sistema: funkcije prijmajut se ili izključajut se po zadanoj algebraičnoj prověrke. Procedura može byti prěkinjena na libovoljnom městu, a razgledanje vseh poredkov i měst prěkinjenja dava vse dopustime sistemy. Zato smysl ne možno skratiti do prosto izbrati funkcije; redoslednost jest čest konstrukcije.

Reason: Dobro uporjadkovana množina and dobro uporjadkovanje name a technical ordering, not merely a tidy list. The footnote uses a well-order of functions to construct an admissible system successively: functions are admitted or excluded by a specified algebraic test. The procedure may stop at any point, and considering every ordering and stopping point gives all admissible systems. The meaning cannot therefore be reduced simply to choose functions; the order is part of the construction.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Redoslednost i město prěkinjenja sut česti postupka.

Textual comparison: The order and stopping point are parts of the procedure.

dobro uporjadkovanje

Iztočnik / Source: Wohlordnung

Rusky / Russian: вполне упорядочение

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: добре впорядкування

Razlog: Dobro uporjadkovanje prodolžaje termin iz uvoda i shranjaje tehničny smysl dobrogo poredka. V sekciji 8 ono služi izboru predstaviteljev: oblast prijmaje se, ako ne jest izomorfna nijednoj prědhodnoj oblasti. Prva vozmožna iznimka potom vodi k proturěčenju. V ranějšem priměru, naprotiv, nijedno dobro uporjadkovanje ne dava želanyh svojstv. Jedna nazva mora dopuščati oba logična konteksta; ona ne sugeruje, že libovoljny izbor daje tu samu bazu. Arhiv ostavlja jezyčnu formu dlja ocěny, bez čitateljske prověrky razumljivosti.

Reason: Dobro uporjadkovanje continues the introductory term and retains the technical sense of a well-order. In section 8 it selects representatives: a domain is admitted if it is not isomorphic to any preceding domain. A first possible exception then yields a contradiction. In an earlier example, by contrast, no well-order gives the desired properties. One name must support both logical contexts; it does not suggest that arbitrary choices produce the same basis. The archive leaves the linguistic form open to assessment, without a reader test of intelligibility.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Ista nazva služi raznym kvantifikacijam.

Textual comparison: The same name occurs under different quantifiers.

dobro uporjadkovanje / porjadok elementov

Iztočnik / Source: Wohlordnung / Anordnung der Elemente

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Dobro uporjadkovanje i porjadok elementov ne sut dve svobodno zaměnjive frazy. Prva imenuje osobly typ poredka; druga govori o redoslědnosti elementov. Definicija racionalnoj bazy potrěbuje prinajmenje jedno dobro uporjadkovanje. Primětka pokazuje, že pri poredku \(\eta,\sqrt[\nu]{\eta}\) potrěbne sut oba elementy, a pri obratnom samo korenj. Ta zavisimost od poredka jest matematičny razlog shranjenja razliky. Aktualna proza piše poredok. Poškodžene ruske i ukrajinske zapisy ne davajut čitljive sravniteljne formy; slovnik ih ne rekonstruuje iz domysla.

Reason: Dobro uporjadkovanje and porjadok elementov are not freely interchangeable phrases. The former names a special kind of order; the latter refers to the sequence of the elements. The definition of a rational basis requires at least one well-order. The footnote shows that in the order \(\eta,\sqrt[\nu]{\eta}\) both elements are required, whereas the reverse order needs only the root. That dependence on order is the mathematical reason for retaining the distinction. Current prose writes poredok. The damaged Russian and Ukrainian records provide no readable comparative forms; the dictionary does not reconstruct them by conjecture.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Obratny poredok měnja izbor bazovyh elementov.

Textual comparison: Reversing the order changes the selected basis elements.

dobro uporjadkovanje / teorema o dobrom uporjadkovanju

Iztočnik / Source: Wohlordnung / Wohlordnungssatz

Rusky / Russian: вполне упорядочение / теорема о вполне упорядочении

V novom priměnjenju čisla, ktore ne možno racionalno izraziti prěz konečno mnogo prědhodnyh, tvoret bazu; poredok potom prěnosi se na obrazy i određuje polja početnyh odrězkov. Glosa proto mora shraniti i poredok, i obseg kvantifikacije. Nazva teorema ne jest sama dokazom vseh dalših tvrđenij o obrazah.

Reason: Dobro uporjadkovanje names an object, while teorema o dobrom uporjadkovanju names the result permitting its choice. The record deliberately continues terminology from the preceding paper. In the new application, numbers not rationally expressible through finitely many predecessors form a basis; the order is then transported to the images and determines initial-segment fields. The gloss must therefore retain both the order and the scope of quantification. Naming the theorem does not by itself prove every subsequent claim about the images.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Poredok prěnosi se na obrazy bazy.

Textual comparison: The order is transported to the images of the basis.

teorema o dobrom uporjadkovanju

Iztočnik / Source: Wohlordnungssatz

Rusky / Russian: теорема о вполне упорядочении

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема про добре впорядкування

Razlog: Teorema o dobrom uporjadkovanju jest razložena fraza vměsto německogo složenogo slova. Zachovany razlog sravnjava ukrajinsku konstrukciju s dobro i rusku s vpolně; ne dava čislovyh vah ni dokaza všeslovjanskoj razumljivosti. Uvod izrično pripisuje Zermelu konstrukciju, osnovanu na toj teoremě, a zatym objašnjava egzistenciju algebraičnoj bazy. Toj kredit i prelaz od poredka k bazi sut česti smisla. Kratka nazva ne smi prepisati avtorstvo konstrukcije prevoditelju.

Reason: Teorema o dobrom uporjadkovanju expands the German compound into a phrase. The preserved rationale compares the Ukrainian construction with dobro and the Russian one with vpolně; it supplies neither numerical weights nor a demonstration of pan-Slavic intelligibility. The introduction explicitly credits Zermelo with a construction based on the theorem and then explains the existence of an algebraic basis. That attribution and the passage from ordering to a basis are part of the meaning. The short name must not transfer authorship of the construction to the translator.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem služi konstrukciji s izričnym ljudskim kreditom.

Textual comparison: The theorem serves a construction with explicit human attribution.

korenjevo polje

Iztočnik / Source: Wurzelkörper

Rusky / Russian: поле корней

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле коренів

Razlog: Korenjevo polje izbrano jest kako prozračna tvorba, soglasna s poljem kvocientov i medžupoljem, vměsto novogo zaimstvovanja. Rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy imajo istu korenevu metaforu. Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Čitljiva aktualna forma razložena algebra svjazana jest s arhivnym razlo?ena algebra, čije izgubljene bukvy ne možno predstavljati kako zachovany tekst. Razlog izbora razlikuje algebru od razpadnogo polja: prvo jest objekt, ktory razpadaje se, drugo razširjenje, ktore taj razpad omogožuje. V pasaži razložena algebra jest polny matričny prsten nad centrom. To ne znači samo reducibilnu ili poluprostu algebru. Slovo potrebuje tu strukturnu glosu, ne samu analogiju s razloženjem polinoma.

Reason: The readable current form razložena algebra is linked to archival razlo?ena algebra, whose lost letters must not be presented as preserved text. The rationale distinguishes the algebra from a razpadno polje: the former is the object that splits, the latter the extension enabling it. In the passage a split algebra is a full matrix ring over the center. This does not mean merely a reducible or semisimple algebra. The word needs that structural gloss, not just an analogy with polynomial factorization.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razloženost algebry ne jest prosto poluprostost.

Textual comparison: Splitting of the algebra is not merely semisimplicity.

razlo?ena algebra; povsudu razlo?ena [Čestično nezachovane bukvy / Partly unrecoverable lettering]

Iztočnik / Source: zerfallende Algebra; ?berall zerfallend [Čestično nezachovane bukvy / Partly unrecoverable lettering]

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Razložena algebra i povsudu razložena prodolžajut istu pridavnikovu porodinu. Povsudnost odnosi se k konečnym i beskonečnym městam čislovogo polja, ne k proizvoljnym točkam prostora. V teoremu o glavnom rodu prvo se prověrjajut razvětvjene města i uslovje na faktorny sistem; zaključok potom govori o vseh městah i globalnom razpadu. Slovnik mora razložiti tu kvantifikaciju, a ne prosto ponoviti slovo povsudu. Arhivne formy s izgubljenymi bukvami ostajut označene oddělno od čitlivogo aktualnogo teksta.

Reason: Razložena algebra and povsudu razložena continue the same adjectival family. Everywhere refers to finite and infinite places of the number field, not arbitrary points in space. In the principal-genus theorem the ramified places and a condition on the factor system are checked first; the conclusion then concerns every place and global splitting. The dictionary must explain that quantification rather than merely repeat everywhere. Archived forms with lost letters remain distinguished from the readable current text.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Povsudu znači vse relevantne města polja.

Textual comparison: Everywhere means all relevant places of the field.

razložima/razložime formy

Iztočnik / Source: zerfallende Form(en)

Rusky / Russian: разлагающаяся/разлагающиеся формы; распадающаяся/распадающиеся формы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: форма/форми, що розкладаються

Razlog: Razložima i razložime sut jedinstvena i množestvena forma odnogo pridavnika. Arhiv dava prednost kratkoj medžuslovjanskoj formě, togda kako sravniteljne ruske i ukrajinske izrazy često razkladyvajut značenje v pričastnu frazu. Kontekst §§12–13 kaže, kako razklad slěduje iz jednokratnogo prěnosa nad ranějše razložimoju formoju i iz funkcionalnyh determinantov. To sohranjaje svjaz s konkretnoju konstrukcijeju. Arhivna ocěna prozračnosti ostaje kvalitativna, ne izměreny čitateljsky rezultat.

Reason: Razložima and razložime are singular and plural forms of one adjective. The record prefers the short Interslavic form, whereas the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda often spell out the meaning in a participial phrase. The context of sections 12–13 explains decomposition through a single transvection over an already decomposable form and through functional determinants. This retains the connection to the specific construction. The archived judgment of transparency is qualitative, not a measured reader result.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jedinstvena i množestvena forma ne sut razne pojmy.

Textual comparison: Singular and plural forms are not different concepts.

Kratko razložime iz pozdějše raboty mora byti povezano s jej osobno širšoju definicijeju, ne bezuslovno proglašeno istoznačnym.

Reason: Formy, koje se razkladųt na faktory is an early descriptive choice; the current phrase reads formy, ktore razkladajut se na faktory. The archive preserves the concept and an assessment of suitability for the pilot, but no detailed comparison of alternatives. Its function can therefore be explained without inventing a lost debate: the phrase explicitly names factors and requires no knowledge of a new adjective. The shorter razložime in the later paper must be linked to that paper’s specially broadened definition, not declared unconditionally synonymous.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nedostajajuči razlog ne može byti izmislen.

razkladne formy

V §25 avtorica razlikuje neposrědnje kontrakcije, ktore več ne nabraja, od razklada posrědstvom dvojnoj redukcije određene forme. Taka struktura dokaza daje pridavniku smisao. Njegova kratkost ne zaměnjuje odkazku na §13 i ne dopušča prevoditi redukciju i razklad jednoj neodrěđenej operacijej.

Reason: Razkladne formy is the shorter adjectival variant in the razklad- family. The record retains it for consistency without declaring its idiom finally established. In section 25 the author distinguishes direct contractions, no longer enumerated, from decomposition by double reduction of a specified form. That proof structure supplies the adjective’s sense. Its brevity does not replace the reference to section 13 or permit translation of reduction and decomposition as one unspecified operation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kratka forma ostaje vezana k točnomu dokazu.

razložime formy

Iztočnik / Source: zerfallende Formen

Rusky / Russian: разлагающиеся формы; распадающиеся на множители формы; распадающиеся формы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: форми, що розкладаються; форми, що розкладаються на множники

Razlog: Razložime formy bylo izbrano vměsto dolge pričastnoj frazy radi čitlivosti. Sravniteljne zapisy sohranjajut i ruske varianty s razlaganjem i raspadanjem, ne jednu tobože jedinu normu. Najvažnějša ograda jest matematična: §3 izrično obobčaje običny pojem, dopuščajuči produkty nižšego stepena zajedno s vyšimi formami. Pozdějše priměry naslědujut tu definiciju. Zato zabilěžene pytanje o jezyčnom registru ne može byti rěšeno prostym zaměnjenjem slova faktorizujema bez prověrky smisla.

Reason: Razložime formy was preferred to a longer participial phrase for readability. The comparative records preserve Russian variants involving both razlaganie and raspadanie, not a supposed single norm. The most important qualification is mathematical: section 3 explicitly generalizes the ordinary concept by permitting products of lower degree together with higher forms. Later examples inherit that definition. The recorded question of linguistic register therefore cannot be resolved simply by substituting factorable without checking the meaning.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Obyčna faktorizacija ne pokryvaje celu definiciju.

Textual comparison: Ordinary factorization does not cover the whole definition.

razkladny ręd form

Iztočnik / Source: zerfallende Formenreihe

Rusky / Russian: разложимый ряд форм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розкладний ряд форм

Razlog: Razkladny ręd form pripisuje razkladnost cělomu redu form, ne samo jednogo iz njegovyh členov. Aktualna grafija jest red. V §24 redukcija takogo reda vyhodi iz formule (30.)c i slědujuče točne relacije. Arhivny razlog izrično potrěbuje zachovati tu razliku v obsegu. Slovnik zato povezuje izraz s ranějšim pojmom reda form; on ne nudi interpretaciju kakoby šlo o konvergentny beskonečny red ili samo o proizvoljny spis polinomov.

Reason: Razkladny ręd form attributes decomposability to the whole row of forms, not merely to one member. The current spelling is red. In section 24 reduction of such a row follows from formula (30.)c and the ensuing exact relation. The archived rationale expressly requires preservation of that scope distinction. The dictionary therefore links the phrase to the previously defined row of forms; it does not suggest a convergent infinite series or merely an arbitrary list of polynomials.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Svojstvo ne odnosi se samo k jednomu členu.

Textual comparison: The property does not refer only to one member.

razložime rědy form ili formy

Iztočnik / Source: zerfallende Formenreihen oder Formen

Rusky / Russian: ряды форм или формы, распадающиеся на множители

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ряди форм чи форми, що розкладаються на множники

Razlog: Razložime rědy form ili formy širi obseg na cěly red i na pojedinu formu. Kratka arhivna motivacija govori o kontinuitetu s §3 i faktorah, ale treba sohraniti tamo obobčenu definiciju, ne samo običnu faktorizaciju. V planě konstrukcije te slučaje označujut města, kde red konči i kde dokaz ustanovljaje izčrpanost nereducibilnyh tvorjenij. Spojka ili zato nese informaciju o predmetu redukcije. Ona ne znači, že red i jedna forma sut istovětni objekty.

Reason: Razložime rědy form ili formy covers both a whole row and an individual form. The brief archived rationale refers to continuity with section 3 and to factors, but its broadened definition must be retained, not merely ordinary factorization. In the construction’s plan these cases mark where the row terminates and where the argument establishes exhaustion of the irreducible constructions. Or therefore carries information about the object of reduction. It does not identify a row with one form.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Spojka ili čuva obseg predmeta.

Textual comparison: Or preserves the scope of the object.

razložene skrěžene produkty

Iztočnik / Source: zerfallende verschränkte Produkte

Rusky / Russian: расщепляющиеся скрещенные произведения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розщеплені схрещені добутки

Razlog: Razložene skrěžene produkty spojujut zabilěženy termin skrěženy produkt s uslovjem razloženosti algebry. Uvod izrično povezuje to uslovje s faktornymi sistemami asocijovanymi s jedinicoju; v §1 beret se predstavitelj s faktornym sistemom jedinic. To ne jest običny produkt dvoh polinomov. Arhiv naměrno razlikuje razloženy objekt od razpadnogo polja i ostavlja jezyčnu ocěnu skrěženy otvorenoju. Pozdějši negaloisovy slučaj ima svoje hipotezy, ktore kratka nazva ne ukida.

Reason: Razložene skrěžene produkty combines the recorded crossed-product term with the condition that the algebra is split. The introduction expressly connects this condition with factor systems associated with unity; section 1 chooses a representative whose factor system consists of units equal to one. This is not an ordinary product of two polynomials. The record deliberately distinguishes the split object from the splitting field and leaves the linguistic assessment of skrěženy open. The later non-Galois case has its own hypotheses, which the short name does not remove.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Asocijovanje s jedinicoju daje konkretny kriterij.

Textual comparison: Association with unity supplies a concrete criterion.

razpadne polja

Iztočnik / Source: zerfällende Körper / Zerfällungskörper

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поля розкладу

Razlog: Razpadne polja v bibliografiji prodolžajut istu nazvu kako v rabotah o predstavjenjah. Reason: Razpadne polja in the bibliography continues the name used in the representation-theory papers. The record avoids introducing a different variant only at the end of the book; rozkladno polje remains a comparative proposal, not an implemented substitution. The bibliography names minimal splitting fields and Brauer as coauthor. Those identifying details must remain and lead to the particular work. The bibliography is not an additional independent attestation of linguistic norm or a new proof of minimality.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nazva v bibliografiji ne jest novy terminologičny dokaz.

Textual comparison: A bibliographic name is not new terminological evidence.

razkladaje se / razkladanje

Iztočnik / Source: zerfällt / Zerfallen

Rusky / Russian: разлагается / разложение

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розкладається / розкладання

Razlog: Razkladaje se i razkladanje davajut glagol i imennik za istu operaciju. Konkretny primer v §19 upotrěbja kratšu glagolnu variantu razklada se, odkazuje na formulu (7.)a i iz togo vyvodi razklad slědujuče forme. Zato različna dulžina glagola ne ukazuje novu matematičnu razliku. Arhivny razlog jest kontinuitet s determinantnymi redukcijami; on ne dava pravo zameniti specifičnu formulu obćim slovom razklad. Prěvod mora sohraniti smer togo zaključka.

Reason: Razkladaje se and razkladanje give the verb and noun for the same operation. The specific example in section 19 uses the shorter verbal variant razklada se, refers to formula (7.)a and deduces decomposition of the next form. The difference in verbal length therefore does not mark a new mathematical distinction. The recorded reason is continuity with determinant reductions; it does not authorize replacing the specific formula by the generic word decomposition. Translation must preserve the direction of the inference.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razklada se i razkladaje se ne tvorjat dva matematična pojma.

Textual comparison: Razklada se and razkladaje se do not create two mathematical concepts.

razklada se / razkladna forma

Iztočnik / Source: zerfällt / zerfallende Form

Rusky / Russian: разлагается / разложимая форма

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розкладається / розкладна форма

Razlog: Razklada se i razkladna forma prodolžajut kratku glagolnu i pridavnikovu tvorbu. Arhiv upominaje poljske, češke i južnoslovjanske obrazce, ale bez točnyh citacij, zato to ostaje zabilěžena motivacija, ne nově ustanovjena attestacija. V §22 razklad dobiva se dvojnoju redukcijeju i kontrakcijeju s funkcionalnym determinantom; zaključna čest kaže, ktora točno forma čuva razkladnost pri jedno- i dvojkratnyh kontrakcijah. Taj konkretni subjekt ne možno izpustiti i potom pripisati svojstvo vsakoj formě.

Reason: Razklada se and razkladna forma continue the short verbal and adjectival formation. The record mentions Polish, Czech and South Slavic patterns without exact citations, so this remains a recorded motivation rather than a newly established attestation. In section 22 decomposition is obtained by double reduction and contraction with a functional determinant; the conclusion specifies exactly which form preserves decomposability under single and double contractions. That particular subject cannot be omitted and the property then attributed to every form.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kvantifikacija ostaje vezana k konkretnomu subjektu.

Textual comparison: Quantification remains attached to its particular subject.

polje razloženja

Iztočnik / Source: Zerfällungskörper

Rusky / Russian: поле разложения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле розщеплення

Razlog: Polje razloženja jest zabilěžena imennička alternativa k razpadno polje. Zapis sravnjava ukrajinske rozščepennja s ruskom razloženie i biraje tu drugu tvorbu dlja medžuslovjanskogo. V članku oba jezyčna dela mają strogy smisao: \(K\) razklada algebru, kogda razširjena algebra naleži klasu polnyh matric nad \(K\). Lokalny kriterij dodatno potrěbuje dělimost odgovarjajučih stepenjev indeksami. Zato slovnik sohranja variantu i kriterij, ne predstavlja pojavu različnogo nazvanja kako novo matematično otkrytje.

Reason: Polje razloženja is the recorded nominal alternative to razpadno polje. The record compares Ukrainian rozščepennja with Russian razloženie and chooses the latter formation for Interslavic. In the article the phrase has a strict meaning: \(K\) splits the algebra when the extended algebra belongs to the class of full matrix algebras over \(K\). The local criterion additionally requires divisibility of the relevant degrees by the indices. The dictionary retains both the variant and the criterion, rather than presenting a different name as a mathematical discovery.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Imennikova i pridavnikova nazva trebujut jednoj svezi.

Textual comparison: The nominal and adjectival names need a cross-reference.

razpadne polja

Iztočnik / Source: Zerfällungskörper

Rusky / Russian: поля разложения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поля розщеплення

Razlog: Razpadne polja prodolžajut ranějši izbor, a rozkladno polje ostaje imenovanoju alternativoj bez tichoj zaměny sredi raboty. Uvod određuje predmet: komutativne razširjenja oblasti koeficientov, v ktoryh predstavjenja razpadajut se na absolutno ireducibilne. Hipoteza sistema bez radikala i svez s tělom avtomorfizmov sut česti toga izloženja. Prosta pluralna nazva ne mora skrivati ni te uslovja, ni naučnu svez s Šurovymi i Brauerovo-Noetherovymi rabotami.

Reason: Razpadne polja continues the earlier choice, while rozkladno polje remains a named alternative without a silent mid-paper substitution. The introduction specifies the object: commutative coefficient-field extensions over which representations split into absolutely irreducible ones. The radical-free hypothesis and connection with the automorphism division ring belong to that account. The simple plural name must not conceal those conditions or the scholarly connection with Schur’s work and the Brauer–Noether paper.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Hipoteza odsutnosti radikala ne jest neobvezna.

Textual comparison: The radical-free hypothesis is not optional.

razpadno polje

Iztočnik / Source: Zerfällungskörper

Rusky / Russian: поле расщепления

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поле розщеплення

Razlog: Razpadno polje zabilěženo jest v trěh kontekstah kako nazva komutativnogo razširjenja, v otličji od razložene algebry. Ta doslědnost ne sliva vse definicije: v rabotě o Šurovom pytanju govorji se o razpadu predstavjenja, a v rabotě o skrěženyh produktah o algebrě i jej maksimalnom komutativnom podpolju. Minimalnost po uključanju i najnižši stepenj takože ostajut različne. Slovo razpad- izbrano jest radi prozračnoj slovjanskoj tvorby, no arhivna ograda o jezyčnom odobrenju ne jest svědectvo provedenoj ekspertnoj ocěny.

Reason: Razpadno polje is recorded in three contexts for a commutative extension, as distinct from a razložena algebra. That consistency does not merge all definitions: the paper on Schur’s question concerns splitting a representation, while the crossed-product paper concerns an algebra and its maximal commutative subfield. Inclusion-minimality and least degree also remain different. The razpad- formation was chosen for its transparent Slavic construction, but the archived reservation about linguistic approval is not evidence of completed expert review.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Doslědnost nazvy ne odstraňuje razlike konteksta.

Textual comparison: Consistency of the name does not remove contextual differences.

razložima identičnost

Iztočnik / Source: zerlegbare Identität

Rusky / Russian: разложимое тождество

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розкладна тотожність

Razlog: Razložima identičnost označaje svojstvo identičnosti; razkladna identičnost označaje imenovany vid identičnosti, ktora razkladaje simbolny red. Razlika jest matematična, ne samo stilistična. Avtorka naziva razkladnu identičnost nerazložimoju, dokolě jej redy imajut nezavisno značenje; po odgovarajučoj zaměně ona stava razložimoju. Zato te dvě nazvy ne smějut byti mehanično zamenjene jedna drugoju. Ocěna zavisi od definicije i od toga, ktore simboly jesmo ostavili nezavisnymi.

Reason: Razložima identičnost describes a property of an identity; razkladna identičnost names a family of identities that decompose a symbolic row. The difference is mathematical, not merely stylistic. The author calls a decomposition identity indecomposable while its rows retain independent meaning; after the relevant substitution it becomes decomposable. The two names therefore cannot be mechanically interchanged. The classification depends on the definition and on which symbols remain independent.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razlika zavisi od nezavisnosti simbolnyh redov.

Textual comparison: The distinction depends on independence of symbolic rows.

razklad v \(k\) sostavnyh ?esti / \(k\) podgrup [Čestično nezachovane bukvy / Partly unrecoverable lettering]

Iztočnik / Source: Zerlegung in \(k\) Bestandteile / \(k\) Untergruppen

Rusky / Russian: ?????????? ?? \(k\) ???????????? / \(k\) ???????? [Čestično nezachovane bukvy / Partly unrecoverable lettering]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: ??????? ?? \(k\) ????????? / \(k\) ??????? [Čestično nezachovane bukvy / Partly unrecoverable lettering]

Razlog: Razklad v k sostavnyh česti / k podgrup imenuje razklad na k aditivnyh komponentov. Čislo k ostaje parametrom: govorimo ne neobhodimo o dvuh komponentah. Formuly potrěbujut, že suma ravna nulu povlěče nuljevost vsakej česti, a teorema svazuje razklad grupy ostatkov s najmanjšim obščim kratnym k vzajemno prostyh modulov. Podgrupa zato ne označaje proizvoljny podmnožestvo. Prva fraza zde objasnjaje smysl čestično povrědženogo zapisa; originalne nezachovane bukvy i neprovedena jezyčna ocěna ne sut prikryte obnovjenoju tablicoju.

Reason: The phrase denotes decomposition into k additive components or subgroups. The symbol k remains a parameter: the decomposition need not have only two components. The formulas require a zero sum to force each component to vanish, and the theorem relates decomposition of the residue group to the least common multiple of k mutually coprime modules. Subgroup therefore does not mean an arbitrary subset. The explanatory wording clarifies a partially damaged record; it does not conceal the lost lettering or turn an outstanding linguistic assessment into completed review.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Razklad uključaje uslovje nezavisnosti komponentov.

Textual comparison: The decomposition includes a component-independence condition.

razloženje na dvustranne idealy

Iztočnik / Source: Zerlegung in zweiseitige Ideale

Rusky / Russian: разложение на двусторонние идеалы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: розклад на двобічні ідеали

Razlog: Razloženje na dvustranne idealy zachovuje neobhodimy pridevnik dvustranne. V danyh uslovjah razne idealne komponenty imajut nuljevy produkt, a vsaka komponenta ravna svojemu kvadratu. Obratny argument uživa te svojstva, da ustanovi idealnu strukturu. Prsten s jediniceju jest vyrazna hipoteza izloženja, ne domysl slovnika. Krača nazva razloženje na idealy by skryla važnu informaciju v nekomutativnom kontekstě; razloženje na levostranne idealy ne jest ravnoznačno.

Reason: Razloženje na dvustranne idealy preserves the essential qualification two-sided. Under the stated conditions, distinct ideal components have zero product and each component equals its square. The converse argument uses these properties to establish the ideal structure. A ring with identity is an explicit hypothesis, not an assumption supplied by the dictionary. Shortening the phrase to decomposition into ideals would hide important information in a noncommutative context; decomposition into left ideals is not equivalent.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Multiplikativne uslovja ne sut zaměnljive s obščim zbirkom podmnožestv.

Textual comparison: The multiplicative conditions are not interchangeable with an arbitrary collection of subsets.

The tabulated spellings are damaged; explaining the concepts does not pretend to recover the original Russian and Ukrainian lettering.

razkladna identičnost

The introduction connects the question with Clebsch and Study; these names identify the mathematical background, not linguistic endorsement of the translation. The concise adjective razkladna names what the formula does, whereas razložima would assert a different property. The archive leaves the formation provisional. The present text supports the semantic distinction, not a claim of general acceptance.

razkladne identičnosti

The definition specifies which row is decomposed and what remains independent; it is not a name for any expansion of an expression or an arbitrary collection of equalities. Iztočnik / Source: Zerlegungsidentitäten in expliziter Form

Avtorka dostaje takov izraz produktovoju teoremoju i zaměnoju ranějše definicije. Eksplicitny zato ne znači samo jasno napisany, ni numerično izračunany. Naslov mora zachovati tehničny smysl i svez s ranějšimi razkladnymi identičnostjami, vključno s uslovjami, pri ktoryh postajut razložimymi.

Reason: In explicit form means that the identity is expressed through the given forms and coefficients without retaining the individual symbolic rows as independent auxiliary objects. The author obtains such an expression through a product theorem and substitution of an earlier definition. Explicit therefore does not merely mean clearly written, nor does it mean numerically evaluated. The heading must retain the technical sense and the connection with the earlier decomposition identities, including the conditions under which they become decomposable.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Eksplicitna forma odstranjava zavisimost od pomočnih redov.

teorema razloženja

Iztočnik / Source: Zerlegungssatz

Rusky / Russian: теорема разложения

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теорема розкладу

Razlog: Teorema razloženja zde prinadleži teoriji klas polj. Dlja nerazvětvjenogo prostogo města ona izražaje stepenj ostatkov črez najmanjši eksponent, ktory daje lokalno trivijalnu klasu dlja vsakoj algebry iz nazvanoj podgrupy. Kvantifikator vsakoj i uslovje nerazvětvjenosti sut neizostavne. Nazva ne označaje ni opču teoremu o jedinstvenom razkladu na proste faktory, ni svojstvo jednoj izbranoj algebry. Arhivny izbor daje čitlivu obšču nazvu; matematično ograničenje daje konkretna teorema.

Reason: Here teorema razloženja belongs to class field theory. For an unramified prime place, it expresses the residue degree through the least exponent that gives a locally trivial class for every algebra in the specified subgroup. Every and unramified are indispensable. The name denotes neither a general unique-factorization theorem nor a property of one chosen algebra. The recorded choice supplies a readable general name; the particular theorem supplies its mathematical restriction.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Najmanjši eksponent odnosi se na vse algebry nazvanoj podgrupy.

Textual comparison: The least exponent concerns every algebra in the specified subgroup.

razložne teoremy

Iztočnik / Source: Zerlegungssätze

Rusky / Russian: теоремы о разложении

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теореми про розклад

Razlog: Razložne teoremy služi kako skupna nazva dlja nekoliko vidov idealnogo razloženja. Uvod oddělja produkt idealov od najmanjšego obščego kratnogo idealov i razlikuje tvrđenja o jedinstvenosti. Primarny ideal ne mora byti stepenju svojego pridruženogo prostogo ideala. Zato obšča nazva ne tvrdi, že vse teoremy sut faktorizacije s istim pravilom jedinstvenosti. Vyslovjene domněnky v podnožnoj primětke ostajut domněnkami, a ne dokazanou čestju značenja termina.

Reason: Razložne teoremy serves as a collective name for several kinds of ideal decomposition. The introduction distinguishes products of ideals from least common multiples and separates the different uniqueness assertions. A primary ideal need not be a power of its associated prime ideal. The umbrella term therefore does not assert that all these theorems are factorizations with the same uniqueness rule. Conjectures in the footnote remain conjectures, not proved content smuggled into the term.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Produkt, obšči kratny i jedinstvenost imajut razne uslovja.

Textual comparison: Product, common multiple and uniqueness have different conditions.

teoremy o razloženju norm i modulov

Iztočnik / Source: Zerlegungssätze für Normen und Moduln

Rusky / Russian: теоремы о разложении норм и модулей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: теореми про розклад норм і модулів

Razlog: Teoremy o razloženju norm i modulov govori o moduloch linearnyh form, ne o geometrickoj dlžině vektora. Norma jest opisana determinantom i produktom elementarnyh děliteljov. Dlja cělobrojnyh koeficientov dava čislo klas; dlja polinomov v jednoj proměnnoj odgovarajuči razměr dava stepenj normy. Razklad normy na vzajemno proste faktory r i s vodi k određenyh modulah toga že ranga. Ne smějemo prenesti vse te značenja v pozdějšu teoriju primarnogo razloženja bez konteksta.

Reason: Theorems on decomposition of norms and modules concerns modules of linear forms, not the geometric length of a vector. The norm is described by a determinant and a product of elementary divisors. For integer coefficients it counts residue classes; for univariate polynomials the relevant dimension is given by its degree. A factorization of the norm into coprime factors r and s leads to specified modules of the same rank. These meanings must not be silently replaced by the terminology of later primary decomposition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Norma zde ne jest geometricka dlžina.

Textual comparison: Here a norm is not geometric length.

Iztočnik / Source: Zermeloscher Bereich

Rusky / Russian: область Цермело

Reason: Zermelova oblast preserves Ernst Zermelo’s name and denotes a domain obtained by a particular construction. It is not another name for every integral domain. The text examines dependence on the chosen basis, integral closure and inclusion in further domains. The adjectival form provides a readable label without losing the historical attribution. The Russian and Ukrainian forms with initial Ц are recorded comparanda; by themselves they establish no mandatory Interslavic pronunciation or transliteration rule.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Imeno označaje konkretnu konstrukciju, ne vse oblasti.

For a primary ideal q, the prime ideal p is unique: its elements have some power in q, and the text relates the ideals through precise divisibility conditions. A counterexample also shows that the relevant relation to a prime ideal alone does not make an ideal primary. In decompositions, uniqueness of the associated primes does not mean uniqueness of every irreducible component. The recorded need to harmonize the Ukrainian wording remains open; it is not rewritten as completed expert review.

asociovany prosty ideal / naležati k \(p\)

pridruženy prosty ideal / pridruženo prosto čislo

Iztočnik / Source: zugehöriges Primideal / zugehörige Primzahl

Rusky / Russian: ассоциированный простой идеал / ассоциированное простое число

For a primary integer, the associated prime number is unique up to sign; a general primary ideal need not be a power of its associated prime. The later argument uses divisibility among prime ideals to characterize relative primeness and group the components. The archived Ukrainian wording remains marked for harmonization; that does not change the distinction between a number and an ideal.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Čislova analogija ne dokazuje, že vsaky primarny ideal jest stepenj.

Textual comparison: The numerical analogy does not prove that every primary ideal is a power.

pridruženy prosty ideal v nekomutativnom slučaju

Iztočnik / Source: zugehöriges Primideal im nicht-kommutativen Fall

Rusky / Russian: ассоциированный простой идеал в некоммутативном случае

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: належний простий ідеал у некомутативному випадку

Razlog: V nekomutativnom slučaju jest suštna ograda, ne novo bezuslovno razširjenje termina. Avtorka pokazuje, kde obči prenos dokaza ne uspěvaje: iz nilpotentnosti dvuh elementov ne slěduje potrěbna nilpotentnost njihove razlike, a potega produkta ne može byti prosto razdělena na potegi faktorov. To ne jest tvrđenje, že nikaka teorija pridruženih prostyh idealov v nekomutativnoj algebrě ne može obstajati. Slovjansky pridruženy ostaje izborom nazvy; ne opravdava tvrditi egzistenciju, ktoru dany argument ne dokazuje.

Reason: In the noncommutative case is an essential qualification, not an unconditional extension of the term. The author identifies where a formal transfer of the proof fails: nilpotence of two elements does not yield the required nilpotence of their difference, and a power of a product cannot simply be separated into powers of the factors. This does not assert that no theory of associated primes can exist in noncommutative algebra. The Slavic pridruženy remains a naming choice, not grounds for asserting existence that the argument does not prove.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Neuspěh danyh dokazov ne jest teorema o nemožnosti vsej teorije.

Textual comparison: Failure of these proofs is not an impossibility theorem for an entire theory.

pridruženy prosty ideal

Iztočnik / Source: zugehöriges Primideal [upotrěba v dokazu jedinstvenosti v §7 / use in the uniqueness proof in §7]

Rusky / Russian: ассоциированный простой идеал

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: належний простий ідеал

Razlog: Tuto jest ponovjena upotrěba pridruženy prosty ideal v dokazě jedinstvenosti izolovanyh komponentov. Anglijsky dodatok o sedmoj sekciji v arhivnom polju jest opis upotrěby, ne čest německogo termina. Teorema doloži, že izolovane idealy sut određene svojimi pridruženymi prostymi idealami; mnogoznačnost ostaje pri neizolovanyh komponentah. Zato razlog za doslědnu nazvu jest možnost slědovati tom odnose, ne nova jezyčna invencija ili tvrđenje o jedinstvenosti vseh komponentov.

Reason: This is a repeated use of pridruženy prosty ideal in the uniqueness argument for isolated components. The English addition about section seven in the archived field describes the use; it is not part of the German term. The theorem establishes that isolated ideals are determined by their associated primes, while ambiguity remains for nonisolated components. Consistent naming lets the reader follow that relationship. It is neither a new linguistic invention nor a claim that every component is unique.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jedinstvenost odnosi se na određenu klasu komponentov.

Textual comparison: Uniqueness concerns a specified class of components.

prirědžene idealy

Iztočnik / Source: zugeordnete Ideale

Rusky / Russian: поставленные в соответствие идеалы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: поставлені у відповідність ідеали

Razlog: Prirědžene idealy znači idealy, določene konkretnym prirědženjem iz modulov. V dokazě modulnomu oběktu odgovarjaje konečny sistem koeficientnyh idealov; strogy prehod medžu modulami dava prinajmenje jeden strogy prehod medžu tymi idealami. Ta svez prenosi uslovje cěpov. Zato anglijsku arhivnu glosu associated ideals ne trěba razuměti kak nazvu asociovanyh prostyh idealov. Prirědžene opisuje konstrukciju, bez pridavanja neustanovjenej prostoty.

Reason: Prirědžene idealy means ideals specified by a particular assignment from modules. In the proof, a module is assigned a finite system of coefficient ideals; a strict step between modules yields at least one strict step between those ideals. This transfers the chain condition. The archive’s English gloss associated ideals must therefore not be read as the technical associated-prime terminology. Prirědžene describes the construction without asserting primality that has not been established.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prirědžene idealy ne sut avtomatično proste.

Textual comparison: Assigned ideals are not automatically prime.

prirěđene matrice

Iztočnik / Source: zugeordnete Matrizen

Rusky / Russian: сопоставленные матрицы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: матриці, поставлені у відповідність

Razlog: Prirěđene matrice sut matrice dějstvija elementov prstena po izboru modulnoj bazy. Ta baza jest čest konstrukcije, ne izpuščena podrobnost: koeficienty razloženja davajut matrice, razlici odpovědaje razlika i produktu produkt. Nuljeva matrica odpovědaje točno elementam anuljujučim ideal. Zato slovo prirěđene izražaje određeno pravilo prirědženja, ne opču podobnost matric. Aktualny tekst piše prirědžene; originalny zapis s đ ostaje istorijnym pravopisnym variantom.

Reason: Prirěđene matrice are the matrices describing the action of ring elements after a module basis has been chosen. The basis is part of the construction, not an omitted detail: expansion coefficients give the matrices, and differences and products correspond. Precisely the elements annihilating the ideal give the zero matrix. The adjective therefore expresses a definite assignment, not a general resemblance between matrices. The current text writes prirědžene; the archived spelling with đ remains a historical orthographic variant.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prirědženje i njegov anuljator imajut izričnu definiciju.

Textual comparison: The assignment and its annihilator have an explicit definition.

prirędžene rędy

Iztočnik / Source: zugeordnete Reihen

Rusky / Russian: сопоставленные строки

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: зіставлені рядки

Razlog: Prirędžene rędy prodolžaje terminologiju korespondencije iz uvoda raboty. Zde red ne jest beskonečny čislovy red: elementi redov sut determinanty, a označene redy Q i P svazujut se vyraznymi formulami. Prehod od gornjih indeksov k dolnjim i obratno jest čest matematiki, ne tipografska sloboda. Aktualno priredžene redy i arhivno prirędžene rędy sut različne grafije toj nazvy; otvorena jezyčna ocěna ne jest dovršena samo tym, že relacija byla lokalizovana.

Reason: Prirędžene rędy continues the introduction’s correspondence terminology. Here a row is not an infinite numerical series: its entries are determinants, and the specified Q and P rows are related by explicit formulas. Moving from upper to lower indices and conversely belongs to the mathematics, not typographical discretion. Current priredžene redy and archived prirędžene rędy are different spellings of that name. Locating the relation does not by itself complete the outstanding linguistic assessment.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Gornje i dolnje indeksy imajut različne ulogi.

Textual comparison: Upper and lower indices have different roles.

dopustimy sistem

Iztočnik / Source: zul?ssiges System [Čestično nezachovane bukvy / Partly unrecoverable lettering]

Rusky / Russian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: [Bukvy ne sut zachovane / Lettering not recoverable]

Razlog: Dopustimy sistem v šestoj sekciji izpolnjaje točno uslovje: racionalno-cěla adjunkcija ne vvede algebraično-drobno čislo v oblast. Pridevnik znači ispolnjenje toga uslovja, ne obšču priměrnost sistema. U ranějšoj sekciji analogično město govori o algebraično-cěloj adjunkciji; tekst izrično objasnjaje zaměnu slova algebraično slovom racionalno. Ista nazva zato potrěbuje dve kontekstne glosy. Povrědžene srovniteljne zapisy ne služat svědectvom novoj ruskoj ili ukrajinskoj attestacije.

Reason: In section six, dopustimy sistem satisfies an exact condition: rationally integral adjunction must introduce no algebraically fractional number into the domain. The adjective means satisfaction of that condition, not general suitability. The corresponding passage in the earlier section concerns algebraically integral adjunction; the text expressly explains the substitution of rationally for algebraically. One name therefore needs two contextual glosses. The damaged comparative records supply no fresh Russian or Ukrainian attestation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Definicija ne dopušča algebraično-drobne čisla v oblasti.

Textual comparison: The definition excludes algebraically fractional numbers from the domain.

dopustima podgrupa

Iztočnik / Source: zulässige Untergruppe

Rusky / Russian: допустимая подгруппа

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: допустима підгрупа

Razlog: Dopustima podgrupa jest podgrupa zatvorjena pod vsimi operatorami fiksovanoj oblasti operatorov. To ne jest svedeno samo k normalnoj podgrupě: pri vnutrnyh avtomorfizmah dobyvajut se normalne podgrupy, pri vsih avtomorfizmah karakteristične. Izbor dopustim- prodolžaje zabilěženu familiju i imeje blizke ruske i ukrajinske formy. Definiciju, odnako, nosi ukazany operatorny sistem. Bez njega kratka nazva ne opreděljaje, ktore podgrupy sut dopustime.

Reason: A dopustima podgrupa is a subgroup closed under every operator in the fixed operator domain. It is not simply a synonym for normal subgroup: inner automorphisms give normal subgroups, while all automorphisms give characteristic subgroups. Choosing dopustim- continues the recorded family and closely parallels the Russian and Ukrainian forms. The specified operator system supplies the definition, however. Without it, the short name does not determine which subgroups are admissible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Normalnost i karakterističnost sut razne priměry.

Textual comparison: Normality and characteristicity are different examples.

dopustimy ideal

Iztočnik / Source: zulässiges Ideal

Rusky / Russian: допустимый идеал

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: допустимий ідеал

Razlog: Dopustimy ideal prodolžaje tu samu operatornu terminologiju v teoriji idealov. K obyčnoj levostrannoj, pravostrannoj ili dvustrannoj idealnoj strukture dodavaje se uslovje byti K-modulom; i homomorfizm mora soglasovati se s dějstvijem K. Ne ide o moralnu ili redakcijnu dopustimost. Iztočna primětka izrično govori, že v hiperkompleksnyh sistemah obična nazva ideal vključaje tu dopustimost po odnošenju k osnovnomu koeficientnomu polju. Ta konvencija ne smí byti bez objasnjenja prěnesena vo vse raboty.

Reason: Dopustimy ideal carries the same operator vocabulary into ideal theory. Besides being a left, right or two-sided ideal, the object must be a K-module, and the homomorphism must respect the K-action. This is not moral or editorial admissibility. The source expressly says that, in hypercomplex systems, the unqualified word ideal includes admissibility relative to the underlying coefficient field. That convention must not be transferred without explanation to every paper.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dodatna struktura ograničaje i idealy i homomorfizmy.

Textual comparison: The extra structure restricts both ideals and homomorphisms.

dopustimy sistem

Iztočnik / Source: zulässiges System

Rusky / Russian: допустимая система

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: допустима система

Razlog: Dopustimy sistem v četvrtoj sekciji označaje sistem, pri ktorom algebraično-cěla adjunkcija k Zermelovoj oblasti ne vvede algebraično-drobne čisla. Izpolnjenje uslovja dava določeny vid oblasti, a obratny argument ispytuje vse oblasti nazvanoj familije. Arhivny razlog naziva dopustimy prozračnym; to jest jezyčna ocěna, ne izměrena razumljivost. Pozdějša racionalna analogija jest svezana s istim slovom, no ne dovoljuje zaměniti dve operacije adjunkcije jedna drugoju.

Reason: In section four, dopustimy sistem denotes a system whose algebraically integral adjunction to the Zermelo domain introduces no algebraically fractional numbers. The condition gives the specified kind of domain, and the converse considers every domain in that family. The archived rationale calls dopustimy transparent; that is a linguistic judgment, not measured intelligibility. The later rational analogue uses the same word, but that does not make the two adjunction operations interchangeable.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Ta analogija ne identifikuje dve operacije adjunkcije.

Textual comparison: This analogy does not identify the two adjunction operations.

prirędženje

Iztočnik / Source: Zuordnung

Rusky / Russian: сопоставление

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: зіставлення

Razlog: Prirędženje jest imenovnik dlja prirědženja objekta drugomu objektu, odděleny v arhivě od širšej nazvy zobraženje. V danyh pasažah prirědženje racionalnyh funkcij jest vzajemno jednoznačno i zachovuje relacije v obojih směrah; ničto z toga ne slěduje iz samogo slova. Tekst piše priredženje, bez nosovogo znaka arhivnoj formy. Razlog jezyčnogo izbora jest zachovati korespondenciju kak dějstvije, a konkretnu bijektivnost nosit teorema.

Reason: Prirędženje is the noun for assigning one object to another, distinguished in the archive from the broader mapping term zobraženje. In the cited passages, the assignment of rational functions is bijective and preserves relations in both directions; none of that follows from the word alone. The current text writes priredženje without the archived nasal spelling. The lexical aim is to retain assignment as an operation; the theorem supplies the particular bijectivity.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Vzajemna jednoznačnost jest vyrazna hipoteza ili rezultat.

Textual comparison: Bijectivity is an explicit condition or result.

zvedenje procesa svijanja na osnovne svijanja

Iztočnik / Source: Zurückführung des Faltungsprozesses auf Grundfaltungen

Rusky / Russian: сведение процесса свертки к основным сверткам

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: зведення процесу згортання до основних згортань

Razlog: Zvedenje procesa svijanja na osnovne svijanja bylo istorijnym naslovnym rěšenjem. Aktualny naslov piše proces kontrakcije i osnovne kontrakcije. Obe frazy potrebuju isti směr: opči proces sastavjaje se iz određenih osnovnyh operacij, ne vračaje se k ranějšej istorijnoj fazě. Teorema govori o n−1 tipah i razlikuje osnovne kontrakcije od širšej klasy kogredientnyh kontrakcij. Slovnik zato pokazuje i zabilěženy variant svijanje, i stvarnu pozdějšu formu kontrakcija, bez predstavy, že vsaka kogredientna operacija jest osnovna.

Reason: Zvedenje procesa svijanja na osnovne svijanja was the historical title choice. The present heading uses proces kontrakcije and osnovne kontrakcije. Both need the same direction: the general process is composed of specified primitive operations, not returned to an earlier historical stage. The theorem gives n−1 types and distinguishes basic contractions from the larger class of cogredient contractions. The dictionary therefore shows both archived svijanje and later kontrakcija without suggesting that every cogredient operation is basic.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Osnovna kontrakcija jest užša kategorija od kogredientnoj.

Textual comparison: Basic contraction is narrower than cogredient contraction.

svedenje modula \((A,\nu)\) k modulu \((\nu)\)

Iztočnik / Source: Zurückführung des Moduls \((A,\nu)\) auf den Modul \((\nu)\)

Rusky / Russian: сведение модуля \((A,\nu)\) к модулю \((\nu)\)

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: зведення модуля \((A,\nu)\) до модуля \((\nu)\)

Razlog: Svedenje modula (A,ν) k modulu (ν) zachovuje iztočny i ciljevy modul; dvě oznaky ne mogut byti spojene v neodređeno svedenje. Znak A v kratkom arhivnom zapisu v aktualnom naslově ima osobnu frakturnu formu, a ν ostaje grčskim simbolom. Nazva prodolžaje prethodnu sekciju, kde svedenje govori o kontrakcijah v konstrukciji sistema form. Ne znači zameniti vse raboty s modulom jedinoju formulačnou zaměnoju, a elipsa iz kračej susědnoj stavky ne odstraňuje konkretne argumenty.

Reason: Svedenje modula (A,ν) k modulu (ν) retains both the source and target module; the two labels cannot be collapsed into an unspecified reduction. The abbreviated archive’s A has a distinct fraktur form in the actual heading, while ν remains a Greek symbol. The title continues the preceding section, where reduction concerns contractions in the construction of a system of forms. It does not mean replacing every operation on a module with one symbolic substitution, and the neighbouring abbreviated entry does not remove these concrete arguments.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Oba argumenty ostajut vidime.

Textual comparison: Both arguments remain visible.

svedenje modula ... k ...

Iztočnik / Source: Zurückführung des Moduls ... auf ...

Rusky / Russian: сведение модуля ... к ...

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: зведення модуля ... до ...

Razlog: Svedenje modula ... k ... bilo izbrano, da by internacionalny termin redukcija ne zaměnjal vsaku konstrukciju německogo Zurückführung. Iztočny naslov i tekst ukazujut točny cilj: svesti kontrakcije s jednim modulom k kontrakcijam s vyššim modulom. Slovjansky imenovnik daje čitlivy opis prehoda, no sam ne opreděljaje algebraičnu proceduru. Arhivna ocěna domačnosti i prozračnosti ne jest statističnym rezultatěm; slovnik ne dodava nedokumentovane težiny pri sravnenju s redukcijeju.

Reason: Svedenje modula ... k ... was chosen so that the international term redukcija would not replace every construction expressed by German Zurückführung. The actual heading and text give the target: reduce contractions involving one module to contractions involving a higher module. The Slavic noun makes that transition readable but does not itself define the algebraic procedure. The archived assessment of familiarity and transparency is not a statistical result; no undocumented weights are added to the comparison with redukcija.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Slovo svedenje ne zaměnjaje definiciju konstrukcije.

Textual comparison: The word reduction does not replace the construction’s definition.

prinaležne sistemi veličin / sistem nul

Iztočnik / Source: zusammengehörige Wertsysteme / Nullstellensystem

Rusky / Russian: связанные системы значений / система нулей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: пов’язані системи значень / система нулів

Razlog: Prinaležne sistemi veličin znači svazane n-tice značenij, ktore vměstě izpolnjajut polinomne uravnenja; veličiny zde ne sut fizične razměry. Pri sukcesivnoj eliminaciji jednotlivy korenj dopolnjaje se do celogo sistema, a odgovarajuči linearne faktory čuvajut tu svez. Sistem nul ne jest prosto nesvezany spis vsih korenjev po každoj proměnnoj oddělno. Arhiv označuje prinaležny kak jezyčno sporny; matematična lokalizacija objasnjaje predmet izbora, ale ne izmyslja nedostavajuču ekspertnu ocěnu.

Reason: Prinaležne sistemi veličin denotes linked tuples of values satisfying the polynomial equations together; veličiny does not mean physical dimensions here. In successive elimination, an individual root is completed to a whole system, and the corresponding linear factors retain that connection. A system of zeros is not simply an unrelated list of roots for each variable separately. The archive marks prinaležny for linguistic scrutiny. Locating the mathematics explains the object of the choice without inventing the missing expert assessment.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Koordinaty dolžny vměstě izpolnjati uravnenja.

Textual comparison: The coordinates must satisfy the equations together.

prinaležny sistem nuljev

Iztočnik / Source: zusammengehöriges Nullstellensystem

Rusky / Russian: соответствующая система нулей

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: відповідна система нулів

Razlog: Prinaležny sistem nuljev naměrno ostaje obščim odnosnym izrazom, ne tehničnym asociovanym prostym idealom. V razloženju formy elementarnyh děliteljov odin indeks ν svazuje koordinaty jednogo sistema nuljev; različne indeksy odgovarjajut različnym linearnym faktoram. Slovnik mora zachovati tu společnost koordinat i ograditi ju od formalnoj terminologije asociovanyh idealov. Dodatne uslovja o doskonalom ili nedoskonalom polju upravljajut eksponentami faktorov, ne grammatikoju pridevnika.

Reason: Prinaležny sistem nuljev deliberately remains a general relational expression, not the technical associated-prime term. In the factorization of the elementary-divisor form, one index ν links the coordinates of a single zero system; different indices correspond to different linear factors. The dictionary must retain that coordination and distinguish it from formal associated-ideal terminology. Further conditions concerning perfect or imperfect fields govern factor exponents, not the grammar of the adjective.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odin indeks svazuje koordinaty istogo sistema.

Textual comparison: One index links coordinates of the same system.

sostavne identičnosti

Iztočnik / Source: zusammengesetzte Identitäten

Rusky / Russian: составные тождества

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: складені тотожності

Razlog: Sostavne identičnosti označajut identičnosti dobyty određenoju specializacijeju i potom priměnjenjem už znanej identičnosti. Sostavne zato ne znači prosto složne ili težke dlja razuměnja. Avtorka dodava važnu konvenciju: identičnosti s k redami simbolov ostajut razgledane kak nerazložime, i kogda nastali podobnym postupkom iz menjšego čisla redov. Reason: Sostavne identičnosti denotes identities obtained by a specified specialization followed by application of an existing identity. Composite therefore does not merely mean complicated or difficult to understand. The author adds an important convention: identities with k symbolic rows are still treated as indecomposable even when obtained by a similar procedure from fewer rows. The dictionary must show this definitional restriction rather than turn composite into a generic description of every derived formula.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Sostavny ne znači prosto težky.

Textual comparison: Composite does not merely mean difficult.

složene polary

Iztočnik / Source: zusammengesetzte Polaren

Rusky / Russian: составные поляры

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: складені поляри

Razlog: Složene polary spajaje slovjansky pridevnik s tehničnym internacionalnym imenovnikom. Zapis izrično izběgaje težšu tvorbu tipa kompozicijne polary; vybrana kratkost ne skriva, že idut o kombinovane polarne operacije. V tekstě koeficienty razvitja sut polary po dvuh različnyh redah proměnnyh; daljši dokaz uživa rekursivny sistem. Složenost oběkta i računna težkost sut zato različne stvari, iako slovo složeny može v obyčnoj prozě vyvolati obě asociacije.

Reason: Složene polary combines a Slavic adjective with an international technical noun. The record expressly avoids a heavier formation such as compositional polars; the shorter wording still denotes combined polar operations. In the text, expansion coefficients are polars with respect to two different variable rows, and the subsequent argument uses a recursive system. Composition of the object and computational difficulty are therefore distinct, although an ordinary-language adjective may evoke both.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kompozicija operacij ne jest ocěna težkosti.

Textual comparison: Composition of operations is not a difficulty rating.

vez medžu idealami iz polinomov i modulami iz linearnyh form

Iztočnik / Source: Zusammenhang zwischen Idealen aus Polynomen und Moduln aus Linearformen

Rusky / Russian: связь между идеалами из полиномов и модулями из линейных форм

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: зв’язок між ідеалами з поліномів і модулями з лінійних форм

Razlog: Vez medžu idealami iz polinomov i modulami iz linearnyh form razkladaje dolg německy naslov v vyraznu frazu. Opakovanje iz ukazuje, iz čego sut dva vida oběktov, vměsto zgustiti vse v red pridevnikov. Most jest konkretny: polinom razglědaje se kak linearna forma v stepenovyh produktah s koeficientami v ostalyh proměnnyh. Vsaka taka forma imaje konečno mnogo členov, iako cěly sistem dopušča beskonečno mnogo monomov. Dva arhivna zapisa sut svezane kopije togo izbora, ne dva nezavisne jezyčne svědectva.

Reason: Vez medžu idealami iz polinomov i modulami iz linearnyh form unfolds the long German heading into an explicit phrase. Repeating iz identifies what the two kinds of objects consist of, instead of compressing everything into an adjective chain. The bridge is concrete: a polynomial is regarded as a linear form in power products, with coefficients in the remaining variables. Each form has finitely many terms although the whole system admits infinitely many monomials. The two archived records are related copies of this choice, not two independent linguistic attestations.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Konečnost pojedinoj formy ne znači konečnost vseh monomov.

Textual comparison: Finiteness of each form does not mean finiteness of all monomials.

sostavimost iz osnovnyh svijanj

Iztočnik / Source: Zusammensetzbarkeit aus Grundfaltungen

Rusky / Russian: составимость из основных сверток

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: складність з основних згортань

Razlog: Sostavimost iz osnovnyh svijanj znači možnost sestaviti operaciju iz imenovanyh osnovnyh operacij. Ne označaje jeji težkost. Arhiv izrično upozornjaje, že ukrajinsko складність v togo zapisu bylo naměreno v prvom smyslu, i ostavlja vhodnost toj formy otvorenoju. Aktualna rabota piše osnovne kontrakcije i dokazuje dostatočnost n−1 tipov. Sravnenje mora zato čuvati i risk dvosmyslnosti, i novu kontekstnu formu, bez tvrđenja, že otvoreno jezyčno pytanje už bylo rěšeno.

Reason: Sostavimost iz osnovnyh svijanj means that an operation can be composed from the specified basic operations. It does not denote difficulty. The archive explicitly warns that Ukrainian складність was intended in the former sense and leaves its suitability open. The current paper uses osnovne kontrakcije and proves the sufficiency of n−1 types. The comparison must therefore retain both the ambiguity risk and the current contextual wording without claiming that the linguistic question has been settled.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Ukrajinska dvosmyslnost ostaje izrično označena.

Textual comparison: The recorded Ukrainian ambiguity remains explicit.

skladanje

Iztočnik / Source: Zusammensetzung

Rusky / Russian: композиция

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: композиція

Razlog: Skladanje bylo izbrano vměsto internacionalnogo kompozicija, ktoro jest zapisano v ruskom i ukrajinskom sravnenju. Motivacija jest slovjanska tvorba soglasna s ranějšim svijanje; aktualny tekst govori o poredku skladanja kontrakcij. V teoremě nezavisnost od poreda jest vyrazno tvrđenje o danyh osnovnyh operacijah, ne svojstvo vsakoj matematičnoj kompozicije. Arhivna prednost domačej tvorbě ne dokazuje, že internacionalna alternativa ne može byti razumljiva ili ispravna.

Reason: Skladanje was chosen instead of the international kompozicija recorded in the Russian and Ukrainian comparison. The motivation is a Slavic formation consistent with earlier svijanje; the current text speaks of the order of composing contractions. Independence of order is an explicit theorem about the specified primitive operations, not a property of every mathematical composition. The archived preference for the Slavic formation does not show that the international alternative would be unintelligible or incorrect.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nezavisnost poreda jest konkrětno tvrđenje.

Textual comparison: Independence of order is a particular assertion.

dodatne členy \(n_i\xi_i\) / dodatne cěločiselne kratne

Iztočnik / Source: Zusatzglieder \(n_i\xi_i\) / zusätzliche ganze Vielfache

Rusky / Russian: дополнительные члены \(n_i\xi_i\) / дополнительные целые кратные

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: додаткові члени \(n_i\xi_i\) / додаткові цілі кратні

Razlog: Dodatne členy n_i xi_i označajut dodatne cěločiselne kratne bazovyh elementov, ne nove neograničene koeficienty iz prstena. Oni pojavjajut se pri odstranjenju hipotezy, že prsten imaje jedinicu. Postupok sleduje dva vida idealov: idealy prstena i idealy cělyh čisel; zato čislo prirědženih idealov stava 2k. Dodatny uslovje nenuljevosti pri teoremě o cěpah takože ostaje. Kratka fraza čuva tu korekciju uslovij, a ne samo ukazuje nekake dopisane členy.

Reason: Dodatne členy n_i xi_i means additional integer multiples of the basis elements, not unrestricted new ring coefficients. They occur when the assumption that the ring has an identity is removed. The construction tracks two kinds of ideals—ring ideals and integer ideals—so there are 2k assigned ideals. The further nonzero condition in the chain statement also remains. The short phrase preserves this adjustment of hypotheses rather than merely pointing to some added terms.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dva vida koeficientnyh idealov ne sut odvečne.

Textual comparison: The two kinds of coefficient ideals are not redundant.

dvojnorazova polarizacija

Iztočnik / Source: zweimalige Polarisation

Rusky / Russian: двукратная поляризация

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: дворазова поляризація

Razlog: Dvojnorazova polarizacija kaže, že operacija izvršava se dvakrat. Arhiv sam postavlja kraču alternativu dvojna polarizacija dlja sravnenja, no ne zabilěža dokonanu odluku v njej korist. V tekučem tekstě dlga forma ostaje pri izvedenju razklada iz određene relacije. Važno jest ne poměšati dvakratno priměnjenje s množenjem rezultata čislom dva, ni s dvoma raznymi izbornymi postupkami. Točna modalnost početnogo predloga ostaje provisionalna.

Reason: Dvojnorazova polarizacija says that the operation is performed twice. The archive itself proposes the shorter dvojna polarizacija for comparison but records no completed decision in its favour. The current text retains the longer form when deriving a decomposition from a specified relation. Two applications must not be confused with multiplying the result by two, or with two alternative procedures. The original proposal remains provisional.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Opakovanje operacije ne jest množenje rezultata čislom dva.

Textual comparison: Repeating an operation is not multiplying its result by two.

dvustranno prosty

Iztočnik / Source: zweiseitig einfach

Rusky / Russian: двусторонне простой

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: двобічно простий; двосторонньо простий

Razlog: Dvustranno prosty zachovuje uslovje prostoty po odnošenju k dvustrannym idealam. V teoremě iz pravostrannoj polnoj reducibilnosti i jedinice slěduje razklad na dvustranno proste komponenty; v pozdějšej sekciji takova komponenta služí osnovoju teorije modulov. Jedinica dělaje kak jediničny operator na razgledanom modulu, čto jest osobna hipoteza. Kratky pridevnik ne směje skryti, že odnostranna prostota, polna reducibilnost i dvustranna prostota sut razne tvrdženja.

Reason: Dvustranno prosty retains simplicity with respect to two-sided ideals. One theorem derives decomposition into two-sided simple components from right complete reducibility and an identity; a later section uses such a component as the basis for module theory. The identity acts as the identity operator on the module under consideration, a separate hypothesis. The short adjective must not hide the distinctions between one-sided simplicity, complete reducibility and two-sided simplicity.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jedinica i jeji dějstvije ostajut uslovjami.

Textual comparison: The identity and its action remain conditions.

dvustranno proste kolca

Iztočnik / Source: zweiseitig einfache Ringe

Rusky / Russian: двусторонне простые кольца

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: двобічно прості кільця

Razlog: Dvustranno proste kolca jest pluralna fraza za prsteny bez netrivialnyh dvustrannyh idealov, ne drugo ime nekomutativnyh těl. Uvod razděljaje njimi upravljane opče razpadne polja od polj najnižšego stepena, opisanih s pomočju pridruženih těl. Zato vsako skračenje do proste algebry potrěbuje zachovati tot odnos. Aktualny tekst ima prsteny, togda kak arhivni izbor kolca dokumentuje ranějšu terminologiju; slovnik ne pripisuje tekstu formu, ktora v citovanom městu nestojí.

Reason: Dvustranno proste kolca is a plural phrase for rings with no nontrivial two-sided ideals, not another name for noncommutative division rings. The introduction distinguishes general splitting fields, described through these rings, from least-degree fields described through the associated division rings. Any shorter gloss such as simple algebra must preserve that relationship. The current text uses prsteny; archived kolca documents the earlier terminology rather than a form falsely attributed to the quoted passage.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Opče razpadne polja ne sut isto čto polja najnižšego stepena.

Textual comparison: General splitting fields are not the same as fields of least degree.

dvustranno prosto kolco

Iztočnik / Source: zweiseitig einfacher Ring

Rusky / Russian: двусторонне простое кольцо

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: двобічно просте кільце

Razlog: Dvustranno prosto kolco jest jedinstvena forma istoj strukturnoj nazvy. Izbor kolco byl zabilěžen radi soglasnosti s grupno kolco i sravnenja slovjanskyh form, no nyněšnji tekst upotrěbjaje prsten. Avtorkina konstrukcija razlikuje matričny prsten od pridruženogo těla: matrice nad danym tělom mogut tvoriti dvustranno prosty prsten, ale ne sut vsegda samo tělo. Tu matematičnu razliku čuvamo nezavisno od jezyčnogo izbora kolco ili prsten.

Reason: Dvustranno prosto kolco is the singular form of the same structural term. Kolco was recorded for consistency with grupno kolco and comparison of Slavic forms, but the present text uses prsten. The author’s construction distinguishes the matrix ring from its associated division ring: matrices over a division ring may form a two-sided simple ring without themselves forming a division ring. That mathematical distinction must survive either lexical choice, kolco or prsten.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Matrice nad tělom ne morajut samy tvoriti tělo.

Textual comparison: Matrices over a division ring need not themselves form a division ring.

dvustranno nerazložime kolca

Iztočnik / Source: zweiseitig unzerlegbare Ringe

Rusky / Russian: двусторонне неразложимые кольца

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: двобічно нерозкладні кільця; двосторонньо нерозкладні кільця

Razlog: Dvustranno nerazložime kolca govori o nemožnosti netrivialnogo direktnogo razklada na dvustranne idealne komponenty. To ne jest sinonim prostyh prstenov i ne opisuje ireducibilnost predstavjenja. Tekst najprvo prenosi teoriju idealov na direktne komponenty, a potom podobno razkladaje modul pomoču idempotentnyh jedinic komponentov. Familija razložiti/nerazložimy zachovuje tu strukturnu operaciju. Arhivne dve ukrajinske formy sut različne jezyčne realizacije, ne dve definicije nerazložimosti.

Reason: Dvustranno nerazložime kolca concerns the impossibility of a nontrivial direct decomposition into two-sided ideal components. It is not synonymous with simple rings and does not describe irreducibility of a representation. The text first transfers ideal theory to the direct components and later decomposes modules by using the components’ idempotent identities. The razložiti/nerazložimy family retains that structural operation. The two recorded Ukrainian forms are linguistic variants, not two definitions of indecomposability.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nerazložimy i prosty ne sut obšče ravnoznačne.

Textual comparison: Indecomposable and simple are not generally synonymous.

dvustranne idealy

Iztočnik / Source: zweiseitige Ideale

Rusky / Russian: двусторонние идеалы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: двосторонні ідеали

Razlog: Dvustranne idealy jest slovjansky složeny pridevnik, paralelny zapisanym ruskim i ukrajinskim formam. Obe strany sut suštne: pri nekomutativnom prstenu ideal mora byti zatvorjen pod levym i pravym množenjem, da bi kvocient iměl potrěbnu prstenovu strukturu. V drugom městu dvustranne komponenty razkladajut modul s jediničnym operatorom. Nazva čuva toj uslovje, ne tvrdi komutativnost prstena; dvustrannost i komutativnost ne sut ravne stvari.

Reason: Dvustranne idealy is a Slavic compound adjective parallel to the recorded Russian and Ukrainian forms. Both sides matter: for a noncommutative ring, closure under left and right multiplication is needed for the relevant quotient-ring structure. Elsewhere, two-sided components decompose a module on which the identity acts as the identity operator. The name preserves that condition without asserting that the ring is commutative. Two-sidedness and commutativity are not equivalent.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dvustrannost ne znači komutativnost.

Textual comparison: Two-sidedness does not mean commutativity.

dvustranne klasy

Iztočnik / Source: zweiseitige Klassen

Rusky / Russian: двусторонние классы

Ukrajinsky / Ukrainian: двобічні класи

Razlog: Dvustranne klasy označajut klasy cěločislenyh matric pri levyh i pravyh unimodularnyh preobrazovanjah. Iako fraza jest analogična dvustrannym idealam, tekst naměrno prehodi od idealov k klasam, da dopušča opče elementarne dělitelje. Idealny slučaj imaje silnějše ograničenja.
