Dropping proper or different from the unit ideal would change the assertion. The older language of ideal divisibility must be explained in its own order relation, not automatically read as ordinary numerical divisibility.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V diskriminantnom poslědku raboty 31 vsaky i samo takovy sohranja dva směry pod uslovjem doskonalosti polja ostatkov. Drugy odlomok ograničuje uslovje bez vlastnogo dělitelja na pridružene proste idealy. V oběh slučajah kratka gramatična fraza nosi čest matematičnyh hipotez; izpuščena čest ne jest samo stilistična razlika.

Textual comparison: In Paper 31’s discriminant consequence, every and only such preserves both directions under the perfect-residue-field hypothesis. The other passage restricts the no-proper-divisor condition to associated prime ideals. In both cases a short grammatical phrase carries mathematical qualifications; omission would not be merely stylistic.

Kogda najmenše obče mnogokratno jest produkt

When the least common multiple equals the product

Razlog: Najmenše obče mnogokratno stavaje jednako produktu jest rečenica o rezultatu, ne definicija sinonimov. V rabotě 19, §8, ravnost dokazuje se za poparno vzajemno proste idealy, i Teorema XV koristi toj prěhod. Zato mnogokratno i produkt ostajut oddělne pojmy, a uslovje ne směje odpasti. Sravnjeni tekst imaje stavaje ravno produktu vměsto arhivnogo jednako. Taka proměna predikata ne měnja glavnu metodologičnu potrěbu: zachovati oba člena ravnosti i uslovje, pri ktorom ona imaje město.

Reason: Najmenše obče mnogokratno stavaje jednako produktu states a result, not a definition of synonyms. Paper 19, §8 proves the equality for pairwise coprime ideals, and Theorem XV uses that transition. Least common multiple and product therefore remain distinct notions, and the hypothesis must not disappear. The compared text has stavaje ravno produktu rather than archival jednako. This predicate variation leaves the central requirement unchanged: preserve both sides of the equality and the condition under which it holds.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 19 prehod k produktu argumentuje se pri poparnoj vzajemnoj prostosti. Pokazana jest ravnost najprvo za ideal i jego komplement, a potom postupok prodolžaje se. Izostavjenje uslovja proširilo by tvrdženje bez opravdanja.

Textual comparison: Paper 19 argues for the product under pairwise coprimality. It first establishes the equality for an ideal and its complement, then continues the procedure. Removing the hypothesis would broaden the assertion without justification.

Minus v definiciji slěda

The minus sign in the trace definition

Razlog: Koeficient pri \((-t^{s-1})\) prodolžuje obyčnu konstrukciju koeficient pri v rabotě 31, §4. Minus jest čestju definicije slěda, ne tipografično ukrašenje: tekst naziva slědom koeficient pri negativnoj potegi v \(|tE-C|\) i odmah dava sumu diagonalnyh elementov. Ispuščenje minusa obratilo by znak v toj konvenciji. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenje izrično sohranjajut toj znak; medžuslovjansky razlog dodaje doslědnost s okolnoju rečeniceju o koeficientah.

Reason: Koeficient pri \((-t^{s-1})\) continues the ordinary coefficient-at construction in Paper 31, §4. The minus sign belongs to the trace convention, not to decoration: the text names the coefficient of the negative monomial in \(|tE-C|\) as the trace and immediately gives the sum of diagonal entries. Omitting the minus would reverse the sign under that convention. Both Russian and Ukrainian rationales expressly preserve it; the Interslavic rationale adds consistency with the surrounding coefficient sentence.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: V rabotě 31 koeficienty \(|tE-C|\) sut invarianty klasa. Slěd jest koeficient pri \((-t^{s-1})\) i ravny sumě diagonalnyh elementov. Taka definicija svazuje leksičny izbor s přesnym znakom i s konkretnym smyslom klasa.

Textual comparison: In Paper 31 the coefficients of \(|tE-C|\) are class invariants. The trace is the coefficient of \((-t^{s-1})\) and equals the sum of diagonal entries. The definition links the lexical choice to an exact sign and a particular meaning of class.

Komponenty kak prsteny, ne kak idealy

Components as rings, not as ideals

Razlog: Komponenty kako kolca same po sebě, a ne kako idealy jest objasnjajuča primětka k diskriminantam v rabotě 31. Sravnjeni tekst imaje prsteny vměsto arhivnogo kolca i izrično razlikuje komponente kak samostojne prsteny od idealov većšego \(\overline{\mathfrak R}\). To určuje, katere diskriminanty umnožajut se. Razlog kaže, že primětka byla najdena v pečatnom iztočniku; tuto ostaje tvrdženje sohranjenogo zapisa, ne nova nezavisna prověrka skana. Prosta objasnjajuča rečenica čuva razliku, ktoru sama notacija ne izrekla by.

Reason: Components as rings in their own right, not as ideals is an explanatory qualification about discriminants in Paper 31. The compared text uses prsteny instead of archival kolca and distinguishes the components as independent rings from ideals of the larger \(\overline{\mathfrak R}\). This determines which discriminants are multiplied. The rationale says the parenthesis was recovered from the printed source; that remains the record’s historical claim, not a fresh independent scan check. Plain explanatory prose preserves a distinction that notation alone would not express.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odlomok raboty 31 izrično razgledaje komponente kak prsteny same po sebě, ne kak idealy většego prstena. Ta razlika upravjaje interpretacijeju diskriminantnogo produkta. Arhivno pripisanje k pečatnomu iztočniku ne jest s tym samym nezavisno prověreno.

Textual comparison: The Paper 31 passage explicitly considers the components as rings in their own right, not as ideals of the larger ring. That distinction governs interpretation of the discriminant product. The archival attribution to the printed witness is not independently verified by this comparison.

Grupovanje komponentov

Grouping components

Razlog: Shvatiti komponenty v grupy jest naměrny opis s sobirateljnym smyslom v rabotě 19. Sam razlog označaje glagol kak predloženy izbor v stvorjenom odbornom registru, otvorjen jezykovoj ocěně. Lema IV v nyněšnjem tekstě govori, že komponenty grupujut se, a za vsaku grupu tvori se najmenše obče mnogokratno. Zato ne ide o slučajno sobiranje ili umnoženje bez uslovij. Predmetom ocěny jest vhodnost shvatiti za taj postupok; razumlivost ne jest potvrđena čitateljskim izpytanjem.

Reason: Shvatiti komponenty v grupy is an intentional collecting expression in Paper 19. The rationale itself marks the verb as a constructed-register proposal open to linguistic appraisal. Lemma IV in the present text says that the components are grouped and the least common multiple is formed for each group. This is not arbitrary collection or multiplication without conditions. The issue for appraisal is whether shvatiti suitably expresses that operation; no reader experiment establishes its intelligibility.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Lema IV govori o grupovanju komponentov redukovanogo prědstavjenja i tvorjenju najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo. Nyněšnje grupujut se čuva postupok, dokolě arhivno shvatiti ostaje predmetom jezykovej ocěny.

Textual comparison: Lemma IV concerns grouping components of a reduced representation and forming the least common multiple. The present grupujut se preserves the operation; archival shvatiti remains open to linguistic appraisal.

Sohranjenje citovanogo německogo termina

Preserving a quoted German term

Razlog: Kongruenzkomposition ostaje německym slovom, zato že jest citovany historijny termin u Brandta, ne novy medžuslovjansky predlog. Podnožna primětka raboty 19 svazuje jeho s najmenšim občim mnogokratnym klasov. Sohranjenje originalnoj formy pomaga najdti imenovanu rabotu i razlikovati avtorov termin od objašnjenja prevoditelja. Okolna proza može byti polno medžuslovjanska; to ne trěbuje prevoda samogo identifikacijnogo citata.

Reason: Kongruenzkomposition remains German because it is Brandt’s cited historical term, not a new Interslavic proposal. The Paper 19 footnote connects it with the least common multiple of classes. Keeping the original form lets readers locate the cited work and distinguish its terminology from the translator’s explanation. Fully localized surrounding prose does not require translating the identifying quotation itself.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Primětka raboty 19 identificira Kongruenzkomposition pri Brandtu kak najmenše obče mnogokratno klasov. Německa forma služi točnomu odkazu, ne predstavjaje neprevedenu obyčnu prozu.

Textual comparison: The Paper 19 footnote identifies Brandt’s Kongruenzkomposition with the least common multiple of classes. The German form serves precise reference; it is not untranslated ordinary prose.

Konstrukcija i ranějši dokaz obstajanja

Construction and a prior existence proof

Razlog: Konstrukcija po zadannom dobrom uporjadkovanju jest izbor dokaznogo izloženja, ne samo nazvanje novogo objekta. Početok §7 raboty 9 izrično razlikuje ranějši dokaz obstajanja racionalnoj bazy s dodatnym uslovjem od metody jej konstrukcije pri zadannom poredku. Zato kratka zaměna slovami baza obstaje izbrisala by pytanje, na ktore paragraf odgovarja. Dobry poredok trěba razuměti v množinovo-teoretičnom smyslu, ne kak ocěnu udobnosti. Konstrukcija tu ne znači sama po sobě konečny računalny algoritm.

Reason: Konstrukcija po zadannom dobrom uporjadkovanju is a choice in proof exposition, not merely the name of a new object. Paper 9, §7 explicitly distinguishes the earlier existence proof for a rational basis with an additional condition from its construction under a specified well-ordering. Replacing the phrase with a basis exists would erase the question being answered. Well-ordering has its set-theoretic meaning, not an evaluative sense of good order; construction does not itself promise a finite computational algorithm.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §7 raboty 9 razlikuje dokaz obstajanja od konstrukcije pri zadannom dobrom uporjadkovanju. §3 raboty 10 izrično prirědžaje bazove elementy s pomočju drugogo dobrogo uporjadkovanja. Reč konstrukcija ne obeščava konečny algoritm.

Textual comparison: Paper 9, §7 distinguishes existence from construction under a specified well-order. Paper 10, §3 explicitly assigns basis elements using another well-order. The word construction does not promise a finite algorithm.

Kratke komunikacije kako bibliografična kategorija

Short communications as a bibliographical category

Razlog: Kratke komunikacije jest bibliografična kategorija, ne novy matematičny pojem. V spisku ona stoji pored recenzij, a pod njoju sut kratke objavy o invariantah i drugih temah. Arhivny razlog koristi obyčny naziv za kratku naučnu komunikaciju, vměsto preobrazovanja naslova kategorije v strogy termin. Točnost tu znači čuvati rod publikacije i odnošenje k recenzijam; ne znači pripisati vsakomu zapisu polny raziskovateljsky članok.

Reason: Kratke komunikacije is a bibliographical category, not a new mathematical concept. It appears alongside reviews and covers short notices about invariants and other subjects. The recorded reason favors an ordinary description of a short scholarly communication rather than treating the heading as a formal mathematical term. Accuracy here means retaining the publication type and its distinction from reviews, not representing each item as a full research article.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Spisok razlikuje kratke komunikacije od recenzij. Naslov trěba čitati kako žanr objavy, ne kak novy tehničny termin.

Textual comparison: The list distinguishes short communications from reviews. The heading identifies a publication type rather than a new technical term.

Lěvy gorny kut v shemě

The upper-left corner in a diagram

Razlog: Lěvy gorny kut dava čitatelju směr v pravougolnoj shemě, ne definiciju novogo algebraičnogo objekta. V rabotě 2 prěhod na pravo označa kontrakciju I, a prěhod v niz kontrakciju II; forma v lěvom gornom kutu začina novy red form. Arhivny razlog jest kratky: prěmy jezyk diagramy. Sravnjenje s ruskim ugol i ukrajinskim kut pokazuje različne domače nazvy togo města. Pri novom razměščenju shemy trěba čuvati směrje i početkovu formu; sam naziv ne može napraviti obratenu diagramu pravilnoju.

Reason: Lěvy gorny kut directs the reader within a rectangular arrangement; it does not define a new algebraic object. In Paper 2, moving right denotes contraction I and moving down denotes contraction II; the form in the upper-left corner starts a new series of forms. The recorded reason is simply direct diagram language. Russian ugol and Ukrainian kut supply different native names for that position. A redesigned arrangement must preserve the directions and starting form: correct wording cannot make a reversed diagram correct.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 2 svezuje prěhod na pravo s kontrakcijeju I, a prěhod v niz s kontrakcijeju II. Kut označa početkovu formu podshemy; to jest navod dlja čitanja, ne nova terminologična definicija.

Textual comparison: Paper 2 assigns contraction I to movement right and contraction II to movement down. The corner identifies the starting form of a subarrangement; this is a reading instruction, not a new terminological definition.

Obseg izključenja

Scope of an exception

Razlog: S izključenjem jest konstrukcija za ograničenje tvrdnje, ne novy matematičny objekt. Arhivny razlog govori o očekyvanoj prozračnosti i odělno priznaje neprověrenu idiomatičnost medžuslovjanske frazy; ne dava imenovanoj konkurenčnoj konstrukcije. V §23 raboty 2 izraz izključaje točno jednu zapisanu formu iz danogo načina redukcije i srazu opisuje, iz kakogo člena ona nastavaje kontrakcijeju. Zato nužno jest čuvati obseg izključenja i sledovajuče objasnjenje. Ne směje se iz toga učiniti izključenje iz vsakej redukcije ili iz cělogo spiska nezvodimyh form.

Reason: S izključenjem restricts a statement rather than naming a new mathematical object. The archived reason invokes anticipated transparency and separately acknowledges that the idiomaticity of the Interslavic phrase is unverified; it identifies no competing construction. In §23 of Paper 2, the phrase excepts one displayed form from the stated route of reduction and immediately says which term produces it by contraction. The scope of the exception and that following explanation must both be preserved. It must not become an exception to every reduction or to the entire list of irreducible forms.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Vyraženje s izključenjem ograničaje konkretny opis redukcije. Izključena forma ostaje zapisana v cělosti, vměstě s členom, iz ktorogo nastavaje kontrakcijeju.

Textual comparison: The exception phrase restricts a particular account of reduction. The excepted form remains specified in full, together with the term from which contraction produces it.

Avtorstvo dodatka

Authorship of a supplement

Razlog: Zapis o dodatku k Kapfererovoj rabotě pripisyvaje sovměstnu rabotu s E. Noether dodatku, ne avtomatično cělomu članku. To jest sučstvenny razlog arhivnogo izbora: čuvati granicu avtorstva. Arhiv imaje společně s, nynějšna bibliografija spolu s; slovnik pokazuje obě formy bez prěpisyvanja bibliografičnoj zaslugy. Cěla primětka dolžna ostati vezana s dodatkom. Spisok dvoh avtorov bez toj primětki byl by kratši, ale skryl by informaciju, ktoru zapis izrično hoče čuvati.

Reason: The note about the supplement to Kapferer’s paper attributes joint work with E. Noether to the supplement, not automatically to the whole article. Preserving that authorship boundary is the substantive reason recorded for the choice. The archive has společně s and the current bibliography spolu s; the dictionary shows both forms without reallocating bibliographical credit. The whole note must remain attached to the supplement. A bare list of two authors would be shorter but would suppress the information the record expressly seeks to preserve.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Bibliografija pripisyvaje glavnu rabotu H. Kapfereru i dodava primětku o dodatku spolu s E. Noether. Spolu jest nynějšna forma; arhivny zapis společně ne měnjaje obseg sovměstnogo avtorstva.

Textual comparison: The bibliography attributes the main paper to H. Kapferer and adds a note about a supplement jointly with E. Noether. Spolu is the current wording; the archived společně does not change the scope of joint authorship.

Konstrukcija s modulo

The construction with modulo

Razlog: Modulo jest kratka medžunarodna predložna konstrukcija, izbrana vměsto odvojenyh fraz po modulju i za modulem v ruskom i ukrajinskom sravnjenju. Arhivny razlog govori o obšteslovjanskoj razumlivosti, ale ne sodrživaje čitateljskogo izslědovanja; to jest očekyvanje, ne izměreny rezultat. V uvodu raboty 2 modulo upotrěbjaje se pri odnosno polnyh sistemah form po odnošenju k \(\nu\), a potom k \((s,\varrho,t)\) i \((\varrho,t)\). Zato slovnik ne směje ograničiti frazu na ostatok pri děljenju cělyh čisel. Symboli poslě modulo i lokalna definicija redukcije noset matematičny smysl.

Reason: Modulo is the concise international prepositional construction selected in place of the separate Russian and Ukrainian phrases po modulyu and za modulem. The archived reason claims pan-Slavic intelligibility but contains no reader study; this is an expectation, not a measured result. In the introduction to Paper 2, modulo occurs with relatively complete systems of forms, first with respect to \(\nu\) and then to \((s,\varrho,t)\) and \((\varrho,t)\). The dictionary must therefore not restrict the phrase to remainders in integer division. The symbols following modulo and the local definition of reduction carry the mathematical meaning.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvod raboty 2 postupno měnjaje moduly pri konstrukciji odnosno polnyh sistemov form. Medžunarodna predložna konstrukcija čuva te symbole; interpretacija samo kako cěločislny ostatok byla by prěuzka.

Textual comparison: The introduction to Paper 2 successively changes the moduli in constructing relatively complete systems of forms. The international prepositional construction preserves those symbols; interpreting it only as an integer remainder would be too narrow.

Kongruencija po dvom označenym modulam

Congruence with respect to two specified moduli

Razlog: Kratka konstrukcija mod \((i,J)\) čuva standardny zapis kongruencije i jego dva označena modula. Arhivny razlog dava prědnost toj kompaktnosti i soglasnosti s §17 raboty 2 prěd polnymi frazami iz ruskogo i ukrajinskogo sravnjenja. V §20 ona uvodi tri relacije izvedene iz formul (24) i (26). Smysl ne jest cěločislno děljenje: \(i\) i \(J\) pripadajut lokalnoj teoriji form. Zato pri čitanju mora ostati vidima cela para \((i,J)\), a ne samo slovo mod. To jest konvencija matematičnogo izlaganja, ne novy naziv objekta.

Reason: The compact construction mod \((i,J)\) preserves the standard congruence notation and its two specified moduli. The archived reason favours this brevity and consistency with §17 of Paper 2 over the expanded phrases in the Russian and Ukrainian comparison. In §20 it introduces three relations derived from formulas (24) and (26). The meaning is not integer division: \(i\) and \(J\) belong to the local theory of forms. The whole pair \((i,J)\) must therefore remain visible, not merely the word mod. This is a convention of mathematical exposition, not a newly coined object name.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvodna fraza čuva \((i,J)\) pri trěh relacijah. Jezyk kongruencije zavisi od definicij form v rabotě, ne od obyčnogo cěločislnogo děljenja.

Textual comparison: The introductory phrase preserves \((i,J)\) for three relations. The congruence language depends on the paper’s definitions of forms, not on ordinary integer division.

Odkaz i děliteljnost v dokazě

Reference and divisibility in a proof

Razlog: Po punktu 1 čuva odkaz, na ktorom opiraje se tvrdženje o děliteljnosti vsih razgledanyh determinantov. V §8 raboty 31 vybrana jest lokalna modulna baza, a jej slědovy determinant děli druge determinanty v ukazanom lokalnom prstenu. Vsaky i nazvanje prstena sut suštvene: děliteljnost nad prstenom ne možno zaměniti neograničenym děljenjem v polju. Arhivny razlog tumači odkaz kako §8,1. Dostupny tekst v samoj stvari piše samo po punktu 1; §8,1 ustanovjaje lokalnu osnovu teorije, a §8,2 izrično govori o determinantah prědstavjenyh prěz bazu. Bez sravnjenja s pečatnym pasusom ne podavamo podrobnějšu identifikaciju odkaza kako dokazanu. To jest izbor dokaznoj prozy i predmet kontroly odkaza, ne samostojny novy termin.

Reason: Po punktu 1 preserves a reference supporting the divisibility assertion for all the determinants under consideration. In §8 of Paper 31 a local module basis is chosen, and its trace determinant divides the other determinants in the specified local ring. Every and the ring specification are essential: divisibility in a ring must not be replaced by unrestricted division in a field. The archived reason identifies the reference as §8,1. The available text actually says only according to point 1; §8,1 establishes the local setting, whereas §8,2 expressly discusses expressing determinants through a basis. Without comparing the printed passage, the more detailed reference identification is not treated as established. This is a choice in proof exposition and a cross-reference question, not a separate new term.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dostupny pasus čuva kratky odkaz, ale ne nazyvaje paragraf. Sravnjene pasusy pokazyvajut predposylky poredkov, lokalny prsten glavnyh idealov i prědstavjenje determinantov. Podrobna identifikacija odkaza ostaje pitanjem za pečatny izvornik.

Textual comparison: The available passage preserves a short reference without naming the section. The compared passages supply the assumptions on orders, a local principal ideal ring and the expression of determinants. The detailed reference identification remains a printed-witness question.

Uvod razloženja v §20

Introducing a decomposition in §20

Razlog: Po slědujućej shemě jest arhivny prěvod nach dem Ansatz v §20 raboty 2. Razlog jest ne prěnositi německo slovo, kogda formula pokazuje način razloženja. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjena imenno govoret o razloženju. Dostupny korpus v odgovarjajučem městě piše po slědujučem nastavku i davaje dva prědstavjenja produktov, prinaležne dvojnoj redukciji. Shema i nastavok zato sut dvě dokumentovane formulacije, ne dokazano odbačena i pobjědna alternativa s izvěstnymi vagami. Razlog proměny ne jest ustanovjen etym sravnjenjem. Čitatelj mora viděti, že izraz uvodi konkretne formule; ne mora poznavati německy termin Ansatz ni tumačiti jego kako nedokazanu matematičnu dogadku.

Reason: Po slědujućej shemě is the archived rendering of nach dem Ansatz in §20 of Paper 2. Its reason is to avoid importing the German word where the formula supplies a decomposition pattern. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda specifically refer to decomposition. At the corresponding location the available corpus says po slědujučem nastavku and gives two representations of products used in a double reduction. Shema and nastavok are therefore two documented formulations, not a demonstrated rejected/winning pair with known weights. This comparison does not establish why the wording differs. Readers need to understand that the expression introduces particular formulas; they need neither know the German word Ansatz nor interpret it as an unproved mathematical conjecture.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: §20 daje dvije formule za dvojnu redukciju. Nazvanje uvoda različaje se od arhivnoj glosy; samo to sravnjenje ne ustanovjaje pričinu izbora nastavok.

Textual comparison: Section 20 gives two formulas for a double reduction. Its introductory wording differs from the archived gloss; this comparison alone does not establish the reason for choosing nastavok.

Uvod vyčisljenja v §9

Introducing a calculation in §9

Razlog: Po slědujučej začetnoj shemě uvodi vyčisljenje v §9 raboty 2. Pridavny izraz začetna izjasnjaje, že ide o početkovy način postavjenja vyčisljenja, a slědujuča odkazuje k bezposrědnje danym formulam. Arhivny razlog bira opis vměsto neprozračnoj německoj zaimky i ostavjaje prirodnost izraza za jezykovu ocěnku. V dostupnom tekstu izraz stojí pri dvojnoj redukciji trěh izrazov iz reducenta; ne ustanovjaje novy objekt algebraičnoj teorije. Arhivna forma s ć i korpusna forma s č čuvajut isto naměrene značenje. Izbor služi orientaciji v dokazě, a ne skraćenju samogo vyčisljenja.

Reason: Po slědujučej začetnoj shemě introduces a calculation in §9 of Paper 2. Začetna explains that this is the initial setup of the calculation, while slědujuča points to the immediately following formulas. The archived reason chooses a description instead of an opaque German loan and leaves the expression’s naturalness open to linguistic assessment. In the available text it accompanies a double reduction of three expressions from a reducent; it does not introduce a new object of algebraic theory. The archived ć and the corpus č retain the same intended meaning. The choice helps readers navigate the proof; it does not abbreviate the calculation itself.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvodna fraza v §9 i §11 ne zaměnjaje vyčisljenja. Primětka v §11 izrično zabranjaje čitati sim kako ravnost pri izpuščenyh produktah.

Textual comparison: The introductory phrase in §§9 and 11 does not replace the calculations. The §11 footnote expressly rules out reading sim as equality when products have been omitted.

Uvod vyčisljenja i skraćena notacija v §11

Introducing a calculation and abbreviated notation in §11

Razlog: Po začetnoj shemě v §11 raboty 2 prodolžaje opisnu strategiju iz §9 za německo nach dem Ansatz. Arhivna forma začętnoj imaje nosovu bukvu; dostupny korpus piše začetnoj. Razlog izbora jest objasniti početkovu formu vyčisljenja bez potrěby znati německy izraz; prikladnost same formulacije ostala jest otvorjena. Osoblivo važno jest čitati primětku pri etom městě: znak \(\sim\) ne označa ravnost, zato že opreděljene produkty s \(u_x\) i vyšimi formami sut izpuščene. Prěvod uvodnoj frazy ne može čitatelju sugerovati točnu identičnost tam, kde avtor uživa skraćeno prědstavjenje. Notacija i njeno objasnjenje morajut ostati vměstě. Arhivna oznaka jedinicy odsyla k §12; citovany naslov dostupnogo teksta odvojeno ustanovjaje, že tu razgledano město naleži §11.

Reason: Po začetnoj shemě in §11 of Paper 2 continues the descriptive treatment of German nach dem Ansatz used in §9. The archived začętnoj has a nasal vowel letter; the available corpus writes začetnoj. The choice aims to explain the initial form of the calculation without requiring knowledge of the German expression; the suitability of the wording itself remains open. The accompanying footnote is particularly important: \(\sim\) is not equality, because specified products involving \(u_x\) and higher forms are omitted. Translating the introductory phrase must not suggest an exact identity where the author uses an abbreviated representation. The notation and its explanation must remain together. The archival unit label points to §12; the quoted heading of the available text separately establishes that the passage discussed here belongs to §11.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvodna fraza v §9 i §11 ne zaměnjaje vyčisljenja. Primětka v §11 izrično zabranjaje čitati sim kako ravnost pri izpuščenyh produktah.

Textual comparison: The introductory phrase in §§9 and 11 does not replace the calculations. The §11 footnote expressly rules out reading sim as equality when products have been omitted.

Uvod rezultata vyčisljenja

Introducing a calculated result

Razlog: Fraza po sootvětnom računu uvodi rezultat vyčisljenja, a ne novy matematičny pojem. Arhivny razlog davaje prědnost obyčnoj dokazovoj prozě; rusky i ukrajinsky sravnjajemy izraz takože govori o odgovarjajučem vyčisljenju. Izbor računu ostal jest privremenny: zapis izrično potrěbuje sravnjenja s izračunanje i računati, bez čislovyh vah. V §11 raboty 2 dostupny tekst piše po odgovarjajučem računu kako vyše i potom navodi formuly. Kako vyše odsyla k podobnomu postupu, ne k doslovnomu povtorjenju vsego dokaza. Fraza ne zaměnjaje formuly i ne dokazuje, že izračun byl nezavisno prověren. Sravnjenje pokazyvaje kontinuitet izloženja i različje medžu arhivnym sootvětnom i tekstovym odgovarjajučem.

Reason: The phrase po sootvětnom računu introduces the result of a calculation, not a new mathematical concept. The recorded reason favors ordinary proof prose; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda likewise refer to a corresponding calculation. Računu remained provisional: the record expressly calls for comparison with izračunanje and računati, without numerical weights. In §11 of Paper 2 the available text reads po odgovarjajučem računu kako vyše and then gives formulas. Kako vyše points to an analogous procedure, not a verbatim repetition of the entire proof. The phrase neither replaces the formulas nor establishes that the calculation has been independently checked. The comparison documents continuity of exposition and the difference between archived sootvětnom and textual odgovarjajučem.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Fraza po odgovarjajučem računu kako vyše odsyla k analogičnomu postupu i neposrědnje prědhodi konkretnym formulam. Naslov paragrafa potvrđuje §11.

Textual comparison: Po odgovarjajučem računu kako vyše points to an analogous procedure and immediately precedes concrete formulas. The section heading confirms §11.

Avtorova dodatna primětka

The author’s supplementary note

Razlog: Dodatna primětka jest naslov avtorovoj primětky poslě teoremy, ne novo objasnjenje prěvoditelja. Zapis daje prědnost prirodnoj opisnoj frazě prěd doslovnym prěvodom německogo Nachbemerkung; rusky i ukrajinsky ekvivalent takože podpirajut tu funkciju naslova. V §1 raboty 2 primětka sodrživaje izključenje k teoremě I, kogda dva ukazane parametry stanut nula. Ona utočnjaje, ktore kontrakcije ostavajut, kako razuměti red form i začto teoremy o reducentah ostavajut v silě. Dodatna zato ne znači nepotrěbna: primětka ograničava obseg prědhodečego tvrđenja. Kratky naslov primětka v drugom městě ima podobnu izložiteljnu funkciju, ale ne davaje pravo izgubiti tuty uslovja ili směšati avtorov tekst s redakcijnym komentarjem.

Reason: Dodatna primětka labels the author’s subsequent note, not an explanation added by the translator. The record favors a natural descriptive phrase over a literal rendering of German Nachbemerkung; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support that function. In §1 of Paper 2 the note gives an exception to Theorem I when two specified parameters become zero. It explains which contractions remain, how to understand the series of forms, and why the theorems concerning reducents still hold. Additional therefore does not mean dispensable: the note qualifies the preceding assertion. The shorter label primětka elsewhere serves a similar expository function, but does not justify dropping these conditions or confusing the author’s text with editorial commentary.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dodatna primětka ograničava teoremu I; kratka primětka uvodi daljše relacije. Izložiteljny naslov ne davaje povoljenje izpustiti matematične uslovja.

Textual comparison: The supplementary note qualifies Theorem I; the short note introduces further relations. An expository heading does not license omission of mathematical conditions.

Kratky naslov primětky

The short note heading

Razlog: Primětka jest kratky izložiteljny naslov za německo Nachbemerkung. Arhivny izbor odklanja doslovnu konstrukciju so značenjem poslje-zaměčanje, da by čitatelj neposrědnje poznal funkciju odstavca. Rusko primečanije i ukrajinska prymitka sut zapisane sravnjajeme formy; to ne jest čislovo glasovanje medžu jezykami. V rabotě 2 tekst pod tym naslovom govori o analogičnom izračunjenju prěkrivanj \(f\) nad \(j\), reducibilnyh po §5, i davaje relacije (4). Naslov ne měnjaje jih dokazovogo statusa i ne čini jih komentarjem prěvoditelja. Različje medžu kratkym primětka i razširjenym dodatna primětka trěba ocěnjati po funkciji konkretnoj primětky; zapis ne ustanovjaje dvě različne matematične kategorije.

Reason: Primětka is a short expository label for German Nachbemerkung. The recorded choice rejects a literal construction meaning after-remark so that readers can recognize the paragraph’s function directly. Russian primečanie and Ukrainian prymitka are the recorded comparanda; this is not a numerical vote among languages. In Paper 2 the paragraph under this label describes an analogous calculation of overlaps of \(f\) over \(j\), reducible by §5, and supplies relations (4). The label changes neither their argumentative role nor their authorship. The difference between primětka and the longer dodatna primětka should be assessed by the function of the particular note; the record establishes no two distinct mathematical categories.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dodatna primětka ograničava teoremu I; kratka primětka uvodi daljše relacije. Izložiteljny naslov ne davaje povoljenje izpustiti matematične uslovja.

Textual comparison: The supplementary note qualifies Theorem I; the short note introduces further relations. An expository heading does not license omission of mathematical conditions.

Matematične tablice i znak modulo

Mathematical arrays and modulo notation

Razlog: To jest pravilo pisma i notacije, ne slovnikova para dvou jezykov. Pri kiriličnom prěpisu prozy matematične bukvy, grečske znaky i tehnične edinice razstupa ostavajut neizměnjene. V §14 raboty 2 jedna tablica stoi v drugoj; končanje vnutrěnnoj tablicy ne konča matematičny kontekst vněšnjej. Formulacija uključaje takože izraz modulo: znak \(\nu\) v kongruenciji jest matematičny simbol, ne slovo za transliteraciju. Arhivny razlog opiraje se na ohranu identičnosti notacije, ne na sravnjenje ruskyh i ukrajinskyh terminov. Prozni tekst vnutri formuly trěba razlikovati od simbolov; jedna obalna matematična struktura sama ne znači, že vse vidime slova sut netransliterovateljne. To pravilo opisuje, čto se mora zachovati, ale ne jest dokazom pravilnosti cělogo kiriličnogo prěpisa.

Reason: This is a script and notation rule, not a bilingual lexical pair. When prose is projected into Cyrillic, mathematical letters, Greek symbols, and technical spacing units remain unchanged. In §14 of Paper 2 one array sits inside another; closing the inner array does not end the surrounding mathematical context. The rule also covers modulo expressions: \(\nu\) in the congruence is a mathematical symbol, not a word to transliterate. The recorded reason is preservation of notation, not a comparison of Russian and Ukrainian terms. Prose inside a formula still has to be distinguished from symbols; an enclosing mathematical structure does not by itself make every visible word exempt from transliteration. The rule specifies what must be preserved, but is not evidence that the entire Cyrillic projection has been checked.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Končanje vnutrěnnoj tablicy ne izključaje slědujuče simboly iz vněšnjej matematičnoj struktury. Simbol pri modulo takože ostavaje matematičnym znakom.

Textual comparison: Closing an inner array does not remove the following symbols from the outer mathematical structure. The symbol in the modulo expression likewise remains mathematical notation.

Vložene tablice i identičnost simbolov

Nested arrays and symbol identity

Razlog: Vložena tablica ne měnjaje identičnost bukv izvan sebe. V §13 raboty 2 vnutrěnna tablica konča se prěd izrazami s \(H\), \(a\) i \(j\), ale vse te izrazy ostavajut v obemlječej matematičnoj tablici. One ne smějut stati kiriličnymi dvojnicami podobnogo vida; takože oznaka edinicy em v zapisu razstupa jest tehnična edinica, ne proza. Arhiv dokumentuje razlog različenja vnutrěnnoj i vněšnjej struktury pri prěpisu. Iz togo vyhodi obče pravilo: matematičny kontekst konča se tek, kogda konči se odgovarjajuča obemlječa struktura, ne pri prvom znaku konca vnutri nje. Tuta odluka pripada k vernosti notacije. Ona ne tvori novy matematičny termin i ne davaje kiriličnoj versiji status nezavisnogo prěvoda.

Reason: An embedded array does not change the identity of letters outside it. In §13 of Paper 2 the inner array ends before expressions involving \(H\), \(a\), and \(j\), yet all remain inside the enclosing mathematical array. They must not become visually similar Cyrillic letters; likewise em in a spacing instruction is a technical unit, not prose. The archive records the reason for distinguishing inner and outer structure during script conversion. The general rule is that a mathematical context ends only when its corresponding enclosing structure ends, not at the first internal closing marker. This decision concerns fidelity of notation. It coins no mathematical term and does not make the Cyrillic version an independent translation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Končanje vnutrěnnoj tablicy ne izključaje slědujuče simboly iz vněšnjej matematičnoj struktury. Simbol pri modulo takože ostavaje matematičnym znakom.

Textual comparison: Closing an inner array does not remove the following symbols from the outer mathematical structure. The symbol in the modulo expression likewise remains mathematical notation.

Kritika dokaza bez zaměny tvrđenja

Criticizing a proof without changing the claim

Razlog: Ne jest dostatočno obosnovany odnosi se k dokazu, ne k istinnosti teorema. Arhivny razlog požadaje izběgati nepotrěbno polemičnogo tona, ne oslabevati konkretnu logičnu kritiku. V primětce raboty 7 Noether kaže, že iz invariantnosti koeficientov jednej funkcije ješče ne jest pokazana jih racionalna izrazimost prěz koeficienty drugoj. Potom daje postup s diferencialovanjem, ktory tu prazninu obhodi. Rusky izraz o nesostojateljnosti i ukrajinsky o nekorektnosti pokazujut različne sposoby izrečti ocěnku dokaza, ale ne opravdajut prěvod teorem jest nepravdivy. Takože nedostatok podrobnosti byl by preslaby, ako skryvaje imenno nevyvedeny krok. Ovdě se objasnjaje kritika, ktora jest v avtorovoj primětce; to ne jest nezavisna prověrka citovanogo Weberovogo dokaza.

Reason: Ne jest dostatočno obosnovany concerns the proof, not the truth of the theorem. The recorded reason calls for avoiding unnecessary polemic, not weakening a specific logical criticism. In a footnote to Paper 7, Noether says that invariance of the coefficients of one function has not yet established their rational expressibility through the coefficients of another. She then gives a differentiation procedure that avoids the gap. The Russian expression of invalidity and the Ukrainian expression of incorrectness illustrate different ways of evaluating the proof, but do not warrant translating the statement as the theorem is false. Mere lack of detail would also be too weak if it concealed the missing inference. This explains the criticism in the author’s footnote; it is not an independent examination of the cited proof by Weber.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Primětka razlikuje invariantnost koeficientov od jih racionalnoj izrazimosti prěz druge koeficienty. Kritika odsyla k nevyvedenomu kroku, ne k nepravdivosti teorema.

Textual comparison: The footnote distinguishes invariance of coefficients from their rational expressibility through other coefficients. The criticism concerns a missing inference, not falsity of the theorem.

Komutativnost koeficientov v nekomutativnom prstenu

Commuting coefficients in a noncommutative ring

Razlog: To jest odluka o formulovanju uslovja, ne samostojny novy termin. Německo vertauschbar prěvedeno jest glagolom komutovati, da fraza jasno kaže: elementy \(\Sigma\) komutujut so vsimi elementami prstena. Zapis objašnjaje, že ta formulacija čuva smysl avtorovoj podčrtnoj primětky: dani zapisi i dokaz ostavajut uporabimy takože v ukazanom nekomutativnom slučaju. Uslovje ne tvrdži, že prsten v cělosti jest komutativny. Ono dopušča potrěbnu prěměnu poredka koeficientov, bez dopuščanja libovoljnoj prěměny vseh faktorov. V dostupnom tekstu ta primětka stoji v dokazě korespondencije klasov idealov i matričnyh prědstavjenij. Arhivno kolca i nynějšnje prsteny sut različne leksične formy; matematičny symbol \(\Sigma\) ne jest slovo za prěvod.

Reason: This is a decision about stating a hypothesis, not a separate new term. German vertauschbar is rendered by komutovati so that the sentence says explicitly that the elements of \(\Sigma\) commute with every ring element. The record explains the purpose of the author’s footnote: the notation and argument also remain applicable in the specified noncommutative setting. The condition does not assert that the whole ring is commutative. It permits the required interchange with coefficients, not arbitrary rearrangement of all factors. In the available text the footnote occurs in the correspondence between ideal classes and matrix-representation classes. Archival kolca and current prsteny are different lexical forms; the mathematical symbol \(\Sigma\) is not a word to translate.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Podčrtna primětka ograničava nekomutativno razširjenje dokaza prědpoloženjem o \(\Sigma\); ona ne razširja komutativnost na cěly prsten.

Textual comparison: The footnote limits the noncommutative extension of the proof by a hypothesis on \(\Sigma\); it does not extend commutativity to the whole ring.

Latinica i kirilica pri nulj-

Latin and Cyrillic treatment of nulj-

Razlog: Toj zapis prodolžaje terminologiju raboty 24, ale njegov osobny razlog tyče se pismenosti. Latinske nulje i polje nuljev služe osnovoju, a kiriličny zapis ima slědovati jednoj povtorimoj prěobrazbi; arhiv izrično ukazuje lj v ль, bez samovoljnogo pravopisnogo popravljanja v kirilici. Tako dvě pismenosti ne stavajut dvoma nezavisnymi prěvodami. To jest zasada zapisana pri prvonačalnom izborě, ne tvrdženje, že v toj rekonstrukciji byl iznova prověren cěly konverter. Izbor samogo korenja, njegovogo sklanjanja i njegove matematičnoj priměny ostavaje oddělnym lingvističnym voprosom. Rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy mogut podpirati sravnenje, ale avtomatična kirilična kopija medžuslovjanskogo teksta ne može byti tretjim nezavisnym svědkom.

Reason: This record continues Paper 24’s terminology, but its distinctive reason concerns script. Latin nulje and polje nuljev are the source forms, while Cyrillic is to follow one reproducible conversion; the archive expressly specifies lj to ль, without discretionary spelling changes in Cyrillic. The two scripts therefore do not become independent translations. This is the policy recorded with the original choice, not a claim that the whole converter was freshly tested in this reconstruction. Selection of the stem, its inflection and its mathematical application remain separate linguistic questions. Russian and Ukrainian records can inform comparison, but an automatic Cyrillic copy of the Interslavic text cannot count as a third independent witness.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 24, §1, razgleda algebraične vrijednosti nad poljem s ostalymi proměnnymi kako parametrami. Produkt linearnyh faktorov rezultanta čuva takože kratnosti. Zapis o pismenosti v §3 prodolžaje termin nulj-; sam latinicky kontekst ne jest novym testom kiriličnogo konvertera ni nezavisnym svědčenjem jezykovoj upotrěby.

Textual comparison: Paper 24, §1, considers algebraic values over a field retaining the other variables as parameters. The resultant’s product of linear factors also carries multiplicities. The §3 script record continues nulj- terminology; the Latin context is not itself a new test of the Cyrillic converter or independent language attestation.

Samo jedin: jedinstvenost s točnymi uslovjami

Only one: uniqueness with its exact hypotheses

Razlog: Samo jedin izrično čuva jedinstvenost, ne jest stilističny dodatok. Arhiv podčrtaje, že na tom uslovju zavisi zaključok. V rabotě 31, §8, govori se o multiplikacionnom prstenu s jedinym prostym idealom različnym od nulovogo i jediničnogo. V toj klasě prstenov to vodi k prstenu glavnyh idealov. Ne možno izostaviti ni klasu prstenov, ni izključene idealy, i poslě tvrdžiti to o libovoljnom prstenu s jedinym prostym idealom. Fraza takože ne zaměnjaje postojanje samo gornjoju graniceju od jednogo ideala. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela imajut tu istu omeđujuču česticu. To jest odluka o logičnoj točnosti rečenice, ne novy nazov matematičnogo objekta.

Reason: Samo jedin explicitly preserves uniqueness; it is not stylistic padding. The record stresses that the consequence depends on this condition. Paper 31, §8, concerns a multiplication ring with just one prime ideal other than the zero and unit ideals. Within that class of rings the conclusion is a principal ideal ring. Neither the ring class nor the excluded ideals may be dropped to assert this of an arbitrary ring with one prime ideal. The phrase also does not replace existence by merely an upper bound of one ideal. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels have the same restrictive particle. This is a decision about a sentence’s logical precision, not a new mathematical object-name.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §8, najprvo ograničavaje klasu prstenov, potom davaje zaključok pri jedinom prostom idealu različnom od nulovogo i jediničnogo. Pri lokalizaciji povtorjajut se i ta jedinstvenost i svojstva multiplikacionnogo prstena. To objašnjaje začto povtorjenje uslovja jest matematično korisno, a ne izbytočno.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §8, first specifies the ring class, then draws the consequence when there is only one prime ideal other than zero and the unit ideal. The localization passage repeats both uniqueness and the multiplication-ring properties. This explains why repeating the hypothesis is mathematically useful rather than redundant.

Povtorjenje uslovja poslě lokalizacije

Repeating the hypothesis after localization

Razlog: To jest povtorjenje nužnogo uslovja v novom městě dokaza. Zapis izrično objašnjaje, že rečenica o jedinom prostom idealu v lokalizovanom prstenu ima pokazati, začto možno priměniti rannějši zaključok o glavnyh idealah. V rabotě 31, §8, lokalizacija čuva potrěbne svojstva multiplikacionnogo prstena; izključene ostavajut nulovy i jediničny idealy. Z toho ne slěduje, že vsaky lokalny prsten jest prstenom glavnyh idealov. Arhivno \(o_p\) jest oznaka prstena, ne čislo 0 s indeksom; dostupny tekst koristi frakturne bukvy za prsten i prosty ideal. Pismenost oznaki i matematičny smysl uslovja trěba čuvati oddělno. Ponavljanje tu pomaga čitatelju proslediti priměnu teoremy.

Reason: This is a repetition of a necessary hypothesis at a new point in the proof. The record expressly explains that the localized ring’s one-prime-ideal sentence makes the earlier principal-ideal conclusion applicable. In Paper 31, §8, localization preserves the required multiplication-ring properties, and the zero and unit ideals remain excluded. It does not follow that every local ring is a principal ideal ring. Archival \(o_p\) denotes the ring, not the numeral 0 with a subscript; the available text uses fraktur letters for the ring and prime ideal. The typography of the identifier and the hypothesis’s mathematical meaning must be preserved separately. Repetition here helps readers follow the application of a theorem.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §8, najprvo ograničavaje klasu prstenov, potom davaje zaključok pri jedinom prostom idealu različnom od nulovogo i jediničnogo. Pri lokalizaciji povtorjajut se i ta jedinstvenost i svojstva multiplikacionnogo prstena. To objašnjaje začto povtorjenje uslovja jest matematično korisno, a ne izbytočno.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §8, first specifies the ring class, then draws the consequence when there is only one prime ideal other than zero and the unit ideal. The localization passage repeats both uniqueness and the multiplication-ring properties. This explains why repeating the hypothesis is mathematically useful rather than redundant.

Bez povtorjenja i točno jedin raz

Without repetition and exactly once

Razlog: Bez povtorjenja i jedin raz i samo jedin raz čuvajut različne, povězane česti tvrdženja: nepovtorjanje i cělo objimanje. Arhiv izrično odvrgaje njih razgledanje kako pustogo stila. V rabotě 9, §8, osnovny seznam ima po jednom polju iz vsakoj izomorfnej klasy. Potom konstrukcija pro jednu klasu davaje vse različne polja v toj klasě, každo samo jedin raz. Jedin prědstavitelj klasy zato ne znači isto kako jedin pojav vsakogo polja v klasě. Izraz bez povtorjenja sam ne garantuje, že žadno polje ne jest izpuščeno; jedin raz i samo jedin raz vyražaje i postojanje i jedinstvenost pojavu. Ta razlika potrěbuje čitanje cěloj konstrukcije, ne samo zaměnu sinonimov.

Reason: Bez povtorjenja and jedin raz i samo jedin raz preserve related but distinct parts of the assertion: non-repetition and exhaustive coverage. The record expressly rejects treating them as mere style. In Paper 9, §8, the initial list has one field from each isomorphism class. The subsequent construction for a class gives all distinct fields in that class, each once. One representative of a class therefore does not mean the same thing as one occurrence of every field in it. Without repetition alone does not guarantee that no field is omitted; once and only once expresses both existence and uniqueness of occurrence. The distinction requires reading the whole construction, not merely substituting synonyms.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 9, §8, počinaje iz prědstaviteljev izomorfnyh klasov i dalje izčisljaje različne polja v každoj klasě. Nepovtorjanje i cělost izčislenja trěba prověriti na pravom urovnju. Zato objašnjenje ne sklada vse pojavy slova prědstavitelj v jeden nerazličen smysl.

Textual comparison: Paper 9, §8, starts from representatives of isomorphism classes and proceeds to enumerate distinct fields within each class. Non-repetition and completeness must be checked at the correct level. The explanation therefore does not collapse every representative-related formulation into one undifferentiated sense.

Konec povtorjanoj operacije

Termination of a repeated operation

Razlog: Operacija prěryvaje se opisuje konec povtorjanogo koraka dokaza poslě oprěděljenogo čisla priměn. Arhivny razlog daje prědnost procedurnoj formulaciji, v paraleli s ruskoju i ukrajinskoju frazoju. V rabotě 4, §4, granično čislo povtorjenij zavisi od razgledanogo slučaja i od indeksov: v jednom městě \(\rho\), v drugom \(\sigma\). To ne jest slučajny tehničny neuspěh ni prěryvanje od vněšnjego dějatelja. Takože ne govori se o približnom sbliženju nekonečnogo procesa. Pri prěnosu takoj frazy v drugu matematičnu oblast trěba oddělno ustanoviti, ktory korak ponavlja se, ktora granica čisla korakov jest dokazana i pod ktorymi uslovjami. Sam glagol ne dokazuje končanje.

Reason: Operacija prěryvaje se describes the end of a repeated proof operation after a specified number of applications. The recorded reason prefers procedural wording, parallel to the Russian and Ukrainian phrases. In Paper 4, §4, the repetition limit depends on the case and indices: \(\rho\) at one point, \(\sigma\) at another. This is not an accidental technical failure or an interruption by an external actor. Nor is it approximate convergence of an infinite process. Transferring such wording to another mathematical subject requires identifying the repeated step, the proved bound on repetitions and its hypotheses. The verb alone does not establish termination.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 4, §4, povězuje konec operacije s indeksami i granicami sum. Odvisno od slučaja, čislo povtorjenij jest ograničeno s \(\rho\) ili \(\sigma\). Slovny prěvod mora čuvati čislo i slučaj; samo prěryvaje se ne govori, ktora granica jest pravdiva.

Textual comparison: Paper 4, §4, links termination to indices and summation limits. Depending on the case, repetitions are bounded by \(\rho\) or \(\sigma\). The verbal translation must preserve both number and case; terminates alone does not say which bound is valid.

Oznaka razširjenogo ideala

Notation for an extended ideal

Razlog: Formula \(P=Tp\) v zapisu čuva identitet razširjenogo ideala i njegov okolny prsten. Arhivny razlog jest doslědnost s rannějšimi odlomkami o razširenju idealov. V dostupnom tekstu raboty 31, §8, oznaki za idealy i prsten pišut se frakturno: dolno p imenuje prosty ideal osnovnogo prstena, ne prosty element. Konečne sumy produktov s elementami nadprstena tvoret razširjeny ideal; ne potrěbno, že vsaky njegov element jest jeden takovy produkt. Ne trěba prědpolagati, že razširjeny ideal ostavaje prosty. Isti odlomok ima nerazrěšenu oznaku osnovy pri slovu poredok, kde piše idealno p, hoti bližši tekst govori o lokalizovanom osnovnom prstenu. To potrěbuje izvorno sravnenje, ne molčalivu zaměnu.

Reason: The recorded formula \(P=Tp\) preserves the extended ideal’s identity and ambient ring. Its stated reason is continuity with the earlier ideal-extension passages. In Paper 31, §8, the current text uses fraktur for the ideals and ring: lower-case p denotes a prime ideal of the base ring, not a prime element. The extended ideal consists of finite sums of products with elements of the overring; not every element need be a single such product. The extended ideal must not be assumed prime. The same passage has an unresolved base label beside order, writing ideal p although the surrounding text concerns the localized base ring. This needs source comparison, not silent substitution.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 31, §8, izrično naznačaje razširjeny ideal v nadprstenu, a potom koristi jeho primarne komponenty. Formula ne govori, že on jest prosty. V istom odlomku oznaka pri konečnom poredku jest zapisana idealnym p, ne navedenym lokalizovanym osnovnym prstenom; to ostavaje otvorenym voprosom iztočnogo teksta.

Textual comparison: Paper 31, §8, explicitly identifies the extended ideal in the overring and then uses its primary components. The formula does not assert that it is prime. In the same passage the finite-order label uses ideal p rather than the stated localized base ring; this remains an open source-text question.

Vhodi v kako dělitelnost

Vhodi v as divisibility

Razlog: Vhodi v v toj rečenici vyražaje dělitelnost, ne pripadnost elementa množstvu. Arhivny razlog čuva tu glagolnu formulaciju, čoby dokaz ostal paralelny s teoremnym tvrdženjem. V rabotě 31, §8, ono povězuje prosty ideal v osnovnom prstenu s prostym elementom \(p\) v lokalizovanom prstenu; \(p\) děli tamošnji diskriminantny element \(D_{T_P}\). Ne možno zaměniti ideal i njegov lokalny generator ili čitati vhodi kako prosto figuriranje symbola v formulě. Arhivne prostye bukvy v oznakah ne kažut vsih tipografičnyh razlik nynějšego teksta. Smysl čuva se točnym určenjem objekta, osnovnogo prstena i napravjenja dělitelnosti, ne samym povtorjenjem glagola.

Reason: Vhodi v in this sentence expresses divisibility, not set membership. The recorded reason preserves that verbal formulation to keep the proof parallel to the theorem statement. In Paper 31, §8, it connects a prime ideal of the base ring with a prime element \(p\) in the localized ring: \(p\) divides the local discriminant element \(D_{T_P}\). The ideal and its local generator must not be interchanged, nor vhodi read as a symbol merely appearing in a formula. The archival plain letters do not preserve every typographic distinction of the current text. Meaning is retained by specifying the object, base ring and direction of divisibility, not by repeating the verb alone.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dokaz raboty 31, §8, prěhodi od dělitelnosti diskriminantnogo ideala prostym idealom do dělitelnosti lokalnogo diskriminantnogo elementa generatorom \(p\). Glagol vhodi čuva tu svezu, ako čitatelj različi ideal, element i prsten. Smer dělitelnosti ne smije byti obratny.

Textual comparison: The proof in Paper 31, §8, passes from divisibility of the discriminant ideal by a prime ideal to divisibility of a local discriminant element by the generator \(p\). Vhodi preserves that connection only if the ideal, element and ring are distinguished. The direction of divisibility must not be reversed.

Jedin element poraždaje ideal

One element generates the ideal

Razlog: Poraždaje čuva izbrany glagol za algebraično generovanje. Zapis ne prědlagaje novu konkurentnu formu, ale prodolžaje uže upotrěbjany jezyk dokaza. V rabotě 31, §8, sam \(p\) poraždaje prosty ideal, zato že jego glavny ideal ima točno prvu stepen jedinogo dopuščenogo prostogo idealnogo faktora. To znači ravnost idealov, ne samo pripadnost \(p\) idealu. Rečenica zavisi od navedenogo svojstva multiplikacionnogo prstena i jedinstvenosti prostogo ideala različnogo od nulovogo i jediničnogo. Slovo sam podčrtaje, že ne potrěbny druge generatory; ne tvrdži, že generator jest jedinstveny. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože čuvajut glagol za generovanje.

Reason: Poraždaje retains the selected verb for algebraic generation. The record proposes no new competing form; it continues the proof’s existing terminology. In Paper 31, §8, \(p\) itself generates the prime ideal because its principal ideal has exactly the first power of the only allowed prime-ideal factor. This asserts equality of ideals, not merely membership of \(p\) in the ideal. The sentence depends on the stated multiplication-ring properties and uniqueness of the prime ideal other than zero and the unit ideal. Itself emphasizes that no additional generators are needed; it does not assert uniqueness of the generator. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels likewise retain the generation verb.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uslovja raboty 31, §8, dajut, že glavny ideal od \(p\) jest ravny razgledanomu prostomu idealu. Poraždaje vyražaje tu ravnost. Pripadnost jednogo elementa idealu ne byla by dovoljna; ni slovo sam ne ustanavljaje jedinstvenost generatora.

Textual comparison: The hypotheses of Paper 31, §8, make the principal ideal of \(p\) equal to the prime ideal in question. Generates expresses that equality. Membership of one element would not suffice; itself does not establish uniqueness of the generator.

Avtorovo popravjenje: polja s konjugatami

Authorial correction: fields with conjugates

Razlog: To jest redakcijna odluka o priměnjenju avtorovogo popravjenja, ne novo nazvanje za polje. Arhiv govori o razširjenju izbranyh \((H,y)\) i \((H,Y)\) vsimi konjugatami do indeksa \(\lambda_0-1\). Dostupna rabota 16 v prvom popravjenju navodi točny naslov ranějšej raboty, pečatne lokatory i zaměny; rabota 9, §7, už sodrživaje razširjene polja. Črty i gornje indekse tu označajut konjugate, ne derivacije ni obične stepeni. Zaměna měni osnovu razsudženja o medžupoljah i prěsěkah. Diplomatično izdanje ranějšej raboty i izdanje s priměnjenym popravjenjem morajut byti različene. Nynešnja sravniteljna prověrka čita prěvod popravjenja; ne predstavlja novu prověrku pečatnogo německogo iztočnika.

Reason: This is an editorial decision to apply an authorial correction, not a new name for a field. The record says selected \((H,y)\) and \((H,Y)\) are enlarged by all conjugates through index \(\lambda_0-1\). The available Paper 16’s first correction names the earlier work, printed locators and replacements; Paper 9, §7, already contains the enlarged fields. Primes and parenthesized superscripts here label conjugates, not derivatives or ordinary powers. The change affects the argument about intermediate fields and intersections. A diplomatic edition of the earlier work and an edition incorporating the correction must be distinguished. The present comparison reads the translated correction; it does not claim a new examination of the printed German witness.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prvo popravjenje raboty 16 naznačaje ranějši naslov, pečatne lokatory i proširjene polja. Te liste konjugatov sut už prisutne v rabotě 9, §7. To podpiraje redakcijnu istoriju zapisanej zaměny, ale ne novu diplomatičnu prověrku pečatnogo originala.

Textual comparison: Paper 16’s first correction specifies the earlier title, printed locators and enlarged fields. Those conjugate lists are already present in Paper 9, §7. This supports the editorial history of the recorded replacement, but is not a new diplomatic comparison with the printed original.

V polinomnom smyslu: ograda odnosa

In the polynomial sense: qualifying a relation

Razlog: V polinomnom smyslu jest ograda smysla, ne novo nazvanje za matematičny objekt. Zapis ju dodržuje, da by čitatelj ne směšal děliteljnost polinomov s děliteljnostju idealov ili modulov. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože izrično označajut smysl. V rabotě 22 ta ograda nastupaje pri vzajemno prostyh faktorah i pri največšem občem dělitelju polinomov, dočim okolny tekst upotrěbljaje idealne kvocienty i modulne normy. Samo prisutstvo idealov v odlomku zato ne měni tip dělitelja. Prěvod mora čuvati objekt i odnos: polinomni obči dělitelj ne jest avtomatično ideal generovany vsimi danymi polinomami.

Reason: V polinomnom smyslu is a qualification of sense, not a new mathematical object name. The record retains it to prevent polynomial divisibility from being confused with ideal or module divisibility. Russian and Ukrainian also mark the sense explicitly. In Paper 22 it accompanies relatively prime polynomial factors and a greatest common divisor of polynomials, while the surrounding argument uses ideal quotients and module norms. The presence of ideals in the passage does not change the divisor’s type. The translation must preserve both object and relation: a polynomial gcd is not automatically the ideal generated by all the polynomials.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rabota 22 odlišava največši obči dělitelj polinomov od idealnogo kvocienta i modulnoj normy. Ograda v polinomnom smyslu čuva tip odnosa, ne jest odvečny ukras prozy.

Textual comparison: Paper 22 distinguishes a polynomial greatest common divisor from an ideal quotient and a module norm. In the polynomial sense preserves the relation’s type; it is not dispensable prose decoration.

Kogda vse primarne komponenty sut proste

When all primary components are prime

Razlog: Primarne komponenty stavajut prostymi idealami jest čest definicije polnoj razložimosti, ne novy termin ni tvrdženje, že vsaka primarna komponenta vsegda jest prosta. Arhiv žela čuvati razliku primarny/prosty, potrěbnu za pozdnějši diskriminantny kriterij. Rabota 31, §3, veže uslovje k produktnomu prědstavjenju nulovogo ideala i k vsim njegovym komponentam. Ravnoznačno prědstavjenje jest direktna suma konečno mnogyh polj. Vse ne može byti zaměnjeno s někoje; glagol stavajut tu izražaje uslovje definicije, ne časovy proces. Tak samo se oddělja prvy rod, ktory trěbuje daljšego uslovja na proste idealy.

Reason: Primarne komponenty stavajut prostymi idealami is part of the definition of complete reducibility, not a new term or an assertion that every primary component is always prime. The recorded reason is to preserve the primary/prime distinction needed for the later discriminant criterion. Paper 31, §3, attaches the condition to the product representation of the zero ideal and to all its components. The equivalent representation is a direct sum of finitely many fields. All cannot become some; become expresses a defining condition here, not a temporal process. First-kind complete reducibility adds a further condition on the primes.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Produkt idealov i direktna suma prstena imajut razne objekty. Polna razložimost trěbuje prostotu vsih primarnyh komponentov.

Textual comparison: The product of ideals and the direct sum of the ring concern different objects. Complete reducibility requires every primary component to be prime.

Granica prěnosa: nedostajuča operacija

A limit on transfer: a missing operation

Razlog: Pojem produkta ne prěnosi se na moduly čuva ograničenje metoda, ne izkazuje, že ne može obstajati nikaky produkt nikakih modulov. Arhiv ostavlja produkt izrično, zato že v razgleđanoj oblasti \(T\) ne jest definirano množenje dvoh jej elementov. Zato danu definiciju primarnogo i prostogo ideala ne možno neposrědnje prěnesti. Rabota 19, §9, od toga razlikuje teoremy osnovane samo na děliteljnosti i najmenšem občem mnogokratnom, ktore se prěnoset. Posebno razgleđaje nekomutativne prsteny i neuspěh potrěbnyh dokazov. Izraz ne směje byti skračen do bezuslovnogo zakaza, ktory by obhvačal i drugače definirane konstrukcije.

Reason: Pojem produkta ne prěnosi se na moduly preserves a limitation of the method, not a claim that no kind of product of modules can exist. The archive keeps product explicit because multiplication of two elements of the domain \(T\) under discussion is undefined. The given definitions of primary and prime ideals therefore cannot transfer directly. Paper 19, §9, contrasts this with theorems based only on divisibility and ideal least common multiples, which do transfer. It separately discusses noncommutative rings and failure of the required proofs. The phrase must not become an unconditional prohibition covering differently defined constructions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teoremy o děliteljnosti mogut ostati, hoti rezultat potrěbujuči nedefinirany produkt ne može prějti. Negacija jest lokalna k danoj strukturi.

Textual comparison: Divisibility theorems can survive when a result requiring an undefined product cannot transfer. The negative statement is local to the given structure.

Imena i bibliografične nazvanja v rabotě 12

Names and bibliographic titles in Paper 12

Razlog: Pravilo za rabotu 12 razlikuje imena v běžnom izloženju od točnyh bibliografičnyh nazvanij. Arhiv izbral slovjanske formy Kristofel, Riči, Riman, Lipšic i Lagranž za izloženje, ktore može byti prěvedeno v kirilicu; nazvanja Crelle, Math. Annalen, Werke i Mécanique analytique ostavajut latinskymi bibliografičnymi ostrovami. Razlog jest čitlivost teksta zajedno s možnostju najdti citovanu publikaciju. Nynějšny latinsky tekst pokazuje tuto razliku pri imenah i citacijah v uvodu. To jest pravilo pisanja i identifikacije, ne novo matematično slovo; anglijsky opis v starom spisku ne jest medžuslovjansky termin. Tuto sravnjenje samo po sobě ne proverjaje vsakogo kiriličnogo výstupa.

Reason: The Paper 12 convention distinguishes names in running exposition from exact bibliographic titles. The record selects Slavicized forms such as Kristofel, Riči, Riman, Lipšic and Lagranž for prose that can be converted to Cyrillic, while Crelle, Math. Annalen, Werke and Mécanique analytique remain Latin-script bibliographic islands. Its rationale combines readable prose with identifiable references. The current Latin text shows that distinction in the introduction’s names and citations. This is a writing and identification convention, not a mathematical coinage; the older English description is not an Interslavic term. This comparison alone does not verify every Cyrillic output.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prisposobljene imena ostavajut različne od izvorno napisanyh bibliografičnyh nazvanij.

Textual comparison: Adapted names remain distinct from bibliographic titles in their original spelling.

Latinske citacije v kiriličnom izloženju

Latin citations in Cyrillic exposition

Razlog: V rabotě 11 zaščita citacij čuva izvorno pisanje inostrannyh nazvanij, dokolě medžuslovjansko izloženje i prisposobljene imena podležat prěvodu v kirilicu. Arhiv povezuje tuto razliku s kurzivoju i zaštitoju bibliografičnyh fragmentov; cilj byl izběgnuti slučajnu směs latinskyh i kiriličnyh bukv v jednom slově. Nynějšny tekst, napr., razlikuje běžno imeno Lurot od německogo nazvanja njegove raboty, a Weber Algebra ohranjaje kako citaciju. Kurziva sama ne dokazuje, že tekst jest inostranny: v matematičnom izloženju ona može iměti druge funkcije. Zato pravilo trěbuje smyslovo označene bibliografične česti, ne slěpu zaščitu vsego kurzivnogo teksta. Kirilična versija ostavaje projekcijeju latinskoj, ne nezavisnym prěvodnym svědkom.

Reason: In Paper 11, citation protection preserves the original spelling of foreign titles while Interslavic exposition and adapted names are eligible for Cyrillic conversion. The record associates this distinction with italics and protected bibliographic spans, aiming to avoid accidental Latin–Cyrillic mixtures within a word. The current text, for example, distinguishes the running name Lurot from the German title of his work and retains Weber Algebra as a citation. Italics alone do not establish foreign-language status: they have other mathematical uses. The rule therefore requires semantically identified bibliographic spans, not blanket protection of italic text. The Cyrillic edition remains a projection of the Latin edition, not an independent translation witness.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Latinsky tekst razlikuje prisposobljene imena od citacij. Sravnjenje ne jest proverka vsego kiriličnogo izdanja.

Textual comparison: The Latin text distinguishes adapted names from citations. This comparison is not verification of the entire Cyrillic reader.

Upozorenje o neopreděljenom kvocientu

The warning about an undefined quotient

Razlog: Tuto izložiteljsko rěšenje čuva upozorenje, že racionalny kvocient po jednočasnoj substituciji dvoh prěměnnyh može stati neopreděljenym. Rabota 6, §2, pokazyvaje priměr, kde čislitelj i imenitelj oba izčezajut pri \(x_3=x_4=0\). Zapis \(0/0\) označaje nedopustimu podělu, ne novu čislovu cěnnost funkcije. Razlog arhiva jest čuvanje ograničenja dokaza: zaključanje za jednu sukcesivnu substituciju ne može bez dodatnogo opravdanja važiti za dvě zajedno. Takova rečenica ne jest ukrasna primětka, ktorej možno dati kračši nejasny opis. Zapis neopreděljenym jest padežna forma iz konkretnoj rečenice, ne osnovna slovnična forma pridavnogo imena.

Reason: This expository decision preserves the warning that a rational quotient may become undefined after simultaneous substitution of two variables. Paper 6, §2, gives an example whose numerator and denominator both vanish at \(x_3=x_4=0\). The notation \(0/0\) marks an inadmissible division, not a newly assigned numerical value of the function. The recorded reason is to retain a limitation of the proof: an argument for a single successive substitution does not automatically apply to two substitutions together. The sentence is substantive, not dispensable commentary. Neopreděljenym is an inflected form from the sentence, not the adjective’s dictionary citation form.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Čislitelj i imenitelj mogut izčeznuti zajedno. Zapis \(0/0\) ne davaje funkciji cěnnost.

Textual comparison: Numerator and denominator can vanish together. The notation \(0/0\) assigns no value to the function.

Komponentne odobraženja i vyraženje invariantov

Component maps and the expression of invariants

Razlog: Konstrukcija \(R\) jest homomorfno k \(K_i\) čuva konkretne odobraženja v komponenty, potrěbne za vyraženje slěda, normy i diskriminanta. Arhiv bira internacionalno homomorfno zajedno s izričnym izraziti črez elementy; nynějšny tekst piše prěz. V rabotě 31, §6, komponenty imajut vid \(K_i e_i\), kde \(K_i\) leži v obhvatnom polju \(Q\). Homomorfizm zato ne jest samo neoprěděljena svez dvoh objektov. Ne možno bez daljšego uslovja zaměniti homomorfno slovom izomorfno: tekst čini tuty prěhod samo v osobnom slučaju, kogda izvorno prsten samo jest polje. Tuto jest izložiteljsko rěšenje o smyslu odobraženja, ne novy slovničny korenj.

Reason: The construction \(R\) jest homomorfno k \(K_i\) retains the concrete component maps needed to express trace, norm and discriminant. The archive selects international homomorfno with the explicit phrase izraziti črez elementy; the current text uses prěz. In Paper 31, §6, the components have the form \(K_i e_i\), with \(K_i\) contained in the overfield \(Q\). A homomorphism is therefore not merely an unspecified association of objects. Homomorphic cannot be changed to isomorphic without further conditions: the text makes that transition in the special case where the original ring is itself a field. This is an expository decision about the map’s meaning, not a newly coined stem.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Komponentne odobraženja dajut izraz slěda, normy i diskriminanta. Izomorfizm potrěbuje osobny slučaj polja.

Textual comparison: Component maps give expressions for trace, norm and discriminant. Isomorphism uses the special field case.

Izomorfija ne znači vključanje

Isomorphism does not assert inclusion

Razlog: Ograničenje samo kako ekvivalentno polje, a ne kako polje už ležeče v \(Q\), čuva razliku medžu izomorfijeju i vključanjem. To jest cěly matematičny razlog zachovanogo izbora. Rabota 31, §6, davaje izomorfne obrazy \(K_i\) v jednom Galoisovom polju \(Q\), ale izvorno polje ne prědpokladaje už tamo směstjenym. Slova samo i a ne ne sut stilističny dodatok: ona ograđajut tvrđenje. V tutom kontekstu ekvivalentno objasnjaje se pomoču navedenyh izomorfizmov; ne trěba go čitati kako libovoljnu neoprěděljenu ekvivalenciju. Pri prěnosu v logiku razlikovanje abstraktnogo objekta i njegove realizacije mora ostati jednako eksplicitno.

Reason: The qualification ’only as an equivalent field, not as a field already lying in \(Q\)’ preserves the difference between isomorphism and inclusion. That is the full mathematical reason for the recorded choice. Paper 31, §6, supplies isomorphic images \(K_i\) in one Galois overfield \(Q\), but does not assume the original field is already situated there. Only and not are not stylistic additions: they delimit the claim. Equivalent is explained here by the stated isomorphisms, not an unspecified equivalence relation. Transfer to logic must preserve the distinction between an abstract object and its realization just as explicitly.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Tekst ne prědpokladaje, že izvorno polje samo už leži v \(Q\).

Textual comparison: The text does not assume the original field is already contained in \(Q\).

Jednako nazvanje pri upučenju v slědujuči paragraf

Consistent naming across a forward reference

Razlog: Zapis čuva svez konca §5 s naslovom i dokazom §6, ne novu različnu matematičnu rěč. §5 obeščaje prostějšu konstrukciju pomoču racionalnoj bazy; §6 pod tym samym nazvanjem davaje definiciju i konstrukciju. Pri rěšenju užito jest kontinuitet upučenja: zaměna sinonimom samo v jednom iz tih měst mogla by stvoriti vtis novego objekta. Arhivny znak prěd čislom 6 ne jest zachovany dostatočno za ego samostojnu rekonstrukciju, ale směr upučenja jest čitliv iz sosednyh odstavkov i naslova. To jest izložiteljska konvencija, ktora potrěbuje prověrjenje oboju koncev upučenja, ne novu slovničnu jedinicu.

Reason: The record preserves the connection between the end of §5 and the heading and argument of §6, rather than introducing a distinct mathematical word. Section 5 promises a simpler construction using a rational basis; §6 supplies its definition and construction under that same name. Referential continuity governs the choice: replacing the term with a synonym at only one endpoint could suggest a new object. The archival character before the numeral 6 is not sufficiently preserved to reconstruct on its own, but the destination is readable from the adjoining paragraphs and heading. This is an expository convention requiring both ends of the reference to be checked, not a new lexical item.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Upučenje i naslov upotrěbljajut isto nazvanje za objavljenu konstrukciju.

Textual comparison: The forward reference and heading use the same name for the promised construction.

Dva objekty v jednom naslovu

Two objects in one heading

Razlog: Naslov čuva dvě različne česti zadanja: redukciju modula \((ss'u)^4\) i opis sistema od \(s\). §17 raboty 2 izrično razděljaje dokaz na A) reducibilnost modula i B) ostavanje jedinoj formy \(s\) v sistemu pri vyšem modulu. V arhivu od \(s\) označeno jest kako vrěmenna prozirna konstrukcija, čekajuča jezyčno ocěnjenje; ne trěba iz povtorjenja vyvoditi, že to ocěnjenje nastupilo. Četvrta stepenj, apostrof i razlikovanje \(s\) od njegovogo sistema morajut ostati točne. To jest rěšenje o strukturi naslova i upravljanju, ne samostojno novo značenje slova redukcija.

Reason: The heading preserves two parts of the task: reduction of the modulus \((ss'u)^4\) and description of the system of \(s\). Paper 2, §17, explicitly divides the argument into A) reducibility of the modulus and B) the system’s reduction to the single form \(s\) under the higher modulus. The archive labels od \(s\) a provisional transparent construction pending linguistic review; recurrence does not show that such review occurred. The fourth power, prime mark and distinction between \(s\) and its system must remain exact. This is a decision about heading structure and grammatical government, not a separate new sense of redukcija.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Redukcija modula i opis sistema ostavajut različne česti zadanja.

Textual comparison: Reduction of the modulus and description of the system remain distinct parts of the task.

Směr upučenja i čislo operacij

Reference direction and number of operations

Razlog: Věta o neposrědnom slědovanju redukcij čuva zavisimost od §21 i točno jednu kontrakciju. Arhiv pozvoljaje novy poredok slov, ale ne odstranjenje tih dvoh podatkov. Staru konstrukciju črez jednokratno svijanje nynějša pasaža §22 prědaje kak prěz jednokratnu kontrakciju; ide o upučenje na konkretnu operaciju, ne o volnu zaměnu vsih slov s podobnym běžnym značenjem. Neposrědno ili prosto opisuje kratkost vyvoda iz nazvanyh rezultatov; ne znači, že rezultat ne potrěbuje osnovy. Tuto jest izložiteljsko rěšenje o zavisimosti dokaza, s čislom operacij i iztočnikom vyvoda kako nepoměnnymi čestjami smysla.

Reason: The sentence about reductions following directly preserves their dependence on §21 and the use of exactly one contraction. The archive allows a modernized word order, but not removal of those two facts. The older črez jednokratno svijanje appears in the current §22 passage as prěz jednokratnu kontrakciju: this identifies a particular operation, not a licence to interchange all words with similar everyday meanings. Directly or simply describes the short derivation from named results; it does not mean that the result needs no basis. This is an expository decision about proof dependence, with the operation count and cited source of the inference preserved.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Upučenje na §21 i jedna kontrakcija nosut smysl vyvoda.

Textual comparison: The reference to §21 and a single contraction carry the inference’s meaning.

Konstrukcija i historičny metod

Construction and historical method

Razlog: Rekursivna konstrukcija specialnyh razvitij v rędy jest metodna fraza, ne nazvanje novogo matematičnogo objekta. Uvod raboty 2 razlikuje točnu formulaciju redukcijnyh teoremov od računnogo sredstva za jih priměnjenje. Arhiv trěbuje čuvati postepenny, rekursivny postupok bez anahronističnogo prěimenovanja v sovrěmenny algoritm. To ne zabranjaje izjasniti način računa: §2 pokazuje, kako koeficienty slědujut iz sistema uravnenij. No pojem rekursivno sam ne dodava čislenu složenost, formalny računny model ili ocenjenje potrebnyh resursov. Fraza jest zato predstavjena medžu izložiteljskymi odlukami, s terminologičnymi svezami k razloženju i polaram, a ne kako odrěčena ili pozabylena slovnička stavka.

Reason: Rekursivna konstrukcija specialnyh razvitij v rędy is a methodological phrase, not the name of a new mathematical object. Paper 2’s introduction distinguishes precise formulation of reduction theorems from the computational means of applying them. The archive requires retaining a stepwise recurrent procedure without anachronistically renaming it as a modern algorithm. This does not prohibit explaining the calculation: §2 shows how coefficients follow from a system of equations. But recursive alone adds no complexity bound, formal model of computation, or resource estimate. The phrase is therefore presented among expository decisions, with links to expansion and polar terminology, rather than omitted from the dictionary.
