Sravnjenje s tekstom: Uvodna metodna fraza imaje konkretno prodolženje v sistemu za koeficienty. Jeje dokumentovanje ne trěbuje pripisati historičnomu tekstu sovrěmennu teoriju algoritmov.

Textual comparison: The introductory methodological phrase has a concrete continuation in the coefficient system. Documenting it does not require attributing a modern theory of algorithms to the historical text.

Ravnost idealov iz vseh lokalizacij

Equality of ideals from all localizations

Razlog: To jest cělo tvrdženje o ravnosti idealov, ne novo leksično zaglavje. Arhiv govori o dopolnjenju po pečatnom svědku; toj opis ostavaje historijna informacija, ne nova vizualna prověrka skana. Nynějšny konec §8, točka 3 raboty 31 izrično trěbuje sběganje razširjenyh idealov v vsih tam opreděljenyh lokalizacijah. Dokaz se opira na iste proste idealy i iste eksponenty. Vsi ne možno oslabiti na jednu izbranu lokalizaciju; identični ne znači samo izomorfni. Izraz kolca kvocientov tu označaje prsteny s dozvoljenymi imenovateljami, ne prsteny ostatkovyh klasov. Tute kvantifikacija i tip konstrukcije sut glavno obrazloženje prěvoda.

Reason: This is a complete assertion about equality of ideals, not a newly coined headword. The archive reports expansion from a printed witness; that remains historical information, not a fresh visual check of the scan. The current end of Paper 31, §8, item 3 expressly requires equality of the extended ideals in all the localizations defined there. Its argument uses the same prime ideals with the same exponents. All cannot be weakened to one selected localization, and identical does not merely mean isomorphic. Kolca kvocientov here denotes rings with permitted denominators, not residue-class rings. Quantifier scope and construction type are the central translation choices.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Vsi lokalizacije i ravnost idealov ne možno zaměniti jednoj lokalizacijeju i izomorfijeju.

Textual comparison: All localizations and equality of ideals cannot be replaced by one localization and isomorphism.

Rimske oznaky VI i VII i svez teoremov

Roman VI and VII and the connection between theorems

Razlog: Izbor v tom zapisu ohranjaje rimsky VI i VII kako iste oznaky v oběh pismach. To jest pravilo identifikacije, ne tvorjenje dvoh novyh terminov. V rabotě 17 teorem VI veže jednakost vida modulov s izomorfijeju grup ostatkov; prěd teoremom VII tekst izrično kaže, že teorem V bude prěformulovany prěz VI. Zato oznaky nesut dokaznu zavisnost i ne smějut byti zaměnjene podobnymi kiriličnymi bukvami. Arhiv popisuje kiriličnu ochranu; nynějšne sravnjenje potvrđuje latinične lokatory i svez, ne novu polnu prověrku kiriličnogo čitatelja.

Reason: The choice preserves Roman VI and VII as the same identifiers in both scripts. It is an identification rule, not the creation of two new terms. In Paper 17, Theorem VI connects sameness of type of modules with isomorphism of residue groups; immediately before Theorem VII, the text expressly says that Theorem V is being reformulated through VI. The labels therefore carry a proof dependency and must not be replaced by visually similar Cyrillic letters. The archive describes Cyrillic protection; the present comparison confirms the Latin locations and relation, not a fresh full check of the Cyrillic reader.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Teorem VI služi prěformulaciji V v VII; rimsky znak jest identifikator.

Textual comparison: Theorem VI supports reformulating V as VII; the Roman numeral is an identifier.

Adaptovane imena i točna avtorska identičnost

Adapted names and exact author identification

Razlog: Lurot, Kastelnuovo i Enrikes sut adaptovane osnovy vlastnyh imen, s genitivom pri teorem. Arhiv objašnjaje Lurot kako način izběgnuti mehanično prěpisano th v kirilici. To jest redakcijna pravopisna odluka, ne dokaz, že izvorno ime Lüroth trěba izbrisati iz bibliografije. V rabotě 11 Lurot i Kastelnuovo podpirajut pozitivne tvrdženja o minimalnoj bazi, dokole Enrikes jest citovany za protivny priměr pri vyšem čislu neizvěstnyh. Tri imena v arhivnom spisku zato ne označajut tri sinonimne teoremy. Bibliografija mora dati točnu identičnost citovanyh avtorov; jezyčna adaptacija v prozě ne směje odstraniti avtorsky prinos.

Reason: Lurot, Kastelnuovo, and Enrikes are adapted proper-name stems, used in the genitive after teorem. The archive explains Lurot as avoiding a mechanical th rendering in Cyrillic. This is an editorial spelling choice, not a reason to erase Lüroth’s original name from bibliographic identification. In Paper 11, Lüroth and Castelnuovo support positive minimal-basis assertions, while Enriques is cited for a counterexample with more indeterminates. The three names in the archival list therefore do not designate three synonymous theorems. Bibliography must identify the actual cited authors; linguistic adaptation in prose must not remove their contributions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Imena v jednom spisku ne činęt citovane rezultaty zaměnjivymi.

Textual comparison: Names in one list do not make their cited results interchangeable.

Ostrowski: ime v prozě i bibliografiji

Ostrowski: the name in prose and bibliography

Razlog: Zapis o teoremu Ostrowski ohranjaje historijno latinično napisanje i posebno opisuje kirilično Островски v prozě. Bibliografsky citat i obyčna rečenica ne morajut iměti jednaku grafičnu obrabotku; važno jest, aby oboje vodilo k istomu avtoru. Rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy tu sami ohranjajut latinično ime, zato ne davajut nezavisny dokaz za kiriličnu normu. V rabotě 20 jde o zachovanje absolutnoj nerazložimosti polinoma modulo vsi kromě konečno mnogyh prostyh idealov. Ne trěba to zaměniti drugym poznatym teoremom togo avtora. Nynějšny latiničny korpus potvrđuje ime i konkretny citat; polna kirilična prověrka tu ne jest tvrdžena.

Reason: The Ostrowski record preserves the historical Latin spelling and separately describes Cyrillic Островски in running prose. A bibliographic quotation and an ordinary sentence need not receive identical script treatment, but both must identify the same author. The Russian and Ukrainian records here themselves retain the Latin name, so they supply no independent authority for Cyrillic spelling. In Paper 20 the result concerns preservation of absolute polynomial irreducibility modulo all but finitely many prime ideals. It must not be replaced by another well-known theorem of the same author. The current Latin text confirms the name and specific citation; no exhaustive Cyrillic check is claimed here.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Izključene sut najvyše konečno mnoge proste idealy; citat identifikuje rezultat.

Textual comparison: At most finitely many prime ideals are excluded; the citation identifies the result.

Odkaz na prvi slučaj teorema X

Reference to the first case of Theorem X

Razlog: Teorema X v tom zapisu jest odkaz, ne novy pojem. Arhiv govori, že pri prěpisu v kirilicu byla opravjena pokvarjena oznaka; samo zabilěženje ne ustanavjaje, že byla provedena ljudska redakcija, ni ne vosstanavjaje nezachovane bukvy zapisane kako ?? v razlogu. Točno rimsky X mora ostati X. V nynějšnom §12 raboty 17 primětka ukazuje na prvi slučaj teorema X; sam teorem razlikuje dvě alternativy a trěbuje beskonečno mnogo konstant v oblasti racionalnosti. Prověrka odkaza zato obhvača cělj, slučaj i prědpoloženja, ne samo podobnost znaka.

Reason: Teorema X is a reference in this record, not a new concept. The archive reports correction of a damaged identifier during Cyrillic conversion; that report neither establishes a human editor nor recovers the lost lettering represented as ?? in the rationale. The exact Roman X must remain X. In the current Paper 17, §12, the footnote points to the first case of Theorem X; the theorem distinguishes two alternatives and assumes infinitely many constants in the rationality domain. Checking the reference therefore includes its destination, case, and hypotheses, not merely the shape of the numeral.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odkaz trěbuje pravilny rimsky znak i pravilny slučaj teorema.

Textual comparison: The reference requires the right Roman numeral and the right case of the theorem.

Različne tvrdženja pod oznakami XI i XII

Distinct assertions labelled XI and XII

Razlog: XI i XII sut stabilne rimske identifikatory, ohranjene takože v kiriličnom tekstu po arhivnom pravilu. Prěvod okolnogo naziva ne měnjaje kodovne znaky oznaky. V rabotě 17 XI veže red konečnoj grupy ostatkov s čislom linearno nezavisnyh integralov diferencialnogo sistema; XII govori o diferencialnyh izrazah, ktore prěvodęt integraly medžu modulami jednakogo vida. Čisla zato razlikujut dve tvrdženja i jih odkazy, ne dvě formy istogo termina. Nynějšne pasaže potvrđajut tu razliku. Iz pravilno prikazanoj latiničnoj oznaky same ne možno zaključiti, že vsegda byla pravilna i kirilična projekcija.

Reason: XI and XII are stable Roman identifiers, retained in Cyrillic text under the recorded rule. Translating the surrounding label does not change the identifier’s characters. In Paper 17, XI relates the order of a finite residue group to the number of linearly independent integrals of a differential system; XII concerns differential expressions carrying integrals between modules of the same type. The numbers therefore distinguish two assertions and their references, not two forms of one term. Current passages confirm that distinction. A correctly displayed Latin identifier alone does not prove that the Cyrillic projection has always been correct.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dve oznaky razlikujut čislovy rezultat i odnos medžu sistemami integralov.

Textual comparison: The identifiers distinguish a counting result from a relation between systems of integrals.

Vosstanovjena iztočna věta o determinantu

Restored source sentence about a determinant

Razlog: Razširjenje po pečatnom skanu jest redakcijna primětka o vosstanovjenju iztočnogo teksta, ne matematično slovo avtora. Arhiv svęzuje ju s větoju, že determinant matrice proměny bazy jest jedinica; ta věta nedostavala v tadašnjom prěpisanom odlomku. Nynějšny §4 raboty 31 ju sodržuje i upotrěbjaje obratnu matricu v relaciji ekvivalentnosti. Jedinica tu jest silnějše uslovje než nenulovy determinant nad oblastju cělosti: ona dava obratnu matricu nad toj samoj oblastju. Novo sravnjenje potvrđuje prisutnost věty, ne povtorjaje arhivnu prověrku pečatnogo svědka. Takovo vosstanovjenje trěba dokazati sravnjenjem iztočnikov; ne směje se vydavati za avtorskogo novogo termina ili za tihu matematičnu popravu.

Reason: Razširjenje po pečatnom skanu is an editorial note about restoring source text, not the author’s mathematical vocabulary. The archive links it to the sentence saying that the determinant of a basis-change matrix is a unit, missing from the then-current transcription excerpt. Paper 31, §4 now contains that sentence and uses the inverse matrix in the equivalence relation. Unit is stronger here than nonzero determinant over an integral domain: it permits inversion over that same domain. The new comparison confirms presence of the sentence, not a repeat of the archival printed-witness check. Such restoration needs source comparison; it must not be presented as a newly coined authorial term or a silent mathematical correction.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Determinant-jedinica opravdava upotrěbu obratnoj matrice nad istoju oblastju.

Textual comparison: A unit determinant licenses use of the inverse matrix over the same base.

Bibliografičny titul i lokalna oznaka stranic

Bibliographic title and localized page label

Razlog: Sitz. Ber. d. Preuß. Akad. d. Wiss. jest skračeny titul periodičnogo izdanja, ne matematičny termin za prěvod. Zapisany izbor čuva titul i bibliografične čisla, ale lokalizuje S. kako str.; ruska i ukrajinska verzija imajut c. za stranicu. Nynějšny početok raboty 32 potvrđuje 1927, str. 221–228 i sovavtorstvo R. Brauera. Čitatelj tako može najdti original, a obyčna oznaka stranic ne trěbuje znanja němčiny. Redakcijne razsmotrenje jedinstvenogo bibliografičnogo stila ne dava prava odstraniti ime sovavtora ili zameniti iztočnik novym izdanjem bez objašnjenja.

Reason: Sitz. Ber. d. Preuß. Akad. d. Wiss. is an abbreviated periodical title, not mathematical vocabulary to translate. The recorded choice preserves the title and bibliographic numbers but localizes S. as str.; the Russian and Ukrainian versions use their page abbreviation c. The current opening of paper 32 confirms 1927, pp. 221–228 and coauthorship with R. Brauer. A reader can therefore locate the original without needing German to understand the ordinary page label. Review for a consistent bibliographic style does not authorize removing a coauthor or substituting a later edition without explanation.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Lokalizovana oznaka stranic čuva identitet publikacije i sovavtorstvo.

Textual comparison: The localized page label preserves the publication’s identity and coauthorship.

Avtorske ograničenje povtorjanih redukcij

Authorial restriction on repeating routine reductions

Razlog: Dalej ne budut spominjane čuva avtorskym glasom oznajmenje o sposobu izloženja. V §25 raboty 2 ide točno o redukcijah, ktore neposrědnje nastavajut kontrakcijeju s reducentami ili razkladnymi formami; potrěbne daljše konstrukcije slědujut dalje. Zapisany razlog jest modernizacija prozy bez proměny toj ograničenoj odluki avtorky. Fraza ne jest instrukcija prěvoditelju, da može izpustiti težke dokazy, formulne kroky ili dokumentaciju svoji izborov. Njen obseg mora ostati svezany s navedenym razredom rutinnyh redukcij. Zato ona pripada pravilam izloženja v slovniku izborov, ne spisku novyh matematičnyh imenikov.

Reason: Dalej ne budut spominjane preserves an announcement, in the author’s voice, about the exposition. Paper 2, §25 refers specifically to reductions obtained directly by contraction with reducers or decomposable forms; further constructions still follow. The recorded reason is to modernize the prose without changing this limited authorial decision. The sentence is not an instruction permitting a translator to omit difficult proofs, formula steps or documentation of translation choices. Its scope must remain attached to the specified class of routine reductions. It therefore belongs among expository choices, not in a list of newly coined mathematical nouns.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odluka ne ponavljati rutinne redukcije ne jest dozvoljenje izpustiti drugy tekst.

Textual comparison: The decision not to repeat routine reductions is not permission to omit other text.

Povtorjena formula i iztočna věrnost

Repeated formula and source fidelity

Razlog: Povtor \(H_j^2\), \(H_j^2\) jest odluka o věrnosti prěpisanja, ne nova matematična nazva. Arhiv govori, že redukcijna věta povtorjaje formulu i že povtor byl ohranjen do sravnjenja s pečatnym iztočnikom. Nynějšny §16 raboty 2 ješče ima oba jednaka izrazy. To potvrđuje sostojanje teksta, ne to, že avtorka naměrno hotěla povtor. Bez iztočnogo dokazanja nije opravdano proizvoljno změniti indeks ili stepen. Ako pečatny original sam ima pogrěšku, diplomatski tekst ju čuva, a predložena poprava pripada oddělnomu kritičnomu izdanju.

Reason: The repetition \(H_j^2\), \(H_j^2\) records a transcription-fidelity decision, not a new mathematical name. The archive says that the reduction sentence repeats the formula and that the repetition was retained pending comparison with print. Current paper 2, §16 still has both identical expressions. This establishes the text’s state, not that the author intended the repetition. An index or exponent must not be changed arbitrarily without source evidence. If the printed original itself contains an error, a diplomatic text preserves it and a proposed emendation belongs in a separate critical edition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dva jednaka izrazy ostavajut v tekstu; pravilnost povtora ne jest tym dokazana.

Textual comparison: Both identical expressions remain in the text; this does not establish that the repetition is correct.

Pomoćne polinomy: prěvod i kritična poprava

Auxiliary polynomials: translation and critical correction

Razlog: Prěvod \(A\) i \(B\) jest zabeležena kritična poprava němčinskogo zapisa \(A\) und psi. Razlog jest matematičny: v identičnosti \(K=A\varphi+B\psi\) iskane pomoćne polinomy sut \(A\) i \(B\), a \(\varphi\) i \(\psi\) sut dane. Nynějšna rabota 45 ima \(A\) i \(B\). Ta soglasnost s formuloju objasnjaje motivaciju, ale ne dokazuje, čto točno stoji v pečatnom originalu; arhiv odkazuje na tadašnji prěpis i stranovy tekst. Izbor zato ne možno skryti pod nazvoju obyčnogo prěvoda. Diplomatska i popravjena verzija morajut jasno razlikovati iztočno čitanje i redakcijnu intervenciju.

Reason: The rendering \(A\) and \(B\) is a recorded critical correction of German wording reported as \(A\) und psi. Its reason is mathematical: in \(K=A\varphi+B\psi\), the auxiliary polynomials sought are \(A\) and \(B\), whereas \(\varphi\) and \(\psi\) are given. Current paper 45 has \(A\) and \(B\). Agreement with the formula explains the motivation but does not establish what the printed original says; the archive refers to its then-staged transcription and page text. This choice must not be hidden as ordinary translation. Diplomatic and corrected versions must distinguish the source reading from the editorial intervention.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prěvod \(A\) i \(B\) soglašaje se s identičnostju, ale predstavlja zabeleženu intervenciju.

Textual comparison: The wording \(A\) and \(B\) agrees with the identity but represents a recorded intervention.

Simbolične formy s faktorom H

Symbolic forms with factor H

Razlog: Arhivno theta-H / f-H jest kratky zapis simboličnyh form, ne para novyh slov. Nynějšne pasaže pišut \(\theta\cdot H\) i \(f\cdot H\) v kontekstu jednokratnoj kontrakcije. V čitateljskom prědstavjenju zato pišemo grčsku bukvu i točku množenja, a ne puščajemo, da arhivny defis vypada kako znak odimanja. To jest objasnjeno čitanje matematičnoj notacije; izvorna arhivna grafija ostaje dostupna v zapisu. Razlog prěvoda čuva odkaz na simboličny sistem, vměsto zaměniti go neoprědělennym slovnym opisom.

Reason: Archived theta-H / f-H is shorthand for symbolic forms, not a pair of new words. The current passages write \(\theta\cdot H\) and \(f\cdot H\) in the context of onefold contraction. The reading form therefore uses the Greek letter and multiplication dot rather than allowing the archival hyphen to look like subtraction. This is an explained reading of mathematical notation; the original archival spelling remains available in the record. The translation rationale preserves the reference to the symbolic system instead of replacing it with an indefinite verbal description.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Arhivny defis ne čita se kako minus.

Textual comparison: The archival hyphen is not read as a minus sign.

Čuvanje imena Sistem III

Preserving the name System III

Razlog: Sistem III jest strukturno ime v rabotě, povtorjeno v několiko paragrafah. Prevod imenika ne opravdava zaměnu rimskogo III arabskym 3, ni kiriličnymi bukvami, ktore slično izgledajut. Zaglavje §14 ukazuje, že vnutri Sistema III obgovarjajut se formy devetogo poreda; III zato ne jest poredok formy. Zaključny pregled pripisuje tomu sistemu 117 form. Razlog jezyčnogo izbora jest kontinuitet odkazov, a ne tvorjenje nove matematične klasifikacije.

Reason: Sistem III is a structural name recurring across several sections. Translating the noun does not justify replacing Roman III by Arabic 3 or by similar-looking Cyrillic letters. The heading of section 14 discusses forms of order nine within System III, so III is not the order of a form. The closing synopsis assigns the system 117 forms. The reason for the language choice is continuity of references, not the creation of a new mathematical classification.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rimski numer identifikuje sistem, a ne stepen ili poredok formy.

Textual comparison: The Roman numeral identifies the system, not the degree or order of a form.

Navod k čitanju tabely

An instruction for reading the table

Razlog: Provodimo tabelarno govori čitatelju, kako bude izložena konstrukcija form jednakogo poreda. To jest izbor obyčnogo dokaznogo registra, ne novy algebraičny termin. Imenno tabelarno svazuje rečenicu s nadslědujučimi strukturnymi podatkami; izpustiti jeho značilo by oslabiti navod dlja čitanja. Prva osoba množstvena prěnosi golos avtorskogo izloženja, ne tvrdženje, že prevoditelj ili čitatelj izvršil naučno izslědovanje. Polna tabela mora ostati čitljiva zajedno s rečenicoju.

Reason: Provodimo tabelarno tells the reader how the construction of forms of equal order will be presented. This is ordinary expository language, not a new algebraic term. Tabelarno specifically connects the sentence with the structured material that follows; omitting it would weaken the reading instruction. The first-person plural conveys the voice of the exposition, not a claim that the translator or reader conducted the research. The complete table must remain readable together with the sentence.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Navod k tabeli jest čest avtorskogo izloženja.

Textual comparison: The instruction referring to the table is part of the author’s exposition.

Česti časopisa v bibliografiji

Journal parts in bibliographic references

Razlog: Čest I i čest II označajut česti izdanja časopisa, ne odděly dokazov. Vybrano kratko čest čuvaje bibliografičnu informaciju vměstě s tomom, rokom i stranicami. Zaměna s glava ili s tom mogla by poslati čitatelja k drugomu městu. Ruske i ukrajinske sravnjenja podpirajut smysl česti; iz njih samyh ne slěduje, že vybrana medžuslovjanska forma jest jedinym možnym izrazom. V nynějšnom spisku komunikacij čest I i čest II ostajut čitljivi, a originalne čisla ne sut lokalizovane.

Reason: Čest I and čest II identify parts of the journal publication, not divisions of an argument. The short word čest preserves the bibliographic distinction alongside the volume, year, and pages. Replacing it with chapter or volume could direct readers to the wrong place. The Russian and Ukrainian comparisons support the part sense, not the claim that the chosen Interslavic wording is the only possible form. The current list of communications retains both part labels without altering the original numbers.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nazvy čest I i čest II ostajut bibliografičnymi lokatorami.

Textual comparison: The part labels remain bibliographic locators.

Podsistemy i rimske indekse

Subsystems and Roman subscripts

Razlog: Podsistemy jest prěvodimy imenik, ale \(s_I\), \(s_{II}\), \(s_{III}\) i \(s_{IV}\) sut stabilne matematične nazvy. Rimske indekse razlučajut konstrukcije prěz različne kontrakcije; ne sut čisla stepena, ktore možno proizvoljno prepismovati. Zato v kiriličnom čitanju mora měnjati se okolna proza, ne ty identifikatory. Arhiv izrično čuvaje rimske labely. To jest pravilo notacije povezano s terminom, ne dodatny slovnikovy sinonim.

Reason: Podsistemy is a translatable noun, but \(s_I\), \(s_{II}\), \(s_{III}\), and \(s_{IV}\) are stable mathematical names. Their Roman subscripts distinguish different contraction constructions; they are not degree numerals to be freely respelled. A Cyrillic reading must therefore change the surrounding prose, not those identifiers. The record explicitly protects the Roman labels. This is a notation rule associated with the term, not another lexical synonym.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Indekse razlikujut konkretne konstrukcije.

Textual comparison: The subscripts distinguish particular constructions.

Učestvovanje v kontrakciji

Participation in a contraction

Razlog: Vhodi v svijanje jest glagolna konstrukcija za učestvovanje formy v konkretnoj invariantnoj operaciji. Arhiv ne sozdava novy tehničny glagol; obyčno vhodi povezuje subjekt s nazvoju operacije. Nynějšne pasaže pišut vhodi v kontrakciju. Taka zaměna imenika može uskladniti terminologiju, ale ne smi izbrisati uslovje, že forma nastupaje samo v produktah ili stepenjah. Arhivno tvrđenje o širokoj razumělivosti jest motivacija izbora, ne rezultat čitatelskogo testa.

Reason: Vhodi v svijanje is a verbal construction for a form’s participation in a particular invariant-theoretic operation. The record avoids coining a new technical verb: ordinary vhodi connects the subject with the operation’s name. The current passages use vhodi v kontrakciju. Changing the noun can align terminology, but must not erase restrictions to products or powers. The archival claim of broad intelligibility is a motivation, not a reader-test result.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Glagolna konstrukcija ne zaměnjaje uslovja operacije.

Textual comparison: The verbal construction does not replace the operation’s conditions.

Negacija v opisu kontrakcije

Negation in a contraction statement

Razlog: Ne vhodi v svijanje jest negativna forma toj samej konstrukcije. Negacija odnosi se k učestvovanju v imenovanoj kontrakciji, ne k obstavanju formy ili k tomu, že ona jest nula. Pasaže razlikujut nevhodenje v obče od nevhodenja v produktah i od razgledanja kako kovarianta ili kontravarianta. Zato kopirovanje jednogo kratkogo izraza bez njegovyh ograničenij moglo by izměniti dokaz. Vhodi i vhodet dodatno zahtěvajut soglasovanje s jedinym ili množestvenym subjektom, vključajuči simbolične izrazy.

Reason: Ne vhodi v svijanje negates the same construction. It negates participation in the named contraction, not the form’s existence or its being nonzero. The passages distinguish exclusion altogether from exclusion in products, and distinguish treatment as a covariant or contravariant. Copying the short expression without those qualifications could change the proof. Vhodi and vhodet also require agreement with a singular or plural subject, including symbolic expressions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Subjekt, partner i ograničenje morajut ostati jasne.

Textual comparison: Subject, partner, and qualification must remain clear.

Negacija ograničena na stepenje

Negation restricted to powers

Razlog: V stepenjah ne vhodi v svijanje prěměšča ograničenje k početku rečenice, aby jego oblast byla vidima. Ne znači to, že forma nikogda ne može učestvovati v kontrakciji. Nynějšna pasaža o \(s\) razlučaje potencije i produkty s kontragredientnymi formami, i iz toga izvodi, ktore produkty ješče trěba razgleděti. Slovnik zato mora čuvati uslovje o stepenjah i imenovane partnery kontrakcije. Slědovanje njemeckomu poredku slov ne jest važnějše než ta jasna oblast negacije.

Reason: V stepenjah ne vhodi v svijanje moves the qualification to the beginning so its scope is visible. It does not mean the form can never enter a contraction. The current passage about \(s\) distinguishes powers from products with contragredient forms, then determines which products remain to be considered. The dictionary must preserve the restriction to powers and the named contraction partners. Clear negation scope matters more than reproducing German word order.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Ograničenje na potencije jest čest tvrdženja.

Textual comparison: The restriction to powers is part of the assertion.

Tvrdženje i dva pismena oblika

Tvrdženje across the two scripts

Razlog: Tvrdženje jest izbor jezyčnoj i pismennej formy za statement, ne novy termin Noether. Arhiv razlučaje ranje tvrđenje s đ od vybranej formy s dž i svazuje izbor s pravilnym prěhodom v kirilicu. Jeho sravniteljne ruske i ukrajinske slova ne sut citati iz originala. Nynějšny latinski tekst ima tvrdženje v običnoj dokaznoj proze. Tehnično uspešno prěpisovanje samo po sobě ne dokazuje pravilnost jezyčnogo izbora; ono objasnjaje jedinu zabilježenu pričinu normalizacije.

Reason: Tvrdženje is a linguistic and script choice for statement, not a new Noether term. The archive distinguishes earlier tvrđenje with đ from the selected dž form and connects the choice with consistent Cyrillic conversion. Its Russian and Ukrainian comparisons are not quotations from the original. Current Latin text uses tvrdženje in ordinary proof prose. Successful script conversion does not by itself establish linguistic correctness; it explains one recorded reason for normalization.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nynějšna latinska forma ne jest njemecky izvorni termin.

Textual comparison: The current Latin form is not a German source term.

Nezavisnost od vybranoj klasi

Independence from the chosen class

Razlog: Ne zavisi od klasa položenogo v osnovu jest tvrdženje o nezavisnosti od vybranoj klasi, ne o statističnoj nezavisnosti. V razgledanom prstenu bez nulovyh děliteljev ono kasaje se diskriminanta ideala: vsak element determinanta ima tu nezavisnost. To ne odstraňaje drugu, osobno opisanu zavisnost od bazy do kvadrata jedinice. Fraza položenogo v osnovu sohranjaje predmet izbora; kračše ne zavisi od ničego bylo by matematično ložno.

Reason: Ne zavisi od klasa položenogo v osnovu states independence from the chosen class, not statistical independence. For the ring without zero divisors under consideration it concerns the ideal’s discriminant: each determinant entry has this independence. It does not remove the separately described change by the square of a unit under change of basis. Položenogo v osnovu preserves what is being chosen; shortening the phrase to independent of everything would be mathematically false.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nezavisnost od klasa ne odstraňaje faktor kvadrata jedinice pri zaměně bazy.

Textual comparison: Independence from the class does not remove the square-unit factor under a basis change.

Odkaz na ranějše redukcije

Referring to earlier reductions

Razlog: S učtenjem redukcij togo paragrafa jest spojna fraza, ktora upominaje raněje opravdane redukcije v tym samym oddělu. Aktualny tekst ima s uvažanjem redukcij tutogo paragrafa. V oběh formah zavisnost vyvoda mora ostati vidljiva: formuly za red form \((\theta gu)^2\) dobyvajut se iz (27) s tymi redukcijami, ne iz samoj formuly bez dodatnyh krokov. Izbor modernogo porjadka slov jest stilističny; ne daje dozvoljenje izpustiti referenciju ili matematiku.

Reason: S učtenjem redukcij togo paragrafa is a connective phrase referring to reductions already justified in the same section. The current text has s uvažanjem redukcij tutogo paragrafa. In both forms the dependency must remain visible: the formulas for the family \((\theta gu)^2\) follow from (27) together with those reductions, not from the formula alone without additional steps. Choosing modern word order is stylistic; it does not license omission of the reference or the mathematics.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Aktualno s uvažanjem i arhivno s učtenjem imajut istu dokaznu ulogu.

Textual comparison: Current s uvažanjem and archived s učtenjem have the same role in the deduction.

Jednočasno razgledanje form

Considering the forms together

Razlog: Pri jednovrěmennom razsmotrenju jest uslov postupka, ne samo časovy ukazatelj. V redukcijnoj primětke trěba razgledati skupaj navedene formy i njihove razklady; ignorovanje drugoj skupiny moglo by proměniti ono, čto se reducira. Aktualna fraza pri jednočasnom razgledanju jest kračša i znači to samo. Arhiv označuje izvorno formulovanje kako potrěbujuče jezyčnu prověrku. Slovnik sohranjaje tu ogradu, ale objasnjaje dokaznu ulogu bez služebnogo jezyka.

Reason: Pri jednovrěmennom razsmotrenju is a condition on the procedure, not merely a time marker. In the reduction note the listed forms and their decompositions must be considered together; ignoring the second group could change what is being reduced. The current phrase pri jednočasnom razgledanju is shorter and expresses the same relation. The archive marks the earlier phrasing as needing linguistic review. The dictionary preserves that reservation while explaining the phrase’s role in the argument.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jednočasno razgledanje spojuje navedene formy s njihovymi razkladami.

Textual comparison: Considering the forms together connects them with their decompositions.

Bibliografičny kredit za učestje

Bibliographic credit for participation

Razlog: S učestjem znači s prinosom ili učestjem imenovanoj osoby. Bibliografična rubrika obhvačaje knjigy drugih avtorov, v izdanju ktoryh Emmy Noether učestvovala: zapisy za Dedekinda i Cantora osobno imenujut vydavatelje. Fraza ne čini ju jedinoju avtoriceju tih knjig ni jedinym redaktorom. Izbor čuva točnu razliku medžu avtorstvom i učestjem. Takovy kredit dolžen ostati pri prěvodu zaglavij i pri preuređenju bibliografije.

Reason: S učestjem means with the contribution or participation of the named person. The bibliographic category includes books by other authors in whose publication Emmy Noether participated: the Dedekind and Cantor entries separately name the editors. The phrase does not make her the sole author of those books or their sole editor. The choice preserves the distinction between authorship and participation. That credit must survive translation of headings and rearrangement of the bibliography.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rubrika i konkretne kredity imenujut različne ulogy.

Textual comparison: The heading and individual credits name different roles.

Metafora cělogo i drobnogo

The integral–fractional metaphor

Razlog: Razlika med cělym i drobnym razmyvaje se sohranjaje avtorsku završnu formulaciju. V karakteristice p prvotno polje ne sodrživaje drobnyh veličin v smyslu uvedenej definicije; zato něktore dodatne uslovja otpadajut i klasa dopustimyh oblastij cělosti razširjaje se. To ne znači, že vsaka racionalna funkcija stava polinomom ili že imenovatelje možno ignorovati. Fraza ima strukturny smysl o definicijah, ne bezuslovnu algebraičnu ravnost cělogo i drobnogo.

Reason: Razlika med cělym i drobnym razmyvaje se preserves the author’s closing formulation. In characteristic p the prime field contains no fractional quantities in the sense of the definition introduced, so certain supplementary conditions disappear and the admissible class of domains of integral quantities broadens. This does not mean that every rational function becomes a polynomial or that denominators can be ignored. The phrase makes a structural observation about definitions, not an unconditional algebraic identification of integral and fractional.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prosta karakteristika měnjaje definicijne uslovja, ne izključaje vse imenovatelje.

Textual comparison: Prime characteristic changes the defining conditions; it does not eliminate every denominator.

Polna fraza vměsto skračenja

Writing the phrase out instead of abbreviating

Razlog: I podobne bylo vybrano kako polna fraza vměsto skračenja i t. d., da by avtomatično prěpisyvanje v kirilicu ne ostavilo směšany zapis. To jest tehnično motivovana pisemna konvencija, ne dokaz, že skračenje jest jezyčno nepravilno. V trěh pregledanyh aktualnyh pasažah jednake serije form však končat s i t. d. Zato historijno potrěbovanje ne možno opisati kako vsude ostvarjeno. Navedena slova upominajut prodolženje obrazca, ne dozvoljajut izpustiti novo matematično sodržanje.

Reason: I podobne was chosen as a written-out phrase instead of i t. d. to avoid mixed-script output during automatic Cyrillic conversion. This is a technically motivated writing convention, not evidence that the abbreviation is linguistically wrong. Yet the three examined current passages end the corresponding families of forms with i t. d. The historical requirement therefore cannot be described as uniformly implemented. The phrase signals continuation of a pattern; it does not authorize omission of new mathematical content.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Vse tri prověrene pasaže imajo i t. d.; polna fraza nebyla doslědno provedena.

Textual comparison: All three examined passages have i t. d.; the written-out phrase was not consistently implemented.

Poděkovanje s konkretnym kreditom

Acknowledgment with specific credit

Razlog: Zahvaljujem Hentzeltu za zaměčenja vyražaje priznanje naučnogo prinosa. Sohranjena motivacija kaže, že konstrukcija zahvaljujem zaměnila grub prěvod glagola dlga. V aktualnom odstavku Noether pripisuje Hentzeltu i konkretne pobudky k obobčenju bazovyh teorem, i daljše menše zaměčenja. To jest glas avtorice v prěvodu, ne izjava prevoditelja. Stilistična obrabotka ne směje izbrisati imenovanogo čelověka ni zameniti konkretne zaslugy obščim poděkovanjem.

Reason: Zahvaljujem Hentzeltu za zaměčenja expresses acknowledgment of a scholarly contribution. The preserved motivation says that zahvaljujem replaced a rough calque of owing. In the current paragraph Noether credits Hentzelt both with specific prompts toward generalizing the basis theorems and with further smaller observations. This is the author’s voice in translation, not a statement by the translator. Stylistic adjustment must not remove the named person or replace specific contributions with generic thanks.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Prěvod priznanja ne směje stratiti konkretne zaslugy.

Textual comparison: Translation of the acknowledgment must not lose the specific contributions.

Zaglavje s matematičnoju hipotezoju

A heading with a mathematical hypothesis

Razlog: Ponašanje slěda i diskriminanta pri direktnoj sumě klasov jest zaglavje s matematičnoju hipotezoju. Slěd elementa po odnošenju k klasu stava summoju slědov po odnošenju k komponentnym klasam; diskriminantny ideal stava produktom komponentnyh diskriminantnyh idealov. Nije pravdivo zameniti obě operacije jednim občim skladanjem. Klasy i baza, prirěđena direktnoj sumě, sut čest argumenta. Ponašanje tu znači zakon proměny invariantov, ne neformalnu analogiju.

Reason: Ponašanje slěda i diskriminanta pri direktnoj sumě klasov is a heading carrying a mathematical hypothesis. The trace relative to the class becomes the sum of traces relative to component classes; the discriminant ideal becomes the product of the component discriminant ideals. The two operations cannot be replaced by a single vague combination. The classes and the basis adapted to the direct sum belong to the argument. Behaviour here means a law governing the invariants, not an informal analogy.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Ne jedna i ta sama operacija za oba invarianta.

Textual comparison: The two invariants do not obey the same operation.

Prěnos bazy prěz izomorfizm

Transporting a basis through an isomorphism

Razlog: Baza prirěđena posrědstvom izomorfizma označaje prěnesenu bazu, ne novu libovoljno vybranu bazu. Elementy \(\beta_i\) odgovarjajut \(\alpha_i\) pod modulnym izomorfizmom; zato množenje tym samym \(\gamma\) ima iste koeficienty v oběh bazah. To daje identične matrične prsteny za te konkretno svezane bazy. Ako bazy samo nezavisno vybrati, iz takoj frazy nelzja vyvesti ravnost pojedinyh matric. Relacionna konstrukcija zato sohranjaje ključny krok dokaza.

Reason: Baza prirěđena posrědstvom izomorfizma denotes a transported basis, not a newly chosen arbitrary basis. The \(\beta_i\) correspond to the \(\alpha_i\) under a module isomorphism, so multiplication by the same \(\gamma\) has identical coefficients in both bases. This yields identical matrix rings for those specifically related bases. Independent choices of bases would not justify equality of the individual matrices. The relational phrase therefore preserves an essential step of the proof.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Istovetne koeficienty proizhodjat iz modulnogo izomorfizma.

Textual comparison: Identical coefficients result from the module isomorphism.

Odkazka na konec sekcije

A reference to the end of a section

Razlog: Srav. konec § 5 jest kratka odkazna fraza: ona posylaje čitatelja na konec odrěđenej sekcije, ne na vse jeje sodržanje. V aktualnom zapisu fraza stoji v tekstovom vstavjenju pri formuli. Bukvalny znak § čuva identitet odkazki pri prěpisu prozy v kirilicu; broj 5 ostaje neproměnjeny. To jest konvencija odkazovanja i pisanja, ne novy matematičny termin. Samo sohranjenje odkazki ne jest prověrka vsih povjazanyh formul.

Reason: Srav. konec § 5 is a compact cross-reference directing the reader to the end of a specified section, not indiscriminately to everything in it. In the current source it appears in a text insertion beside the formula. The literal section sign preserves the reference when prose is converted to Cyrillic; the number 5 is unchanged. This is a referencing and writing convention, not a new mathematical term. Preserving the reference is not in itself verification of all the formulas it connects.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odkazka ukazuje na konec sekcije 5.

Textual comparison: The reference specifies the end of section 5.

Soglasovanje pri simboličnyh subjektah

Agreement with symbolic subjects

Razlog: Vhodi i vhodet razděljajut jedinstveny i množstveny subjekt v toj konkretnoj rečenici. \(H^2L\) samo ne vhodi v kontrakciju s \(K\); dva imenovane izraza, \(H^3\) i \(H^2L\), ne vhodet s \(\theta\). Zato prisutnost dvuh glagolnyh form ne jest sama po sobě neporednost. Historijny zapis ostavil skladnju pri simboličnyh subjektah otvorenoju dlja jezyčnoj ocěny. Slovnik čuva to ograničenje; razgledanje jednoj rečenice ne ustanavjaje obče pravilo dlja vseh formulnih subjektov.

Reason: Vhodi and vhodet distinguish a singular from a plural subject in this particular sentence. \(H^2L\) alone does not enter a contraction with \(K\); the two named expressions \(H^3\) and \(H^2L\) do not enter one with \(\theta\). The presence of the two verb forms is therefore not by itself inconsistency. The historical record left agreement with symbolic subjects open to linguistic assessment. The dictionary preserves that qualification; one examined sentence does not establish a general rule for every formula used as a subject.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Rečenica razděljaje jedinstveny i množstveny subjekt.

Textual comparison: The sentence distinguishes singular and plural subjects.

Dvojno izključenje v hipoteze

A double exclusion in a hypothesis

Razlog: Različny od nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala ostavlja oba krajne ideala izvan razgledanja. V konkretnoj posledici prsten ima jedin prosty ideal medžu ostalymi idealami; odtud dobiva se prsten glavnyh idealov. Izpustjenje jediničnogo bi izměnilo obseg jedinstvenosti. To jest jasno napisana hipoteza, ne nova nazva klasa ili neobvezna slovna dodatka. Arhivny izbor naměrno povtarja formulaciju predhodnyh aksiomov, aby zavisimost byla vidliva.

Reason: Različny od nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala excludes both extreme ideals. In the particular consequence the ring has one prime ideal among the remaining ideals, from which the principal-ideal conclusion is obtained. Dropping unit would alter the scope of uniqueness. This is an explicitly written hypothesis, not a new class name or optional verbal addition. The recorded choice deliberately repeats the preceding axiomatic wording to make the dependence visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jediničny i nulovy ideal ne vhodet v obseg tvrdženja.

Textual comparison: The unit and zero ideals lie outside the statement’s scope.

Nulovy i jediničny ideal pri množenju

Zero and unit ideals in multiplication

Razlog: Idealy različne od nulovogo i jediničnogo idealov čuva množstveno čitanje i obě izključenja v tvrđenju o idealnom produktu. Predhodna lema iz jednakosti \(\mathfrak a=\mathfrak a\mathfrak b\) i nenulovosti \(\mathfrak a\) vyvodi, že \(\mathfrak b\) jest jediničny ideal; poslědujuča neravnost zato potrěbuje te granice. Frazu ne možno skratiti prosto do nenulove idealy, ibo by dopuštjala jediničny faktor. Ruskaja i ukrajinskaja sravniteljnaja forma čuvajut isto dvojno izključenje.

Reason: Idealy različne od nulovogo i jediničnogo idealov preserves the plural reading and both exclusions in the statement about ideal products. The preceding lemma deduces that \(\mathfrak b\) is the unit ideal from \(\mathfrak a=\mathfrak a\mathfrak b\) and nonzero \(\mathfrak a\); the following inequality therefore needs those boundaries. The phrase cannot be shortened simply to nonzero ideals, which would allow the unit factor. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda preserve the same double exclusion.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Izključenje jediničnogo faktora jest sučstveno.

Textual comparison: Exclusion of the unit factor is essential.

Nenulovost diskriminantnogo ideala

Nonvanishing of the discriminant ideal

Razlog: Različny od nulovogo ideala na koncu definicije govori o samom diskriminantnom idealu. On jest porodženy determinantami slědov, a nenulovost pri linearno nezavisnom izboru elementov daje nenulovost togo ideala. Slabše tvrdženje, že někoja matrica može byti nenulova, ne prědaje togo zaključka. Arhivna motivacija govori o prověrke skana; zde nově prověrena jest aktualna tekstova pasaža, ne povtorjena nezavisna prověrka skana.

Reason: Različny od nulovogo ideala at the end of the definition concerns the discriminant ideal itself. It is generated by trace determinants, and nonvanishing for a linearly independent choice of elements establishes that the ideal is nonzero. A weaker statement that some matrix might be nonzero would not convey that conclusion. The historical rationale reports a scan check; the new examination here is of the current textual passage, not a repeated independent inspection of the scan.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Zaključok kasaje se ideala, ne samo matrice.

Textual comparison: The conclusion concerns the ideal, not merely a matrix.

Izrična hipoteza o nenulovom idealu

An explicit nonzero-ideal hypothesis

Razlog: Ideal razny od nulovogo ideala jest izrična forma korotšego nenulovy ideal. Byla izbrana, aby kontrast nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala ostal čitlivy pri prěhode do prstena ostatkov. Pasaža prědstavjaje takovy ideal kako produkt konečno mnogyh vzajemno prostyh primarnyh idealov. Ona odrěđuje ješče svojstvo jih pridruženih prostyh idealov; ta čest ne dolžna propasti pri skračenju frazy. Razny i različny sut varianty jezyčnogo vyraženja, ne dva različne matematične uslovja.

Reason: Ideal razny od nulovogo ideala is an explicit form of the shorter nonzero ideal. It was chosen to keep the zero–unit contrast legible when passing to residue rings. The passage expresses such an ideal as a product of finitely many relatively prime primary ideals. It also specifies a property of their associated prime ideals; that part must survive any shortening of the phrase. Razny and različny are variants of expression, not two different mathematical conditions.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Obě česti formulacije noset matematične uslovja.

Textual comparison: Both parts of the formulation carry mathematical conditions.

Rang jedan kako predikat

Rank one as a predicate

Razlog: Imaje rang jedan prěvodi staršu imennu konstrukciju prostym predikatom. Rang jest relativny k ukazanomu podpolju \(P\); pri danoj hipoteze algebraičnogo zatvorjenja i prostosti nulovogo ideala tekst zaključuje, že prsten jest identičny s \(P\). Jediničny element togda služi kako modulna baza. To ne jest tvrdženje, že libovoljny prsten ima jedin element. Zapis dava prednost obyčnoj sovrěmennoj formulaciji, ale široka razumělivost ne byla změrjena čitatelskym testom.

Reason: Imaje rang jedan renders an older nominal construction as a direct predicate. Rank is relative to the specified subfield \(P\); under the algebraic-closure and zero-ideal primality hypotheses, the text concludes that the ring is identical with \(P\). The identity element then serves as a module basis. This does not say that an arbitrary ring has only one element. The record prefers ordinary contemporary phrasing, but broad intelligibility was not measured by a reader test.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jedinica tvori modulnu bazu pri ukazanyh hipotezah.

Textual comparison: The identity forms a module basis under the stated hypotheses.

Obseg nepisanogo modula

The scope of an implicit modulus

Razlog: Od nyně vse formuly trěba razuměti mod označuje obseg dalšego čitanja, ne novu matematičnu operaciju. Aktualna rečenica najprvo dava modul \((\varrho,t)\), a od formuly (27) širši modul, vključajuči i, J i vyše formy. Kratko zaglavje slovnika ne dolžno izbrisati tu drugu čest. Izrična konstrukcija trěba razuměti bila izbrana zaradi jasnosti; zapis čuva otvoreno pytanje o modalnosti i porjadku slov. Simboly samogo modula ne prevodet se pri změně pisma.

Reason: Od nyně vse formuly trěba razuměti mod specifies the scope of subsequent reading, not a new mathematical operation. The current sentence first gives modulus \((\varrho,t)\), then from formula (27) a larger modulus including i, J and higher forms. The short dictionary heading must not erase that second part. The explicit trěba razuměti construction was chosen for clarity; the record preserves an open question about modality and word order. The modulus symbols themselves are not translated when the script changes.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Od formuly (27) modul jest širši.

Textual comparison: The modulus becomes larger from formula (27).

Konečny i nenulovy skalar

A finite nonzero scalar

Razlog: Od nuly različny i konečny jest dvojno ograničenje realnogo skalara \(c\). Ono stojit pri prěpisu relacije medžu obrazami i početkovymi veličinami; obe vlastnosti trěba sohraniti. Konečny ne kaže, že množina možlivyh \(c\) jest konečna, a nenulovy ne znači pozitivny. Prosta spojka i činji hipotezy čitlivymi bez preměny jih matematičnogo obsega. Tuto jest formulacija uslovja, ne slovnikov novy tehničny imennik.

Reason: Od nuly različny i konečny places two restrictions on the real scalar \(c\). They occur when rewriting a relation between images and original quantities; both must remain. Finite does not say that the set of possible \(c\) is finite, and nonzero does not mean positive. The simple conjunction makes the hypotheses legible without changing their mathematical scope. This is the wording of a condition, not a newly coined technical noun.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Konečnost skalara ne jest konečnost množiny izborov.

Textual comparison: Finiteness of the scalar is not finiteness of the set of choices.

Hipoteza pri nenulovosti determinanta

The hypothesis for determinant nonvanishing

Razlog: Nenulovy, skoro tau sut linearno nezavisne pripojuje nenulovost determinanta k izričnoj hipoteze. Skoro tu znači kogda uslovje izpolnjeno, ne tvrdženje o skorom časovom nastupanju. Aktualny tekst nazyvaje elementy \(\tau_1,\ldots,\tau_n\) i potom vyvodi nenulovost diskriminantnogo ideala. Samo n-spis elementov bez nezavisnosti ne dava togo zaključka. Zapis upominaje ranějšu skanovu prověrku; novym svědectvom tu jest pročitana aktualna pasaža, ne povtoreny pregled skana.

Reason: Nenulovy, skoro tau sut linearno nezavisne attaches nonvanishing of the determinant to an explicit hypothesis. Skoro here means when the condition is satisfied, not that something will happen soon in time. The current text names the elements \(\tau_1,\ldots,\tau_n\) and then deduces nonvanishing of the discriminant ideal. An n-tuple without independence does not supply that conclusion. The record mentions an earlier scan check; the new evidence here is the examined current passage, not another inspection of the scan.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Hipoteza odnosi se k izbranym elementam.

Textual comparison: The hypothesis concerns the selected elements.

Nenulovy element s nulovoju stepenju

A nonzero element with a zero power

Razlog: Nenulovy element i někoja stepenj izčezaje opisujut nilpotentny svědok, ne protivrěčje. Element sam ne jest nula, ale někoja jego pozitivna stepenj jest nula. V dokazě element \(G(\gamma)\) nastavaje po razširjenju koeficientov; jego nenulovost vyhodi iz linearnoj nezavisnosti nižših stepenjev, a p-ta stepenj izčezaje po definicijnom uravnenju. Glagol izčezaje zato znači algebraičnu ravnost nuli, ne postupno umenšenje veličiny.

Reason: Nenulovy element and někoja stepenj izčezaje describe a nilpotent witness, not a contradiction. The element itself is nonzero but some positive power is zero. In the proof \(G(\gamma)\) is constructed after coefficient extension; its nonvanishing follows from linear independence of lower powers, while its pth power vanishes by the defining equation. Izčezaje therefore means algebraic equality to zero, not gradual decrease in magnitude.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nenulovost elementa i nulovost jeho stepenja imajut razne dokazy.

Textual comparison: Nonvanishing of the element and vanishing of its power have different justifications.

Prědpoloženje v obratnom dokazu

An assumption in a converse proof

Razlog: Predpostavjeno razloženje čuva logičny směr obrata: razloženje nyně jest hipoteza, iz ktorej dolžne slědovati aksiomy. Aktualny tekst piše prědpoloženo razloženje i izrično ogrančuje jego formu. Egzistencija jediničnogo elementa tam ne jest prědpoložena; ona ne smi byti neprimětno dodana slovnikom. Změna pridavnika ne měnja dokaznu rolu, ale skračenje do prosto razloženje by skrylo, čto jest dano i čto trěba vyvesti.

Reason: Predpostavjeno razloženje preserves the direction of the converse: decomposition is now an assumption from which the axioms are to follow. The current text writes prědpoloženo razloženje and explicitly restricts its form. Existence of an identity element is not assumed there; the dictionary must not silently add it. Changing the adjective does not change its logical role, but shortening it simply to decomposition would hide what is given and what must be derived.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Jediničny element ne jest početkova hipoteza.

Textual comparison: An identity element is not an initial hypothesis.

Kredit osobě, ktora predložila rabotu

Credit to the person presenting the paper

Razlog: Predloženo g. Šurom označuje osobu, ktora predložila rabotu akademiji. To bibliografičny kredit, ne pripisanje jej avtorstva Šuru: zaglavje odrěđeno nazyvaje Noether i Brauera. Inštrumentalna forma Šurom i latinsko Š izbrany sut, aby kiriličny prěpis dal Шуром. To motivacija pisma; ona ne zaměnjaje originalno ime Schur v bibliografičnoj identifikaciji. Kratka formula dolžna sohraniti i rolu, i konkretnu osobu.

Reason: Predloženo g. Šurom identifies the person who presented the paper to the academy. It is bibliographic credit, not attribution of authorship to Schur: the heading separately identifies Noether and Brauer. Instrumental Šurom and Latin Š were chosen so that Cyrillic conversion yields Шуром. That is a script-related motivation; it does not replace the original name Schur in bibliographic identification. The compact formula must retain both the role and the particular person.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Predloženo ne znači napisano.

Textual comparison: Presented does not mean written.

Dopustimost lokalnogo izbora bazy

Possibility of choosing a local basis

Razlog: Što jest vsegda možno čuva tvrdženje o dopustimosti izbora, ne obeščanje proizvoljnoj konstrukcije. V pasaži možno izbrati elementy iz početkovogo poredka \(\mathfrak T\) kako modulnu bazu lokalizovanogo poredka. Aktualna fraza kako jest vsegda možno ima tu istu rolu. Ona ne govori, že početkovy modul ima globalnu svobodnu bazu nad početkovym prstenom. Arhivna motivacija upominaje obnovu po skanu; naš aktualny pregled podtvrđaje tekstovu formulaciju, ne samostojnu skanovu prověrku.

Reason: Što jest vsegda možno preserves an assertion that a particular choice is possible, not a promise of arbitrary construction. The passage permits elements of the original order \(\mathfrak T\) to be chosen as a module basis of the localized order. Current kako jest vsegda možno plays the same role. It does not assert that the original module has a global free basis over the original ring. The historical rationale mentions recovery from a scan; the present examination confirms the textual formulation, not an independent scan check.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Lokalna baza ne ustanavjaje globalnu svobodnu bazu.

Textual comparison: A local basis does not establish a global free basis.

Adaptacija imen Weber i Steinitz

Adaptation of the names Weber and Steinitz

Razlog: Veber i E. Štejnic sut adaptovane pisanja vlastnyh imen, ne novy matematičny leksikon. Historijny izbor měl tehničnu pričinu: neprěvedene Weber moglo dati směšane pismo pri avtomatičnoj kirilizaciji. Aktualna pasaža doista ima Veberu i E. Štejnicu pri připisaniu abstraktnoj definicije polja. Pisanje dolžno sohraniti prepoznavanje Webera i Steinitza i njihove kredity. Kontrola pisma sama ne ustanavjaje, že adaptacija jest jedina jezyčno dopustima forma.

Reason: Veber and E. Štejnic are adapted spellings of proper names, not new mathematical vocabulary. The recorded choice had a technical reason: unadapted Weber could produce mixed script during automatic Cyrillic conversion. The current passage does have Veberu and E. Štejnicu when crediting the abstract definition of a field. The spelling must preserve identification of Weber and Steinitz and their scholarly credit. Script checking alone does not establish the adaptation as the only linguistically permissible form.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Adaptovano pisanje ne odstranjaje ljudsky kredit.

Textual comparison: Adapted spelling does not remove human credit.

Izomorfizm kako pričina zaključka

Isomorphism as the reason for an inference

Razlog: Zaradi izomorfizma kolc klasov ostatkov jest pričinna svez, ne samo pomenanje srodnyh objektov. Aktualna forma zaměnjuje kolc slovom prstenov. Pasaža upotrěbjaje izomorfizm dlja prenosa svojstva multiplikacijnogo prstena na lokalizovany prsten, potom priměnjaje ranějši rezultat o glavnyh idealah. Izpustiti zaradi značilo by oslabiti vidlivu osnovu zaključka. Samo izomorfizm kvocientov ne nazyva početkovy i lokalizovany prsten bukvalno jednakymi.

Reason: Zaradi izomorfizma kolc klasov ostatkov is a causal link, not merely a mention of related objects. The current form replaces kolc with prstenov. The passage uses the isomorphism to transfer the multiplication-ring property to the localized ring, then applies the earlier result concerning principal ideals. Dropping zaradi would obscure the stated basis of the inference. Isomorphism of the residue rings does not call the original and localized rings literally identical.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Pričinna svez ostaje čest dokaza.

Textual comparison: The causal connection remains part of the proof.

Prěhod k reducibilnosti i soglasovanje

Becoming reducible and agreement

Razlog: Stavajut reducibilne kaže, že razgledane polne transvekcije postavajut reducibilne v danoj konstrukciji. Glagol čuva prěhod, a množstvena forma odnosi se k transvekcijam, ne k jedinom funkcionalnomu determinantu v toj samoj rečenici. Internacionalna osnova reducibil- nastavlja obšču terminologiju. Arhivny zapis ostavlja morfologiju i soglasovanje otvorenymi dlja jezyčnoj ocěny; matematicky kontekst sam ne jest dokazom polnoj gramatičnoj normativnosti.

Reason: Stavajut reducibilne says that the full transvections under discussion become reducible in the specified construction. The verb retains the transition, and the plural refers to the transvections, not to the singular functional determinant in the same sentence. The international reducibil- stem continues the terminology. The historical note leaves morphology and agreement open to linguistic assessment; mathematical context alone is not proof of complete grammatical normativity.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Soglasovanje prati transvekcije, ne susědny jedinstveny imenik.

Textual comparison: Agreement follows the transvections, not the neighbouring singular noun.

Odkazka na razširjenje istogo ranga

Reference to a same-rank extension

Razlog: Definirano, kako v §1, 2, kako kolco togo samogo ranga čuva i odkazku, i točny tip razširjenja. Aktualny tekst piše prsten i osobno vyžaduje otsutnost děliteljev nuly i zadany prěsěk. Sledujuči argument o diskriminante koristi sohranjenje bazy. Zato fraza ne označuje libovoljno razširjenje koeficientov bez tyh prědpoloženj. Ranějša motivacija o oprave tiskanoj odkazki ostaje historijnym zapisom; zde prověřeny jest aktualny tekst i jego dokazna rola.

Reason: Definirano, kako v §1, 2, kako kolco togo samogo ranga preserves both the reference and the exact type of extension. The current text writes prsten and separately requires absence of zero divisors and a specified intersection. The subsequent discriminant argument uses preservation of the basis. The phrase therefore does not denote an arbitrary coefficient extension without those assumptions. The earlier rationale concerning restoration of the printed reference remains a historical record; the present check concerns the current text and its role in the proof.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Odkazka svjazuje formulaciju s opredělenoju konstrukcijeju.

Textual comparison: The reference ties the formulation to a specified construction.

Matematična libovoljnost

Mathematical arbitrariness

Razlog: Libovolne veličiny, nyně libovoljne veličiny, označuje matematičnu libovoljnost \(p\) i \(q\), ne nahodne ili kapriciozne izbory. Rečenica dava čitatelju pokyn, kako razuměti veličiny v identičnosti; ona ne kaže, že možno bez uslovja izměniti vse simbole formula. Shranjene ruske i ukrajinske formy imajut tože kvantifikacijno značenje. Korotka fraza ima smysl samo s ukazanymi argumentami, ne kako neograničeno pravilo svobody.

Reason: Libovolne veličiny, now libovoljne veličiny, expresses mathematical arbitrariness of \(p\) and \(q\), not random or capricious choices. The sentence tells the reader how to treat the quantities in the identity; it does not say that all symbols in the formula can be altered without restriction. The preserved Russian and Ukrainian forms have the same quantificational meaning. The short phrase is meaningful with its specified arguments, not as an unrestricted rule of freedom.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Libovoljnost ima ukazanyh nositeljev.

Textual comparison: Arbitrariness has specified arguments.

Črta v oznakě dobrogo poredka

The prime in the notation for a well-order

Razlog: Znak \(\Omega'\) označuje drugo dobro uporjadkovanje, ne proizvodnu od prvogo. Rěči Omega prime v historijnom zapisu sut opis simbola, ne čest medžuslovjanskogo termina. Aktualny dokaz izbira prvy ješče neprirěđeny element po tomu drugomu poredku; tím nastaje vzajemno jednoznačno prirěđenje medžu bazami. Zachovanje črty jest zato potrěbno dlja razlikovanja dvoh izborov. Jezyk okolnoj frazy može se změniti, ale matematična oznaka ostaje ista.

Reason: The symbol \(\Omega'\) denotes a second well-order, not a derivative of the first. Omega prime in the historical record is a description of the symbol, not part of the Interslavic term. The current proof selects the first still-unassigned element in that second order, thereby constructing a bijective assignment between the bases. Retaining the prime is necessary to distinguish the two choices. The language surrounding it may change, but the mathematical identifier remains the same.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Črta razlikuje dva poredky; ne označuje derivaciju.

Textual comparison: The prime distinguishes two orders; it does not indicate differentiation.

Odkazka na numerovano svojstvo

Reference to a numbered property

Razlog: Gubi svojstvo 1 jest odkazka na točno numerovano uslovje, ne obča fraza o gubljenju informaciji. V definiciji veličiny prvogo tipa pri adjunkciji vvodet algebraično-drobno čislo v oblast cělosti. Dokaz potom pomnožuje \(y(\eta)\) polinomom, aby to svojstvo prestalo iměti město. Simbol Y iz kratkogo zapisa ne smi zaměniti aktualne \(y\) i \(\eta\) ni izbrisati broj 1. Zachovanje te odkazki jest razlog izbora frazy i uslovje sledovanja dokazovoj argumentaciji.

Reason: Gubi svojstvo 1 refers to a precisely numbered condition, not to a general loss of information. In the definition, adjoining quantities of the first type introduces an algebraically fractional number into the integral domain. The proof then multiplies \(y(\eta)\) by a polynomial so that this property ceases to hold. The Y of the abbreviated record must not replace the actual \(y\) and \(\eta\) or remove the number 1. Preserving that reference is the reason for the phrase and is necessary for following the argument.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Broj odkazki i aktualne oznaky trebujut sohranjenja.

Textual comparison: The reference number and actual symbols must be preserved.

Čislovo fiksovanje koeficientov

Fixing coefficients numerically

Razlog: Čislovo fiksovati označuje zadanje čislovyh cěnnostij někoj česti koeficientov posrědstvom linearnoj transformacije. Arhiv izrično odlišuje to od algebraičnogo izključenja koeficientov. Pasaža dodava ključno uslovje: relacije, platne dlja specialnoj formy, ostajut platne i v občem slučaju. Zato čislovo ne znači, že ide samo o približnom numeričnom izračunu. Glagol i njegova dopolnjenja čuvajut točnu rolu specializacije v argumentu.

Reason: Čislovo fiksovati denotes assigning numerical values to some coefficients by a linear transformation. The record explicitly distinguishes this from algebraic elimination of the coefficients. The passage adds the crucial condition that relations valid for the special form remain valid in the general case. Numerically therefore does not mean merely an approximate numerical computation. The verb and its complements preserve the exact role of specialization in the argument.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Fiksovanje cěnnostij ne jest algebraično izključenje.

Textual comparison: Fixing values is not algebraic elimination.

Padežne formy nazvy v naslově

Case forms of a term in a title

Razlog: Razpadno polje jest osnovna nazva; razpadne polja i razpadnyh poljah sut jej pluralne padežne formy, ne tri razne termina. V naslově sovmestnoj raboty s Richardom Brauerom predlog o potrěbuje lokativ: o minimalnyh razpadnyh poljah. Arhivny komentar izbral slovjansku osnovu razpad- naměsto germanskogo zaimovanja i upominal anglijsku kontrolu, no bez dostatočnogo citata dlja novogo nezavisnogo podtvrđenja. Gramatika naslova i priznanje sovavtorstva ostajut oddělne od izbora leksikona.

Reason: Razpadno polje is the headword; razpadne polja and razpadnyh poljah are its plural case forms, not three different terms. In the title of the joint paper with Richard Brauer, o takes the locative: o minimalnyh razpadnyh poljah. The archived note preferred the Slavic razpad- formation to a Germanic borrowing and mentioned an English control, but supplied no sufficiently specific citation for a new independent corroboration. Title grammar and acknowledgement of coauthorship are separate from the lexical choice.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Lokativ v naslově ne jest novy termin.

Textual comparison: The title’s locative is not a new term.

Kratka odkazka na izvor dokaza

A short reference to a proof source

Razlog: Za dokaz sravn. H. Grell jest kratka bibliografična odkazka. Ona pripisuje izvor dokaza imenovanomu matematikovi, ne tvrdi, že prevoditelj sam izvršil novy nezavisny dokaz. Aktualna podnožna primětka piše Za dokaz sravni. H. Grell.; razlika meždu skračenjem i polnějšim glagolom ne měni adresata odkazky. Arhiv opisuje obnovjenje pečatnoj primětky, no nyněšnje objasnjenje ne tvrdí novu vizualnu proverku skena. Ime, směr odkazky i njezina uloga morajut ostati vidime.

Reason: Za dokaz sravn. H. Grell is a short bibliographic reference. It identifies the named mathematician as the source of a proof; it does not claim that the translator supplied a fresh independent proof. The present footnote writes Za dokaz sravni. H. Grell. The abbreviation and fuller verb have the same addressee. The archive describes restoration of the printed note, but this explanation claims no fresh visual scan check. The name, direction of reference and function must remain visible.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Bibliografična odkazka zachovuje čužy naučny doprinos.

Textual comparison: The bibliographic reference preserves another scholar’s contribution.

Prevedena proza i zachovany bibliografičny naslov

Translated prose and a retained bibliographic title

Razlog: Arhivna fraza K aksiomatice ... Idealtheorie ne jest polny bibliografičny naslov. Aktualna podnožna primětka prevodi uvodno objasnjenje o aksiomatice multiplikacijskyh prstenov, a potom odkazuje na dělo skračeno imenovano Idealtheorie. Razlog v arhivě, že cěly red jest naslov, zato trěbuje popravu. Zachovany německy naslov pomaga najdti citovanu rabotu; prevedena okolna proza objasnjaje, dlja čego citat služi. To ne jest směšany medžuslovjansko-německy termin dlja aksiomatiki.

Reason: The archived phrase K aksiomatice ... Idealtheorie is not a complete bibliographic title. The actual footnote translates the introductory explanation about the axiomatics of multiplication rings and then cites the work under the short title Idealtheorie. The archived rationale treating the whole string as a title therefore needs correction. The retained German title helps identify the cited work; the translated surrounding prose explains why it is cited. This is not a hybrid Interslavic–German technical term for axiomatics.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Okolna proza ne jest čestju bibliografičnogo naslova.

Textual comparison: The surrounding prose is not part of the bibliographic title.

Avtorkina primětka o proverki izračuna

The author’s note on checking a calculation

Razlog: Za kontrolu računa uvodi avtorkin sposob proverky izračuna. V sledovajučej tablicě stojat dve specialne formy i njihove vrednosti; one dopolnjajut dvojnu redukciju. Račun znači matematičny izračun, ne račun za platbu. Tuto jest jezyk samej raboty, ne komentar o proverki AI-prevoda. Citovanje dvuh testovyh slučajev ne daje osnovu tvrdženju, že tym byla nezavisno dokazana vsaka formula v cěloj rabotě.

Reason: Za kontrolu računa introduces the author’s way of checking a computation. The following table gives two special forms and their values, supplementing double reduction. Račun means mathematical calculation, not a bill. This is the language of the original work, not commentary on checking the AI translation. The two test cases do not justify a claim that every formula in the paper has thereby received an independent proof.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Dva slučaja ne zaměnjajut vse dokazy.

Textual comparison: Two cases do not replace all proofs.

Oznaka lokalnogo dopolnjenja teoremy

A label for a local addition to a theorem

Razlog: Dodatok jest kratka oznaka lokalnogo dopolnjenja teoremy. Ne označaje bibliografičny dodatok na koncu knigy i ne dodavaje novy razděl samym slovom. Zde primětka oslabjaje potrěbu redukovanogo predstavjenja do najkratšego i potom objasnjaje, čto ostaje jedinstveno. Oznaka mora ostati pri tom argumentě, da čitatelj vidi jeji zavisimost od teoremy IX. Dodatok i korolar mogut iměti blizku izložiteljnu ulogu, no arhiv nedava razloga zaměniti avtorkinu oznaku bez potrěby.

Reason: Dodatok is a short label for a local addition to a theorem. It is not a bibliographic appendix at the end of the book and does not by itself create a new section. Here the note weakens reduced representation to shortest representation and explains what remains unique. The label belongs beside that argument so readers can see its dependence on theorem IX. An addendum and a corollary may have similar expository functions, but the archive supplies no reason to replace the author’s label unnecessarily.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Lokalna oznaka ostaje pri svojem dokazu.

Textual comparison: The local label stays with its proof.

Padežna forma nazvy medžupolje

An inflected form of medžupolje

Razlog: Medžupolja i medžupolj ne treba čitati kak dve nove jedinstvene nazvy. V lokalizovanoj větě konečno mnogo medžupolj poslednja forma služi kak genitiv množiny. Arhivny komentar, ktory nazyvaje ju kratkoju nazvoju i daje kiriličny prepis, zato ne jest dostatočny osnov dlja napravjenja iz nje samostalnogo osnovnogo slova. Značenje ostaje polje medžu dvoma ukazanymi poljami. Determinističny prepis v kirilicu ne daje nezavisno podtvrđenje ni gramatiki, ni razumljivosti složenicy.

Reason: Medžupolja and medžupolj should not be read as two newly coined singular headwords. In the located sentence konečno mnogo medžupolj, the latter functions as a genitive plural. The archived comment calling it a compact term and giving a Cyrillic rendering is therefore insufficient grounds for treating it as a separate lemma. The meaning remains a field between two specified fields. Deterministic Cyrillic conversion independently verifies neither grammar nor intelligibility of the compound.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Kirilica ne tvori vtoru nezavisnu jezyčnu proverku.

Textual comparison: Cyrillic does not supply a second independent linguistic check.

Diskriminant kako kvadrat determinanta

Discriminant as a determinant square

Razlog: Opis diskriminant kako kvadrat determinanta razjasnjaje formulu, a ne vvodit nezavisny termin. \(S\) tut jest slěd, a alfa-elementy tvorjat bazu. Kvadrat odnaša se k cělomu determinantu matricy konjugovanyh baznyh elementov, ne k oddělnym elementam matricy. Vertikalne črty označajut determinant, ne apsolutnu veličinu ni kvadrat kompleksnogo modula. Arhiv spominaje ranějšu prověrku izvornogo obraza; nynějšno objašnjenje opiraje se na zachovanu formulu i kontekst, ne tvrdi novu prověrku obraza.

Reason: The description discriminant as the square of a determinant explains the formula rather than introducing an independent term. Here \(S\) is the trace and the alpha elements form a basis. The square applies to the entire determinant of the matrix of conjugate basis elements, not to its individual entries. The vertical bars denote a determinant, not absolute value or squared complex modulus. The archive mentions an earlier image comparison; this explanation relies on the preserved formula and context and does not claim a new image check.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Črty označajut determinant, ne kompleksny modul.

Textual comparison: The bars denote a determinant, not complex modulus.

Neizměnny zapis slědovogo determinanta

Unchanged trace-determinant notation

Razlog: To jest izbor zapisa, ne prevod slova: izraz \(|S(\alpha_i\alpha_j)|\) ostaje matematičnym identifikatorom v različnyh jazykah i pismenah. Latinsko \(S\), grčke bukvy i indeksy ne trěba transliterovati kako običnu prozu. Kontekst govori o nezavisnoj bazi polja prvogo roda i nenulovom diskriminantu; ne dava takovo tvrdženje za proizvoljnu zavisnu množinu. Arhivna naměra zachovati formulu bajt za bajtom ne zaměnjuje prověrku vsakoj gotovoj versije.

Reason: This is a notation choice, not a word translation: \(|S(\alpha_i\alpha_j)|\) remains a mathematical identifier across languages and scripts. Latin \(S\), Greek letters and indices must not be transliterated as ordinary prose. The context concerns an independent basis of a field of the first kind and a nonzero discriminant; it makes no such assertion for an arbitrary dependent set. The archived intention to preserve the formula byte for byte does not substitute for checking each resulting edition.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nezavisnost bazy jest čestju konteksta.

Textual comparison: Independence of the basis is part of the context.

Determinanty n-torkov i jih ideal

Determinants of n-tuples and their ideal

Razlog: Slovo determinant lokalizuje objašnjenje, medžutym \(|S(\tau_i\tau_j)|\) ostaje formulom. Tau-elementy proběgajut vse razsmatrjane n-torky; ne sut od počętka vsi nazvane bazami. Determinant jest nenulovy pri nezavisnosti, a ideal jest generovany determinantami tyh n-torkov. Zaměna tau na alfa radi vněšne jednolikosťi by zakryla razliku dvuh kontekstov. Takže trěba zachovati razliku medžu množinoju generatorov ideala i jednym generatorom v specialnom slučaju.

Reason: The word determinant localizes the explanation while \(|S(\tau_i\tau_j)|\) remains a formula. The tau elements range over the relevant n-tuples; they are not all assumed at the outset to be bases. The determinant is nonzero when the elements are independent, and the ideal is generated by the determinants of these tuples. Replacing tau by alpha for visual uniformity would hide the distinction between the contexts. The set of ideal generators must also be distinguished from the single generator in the special case.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Ne vsaka razsmatrjana n-torka jest baza.

Textual comparison: Not every tuple considered is a basis.

Latinska bukva v odsylkě na §12 C)

Latin letter in the reference to §12 C)

Razlog: Odsylka §12 C) označaje konkretno podrazděljenje i ne jest tekst dlja jazykovoj zaměny. Latinska bukva C mora ostati C, takože v kiriličnom tekstu; podobny vid kiriličnoj bukvy ne garantuje jednaky identifikator. Arhiv predpisuje zaščitny TeX-zapis s mbox, ale nynějšna latinska odsylka ima običny zapis C. Zato tut dokumentujemo naměru i identitet odsylky, ne tvrdimo, že arhivny obvoj jest v nynějšnom tekstu realizovany ili že vsaka kirilična odsylka byla nyně prověrena.

Reason: The reference §12 C) identifies a particular subsection and is not prose to be translated. Latin C must remain C, including in Cyrillic text; a similar-looking Cyrillic letter does not guarantee the same identifier. The archive prescribes a protective TeX mbox wrapper, but the present Latin reference uses plain C. This entry therefore documents the intended protection and reference identity, not a claim that the archived wrapper is implemented or that every Cyrillic reference has now been checked.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Nynějšny zapis ne ima arhivno predpisanogo mbox.

Textual comparison: The present notation lacks the mbox prescribed in the archive.

Naslov obzora konstrukcije

Heading for an overview of the construction

Razlog: Obzor tvorjenja sistema jest orientujuči naslov, ne novy matematičny termin. On vvodit tabličny opis konstrukcije: kontrakcije, nerazložime formy, redukcije i nove reduktanty. Tvorjenje bylo izbrano kako obšče nazvanje postupka, soglasno drugim městam prevoda. Obzor ne dava dozvoljenje skratiti avtorkinu konstrukciju do rezjume: tablica i jeje vysvětljenja sut predmetom polnogo prevoda. Takovy izbor trěba dokumentovati s terminologijeju, ale ne čisliti kako novo slovo matematičnogo slovnika.

Reason: Obzor tvorjenja sistema is an orienting heading, not a new mathematical term. It introduces a tabular account of the construction: contractions, indecomposable forms, reductions and new reductants. Tvorjenje was chosen as a general name for the process, consistently with other passages. Overview does not license replacing the author’s construction with a summary: the table and its explanations require complete translation. Such a choice belongs in the documentation but should not be counted as a new mathematical word.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Naslov orientuje čitatelja v polnoj konstrukciji.

Textual comparison: The heading guides the reader through the full construction.

Od porędka k prstenam nad poljem

From an order to rings over a field

Razlog: Naslov sohranjaje prěhod od algebričnogo porędka k prstenam konečnogo ranga nad poljem, ne prěhod od običnogo raspoređenja. Kontekst tvori količnik \(R=T/Tp\) nad poljem, izomorfnym sootvětnomu količniku bazovogo prstena. Arhivny zapis porjadka, kolcam, vzhodno i nynějšny poredka, prstenam, po odnošenju ne sut jedna i ta že površnost; slovnik ih pokazuje kako svęzane realizacije, ne pripisuje staru frazu nynějšnomu tekstu. Predlog mora izraziti bazovo polje otnosno ktoroho jest rang konečny.

Reason: The heading preserves the passage from an algebraic order to rings of finite rank over a field, not from an ordinary arrangement. The context forms the quotient \(R=T/Tp\) over a field isomorphic to the corresponding quotient of the base ring. The archived wording porjadka, kolcam, vzhodno and the present poredka, prstenam, po odnošenju are not the same surface form; the dictionary relates them without attributing the old wording to the current text. The prepositional phrase must identify the base field relative to which the rank is finite.

Sravnjenje s tekstom: Naslov govori o algebričnom porędku.

Textual comparison: The heading concerns an algebraic order.

Naslov obzora redukcij

Heading for an overview of reductions
