Hurwitz v citaciji, Hurvica v prozě / Hurwitz in a citation, Hurvica in prose

Razlog: Dvadset nesklonjenyh imen čuva originalny zapis: medžu nimi Enriques, \(W_i\)rtinger, Weierstrass, Loewy, Weyl i Du Pasquier. Poslědnje jest cělo prezimeno s partikuloju, ne samo Pasquier. V izrazu Hurwitz tamže ime ima citacijsku funkciju; sklonjeno Hurvica jest gramatično uključeno v medžuslovjansku frazu. Zato dvě forme mogu legitimno obstajati v jednoj knigě, ako njih razlika ostaje jasna.

Reason: Twenty uninflected names retain their original spelling, among them Enriques, \(W_i\)rtinger, Weierstrass, Loewy, Weyl and Du Pasquier. The last is the complete surname with its particle, not Pasquier alone. Hurwitz in Hurwitz tamže functions as a citation, whereas inflected Hurvica is integrated into an Interslavic phrase. Both forms can therefore legitimately occur in one book when their functions remain clear.

Izvory: Polny spisok sravnjenyh vlastnyh imen, odděl 160.

Sources: Complete personal-name comparison inventory, group 160

Inicijaly i partikuly v imenah / Initials and particles in names

Razlog: J. König, A. Hurwitz, G. Köthe, A. Châtelet i B. L. van der Waerden čuvajut inicijaly i partikuly skupa s prezimenem. Dvadset zabilěženih pojavjenij ne ustanavjaje dvadset novih terminov: priměnjaje jedno pravilo k točno identifikovanym imenam. Skryti samo Waerden, ostavljajuči van der za avtomatičny prěpis, dalo by směšano ime.

Reason: J. König, A. Hurwitz, G. Köthe, A. Châtelet and B. L. van der Waerden retain initials and particles with their surnames. The twenty recorded occurrences do not establish twenty new terms: they apply one rule to identified names. Protecting Waerden alone while automatically converting van der would produce a mixed-script name.

Izvory: Polny spisok sravnjenyh vlastnyh imen, odděl 161.

Sources: Complete personal-name comparison inventory, group 161

Svjazane imena dvuh avtorov / Paired authors’ names

Razlog: G. Wallenberg–A. Guldberg i Artin–van der Waerden sut svjazane avtorske identifikacije. Ih česti, inicijaly i spojny znak treba čuvati skupa. Isto pravilo kontroluje ostale zabilěžene nesklonjene imena, kako W. Schmeidler, R. Weitzenböck i H. Prüfer. To čuva naučno priznanje i možnost najdti izvor; ne govori, kak treba tvoriti sklonjenu izvedenicu prezimena.

Reason: G. Wallenberg–A. Guldberg and Artin–van der Waerden are paired author identities. Components, initials and connecting punctuation belong together. The same rule governs the other recorded uninflected names, including W. Schmeidler, R. Weitzenböck and H. Prüfer. It preserves scholarly credit and source retrieval; it does not prescribe inflected derivatives of those surnames.

Izvory: Polny spisok sravnjenyh vlastnyh imen, odděl 162.

Sources: Complete personal-name comparison inventory, group 162

Originalno nazvanje i město / An original title and a place name

Razlog: Algebraische Theorie der Körper i Rationale Funktionenkörper ostajut originalnymi nazvanjami, kako i polno nazvanje s Lorentzgruppe. Göttinger Nachrichten i \(W_i\)ener Sitzungsberichte sut časopisne ili institucionalne nazvanja, ne prislovnikove frazy prěklada. Göttingen i Dixmuiden označajut města. Dvadset izrazov v tablici jest klasifikovano po toj funkcii; čuvanje nazvanja ne směje obejmati sosednju medžuslovjansku frazu.

Reason: Algebraische Theorie der Körper and Rationale Funktionenkörper remain original titles, as does the complete title containing Lorentzgruppe. Göttinger Nachrichten and \(W_i\)ener Sitzungsberichte are publication or institutional names, not translated adverbial phrases. Göttingen and Dixmuiden identify places. The twenty expressions in the table are classified by function; preserving a title must not absorb neighboring Interslavic prose.

Izvory: Polny spisok naslovov, publikacij i měst, odděl 163.

Sources: Complete title, venue and place inventory, group 163

Jezyk bibliografije ne zavisi od jezyka knigy / Bibliographic language need not match the book’s language

Razlog: The Madison Colloquium 1913 čuva anglijsko nazvanje, Neue Begründung der algebraischen Zahlentheorie německo. R. Hölzer i W. Krull sut imena, Zürich i Göttingen města. Dvadset takyh izrazov čuva se v originalnoj formě zato, že ih funkcija jest identifikacija, ne objašnjenje matematiky. Slovjansko objašnjenje možno dodati oddělno, ale ne vměsto originalnogo nazvanja.

Reason: The Madison Colloquium 1913 retains its English title and Neue Begründung der algebraischen Zahlentheorie its German title. R. Hölzer and W. Krull identify people; Zürich and Göttingen identify places. Twenty expressions retain their original forms because their function is identification, not mathematical explanation. A Slavic gloss can be supplied separately, but should not replace the original title.

Izvory: Polny spisok naslovov, publikacij, imen i měst, odděl 164.

Sources: Complete title, venue, name and place inventory, group 164

Jordan–Hölder: citovano ime teoremy / Jordan–Hölder: a cited theorem name

Razlog: Jordan–Hölder i Hilbert–Furtwängler v citovanoj formě čuvajut oba prezimena. Isto pravilo obejma nazvanja i časopisne izrazy v ostalyh petnadseti zapisanyh cělinah. Dva nestandardne znaky v jednom nazvanju ne činjut dva termina. Cěla bibliografična fraza može zahranjati godinu i stranicu; njen obseg treba določiti po čitanju, ne po čislu bukv, ktore program ne poznaje.

Reason: Jordan–Hölder and Hilbert–Furtwängler retain both surnames in their cited forms. The rule also covers titles and publication expressions among the fifteen recorded units. Two nonstandard letters within one title do not make two terms. A complete bibliographic expression may include its year and pages; its extent must be determined by reading, not by counting characters a program does not recognize.

Izvory: Polny spisok imen, naslovov i citatov, odděl 165.

Sources: Complete name/title/citation inventory, group 165

Nazvanje knigy i nomer glavy / A book title and a chapter number

Razlog: Polna citacija Lürotha, Castelnuova ili Enriquesa jest jedna čitateljska cělina, daže ako sodržuje nekoliko tuđych slov. Pri Theorie d. algebr. Größen originalno nazvanje završaje se prěd Kap. VI. Rimsky nomer glavy ostaje strukturna oznaka, ne prěkladano slovo. Jedenadset takyh cělin pokazuje, čemu granica citacije potrěbuje analizu sadržanja.

Reason: A complete citation to Lüroth, Castelnuovo or Enriques is one reading unit even when it contains several foreign words. In Theorie d. algebr. Größen the original title ends before Kap. VI. The chapter numeral remains a structural reference rather than a translated word. These eleven units show why quotation boundaries require interpretation of content.

Izvory: Polny spisok citatov, odděl 166.

Sources: Complete citation inventory, group 166

Formula v nazvanju statje / A formula within an article title

Razlog: Hassevo nazvanje Über p-adische Schiefkörper sodržuje matematičny symbol p, izvorno v gotičnom obliku. Citat mora čuvati i tekst i symbol. Drugy priměr, Schurovo nazvanje, završaje se prěd Satz VII: to jest odvolanje na teoremu, ne čest nazvanja. Osm cělyh citacij vključaje takože odvojenje treh Fraenkelovyh rabot; ih ne treba sjediniti samo zato, že imajut jednogo avtora.

Reason: Hasse’s title Über p-adische Schiefkörper contains the mathematical symbol p, originally in fraktur. Both title text and symbol must be preserved. A Schur title ends before Satz VII: that is a theorem reference, not part of the title. The eight complete citations also keep three Fraenkel works distinct; common authorship does not make them one citation.

Izvory: Polny spisok citatov, odděl 167; matematičny zapis v citatah ostavaje netknjeny.

Sources: Complete citation inventory, group 167; literal mathematical payload retained

Povtorjeno ime ne znači isto upotrěbjenje / A repeated name need not have the same function

Razlog: Devetnadset izrazov zahranja skračenje D.–W., imena Ostrowski, Weitzenböck i W. Krull i nazvanje Encyklopädie d. math. \(W_i\)ss. Ako jedno ime nastupaje dvakrat v istoj frazě, kazdo pojavjenje mora byti svjazano so svojim kontekstom. Inače možno pomylno zaščititi sklonjenu prěkladanu formu vměsto citacije. Sosednje medžuslovjanske spojky ostajut čestju prěkladanoj prozy.

Reason: Nineteen expressions include D.–W., the names Ostrowski, Weitzenböck and W. Krull, and Encyklopädie d. math. \(W_i\)ss. When a name appears twice in one sentence, each occurrence must be tied to its own context. Otherwise an inflected translated form could be protected instead of the citation. Neighboring Interslavic connectives remain translated prose.

Izvory: Polny spisok povtorjenyh imen i citatov, odděl 168.

Sources: Complete repeated-name and citation inventory, group 168

D.–W. i neměnjane bibliografične frazy / D.–W. and retained bibliographic expressions

Razlog: Jedinnadset upotrěbjenij D.–W. sut odvolanja na avtorske inicijaly, ne rimsky nomery ili nepoznate slova. Drugyh deset cělin zahranja nazvanja, Braunschweig, Vieweg i německe Vgl. etwa. Posljednje jest bibliografičny ukazatel ‘sravni, napr.ʼ: jeho čuvanje jest odluka o citacijskom sloju, ne tvrdženje, že jest medžuslovjansky. V lokalizovanoj navigaciji takove frazy potrěbujut razumljivo objašnjenje.

Reason: Eleven D.–W. occurrences are author abbreviations, not Roman numerals or unknown words. Ten other units include titles, Braunschweig, Vieweg and German Vgl. etwa. The last is a bibliographic cue meaning ‘compare, for example’: retaining it is a choice about the citation layer, not a claim that it is Interslavic. Localized navigation still needs an intelligible explanation.

Izvory: Polny spisok skračenij, naslovov i citatov, odděl 169.

Sources: Complete abbreviation/title/citation inventory, group 169

Citovane W. Schmeidler i sklonjeno V. Šmajdlera / Cited W. Schmeidler and inflected V. Šmajdlera

Razlog: Originalno W. Schmeidler v bibliografiji ostaje neproměnjeno. Fraza V. Šmajdlera jest, naprotiv, medžuslovjansko sklonjenje; istorija izdanja prijela V. po uživanoj formě V. Šmajdlerom. Ta odluka o inicijalu mora byti vidima, ne prikryta kako čisto tipografična rabota. Četyrdeset tri citacijske cěliny čuvajut druge originalne forme. Dva nazvanja s matematičnym n razděljajut se okolo symbola; Bd. II der prěd Gesammelten Werke ostaje posebnym strukturnym odvolanjem.

Reason: Original W. Schmeidler remains unchanged in bibliographic citation. V. Šmajdlera, by contrast, is an inflected Interslavic form; the edition adopted V. following its existing V. Šmajdlerom. That decision about an initial must be visible, not disguised as merely typographic work. Forty-three citation units retain other original forms. Two titles containing mathematical n are divided around the symbol; Bd. II der before Gesammelten Werke remains a separate structural reference.

Sources: Complete citation inventory, group 170; integrated-name initial decision

Citacija v statji i v zbirnoj knigě / A citation in an article and in the collection

Razlog: Četrnadset citacij v Paper 2, 8, 22 i 24 mora imati jednaku originalnu formu v samostojnoj statji i v zbirnoj knigě. Zahranjajut Fischerovo nazvanje o modulsystemah, König, Dixmuiden, Ostrowski i nazvanje o absolutnoj irreducibilnosti. Nula nepoznatyh znakova v toj istorijnoj proverce dokazuje toliko zaključenu klasifikaciju tih izrazov. Ne dokazuje polnu terminologičnu pravilnost, razumljivost ili věrnost každoj formule. Te poslednje ocěny potrěbujut svoji dokazy.

Reason: Fourteen citations in Papers 2, 8, 22 and 24 must have the same original forms in the separate articles and the collection. They include Fischer’s title on module systems, König, Dixmuiden, Ostrowski and a title concerning absolute irreducibility. Zero unknown characters in that historical check establishes only completion of that expression classification. It does not establish complete terminological correctness, intelligibility or fidelity of every formula. Those judgments require their own evidence.

Dvě pisma, jeden prěvod / Two scripts, one translation

Latinica i kirilica ne sut dva nezavisne prěvody. Kirilična verzija prěpisuje medžuslovjansky tekst, ale zachovuje formule, bibliografične identičnosti i izvorne citaty. Razlika zavisi od funkcije v konkretnom městě: On može byti medžuslovjansky zaimennik, a II rimsko čislo. Ime v sklonjenoj frazě može iměti drugu funkciju od togo samogo imena v bibliografiji.

EN: Latin and Cyrillic are not independent translations. The Cyrillic version transliterates Interslavic text while retaining formulas, bibliographic identities, and source-language quotations. Function is contextual: On may be an Interslavic pronoun, whereas II is a Roman numeral. A name integrated into an inflected phrase may have a different function from the same name in a bibliography.

Odluka ne ustanavjaje opče pravilo za vsako pojavjenje istogo napisa. Za vse niže navedene slučaje tablice podatkov zachovujut datoteku, red i stupac. / These choices do not establish a global rule for every occurrence of the same spelling. Imena Grassmann i Jordan v tabeli sut česti prilagođenyh fraz Grassmann–Mullerovogo i Jordan-Helderov. Podobno, van der v frazah van der Vardena/Vardenu jest vključeno v jezyčny prěpis. To ne ustanavjaje novy način zapisa imena v bibliografiji. Dvě citatne skračenja Jan i pet nesklonjenyh pojavjenj Noether zachovujut izvorni zapis.

EN: The Grassmann and Jordan cases occur inside the integrated phrases Grassmann–Mullerovogo and Jordan-Helderov. Likewise, van der is included in transliteration in van der Vardena/Vardenu. This does not prescribe a new bibliographic spelling. Two citation-month abbreviations Jan and five undeclined Noether identities retain their source spelling.
